MUKTABODHA INDOLOGICAL RESEARCH INSTITUTEUse of this material (e-texts) is covered by Creative Commons license BY-NC 4.0. Catalog number : M00310 Uniform title: devīrahasya Main title: devī rahasya with pariśiṣṭas Editor : ram chandra kak Editor : harrabaṭṭa śastrī Description: The Devīrahasya and Uddhārakośa are published together in one volume. Edited by Rāma candra Kāka and Haribhaṭṭa śāstrī, it was published originally published in Kashmir in 1941. The Devīrahasya is considered to be a part of the Rudrayāmala. It appears to be have been composed in Kashmiri as it refers repeatedly to the goddesses Jvālāmukhī, śārikā, Mahārājñī, śāradā, Bhidā, and Bālā who have shrines in the Kathmandu Valley where they were very popular. The words Arabic words phirangahā and safak found on pages 307 and 317 indicate that it was composed when the Muslims were already establized in the Valley.
The Devīrahasya is divided into three parts, as follows. A) The Pūrvārdha (First Half). This consists of twenty-five paṭalas that deal with (1) Initiation. (2) Mantras of form so the Goddess. (3) Mantras of śiva. (4) Mantras of Viṣṇu. (5) Utkelana or unlocking of Mantras. (6) Vitalizing of Mantras. (7) Methods to remove curses attached to Mantras. (8) The mental utterance of Mantras (pārāyaṇa). (9) How to use particular seed syllables (bīja) uttered , before and after particular Mantras. (10) Preliminary practice of Mantras. (11) The sacrificial rite performed for the preliminary practice of Mantras. (12) Diagrams used for worship (yantra). (13) How to wear amulets containing those diagrams. (14) The Rṣ.i, metre etc of Mantras. (15, 16) Worship in cremation grounds. (17, 18) Purification of the impliments used for worship. (19) The origin of wine. (20) Ritual ingestion of wine. (21) Prayers and hymns dedicated to śākta sādhakas (vīra). (22) Purification of wine. (23) Purification of the consort. (24) Different kinds of rosary and their purification. (25) Purification etc., of the diagrams.
B) The uttarārdha (Second Half) otherwise called Rahasyavijaya consists of thirty-five chapters embodying the Pañcāṅgas, Paṭala, Kavaca, Paddhati Sahasranāma and Stotra of Gaṇeśa, Sūrya, Lakṣhmīnārāyaṇa, śiva and Durgā. The appendix (Pariśiṣṭha) gives the Pañcāṅgas of Jvālāmukhī, śārikā, Mahārajñī and Bālā the family goddesses of the Kashmiri paṇḍits.
B) The Uddhārakośa (Treasure of Mantras) which is in the appendix. Written in the form of a dialogue between Dakṣināmūrti and his disciple Akṣobhya, it is a collection of quotations from no less than forty-seven Tantrika works. It is in seven sections. 1) The Mantras of the goddesses Tripurā, Lakṣmī, Sarasvatī, Tārā, Bhuvaneśvarī, Mātaṅgī, śarikā, Rāñjī, Bhīdā and Jvālāmukhī along with some seed syllable Mantras and their names. 2) The Mantras of Bhadrakālī, Turī, chinnamastā, Dakṣiṇākālikā, śyāmā and Kālarātrī. 3) The Mantras of Vajrayoginī, Vārāhī, śāradā, Kāmeśvarī, Gaurī, Annapurṇā and Kulvāgīśvarī along with those of Ganeśa, Vatuka, Kumāra, Mṛtyuñjaya, Kārtaviryārjuna, Sugrīva and Hanuman. 4) The Mantras of the nine planets. 5) Names of the letters of the Sanskrit alphabet. 6) The Mantras of Bhavānī, Bagalāmukhī, Indrākṣī and Khecarī. 7) Descriptions of the goddesses, gods and planets mentioned in the preceding sections. Notes: Revision 0: November 13, 2014
Data-entered by the staff of Muktabodha under the supervision of Mark S. G. Dyczkowski. Publisher : Unknown Publication year : 1941 Publication city : Srinigar Publication country : India

atha
{śrīdevīrahasyam}
oṃ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ | namastripurasundaryai |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devi vakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam | yanna sarveṣu tantreṣu yāmalādiṣu bhāṣitam || 1 ||
parādevīrahasyākhyaṃ tantraṃ mantroccavigraham | tattvaṃ śrīṣoḍaśākṣaryāḥ sarvasvaṃ mama pārvati || 2 ||
aprakāśyamadātavyaṃ paramoccaphalapradam | bhogāpavargadaṃ loke sādhakānāṃ sukhāvaham (k: śubhāvaham) || 3 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan sarvatantrajña kaulikeśvara śaṅkara | tvatprasādānmayā jñātaṃ tattvaṃ devyāḥ sudurlabham || 4 ||
tantraṃ mantrātmakaṃ guhyaṃ sūcitaṃ bhavatā svayam | parādevīrahasyākhyaṃ dīkṣāpūrvaṃ vadasva me || 5 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
devīrahasyamīśāni śṛṇu tvaṃ bhaktipūrvakam | yena śravaṇamātreṇa koṭipūjāphalaṃ labhet || 6 ||
athāhaṃ nirṇayaṃ vakṣye paramaṃ guruśiṣyayoḥ |
vicārya vidhivaddhīmān dīkṣākarma samācaret || 7 ||
brahmādikīṭaparyantaṃ jagata sthāvarajaṅgamam | parādevyā paśutvena mohitaṃ vigataspṛham || 8 ||
tathāpi tatprasādena sevayā tatpadābjayoḥ | kaulikaḥ paśubhāvena mukto jñānaṃ bhajet tataḥ || 9 ||
dīkṣāṃ tasyāḥ śive mantrī labdhvā gurupadārcanāt | dīkṣitaḥ sa bhavejjñānī dīkṣāhīno bhavet paśuḥ || 10 ||
yasya dīkṣā śive nāsti jīvanaṃ tasya niṣphalam (kh: jīvanāntaṃ ca janminaḥ) | sa jātu nottared devi nirayāmbunidheḥ kvacit || 11 ||
dīkṣāhīnasya deveśi paśoḥ kutsiṃtajanmanaḥ | pāpaugho'ntikamāyāti puṇyaṃ dūraṃ palāyate || 12 ||
tasmād yatnena dīkṣaiṣā grāhyā kṛtibhiruttamā | bālye vā yauvane vāpi vārdhakye'pi sureśvari || 13 ||
anyathā nirayī pāpī pitṝn svān nirayaṃ nayet | ataḥ paśurmanuṣyaḥ san paśuyoniṃ vrajecchive || 14 ||
pūrvajanmārjitāṃ prāpya vāsanāṃ paramārthadām | gurumanveṣayed devi kaulikācāradīkṣitam || 15 ||
guruṃ kulīnaṃ tantrajñaṃ sarvāṅgaiḥ sumanoharam | nirāmayaṃ ca nirlobhaṃ niḥśeṣāgamapāragam || 16 ||
labdhvā bhaktyā praṇamyādau toṣayitvā viśeṣataḥ | siddhasādhyārinirṇītāṃ dīkṣāṃ devyā yathāvidhi || 17 ||
gṛhṇīyāt parayā bhaktyā sādhako yena jāyate | guruśca śiṣyaṃ ramyāṅgaṃ kulīnaṃ garbhadīkṣitam || 18 ||
gurubhaktirataṃ bālaṃ yuvānaṃ dhiṣaṇāyutam |
devībhaktirataṃ bhaktaṃ pāpabhītaṃ kṛtātmakam || 19 ||
dṛṣṭvā dīkṣāṃ parāṃ dadyāt kṛtabhāgī bhavet tataḥ |
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan karuṇāmbhodhe saṃśayo'yaṃ mahān mama | yasya citte parā bhaktirgururnāsti tathāvidhaḥ (kh: tathā vidhiḥ) || 20 ||
kulīnaḥ sarvatantrajño mantrasādhanakakṣamaḥ | bhaktyā paramayā yuktaḥ sa kiṃ deva kariṣyati || 21 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
adīkṣita upādhyāyavihīnaḥ śaktibhaktimān | gurorabhāve deveśi pustakaṃ gurumācaret || 22 ||
yadi kaścid bhaved devi gurustantravicakṣaṇaḥ | dīkṣitaḥ śivamantreṇa vaiṣṇavaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ || 23 ||
taṃ parityajya yo devi parābhakto'pi bhaktimān | pustakaṃ tu guruṃ kuryāt sa bhavecchivaghātakaḥ || 24 ||
guruṃ kulīnaṃ tantrajñaṃ bhajenmantrasya siddhaye | mūrkhaṃ lobhātmakaṃ devi kulīnaṃ ca parityajet || 25 ||
piturdīkṣāṃ na gṛhṇīyāt tathā mātāmahasya ca | sodarasya kaniṣṭhasya mātulasya viśeṣataḥ || 26 ||
dambhaṃ vittecchayā laulyaṃ na kuryānmanasāpi vā | paralokecchayā kuryāt paralokabhayāya vā || 27 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan parameśāna sādhakānāṃ hitecchayā | kadā dīkṣā parā grāhyā sādhakaistadvadasva me || 28 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
sudine śubhanakṣatre saṃkrāntāvayanadvaye | navarātridine pitroḥ śrāddhe svajanivāsare || 29 ||
navavarṣadine devi candrasūryoparāgake | tiṣye svajanmanakṣatre dīkṣāṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 30 ||
tatrādau śubhanakṣatre snātvā saṃpūjya bhairavam | gatvā nadītaṭaṃ divyaṃ latākusumasundaram || 31 ||
dvīpaṃ vā paramaṃ puṇyaṃ devānāmapi durlabham | devatāyatanaṃ vāpi prāpyāśu praṇamet tataḥ || 32 ||
vilipya (k: vilikhya) vidhivad devi guruḥ kuryāt kṛtāhnikaḥ | vedīmīśānadigbhāge catuṣkoṇāṃ manoharām || 33 ||
tatra devi parādevyāḥ śrīcakraṃ tu vibhāvayet | sindūreṇa śive yantraṃ mūlamantraṃ samuccaran || 34 ||
trikoṇaṃ bindusaṃyuktaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vṛttamaṇḍalam | vasupatraṃ trivṛttāṅkaṃ (kh: vṛttāṅgaṃ) bhūgṛheṇopaśobhitam (kh: geheno) || 35 ||
dīkṣāyantramidaṃ devi dīkṣākāle prapūjayet | gaṇeśadharmavaruṇāḥ kuberasahitāḥ śive || 36 ||
vidikṣu vidigīśānāḥ pūjanīyā yathākramam | tāramāyāramābījairdhūpadīpaprasūnakaiḥ || 37 ||
māyāṃ ca mohinīṃ menāṃ maṅgalāṃ sarvamaṅgalām | mahāvidyāṃ ca deveśi ṣaṭkoṇeṣu prapūjayet || 38 ||
tāramāyāramābījairgandhākṣataprasūnakaiḥ | gaṅgāṃ ca yamunāṃ devi tadagre'pi sarasvatīm || 39 ||
trikoṇe pūjayed dhīmānīśānāgneyapūrvakam | bindau śrīmūlamantreṇa parādevīṃ prapūjayet || 40 ||
sadāśivaṃ mahāraudraṃ kāmeśaṃ kāmaneśvaram | gandhākṣataprasūnādyairdhūpadīpāditarpaṇaiḥ || 41 ||
naivedyācamanīyādyaistāmbūlaiśca suvāsitaiḥ | aṣṭapatreṣu deveśi saṃpūjyā aṣṭa mātaraḥ || 42 ||
brāhmyādyā devi mantreṇa aṣṭabhairavapūrvakam | brāhmī nārāyaṇī caiva kaumārī cāparājitā || 43 ||
māheśvarī ca cāmuṇḍā vārāhī nārasiṃhikā | vāmāvartakrameṇaivaṃ pūjanīyā viśeṣataḥ || 44 ||
tatraiva pūjayedaṣṭa bhairavān bhairaveśvari | mahākālaṃ ca kālāgniṃ karālaṃ vikarālakam || 45 ||
saṃhāraṃ rurumīśāni suptamunmattabhairavam | saṃpūjya vidhivat tatra gandhākṣataprasūnakaiḥ || 46 ||
yantramabhyarcya deveśi guruṃ saṃpūjayet tataḥ | pūrve tataḥ khanet kuṇḍaṃ yonirūpaṃ trikoṇakam || 47 ||
tatrāraṇiṃ prapūjyādau vahnimāvāhayecchive | tāraṃ vahnitrayaṃ cāgne vaiśvānarapadaṃ vadet || 48 ||
prajvaleti yugaṃ procyedihāgaccheti saṃvadet | iha sannidhimādhatsva varaṃ me dehi(-)yugmakam || 49 ||
phaḍvahnijāyāṃ proccārya gandhenābhyarcayet tataḥ | parādevyāstu mantreṇa ghṛtamājyaṃ carecchive || 50 ||
mūlenāgnau śive dadyādāhutīnāṃ śataṃ param | ghṛtakhaṇḍādimṛdvīkākharjūrāmbujapāyasaiḥ || 51 ||
tatra devīṃ samāvāhya parāṃ dhyātvā viśeṣataḥ | prāṅmukho gururāsīna uttarābhimukhaṃ śiśum || 52 ||
saṃsthāpya vidhivad devi kṛtvā viṣṭaraśodhanam |
bhūtaśuddhikramopetaṃ prāṇārpaṇavidhiṃ caret || 53 ||
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā vidhāyācamanatrayam | tatra mūlena deveśi diśo baddhvā parāṃ smaret || 54 ||
guruḥ śiṣyāya śāntāya parāprītyai maheśvari | vahneḥ samakṣaṃ yantrāgre dīkṣāṃ paramadurlabhām || 55 ||
karṇamūle mahāvidyāṃ śrīvidyāṃ sādhakeśvaraḥ | ānandāsaktahṛdayaḥ śanaistristriḥ samarpayet || 56 ||
prathamaṃ tu gaṇeśasya mantraṃ sāṅgaṃ samarpayet | tato devyāśca gāyatrīṃ tato mūlaṃ maheśvari || 57 ||
evaṃ samarpya deveśi kṛtvā homaṃ yathāvidhi | śiṣyo dīkṣāṃ tu saṃprāpya gurumabhyarcya śaktitaḥ || 58 ||
toṣayitvā praṇāmaiśca dakṣiṇābhiḥ śubhāmbaraiḥ | tadājñāṃ sahasādāya japāya parameśvari || 59 ||
yantraṃ mantraṃ ca mālāṃ ca tantraṃ vaikāṅgamīśvari | punarjātu śive śiṣyo gurave'pi na darśayet || 60 ||
tato homaṃ ca saṃpādya vaṭukaṃ yoginīgaṇam | bhūtān santarpya balinā devīṃ (kh: devīdevaṃ) devaṃ visarjayet || 61 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan devadeveśa bhaktānugrahakāraka | gaṇeśaṃ caiva gāyatrīṃ mūlavidyāṃ japet param || 62 ||
śaivaṃ mantraṃ japanno (kh: japan yo) vā vaiṣṇavaṃ sādhakeśvaraḥ | kāṃ kāṃ vidyāṃ sa gṛhṇīyācchindhyetat saṃśayaṃ mama || 63 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
prathame'hani deveśi sādhako gurubhaktitaḥ |
gaṇeśaṃ devi gāyatrīṃ mūlavidyāṃ japet param || 64 ||
muhūrte śubhade devi śaivaṃ mantraṃ japet tataḥ | guroḥ pādaprasādena labdhvā katipayairdinaiḥ || 65 ||
tato guruṃ śive bhaktyā vandanaiḥ pūjanaiḥ sadā | prārthanābhiśca saṃtoṣya śrīvidyāṃ prārthayet tataḥ || 66 ||
vinā śrīvidyayā devi sādhako'dīkṣitaḥ smṛtaḥ | adīkṣitaḥ paśuḥ proktaḥ paśutvānnirayī bhavet || 67 ||
svajanmani śive tasmād gurumabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ | śrīvidyāṃ prārthayitvādau gṛhṇīyāt sarvasiddhaye || 68 ||
mahātripurasundaryāḥ śrīvidyāṃ prāpya durlabhām | saśivāṃ girije sāṅgāṃ prārthayed dakṣiṇāṃ tataḥ || 69 ||
vinā śyāmāṃ na siddhiḥ syānmamāpi parameśvari | dvāviṃśatyakṣarīṃ vidyāṃ prajapet sādhakottamaḥ || 70 ||
śyāmāvidyājapenāśu śrīvidyā siddhimeṣyati | tāmasī kālikā proktā rājasī ṣoḍaśākṣarī || 71 ||
sāttvikī ca parādevī mahāśrīṣoḍaśākṣarī | rājyaṃ deyaṃ śiro deyaṃ deyā santatirarthine || 72 ||
vasupūrṇaṃ gṛhaṃ deyaṃ na deyā ṣoḍaśākṣarī | vidyāṃ tripurasundaryā labdhvā guruprasādataḥ || 73 ||
manasāpīti no brūyācchrīvidyopāsako'smyaham | śyāmāṃ bhajet parāvidyāṃ śrīvidyābhedarūpiṇīm || 74 ||
tena siddhirbhavedāśu devānāmapi durlabhā | yanna dṛṣṭyāpi vai brūyādgurustanna (k: tatra) samācaret || 75 ||
gurureva parā devī gurureva parā gatiḥ |
gurumullaṅghya yaḥ kuryāt kiñcit sa nirayaṃ vrajet || 76 ||
evaṃ devi parābhakto dīkṣito gurupūjakaḥ | gurūpadeśataḥ kuryāj japaṃ pūjāmaharniśam || 77 ||
svayaṃ dīkṣāṃ gurorlabdhvā dīkṣitaḥ puṇyabhājanam (k: bhājanaḥ) | gurumabhyarcya saṃprārthya śaktidīkṣārthamīśvari || 78 ||
dīkṣitā yasya no śaktistasya dīkṣā tu niṣphalā | janmakoṭiṣu japtāpi tasya vidyā na sidhyati || 79 ||
tataḥ śive guruḥ śiṣyaṃ saṃpūjya paramārthavit | śiṣyastriyaṃ parārūpāṃ devīrūpāṃ vicintayet || 80 ||
abhyarcya paramāṃ śaktiṃ parāvad vandanaiḥ stavaiḥ | ādṛtya mātṛvad devi kanyāvad dīkṣayet tadā || 81 ||
parāvat pūjayitvādau tato dīkṣāṃ samarpayet | upaviśya gurustatra paścimābhimukhaḥ śive || 82 ||
dīkṣāyai prāṅmukhīṃ kṛtvā pūjayed yantrarājavat | tataḥ saṃpūjya deveśi yantrāgre devatāgṛhe || 83 ||
śivo bhūtvā parāvidyāṃ karṇamūle samarpayet | saṃprāpya saśivāṃ vidyāṃ guruṃ pitṛvadarcayet || 84 ||
gandhākṣataprasūnādyairdakṣiṇāmbarapūrvakaiḥ | tadājñāṃ śirasādāya japaṃ kuryāttu sarvadā || 85 ||
śaktiśca dīkṣitā bhūtvā dīkṣito'pi svayaṃ śive | martyo'pi sañchive janturamaratvamavāpnuyāt || 86 ||
guroḥ pādaprasādena śrīvidyā yadi labhyate | sa śyāmā sa śivā devi vaśyaṃ tasya jagat trayam || 87 ||
idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ tava bhaktyā mayeritam |
dīkṣāvidhermahādevi gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 88 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye dīkṣāvidhinirūpaṇaṃ prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 1 || atha
[dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā kathayiṣyāmi mantrān sāṅgān maheśvari | devīnāṃ vaiṣṇavāñchāktāñchaivāṃstvaṃ śṛṇu pārvati || 1 ||
tripurā tryakṣarī bālā tathā tripurabhairavī | kālikā bhadrakālī ca mātaṅgī bhuvaneśvarī || 2 ||
ugratārā chinnaśīrṣā sumukhī ca sarasvatī | annapūrṇā mahālakṣmīḥ śārikā śāradā tataḥ || 3 ||
indrākṣī bagalā turyā rājñī jvālāmukhī tathā | bhīḍā ca kālarātriśca bhavānī vajrayoginī || 4 ||
vārāhī siddhalakṣmīśca kulavāgīśvarī tataḥ | (padmāvatī kubjikā ca gaurī śrīkhecarī tataḥ || 5 ||)
nīlasarasvatī devi parāśaktiḥ tataḥ smṛtā | etāsāṃ devi sāṅgānāṃ śaktīnāṃ vacmyahaṃ manūn || 6 ||
śaivān mantrāṃstato vakṣye yathāvacchṛṇu pārvati | mṛtyuñjayo'mṛteśāno vaṭuko'pi maheśvaraḥ || 7 ||
śivaḥ sadāśivo rudro mahādevaḥ karālakaḥ |
vikarālo nīlakaṇṭhaḥ śarvaḥ paśupatirmṛḍaḥ || 8 ||
pinākī giriśo bhīmo gaṇeśaḥ pramathādhipaḥ | kumāraḥ krodhanaśceśaḥ kapālī krūrabhairavaḥ || 9 ||
saṃhāra īśvaro bhargo ruruḥ kālāgniravyayaḥ | aghoraśca mahākālaḥ kāmeśvara iti smṛtaḥ || 10 ||
vaiṣṇavāñchṛṇu deveśi mantrāṃstantreṣu gopitān | yena (kh: yeṣāṃ) śravaṇamātreṇa mantrī viṣṇupadaṃ vrajet || 11 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇo rādhākṛṣṇo viṣṇurnṛsiṃhakaḥ | varāho jāmadagnyaśca sītārāmo janārdanaḥ || 12 ||
viśvakseno vāsudeva ityevaṃ daśa vaiṣṇavāḥ | mantrā atyuttamā (k: abhyuttamāḥ) devi japyāḥ sādhakasattamaiḥ || 13 ||
eteṣāṃ śāktaśaivānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ maheśvari | uddhārān vacmi mantrāṇāṃ śrutvā gopaya yatnataḥ || 14 ||
vāgbhavaṃ kāmarājaśca śaktirmadhye'bhidhaṃ nyaset | namo'nte devi bālāyā mantro'yaṃ cāṣṭavarṇakaḥ || 15 ||
prakāśam(-) aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ bālāyai namaḥ iti bālā |
vedhobījamadho'dhyarṇamadho jiṣṇustamaḥ parā | chaviḥ śaktiḥ śiraḥ kāntistamo māyā śarat śiraḥ || 16 ||
tamo māyāñcale devyā mantraḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥ |
spaṣṭam (g: prakāśaṃ)(-) kaeīlahrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ sakalahrīṃ iti |
lakṣmīḥ parā madanavāgbhavaśaktiyuktā tāraṃ ca bhūtikamale kathitāpi vidyā | śaktyādikaṃ tu viparītatayā ca proktaḥ śrīṣoḍaśākṣaravidhiḥ śivamastu (kh: śubhadostu) pūrṇaḥ || 17 ||
spaṣṭam(-) śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ aiṃ sauḥ oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kaeīlahrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ sakalahrīṃ sauḥ aiṃ klīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ iti |
devi vakṣyāmyahaṃ guhyaṃ tripurāyā rahasyakam | nityāyāḥ śaktayaḥ pūjyā vāgbhavīkāmaśaktayaḥ || 18 ||
tāramāyāramābījairnāma madhye'ñcale'śmarī | mantro'yaṃ sarvaśaktīnāṃ sarvasādhāraṇo mataḥ || 19 ||
tripurāpūjane devi pṛthag jāpye mṛthagmanuḥ | kālītrayaṃ kūrcayugmaṃ lajjāyugmaṃ samuccaret || 20 ||
dakṣiṇe kālike ceti punarbījāni pūrvavat | ṭhadvayaṃ syānmanorante mantro'yaṃ bhuvaneśvaraḥ || 21 ||
dvāviṃśatyakṣarī vidyā vidyārājñī prakīrtitā |
spaṣṭam(-) krīṃkrīṃkrīṃ hūṃhūṃ hrīṃhrīṃ dakṣiṇe kālike krīṃkrīṃkrīṃ hūṃhūṃ hrīṃhrīṃ svāhā iti kālī |
kālyādyāḥ śaktayaḥ pūjyāḥ kālībījena kevalam | anyathā siddhihāniḥ syāt kālikāpūjane param || 22 ||
kālītrayaṃ kūrcayugmaṃ lajjāyugmaṃ ca bhadrikām | bhadrakālipadaṃ brūyād bījāni pratilomataḥ || 23 ||
ṭhadvayena samāyukto bhadrakālī mahāmanuḥ |
prakāśam(-) krīṃkrīṃkrīṃ hūṃhūṃ hrīṃhrīṃ bhaiṃ bhadrakāli bhaiṃ hrīṃhrīṃ hūṃhūṃ krīṃkrīṃkrīṃ svāhā iti bhadrakālī |
kālīkūrcaparābījaiḥ parivārādiśaktayaḥ | pūjanīyā mahādevi bhadrakālīsamarcane || 24 ||
tāraṃ parāṃ samuddhṛtya rājamātaṅginīti ca | mama sarvārthasiddhiṃ ca dehi(-)yugmaṃ samuddharet || 25 ||
turagaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ cānte mantro'yaṃ rājavallabhaḥ |
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ rājamātaṅgini mama sarvārthasiddhiṃ dehi 2 phaṭ svāhā iti mātaṅgī |
tāreṇa pūjyā deveśi śaktayaḥ parivāragāḥ | māyābījaṃ nāma madhye namo mantrāñcale vadet | ekākṣarīyaṃ viditā bhuvane bhuvaneśvarī || 27 ||
prakāśam(-) hrīṃ bhuvaneśvaryai namaḥ iti bhuvaneśvarī |
māyābījena saṃpūjyāḥ pūjākāle'tra śaktayaḥ | tāraṃ parāṃ vadhūṃ kūrcaṃ turagaṃ sakalāñcale || 28 ||
sārdhapañcākṣarī tārā bhavasāgaratāriṇī |
spaṣṭam(-) oṃ hrīṃ śtrīṃ hūṃ phaṭ ityugratārā |
tārakāntātaṭaiḥ pūjyāḥ śaktayaścakramadhyagāḥ || 29 ||
lakṣmīṃ lajjāṃ tathā māyāṃ mātrāṃ dvādaśikīmatha | vajravairocanīye dve māye phaṭsvāhayā yute || 30 ||
spaṣṭam(-) śrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ vajravairocanīye hrīṃhrīṃ phaṭ svāhā iti chinnamastā |
māyāyugmena saṃpūjyāḥ śaktayaḥ parivāragāḥ | vāgbhavaṃ kāmarājaṃ ca tathocchiṣṭa(-)padaṃ vadet || 31 ||
caṇḍālinīti proccārya sumukhīdevi coddharet | mahāpiśācini ceti māyārṇaṃ paṅkajatrayam || 32 ||
vahnijāyāñcalo mantro gopanīyo maheśvari |
spaṣṭam(-) aiṃ klīṃ ucchiṣṭacaṇḍālini sumukhīdevi mahāpiśācini hrīṃ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ svāhā iti sumukhī |
vākkāmabījaiḥ saṃpūjyāḥ śaktayo'nyāḥ parasparam || 33 ||
tāraṃ māyā ca vāgbījaṃ parā tāraṃ maheśvari | sarasvatyai jaganmantraḥ prasiddho'yaṃ śivākṣaraḥ || 34 ||
spaṣṭaṃ yathā(-) oṃ hrīṃ aiṃ hrīṃ oṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ iti sarasvatī |
tāramāyākṣaraiḥ pūjyā devyo devīsamīpagāḥ | tāraṃ parāpi kamalā kāmaṃ viśvaṃ tato vadet || 35 ||
bhagavati māheśvari cānnapūrṇe ca ṭhadvayam |
spaṣṭam(-) oṃhrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ namo bhagavati māheśvari annapūrṇe svāhā iti annapūrṇā |
ādibījadvayenaiva pūjyā devyāḥ samīpagāḥ || 36 ||
(k: bhrukuṭibandhāntargataṃ pustake nāsti) tāraṃ parāṃ ramāṃ kāmaṃ vāgbhavaṃ śaktibījakam | mahālakṣmi prasīdeti yugmaṃ mā paṅkajatrayam || 37 ||
svāhānto'yaṃ mahāmantro mahālakṣmīpadapradaḥ |
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ aiṃ sauḥ mahālakṣmi prasīda 2 śrīṃ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ svāhā iti mahālakṣmīḥ |
ādibījatrayeṇaiva pūjyāḥ paramaśaktayaḥ || 38 ||
tāraṃ māyāṃ śriyaṃ kūrcaṃ sindhuraṃ śarma pro reta | nāmāśmarīṃ manorante mantro'yaṃ bhuvi durlabhaḥ || 39 ||
spaṣṭam(-) oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hūṃ phrāṃ āṃ śāṃ śārikāyai namaḥ iti śārikā |
māyayā pūjayed devīḥ parivāragatāḥ śive | tāraṃ māyā smaraḥ śaktiraśmarī nāma saṃvadet || 40 ||
bhagavatyai śāradāyai manorante parā vanam |
spaṣṭam(-) oṃ hrīṃ klīṃ saḥ namo bhagavatyai śāradāyai hrīṃ svāhā iti śāradā |
tārakāmaiḥ śive pūjyāḥ śaktayaḥ paramārthadāḥ || 41 ||
praṇavaṃ kamalāṃ māyāṃ vāgbhavaṃ śaktimanmathau | indrākṣi vajrahaste ca haramante'gnivallabhā || 42 ||
mūlam(-) oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ sauḥ klīṃ indrākṣi vajrahaste phaṭ svāhā iti indrākṣī |
ādibījatrayeṇaitāḥ pūjyāḥ śrīcakradevatāḥ | tāraṃ mṛtsnāṃ ca deveśi bagalāmukhi sarva ca (kh, g: sarvadā) || 43 ||
duṣṭānāṃ vācaṃ mukhakaṃ padaṃ stambhaya(-)yugmakam | jihvāṃ kīlaya(-)yugmaṃ ca mṛttāraṃ ṭhadvayaṃ manuḥ || 44 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ hlīṃ bagalāmukhi sarvaduṣṭānāṃ vācaṃ mukhaṃ padaṃ stambhaya 2 jihvāṃ kīlaya 2 hlīṃ oṃ svāhā iti bagalāmukhī |
bījadvayena saṃpūjyāḥ parivāragatāḥ parāḥ | praṇavastārakā jyotistārā madhye'bhidhaṃ nyaset || 45 ||
ante'śmarī mahādevi mantro'yaṃ śatrusūdanaḥ |
prakāśam(-) oṃ truṃ trauṃ troṃ mahāturyai namaḥ iti mahāturī |
praṇavenārcayed devi parivārān yathākramam || 46 ||
tāraṃ parā ramā vahniḥ kāmaḥ śaktiḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ | bhagavatyai ca rājñyai ca māyā ṭhadvayamañcale || 47 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ rāṃ klīṃ sauḥ bhagavatyai rājñyai hrīṃ svāhā iti mahārājñī |
tārāgnibhyāṃ śive devīparivārān samarcayet | tāraṃ lajjāṃ śriyaṃ caiva jvālāmukhi mameti ca || 48 ||
sarvaśatrūn bhakṣaya dvirante kūrcaṃ haraṃ payaḥ |
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ jvālāmukhi mama sarvaśatrūn bhakṣaya bhakṣaya hūṃ phaṭ svāhā iti jvālāmukhī |
tāreṇa pūjayed devi parivāragatāḥ parāḥ || 49 ||
tāraṃ parā ramā vedī candramanmathaśaktayaḥ | bhīḍābhagavatītyevaṃ haṃsarūpiṇi ṭhadvayam || 50 ||
spaṣṭaṃ yathā(-) oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hsraiṃ aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ bhīḍābhagavati haṃsarūpiṇi svāhā iti bhīḍā |
parāramārṇairdeveśi parivārān prapūjayet | praṇavaṃ vāsanā māyā manmathaḥ kamalā tataḥ || 51 ||
madhye nāmāñcale sarvaṃ vaśyaṃ kurudvayaṃ vadet | vīryaṃ dehi punarnāma gaṇeśvaryāśmarī smṛtā || 52 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ śrīṃ kālarātri sarvaṃ vaśyaṃ kuru (2) vīryaṃ dehi (2) gaṇeśvaryai namaḥ iti kālarātrī |
tāracandreṇa saṃpūjya (kh: saṃpūjyā) parivārāṃstato yajet | tāraṃ ramā ramā tāraṃ tāraṃ māyā ramā ramā || 53 ||
hūṃphaḍantaḥ samākhyāto mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ |
prakāśam(-) oṃ śrīṃ śrīṃ oṃ oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śrīṃ hūṃ phaṭ iti bhavānī |
mābījaiḥ pūjayed devi parivāragatāḥ parāḥ || 54 ||
parārṇaṃ vajrayoginyai ṭhadvayaṃ praṇavāditaḥ | mantro'yaṃ sarvasiddhīśaḥ sādhakānāṃ jayapradaḥ || 55 ||
mūlam(-) oṃ hrīṃ vajrayoginyai svāhā iti vajrayoginī |
māyābījena deveśi parivārān samarcayet | candravāhlīkamohārṇacandrā madhye'bhidhaṃ nyaset || 56 ||
candro maṭhaṃ padmayugmaṃ haraṃ nīramayaṃ manuḥ | vāsanāmohabījena pūjayet parivāragān || 57 ||
mūlam(-) aiṃ glauṃ laṃ aiṃ namo bhagavati vārtāli (g: vāttāli) vārāhi devate varāhamukhi aiṃ glauṃ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ phaṭ svāhā iti dhūmravārāhī |
tāraṃ ramāyugaṃ māyā haritaṃ candramanmathau | śaktirnāmāśmarīmantraḥ siddhalakṣmyā udāhṛtaḥ || 58 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ śrīṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ hsauḥ (k: śau) aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ siddhalakṣmyai namaḥ iti siddhalakṣmīḥ |
ramayā pūjayedanyāḥ parivāragatāḥ śive | tāraṃ kāmo ḍimbalakṣmīḥ kūrcaṃ kāṃkṣābhidhaṃ tataḥ || 59 ||
candraḥ padmaḥ spṛhā padmo veśyā padmo vanaṃ manuḥ (kh, g: tataḥ) |
prakāśam(-) oṃ klīṃ hrāṃ śrīṃ hūṃ jhaṃ jhaṣahaste kulavāgīśvari aiṃ ṭhaḥ jhaṃ ṭhaḥ strīṃ ṭhaḥ svāhā iti kulavāgīśvarī |
kāmena pūjayed devi parivārān yathākramam (k: kramāt) || 60 ||
tāraṃ parā ramā kāmā vīcī padmāvatīti ca |
mama varaṃ dehi(-)yugmaṃ haraṃ nīramayaṃ manuḥ || 61 ||
parayā pūjayed devīḥ parivāragatāḥ parāḥ |
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ blūṃ padmāvati mama varaṃ dehi 2 phaṭ svāhā iti padmāvatī |
tāraṃ ramā vāgurārṇaṃ nāma madhye tataḥ parā || 62 ||
padmo vanamayaṃ mantraḥ sarvasiddhiphalapradaḥ | vāgurārṇeṇa deveśi pūjayet parivāragāḥ || 63 ||
parkāśam(-) oṃ śrīṃ prīṃ kubjike devi hrīṃ ṭhaḥ svāhā iti kubjikā |
praṇavaṃ kamalā māyā vālhīkaṃ ca śivaṃ tataḥ | gauri śarvo vanaṃ devi mantraḥ sarvārthasiddhidaḥ || 64 ||
spaṣṭam(-) oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ glauṃ gaṃ gauri gīṃ svāhā iti gaurī |
ramayā parivārāśca pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ | bhekī tamaḥ parā śaktiḥ khecaryai cāśmarī tataḥ || 65 ||
mantro'yaṃ khecaro nāma khecaratvapradāyakaḥ | parayā pūjayed devīḥ parivāragatāḥ priye || 66 ||
spaṣṭam(-) malahrīṃ sauḥ khecaryyai namaḥ iti khecarī |
tāraṃ vyoṣam vāgbhavaṃ ca kūrcaṃ nīlasarasvati | haraṃ nīraṃ manorante mantro'yaṃ vākpradāyakaḥ || 67 ||
vyoṣeṇa pūjayed devi parivārā yathāvidhi |
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrāṃ aiṃ hūṃ nīlasarasvati phaṭ svāhā iti nīlasarasvatī |
tāraṃ ramā parā kāmaḥ śaktirvastraṃ tato'bhidham || 68 ||
vāgbhavaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ devi mantrarājo'yamīritaḥ |
prakāśam(-) oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ sauḥ hsauḥ parāśaktyai aiṃ svāhā iti parāśaktiḥ |
mūlena pūjayedanyā devīstatparivāragāḥ || 69 ||
ityeṣa śāktamantrāḍhyaḥ paṭalo devadurlabhaḥ |
adhunā te manūn śaivān vakṣyāmi śṛṇu pārvati || 70 ||
idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ tava bhaktyā prakāśitam | guhyātiguhyaguptaṃ ca gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 71 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye śāktamantroddhāranirūpaṇaṃ dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 2 || atha
[tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ]
śrībhairava uvāca
yo devadevo deveśi mahāmṛtyuñjayaḥ smṛtaḥ | mantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi tasyāhaṃ śṛṇu pārvati || 1 ||
tryakṣaṃ hṛjjaṃ śaktiśobhe'pi śaṅkā māṃ tasmādvai pālaya dvistathaiva | tasmācchaktiḥ khaṃ śarad hṛjjatāraṃ mantroddhāro devi mṛtyuñjayasya || 2 ||
amṛteśasya vakṣyāmi mantroddhāraṃ maheśvari | yena vijñātamātreṇa dīkṣāphalamavāpnuyāt || 3 ||
tāraṃ hṛjjaṃ śarannāma madhye viśvaṃ tathāñcale | mantro'yaṃ sarvasiddhīśaḥ sumukhīśivavallabhaḥ || 4 ||
praṇavaṃ bhūtibījaṃ ca vaṭukāya samuddharet |
āpaduddhāraṇāyeti kuruyugmaṃ samuccaret || 5 ||
vaṭukāya parābījaṃ mantro'yaṃ devadurlabhaḥ | tāraṃ vyoṣaṃ mahādevi tato maheśvarāya ca || 6 ||
viśvamante manordadyānmantro'yaṃ sarvasiddhidaḥ (ṅ: mantra) | tāraṃ viśvaṃ śivāyeti mantro'yaṃ bhogamokṣadaḥ || 7 ||
tāraṃ vyoṣaṃ śivāyeti namo'nte'styaparo manuḥ |
iti śivasya mantrāḥ |
tāraṃ vāṇī śarat kāmaḥ sadāśivāya proddharet | viśvamante smṛto mantro mantramaulimaṇiḥ paraḥ || 8 ||
iti sadāśivasya |
tāraṃ vyoṣaṃ śivo rudra prasīdeti yugaṃ vadet | ante ṭhadvayamīśāni mantro'yaṃ devadurlabhaḥ || 9 ||
iti rudrasya |
tāraṃ parā śivo devi mahādevāya ṭhadvayam | mantraḥ śivaprado devi śaivānāṃ paramārthadaḥ || 10 ||
tāraṃ kālī śivo nāma turīrūpaṃ (turīrūpaṃ caturthyantamityarthaḥ) ca ṭhadvayam | mantro bhairavavikhyātaḥ kalau bhogāpavargadaḥ || 11 ||
iti karālasya |
tāraṃ vāgbhavamāmāyā vikarālāya vinyaset | ante ṭhadvayamuccārya mantrarājo'yamīritaḥ || 12 ||
iti vikarālasya |
praṇavaṃ haritaṃ ḍimbaṃ nīlakaṇṭhāya cāśmarī | durgeśanīlakaṇṭhasya mantroddhāro daśākṣaraḥ || 13 ||
tāraṃ parā ramā(-)bījaṃ śarvāyeti padaṃ vadet | ante'śmarī manordevi mantro'yaṃ bhogadaḥ smṛtaḥ || 14 ||
praṇavo vāgbhavo māraḥ śaktiḥ paśupatervanam | mantro'yaṃ devadevasya vallabho muktisādhanam || 15 ||
tāraṃ ramā mṛḍāyeti viśvamante manuḥ smṛtaḥ | tāraṃ hṛjjaṃ parā lakṣmīrmadhye brūyātpinākine || 16 ||
ante'śmarī manordevi mantro'yaṃ vairisūdanaḥ | tāraṃ śivo maṭhaṃ devi giriśāyāśmarī manuḥ || 17 ||
tāraṃ parā bhadrikā ca bhīmāyānte'śmarī manu ḥ | māyā śivākṣaraṃ māyā mahāgaṇapamuddharet || 18 ||
taye'śmarī manorante mantro'yaṃ vighnahārakaḥ | tāraṃ parā ca vāhlīkaṃ pramathādhipamuddharet || 19 ||
prasīda(-)dvayamāpo'nte mantro'yaṃ devadurlabhaḥ | chaviḥ kumārāya manorante viśvaṃ manuḥ paraḥ || 20 ||
sarvadevendrapadado bhagado mokṣadaḥ smṛtaḥ | tāraṃ kālī śivo devi krodhaneśāya cāśmarī || 21 ||
mantro'yaṃ sarvasiddhīśo vairivarganivarhaṇaḥ | tāraṃ parā ramā lakṣmīrīśāyeti vanaṃ manuḥ || 22 ||
tāraṃ śivaḥ kāmarājaḥ kapālīśāya saṃvadet | ante ṭhadvayamuddhṛtya mantro'yaṃ syād daśākṣaraḥ || 23 ||
tāraṃ kālīyugaṃ māyā krūrabhairava proddharet | prasīda(-)dvayamāpo'nte mantro'yaṃ sarvasiddhidaḥ || 24 ||
tāraṃ vāṇī śarat kāmaḥ saṃhārāyāñcale vanam | mantro'yaṃ devadevasya varṇitaste daśākṣaraḥ || 25 ||
tāraṃ mā bhūtirmā lakṣmīrīśvarāyāśmarī manuḥ | tāraṃ ca bhāsvatī māyā bhargāyānte'śmarī manuḥ || 26 ||
tāraṃ cābdhiḥ parā bījaṃ rurave cāśmarī manuḥ |
praṇavaṃ kamalā māyā kālāgnaye(-)padaṃ tataḥ || 27 ||
viśvamante manordevi mantrarājo'yamīritaḥ | tāraṃ vyoṣaṃ śivo devi sadyojātāya cāśmarī || 28 ||
ugratārāśivasyāyamavyayasya manuḥ smṛtaḥ | mātrādiḥ ṣaḍabhijñavahnikuliśāstasmādbilaṃ mārajidvahnī vajrakagautamāgniyugalaṃ rātryagnivajrāṅkitam | śaṅkau rvau ca tamī śubhau bakayutau śaktyau(? kti)rvavajrāśmakā rātryabdhīndujasindumatsyakuliśā mantro'yamāghorikaḥ || 29 ||
kūrcadvandvaṃ mahākāla prasīdeti padadvayam | māyādvayaṃ vahnijāyā rājarājeśvaro manuḥ || 30 ||
vāgbhavaṃ madanaśaktitārakā mā parā sakalavidyayāñcitā | tārayuktaviparītabījakaḥ ṣoḍaśākṣaravidhiḥ śivaḥ smṛtaḥ || 31 ||
itīdaṃ mantrasarvasvaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ param | tava bhaktyā mayākhyātaṃ nacākhyeyaṃ durātmane || 32 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye śivamantroddhāranirūpaṇaṃ tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 3 ||
atha
[caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca
adhunā kathayiṣyāmi vaiṣṇavāṃstattvato manūn | yeṣāṃ smaraṇamātreṇa dīkṣito dīkṣito bhavet || 1 ||
mantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya te | aṣṭasiddhipradaṃ sadyaḥ sādhakānāṃ sudurlabham || 2 ||
tāraṃ parā ca haritaṃ parā lakṣmīstato'bhidham | lakṣmīnārāyaṇāyeti viśvamante manuḥ smṛtaḥ || 3 ||
tāraṃ ramā vāgbhavakāmaśaktirmāyāgnirādheti padaṃ vadecca | kṛṣṇāya kūrcaṃ haraṭhadvayaṃ syācchrīkṛṣṇamantro manurājamauliḥ || 4 ||
tāraṃ parāyugaṃ tāraṃ viṣṇave viśvamañcale | devadevasya mantro'yaṃ viṣṇostava samīritaḥ || 5 ||
tāraṃ ramā bhūvijavāksmarāśca śaktirnṛbījaṃ narasiṃhadevam | turyāṅkitaṃ vāk taṭaphaḍvanaṃ te prokto hi lakṣmīnarasiṃhamantraḥ || 6 ||
tāraṃ ramārṇaṃ sakalā smaraśca lakṣmīvarāhāya padaṃ vadet tu | ante'śmarī vaiṣṇavadhāmadāyī lakṣmīvarāhasya manuḥ smṛtaste || 7 ||
tāraṃ parā bhūti ramā kucārṇaṃ śrījāmadagnyāya sarojayugmam | āpastathānte gadito'yamīḍhyo yatheṣṭado bhārgavarāmamantraḥ || 8 ||
tāraṃ parā ramā lakṣmīsītārāmeti saṃvadet | prasīda(-)yugamāpo'nte mantro'yaṃ muktikāraṇam || 9 ||
tāraṃ mā bhūtimā mākhyāṃ vadejjanārdanāya ca | viśvamante manordevi mantro'yaṃ ripusūdanaḥ || 10 ||
tāraṃ parāyugaṃ lakṣmīviśvaksenāya saṃvadet | kūrcaṃ padmatrayaṃ nīraṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ sudurlabhaḥ || 11 ||
tāraṃ parā ramā vaṇī kāmo lakṣmīpadaṃ vadet | vāsudevāya viśvaṃ syānmantro'yaṃ bhogamokṣadaḥ || 12 ||
idaṃ tattvatamaṃ guhyaṃ rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam | vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca sarvasvaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 13 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye vaiṣṇavamantroddhāranirūpaṇaṃ caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 4 ||
atha
[pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
atha vakṣye mahattattvaṃ mantrāṇāṃ paramārthadam | yena vijñātamātreṇa vidyā sidhyati sattvaram || 1 ||
utkīlanavithiṃ vakṣye sarvamantrarahasyakam | adātavyamabhaktebhyo nākhyeyaṃ yasya kasyacit || 2 ||
śāktānāṃ devi mantrāṇāṃ śaivānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | vaiṣṇavānāṃ manūnāṃ tu vakṣyāmyutkīlanaṃ param || 3 ||
prathamaṃ devi bālāyāstryakṣaryāḥ śṛṇu pārvati | vāṇīmante triruccārya bhavedutkīlanaṃ manoḥ || 4 ||
antyakūṭaṃ vadedādau dvirdevi japasiddhaye | bhavet tripurabhairavyā manorutkīlanaṃ param || 5 ||
kūṭatrayāṇāṃ prathamaṃ varṇaṃ varṇaṃ samuddharet | japecchrīṣoḍaśākṣaryā bhavedutkīlanaṃ manoḥ || 6 ||
atha vakṣye rahasyaṃ te kālikāyā maheśvari | niṣkīlitā syādvidyeyaṃ dvāviṃśatyakṣarī parā || 7 ||
bhadrikāṃ prathamaṃ dadyādante kālītrayaṃ vadet (ṅ: japet) | bhadrakālīmanordevi bhavedutkīlanaṃ tathā || 8 ||
ṭhadvayānte parāṃ dadyāt japet sādhakasattamaḥ | bhavedutkīlanaṃ devi rājamātaṅginīmanoḥ || 9 ||
viśvānte sakalāṃ dadyājjapet pārvati jāpakaḥ |
manoḥ śrībhuvaneśvaryāḥ syādutkīlanamuttamam || 10 ||
vadbūmādau paṭhedante tāraṃ japtvā ca pārvati | ayamutkīlano mantrastārāyāḥ samudāhṛtaḥ || 11 ||
mātrāṃ dvādaśikīmādau japenmantrasya pārvati | chinnaśīrṣāmanoreṣa syādutkīlanakaḥ paraḥ || 12 ||
māyāmādau vanānte ca vāgbhavaṃ sādhako japet | sumukhyā mantrarājasya bhavedutkīlanaṃ tathā || 13 ||
vāgbhavaṃ prathamaṃ dadyādviśvānte praṇavaṃ japet | sarasvatīmanordevi mantro'styutkīlanābhidhaḥ || 14 ||
viśvamādau japed devi vanānte madanaṃ paṭhet | annapūrṇāmanoreṣa syādutkīlanako manuḥ || 15 ||
ramāmādau manordadyāt padmatrayamathāñcale | mahālakṣmīmanordevi mantro'styutkīlanābhidhaḥ || 16 ||
sindhuraṃ sañjapedādau māyāmante maheśvari | śārikāmantrarājasya syādutkīlanako manuḥ | 17 ||
vanamādau ca nāmāgre tāraṃ dattvā japecchive | śāradāmantrarājasya mantro'styutkīlanābhidhaḥ || 18 ||
śaktibījaṃ paṭhedādau ṭhadvayānte ca manmatham | indrākṣīmantrarājasya syādutkīlanako manuḥ || 19 ||
mṛdbījaṃ ca manorādau vanānte praṇavaṃ japet | mantro'yaṃ bagalāmukhyā mantrotkīlanasiddhidaḥ || 20 ||
triḥ paṭhedaśmarīprānte praṇavaṃ sādhakottamaḥ | turīmantrasya mantro'yamutkīlanaphalapradaḥ || 21 ||
vahnimādau tathā cānte (kh: cāste va) tāraṃ dattvā maheśvari |
japenmantraṃ mahārājñīmanūtkīlanasiddhaye || 22 ||
ramāmādau japed devi mantrānte sakalāṃ japet | jvālāmukhīmanoreṣa mantro'styutkīlanakṣamaḥ (kh, g: mantrotkīlanako manuḥ) || 23 ||
vedībījaṃ paṭhedādau nāmānte praṇavaṃ japet | bhīḍāmantrasya mantro'yamutkīlanaphalapradaḥ || 24 ||
viśvānte vāgbhavaṃ dadyāt kāmamādau japet priye | kālarātrimanordevi syādutkīlanako manuḥ || 25 ||
tāratrayaṃ paṭhedante mā(-)trayaṃ prathamaṃ japet | bhavānīmantrarājasya mantro'yaṃ kīladoṣanut || 26 ||
parāmante japed devi vajrayogeśvarīmanoḥ | utkīlanākhyo mantro'yaṃ mantrasiddhiphalapradaḥ || 27 ||
maṭhamādau japed devi ṭhadvayānte haraṃ tathā | vārāhīmantrarājasya mantro'styutkīlanābhidhaḥ || 28 ||
haritaṃ prathamaṃ devi viśvānte vāgbhavaṃ japet | siddhalakṣmīrmanordevi mantro'styutkīlanābhidhaḥ || 29 ||
veśyāmādau vanānte ca ḍimbabījaṃ japecchive | utkīlanākhyo mantro'yaṃ kulavāgīśvarīmanoḥ || 30 ||
vīcibījaṃ japedādau ṭhadvayānte ca tārakam | padmāvatīmanordevi mantro'styutkīlanābhidhaḥ || 31 ||
vāgurāṃ sañjapedādau vanānte sakalāṃ japet | kubjikāmantrarājasya mantro'yaṃ kīladoṣahṛt || 32 ||
maṭhamādau manordevi praṇavaṃ ṭhadvayāñcale | mantraṃ japedayaṃ mantro gaurīmantrasya kīlahṛt || 33 ||
śaktimante japedviśvaṃ prathamaṃ parameśvari |
khecarīmantrarājasya syādutkīlanako manuḥ || 34 ||
kūrcamādau manorante vyoṣaṃ dattvā japecchive | manornīlasarasvatyāḥ syādutkīlanako manuḥ || 35 ||
śaktimādau manordevi vāsanāmañcale japet (g, gh: nyaset) | parāśaktermanordevi kīladoṣāpaho manuḥ || 36 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā śaivamantrāṇāṃ kecid devi manūttamāḥ | niṣkīlitā mayā khyātāḥ kecit pārvati kīlitāḥ || 37 ||
maheśvaraḥ śivo rudro mahādevaḥ karālakaḥ | vikarālaḥ śivo śarvo mṛḍaḥ paśupatistathā || 38 ||
pinākī giriśo bhīmaḥ kumāraḥ pramathādhipaḥ | krodheśa īśa īśāni kapālī krūrabhairavaḥ || 39 ||
saṃhāra īśvaro bhargo ruruḥ kālāgnibhairavaḥ | ete mantrā mahādevi kīladoṣavivarjitāḥ || 40 ||
puraścaraṇamātreṇa phalaṃ dāsyanti satvaram | athavā devadeveśi vakṣye tattvaṃ parāt param || 41 ||
eteṣāṃ śaivamantrāṇāṃ śrutvā gopyatamaṃ kuru | mantrādibījaṃ deveśi pratimantraṃ japet sudhīḥ || 42 ||
trivāraṃ sādhako yena bhavedutkīlanaṃ manoḥ | mṛtyuñjayo'mṛteśāno vaṭuko nīlakaṇṭhakaḥ || 43 ||
sadyojāto gaṇeśaśca deveśo'ghorabhairavaḥ | mahākālo mahādevi kāmeśvara iti priye || 44 ||
ete mantrā mayā devi kīlitā mantrasiddhaye | eteṣāṃ śṛṇu mantrāṇāṃ deveśyutkīlanaṃ param || 45 ||
yenoccāraṇamātreṇa mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate |
hṛjjabījaṃ japedādau ante śaktiṃ japet priye || 46 ||
śrīmṛtyuñjayamantrasya mantro'styutkīlanābhidhaḥ | tāramante japedādau śaktiṃ mantrasya pārvati || 47 ||
amṛteśvaramantrasya syādayaṃ kīladoṣahṛt | (kh: bhrakuṭibandhāntargataṃ nāsti ) (parāmādau japedante praṇavaṃ sādhakottamaḥ || 48 ||
mantro vaṭukamantrasya syādayaṃ kīlanāśakaḥ |) haritaṃ prathamaṃ dattvā mantrānte ca śivaṃ japet || 49 ||
durgāśivasya mantro'yaṃ nīlakaṇṭhasya kīlanut | śivamādau japedante tāraṃ pārvati sādhakaḥ || 50 ||
ugratārāśivasyāyaṃ mantro mantrasya kīlahṛt (kh: nut) | māyāmante japed devi śivamādau ca sādhakaḥ || 51 ||
mahāgaṇapatermantro manorutkīlanābhidhaḥ | viśvamādau manordevi mātrādiṃ cāñcale japet || 52 ||
aghorabhairavasyāyaṃ manorutkīlano manuḥ | eṣāmapi mahākālo niṣkīlita iti smṛtaḥ || 53 ||
asya mantraprasādena sarve niṣkīlitāḥ śive | kāmeśakūṭatrayataḥ prathamārṇatrayaṃ japet || 54 ||
śrīvidyāśivamantrasya syādutkīlanako manuḥ | athāhaṃ (g, gh: adyāhaṃ) vaiṣṇavānāṃ te mantrāṇāṃ vacmi pārvati || 55 ||
utkīlanamanūn yeṣāṃ japamātrācchivaṃ bhajet (k: śivo bhavet) | haritaṃ prathamaṃ dadyādante praṇavaimīśvari || 56 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyāyaṃ syādutkīlanako manuḥ | śaktimādau manorante vāgbhavaṃ sādhako japet || 57 ||
śrīrādhākṛṣṇamantrasya mantro'yaṃ kīladoṣahṛt |
parāyugaṃ japedante viśvamādau japenmanoḥ || 58 ||
viṣṇumantrasya mantro'yaṃ syādutkīlanakābhidhaḥ | smaramādau japedante nṛbījaṃ sādhakottamaḥ || 59 ||
lakṣmīnṛsiṃhamantrasya mantro'yaṃ kīladoṣahṛt | tāramante ramāmādau japet sādhakasattamaḥ || 60 ||
lakṣmīvarāhamantrasya bhavedutkīlanaṃ param | kucabījaṃ japedādau mantrānte padmayugmakam || 61 ||
manorbhārgavarāmasya bhavedutkīlanaṃ śive | parāmante ramāmādau japet pārvati siddhaye || 62 ||
śrīsītārāmabhadrasya manormantro'sti kīlahṛt | māmante prathamaṃ māṃ ca japet pārvati sādhakaḥ || 63 ||
janārdanamanormantraḥ syādutkīlanakābhidhaḥ | lakṣmīmādau parāmante sakṛduccārayet sudhīḥ || 64 ||
viśvaksenamanordevi syādutkīlanako manuḥ | kāmamādau ca mantrānte tāraṃ devi japet sudhīḥ || 65 ||
vāsudevamanormantraḥ syādutkīlanakābhidhaḥ | iti tattvaṃ mahādevi mantrāṇāṃ paramārthadam | tava snehena kathitaṃ nākhyeyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ || 66 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye mantrotkīlanavidhinirūpaṇaṃ pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 5 ||
atha
[ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
atha te varṇayiṣyāmi sañjīvanamanūn priye | eṣāmuccāramātreṇa mantraḥ siddhiprado bhavet || 1 ||
bālāyā devi tryakṣaryāḥ śaktimādau paṭhet sudhīḥ | sañjīvanākhyo mantro'yaṃ divyo mantrasya siddhaye || 2 ||
parātrayaṃ paṭhedādau jīvanaṃ bhairavīmanoḥ | kūṭatrayāṇāṃ deveśi trikūṭāyā japet sudhīḥ || 3 ||
dvitīyārṇatrayaṃ devi bhavet sañjīvanaṃ manoḥ | siddhavidyā mahāśyāmā sarvadoṣavivarjitā || 4 ||
japyā sidhyai sadā sadbhirbrahmavidbhirmumukṣubhiḥ | bhadrikāyugalaṃ devi dadyādante manoḥ śive || 5 ||
bhadrakālīmanoreṣa syāt sañjīvanako manuḥ | tāraṃ parāṃ paṭhedante japādau sādhakeśvari || 6 ||
rājamātaṅginīdevyā bhavet sañjīvanaṃ manoḥ | vāratrayaṃ paṭhedādau mūlamantrasya vai parām || 7 ||
mantrasya bhuvaneśvaryā bhavet sañjīvanaṃ param | kālīṃ tāraṃ (k, kh, g, gh: kālītrayaṃ) paṭhedante mantrasyāsya maheśvari || 8 ||
ugratārāmanoreṣa syāt sañjīvanako manuḥ |
vāsanāṃ mūlamantrasya japedante maheśvari || 9 ||
chinnamastāmanoreṣa syāt sañjīvanako manuḥ | parāmādau japed devi kāmamante tathaiva ca || 10 ||
sumukhīmantrarājasya bhavet sañjīvanaṃ priye | tāradvayaṃ japenmantrī mantrānte māntrikeśvari || 11 ||
sarasvatīmanoreṣa syāt sañjīvanako manuḥ | viśvamante japedādau ṭhadvayaṃ kālikeśvari || 12 ||
annapūrṇāmanoryena bhavet sañjīvanaṃ param | vāṇīmante japedādau kāmarājaṃ ca sādhakaḥ || 13 ||
mahālakṣmīmanordevi bhavet sañjīvanaṃ param | kūrcamādau parāmante japet sādhakasattamaḥ || 14 ||
śārikāmūlamantrasya bhavet sañjīvanaṃ priye | kāmarājaṃ japedādau māyābījaṃ tathāñcale || 15 ||
śāradāmantrarājasya sañjīvanamanuḥ smṛtaḥ | manmathaṃ śaktibījaṃ ca japedādau ca sādhakaḥ || 16 ||
indrākṣīmūlamantrasya sañjīvanamanuḥ paraḥ | mṛtsnābījaṃ japed devi praṇavaṃ ca vanāñcale || 17 ||
bagalāmantrarājasya bhavet sañjīvanaṃ param | tārakaṃ mūlamantrānte triruccārya japet priye || 18 ||
turyāmantrasya nirṇītaḥ sañjīvanamanuḥ paraḥ | vahnibījaṃ japedante śaktimādau maheśvari || 19 ||
rājñīmantrasya mantro'yaṃ sañjīvanakaraḥ smṛtaḥ | kūrcamādau ca turagaṃ japedante maheśvari || 20 ||
jvālāmukhīmanoreṣa mantraḥ sañjīvanābhidhaḥ | vāgbhavaṃ praṇavādau ca ṭhadvayānte japet parām || 21 ||
eṣa sañjīvano mantro bhīḍābhagavatīmanoḥ |
tāramante ramāmādau japet sādhakasattamaḥ (kh: tatparam) || 22 ||
gaṇeśvarīkālarātryāḥ syāt sañjīvanako manuḥ | kūrcamādau harānte māṃ japet sādhakasattamaḥ (kh: pārvati sādhakaḥ) || 23 ||
bhavānīmūlamantrasya bhavet sañjīvanaṃ param | māyāmuccārya deveśi trirādau tristathāñcale || 24 ||
sañjīvanamanurdevi syādvajrayoginīmanoḥ | maṭhamante maṭhaṃ cādau japet pārvati kaulikaḥ || 25 ||
mantro'yaṃ dhūmravārāhyā manoḥ sañjīvanābhidhaḥ | haritaṃ mūlamantrānte japedādau ca manmatham || 26 ||
siddhalakṣmīmanoreṣa syāt sañjīvanako manuḥ | kāṅkṣāmādau ramāmante japet sādhakasattamaḥ || 27 ||
bhavet sañjīvanaṃ devi kulavāgīśvarīmanoḥ | kāmamādau mahādevi japedante ramāṃ śive || 28 ||
padmāvatīmanoreṣa smṛtaḥ sañjīvano manaḥ | vāgurāṃ paṅkajānte ca praṇavādau parāṃ japet || 29 ||
kubjikāmūlamantrasya mantro'yaṃ jīvanābhidhaḥ | vāhlīkaṃ praṇavādau ca mūlānte tu (kh: nte'pi) śivaṃ japet || 30 ||
gaurīmantrasya mantro'yaṃ syāt sañjīvanakābhidhaḥ | kūṭamante viśvamādau japet pārvati sādhakaḥ || 31 ||
khecarīmantrarājasya bhavet sañjīvanaṃ śive | vāṇīmādau parāmante japenmāntrikasattamaḥ || 32 ||
bhavet sañjīvanaṃ devi nīlāsarasvatīmanoḥ | vāgbhavaṃ praṇavādau ca kāmamante japet śive || 33 ||
eṣa sañjīvano mantraḥ parāśaktimanoḥ smṛtaḥ |
adhunā śaivamantrāṇāṃ niṣkīlānāṃ maheśvari || 34 ||
vakṣye tattvaṃ rahasyaṃ te sañjīvanakaraṃ param | mūlamantrāñcale mantrī japet tāraṃ pṛthak pṛthak || 35 ||
sarveṣāṃ śaivamantrāṇāṃ bhavet sañjīvanaṃ priye | tathāpi kīlitānāṃ te sañjīvanamanūn bruve || 36 ||
yeṣāṃ sādhanamātreṇa mūlavidyāśu sidhyati | sūryanāmākṣaradvandvaṃ japedādau ca sādhakaḥ || 37 ||
mṛtyuñjayamanoreṣa mantraḥ sañjīvanābhidhaḥ | viśvamādau viśvamante japenmāntrikanāyakaḥ || 38 ||
amṛteśvaramantrasya bhavet sañjīvanaṃ param | vaṭukāyeti tārādau japet pārvati sādhakaḥ || 39 ||
sañjīvanamanuḥ prokto vaṭukasyaiṣa durlabhaḥ | śivaṃ ca praṇavādau tu japet sādhakavandite || 40 ||
śrīnīlakaṇṭhamantrasya mantraḥ sañjīvanābhidhaḥ | parāmādau triruccārya japādau sañjapet sudhīḥ || 41 ||
sadyojātamanoreṣa smṛtaḥ sañjīvano manuḥ | śivamante dviruccārya japed devi japāditaḥ || 42 ||
mahāgaṇapatermantro manoḥ sañjīvanābhidhaḥ | vajrabījāni mūlādau japet pārvati sādhakaḥ || 43 ||
aghoradevamantrasya manuḥ sañjīvanaḥ smṛtaḥ | nirdoṣo mantrarājo'yaṃ mahākālasya pārvati || 44 ||
asyoccāraṇamātreṇa mantrāḥ sidhyanti sarvadā | kūṭatrayebhyo deveśi dvitīyākṣaramuccaret || 45 ||
japet kāmeśamantrasya bhavet sañjīvanaṃ śive | athāhaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu manūnāṃ vacmi jīvanam || 46 ||
yāñjaptvā sādhako devi bhavedbhairavasannibhaḥ | haritaṃ mūlamantrāntaṃ japet pārvati sādhakaḥ || 47 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇamanorbhavet sañjīvanaṃ param | śaktimante manorādau vāgbhavaṃ sādhako japet || 48 ||
śrīrādhākṛṣṇamantrasya sañjīvanamanuḥ smṛtaḥ | viśvānte praṇavaṃ devi japet sādhakasattamaḥ || 49 ||
viṣṇumantrasya mantro'yaṃ smṛtaḥ sañjīvanābhidhaḥ | nṛbījaṃ prathamaṃ devi praṇavaṃ cāñcale japet || 50 ||
lakṣmīnṛsiṃhamantrasya mantraḥ sañjīvanābhidhaḥ | ramāmante triruccārya japedānandanirbhare || 51 ||
lakṣmīvarāhamantrasya sañjīvanamanuḥ smṛtaḥ | parāyugaṃ japedādau mantrarājasya pārvati || 52 ||
mantro bhārgavarāmasya manoḥ sañjīvanaḥ smṛtaḥ | mantrānte praṇavaṃ devi tārādau sakalāṃ japet || 53 ||
śrīsītārāmamantrasya manoḥ sañjīvano manuḥ | viśvamādau parāmante japet pārvati māntrikaḥ || 54 ||
janārdanamanoreṣa mantraḥ sañjīvanaḥ smṛtaḥ | parāmādau parāmante satārāṃ sādhako japet || 55 ||
viśvaksenamanoreṣa syāt sañjīvanako manuḥ | ramāmādau ramāmante japādau sañjapet sudhīḥ || 56 ||
śrīlakṣmīvāsudevasya manoḥ sañjīvano manuḥ | itīdaṃ mantrasarvasvaṃ rahasyaṃ sāramadbhutam | tava bhaktyā mayākhyātaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 57 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye mantrasañjīvanavidhinirūpaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 6 ||
atha
[saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā kathayiṣyāmi vidyāṃ śāpaharīṃ śive | sarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāṃ kalau nistejasāṃ śṛṇu || 1 ||
yā bālā bhairavī saiva saiva tripurasundarī | tirpurā yāsti sā kālī śyāmā saiva parā smṛtā || 2 ||
tāraṃ parāṃ ramāṃ bāle śivaśāpaṃ vimocaya | vimocaya haraṃ nīraṃ bālāśāpaharī smṛtā || 3 ||
vāṇī śarat smaro rudraśāpaṃ mocaya mocaya | turagaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ devi bhairavīśāpamocanam || 4 ||
bālābījatrayaṃ kūṭamādyaṃ tāraṃ parāṃ ramām | sadāśivasya śāpaṃ ca mocaya dvayamuddharet || 5 ||
śarat kūṭaṃ paṭhedante vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī | śyāmā paramavidyeyaṃ dvāviṃśatyakṣarī parā || 6 ||
mahāśrīṣoḍaśīvidyā sarvadoṣavivarjitā | tathāpi durlabhāṃ vidyāṃ vakṣye'haṃ śāpahāriṇīm || 7 ||
dvāviṃśatyakṣarīdevyā yathā mantro hi siddhyati | kālīṃ kūrcaṃ paraṃ nāma dakṣiṇe kālike tathā || 8 ||
vasiṣṭhaśāpaṃ proccārya mocaya dvayamīśvari | kālīṃ kūrcaṃ parāṃ nīrameṣā syācchāpahāriṇī || 9 ||
kālīṃ bhīmāṃ taṭaṃ bhadrakāli bhīmāṃ śivasya hi |
śāpaṃ mocaya yugmāpo vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 10 ||
tāraṃ parāṃ ca mātaṅgi kālaśāpaṃ vimocaya | turagaṃ nīramante tu vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 11 ||
māyāṃ bhairavaśāpaṃ ca mocaya dvayamañcale | māyāṃ syādbhuvaneśvaryā vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 12 ||
praṇavaṃ kāminīṃ māyāṃ brahmaśāpaṃ vimocaya | vimocayāpastārāyā vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 13 ||
vāsanāṃ kamalāṃ māyāṃ rudraśāpaṃ vimocaya | mocayāpo mayākhyātaṃ chinnamastāṅkamocanam || 14 ||
vāgbhavaṃ kāmarājaṃ ca śivaśāpaṃ vimocaya | parāṃ nīramiyaṃ vidyā sumukhyāḥ śāpahāriṇī || 15 ||
praṇavaṃ vāsanāṃ tāraṃ sarasvati vadet tataḥ | durvāsaḥśāpaṃ muñcāśu ṭhadvayaṃ śāpamocanam || 16 ||
tāraṃ parāmannapūrṇe śivaśāpaṃ vimocaya | kūrcaṃ haraṃ vanaṃ devi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 17 ||
tāraṃ ramāṃ mahālakṣmi viṣṇuśāpaṃ vimocaya | turagaṃ nīramīśāni vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 18 ||
tāraṃ ca sindhuraṃ devi śārike brahmalāñchanam | mocaya dvayamāpaśca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 19 ||
tāraṃ māyāṃ śārade ca viṣṇuśāpaṃ vimocaya | śaktirnīraṃ mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 20 ||
tāraṃ vāṇī śaratkāmamindrākṣi brahmalāñchanam | mocaya dvayamāpaśca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 21 ||
tāraṃ mṛtsnāṃ ca bagale rudraśāpaṃ vimocaya | tāraṃ mṛdaṃ vanaṃ devi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 22 ||
tāraṃ tārāṃ ca turye tu śivaśāpaṃ vimocaya | tārakaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ devi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 23 ||
tāraṃ vahniṃ śaradrājñi brahmaśāpaṃ vimocaya | vimocaya vanaṃ devi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 24 ||
tāraṃ ramāṃ parāṃ jvālāmukhi bhairavalāñchanam | kūrcaṃ nīraṃ mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 25 ||
tāraṃ parāṃ ramāṃ bhīḍe dhruvaśāpaṃ vimocaya | mocayāpo mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 26 ||
tāraṃ vāṇīṃ ca ḍimbaṃ ca kālarātri śivasya ca | śāpaṃ mocaya nīraṃ ca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 27 ||
tāraṃ ramāṃ ramāṃ tāraṃ rudraśāpaṃ vimocaya | kūrcaṃ haraṃ vanaṃ devi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 28 ||
tāraṃ parāṃ parāṃ tāraṃ vajrayogini proddharet | śivaśāpaṃ mocayāpo vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 29 ||
tāraṃ ramāṃ ca vārāhi nāradāṅkaṃ vimocaya | maṭhaṃ nīraṃ mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 30 ||
tāraṃ ramāṃ siddhalakṣmi siddhaśāpaṃ vimocaya | vāṇī śarat smaro nīraṃ vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 31 ||
tāraṃ vyoṣaṃ ramāṃ kāṅkṣāṃ kulavāgīśvari sphuṭam | śivaśāpaṃ ca muñcāpo vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 32 ||
tāraṃ māyāṃ ca padmaṃ ca padmāvati harestathā | śāpaṃ muñcayugaṃ nīraṃ vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 33 ||
tāraṃ māyāṃ kubjike ca jahnuśāpaṃ vimocaya | nīramante mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 34 ||
tāraṃ śivaṃ gauri bhṛgoḥ śāpaṃ mocaya mocaya |
nīramante manordevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 35 ||
(kh: pustake adhikaḥ) (tāraṃ khecari rudrasya śāpaṃ mocaya mocaya | parāṃ nīraṃ mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 36 ||)
tāraṃ vāṇī ca nīleti sarasvati haricchalam | mocayāpo manorante vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 37 ||
tāraṃ śaktiḥ parāśakte śivaśāpaṃ vimocaya | vimocaya śarannīraṃ vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 38 ||
adhunā śaivamantrāṇāṃ kīlitānāṃ maheśvari | sarvasādhāraṇīṃ vidyāṃ vakṣye'haṃ śāpahāriṇīm || 39 ||
niṣkīlitānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ vidyāṃ śāpaharīṃ śṛṇu | yasyā uccāramātreṇa duṣṭamantro'pi sidhyati || 40 ||
tāraṃ parāṃ ramāṃ vāṇīṃ kāmaṃ śaktiṃ sadāśiva | śivaśāpaṃ mocayāpo vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 41 ||
tāraṃ hṛjjaṃ śaradrudraśāpaṃ mocaya mocaya | śaradhṛjjaṃ ca tāraṃ ca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 42 ||
tāraṃ tato'mṛteśāna śivaśāpaṃ vomocaya | yugmamante tathā tāraṃ vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 43 ||
tāraṃ parāṃ ca vaṭuka brahmaśāpaṃ vimocaya | dvayaṃ ca devīpraṇavo vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 44 ||
tāraṃ ca nīlakaṇṭheti durvāsāṅkaṃ vimocaya | mocayāpo mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 45 ||
tāraṃ chaviḥ parā tāraṃ sadyojāta ravicchalam | mocaya ṭhadvayaṃ devi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 46 ||
tāraṃ śivaṃ gaṇeśāna rudraśāpaṃ vimocaya |
vanamante mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 47 ||
tāramādyakṣarahavirdeva svacchandanāyaka | śivaśāpaṃ mocayāpo vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 48 ||
tāraṃ kūrcaṃ parāṃ devi mahākāla vidhicchalam | mocaya dvayamāpaśca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 49 ||
vāgbhavaṃ kāmaśaktiśca bhairavāṅkaṃ vimocaya | tāraṃ parāmādyabījaṃ vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 50 ||
atha vaiṣṇavamantrāṇāṃ śṛṇu pārvati sādaram | vidyāṃ śāpaharīṃ sadyo mantrasiddhirbhaved yataḥ || 51 ||
tāraṃ ramāṃ ca lakṣmīti nārāyaṇa śivacchalam | mocaya dvayamāpaśca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 52 ||
tāraṃ śaktiḥ parā tāraṃ rādhākṛṣṇa vidhicchalam | mocayāpo mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 53 ||
tāraṃ parāṃ ramāṃ viṣṇo rudraśāpaṃ vimocaya | tāraṃ ṭhadvayamante ca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 54 ||
tāraṃ parāṃ nṛbījaṃ ca narasiṃha śivacchalam | mocaya dvayamāpaśca (kh: po'nte) vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 55 ||
tāraṃ ramāṃ (kh: parāṃ) ca lakṣmīti varāha harilāñchanam | mocaya dvayamāpo'nte vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 56 ||
tāraṃ kūrcaṃ bhārgaveti śukraśāpaṃ vimocaya | turagaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ devi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 57 ||
tāraṃ ramāṃ rāmabhadra guruśāpaṃ vimocaya | haraṃ ṭhadvayamante ca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 58 ||
(kh: pustake adhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ) (tāraṃ ramā ramā tāraṃ janārdana vidhicchalam |
mocayāpo mahādevi vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 59 ||)
tāraṃ parāṃ ramāṃ tāraṃ viśvaksena manucchalam | mocaya dvayamāpaśca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 60 ||
tāraṃ ramā ramā lakṣmīvāsudeva śivacchalam | mocaya dvayamāpaśca vidyeyaṃ śāpahāriṇī || 61 ||
itīdaṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ rahasyaṃ sāramuttamam | guhyaṃ sarvasvamīśāni gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 62 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye śāpaharīvidyoddhāranirūpaṇaṃ saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 7 || atha
[aṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā kathayiṣyāmi japasādhanamuttamam | yena sādhitamātreṇa mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate || 1 ||
gurupādaprasādena śrīvidyā yadi labhyate | puraskriyājapenaiva cettāṃ sādhayituṃ kṣamaḥ || 2 ||
vāgmī dhanī jayī śūra iha bhogī sa bhūpatiḥ | paratra sādhako devi bhaved bhairavasannibhaḥ || 3 ||
sudine śubhanakṣatre prātaḥkṛtyaṃ vidhāya ca |
svagṛhaṃ svaguruṃ nītvā natvā pādau maheśvari || 4 ||
prakṣālya pūjāyatane śrīcakraṃ pūjayecchive | sindūreṇa likhet tryasraṃ guruṃ tatra niveśayet || 5 ||
tāraṃ śivatrayaṃ devi gurave padamuccaret | viśvamante mahādevi gurumantro'yamuttamaḥ || 6 ||
anena mūlamantreṇa guruṃ saṃpūjayet sudhīḥ | mātṛkābhiḥ samaṃ devi yathāsthāneṣu pārvati || 7 ||
gandhākṣataprasūnādyairdravyairdevi śubhāmbaraiḥ | guruṃ santoṣayet tatra dakṣiṇābhiḥ kulāmṛtaiḥ || 8 ||
tadājñāṃ śirasādāya japāya sādhakottamaḥ | ravau prātarmahādevi guruṃ natvā ca sādhakaḥ || 9 ||
prāṅmukhaḥ praṇato bhūtvā japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | śivaśaktyoḥ pṛthag devi japaṃ saṃpādya sādhakaḥ || 10 ||
ṣaḍaṅgaṃ mūlamantrasya daśāṃśena japet tataḥ | tato devi japenmantrī chandomunimanuṃ tataḥ || 11 ||
tato devi jayī japtvā homaṃ kuryād daśāṃśataḥ | tarpayitvā daśāṃśena mārjayet taddaśāṃśataḥ || 12 ||
bhojayitvā daśāṃśena japasiddhirbhavet tataḥ | japāt siddhirjapāt siddhirjapāt siddhirmaheśvari || 13 ||
na stavānnārcanād dhyānāt siddhirbhavati tādṛśī | pārāyaṇajapenāsti yādṛśī mantriṇāṃ śive || 14 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan parameśāna sādhakānāṃ hitecchayā | pārāyaṇajapaṃ brūhi yadyahaṃ tava vallabhā || 15 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
devi pārāyaṇaṃ vakṣye vidyājapaphalāptaye | yena siddhiyuto mantrī bhavedbhairavasannibhaḥ || 16 ||
asaṃkhyātāśca vikhyātāḥ pārāyaṇajapāḥ priye | teṣāṃ tattvaṃ paraṃ vakṣye yena brahmamayo bhavet || 17 ||
pārāyaṇastu sa japaḥ samyag yad brahmacintanam | tasyaiva saguṇasyātra cintanaṃ ghaṭikājapaḥ || 18 ||
dvividho'yaṃ japo devi saguṇo nirguṇastathā | siddhaḥ sādhya iti smṛtvā japet pārāyaṇaṃ manum || 19 ||
kaleryugārambhadine dineśo hṛllekhabīje'bhyudito babhūva | tadādi nityaṃ ghaṭikaikamānāt pratyakṣaraṃ yāti dine dine'rkaḥ || 20 ||
navārṇamantrāvalimeti sūryo madhyandine sāyamatha prabhāte | tribhāgamādyantarayostathānte vidhāya mantrasya japenmumukṣuḥ || 21 ||
ekādipañcāśativarṇapaṅktyā saṃyojya mantrasya navākṣarāṇi | ghaṭīpramāṇāḥ kulamātṛkāyā bhavanti varṇā manurājasiddhyaiḥ || 22 ||
āī(-)vibhūṣitāṃ kṛtvā mātṛkāṃ haṃsabhūṣitām | mūlavidyāṃ japenmantrī śivaśaktimayīṃ śive || 23 ||
pañcanādān parityajya yo japet ṣoḍaśākṣarīm | pañcaṣaṣṭyakṣarīmūlān pañcanādātmako bhavet || 24 ||
ādito devi vidyādau vidyāmadhye tadagrataḥ | vidyānte'pi tyajedvidyāṃ śivarūpāṃ śivo bhavet || 25 ||
śahake viśvarūpo'pi sūryo'kāre tadoditaḥ | tadā prabhṛti loke'smin mātṛkāsu caredraviḥ || 26 ||
vāsanāvaśatastryakṣo vahnitejomayo bhavet | lakṣmīṃ prāpya śivo mantrī saubhāgyāntāṃ yathākramam || 27 ||
payodavidyayā vidyāmāī(-)pallavitāṃ kramāt |
haṃsāntāṃ sañjaped devi mantrī mātṛkayā sadā || 28 ||
ayaṃ pārāyaṇo nāma japaḥ siddhipradaḥ kalau | mahāśrīṣoḍaśīvidyāmaṣṭabhūtimayīṃ parām || 29 ||
vedādibhūtāṃ prajapenmātṛkābhiḥ kulāśrayaḥ | idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ pārāyaṇajapātmakam | brahmavidyālayotthānaṃ nākhyeyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ || 30 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye pārāyaṇajapavidhinirūpaṇamaṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 8 || atha
[navamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
athāhaṃ sarvamantrāṇāṃ vakṣye saṃpuṭasaṅkramam | yaṃ vijñāya bhaved devi sarvasaukhyamayaḥ sudhīḥ || 1 ||
bālāyāḥ śaktibījaṃ tu dadyādādau maheśvari | bālātripurasundaryāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥ || 2 ||
māyātrayaṃ paṭhedante trikūṭāyā maheśvari | sādhyastripurabhairavyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥ || 3 ||
śaktyādikūṭaṃ mantrasya dadyādādau japenmanum | mahātripurasundaryā mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 4 ||
śyāmāsti dakṣiṇākālī dvāviṃśatyakṣarī śive |
sarvadoṣavinirmuktā purāpi kathitaṃ mayā || 5 ||
bhadrikāmañcale dattvā japenmūlaṃ maheśvari | bhadrakālyā ayaṃ mantraḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'sti sundari (ṅ: pārvati) || 6 ||
tāramante japed (jape iti syāt) devi trivāraṃ proccaret sudhīḥ | rājamātaṅginīdevyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥ || 7 ||
viśvānte ca parābījaṃ daśavāraṃ paṭhecchive | mantro'yaṃ bhuvaneśvaryāḥ saṃpuṭākhyaḥ susiddhidaḥ || 8 ||
turagaṃ mūlamantrādau japet pārvati sādhakaḥ | ugratārāmanoreṣa mantraḥ śrīsaṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 9 ||
māyādvayaṃ japedante sādhakaḥ sādhakeśvari | mantro'yaṃ chinnamastāyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'tidurlabhaḥ || 10 ||
padmatrayaṃ paṭhedādau māyāmante maheśvari | devyā ucchiṣṭamātaṅgyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥ || 11 ||
vāgbhavaṃ ca manorante paṭhet sādhakasattamaḥ | sarasvatyā manordevi mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 12 ||
tāraṃ kāmaṃ manorante dadyāt pārvati sādhakaḥ | annapūrṇāmanoreṣa manuḥ syāt saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 13 ||
vāgbhavaṃ prathamaṃ dadyādante dadyācca manmatham | devatāyā mahālakṣmyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥ || 14 ||
sindhuraṃ sādhako dadyānmanorante maheśvari | śārikāmūlamantrasya mantraḥ saṃpuṭakābhidhaḥ || 15 ||
tāraṃ kāmaṃ manorante paṭhet sādhakasattamaḥ | śāradāyāḥ sarasvatyā'mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 16 ||
śaktimādau paṭhenmantrī vāṇīmante maheśvari |
indrākṣyā vajrahastāyā mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 17 ||
rasanāṃ mṛttikābījaṃ manorante paṭhet sudhīḥ | śrīdevyā bagalāmukhyā mantraḥ saṃpuṭakābhidhaḥ || 18 ||
tāraṃ dadyānmanorante japet pārvati sādhakaḥ | mahāturyā manoreṣa saṃpuṭākhyo'sti siddhidaḥ || 19 ||
vahniṃ vāṇīṃ paṭhedante japet pārvati sādhakaḥ | mahārājñyā manoreṣa manuḥ syāt saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 20 ||
kūrcamādau haraṃ cānte japenmūlaṃ maheśvari | jvālāmukhyā ayaṃ mantraḥ saṃpuṭākhyo'sti pārvati || 21 ||
tāraṃ śaktiṃ manorante ṭhadvayaṃ prathamaṃ paṭhet | saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ mantro bhīḍāyā devadurlabhaḥ || 22 ||
kuru bījaṃ japedādau viśvānte praṇavaṃ paṭhet | kālarātrimanoreṣa mantraḥ saṃpuṭakāraṇam || 23 ||
ramāṃ tāraṃ paṭhedante kūrcamādau maheśvari | bhavānīmūlamantrasya saṃpuṭo'yaṃ mayeritaḥ || 24 ||
tārādau sakalāṃ dadyādante tāraṃ japet priye | saṃpuṭo varṇito devi śrīvajrayoginīmanoḥ || 25 ||
maṭhabījaṃ japedādau mantrānte paṅkajaṃ japet | mantro'yaṃ dhūmravārāhyāḥ saṃpuṭākhyo mayeritaḥ || 26 ||
kāmarājaṃ japedādau viśvānte vāgbhavaṃ japet | siddhalakṣmīmanoreṣa saṃpuṭo varṇito mayā || 27 ||
spṛhāmādau japed devi vanānte paṅkajaṃ japet | mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭākhyo'sti kulavāgīśvarīmanoḥ || 28 ||
kāmarājaṃ japedādau vanānte sakalāṃ japet | padmāvatīmanoreṣa mantraḥ syāt saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 29 ||
vāgurāṃ praṇavādau ca vanānte paṅkajaṃ japet | kubjikāmūlamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 30 ||
maṭhamādau mahādevi ṭhadvayānte śivaṃ japet | gaurīmantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭo varṇito mayā || 31 ||
viśvānte sañjapet kūṭaṃ kūṭādau śaradaṃ japet | khecarīmūlamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 32 ||
kūrcaṃ japenmanorādau vanānte turagaṃ japet | manornīlasarasvatyāḥ saṃpuṭo varṇito mayā || 33 ||
vāgbhavaṃ prathamaṃ devi praṇavaṃ ṭhadvayāñcale | parāśaktimanoreṣa mantraḥ saṃpuṭakāraṇam || 34 ||
niṣkīlitānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ śaivānāṃ kulapūjite | sarvasādhāraṇaṃ vakṣye saṃpuṭaṃ surapūjite || 35 ||
tāradvayaṃ japedādau madhye nāmāñcale parām | sarveṣāṃ śaivamantrāṇāṃ saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥ || 36 ||
tāraṃ hṛjjaṃ paṭhenmadhye pālaya dvayamāditaḥ | mṛtyuñjayamanoreṣa saṃpuṭo varṇito mayā || 37 ||
viśvamādau mahādevi śaktimante japet sudhīḥ | amṛteśvaramantrasya saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ manuḥ || 38 ||
kuru dvayādau praṇavaṃ parānte'pi kuru dvayam | saṃpuṭākhyo manuḥ prokto vaṭukasya mayā śive || 39 ||
haritaṃ dviḥ samuccārya madhye nāma tataḥ parām | mantro'yaṃ nīlakaṇṭhasya saṃpuṭākhyo mayeritaḥ || 40 ||
tāramante parāmādau japet sādhakasattamaḥ | sadyojātasya mantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 41 ||
parātrayaṃ śivānte ca praṇavānte śivatrayam |
mahāgaṇapatereṣa mantraḥ saṃpuṭakārakaḥ || 42 ||
viśvabījaṃ japedādau viśvamante japet priye | mantro'styaghoradevasya varṇitaḥ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 43 ||
kūṭamādau mahādevi kūṭānte vāgbhavaṃ japet | śrīkāmeśvaramantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 44 ||
eteṣāmapi mantrāṇāṃ śaivānāṃ kulanāyike | niṣkīlito mahākālamantro doṣavivarjitaḥ || 45 ||
adhunā vaiṣṇavānāṃ te mantrāṇāṃ parameśvari | vakṣye saṃpuṭamantrāṃśca sādhakānāṃ hitecchayā || 46 ||
nāmānte kamalāṃ devi viśvānte praṇavaṃ japet | lakṣmīnārāyaṇamanormantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 47 ||
haramādau mahādevi ṭhadvayānte ramāṃ japet | śrīrādhākṛṣṇamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 48 ||
tāramante japedādau viśvaṃ viśvasamarcite | śrīviṣṇumūlamantrasya (k, kh: viṣṇoḥ) mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 49 ||
smaramādau japed devi ramābījaṃ tathāñcale | lakṣmīnṛsiṃhamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 50 ||
viśvamādau manordevi nāmno'gre sakalāṃ japet | lakṣmīvarāhamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 51 ||
sarojaṃ prathamaṃ devi vanānte ca ramāṃ japet | jāmadagnyamanoreṣa mantraḥ saṃpuṭakārakaḥ || 52 ||
tāramante vanaṃ cādau japet sādhakasattamaḥ | śrīsītārāmamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 53 ||
viśvānte nāma deveśi māyugaṃ prathamaṃ japet |
śrījanārdanamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 54 ||
parāmādau parāmante japet sādhakanāyakaḥ | viśvaksenamanoreṣa mantraḥ saṃpuṭakārakaḥ || 55 ||
vāṇīmādau japed devi lakṣmīmante maheśvari | śrīvāsudevamantrasya mantro'yaṃ saṃpuṭābhidhaḥ || 56 ||
itīdaṃ mantrasarvasvaṃ rahasyaṃ tattvamuttamam | tava snehena nirṇītaṃ gopanīyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ || 57 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye saṃpuṭavidhinirūpaṇaṃ navamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 9 || atha
[daśamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devi vakṣye'haṃ puraścaraṇasādhanam | yena sādhitamātreṇa mantraḥ siddhiprado bhavet || 1 ||
jīvahīno yathā dehī (kh: dehaḥ) sarvakarmasu na kṣamaḥ | puraścaraṇahīno hi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ || 2 ||
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tadardhaṃ vā maheśvari | ekalakṣāvadhiṃ kuryānnāto nyūnaṃ kadācana || 3 ||
vaṭe'raṇye śmaśāne ca śūnyāgāre catuṣpathe |
ardharātre'pi madhyāhne puraścaraṇamārabhet || 4 ||
sudine śubhanakṣatre sumuhūrte maheśvari | svaguruṃ pūjayitvādau puraścaryāṃ samārabhet || 5 ||
gurorājñāṃ samādāya snātvā vedīṃ caret sudhīḥ | catuṣkoṇāmīśadiśi svahastaparivistṛtām || 6 ||
tatra liptvā mahādevi sindūreṇāṣṭagandhakaiḥ | likhed bindutryasramādau ṣaḍaśraṃ vṛttamaṇḍalam || 7 ||
vasupatraṃ ravṛttāḍhyaṃ bhūgehenopaśobhitam (k, kh: gṛheṇo) | puraścaryāyantrametadgaditaṃ girije mayā || 8 ||
sarvasādhāraṇaṃ pūjyaṃ sādhakaistattvadarśibhiḥ | indrāgniyamamāṃsāda varuṇānilavittadāḥ || 9 ||
seśvarā laraya(ṭa)kṣābhrayasahaṃbījamaṇḍitāḥ (k: ma) | pūjyā sahetayo devi dharābhavanamaṇḍale || 10 ||
brāhmī ca vaiṣṇavī raudrī kaumārī nārasiṃhikā | vārāhī caṇḍikā devi pūjanīyāparājitā || 11 ||
sabhairavā vasudale vāmāvṛttyā mumukṣubhiḥ | pārvatī kubjikā durgā cāmuṇḍā nīlatāriṇī || 12 ||
kātyāyanī pūjanīyā ṣaḍaśreṣu mahattaraiḥ | gaṅgā ca yamunā devi pūjyā tryaśre sarasvatī || 13 ||
bindau pūjyā ca saśivā sādhakairiṣṭadevatā | mūlamantreṇa gandhārghyapuṣpadhūpādidīpakaiḥ || 14 ||
tatra bindau nyasedyantraṃ sveṣṭadevyā maheśvari | vedīvidikṣu saṃsthāpya mantrī ghaṭacatuṣṭayam || 15 ||
mūlena sādhako devi yavān saṃmantrya vāpayet |
vahninirṛtivāteśakrameṇaivaṃ samarcayet || 16 ||
gaṇeśaṃ bhāratīṃ durgāṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ghaṭeṣu ca | svasvamūlena deveśi tatra pūjāṃ tathāhnikīm || 17 ||
kuryāt tadagrato devi puraścaraṇamārabhet | śrīcakraṃ pūjayitvādau tataḥ kuryājjapaṃ sudhīḥ || 18 ||
śānto dambhaṃ tathā laulyaṃ tyajenmantrasya siddhaye | brahmacaryadharo mantrī dhyāyan devīṃ varapradām || 19 ||
japenmūlaṃ vaśī lakṣaṃ niyamena samāhitaḥ | haviṣyāśī mahādevi tataḥ siddhamanurbhavet || 20 ||
japtvā mantrī mantrarājaṃ hutvā devi daśāṃśataḥ | tarpayet taddaśāṃśena mārjayet taddaśāṃśataḥ || 21 ||
bhojayet taddaśāṃśena mantrasiddhirbhaved dhruvam | athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate || 22 ||
rātrau parastriyaṃ bālāṃ śyāmāṃ vā madanāturām | ānīya pūjayenmantrī yathoktavidhinā śive || 23 ||
nagno muktakaco dhīro madhupānaparāyaṇaḥ | śaktivakṣaḥsamāśliṣṭo japenmūlaṃ yathāvidhi || 24 ||
lakṣamekaṃ daśāṃśena saṃskṛtaṃ (kh, g: saṃskṛtaḥ) homatarpaṇaiḥ | mantrasiddhirbhavet tasya devānāmapi durlabhā || 25 ||
athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate | putrajanmotsavadine sūtikākulamandire || 26 ||
māntriko mūlamantraṃ svaṃ japed daśadināvadhi | daśāṃśasaṃskṛtaṃ (kh, g: taḥ) mantraṃ kuryāt siddho bhavenmanuḥ || 27 ||
athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate |
mṛtakāśaucadivase prathame sādhako japet || 28 ||
manuṃ vaśī dine rātrau vīro bhūtvā yathārthataḥ | ekādaśe'hani sudhīḥ kuryānmantraṃ tu saṃskṛtam || 29 ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā mantraḥ kalpadrumo bhavet | athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate || 30 ||
sūryodayāt samārabhya yāvat sūryodayāntaram | tāvajjaptvā nirātaṅko mantraḥ kalpadrumo bhavet || 31 ||
athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate | sūryoparāgavelāyāṃ japenmantraṃ maheśvari || 32 ||
japtvā homādikaṃ kṛtvā mantrasiddhirbhaved dhruvam | athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate || 33 ||
candroparāge deveśi japenmūlaṃ yathāvidhi | daśāṃśasaṃskṛto mantro bhaveccintāmaṇiḥ kṣaṇāt || 34 ||
yasya nāsti jape śaktiḥ pañcaratneśvarīṃ japet | varṇalakṣapuraścaryāphalamāpnoti sādhakaḥ || 35 ||
idaṃ tattvaṃ hi mantrāṇāṃ sārāt sāraṃ parāt param | avācyaṃ guhyamīśāni gopanīyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ || 36 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye puraścaryāvidhinirūpaṇaṃ daśamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 10 ||
atha
[ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devi vakṣye'haṃ puraścaryāphalaṃ param | yaṃ labdhvā sādhako devi martyo'pyamaratāṃ labhet || 1 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavaṃstattvavettā tvaṃ sakalāgamapāragaḥ | puraścaraṇahomasya vada me'dya vidhiṃ vibho || 2 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
japtvā manuṃ lakṣasaṃkhyaṃ sādhako mantrasādhakaḥ | gatvā rahaḥsthalaṃ devi homaṃ kuryād daśāṃśataḥ || 3 ||
sudine śubhanakṣatre sādhako bhairavārcane | gṛhītvā homasaṃbhāraṃ vrajet prayatamānasaḥ || 4 ||
tatraikataḥ śmaśānaṃ tu dhṛtvā saṃmukhapṛṣṭhayoḥ | aiśānyāṃ diśi deveśi likhecchrīcakramuttamam || 5 ||
tatsamabhyarcya vidhinā śrīcakraṃ mūlavidyayā | tato mantraṃ japet siddhamaṣṭottaraśatāvadhi || 6 ||
pūrvasyāṃ diśi sadyantrāt khanet kuṇḍaṃ trikoṇakam | hastaikavistṛtaṃ cādho hastaikaparimāṇataḥ || 7 ||
kuṇḍe'smin vilikhedyantraṃ tryaśraṃ binduvirājitam | ṣaṭkoṇamaṣṭapatraṃ ca trivṛttaṃ bhūgṛhāṅkitam || 8 ||
tataḥ pūjāṃ cared devi kuṇḍacakrasya pārvati | yathoktavidhinā yena sādhako dīkṣito bhavet || 9 ||
gaṇeśadharmavaruṇāḥ kuberasahitāstathā | caturdvāreṣu saṃpūjyāścatvāro dvārapālakāḥ || 10 ||
māyā ca mohinī mattā mādhavī vahnivallabhā | vartulī (g: vārtālī) vīrasūrvāmyā pūjyā aṣṭadalasthitāḥ || 11 ||
ambālikāmbā bagalā cchinnaśīrṣāmbikā bhagā | ṣaṭkoṇamadhyagāḥ pūjyāḥ kuṇḍacakre maheśvari || 12 ||
vahniṃ vaiśvānaraṃ cāgniṃ trikoṇe pūjayecchive | svāhābhagavatīṃ bindau jātavedasamarcayet || 13 ||
agniṃ mūlena deveśi vahnerdaśakalāstataḥ | tāraṃ vahniḥ śivo'bdhiśca hṛjjaṃ śaktirmaheśvari || 14 ||
agne vaiśvānaraṃ brūyājjaṭābhāreti saṃvadet | bhāsvareti trinetreti jvālāmukha padaṃ vadet || 15 ||
prajvaleti yugaṃ brūyājjātavedasi saṃvadet | ṭhadvayaṃ saṃvadedante mantro'yaṃ vahnivallabhaḥ || 16 ||
anena mūlamantreṇa vahnicakraṃ prapūjayet | gandhākṣataprasūnaiśca dhūpadīpāditarpaṇaiḥ || 17 ||
naivedyācamanīyādyaistāmbūlaiśca suvāsitaiḥ | tatra saṃpūjya deveśi śrīcakraṃ navayonikam || 18 ||
tato digbhairavān bhūtānarcayet kusumaiḥ param | tato devi pramathyāgniṃ kuṇḍacakre kuleśvari || 19 ||
bindau vahniṃ samāvāhya mūlenojjvālayecchive | agniṃ sandīpya mūlena praṇamed vahnimudrayā || 20 ||
mūlenāhutibhirvahniṃ hunet ṣoḍaśabhistataḥ | aṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā dadyādājyena pārvati || 21 ||
āhutīḥ pāyasairdevi mṛdvīkāgurupuṣpakaiḥ | matsyaṇḍaśarkarācandraiḥ kastūrīdṛṣadaṅkitaiḥ || 22 ||
tato japtvā mahāvidyāṃ sādhakān pūjayecchive | pañca vā nava vā devi tathaikādaśa vā śive || 23 ||
kulīnān dhārmikāñchuddhān dīkṣitān vāpyadīkṣitān | dṛḍhavratāñchubhācārān devībhaktiratāṃstathā || 24 ||
vaiṣṇavān girije śaivān gurubhaktiparāyaṇān | tatra saṃpūjya vidhivaj jñātvā bhairavasannibhān || 25 ||
pādyārghyamadhuparkādyairgandhākṣatasupuṣpakaiḥ | tān saṃpūjya mahādevi daśāṃśaṃ homamācaret || 26 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan devadeveśa tantrajña parameśvara | kulasādhakapūjāyāṃ saṃśayaṃ chetumarhasi || 27 ||
tatra pūjāvidhau nātha sarve pūjyā dvijottamāḥ | athavā kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā vā vada vistarāt || 28 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
pravṛtte bhairave tantre sarve varṇā dvijottamāḥ | nivṛtte bhairave tantre sarve varṇāḥ pṛthak pṛthak || 29 ||
sarvadā śivacakre'smin saṃpradāyo'yamīritaḥ | na puraścaraṇārcāyāṃ tatra sarve dvijottamāḥ || 30 ||
ekastu kṣatriyaḥ puṇyo dātā vaiṣṇavasattamaḥ | dṛḍhavrataḥ śubhācāraḥ kulīnaḥ śivapūjakaḥ || 31 ||
śāktaḥ paramabhaktaśca kulacakre nigadyate | tatra homaṃ ca saṃpādya dadyānnaivedyamādarāt || 32 ||
kulacakragatān devi brāhmaṇān sādhakottamān |
pūjayet kṣatriyo vīro bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 33 ||
gandhākṣatasupuṣpaiśca dhūpadīpādibhiḥ śive | naivedyācamanīyādyairbhakṣyairbhojyaiśca lehyakaiḥ || 34 ||
santarpya sādhakān devi paramānandasevitaḥ | sādhakaḥ kṣatriyaṃ vīraṃ dātāraṃ vīrasevakam || 35 ||
āśīrbhirvardhayed devi praṇamet tripurāmbikām | kulacakragatā virāḥ kulacakraprapūjakāḥ || 36 ||
sarve te kuladevyante yānti śīghraṃ kulālayam | kṣatriyo'pi mahādevi kulasaṅghān kulārthavit || 37 ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvasiddhisamanvitaḥ | iha loke śriyaṃ prāpya bhuktvā bhogān yathepsitān || 38 ||
paratra parameśāni mṛto devīpadaṃ vrajet | evaṃ vidhāya mantrajño homaṃ japaphalāptaye || 39 ||
puraścaryāphalaṃ devi varṇalakṣasya so'śnute | varṇalakṣajapasyaivaṃ phalamāpnoti kaulikaḥ || 40 ||
sarve tatra sthitā natvā śmaśānasthaṃ ca bhairavam | saṃhāramudrayā devīṃ visṛjya saśivāṃ śive || 41 ||
sarve te sādhakaśreṣṭhā bhaveyuḥ kulabhāginaḥ | idaṃ rahasyaṃ deveśi bhaktyā tava mayoditam | aprakāśyamadātavyamityājñā pārameśvarī || 42 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye puraścaryāhomavidhinirūpaṇamekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 11 ||
atha
[dvādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi guhyaṃ sarvasvamuttamam | śrīcakranirṇayaṃ nāma paṭalaṃ devadurlabham || 1 ||
devīnāṃ paramaprītyā yantroddhāraṃ bravīmyaham | yasya kasya na vaktavyaṃ gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 2 ||
trayastriṃśatidevānāṃ koṭayaḥ syurmaheśvari | devīnāṃ ca tathā devi trayastriṃśatikoṭayaḥ || 3 ||
tāsāṃ madhye pradhānāḥ syustrayastriṃśatidevatāḥ | pūrvoktā yā mahādevi tāsāṃ mantrottamāñchṛṇu || 4 ||
atha vakṣye tava prītyā bālāyantraṃ maheśvari | sarvārthasādhakaṃ devi sarvāśāparipūrakam || 5 ||
bindustrikoṇarasakoṇakanāgapatravṛttatrayāñcitamahīsadanatrayaṃ (k, kh, g: yārcita) ca | bālādicakramidamārtiharaṃ girīśabrahmendraviṣṇunamitaṃ gaditaṃ mayā te || 6 ||
atho tripurabhairavyā yantroddhāraṃ bravīmyaham | sakalāgamasārāḍhyamāpaduddhāraṇakṣamam || 7 ||
bindustryaśraṃ nāgakoṇaṃ daśāraṃ vṛttāñcitaṃ (k, kh: rcitaṃ) vasupatraṃ kalāram |
vṛttatrayaṃ bhūniketatrayaṃ ca śrīcakraṃ te varṇitaṃ bhairavīyam || 8 ||
atho tripurasundaryā vakṣye śrīcakranirṇayam | sarvasaṃmonaṃ devi sarvasiddhipravartakam || 9 ||
śūnyaṃ madhyagamagnikoṇasahitaṃ digdantikoṇāṅkitaṃ viṃśāraṃ manumiśritaṃ karidalaśrīṣoḍaśārāñcitam | sadvṛttatrayasaṃyutaṃ ca dharaṇīgehāṅkitaṃ traipuraṃ bhaktyābhīṣṭaphalapradaṃ kaliyuge śrīcakramuddyotate || 10 ||
bindustrikoṇavasukoṇadaśārayugmamanvaśranāgadalasaṅgataṣoḍaśāram | vṛttatrayaṃ ca dharaṇīsadanatrayaṃ ca śrīcakrametaduditaṃ paradevatāyāḥ || 11 ||
athāhaṃ kālikāyāste yantroddhāraṃ bravīmyaham | sarvārthasiddhidaṃ loke sarvakāmaprapūrakam || 12 ||
trikoṇasthaṃ śūnyaṃ tadupari śaratkoṇasahitaṃ trikoṇaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ bhagavati ca vṛttaṃ vasudalam | trivṛttaṃ tadbāhye kṣitibhuvanayuktaṃ ca jayatādidaṃ śyāmāyantraṃ maraṇabhayavargapramathanam || 13 ||
athāhaṃ bhadrakālyāste yantroddhāraṃ surapriyam | bravīmi dayayā devi sarvasārasvatapradam || 14 ||
madhye turyavaraṃ khamaṇḍalayutaṃ dviḥsaptakārāṅkitaṃ dvisturyārayugaṃ caturguṇacatuṣpatrāvalīśobhitam | sadvṛttatrayamaṇḍitaṃ bahirilāgehatrayodbhāsitaṃ jīyādyantramidaṃ yatheṣṭaphaladaṃ śrībhadrakālīpriyam (kh, g: bhaiṃ) || 15 ||
atha vakṣyāmi mātaṅgyā yantraṃ tantraviniścitam |
devadevi tava prītyā nacānyatra prakāśayet || 16 ||
bindustrikoṇaṃ vasukoṇayuktaṃ vṛttaṃ tato nāgadalaṃ trivṛttam | bhūmandiraṃ pārvati vahnirekhaṃ mātaṅginīyantramidaṃ pradiṣṭam || 17 ||
athāhaṃ bhuvaneśvaryā yantroddhāraṃ bravīmi te | prītyā bhaktyā maheśāni nacākhyeyaṃ mahātmabhiḥ || 18 ||
bindustrikoṇaṃ rasakoṇasaṃyutaṃ vṛttāñcitaṃ (k, kh, g: rcitaṃ) nāgadalena maṇḍitam | kalāravṛttatrayabhūgṛhāṅkitaṃ (k, kh, g: karāla) śrīcakrametad bhuvaneśvarīpriyam || 19 ||
atha vakṣyāmi tārāyā yantroddhāramanuttamam | bhogamokṣapradaṃ devi gopyaṃ kuru maheśvari || 20 ||
bindustrikoṇaṃ ca ṣaḍasrayuktaṃ vṛttaṃ tathāṣṭāramalaṃ trivṛttam | sabhūpuraṃ caikajaṭāvilāsagehaṃ mayā yantramidaṃ pradiṣṭam || 21 ||
athāhaṃ chinnamastāyā yantroddhāramanuttamam | pravakṣyāmi tava prītyā na vaktavyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ || 22 ||
bindustrikoṇaṃ ca bahistrikoṇaṃ trikoṇamūrdhvaṃ śubhavṛttabimbam | vasvaśrayuktaṃ dharaṇīgṛhaṃ syāt śrīcakrametat paradevatāyāḥ || 23 ||
atha vakṣyāmi te devyā yantroddhāraṃ maheśvari |
sumukhyāḥ sārasarvasvaṃ na deyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ || 24 ||
binduṃ cānatvakoṇagaṃ ca vilikhed bāṇāśrakoṇāṅkitaṃ vṛttaṃ nāgadalena maṇḍitamatho śrīṣoḍaśārāṅkitam | sadvṛttatrayasaṃyutaṃ ca dharaṇīgehāṅkitaṃ pārvati śrīcakraṃ sumukhīpriyaṃ vijayatād bhogāpavargapradam || 25 ||
adha vakṣyāmi tattvaṃ te yantroddhāraṃ maheśvari | sarasvatyāḥ kaulikānāṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 26 ||
trikoṇaṃ sabinduṃ tataḥ ṣaṭkakoṇaṃ savṛttaṃ tato nāgapatraṃ trivṛttam | dharāmandiraṃ vahnirekhojjvalaṃ te mayoktaṃ hi sārasvataṃ yantrametat || 27 ||
athāhamannapūrṇāyā yantrarājaṃ bravīmi te | sarvasaṃmohanaṃ devi sarvabhogaikasādhanam || 28 ||
trikoṇaṃ rasāraṃ trikoṇaṃ trikoṇaṃ trikoṇaṃ trikoṇaṃ trikoṇaṃ hi vṛttam | tato nāgapatrāñcitaṃ (k, kh, g: rcitaṃ) cāgnivṛttaṃ dharāmandiraṃ cānnapūrṇeṣṭacakram || 29 ||
atha vakṣye śive yantraṃ mahālakṣmyāḥ parāt param | yamabhyarcya mayā prāptaṃ durlabhaṃ paramaṃ padam || 30 ||
khaṃ vahnyāragataṃ ca kāramamalaṃ vṛttaṃ bahiḥ śobhanaṃ bāhye nāgadalaṃ kalāravilasadvṛttatrayodbhāsitam (k, kh, g: karāla) | bhūgehatrayaśobhitaṃ tava mayā nirṇītametat paraṃ śrīcakraṃ paramārthadāyi ca mahālakṣmīpriyaṃ siddhidam || 31 ||
yantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sādhakānāṃ śubhāvaham |
śārikāyā mahādevi līlālayalayākulam || 32 ||
khatrikoṇavasukoṇasuvṛttod(-) dyotanāgadalavṛttamaṇḍalam | bhūgṛhaṃ śikhiravīndubhāñcitaṃ yantrametaduditaṃ śilālayam || 33 ||
yantroddhāraṃ mahādevi śāradāyā bravīmyaham | sarvārthasādhakaṃ cakraṃ sarvakāmaprapūrakam || 34 ||
madhye bindustadbahiḥ syāt trikoṇaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ syād vṛttavasvaśrayuktam | vṛttākāraṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ trivṛttaṃ bhūgehaṃ syācchāradāyantrametat || 35 ||
athāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi yantroddhāraṃ sudurlabham | indrākṣyāstattvasarvasvaṃ triṣu lokeṣu gopitam || 36 ||
bindustrikoṇajaṣaḍaśraṣaḍasrayuktaṣaṭkoṇavṛttavasupatrakalāśramiśram | bhūgehabimbamanalenaśaśiprabhābhamindrākṣiṇīpriyataraṃ jayacakrametat || 37 ||
atha te bagalāmukhyā yantroddhāraṃ bravimyaham | sarvasiddhipradaṃ devi gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 38 ||
bindustrikoṇaṃ ca rasāravṛttavasvaśravṛttāñcitaṣoḍaśāram | vṛttatrayaṃ bhūsadanatrayaṃ ca śrīcakrametad bagalāmukhīyam || 39 ||
athāhaṃ te mahāturyāyantroddhāramanuttamam | bravīmi paramaprītyā sakalābhīṣṭasādhanam || 40 ||
bindustrikoṇaṃ navayoniyuktaṃ vṛttāñcitaṃ nāgadalaṃ trivṛttam | dharāgṛhaṃ vahnituṭībhirīḍyaṃ turyālayaṃ cakramidaṃ pradiṣṭam || 41 ||
yantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvāśāparipūrakam (g: mahārājñyā maheśvari) | sarvārthasādhakaṃ cakraṃ sarvasaṃmohanaṃ tathā || 42 ||
bindustryaśraṃ ṣaḍaśraṃ ca vṛttāṣṭadalamaṇḍitam | vṛttatrayaṃ dharāsadma rājñīśrīcakramīritam || 43 ||
atha yantravaraṃ vakṣye jvālāmukhyā maheśvari | sarvatattvaikanilayaṃ sarvavāñchitadāyakam || 44 ||
madhye śūnyaṃ tadupari śaratkoṇamālikhya devi tatrādhastāt trikamatha bahirdigdalaṃ vṛttamekam | vasvaśraṃ dviḥ kadalajaśaradvṛttabhūgehayuktaṃ jvālāmukhyā jagati jayatāccakrametanmaheśi || 45 ||
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi bhīḍāyantramanuttamam (gh: bheḍā) | sarvāgamarahasyāḍhyaṃ sarvasārasvatapradam || 46 ||
bindustryaśraṃ kāśramiśraṃ suvṛttaṃ vasvaśraṃ syāt tadbahiḥ ṣoḍaśāram | vṛttatrayaṃ bhūmigehatrayāḍhyaṃ bhīḍāyantraṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ syāt || 47 ||
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi kālarātryā anuttamam | yantroddhāraṃ parānandasādhanaikarasāyanam || 48 ||
bindustrikoṇarasakoṇasuvṛttanāgapatraṃ kalāravilasaddahanoruvṛttam |
bhūmandiratrayamidaṃ giriputri yantraṃ śrīkālarātrinilayaṃ paramārthadaṃ syāt || 49 ||
athāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi bhavānyā yantramuttamam | mūlamantrarahasyāḍhyaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam || 50 ||
bindustrikoṇaṃ ca ṣaḍaśrayuktaṃ vṛttaṃ ca nāgārakalādalāḍhyam | vṛttatrayaṃ bhūsadanatrayaṃ syāt śrīcakramānandapadaṃ bhavānyāḥ || 51 ||
atha vakṣye mahādevi yantrarājaṃ sudurlabham | śrīvajrayoginīdevyāḥ sarvasaukhyapravardhanam || 52 ||
bindustrikoṇaṃ ca bahiḥ ṣaḍaśraṃ vṛttaikavasvaśra ravṛttayuktam | dharāgṛhaṃ yantramidaṃ maheśi śrīvajraśabdāṅkitayoginīyam || 53 ||
atha vakṣyāmi vārāhyā yantroddhāramanuttamam | sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaṃ sādhakānāṃ śubhāvaham || 54 ||
trikoṇaṃ sabinduṃ punaḥ syāt trikoṇaṃ tataḥ saptavāraṃ trikoṇaṃ prakuryāt | gajāśraṃ kalāraṃ hi vṛttatrayāṅkaṃ dharāsadma yantraṃ varāheśvarīyam || 55 ||
atha vakṣye mahādevi (g: siddhalakṣmyā) yantroddhāraṃ sudurlabham | sarvavairipraśamanaṃ sarvavāñchitapūrakam || 56 ||
bindustrikoṇaṣaṭkoṇavṛttāṣṭadalamaṇḍitam | trivṛttaṃ bhūgṛhaṃ yantraṃ siddhalakṣmyā mayā smṛtam || 57 ||
atha yantravaraṃ vakṣye kulavāgīśvarīpriyam |
sādhakeṣṭapradaṃ divyaṃ parapadarasālayam || 58 ||
trikoṇaṃ sabinduṃ śarāśraṃ savṛttaṃ tato nāgapatrāñcitaṃ ṣoḍaśāram | trivṛttaṃ dharāsadma padmāspadaṃ te suyantraṃ pradiṣṭaṃ ca vāgīśvarīyam (ṅ: rīṣṭam) || 59 ||
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi yantraṃ padmāvatīpriyam | sarvārthasādhakaṃ divyaṃ sarvāśāparipūrakam || 60 ||
bindustrikoṇavasukoṇasavṛttanāgapatrādiṣoḍaśadalānalavartulaṃ ca | bhūmandiratrayamidaṃ sakalārthadaṃ syāt padmāvatīpriyataraṃ jayacakrametat || 61 ||
atha vakṣye mahādevi kubjikāyantramuttamam | sarvadevarahasyaṃ ca gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 62 ||
bindustrikoṇaṃ rasakoṇayuktaṃ vṛttaṃ tato nāgadalaṃ (k, kh, g: dalāra) ravṛttam | dharāgṛhaṃ sarvarahasyagarbhaṃ śrīkubjikāyantramidaṃ mayoktam || 63 ||
atha vakṣye mahādevi gaurīyantraṃ sudurlabham | sarvaiśvaryapradaṃ sarvavighnapraśamanaṃ śive || 64 ||
madhye trikoṇaṃ khayutaṃ (k, kh, g: yugaṃ) ṣaḍaśraṃ vṛttaṃ tathā nāgadalāgnivṛttam | bhūmandiraṃ kaulakuleṣṭatattvabhūtaṃ sucakraṃ kathitaṃ hi gauryāḥ || 65 ||
atha vakṣye mahādevi khecarīyantramuttamam |
yogināṃ durlabhaṃ yogasādhanānandakāraṇam || 66 ||
bindustrikoṇakaṃ vṛttaṃ vasupatrāgnivṛttakam | dharāgṛhaṃ mayākhyātaṃ khecarīyantramuttamam || 67 ||
atha nīlasarasvatyā yantroddhāraṃ bravīmyaham | mahācīnapadasthānāṃ siddhidaṃ bhogadaṃ śive || 68 ||
bindustato'gnyāraṣaḍaśrayuktaṃ vṛttaṃ tato nāgadalāgnivṛttam | dharāgṛhaṃ vahnituṭībhirīḍyaṃ yantraṃ paraṃ nīlasarasvatīyam || 69 ||
atha devyāḥ parāśakteryantroddhāraṃ bravīmyaham | sarvasaṃpatpradaṃ divyaṃ sarvaiśvaryapradāyakam || 70 ||
bindustrikoṇaṃ vṛttāḍhyavasupatrāgnivṛttakam | bhūgṛhaṃ yantrametatte parāśaktermayā smṛtam || 71 ||
athāhaṃ yantramīśāni śivasya paramaṃ bruve | sarvasādhāraṇaṃ sarvavāñchitaikapradāyakam || 72 ||
bindustrikoṇavasukoṇadaśāravṛttanāgāśraṣoḍaśadalānalavṛttayuktam | bhūmandiratrayamidaṃ paramārthadaṃ syāt sādhāraṇaṃ jagati yantramanādi śaivam || 73 ||
athāhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ devi yantrarājaṃ bravīmi te | sarvasādhāraṇaṃ loke vaiṣṇavānāṃ śubhapradam || 74 ||
bindustrikoṇavasukoṇasuvṛttanāgapatrāḍhyaṣoḍaśadalāñcitavṛttabimbam | bhūmandiraṃ jayati yantramidaṃ bhavāni sādhāraṇaṃ paramavaiṣṇavadhāma satyam || 75 ||
sarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāṃ śaivānāṃ parameśvari | gururaghoro vakṣye'haṃ tasya yantramanuttamam || 76 ||
trikoṇaṃ sabinduṃ śarāśraṃ sakāśraṃ tato nāgapatraṃ savṛttaṃ (k, kh, g: suvṛttaṃ) kalāram | caturbhūgṛhodbhāsitaṃ vahnirekhaṃ sadoddyotate'ghoradevasya yantram || 77 ||
sarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ maheśvari | lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ śreṣṭhastasya yantraṃ bravīmyaham || 78 ||
bindustrikoṇaṃ vasvaśraṃ vṛttāṣṭadalamaṇḍitam | ṣoḍaśāraṃ ravṛttaṃ ca bhūgehenopaśobhitam || 79 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyaitacchrīcakraṃ paramārthadam | itīdaṃ sarvadevānāṃ rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam | tattvaṃ tava mayākhyātaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 80 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye yantrodvāranirūpaṇaṃ dvādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 12 ||
atha
[trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ sarvakāmikam | yantradhāraṇapūjāyā vidhiṃ sādhāraṇaṃ param || 1 ||
vinā varma vinā nāmnāṃ sahasrakaṃ maheśvari | na siddhiḥ sādhakasyāsti bhairavasyāpi pārvati || 2 ||
yaḥ sādhako japed vidyāṃ yantradhāraṇavarjitaḥ | sā vidyā koṭijaptāpi tasya niṣphalatāṃ vrajet || 3 ||
śubhe'hni śubhanakṣatre śubhavāre maheśvari | brāhmye muhūrte utthāya snātvā dhyātvā guruṃ nijam || 4 ||
saśivāṃ devatāṃ dhyātvā rahaḥsthāne sudhūpite | gandhāṣṭakena vilikhed yantraṃ mūlena veṣṭitam || 5 ||
tadbāhye kavacaṃ divyaṃ tathā nāmasahasrakam | likhet kanakalekhanyā bhūrjapatre suśobhane || 6 ||
gandhāṣṭakaṃ pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramaṃ priye | avācyaṃ devabhaktāya paraśiṣyāya sarvathā || 7 ||
svayaṃbhūkusumaṃ kuṇḍagolotthaṃ rocanāguru | karpūraṃ mṛganābhiśca madyaṃ ca malayodbhavam || 8 ||
aparaṃ te pravakṣyāmi siddhidaṃ gandhasādhanam | vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca śaivānāṃ śāktānāṃ ca śubhāvaham || 9 ||
kāśmīra gorocana pūgakādi kuraṅganābhīja sarudra mūrvāḥ |
pūtāsakaṃ candanamiśrametadgandhāṣṭakaṃ bhairavabhairavīṣṭam (kh: bhairavi bhairaveṣṭam) || 10 ||
gandhāṣṭakaṃ svamūlena niyojya kulasādhakaḥ | nyāsamṛṣyādikaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyed devīṃ śivāṅkagām || 11 ||
likhedya(*?) nijaṃ divyaṃ tadbāhye mūlamantrataḥ | mātṛkā vilikhenmantrī tadbāhye kavacaṃ likhet || 12 ||
tathā nāmasahasraṃ ca likhitvā bhūrjapatrake | veṣṭayet śvetasūtreṇa pītanīlakrameṇa ca || 13 ||
nijeṣṭadevīdhyānābha varṇena parameśvari | lākṣayā pariveṣṭyātha suvarṇenātha veṣṭayet || 14 ||
tataḥ parāṃ guṭīṃ divyāṃ devīrūpāṃ vicintya ca | yantradhāraṇa yantrasya bindau saṃsthāpayecchive || 15 ||
yantradhāraṇa yantraṃ te vakṣye sādhakapūjite | kaulikānāṃ hitārthāya gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 16 ||
bindustrikoṇaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ ṣaḍasraṃ vasupatrakam | trivṛttaṃ ca dharāsadma yantradhāraṇa yantrakam || 17 ||
sindūreṇa likhed devi layāṅgaṃ pūjayecchive | yasya pūjanamātreṇa mantrī bhairavatāṃ vrajet || 18 ||
gaṇeśaṃ dharmarājaṃ ca varuṇaṃ ca kuberakam | caturdvāreṣu saṃpūjyāścatvāro dvārapālakāḥ || 19 ||
asitāṅgaṃ ca kālāgniṃ saṃhāraṃ rurubhairavam | karālaṃ vikarāla ca supteśonmattabhairavau || 20 ||
aṣṭapatreṣu saṃpūjya bhairavānaṣṭa pārvati | durgāṃ caṇḍīṃ ca sumukhīṃ śivādūtīṃ śivāṃ jayām || 21 ||
bahiḥ ṣaṭkoṇake pūjyāścaitā mūlena sādhakaiḥ | tārāṃ ca tāriṇīṃ turyāṃ bagalāṃ vijayāṃ tathā || 22 ||
chinnamastāṃ ṣaḍaśreṣu pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ | bhavānī kubjikā gaurī tryaśre pūjyā maheśvari || 23 ||
bindau svadevatāmiṣṭāṃ saśivāṃ kaulikottamaḥ | gandhākṣataprasūnaiśca dhūpadīpāditarpaṇaiḥ || 24 ||
naivedyācamanīyādyaistāmbūlaiśca suvāsitaiḥ | tatra bindau mahādevi yathāvibhavamātmanaḥ || 25 ||
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ muktāmaṇitāmrādipūrvakam | devatāprītaye dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ gurave'pi ca || 26 ||
tatra svayaṃ guṭīṃ divyāṃ devīrūpāṃ kuleśvari | pañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ snāpayet sādhakottamaḥ || 27 ||
saṃsthāpya guṭikāṃ mantrī bindau saṃsthāpayet tataḥ | prāṇān dattvā''vāhanādimudrā mantrī pradarśayet || 28 ||
pādyārghyamadhuparkādi sarvaṃ tatra nivedayet | cintayed devatārūpāṃ pūjayed yantrarājavat || 29 ||
saṃpūjya guṭikāṃ divyāṃ tadagre sādhako japet | mūlamantraṃ yathāśaktyā mālayā karamālayā || 30 ||
paṭhet tatraiva kavacaṃ mantranāmasahasrakam | stotraṃ mantramayaṃ devi mantricakraṃ (g: mantra) prapūjayet || 31 ||
taiḥ samaṃ sādhakaiḥ kuryāt pātravandanamīśvari | tān santarpya sudhīrbhaktyā dhārayed devatāṃ hṛdi || 32 ||
visṛjya saśivāṃ devīṃ namet saṃhāramudrayā |
dhārayenmūrdhnī vā bāhau guṭikāṃ varadāyinīm || 33 ||
ya evaṃ dhārayed yantraṃ japenmantraṃ sa sādhakaḥ | sākṣād bhavabhayonmukto bhaved bhairavasannibhaḥ || 34 ||
japasiddhirbhavet tasya ya evaṃ dhārayed guṭīm | bahunoktena kiṃ devi sa bhaved bhairavaḥ svayam || 35 ||
idaṃ tattvatamaṃ divyaṃ sarvasvaṃ paramārthadam | sārāt sārataraṃ gopyaṃ gopanīyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ || 36 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye yantradhāraṇavidhinirūpaṇaṃ trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 13 || atha
[caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan śrotumicchāmi cchandomunivinirṇayam | tathā devīśvarādīnāṃ devatābījanirṇayam || 1 ||
śaktikīlakadigbandhanirṇayaṃ parameśvara | vaktumarhasi me deva yadyasti mayi te dayā || 2 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
etad guhyatamaṃ devi devānāṃ sāramuttamam | devīnāmādidevānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ me rahasyakam || 3 ||
vakṣyāmi tava bhaktyāhamṛṣicchandovinirṇayam | devānāṃ mantrarājasya devīnāṃ vā tathaiva ca || 4 ||
