ṣaṣṭikalpasahasrāṇi yenaiva vihito japaḥ | tathābdaṣaṣṭilakṣāṇi ṣaṣṭijanmāntareṣu ca || 5 ||
puraścaryākaro devi sarṣirityabhidhīyate | ṛṣihīno bhavenmantro japto janmāntareṣu ca || 6 ||
pratyavāyakaro loke sādhakānāṃ maheśvari | yadā mantro mayā vaktrānmahādevi bahiṣkṛtaḥ || 7 ||
veṣṭito yena tejasvī tacchanda iti gīyate | chandāṃsi vividhānyeṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ parameśvari || 8 ||
chandohīno bhavenmantro nagno martya iva priye | yadā japto manurdevi mayā paramabhaktitaḥ || 9 ||
prādurbabhūva me sadyo yā sā prokteti devatā | mantrarājasya devīnāṃ (kh: devānāṃ) yenotpattirmayā kṛtā || 10 ||
tadbījamiti mantrāṇāṃ varṇyate parameśvari | bījahīno bhavenmantraḥ siddhihānikaraḥ śive || 11 ||
bījahīnaṃ jagaddhīnaṃ jalahīno nado yathā | japānte jagadutpattisthitisaṃhārikī matiḥ || 12 ||
jātā me yena deveśi sā śaktiriti gīyate | śaktihīno mahādevi mantro vighnakaro mataḥ || 13 ||
mahāmāṅgalyado mantro devīnāṃ śaktibījataḥ | japtvā stutvā mahādevi punaryena sa gopitaḥ || 14 ||
nistejakaḥ punarjātaḥ kīlakaṃ tadudāhṛtam | niṣkīlitaṃ japānte ca manumaśraddhayā śive || 15 ||
tyaktvā sādhakarājasya siddhiṃ harati bhairavaḥ | japakāle mahādevi rākṣasā bhūtapretakāḥ || 16 ||
diśo daśa palāyante yena digbandhanaṃ ca tat | digbandhena (kh: bandhane) vinā devi japaḥ pāṭho'pi vā tathā || 17 ||
niṣphalo vighnakṛnnityaṃ tena digbandhanaṃ caret | etairvihīno mantro'sti niṣphalo vighnakārakaḥ || 18 ||
mamāpi devi kiṃ vakṣye punaḥ kṣudreṣu jantuṣu | ityeṣa paṭalo guhyaśchandasāṃ parameśvari || gopanīyo mahāvīrairityājñā pārameśvarī || 19 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye ṛṣyādinirūpaṇaṃ caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 14 || atha
[pañcadaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi śmaśānasyograsādhanam | yena sādhanamātreṇa sādhako bhairavo bhavet || 1 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan bhavatā bhaktyā prasādo'yaṃ mahān kṛtaḥ | vismṛto'yaṃ vidhirguhyaḥ śmaśānasyārcanāṅkitaḥ || 2 ||
sarvatantreṣvavikhyātaḥ smārito me'dhunā paraḥ |
śrībhairava uvāca |
trayastriṃśatikoṭīnāṃ devatānāṃ hi śaktayaḥ | nāmabhirviśrutā devi bhavatyā me paraṃ śrutāḥ || 3 ||
tāsāṃ vakṣye'dhunā devi śmaśānārcā yathāvidhi | sādhakā yena jāyante sarvasiddhiyutāḥ śive || 4 ||
vinā śmaśānavidhinā pūjāyogajapādayaḥ | na siddhyanti varārohe kalau bhairavaśāpataḥ || 5 ||
tristriṃśatkoṭayo devyaḥ sarvāḥ pretālayasthitāḥ | tatra gatvārcayed yastu sa bhaved bhairavopamaḥ || 6 ||
tatra ghorāravairdevi mahākālaḥ sṛgālakaiḥ | sārameyaiśca yakṣendraiḥ soragaiḥ sapiśācakaiḥ || 7 ||
vetālabhūtapretaiśca śmaśānārcāṃ karoti hi | tatra bhūtā mahāghorāścatvāro vighnakārakāḥ || 8 ||
digvidikṣu bhramante te devyaṣṭau bhūtabhairavāḥ | te saṃmukhagatāḥ krūrā bhūtāḥ kurvanti vipriyam || 9 ||
bhairavā vighnahantāraḥ śivaṃ kurvantyasaṃmukhe | teṣāṃ vidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi guhyaṃ sārottamottamam || 10 ||
aprakāśyamadātavyaṃ śmaśānārcanamuttamam | ravau candre kuje saumye gurau śukre śanau tathā || 11 ||
punaḥ sūrye bhramante te digvidikṣvaṣṭabhairavāḥ |
pūrvottareśānasamīraṇāgnikenāśarakṣovaruṇādidikṣu | mahogra citrāṅgada caṇḍa bhāsvallolākṣa bhūteśa karāla bhīmāḥ || 12 ||
ete bhramante satataṃ śmaśāne digbhairavā bhūtayutā maheśi |
etān samabhyarcya vaset śmaśāne syādanyathā dhībhramaṇaṃ vipattiḥ || 13 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye śmaśānārcanavidhinirūpaṇaṃ pañcadaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 15 || atha
[ṣoḍaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
athāhaṃ pūjanasyāsya vakṣye paddhatimādarāt | gadyapadyamayīṃ devi mantrasiddhipradāyinīm || 1 ||
rātriśeṣe samutthāya sādhako vihitāhnikaḥ | śmaśānārcanasaṃbhāraṃ samādāya ca sānugaḥ || 2 ||
savīro vīrabhūmiṃ tu vrajedrātrimukhe priye | tatra devi vidhiṃ vakṣye śṛṇu pārvati sādaram || 3 ||
guhyaṃ sāratamaṃ gopyaṃ nākhyeyaṃ siddhivāñchakaiḥ || 4 ||
tatra rātrimukhe savīraḥ śmaśānaṃ gatvā saptapadāntāṃ bhūmimutsṛjya śmaśānavelāṃ nollaṅghayet | tatra saṃbhāraṃ saṃsthāpya svahastapādau prakṣālya trirācamya prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ mūlena vidhāya pūrvavadācamya svamūlaṛṣicchandonyāsaṃ kṛtvā karāṅganyāsau kṛtvā mūlamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japet | yathāśakti japtvā devīṃ saśivāṃ svaguruṃ dhyātvā kavaca sahasranāma stavān paṭhan velāṃ saptapadamātrāmullaṅghya śmaśānamaṇḍalaṃ pradakṣiṇākṛtyā praviśya citāṃ praṇamet |
jvālākarālavadane kalpāntadahanapriye | prāṇiprāṇālayodbhūte cite me'nugrahaṃ kuru || 4 ||
iti natvā yathāvāraṃ praśastāpraśastān bhūtabhairavān saṃmukhapṛṣṭhayordhṛtvā pūjāmārabhet ||
śrīdevī uvāca |
bhagavan bhairavān bhūtān śāpānugrahakārakān (k: grahaṇakṣamān) | kathaṃ saṃdhārayen mantrī tatra saṃmukhapṛṣṭhayoḥ || 5 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
etad devi paraṃ guhyaṃ bhūtabhairavasādhanam | vakṣyāmi tava bhaktyāhaṃ na cākhyeyaṃ durātmane || 6 ||
bhūto ravau pūrvagato mahograścitrāṅgado'pyuttarago himāṃśau | caṇḍastatheśānagato (g, gh: stave) mahīje bhāsvān budhe bhairava eva vāyau || 7 ||
lolākṣako vahnigataḥ surejya bhūteśvaro dakṣiṇago'surejye | karālako nirṛtigo'pi mande ravau punaḥ paścimago'pi bhīmaḥ || 8 ||
evaṃ bhramante satataṃ maheśi digbhairavā bhūtagaṇāḥ śmaśāne | sudhāṃśuvṛddhau śaśihīnapakṣe tadvaiparītyena śive bhramanti || 9 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
deveśa karuṇāsāndra sādhakeśa jagatpate | jñāyate (k, kh: jāyante) bhīmakarmedaṃ hṛdi sādhakasattamāḥ || 10 ||
mahograbhīmayoḥ pūjāṃ pakṣayorbhīmasaumyayoḥ | kathaṃ devi kariṣyanti dvayorbhāskaravārayoḥ || 11 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
paurṇamāsyāṃ śive dṛṣṭvā grahavāraṃ tato'ṣṭadhā | ravivāraṃ ca saṃguṇya prathamaṃ vā dvitīyakam || 12 ||
prathame ravivāre tu mahograṃ pūrvagaṃ yajet | dvitīye paścime bhīmaṃ pūjayecchuklapakṣake || 13 ||
kṛṣṇapakṣe'rcayed bhūtān viparītakrameṇa tu | adhunaiṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi pūjāsāraṃ maheśvari || 14 ||
avācyaṃ paraśiṣyāya kucailāya durātmane | śmaśānapūjāmantrasya mahākāla ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ || 15 ||
uṣṇik chanda iti khyātaṃ devī śmaśānakālikā | parā bījaṃ taṭaṃ śaktiḥ kālī kīlakamīritam || 16 ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
asya śrīśmaśānakālikāpūjāmantrasya mahākālabhairava ṛṣiḥ uṣṇik chandaḥ śrīśmaśānakālikā devatā hrīṃ bījaṃ hūṃ śaktiḥ krīṃ kīlakaṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe pūjāyāṃ viniyogaḥ | mahākālabhairava ṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi uṣṇikchandase namo mukhe śmaśānakālikādevatāyai namo hṛdi hrīṃ bījāya namo nābhau hūṃ śaktaye namo guhye krīṃ kīlakāya namaḥ pādayoḥ viniyogāya namaḥ sarvāṅgeṣu | oṃkrāṃ hṛ0 | oṃkrīṃ śi(0) ityādi karāṅganyāsaḥ | evaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vidhāyāsanaṃ śodhayet | oṃ āṃ āsanaśodhanamantrasya (g, ṅ: śuddhi) merupṛṣṭha ṛṣiḥ sutalaṃ chandaḥ kūrmo devatā āsanaśodhane viniyogaḥ | prīṃ pṛthvyai namaḥ mahi tvayā dhṛtā lokā devi tvaṃ viṣṇunā dhṛtā | tvaṃ ca dhāraya māṃ devi pavitraṃ kuru cāsanam || oṃ krāṃ ādhāraśaktikamalāsanāya namaḥ | anantāya namaḥ | padmāya namaḥ | padmanālāya namaḥ | tatropaviśya tālatrayaṃ dadyāt | apasarpantu te bhūtāḥ ityādinā
tālatrayaṃ dattvā nārācamudrāṃ pradarśayet | ityāsanaśuddhiṃ vidhāya bhūtaśuddhiṃ kuryāt | oṃ hūṃ ākuñcena (k, kh: aṃkuśena) suṣumnāvartmanā pradīpakalikākārāṃ brahmapathāntarnītvā svajīvaṃ tatra sadāśive līnaṃ dhyātvā ādau yamiti vāyubījena ṣoḍaśadhā japtena pāpapuruṣaṃ vāmakukṣisthaṃ śoṣayet | ramiti vahnibījena catuṣṣaṣṭivārajaptena dāhayet | vamiti varuṇabījena dvātriṃśadvārajaptena plāvayet | lamiti bhūbījena daśadhā japtena śarīraṃ piṇḍībhūtaṃ vibhāvya svajīvaṃ hṛdi saṃsthāpya prāṇānarpayet | iti bhūtaśuddhiḥ || oṃ āṃ hrīṃkroṃ yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃ śaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃ sohaṃ haṃsaḥ (gh: sohaṃ hauṃ haṃsaḥ) mama prāṇā iha prāṇāḥ evaṃ mama jīva iha sthitaḥ evaṃ mama sarvendriyāṇi mama vāṅmanaścakṣuḥśrotrajihvāghrāṇaprāṇā ihaivāgatya (k: ihā) sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu svāhā | iti prāṇān samarpya mātṛkānyāsaṃ vidhāya pūrvavat karāṅganyāsau kṛtvā tatra citāyā īśāne caturaśrāṃ vedīṃ vidhāya tatra śrīcakraṃ vibhāvya yathoktavidhinābhyarcya tatra navagrahān (ṅ: grahā saṃpūjayet oṃ srīṃ) saṃpūjya pūrve vaṭukaṃ saṃpūjya bhūtabhairavān saṃpūjayet | oṃ mrīṃ mahogrāya namaḥ | oṃ mrīṃ madālasāyai namaḥ pūrve | oṃ śrīṃ citrāṅgadāya namaḥ | oṃ śrīṃ citriṇyai namaḥ uttare | oṃ hrīṃ caṇḍāya namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ caṇḍyai namaḥ īśāne | oṃ hauṃ bhāsvate namaḥ | oṃ hauṃ prabhāyai namaḥ vāyave | oṃ lāṃ lolākṣāya namaḥ | oṃ lāṃ lolāyai namaḥ āgneye | oṃ bhaiṃ bhūteśāya namaḥ | oṃ bhaiṃ bhūtadhātryai namaḥ dakṣiṇe | oṃ krīṃ karālāya namaḥ | oṃ krīṃ karālinyai namaḥ nair(-)ṛte | oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ bhīmāya namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ bhīmarūpāyai namaḥ paścime | iti yathāvārakrameṇa gandhākṣatapuṣpairabhyarcya tatra citāgre śrīcakraṃ navayonicakraṃ vā vibhāvya yogapīṭhapūjāṃ kṛtvā pātrāṇi saṃsthāpya pātrapūjāṃ kṛtvā tatra devatāvaraṇapūrvaṃ saśivāṃ devīṃ saṃpūjya yathāśaktyā japtvā japaṃ devyai samarpya tataḥ kavaca sahasranāmastavapāṭhādi vidhāya tadapi samarpya citāgnau daśāṃśaṃ homaṃ kuryāt | tatra vaṭukādīn saṃtarpya ((ṅ: nāsti) bhūtabhairavānapi santarpya navakanyāḥ santarpya) parasparaṃ navapātrāvadhi pānaṃ kuryāt |
śrīdevyuvāca |
devadeva mahādeva śaraṇāgatavatsala | surāpānavidhiṃ brūhi yena siddhirbhaved dhruvam || 17 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi pānapūjāvidhiṃ param | sādhakā yena jāyante kalau bhairavasannibhāḥ || 18 ||
śmaśāneṣu caret pānaṃ niśīthe vā maheśvari | vinā pānaṃ na siddhiḥ syāt sādhakānāṃ kalau dhruvam || 19 ||
surā saṃvidvāruṇīti (k, kh, g: vāmaṇī) tridhā pānaṃ sadottamam | teṣu brahmādayo devā nilīnā muktaye param || 20 ||
āsavo madhuraṃ madyaṃ śīdhu ceti trayaṃ param | tatra sarve sthitā devā vāsavādyā aharniśam || 21 ||
saṃpūjya saśivāṃ devīṃ pravṛtte bhairavārcane | tatra pānaṃ parādevyā mahānandapradāyakam || 22 ||
vinā pānaṃ na siddhiḥ syād vinā śaktisamarcanam | na siddhyati śive mantraḥ śmaśānārcāṃ vinā tathā || 23 ||
tasmāt śmaśānaṃ saṃpūjya śaktimabhyarcya sādhakaḥ | pānaṃ bhajet parādevyāḥ śrīcakrāgre yathāvidhi || 24 ||
saṃvitpānaṃ caredrātrau divāpānaṃ ca śīdhunā | ahorātre surāpānaṃ bhogadaṃ mokṣadaṃ śive || 25 ||
saṃvidāsavayormadhye saṃvideva garīyasī | sa vaiṣṇavaḥ sa śāktaśca sa śaivo yaḥ śmaśānagaḥ || 26 ||
śmaśānabhajanādvīro bhaved bhairavasannibhaḥ | pānaṃ tāvadbhajed devi yāvat saṃvinmanomayī || 27 ||
yati tatra vikāraḥ syāt pānaṃ tad brahmaghātavat | yāvanna calate dṛṣṭiryāvanna calate manaḥ || 28 ||
tāvat pānaṃ prakartavyaṃ paśupānamataḥ param |
vinā pūjāṃ caredyastu pānaṃ vā carvaṇādikam || 29 ||
makārān pañca deveśi kulaṭāṃ vā parastriyam | sa rogī (sa bhogī iti sādhuḥ pāṭhaḥ) nindito loke parapiṇḍopajīvakaḥ || 30 ||
brahmaghātavadīśāni śīghraṃ mṛtyumukhaṃ vrajet | ātmocchiṣṭaṃ na dātavyaṃ parocchiṣṭaṃ na bhakṣayet || 31 ||
yadyucchiṣṭaṃ vīracakre kauliko bhakṣayecchive | siddhihānirbhavet sadyo yoginyo bhakṣayanti tam || 32 ||
pūjākāle niśīthe ca dhyātvā devīṃ śivāṅkagām (k, kh: ṅkitām) | abhyarcya vidhinā pānaṃ kṛtvā carvaṇapūrvakam || 33 ||
makāraiḥ pañcabhirdevi tarpayitvā parastriyam | pānaṃ pānaṃ śive pānaṃ saptavāraṃ samuccaret || 34 ||
tena devī śivāṅkopaviṣṭā prādurbhaviṣyati | ityeṣā paddhatirguhyā śmaśānārcanasaṃyutā || 35 ||
gadyapadyamayī divyā tattvasarvasvasaṃyutā | tava snehena vikhyātā na prakāśyā kadācana || 36 ||
iti guhyatamaṃ devi rahasyaṃ devadurlabham | aprakāśyamadātavyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 37 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye śmaśānārcanavidhinirūpaṇaṃ ṣoḍaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 16 ||
atha
[saptadaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan sarvatantrajña sarvalokanamaskṛta | śrīdevyā yantrarājasya mālākaṅkaṇayorapi || 1 ||
śodhanaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvayaiva prāṅniveditam | yena śuddhirbhaved deva dravyāṇāṃ sādhakasya hi || 2 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devi vakṣyāmi śodhanaṃ sarvakāmadam | sarvasādhāraṇaṃ loke paṭalaṃ guhyamuttamam || 3 ||
sudine devi gatvādau śmaśānaṃ sādhakottamaḥ | kapālaṃ naradantānāṃ mālā kaṅkaṇamīśvari || 4 ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā mūlaṃ yantre nidhāpayet | punaraṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā tenaiva tarpayet || 5 ||
devān pitṝn ṛṣīn devi māyā mā kāmabījakaiḥ | śmaśānabhasmaliptena śuddhena suravandite || 6 ||
tato yantraṃ likhed devi kapāle sādhakottamaḥ | mālāṃ kuryānnṛdantānāṃ sakalābhīṣṭasiddhaye || 7 ||
vāmācāraparaḥ śrīmān yo na kuryānmaheśvari | yantraṃ mālāṃ śive tasya mantrahānirbhaved dhruvam || 8 ||
kapālaṃ mṛtakasyāśu gṛhītvā sphaṭikaprabham |
śmaśānabhasma śuddhaṃ ca kṛtvā sādhakasattamaḥ || 9 ||
svamantraṃ sādhayed dhīmānanyathā siddhihānidaḥ | kapālayantraṃ deveśi keśakaṅkaṇamuttamam || 10 ||
nṛdantamālāṃ dravyaṃ ca muṇḍapātraṃ maheśvari | gopayet sādhako'tyantaṃ devīrūpaṃ vicintayet || 11 ||
ya evaṃ sādhakaḥ kuryāt tasya siddhiradūrataḥ (gh: rna dūrataḥ) | anyathā siddhihāniḥ syānmamāpi parameśvari || 12 ||
itīdaṃ paṭalaṃ divyaṃ guhyaṃ sarvasvamuttamam | aprakāśyamadātavyaṃ gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 13 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye dravyādiśodhananirūpaṇaṃ saptadaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 17 || atha
[aṣṭādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan devadeveśa mālāyantrārcanaṃ param | śodhanaṃ śrotumicchāmi vistarāt paramārthadam || 1 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devi vakṣyāmi paddhatiṃ gadyarūpiṇīm |
śodhanasya hi dravyāṇāṃ mālādīnāṃ maheśvari || 2 ||
tatrādau sādhako rātriśeṣa utthāya baddhapadmāsanaḥ svaśiraḥsthasahasrārādhomukhakamalakarṇikāntargataṃ nijaguruṃ dhyātvā devīṃ ca hṛdviṣaye dhyātvā mānasairupacārairabhyarcyājapājapaṃ gurave devyai ca samarpya praṇamet | tato bahirāgatya nadyādau gatvā snānasandhyādi vidhāya yāgagehametya nityakarma samāpya yantraśodhanādyārabhet | tatreśānadigviṣaye catuṣkoṇāṃ hastaikavistṛtāṃ viśvak samyaktayā vedīṃ vidhāya vilipya sindūreṇa svadrevatāyantraṃ vibhāvya yathoktayā pūjayā saṃpūjya dravyādīnyānāyya yantrādīn śodhayet ||
strīkeśaiśca cared devi kaṅkaṇaṃ sādhakottamaḥ | kaṅkaṇaṃ dantamālāṃ ca yantraṃ kāpālikaṃ śive || 3 ||
dravyaṃ madhu tathā matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ mudrāṃ ca maithunam | makārapañcasaṃyuktaṃ pūjayed bhairaveśvarīm || 4 ||
tatraivānīyāsanādiśuddhiṃ kṛtvā svamūlasya saṅkalpapūrvamṛṣyādinyāsaṃ kuryāt | tato mūlenācamya prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā bhūtaśuddhyādiprāṇān saṃsthāpya pañcagavyenauṣadhasaptakena śodhanaṃ kuryāt ||
stanyaṃ śukraṃ cāraṇālaṃ takraṃ raktaṃ svayonijam | pañcagavyamiti prājyaṃ kuryāt sādhakasattamaḥ || 5 ||
kāśmīra gorocana pūgakādi kuraṅganābhījamathāpi mūrvā | pūtāsamevaṃ malayodbhavaṃ ca sadyantraśuddhau mahadauṣadhāni || 6 ||
ebhiḥ samyaktayā yantraṃ mālāṃ kaṅkaṇaṃ saṃlipya mūlavidyayā pṛthak pṛthak śodhanaṃ kuryāt | oṃhrīṃśrīṃklīṃ devi yantreśvari klīṃśrīṃhrīṃoṃ yantraṃ śodhaya 2 hraḥśraḥklaḥ ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ svāhā |
imāṃ mantrātmikāṃ vidyāmaṣṭottaraśataṃ japet | yantre devīṃ samāvāhya pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ || 7 ||
tatrādau yantraṃ mūlavidyayā pañcagavyauṣadhaiḥ saṃśodhya sindūrayantre
bindūpari saṃsthāpya pūrvavat svoktakrameṇa pūjayet | tato mālāmauṣadhādinā mūlavidyayā śodhayet | oṃoṃhrāṃhrīṃśrīṃśrāṃ klīṃklāṃ mālārūpiṇi sarvalokabhakṣiṇi hūṃ nṛdantamālāṃ śodhaya 2 phaṭ ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ svāhā | ityevamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā mūlavidyayā pañcagavyena śodhayet | tataḥ kaṅkaṇaṃ śatabālānāṃ strīkeśasya kṛtvā mūlavidyayā śodhayet | oṃhrīṃstrīṃhūṃśrīṃkrīṃ keśini nirākeśini kaṅkaṇaṃ śodhaya 2 hūṃkrāṃ phaṭ ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ svāhā | iti mūlavidyāmaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā pañcagavyauṣadhajalena saṃśodhya vāmahastadakṣahastayornibadhya svamūlaṃ nṛdantamālayā yathāśaktyā japet | tataḥ kavacastotrasahasranāmādipāṭhaṃ vidhāya mūlena naivedyaṃ nivedya tadagre cakrapūjāṃ kuryāt | sādhakairekādaśakrameṇa vṛttākṛtyā yāgamaṇḍape upaviśya madhye trikoṇaṃ sabinduṃ ṣaḍaśrakaṃ vṛttamaṣṭadalaṃ vṛttatrayaṃ bhūgṛhaṃ vilikhya raktapuṣpaiḥ pūjayet(-) bāhye gaṃ gaṇeśāya namaḥ dhaṃ dharmarājāya namaḥ vaṃ varuṇāya namaḥ krīṃ kuberāya namaḥ iti saṃpūjya | aṣṭadaleṣu hrīṃ śrīṃ karālāya namaḥ hrīṃśrīṃ vikarālāya namaḥ hrīṃśrīṃ saṃhārāya namaḥ hrīṃśrīṃ rurubhairavāya namaḥ hrīṃśrīṃ mahākālāya namaḥ hrīṃśrīṃ kālāgnaye namaḥ hrīṃśrīṃ suptabhairavāya namaḥ hrīṃśrīṃ unmattabhairavāya namaḥ ityabhyarcya | ṣaḍaśre oṃhrīṃśrīṃ jayāyai namaḥ oṃ vijayāyai(0) oṃ kāntyai namaḥ oṃ ratyai namaḥ oṃ prītyai namaḥ oṃ manonmanāyai namaḥ iti puṣpairabhyarcya | tatastrikoṇe gāṃ gaṅgāyai namaḥ yāṃ yamunāyai namaḥ saṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ ityabhyarcya bindau mūlaṃ(0) mahāmāyāyai namaḥ evaṃ saṃpūjya tatra śrīdevīṃ jyotīrūpāṃ goghṛtena vibhāvya yantravattāṃ ca pūjayet | tatra bhairavaṃ bhairavīṃ ca pūjayet | tatra vaṭukaṃ saśaktikaṃ ca pūjayet | pravṛtte bhairave tantre sarve varṇā dvijātayaḥ | nivṛtte bhairave tantre sarve varṇāḥ pṛthak pṛthak || tatraiva nava kanyāḥ abhyarcya
vāme rāmā ramaṇakuśalā dakṣiṇe cālipātramagre mudrāścaṇakavaṭakau sūkarasyoṣṇaśuddhiḥ | tantrī vīṇā sarasamadhurā sadguruḥ satkathāśca (ṅ: satkathāyāṃ) vāmācāraḥ (g, gh: kaulā) paramagahano yogināmapyagamyaḥ || 8 ||
pītvā pītvā punaḥ pītvā yāvat saṃvinmanomayī | yadi tatra vikāraḥ syāt pānaṃ tad brahmaghātavat || 9 ||
madhupānaparo (k, kh: rato) mantrī śaktiṃ santoṣayedrate | retasā tarpayed devīṃ śaktiṃ pānena tarpayet || 10 ||
śaktyucchiṣṭaṃ pibenmadyaṃ vīrocchiṣṭaṃ tu carvaṇam | makārapañcasaṃyuktaṃ kuryācchrīcakramaṇḍalam || 11 ||
sādhakān sādhako bhaktyā santarpya pānabhojanaiḥ | santarpya devatāmiṣṭāṃ miṣṭānnaiścarvaṇaiḥ śive || 12 ||
svaguruṃ pūjayed bhaktyā tarpayecchaktitaḥ param | santoṣayitvā svaguruṃ dakṣiṇābhiśca vandanaiḥ || 13 ||
tadājñāṃ śirasādāya nityakarmaṇi siddhidām |
tatraivaṃ cakre sādhakānabhyarcyānandabhairavaṃ svātmānaṃ dhyātvā parānandamayo bhūtvā saṃhāramudrayā devīṃ saśivāṃ visṛjya daṇḍavat praṇamet |
ityevaṃ paddhatiṃ guhyāṃ gadyapadyaikarūpiṇīm | sakalāgamasārāḍhyāṃ gopayet sādhakottamaḥ || 14 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye śodhanapaddhatinirūpaṇamaṣṭādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 18 ||
atha
[ekonaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devi vakṣyāmi surotpattiṃ maheśvari | yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa dīkṣāphalamavāpnuyāt || 1 ||
samudre mathyamāne tu kṣīrābdhau sāgarottame | tatrotpannā surādevī kumārīrūpadhāriṇī || 2 ||
nagnā kālāgnisadṛśī kṛtahāsollasanmukhī | aṣṭādaśabhujā divyā navakumbhadharā tathā || 3 ||
navapātradharā tadvanmadirāruṇalocanā | nānākusumabhūṣāḍhyā muktakeśī trilocanā || 4 ||
nānāratnāṅgadayutā muktāhāralatāñcitā | raktātnāṅgulīyaśobhāḍhyā tuṅgāpīnastanāñcitā || 5 ||
vicitraratnakhacitakāñcīguṇanitambinī | ratnasiṃhāsanagatā paramānandadāyinī || 6 ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣtuvurdevīṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | sasurāsuragandharvāḥ seśvarāḥ sasadāśivāḥ || 7 ||
tadā prasannavadanā varadānodyatā surā | ādau pātraṃ dadau divyamānandarasapūritam || 8 ||
sadāśivāya deveśi sa natvā pātramagrahīt | pātrād binduḥ papātorvyāṃ jātā guḍalatāstataḥ || 9 ||
bindupātāt kaṇā jātāstebhyo jātāḥ sahasraśaḥ | ikṣubhedāśca khadirāstryūṣaṇādyāḥ sitādayaḥ || 10 ||
kramukā nāgavallī ca sravantīti maheśvari | gauḍī caitadyutā proktā sarvārthaphaladāyinī || 11 ||
tato dadau paraṃ pātramīśvarāya surā śive | pātrād binduḥ papātorvyāṃ tato jātāhivallarī || 12 ||
bindupātakaṇebhyo'pi drākṣābhedāḥ sahasraśaḥ | mṛdvīkādyā mahādevi jātāḥ paramapāvanāḥ || 13 ||
mādhvī proktā mahāvidyāsādhane (k, kh, gh: sādhake) sarvasiddhidā | tato dadau paraṃ pātraṃ rudrāyāmṛtapūritam || 14 ||
pātrād binduḥ papātorvyāṃ jātā godhūmajātayaḥ | tatkaṇebhyo bhadantī ca jātā vai dhānyajātayaḥ || 15 ||
paiṣṭī proktā surā devi paramānandadāyinī | tato dadau paraṃ pātraṃ viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave || 16 ||
pātrād binduḥ papātorvyāṃ saṃvijjātā tataḥ priye | tatkaṇebhyo'pi deveśi tadbhedāḥ kanakādayaḥ || 17 ||
anye ca bahavo jātā bhedā madanavardhakāḥ (kh, g: vardhanāḥ) | vijayeti mayā proktā vaiṣṇavī paramārthadā || 18 ||
saṃvidāsavayormadhye saṃvideva garīyasī | tato dadau paraṃ pātraṃ śrīsurā parameṣṭhine || 19 ||
pātrād binduḥ papātorvyāṃ jātaḥ śīghraṃ parūṣakaḥ | tatkaṇebhyo'pi sañjātā bhedāḥ kṣaudrarasādayaḥ || 20 ||
pānakaṃ proktamīśāni sarvasādhāraṇaṃ param | tato dadau paraṃ pātramindrāyāmṛtanirbharam (k, kh, g, gh: pūritaṃ) || 21 ||
pātrād binduḥ papātorvyāṃ jātaṃ jātīphalaṃ tataḥ | tatkaṇebhyo'pi sañjātā bhedāścāmalakādayaḥ || 22 ||
pānakaṃ nāma tad divyaṃ rasāyanamudāhṛtam | tato dadau paraṃ pātraṃ gurave girije surā || 23 ||
pātrād binduḥ papātorvyāṃ guḍapuṣpaṃ tataḥ śive | jātaṃ tatkaṇajā bhedā nārikelaphalādayaḥ || 24 ||
pānakaṃ nāma deveśi rasāyanamidaṃ param | tato dadau paraṃ pātraṃ śukrāyāmṛtapūritam || 25 ||
pātrād binduḥ papātorvyāṃ jātāḥ kharjūrapādapāḥ | tatkaṇebhyo'pi sañjātā bhedā bhādāmakādayaḥ (ṅ: bhādhāmakādayaḥ) || 26 ||
pānakaṃ tadapi proktaṃ divyaṃ santoṣakāraṇam | tato dadau paraṃ pātraṃ sūryācandramasoḥ sakṛt (k, kh: pṛthak) || 27 ||
pātrād binduḥ papātorvyāṃ jātā sañjīvanauṣadhiḥ | tatkaṇebhyo'pi sañjātā vividhauṣadhayaḥ śive || 28 ||
pānakaṃ tadapi proktaṃ sarvasādhāraṇaṃ param | sarvārthaphaladaṃ devi sarvasārasvatapradam || 29 ||
dattvā divyaṃ rasaṃ devī surā tatra tirodadhe | te sarve parameśāni surānandaikanirbharāḥ || 30 ||
sadāśivādayo devāḥ surāyai ca varaṃ daduḥ | ye pibanti paraṃ pānaṃ paramānandakāraṇam || 31 ||
te sarve yānti paramaṃ padaṃ śāśvatamavyayam | vinā gauḍīṃ tathā mādhvīṃ surāṃ yaḥ pūjayecchivām || 32 ||
śivaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ rudraṃ sa bhavennirayāspadam | adīkṣitaḥ paśurdevi dīkṣito'pyasuraḥ paśuḥ || 33 ||
tasmāt surāṃ śive'bhyarcya pūjāyāṃ vaiṣṇavottamaḥ | pivedgauḍīṃ tathā mādhvīṃ paiṣṭīmāsavamuttamam || 34 ||
pānakaṃ ca śubhāḥ sarve pūrvābhāve paraḥ paraḥ | itīdaṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ kaulikānāṃ rahasyakam | ānandeśvarasarvasvaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 35 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye surotpattinirūpaṇamekonaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 19 || atha
[viṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devi vakṣye'haṃ pātravandanamīśvari | tatkālaṃ yadvadānandapātraṃ devaiśca vanditam || 1 ||
pūjāyāṃ pātramānandabharitaṃ parameśvari | guruṇā dattamabhyarcya praṇamecchirasā tadā || 2 ||
śrīmadbhairavaśekharapravilasaccandrāmṛtāplāvitaṃ kṣetrādhīśvarayoginīgaṇamahāsiddhaiḥ samārādhitam |
ānandāgamakaṃ mahātmakamidaṃ sākṣāt trikhaṇḍāmṛtaṃ vande śrīprathamaṃ karāmbujagataṃ pātraṃ viśuddhipradam || 3 || (idaṃ te pātraṃ sanavittamindra pivā somamenā śatakrato | pūṇa āhāvo madirasya madhvo yaṃ viśva idabhiharyanti devāḥ || (ṛ0 10 | 112 | 6) ||
idantāpātrasaṃbhūtamahantāparamāmṛtam | parāhantāmaye vahnau juhomi śivarūpiṇi ||
idaṃ pavitramamṛtaṃ pibāmi bhavabheṣajam | paśupāśasamucchedakāraṇaṃ bhairavoditam ||
citeḥ svātantryasāratvāt tasyānandamayatvataḥ | tanmayatvācca bhāvānāṃ bhāvāścāntarhitā rase ||
svasvātantryavikāsāya svarasaḥ svena pīyate | tasmādimāṃ sudhārūpāṃ pūrṇāhantāṃ pibāmyaham ||
svātmamūlatrikoṇasthe koṭisūryasamaprabhe | kuṇḍalyākṛticidrūpe huned dravyaṃ samantrakam || iti gh pustake'dhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ kṣiptaḥ |)
haimaṃ sindhurasāvahaṃ dayitayā dattaṃ ca peyādibhiḥ kiñciccañcalaraktapaṅkajadṛśā sānandamudvīkṣitam (gh: ānandamālokitam) | vāme svāṃduviśuddhaśuddhikavalaṃ (gh: viśuddhaśuddhaśakalaṃ pāṇau nidhāya svake) pāṇau vidhāyātmake vande pātramahaṃ dvitīyamadhunānandaikasaṃvardhanam || 4 ||
sarvāmnāyakalākalāpakalitaṃ kautūhaloddyotitaṃ (gh: loddyotanaṃ) candropendramahendraśambhuvaruṇabrahmādibhiḥ sevitam | dhyātaṃ devagaṇaiḥ paraṃ munigaṇairmokṣārthibhiḥ sarvadā vande pātramahaṃ tṛtīyamadhunā svātmāvabodhakṣamam || 5 ||
madyaṃ mīnarasāvahaṃ hariharabrahmādibhiḥ pūritaṃ (gh: sevitaṃ) mudrāmaithunadharmakarmanirataṃ kṣārāmlatiktāśrayam (gh: śritam) | ācāryāṣṭakasiddhabhairavakalānyāsena (gh: dhīśena) saṃśodhitaṃ pāyāt pañcamakāratattvanilayaṃ (gh: sahitaṃ) pātraṃ caturthaṃ numaḥ || 6 ||
ādhāre bhujagādhirājavalaye pātraṃ mahīmaṇḍalaṃ madyaṃ (gh: dravyaṃ) saptasamudravāri piśitaṃ cāṣṭau ca digdantinaḥ |
so'haṃ bhairavamarcayan pratidinaṃ tārāgaṇairakṣatairādityapramukhaiḥ surāsuragaṇairājñākaraiḥ kiṅkaraiḥ (gh: sevitaṃ) || 7 ||
sacchatrāmalabhadrapīṭhaparamānandodayādāyakaṃ (k: chatraṃ cāmarabhadra) ramyaṃ (k: vājīdantimanoharaṃ) rājyakaraṃ sadā sukhakaraṃ sāyujyasāmrājyadam | nānāvyādhibhavāndhakāraharaṇaṃ janmāntaradhvaṃsanaṃ srīmadbhairavabhairavīpriyataraṃ pātraṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ numaḥ || 8 ||
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptituryaparataścaitanyasākṣyapradaṃ (k: bodhapavanaṃ) vidyudbhāskaravahnicandradhanuṣāṃ (gh: candrajiṣṇudhanuṣāṃ) jyotiṣkalāvyāpitam | yeḍāpiṅgalamadhyagā (kh: vāmā) trivalayā tasyāḥ (kh: satkuṇḍalī cordhvagā) prabodhoddharaṃ pātraṃ saptamamūṣaṇena (gh: mapūraṇena) taruṇānandapradaṃ pātu mām || 9 ||
khaḍgaṃ pātrakamañcalaṃ (kh, ṅ: pādukamañjalaṃ ; gh: śrīgurupādukāca tilakaṃ) ca guṭikāṃ kaṇṭhe hi sārasvataṃ śatrorvāgbalaśauryakāryaharaṇaṃ (kh, gh: buddhi) dehasthiteḥ kāraṇam | vāñchāsiddhikaraṃ (k: vācā) manaḥsthitikaraṃ vaśyaṃ (kh, gh: cāvarjanaṃ yoṣitām) jagadyoṣitāṃ pātraṃ cāṣṭamamaṣṭasiddhikaraṇaṃ prauḍhaprasannaṃ (k: prapannaṃ) bhaje || 10 ||
sarvānandakaraṃ sadāśivapadaṃ sarvārthasaṃpatpradaṃ sāmrājyārthakaraṃ samastasukhadaṃ cājñānavidhvaṃsanam | āyuḥkāntiyaśovivardhanakaraṃ saṃsāramohacchidaṃ pātraṃ lakṣaguṇātmakaṃ ca navamaṃ prauḍhapratāpaṃ bhaje || 11 ||
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ devānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | durlabhaṃ pāvanaṃ pātraṃ daśamaṃ praṇamāmyaham || 12 ||
pāpaghnaṃ śāntiśubhadaṃ divyaṃ svādu sukhālayam |
pātramekādaśaṃ vande gurusevāsukhāgatam || 13 ||
pātraṃ kṛtvā kare mantrī sarvakarma labhet sukhī | iha loke śriyaṃ bhuktvā dehānte bhairavo bhavet || 14 ||
dehasthākhiladevatā gajamukhāḥ kṣetrādhipā bhairavāḥ yoginyo vaṭukāśca yakṣapitaraḥ paiśācikāśceṭakāḥ | anye bhūcarakhecarāḥ pratipagā vetālabhūtagrahāstṛptāḥ syuḥ kulaputrakasya pibataḥ pānaṃ sadīpaṃ carum (k: samaṃ mākṣikam) || 15 ||
(kare mālā mukhe hālā vāme rāmā sukomalā | hṛdaye tripurā bālā yāgaśālā gṛhe gṛhe || 16 ||
pātraṃ bhairavapātraṃ gotraṃ śrīnāthapādukāgotram | śāstraṃ saṃvicchāstraṃ jñānaṃ tattvāvabodhakaṃ jñānam || 17 ||)
vāme rāmā ramaṇakuśalā dakṣiṇe cālipātramagre mudrāścaṇakavaṭakau sūkarasyoṣṇaśuddhiḥ | skandhe (kh: tantrīvīṇā sarasakavitā sadguruḥ satkathāyāṃ) vīṇā sarasamadhurā sadguroḥ satkathā ca kaulo mārgaḥ paramagahano yogināmapyagamyaḥ || 18 ||
alipiśitapurandhrī bhogapūjāparo'haṃ bahuvidhakulamārgārambhasaṃbhāvito'ham | paśujanavimukho'haṃ bhairavīmāśrito'haṃ gurucaraṇarato'haṃ bhairavo'haṃ śivo'ham || 19 ||
kare pātraṃ mukhe stotramānando hṛdayāntare | bhaktirgurupadāmbhoje śaraṇaṃ (kh: smaraṇaṃ) kimataḥ param || 20 ||
ekena śuṣkavaṭakena ghaṭaṃ pibāmi vāpīṃ pibāmi sahasā lavaṇārdrakeṇa |
āsvādya māṃsamalirohitamuṇḍakhaṇḍaṃ gaṅgāṃ pibāmi yamunāṃ saha sāgareṇa || 21 ||
vāme candramukhī mukhe ca madirā pātraṃ karāmbhoruhe mūrdhni śrīgurucintanaṃ bhagavatīdhyānāspadaṃ mānasam | jihvāyāṃ japasādhanaṃ pariṇatiḥ kaulakramābhyāsane ye santo niyataṃ pibanti surasaṃ te bhuktimuktī gatāḥ || 22 ||
pītvā pītvā punaḥ pītvā yāvat patati bhūtale | punarutthāya vai pītvā punarjanma na vidyate || 23 ||
dharmādharmahavirdīpte svātmāgnau manasā srucā | suṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛttīrjuhomyaham || 24 ||
prakāśākāśahastābhyāmavalambyonmanīsrucam (k: srucā) | dharmādharmakalāsnehapūrṇāṃ (ṅ: pūrṇavahnau) vahnau juhomyaham || 25 ||
yāvanna calate dṛṣṭiryāvanna calate manaḥ | tāvat pānaṃ prakartavyaṃ paśupānamataḥ param || 26 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye pātravandanavidhinirūpaṇaṃ viṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 20 ||
atha
[ekaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
devi vakṣyāmi pūjānte śāntistotramanuttamam | vīrā yena parānandapadaṃ prāpsyanti niḥspṛhāḥ || 1 ||
yoginīcakramadhyasthaṃ mātṛmaṇḍalaveṣṭitam | namāmi śirasā nāthaṃ bhairavaṃ bhairavīpriyam || 2 ||
anādighorasaṃsāra vyādhidhvaṃsaikahetave | namaḥ śrīnāthavaidyāya kulauṣadhapradāyine || 3 ||
āpado duritaṃ rogāḥ samayācāralaṅghanāt | te sarve'tra vyapohantu divyacakrasya melanāt || 4 ||
āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ kīrtirlābhaḥ sukhaṃ jayaḥ | kāntirmanorathaścāstu pāntu sarvāśca devatāḥ || 5 ||
saṃpūjakānāṃ pratipālakānāṃ (kh, gh: pari) yatīndrayogīndratapodhanānām | deśasya rāṣṭrasya kulasya rājñaḥ (g, gh: nityaṃ) karotu śāntiṃ bhagavān kuleśaḥ || 6 ||
nandantu sādhakakulānvayadarśakā ye sṛṣṭyādyanākhyacaturuktamahānvayā (k, kh: sṛṣṭā) ye | nandantu sarvakulakaularatāḥ pare ye'pyanye (k, kh: pyante) viśeṣapadabhedakaśāmbhavā ye || 7 ||
nandantu siddhaguravaḥ svagurukramaughā jyeṣṭhānugāḥ samayino vaṭukāḥ kumāryaḥ | ṣaḍyoginīpravaravīrakulaprasūtā nandantu bhūmipatigodvijasādhulokāḥ || 8 ||
nandantu nītinipuṇā niravadyaniṣṭhā nirmatsarā nirupamā nirupadravāśca | nityā nirantararatā (ṅ: nirañjana) guravo nirīhāḥ śāktāśca śāntamanaso hṛtaśokaśaṅkāḥ || 9 ||
nandantu yoganiratāḥ kulayogayuktā ācāryasāmayikasādhakaputrakāśca (k, kh: sādhana) | gāvo dvijā yuvatayo yatayaḥ kumāryo dharme bhavantu niratā gurubhaktiyuktāḥ || 10 ||
nandantu sādhakakulā hyaṇimādiniṣṭhāḥ śāpāḥ patantu dviṣataḥ (k, kh: dviṣatāṃ) kulayoginīnām | sā śāmbhavī sphuratu kāpi mamāpyavasthā yasyāṃ guroścaraṇapaṅkajameva labhyam || 11 ||
yāścakrakramabhūmikāvasatayo nāḍīṣu yāḥ saṃsthitā yāḥ kāyadrumaromakūpanilayā yāḥ saṃsthitā dhātuṣu | ucchvāsormimaruttaraṅganilayāṃ niḥśvāsavāsāśca yāstā devyo ripubhakṣaṇodyamaparāstṛpyantu kaulārcitāḥ || 12 ||
yā divyakramapālikāḥ kṣitigatā yā devatāstoyagā yā nityaṃ prathitaprabhāḥ śikhigatā yā mātariśvāśrayāḥ | yā vyomāmṛtamaṇḍalāmṛtamayā yāḥ sarvadā sarvagāstāḥ sarvāḥ kulamārgapālanaparāḥ śāntiṃ prayacchantu me || 13 ||
ūrdhvaṃ brahmāṇḍato vā divi bhuvanatale bhūtale nistale (k, ṅ: niṣkale) vā pātale vā tale vā pavanasalilayoryatra kutra sthitā vā | kṣetre pīṭhopapīṭhādiṣu ca kṛtapadā dhūpadīpādimāṃsaiḥ prityā devyaḥ sadā vaḥ śubhabalividhinā pāntu virendravandyāḥ || 14 ||
brahmā śrīśeṣadurgāguhavaṭukagaṇā bhairavāḥ kṣetrapālā vetālādityarudragrahavasumanusiddhāpsaroguhyakādyāḥ | bhūtā gandharvavidyādharaṛṣipitṛyakṣāsurāhiprabhūtā yogīśāścāraṇāḥ kiṃpuruṣamunisurāścakragāḥ pāntu sarve || 15 ||
satyaṃ cedguruvākyameva pitaro devāśca (k, ṅ: pitṛdevāḥ śeṣavad) cedyoginīprītiścet paradevatā ca yadi cedvedāḥ pramāṇāśca (gh: pramāṇaṃ) cet | śākteyaṃ yadi darśanaṃ bhavati cedājñeyameṣā(māśā)sti cet santyatrāpi ca kaulikāśca yadi cet syānme jayaḥ sarvadā || 16 ||
tṛpyantu mātaraḥ sarvāḥ samudrāḥ sagaṇādhipāḥ | yoginyaḥ kṣetrapālāśca mama dehe vyavasthitāḥ || 17 ||
śivādyavaniparyantaṃ brahmādistambasaṃyutam | kālāgnyādiśivāntaṃ ca jagadyajñena tṛpyatu || 18 ||
iti śāntistotram || atha vīravandanastotram |
jagattrayābhyarcitaśāsanebhyaḥ parārthasaṃpādanakovidebhyaḥ | samuddhṛtakleśamahoragebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ || 20 ||
prahīṇasarvāsravavāsanebhyaḥ (k: sarvārthaku) sarvārthatattvoditasādhanebhyaḥ (k: vāsanebhyaḥ) | sarvaprajābhyuddharaṇodyatebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ || 21 ||
nistīrṇasaṃsāramahārṇavebhyastṛṣṇālatonmūlanatatparebhyaḥ (k, kh: lavo) | jarārujāmṛtyunivārakebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ || 22 ||
saddharmaratnākarabhājanebhyo nirvāṇamārgottamadeśikebhyaḥ | sarvatra saṃpūrṇamanorathebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ || 23 ||
lokānukampābhyuditādarebhyaḥ (kh: dyu) kāruṇyamaitrīparibhāvitebhyaḥ | sarvārthacaryāparipūrakebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ || 24 ||
vidhvastaniśeṣakuvāsanebhyo jñānāgninā dagdhamalendhanebhyaḥ | prajñāpratijñāparipūrakebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ || 25 ||
sarvārthitāśāparipūrakebhyo vaineyapadmākarabodhakebhyaḥ (kh: bodhanebhyaḥ) | vistīrṇasarvārthaguṇākarebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ || 26 ||
anantakarmārjitaśāsanebhyo brahmendrarudrādinamaskṛtebhyaḥ | parasparānugrahakārakebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ || 27 ||
vibhagnabhūtādimahābhayebhyo mapañcakācāraparāyaṇebhyaḥ | samastasaubhāgyakalākarebhyo namo namaḥ kāraṇanāyakebhyaḥ || 28 ||
vibhaktaduṣkarmajavāsanebhyaḥ (k, kh: vibhagna) samantato juṣṭamahāyaśobhyaḥ | labhyāmalajñānakṛtāspadebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥ (kh, g: va | evamagne'pi) || 29 ||
sarvāgamāmbhodhimahāplavebhyaḥ śrīcakrapūjārthaparāyaṇebhyaḥ | śrīvīracaryācaraṇakṣamebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥ || 30 ||
śrīmantrakoṭidyutibhūṣaṇebhyo dvāviṃśadullāsadaśātigebhyaḥ | advaitatattvāmṛtabhājanebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥ || 31 ||
ṣaṭtriṃśatālakṣaṇabhūṣitebhyaḥ protphullapadmākaralocanebhyaḥ | prataptacāmīkaravigrahebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥ || 32 ||
sambodhasaṃbhārasusaṃsthitebhyaḥ saṃsāranirvāṇanidarśanebhyaḥ (k, ṅ: nirvāravidarśakebhyaḥ) | mahākṛpāveṣṭitamānasebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥ || 33 ||
paraikyavijñānarasākulebhyo vāmāśritācārabhayānakebhyaḥ | svātantryavidhvastajagattamobhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥ || 34 ||
śmaśānacaryāptamahāphalebhyo mohāndhakārāpahṛtikṣamebhyaḥ | parasparājñāparipālakebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥ || 35 ||
vidhūtakeśālikapālakebhyaḥ surāsavāraktavilocanebhyaḥ | navīnakāntārata tatparebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāmbhavebhyaḥ || 36 ||
vibhūtiliptāṅgadigambarebhyaścitāgnidhūmālibhayānakebhyaḥ | kapālasāndrāmṛtapānakebhyo (gh, ṅ: pātrāmṛta) namo namo bhairavibhairavebhyaḥ || 37 ||
siddhyaṣṭakādhānamahāmunibhyaḥ (k, gh, ṅ: dāna) śrībhairavācārakṛtādarebhyaḥ (gh: kṛtāspadebhyaḥ) | svādhīnatānyakkṛtanirjarebhyo namo namo bhairavibhairavebhyaḥ || 38 ||
praśāntaśāstrārthavicārakebhyo nivṛttanānārasakāvyakebhyaḥ | nirastaniḥśeṣavikalpanebhyo namo namo bhairavibhairavebhyaḥ || 39 ||
svātmaikyabhāvāntaritāśayebhyaḥ sāyujyasāmrājyasukhākarebhyaḥ | śrīsaccidānanditavigrahebhyo namo namo bhairavibhairavebhyaḥ || 40 ||
parāprasādāspadamānasebhyo brahmādvayajñānarasākulebhyaḥ | śivo'hamityāśritacetanebhyo namo namo bhairavibhairavebhyaḥ || 41 ||
sarvathā sarvadānandaṃ (ṅ: sarva) sarvaṃ ghaṭapaṭādisat (k, kh: mat) | jagajjanitavistāraṃ brahmedamiti vedmyaham || 42 ||
ahameva paro haṃsaḥ śivaḥ paramakāraṇam | matprāṇe sa tu maccātmā līnaḥ samarasīgataḥ || 43 ||
saccidānandanilayaṃ parāparamakāraṇam | śivādvayaprakāśāḍhyaṃ śyāmalaṃ dhāma dhīmahi || 44 ||
anena vīrastavakīrtanena samuddhṛtakleśasuvāsano'ham | saṃsārakāntāramahārṇave'sminnimajjamānaṃ jagaduddhareyam || 45 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye śāntistotravīravandanā nirūpaṇamekaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 21 ||
atha
[dvāviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi surāśuddhividhiṃ param | yaṃ vidhāya kalau mantrī bhavitā muktibhājanam || 1 ||
yaireva pātakī devi sādhako dravyasaṅkaraiḥ (gh: sañcayaiḥ) | śuddhaistaireva pūjāyāṃ bhavedbhogāpavargabhāk || 2 ||
yadā prabhṛti loke'smin surā khyātimupāgatā | tadā sarve surā devi brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥ || 3 ||
tatsaṃsargodbhavānanda (k, kh: rgotsavā) nirbharāntaramānasāḥ | asurā rākṣasā yakṣā gandharvā mānavādayaḥ || 4 ||
bhajanti ca surāṃ divyāṃ mantrasaṃskāramantritām | kālena kalaśasthābhūt surādevī sureśvari || 5 ||
kalinā kālarūpeṇa bādhite jagati priye | śaptā śukreṇa deveśi kacakāraṇahatyayā || 6 ||
śukraśāpavaśād devā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ | brahmarṣayaḥ surādevyai daduḥ śāpaṃ yathākramam || 7 ||
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ samaṃ jñeyaṃ maheśvari | surā śaptā yadā devaistadā daityā mudaṃ yayuḥ || 8 ||
surāṃ pītvā tu ditijairdevā balavivarjitāḥ | svargānnirākṛtā devi purandarapuraḥsarāḥ || 9 ||
tadā jiṣṇuṃ puraskṛtya devā yajñamatanvata | sadāśivādayo devi prādurbhūtā makhottame || 10 ||
varaṃ vṛṇu yathābhīṣṭaṃ devanāyaka sāṃpratam | taṃ tavāśu prayacchāmo gacchāmo nilayaṃ svakam || 11 ||
tadā śakro'bravīd devi puraskṛtya guraṃ śive | tṛṇāgrabindumātreṇa surāyāḥ prāśitena ca || 12 ||
yā tṛptirjāyate'smākaṃ na sāmṛtaghaṭīśataiḥ | sā śaptā brahmaṇā devī viṣṇunā śaṅkareṇa ca || 13 ||
tāṃ vinā nirbalā jātāḥ śatrubhiśca (k, g, gh: śakrādyā) prājitāḥ | tadā sarve surā devaṃ śivamīśvaramavyayam || 14 ||
tuṣṭuvuḥ parayā bhaktyā praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ | ekākṣarāya rudrāya akārāyātmarūpiṇe || 15 ||
ukārāyādidevāya vidyādehāya vai namaḥ | tṛtīyāya makārāya śivāya paramātmane || 16 ||
sūryāya somavarṇāya yajamānāya vai namaḥ | namaste bhagavan rudra bhāskarāmitatejase || 17 ||
namo bhavāya devāya śarvāya ca kapardine | śivāya kṣitirūpāya sadāsurabhaye (gh: bhide) namaḥ || 18 ||
īśānāya namastubhyaṃ saṃsparśāya namo namaḥ | paśūnāṃ pataye caiva pāvakāmitatejase || 19 ||
bhīmāya vyomarūpāya śabdamātrāya vai namaḥ | mahādevāya somāya amṛtāya namo namaḥ || 20 ||
ugrāya yajamānāya namaste karmayogine (k, kh, g: rūpiṇe) | iti stutvā paraṃ devaṃ bhairavaṃ śivamīśvaram || 21 ||
praṇemuḥ sakalā devā brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥ | tadā vāgudabhūd vyomnaḥ pañcavyomaśarīriṇām || 22 ||
sureyaṃ sarvadā sevyā sakalaistu mumukṣubhiḥ | yuktyānayā prasaṅgena yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 23 ||
caturdhā vedarūpo'hamṛgyajuḥsāmarūpavān | atharvāhaṃ ca mantrātmā paramātmā śivo'vyayaḥ || 24 ||
vedānāloḍya vedārthaṃ mantrarūpaṃ vidhāya ca | kurukullāṃ mahāvidyāṃ sadāśiva prakāśaya || 25 ||
āgamaṃ nāma śāstraṃ tu catuṣṣaṣṭyātmakaṃ param | tasmin surādiśuddhiṃ tu prakāśaya manūttamaiḥ || 26 ||
iti vāṇī śivodbhūtā virarāma yadā parā (ṅ: tadā) | sadāśivaṃ maheśānaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ praṇatāḥ surāḥ || 27 ||
oṃkārarūpiṇe deva namaste viśvarūpiṇe | namo devādidevāya mahādevāya vai namaḥ || 28 ||
ardhanārīśarīrāya sāṃkhyayogapravartite | vedaśāstrārthagamyāya śāśvatāya namo namaḥ || 29 ||
dīnārtatrāṇakartre ca namaste divyacakṣuṣe | namaḥ sahasraśīrṣāya namaḥ sāhasrikāṅghraye || 30 ||
namo mantrāya vidvyomavāsine paramātmane | iti stutvā mahādevo mahātmā śrīsadāśivaḥ || 31 ||
provācāgamaśāstraṃ tu mokṣamārgaṃ mahātmanām | devadevīti yā devī yā bhavānīti viśrutā || 32 ||
sadāśivaṃ praṇamyāśu provāca ślakṣṇayā girā | vada devāgamaṃ śāstraṃ rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam || 33 ||
yasyoccāraṇamātreṇa śāpahīnā bhavet surā |
śrīśiva uvāca |
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi surāśuddhiṃ yathākramam | makārāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śodhanaṃ siddhivardhanam || 34 ||
vedo niṣkalaśabdo vai vedārtho'styāgamaḥ śive | vedārthāgamatattvajñaiḥ surā sevyā mumukṣubhiḥ || 35 ||
na vedāgamayorbhedaḥ sarvatheti viniścayaḥ | śāstrāṇāṃ parameśāni bhrāntiḥ kāryā na kaulikaiḥ || 36 ||
adhunā śṛṇu deveśi surāśodhanamuttamam | yena śodhanamātreṇa sarvasiddhiḥ prajāyate || 37 ||
maṇḍalaṃ vāmataḥ kṛtvā jalena rajasāpi vā | kuṅkumenāṣṭagandhena sarvathā vīrabhasmanā || 38 ||
trikoṇaṃ bindusaṃyuktaṃ vṛttaṃ ca caturaśrakam | sāmānyārghyodakenāśu saṃprokṣya kulasundari || 39 ||
tatrādhāraṃ ca saṃsthāpya vahnimaṇḍalamarcayet | vahneḥ kalāḥ samabhyarcya yathāvadvarṇyate mayā || 40 ||
rakāraṃ bindusaṃyuktaṃ vahnibimbaṃ ca ṅe'ntikam | daśakalātmane viśvamiti mantreṇa pūjayet || 41 ||
dhūmrā ca nīlavarṇā ca kapilā visphuliṅginī | jvālā haimavatī kavyavāhanī havyavāhanī || 42 ||
raudrī saṅkarṣaṇī caiva vaiśvānarakalā daśa | pūjayitvoktavidhinā gandhākṣataprasūnakaiḥ || 43 ||
kalaśaṃ saṃsthulaṃ divyaṃ puṣpamālādiśobhitam | haimaṃ vā rājataṃ mārdaṃ sthāpayed vīramudrayā || 44 ||
śambhunā ca yathā devi viṣṇunā ca yathā purā |
brahmaṇā ca yathā pūrvaṃ tathā tvāṃ sthāpayāmyaham || 45 ||
iti saṃsthāpya kalaśaṃ tatra sūryaṃ prapūjayet | sūryanāma samuccārya jīvamantraṃ maheśvari || 46 ||
sūryamaṇḍalaṅentaṃ ca śrīdvādaśakalātmane | viśvamante prayoktavyaṃ manunānena pūjayet || 47 ||
kalā dvādaśa sūryasya pūjayeducyate mayā | tapinī tāpinī caiva bodhinī caiva rodhinī || 48 ||
kalinī śoṣaṇī caiva vareṇyākarṣaṇī tathā | māyā viśvāvatī hemaprabhā saurakalā imāḥ || 49 ||
saṃpūjya kalaśe devi kaulikaḥ kulasiddhaye | surayā pūrayet kumbhaṃ vilomairmātṛkākṣaraiḥ || 50 ||
tadidaṃ cāmṛtaṃ sākṣāccandrarūpaṃ vicintayet | candramaṇḍalamabhyarcya mantreṇānena pārvati || 51 ||
śaktimuccārya deveśi somamaṇḍalaṅeyutam | viśvāñcalāya deveśi śrīṣoḍaśakalātmane || 52 ||
iti saṃpūjya candrasya kalāḥ ṣoḍaśa pūjayet | amṛtā mānadā tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ prītī ratistathā || 53 ||
śrīśca hrīśca svadhā rātrirjyotsnā haimavatī tathā | chāyā ca pūrṇimā nityā cāmāvasyā ca ṣoḍaśī || 54 ||
etāḥ saṃpūjya mantraistu yajed devīṃ ca bhairavīm | mūlena tatra kalaśe trikoṇaṃ ca vibhāvayet || 55 ||
bindubimbe parāṃ (k, kh, g: bimbaparāṃ) dhyātvā pūjayediṣṭadevatām | praṇavenārcayed devi śivaṃ gandhena vāyunā || 56 ||
tatra tāraṃ ca māyāṃ ca paramasvāminyuddharet |
paramākāśaśūnyaṃ ca vāhinīti samuddharet || 57 ||
candrārkāgnibhakṣaṇīti pātre viśa yugaṃ vadet | ṭhadvayāntāmimāṃ vidyāṃ japettu daśadhā ghaṭe || 58 ||
tatraiva mātṛkānte ca japedṛcamimāṃ priye | ākṛṣṇena rajaseti nāmnīṃ paramapāvanīm || 59 ||
daśadhaitāmṛcaṃ devi madhuvātaṛdābhidhām | tatrānandeśagāyatrīṃ japettu daśadhā priye || 60 ||
vāṅmāyāmāḥ samuccārya tathānandeśvarāya ca | vidmahe śrīsurādevyai dhīmahīti tato vadet || 61 ||
tanno'rdhanārīśvaraśca pracodayāt samuddharet | gāyatrīṃ daśadhā japtvā haṃsaḥ śuciṣadārcayet || 62 ||
agnimīle purohitaṃ triḥsañjapyeti kaulikaḥ | vakāraṃ dīrghaṣaṭkādyaṃ proccārya tadanantaram || 63 ||
brahmaśāpamocitāyai surādevyai kuṭāntakam | daśadhā prajapedvidyāmiṣe tvorjetyṛcaṃ japet || 64 ||
tāraṃ māyārṇaṣaḍdīrghān proccāryeti sudhe tataḥ | śukraśāpaṃ mocaya dvirvanāntaṃ ca manuṃ japet || 65 ||
agna āyāhīti ṛcaṃ daśadhā prajapet priye | śukraśāpaharīṃ vidyāṃ prajapeducyate yathā (kh: mayā) || 66 ||
sūryamaṇḍalasaṃbhūte varuṇālayasaṃbhave | amābījamaye devi śukraśāpādvimucyatām || 67 ||
devānāṃ (vedānāṃ) praṇavo bījaṃ brahmānandamayaṃ yadi | tena satyena deveśi brahmahatyā vyapohatu || 68 ||
ekameva paraṃ brahma sthūlasūkṣmamayaṃ param |
kacodbhavāṃ brahmahatyāṃ tena te nāśayāmyaham || 69 ||
brahmaśāpavinirmuktā tvaṃ muktā viṣṇuśāpataḥ | vimuktā rudraśāpena pavitrā bhava sāṃpratam || 70 ||
etairmantraiḥ samabhyarcya trivāraṃ kaulikaḥ śive | śanno devīriti ṛcaṃ daśadhā prajaped ghaṭe || 71 ||
tato māyāṃ ramāṃ devi paṅguṃ ṣaḍdīrghabhājitam | churikākāriṇyuccārya śobhinīti tato vadet || 72 ||
vikārānasya dravyasya hara yugmaṃ ca ṭhadvayam | churikākhyāṃ japedvidyāṃ daśadhā kalaśopari || 73 ||
yo viśvacakṣuriti ca (ṅ: tāṃ) ṛcaṃ vai daśadhā japet | guruṃ dhyātvā sahasrāre hṛtpadme'pīṣṭadevatām || 74 ||
praṇamya kauliko dhyāyet śrītiraskaraṇīṃ japet | nīlatoyadasaṅkāśāṃ nīlakuntalaśobhitām || 75 ||
nīlāmbaradharāṃ devīṃ nīlotpalavilocanām | nīlapuṣpavibhūṣāḍhyāṃ nīlālaṅkārabhūṣitām || 76 ||
nīlāṅgarāgasaṃchannāṃ nīlavaiḍūryamālinīm | indranīlanibaddhāṃśumahārghamaṇibūṣitām || 77 ||
nīlavājisamārūḍhāṃ nīlakhaḍgāyudhāṃ parām (k, kh: dhāmbarām) | nidrāpaṭena nīlena bhuvanāni caturdaśa || 78 ||
mohayantīṃ mahāyāyāṃ dravyanindakabhakṣiṇīm | vīrapānaratān vīrān pālayantīṃ samantataḥ || 79 ||
saṅketamaṇḍalaṃ divyaṃ chādayantā svavāsasā | paramānandavapuṣīṃ paramānandabhairavīm || 80 ||
paramānandajananīṃ praṇamāmi parāmbikām |
iti dhyātvā japedvidyāṃ yathāvad varṇyate mayā || 81 ||
vākkāmamaṭhamāyāśca tiraskaraṇi saṃvadet | sakalajanaṃ proccārya vāgvādini tato vadet || 82 ||
sakalapaśujanaṃ ca vaded vrātamanaḥpadam | cakṣuḥśrotrajihvāghrāṇādīni ceti tiraskuru || 83 ||
tiraskuru tataḥ padmatrayaṃ ṭhadvayamuddharet | śrītiraskaraṇīṃ vidyāṃ sañjaped daśadhā ghaṭe || 84 ||
pāvamānyāḥ paraṃ brahma śuddhaṃ jyotiḥ sanātanam | pitṝṃstasyopatiṣṭhati kṣīraṃ sarpirmadhūdakaiḥ (kh: madhūdakam) || 85 ||
ṛcametāṃ japedādau trivāraṃ trirjaped tataḥ | pāvamānyaṃ paraṃ brahma pāvamānyaḥ paro rasaḥ || 86 ||
pāvamānyaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ tena tvāṃ pāvayāmyaham | iti japtvā guruṃ dhyātvā japed varuṇabījakam || 87 ||
haṃsa ityarkamantraṃ ca devīṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ smaret | prasuptabhujagākārāṃ sārdhatrivalayāṃ śubhām || 88 ||
sūryakoṭikarālābhāṃ candrakoṭisuśītalām | vahnikoṭidurāda(dha)rṣāṃ bisatantutanīyasīm || 89 ||
ṣaṭ cakrāṇi vibhidyāśu suṣumnāvartmanā nayet | sahasrārasthitaṃ devaṃ natvā śivapade layet || 90 ||
śivaśaktyormahajjyotirdhyātvā candrakalāsrutam | amṛtaṃ vāmanāsāgrānniḥsārya kalaśe kṣipet || 91 ||
amṛtīkṛtya tad dravyaṃ dhenumudrāṃ pradarśayet | māyāṃ ramāṃ kāmakalāmamṛte'pyamṛtodbhave || 92 ||
amṛtavarṣiṇyuccārya amṛtaṃ srāvaya dvayam | aṃāṃ viṣṇukalānte ca paṭhet pārvati kaulikaḥ || 93 ||
viśvāntamamṛteśvaryai manumenaṃ japed ghaṭe | dhyātvāmṛtamayaṃ dravyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam || 94 ||
elālavaṅgakastūrī candanośīramiśritam | vidhāya mūlamantreṇa tīrthānyāvāhayed ghaṭe || 95 ||
tāraṃ śivaṃ śivodbhūtiṃ mūlametat samuddharet | gaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati || 96 ||
narmade sindhukāveri dravye'smin sannidhiṃ kuru | ityāvāhya mahādevi mudrayāṅkuśarūpayā || 97 ||
sarvatīrthamayaṃ dravyaṃ dhyāyet paramapāvanam | dravyamadhye binduyutaṃ trikoṇaṃ ca vibhāvayet || 98 ||
yonimudrāṃ nibaddhyāśu dhyāyedānandabhairavam | sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ candrakoṭisuśītalam || 99 ||
aṣṭādaśabhujaṃ devaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanam | amṛtārṇavamadhyasthaṃ brahmapadmoparisthitam || 100 ||
vṛṣārūḍhaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sarvā(rpā)bharaṇabhūṣitam | kapālakhaṭvāṅgadharaṃ ghaṇṭāḍamaruvādinam || 101 ||
pāśāṅkuśadharaṃ devaṃ gadāmusaladhāriṇam | khaḍgakheṭakapaṭṭīśa mudgarocchūlakuntinam || 102 ||
vicitrakheṭakaṃ muṇḍavaradābhayapāṇikam | lohitaṃ devadeveśaṃ bhāvayet sādhakottamaḥ || 103 ||
dattvā puṣpāñjaliṃ kumbhe japedānandabhairavam | hakāraṃ ca bhṛguṃ devaṃ maṇḍūkaṃ dharaṇiṃ tataḥ || 104 ||
(tathā jīmūtabījaṃ ca hutabhugbījamuddharet |) vāyuṃ keśaṃ tathānandabhairavāya tato'ñcale || 105 ||
vikuṭaṃ ca manuṃ japtvā daśadhā bhairavīṃ yajet |
ānandabhairavīṃ dhyāyed yathāvad varṇyate (g: varṇitā) śive || 106 ||
samudre mathyamāne tu kṣīrābdhau sāgarottame | tatrotpannā surā devī kumārīrūpadhāriṇī || 107 ||
bhāvayecca surāṃ devīṃ candrakoṭyayutaprabhām | himakundendudhavalāṃ pañcavaktrāṃ trilocanām || 108 ||
aṣṭādaśabhujairyuktāṃ sarvānandakarodyatām | prahasantīṃ viśālākṣīṃ devadevasya sammukhīm || 109 ||
śaktiṃ śivaṃ nirjaraṃ ca bhekīṃ bhūbījameva ca | meghaṃ vahniṃ samīrārṇaṃ keśaṃ caiva samuddharet || 110 ||
surādevyai kuṭaṃ cānte vidyāṃ ca daśadhā japet | bhairavaṃ bhairavīṃ caiva yaṣṭvā pārvati kaulikaḥ || 111 ||
mahāmudrāṃ dhenumudrāṃ yoniṃ matsyaṃ pradarśayet | baddhvā ca lelihānākhyāṃ mudrāṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ punaḥ || 112 ||
mūlādhārāt samutthāya suṣumnāvartmanā priye | dvādaśāntaṃ samāsthāpya sohaṃ haṃsa iti smaret || 113 ||
śivena saha saṃyojya parānandamayo bhavet | tadudbhūtāmṛtavṛṣṭimutsṛjed vāmanāsayā || 114 ||
praṇavena ca deveśi paradravye niyojayet | sākṣādamṛtatattvāḍhyaṃ dhyāyet kalaśamuttamam || 115 ||
vāruṇaṃ bījamuccārya mūlamantraṃ samuccaret | daśadhā prajaped devi gandhākṣatapuraḥsaraiḥ || 116 ||
puṣpairnānāvidhairdivyairmālyairvividhabhuṣaṇaiḥ | saṃpūjya kalaśaṃ divyaṃ ghaṇṭāniḥsvānapūrvakam || 117 ||
dhūpairdīpairmahotsāhaiḥ paramairvividhauṣadhaiḥ | prapūjtha parayā bhaktyā praṇāmaiḥ stutipūrvakaiḥ || 118 ||
sarvadevamayaṃ kumbhaṃ dhyāyed deveśi sādhakaḥ | yā surā sā umādevī yo dravyaṃ sa maheśvaraḥ || 119 ||
yo gandhaḥ sa bhaved brahmā yo mohaḥ sa janārdanaḥ | svāde ca saṃsthitaḥ somaṃ phenāyāmanalaḥ sthitaḥ || 120 ||
icchāyāṃ manmatho devaśchardyāmucchiṣṭabhairavaḥ | drāve gaṅgā sthitā devi ghaṭasthāḥ sapta sāgarāḥ || 121 ||
sarvatejomayaṃ dravyaṃ paramānandanirbharam | sarvaśāpavinirmuktaṃ sarvamantrasusaṃskṛtam || 122 ||
paramāmṛtabhāvena bhairavaṃ bhairavīṃ yajet | māheśvarairmahāvīrairmahācīnapadasthitaiḥ || 123 ||
mahāśaktimayairmānyaiḥ sevyaṃ dravyamidaṃ priye | santarpya devatāmiṣṭāṃ yoginīgaṇamaiśvaram || 124 ||
vaṭukaṃ kṣetrapālāṃśca tristriśatkoṭidevatāḥ (tritriṃśat pāṭhaḥ sādhu) | mātṝrmātṛgaṇān sarvān bhūtapretādisaṃyutān || 125 ||
santarpya vidhivad devi guruṃ guruvarāṃstataḥ | guruṃ dhyātvā parāṃ dhyāyedvīrān saṃpūjya śaktitaḥ || 126 ||
śaktiyukto yajet pātramityājñā pārameśvarī | śaktihīne vṛthāpānaṃ śivahīne vṛthārcanam || 127 ||
śivaśaktisamāyoge vīrapūjā vimokṣadā | itīdaṃ śodhanaṃ divyaṃ surāyāṃ suradurlabham || 128 ||
tava snehena nirṇītaṃ śṛṇuṣvānyadapi priye | madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā mīno mudrā maithunameva ca || 129 ||
makārapañcakaṃ pūjyaṃ śivaśaktisamāgame | pūjāyāṃ yadyadānītaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca lehyakam || 130 ||
peyaṃ coṣyaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ sarvaṃ mantreṇa mantrayet | vinābhimantraṇenaitad yo mohād bhakṣayecchive || 131 ||
sa māntriko'pi deveśi sahasā nirayī bhavet | caturasraṃ likhedbimbaṃ tatra mīnān nidhāpayet || 132 ||
śoṣayed dāhayed devi plāvayenmanunā śive | vāyubījena vāhnyena vāruṇena yathākramam || 133 ||
dhenuyonimahāmatsyā (k, kh, g: matsyamu) mudrāścaiva pradarśayet | daśadhā prajapenmantramānandeśvarabhairavam || 134 ||
prajapya prapaṭhedvidyāṃ yathoktāṃ kaulikeśvari | kṛtāvatāro hariṇā kalinā pīḍitaṃ jagat || 135 ||
balinā nigṛhītaṃ ca kaulikānāṃ hitecchayā | bhairavīparitoṣārthaṃ svayaṃ mīno'bhavad hariḥ || 136 ||
māyāṃ ca haraye (harate sarvapustakeṣu pāṭhaḥ) viśvaṃ japedṛcamataḥ param | tryambakaṃ yajāmahīti mantraṃ triḥsañjapet sudhīḥ || 137 ||
prapūjya gandhapuṣpaistu praṇamed devatāṃ parām | caturasre mahādevi māṃsapātraṃ nidhāpayet || 138 ||
saṃśoṣya sandahya palamāplāvya kulasundari | mudrātrayaṃ pradarśyāśu prapaṭhet kauliko manum || 139 ||
chāgalājyeṇamartyāntra(ntaḥ)kṛtarūpāya (k, kh, g: mantrārtha) viṣṇave | balyarthaṃ śivaśaktyostaṃ prapadye viṣṇumavyayam || 140 ||
pratarpayāmi balyarthaṃ pavitrībhava sāṃpratam | triḥ paṭhitvā ṛcaṃ devi japet kaulikasattamaḥ || 141 ||
pra tadviṣṇuriti smṛtvā praṇamed yonimudrayā | mudrāpātraṃ samānīya sthāpayeccaturaśrake || 142 ||
saṃśoṣaṇaṃ dāhanaṃ ca plāvanaṃ pūrvavaccaret | mudrātrayaṃ ca saṃdarśya prapaṭhed vedavad vidhim || 143 ||
devatāpūjane yāni saurabheyāni sāṃpratam | balyarthaṃ devadevyośca pavitrāṇīha siddhaye || 144 ||
mūlaṃ ca daśadhā japtvā japedṛcamanuttamām | (tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ mantraṃ prajapyopari kaulikaḥ || 145 ||
praṇamya bhaktibhāvena kuṇḍagolaṃ ca śodhayet | caturaśre ca saṃsthāpya śoṣayed dāhayet sudhīḥ || 146 ||
āplāvayet parairbījairmudrābhirabhirakṣayet |) mūlaṃ ca daśadhā japtvā japedṛcamathopari || 147 ||
viṣṇuryonimiti smṛtvā prajapya praṇamettataḥ | sarveṣu devadravyeṣu samānīteṣu kaulikaiḥ || 148 ||
ṛcametāṃ japet samyaṅ mantramenaṃ samuddharet | glūṃmlūṃslūṃplūṃnlūṃ deveśi svāntaṃ khaṃ kāmakālikam || 149 ||
amṛte'pyamṛtodbhūte'pyamṛteśvari cāmṛtam | srāvaya dvayamuddhṛtya ṭhadvayaṃ ca samuddharet || 150 ||
iyaṃ śāpaharī vidyā makārāṇāṃ maheśvari | pañcānāṃ pañcakalpānāṃ smaraṇīyārcanāvidhau || 151 ||
saṃśodhya śivadravyāṇi mantrairmudrābhireva ca | ṛgbhiḥ krameṇa mūlena plā(pā)vayecca yathākramam || 152 ||
ānandarasasaṃpūrṇaiḥ kalaśāmṛtabindubhiḥ | evaṃ saṃśodhya dravyāṇi paramāṇi kuleśvari || 153 ||
bhairavaṃ bhairavīṃ devīṃ yajed vīrasamāgame | ayaṣṭvā bhairavaṃ devamakṛtvā devatārcanam || 154 ||
paśupānavidhau pītvā vīro'pi narakaṃ vrajet |
evaṃ saṃskṛtya deveśi gurubhaktipuraḥsaram || 155 ||
yaḥ pibet paramaṃ pānaṃ śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt | itīdaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ rahasyānāṃ rahasyakam || 156 ||
aṣṭasiddhimayaṃ tattvaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat |
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye surāśodhanavidhinirūpaṇaṃ dvāviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 22 || atha
[trayoviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā śṛṇu deveśi śaktiśodhanamuttamam | yena (g: yasya) śravaṇamātreṇa parāśaktipade layet || 1 ||
adīkṣitakulāsaṅgāt siddhihāniḥ prajāyate | tatkathāśravaṇaṃ cet syāt tattalpagamanaṃ yadi || 2 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
kulācārakramārcāyāṃ siddhiṃ kāmayate tu yaḥ | sa kulīnaḥ kathaṃ deva pūjayet kulayoṣitam || 3 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
saṃśodhanamakṛtvā vai strīṣu madyeṣu kaulikaḥ | kṛte'pi siddhihāniḥ syāt kruddhā bhavati caṇḍikā || 4 ||
abhiṣekād bhavet siddhirmantrasyoccāraṇācchubhā | ratikāle maheśānī dīkṣākāle ca kanyakā || 5 ||
balādvā yatnato buddhyā plā(pā)vayet parayoṣitam | surayā retasā vāpi jalena madhunātha vā || 6 ||
saṅge'bhiṣecayennārīṃ (saṃbhoge'bhiṣicet iti sarvatra pāṭhaḥ) caṇḍāṃ vā mantravarjitām | svakīyāṃ parakīyāṃ vā rūpayauvanagarvitām || 7 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan devadeveśa kulācāraikasiddhaye | kulayogī kathaṃ kuryācchodhanaṃ kulayoṣitām || 8 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
kulajāṃ yuvatiṃ vīkṣya namaskuryāt kuleśvaraḥ | vidhāya mānasīṃ pūjāṃ mantraṃ yogī samuccaret || 9 ||
bālāṃ vā yauvanonmattāṃ vṛddhāṃ vā sundarīṃ tathā | kutsitāṃ vā mahāduṣṭāṃ namaskṛtya vibhāvayet || 10 ||
tāsāṃ prahāro nindā ca kauṭilyamapriyaṃ tathā | sarvathā naiva kartavyamanyathā siddhirodhakṛt || 11 ||
striyo devāḥ striyaḥ prāṇāḥ striya eva hi bhūṣaṇam | strīgaṇeṣu sadā bhāvyamanyathā svastriyāmapi || 12 ||
viparītaratā sāpi bhavitā hṛdayopari | sādhakasya bhavedāśu kāmadhenurivāparā || 13 ||
nādharmo jāyate tena na kaścid dharmahā bhavet | tatparaḥ paratanvīnāṃ paratattve pralīyate || 14 ||
naṭī kāpālikī veśyā rajakī nāpitāṅganā | brāhmaṇī śūdrakanyā ca tathā gopālakanyakā || 15 ||
mālākārasya kanyāpi nava kanyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | etāsu kāṃcidānīya saṃśodhanamathācaret || 16 ||
pūjayet kauliko devi yathāvad varṇyate mayā | śaktiśodhanamantrasya ṛṣiḥ proktaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 17 ||
triṣṭup chanda iti khyātaṃ devatā ca parāmbikā | vāgbījaṃ bījamīśāni śaktiḥ śaktiritīritā || 18 ||
kāmeśaḥ kīlakaṃ devi digbandho haramīśvari | bhogāpavargasiddhyarthaṃ viniyogo maheśvari || 19 ||
mahāniśāyāmānīya nava kanyāśca bhairavān | ekādaśa navāṣṭau vā kaulikaḥ kaulikeśvari || 20 ||
śodhayennavabhirmantraiḥ pūjayet kaulikottamaḥ | sādhakaḥ saṃspṛśedādau kṛtvā viṣṭaraśodhanam || 21 ||
bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāyāpi prāṇārpaṇavidhiṃ caret | mantrasaṃkalpakaṃ kṛtvā munyādinyāsamācaret || 22 ||
vidhāya mātṛkānyāsaṃ karāṅganyāsapūrvakam | hṛtpīṭhārcāṃ vidhāyātha (ṅ: yātra) śrīcakrārcanamācaret || 23 ||
saṃśodhya devadravyāṇi (k, kh: devi dra) kuṇḍagolādikaṃ tathā | vīrārcanaṃ vīrakāntāsevanaṃ devadurlabham || 24 ||
yathoktavidhinā devīṃ saṃpūjya śrīparāmbikām | śaktiṃ vāme tu saṃsthāpya pūjayedvarṇyate yathā || 25 ||
trikoṇaṃ vātha ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tryaśratrayamatho haviḥ (bahiḥ) | śivatryaśraṃ kāmatryaśraṃ hetitryaśraṃ maheśvari || 26 ||
brahmatryaśraṃ navatryaśraṃ sindūreṇa vibhāvayet | śrīcakreṣu hi naṭyādimālinyantaṃ vicārya ca || 27 ||
yāmevāsāṃ kumārīṇāṃ kaulikastu samānayet | tadīyaṃ yantramālikhya tasmiṃstāmeva pūjayet || 28 ||
śrīcakre sthāpayed vāme kanyāṃ bhairavavallabhām | muktakeśīṃ vītalajjāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām || 29 ||
sarvaśṛṅgāraśobhāḍhyāṃ tāruṇyamadagarvitām | ānandalīnahṛdayāṃ saundaryātimanoharām || 30 ||
śodhayecchuddhimantreṇa surānandāmṛtāmbubhiḥ | bālābījatrayaṃ devi proccārya tadanantaraṃ || 31 ||
tripurāyai tato viśvaṃ viśvānte nāmapūrvakam | imāṃ śaktiṃ pavitrīti kuru yugmaṃ samuddharet || 32 ||
mama śaktiṃ kuru yugmaṃ vahnijāyāṃ samuddharet | mantreṇānena deveśi kāminīmabhiṣecayet || 33 ||
abhiṣicya kumārīṃ tāṃ nyāsajālaṃ pravinyaset | mātṛkāvanmahādevi kāmabāṇāṃstato nyaset || 34 ||
candrabījadvayaṃ devi kāmarājaṃ ca mohanam | śaktibījaṃ tato devi yathāvadvinyaset priye || 35 ||
lalāṭe vadane nyasya (cāṃse) hṛdaye yonimaṇḍale | sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇaṃ bāṇaṃ sarvavidrāvaṇaṃ tathā || 36 ||
sarvākarṣaṇabāṇaṃ ca sarvasaṃmohanaṃ tataḥ | vaśikaraṇabāṇaṃ ca pañceṣoḥ pañcabāṇakān || 37 ||
vinyasya bāṇamudrāśca pañcaitā devi darśayet | yonibimbe japenmantrān nava yān varṇayāmyaham (k, kh, g: yān varṇyate mayā) || 38 ||
tāraṃ candraṃ ca vāgbījaṃ kāmaṃ śaktiṃ tato vadet | naṭinīti mahāsiddhiṃ mama dehi yugaṃ vadet || 39 ||
ṭhadvayaṃ proccaredante mantro'yaṃ naṭinīpriyaḥ | kālīṃ kūrcaṃ parāṃ śaktiṃ kāmaṃ kāpālini priye || 40 ||
reto muñca yugaṃ brūyādante dahanavallabhā | devi kāpālikīmantraḥ kāmadevavaśaṅkaraḥ || 41 ||
tāradvandvaṃ ca haritaṃ meghaṣaḍdīrghabījakam (ṅ: meghavad) | veśye kāmadughe reto muñca yugmāgnivallabhā || 42 ||
veśyāśodhanamantro'yaṃ sarvakaulikavallabhaḥ | vedādyaṃ vāgbhavaṃ kāmaṃ śaktiṃ lakṣmīṃ parāṃ smaret || 43 ||
rajakīti mahāsiddhiṃ dehi me hara ṭhadvayam | rajakīśuddhimantro'yaṃ kulayoṣidvaśaṅkaraḥ || 44 ||
tāraṃ tāratrayaṃ vastraṃ proccarennāpitāṅgane | hara yugmaṃ ca me vighnāṃsturagaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ tataḥ || 45 ||
nāpitastrīśuddhimantro mahāmāṅgalyadāyakaḥ | vedādyaṃ bhūtibījaṃ ca tāraṃ māyāṃ dhanurdharaḥ || 46 ||
brāhmaṇi smara vīryaṃ ca muñca muñceti sarvadā | siddhiṃ me dehi dehīti haraṃ dahanavallabhā || 47 ||
brāhmaṇīśuddhimantro'yaṃ mahāsiddhipradāyakaḥ | tāraṃ ramā ramā tāraṃ śūdrāṇi ca ratapriye || 48 ||
retaḥ stambhaya me siddhiṃ dehi yugmaṃ tato vanam | śūdrāṇīśuddhimantro'yaṃ kāminījanamohanaḥ || 49 ||
tārakaṃ śivaṣaḍdīrghasaṃyutaṃ maṭhabījakam | gopāli me siddhadaṇḍaṃ drāvaya dvayamuddharet || 50 ||
ṭhadvayānto mahāmantro gopīśodhanasādhakaḥ | tāradvayīsaṃpuṭitāṃ mṛdvīkāṃ dīrghasaṃyutām || 51 ||
uddhṛtya mālini prema kuru yugmaṃ mayi smaret | turagaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ prānte mantro'yaṃ mālinīpriyaḥ || 52 ||
evaṃ śodhanamantrāste varṇitāśca pṛthaṅmayā | yonau japet kumārīṇāṃ kaulikaḥ karamālayā || 53 ||
saṃjapya dakṣakarṇe ca mūlamantraṃ triruccaret | adīkṣitāpi deveśi kīkṣitaiva bhavet tadā || 54 ||
dīkṣitāṃ śodhitāṃ vīro bhajet sarvārthasiddhaye | tāraṃ vyoṣamauṣmakaṃ ca śivāyeti svayambhuvam || 55 ||
saṃpūjya śivamantraṃ ca japet saṃstabhya puṃdhvajam | japtvā nirudhya taṃ daṇḍaṃ karabhītuṇḍamudrayā (k, kh, g: karituṇḍākhyamudrayā) || 56 ||
ānandatarpitāṃ kāntāṃ vīraḥ svānandavigrahaḥ | ratena tarpayet tatra śrīcakre vīrasaṃsadi || 57 ||
paṭhan praṇavamuddhṛtya mantrarājaṃ kuleśvari | dharmādharmahavirdīpte svātmāgnau manasā srucā || 58 ||
suṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛttīrjuhomyaham | svāhāntamantramuccārya japan mūlaṃ smaran parām || 59 ||
kuryānnidhuvanaṃ mantrī mantrasiddhimavāpnuyāt | ratānte sañjapenmūlaṃ paṭhenmantramimaṃ punaḥ || 60 ||
tāradvayāntaragataṃ paramānandakāraṇam | prakāśākāśahastābhyāmavalambyonmanīsrucam || 61 ||
dharmādharmakalāsnehapūrṇāṃ (k, kh, ṅ: pūrṇe) vahnau juhomyaham | svāhāntenāśu mantreṇa śukramādāya pārvati || 62 ||
śrīcakre tarpayed devīṃ tataḥ siddhimavāpnuyāt | saṃpūjya kāntāṃ santarpya stutvā natvā parasparam || 63 ||
saṃhāramudrayā mantrī śaktiṃ vīrān visarjayet | itīdaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ śaktiśodhanamuttamam || 64 ||
tava snehena nirṇītaṃ gopanīyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ |
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye śaktiśodhanavidhinirūpaṇaṃ trayorviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 23 || atha
[caturviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
śṛṇuṣvāvahitā bhūtvā mālāśodhanamuttamam | yena śodhanamātreṇa mālā siddhyati satphalā || 1 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
mālā kīdṛgvidhā nātha kriyate kaulikottamaiḥ | kiyatphalā kiyatsaṃkhyā sarvaṃ me vaktumarhasi || 2 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
navāntā varṇitā saṃkhyā kālo'yaṃ dvādaśāvadhiḥ | mālā japasya deveśi rahasyamidamaiśvaram || 3 ||
kālātmā savitā prokto vallabhe japadevatā | dvādaśātmā sa savitā tadantāvṛttirīritā || 4 ||
mālā raviphalā proktā saṃkhyayā kaulikeśvari | āvartayecca navadhā tāmeva japasiddhaye || 5 ||
athāntarguhyamācakṣe tava snehena pārvati | mālārahasyasarvasvaṃ nākhyeyaṃ yasya kasyacit || 6 ||
rudrāṇāṃ tu śataṃ caikaṃ bhairavāṣṭakayojitam | kṛtvā meruṃ mahārudraṃ japamālā vinirmitā || 7 ||
na hanyād bhairavān rudraiḥ rudrāṃśca bhairavaistathā | anyathā japahāniḥ syādrudrasya vacanaṃ yathā || 8 ||
aṣṭotkṛṣṭaśataṃ devi golakānāṃ mukhaṃ mukhe | pāyuṃ pāyau nibadhnīyāt sūtre mantramanusmaran || 9 ||
ūrdhve meruṃ mahāketuṃ nibadhya kulasundari | śaṅkhamuktāpravālārka rudrākṣavaravīrudhām || 10 ||
maṇikāñcanapadmākṣanṛdantānāṃ yathākramam | sarveṣāṃ golakānāṃ ca meruṃ rudrākṣamācaret || 11 ||
naradantavirodhānāṃ (nṛdantavīrudhāṃ caiva iti sādhuḥ pāṭhaḥ) meruṃ vājiradaṃ caret | ṣaṇmāsenākṣasūtrāṇāṃ śodhanaṃ sādhakaścaret || 12 ||
tato japenmahāvidyāṃ kauliko japamālayā | guṇaistribhistrirāvartya (rāvṛtya sarvatra pāṭhaḥ) ṣaṭtriṃśattattvagolakān || 13 ||
tāraṃ meruṃ vidadhyāt tu tattvamālāsu kaulikaḥ | aṣṭotkṛṣṭaśate prauḍhā māleyaṃ devi durlabhā || 14 ||
praṇavāntaritā varṇā devi lomānulomataḥ | varṇitā mātṛkāmālā vedādihavirāśritā || 15 ||
tāradvayaṃ svarānte ca dadyāllomānulomataḥ | tāradvayaṃ ca vargānte varṇādyante ca taddvayam || 16 ||
vidhāya turagaṃ meruṃ japecchaktyarṇamālayā | tārakāmaiḥ saṃpuṭitā māleyaṃ guruvallabhā || 17 ||
devadevasya deveśi svatantrasya maheśituḥ | ṣaḍānanodbhavāstārāḥ ṣaṭ ṣaḍāmnāyasūcakāḥ || 18 ||
caturṇāmāśramāṇāṃ tu śaṅkhārkavaravīrudhām | rudrākṣāṇāṃ prakurvīta mālāṃ sarvārthasiddhidām || 19 ||
muktāpravālasadratna hemapadmākṣaśālinām | pūrvāmnāyādibhedānāṃ mālāṃ kuryādyathākramam || 20 ||
lāmānulomavarṇānāṃ dvayotkṛṣṭaśataṃ śive | tārakāmena saṃyojya brahmotkṛṣṭaśataṃ śive || 21 ||
kṣaḥ sumeruṃ niyojyādau varṇalomānulomakaiḥ | svaravargayaśāṁllāntān yojayet parameśvari || 22 ||
śrīśivākṣaramāleyaṃ varṇitā snehato mayā | śrīmahāṣoḍaśīvidyāgurūnādāya pārvati || 23 ||
ṣaṭtriṃśattattvamātrābhiryojayet saptabhirgrahaiḥ | śivāmāleyamākhyātā śivasāyujyasiddhaye || 24 ||
pañcaṣaṣṭyakṣarīvarṇāṃścatvāriṃśatibhairavaiḥ | tryadhikairyojayenmālā bhairavīyamudāhṛtā || 25 ||
anāmikādvayaṃ parva kaniṣṭhādikrameṇa tu | tarjanīmūlaparyantaṃ karamāleyamāhṛtā (kh: japed dvādaśaparvasu) || 26 ||
daśāṃśaṃ sañjaped devi kevalaṃ karamālayā | anāmikādvayaṃ parva kaniṣṭhādikrameṇa tu || 27 ||
tarjanīmūlaparyantaṃ japed dvādaśaparvasu | kaniṣṭhikācatuṣparvānāmāparvatrayaṃ tathā || 28 ||
madhyamāparva devyekaṃ tarjanyāśca catuṣṭayam | saṃyojya saṃjaped vidyāṃ mantrī dvādaśaparvasu || 29 ||
śaktimāleyamākhyātā tyaktvā parvacatuṣṭayam | durgāvṛttyā japed devi sahasrādyayutāvadhi || 30 ||
dikpālāśca gṛhāścāṣṭau santi ṣoḍaśaparvasu | pralambaparvatritaye trayo devāḥ samāhitāḥ || 31 ||
krūragrahau ca mandārau dikpālau yamanir(-)ṛtī | kulikaśceti vikhyāto japahānikaro mataḥ || 32 ||
kulikaṃ santyajed devi mantrī karajape sadā | kaniṣṭhāmūlaparvādikrameṇa karagāḥ surāḥ || 33 ||
tān śṛṇuṣva mahādevi yathāvadvarṇyate mayā | īśāno'gnirnir(-)ṛtiśca vāyurindro yamastathā || 34 ||
varuṇaśca kuberaśca sūryaḥ somo budho guruḥ | sitarāhvārasaurāntā (k, kh, g: tamandārasurbhānu) brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || 35 ||
japasiddhikarā devi sakalāḥ karadevatāḥ | kulikaṃ santyajed devi japakāle svasiddhaye (k, kh, g: jāpako japasiddhaye) || 36 ||
kuliko mudgaro jñeyo mudgare tu mahadbhayam | mudgarollaṅghane śaktirmahārudrasya kevalam || 37 ||
kulikaṃ ca mahāketuṃ merurūpaṃ na laṅghayet | anyathā devi mantrī ca devatāśāpamāpnuyāt || 38 ||
atha ṣāṇmāsikīṃ śuddhiṃ mālānāṃ te bravīmyaham | yayā siddhirbhaved devi devānāmapi durlabhā || 39 ||
mālāśodhanakāle tu gatvā pretālayaṃ sudhīḥ | vidhāya bhasmanā snānaṃ jalena mantritena vā || 40 ||
tatra snātvopaviśyātha kṛtvā viṣṭaraśodhanam | bhūtaśuddhikramopetaṃ prāṇārpaṇavidhiṃ tataḥ || 41 ||
dehaśuddhiṃ vidhāyātha mantrasaṅkalpamācaret | mālāśodhanamantrasya ṛṣiḥ kālāgnirudrakaḥ || 42 ||
chando'nuṣṭuv mahādevi devī śmaśānabhairavī | kālarātrīti vikhyātā muṇḍamālāvilāsinī || 43 ||
haritaṃ bījamākhyātaṃ nalinī śaktirīritā | sūryākhyaṃ kīlakaṃ mālāśuddhaye viniyogakaḥ || 44 ||
ṛṣicchandodaivatādinyāsaṃ kuryāt kulārthavit | aṅganyāsaṃ vidhāyātha karanyāsādipūrvakam || 45 ||
vidhāyāsanaśuddhiṃ ca bhūtaśuddhikramaṃ caret | prāṇān devi pratiṣṭhāpya śrīcakrārcanamācaret || 46 ||
yogapīṭhārcanaṃ kṛtvā dravyādīni viśodhayet | kṣetreśa yoginīvṛndaṃ santarpya kulasundari || 47 ||
layāṅgaṃ pūjayed devi pūjānte sañjapenmanum | mālāyā devadeveśi yathāmnāyaṃ yathāvidhi || 48 ||
śrīcakropari saṃsthāpya śodhayet kalaśāmṛtaiḥ | mālāmūleṇa deveśi mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ || 49 ||
mālāmantrān pravakṣye'haṃ śṛṇuṣvāvahitā priye | tāraṃ ramā ramā tāraṃ śaṅkhinīti padaṃ vadet || 50 ||
tāraṃ mā tāramante'po mantro'yaṃ śaṅkhamālikaḥ | tāraṃ lajjā yugaṃ tāraṃ muktāmālini mā yugam || 51 ||
ṭhadvayaṃ mantrarājo'yaṃ muktāmālāviśodhanaḥ | tāraṃ vadhūṃ ca vedādyaṃ raudre ca rodhramālini || 52 ||
abdhibījaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ ca mantro'yaṃ raudhramālikaḥ | tāraṃ mātrādyamuccārya sūryākhyabīja yugmakam || 53 ||
arkamāle haraṃ nīraṃ mantraḥ sphaṭikaśuddhikṛt |
tāramabdhiramāmāyāḥ sindhuṃ rudrākṣamālini || 54 ||
śuddhā bhava vanaṃ mantro devi rudrākṣaśodhanaḥ | tāraṃ tārātrayaṃ tāraṃ vadhūṃ tulasi vaiṣṇavi || 55 ||
vauṣaḍ vanaṃ mahāmantrastulasīśodhanābhidhaḥ | tāraṃ tārā (k, g, gh: tāraṃ) ca mṛdvīkā maṇimāle manohare || 56 ||
ṭhadvayaṃ mantrarājo'yaṃ maṇimālāviśodhanaḥ | vedādyaṃ kamalā kuntī vāgbījaṃ kāmaśaktikam || 57 ||
suvarṇamāle śaktyāpo mantro'yaṃ svarṇaśodhanaḥ | tāraṃ ca vāyupūjyā ca tāraṃ padmākṣamālini || 58 ||
haritaṃ ṭhadvayaṃ mantro devi padmākṣaśodhanaḥ | tāratrayaṃ mā trayaṃ ca kāmarājatrayaṃ śive || 59 ||
śivaḥ śaktirdantamāle muṇḍamāle ca vāgurā | vadhūrvastraṃ vanaṃ mantro naradantaviśuddhikṛt || 60 ||
pṛthaṅpṛthaṅ mahāmantraiḥ śrīcakrasthāṃ maheśvari | mālāṃ saṃśodhya saṃpūjya mūlaṃ japtvā daśāṃśataḥ || 61 ||
gandhākṣataprasūnaiśca pūjayet kaulikottamaḥ | oṃmāle māle mahāmāle sarvatattvasvarūpiṇi (k: sarvaśakti; g, gh, ṅ: parāśakti) || 62 ||
caturvargastvayi nyastastasmānme siddhidā bhava | svāhānto'yaṃ mahāmantraḥ sarvamālāviśodhanaḥ || 63 ||
śivabījaṃ samuccārya tato'vighnaṃ kuru smaret | me ṭhadvayaṃ mahāmantraḥ sadā (g: sarva) mālāviśodhanaḥ || 64 ||
evaṃ saṃśodhya saṃskṛtya saṃpūjya kulasundari | mālāmādāya deveśi sañjapedardharātrake || 65 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
karamālāstvayā proktā vahvyastāsāṃ ca śodhanam | vada deva kathaṃ kuryāt kaulikaḥ sarvasiddhaye || 66 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
kālī kāmaḥ kṛpā kuntī karamāle haraṃ vanam | mantro'yaṃ karamālāyāḥ śuddhidaḥ (g: kṛt) sarvasiddhidaḥ || 67 ||
ṣaṇmāsenaiva mālānāṃ śodhanaṃ sādhakaścaret | tato japenmahāvidyāṃ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 68 ||
idaṃ tattvaṃ hi tattvānāṃ sarvasvaṃ pāradaivatam | tava bhaktyā mayākhyātaṃ nākhyeyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ || 69 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye mālā tanmantrādiśodhananirūpaṇaṃ caturviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 24 || atha
[pañcaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devadeveśi yantraśodhanamuttamam | vakṣyāmi tava bhaktyāhaṃ kaulikānāṃ hitāya ca || 1 ||
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ sphāṭikaṃ raudhrikaṃ tathā | kāpālikaṃ ca pāśāsaṃ śrīcakraṃ vaiṣṇavāśmikam || 2 ||
eteṣvaṣṭasu divyeṣu yogapīṭheṣu pārvati |
vibhāvayenmahāyantraṃ daivaṃ bhaumaṃ ca bhāvikam || 3 ||
ūrdhvarekhamadhorekhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ gandhacitritam | trividhaṃ yantramīśāni susiddhaṃ (k, kh, g: svasiddhaṃ) siddhasādhyakam || 4 ||
sahasrābhaṃ ca pāśāsaṃ śodhayeduttarāyaṇe | pañcame pañcame devi tataḥ siddhipradaṃ bhavet || 5 ||
śarāṅkuśaṃ vaiṣṇavāśmaṃ śodhayed dakṣiṇāyane | caturthe ca caturthe ca tataḥ siddhimavāpnuyāt || 6 ||
sauvarṇaṃ sphāṭikaṃ yantraṃ varṣānte śodhayet sudhīḥ | rājataṃ tāmrikaṃ yantraṃ ṣaṇmāsānte ca śodhayet || 7 ||
evaṃ mayoktakāleṣu śodhayed yantramīśvari | siddhaye kauliko devi yathāvadvarṇyate mayā || 8 ||
yantraśodhanamantrasya ṛṣiḥ prokto mayā śivaḥ | triṣṭup chanda iti khyātaṃ parāśaktiśca devatā || 9 ||
ramā bījaṃ parā śaktiḥ kāmaḥ kīlakamīśvari (kh: kamucyate) | śrīcakraśuddhisiddhyarthaṃ viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 10 ||
munyādinā carennyāsaṃ karanyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṅgakam | tato viṣṭaraśuddhiṃ ca prāṇārpaṇavidhiṃ caret || 11 ||
iṣṭarṣidevatānyāsaṃ karāṅganyāsamācaret | vidhāya mātṛkānyāsaṃ layāṅganyāsasaṃyutam || 12 ||
ardhanārīśvaranyāsaṃ ṣoḍhānyāsamataḥ param | mūlatrikhaṇḍakaṃ nyāsaṃ kṛtvā prāṇacayaṃ śive || 13 ||
pīṭhapūjāṃ svahṛdaye kṛtvā ṣaṭcakradīpanam | svarṇasiṃhāsane sthāpya śrīcakraṃ sveṣṭadaivatam || 14 ||
śodhayenmadhunā devi kuṇḍagolodbhavena vā |
aṣṭagandhena vā devi pauruṣeṇa rasena vā || 15 ||
ibhyājyena mahādevi saṃsthāpya kulapūjite | śrīcakraṃ mūlamantreṇa pūjayet tatra kaulikaḥ || 16 ||
vāgbhavaṃ śaktibījaṃ vāk śaktiṃ cakreśvari priye | yantraṃ sauvarṇamuddhṛtya śodhaya dvayamuddharet || 17 ||
ṭhadvayaṃ svarṇayantrasya mantraḥ śodhanakārakaḥ | tāraṃ sindhuṃ ca tāraṃ ca rājataṃ yantramuddharet || 18 ||
śodhaya dvayamāpaśca yantraśodhanako manuḥ | tāraṃ tārā ca tāraṃ ca vadhūṃ tāraṃ ca tārakā || 19 ||
tāmreśvarīti yantraṃ me śodhayāpo mahāmanuḥ | vedādyaṃ kamalāṃ māyāṃ tāraṃ yantraṃ kulāmbike || 20 ||
śodhaya dvirvanaṃ mantraḥ sphāṭikāśmaviśodhanaḥ | praṇavaṃ kūvarībījaṃ mā māyā vāyupūjitā || 21 ||
rudreśvari parā yantraṃ śodhayāpo manuḥ smṛtaḥ | tāraṃ vāk kāmarājaśca śaktiḥ kapālamālini || 22 ||
yantraṃ śodhaya ṭhadvandvaṃ kapālaśodhano manuḥ | tāraṃ gaurī ca tārtīyaṃ vāk kāmaśca citāsane || 23 ||
yantraṃ śodhaya ṭhadvandvaṃ manuḥ pāśāsaṃśodhanaḥ | vedādyaṃ haritaṃ vāṇī śaktiḥ kāmo ramā ramā || 24 ||
nitye viṣṇuśilāyantraṃ śodhayāpo manuḥ smṛtaḥ | ityevaṃ yantramīśāni ratnasiṃhāsanasthitam || 25 ||
mūlamantreṇa saṃsnāpya pūrvoktauṣadhavāriṇā | mantrairebhiḥ prajaptaiśca pūjayed gandhamālyakaiḥ (k, g, gh, ṅ: puṣpakaiḥ) || 26 ||
saṃpūjya devi saṃśodhya tataḥ pūjāṃ (gh, g: pūrṇaṃ) śivoditām (g, gh: ditam) |
yathoktāṃ sādhakaḥ kuryād dravyaśodhanapūrvakam || 27 ||
aṣṭāṅgapūjāṃ nirmāya niśīthe japamācaret |
śrībhairavyuvāca |
bhagavan kulakauleśa bhairavāṣṭakamadhyaga | niśīthakālaṃ me brūhi saṃśayo'yaṃ mahān mama || 28 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
ardharātrastu trividho yanmuhūrtacatuṣṭayam | niśītho vārdharātraśca tṛtīyaiva mahāniśā || 29 ||
dvitīye ca tṛtīye ca yāme yāmalabhairavi | muhūrte dve samādāya tathā dve ca maheśvari || 30 ||
dve muhūrte niśīthastu parato dve muhūrtake | ardharātro muhūrte dve pūjārhaḥ parameśvari || 31 ||
muhūrtaikaṃ samādāya parataścaikamīśvari | yāmadvayādardharātro varṇitaḥ kaulasiddhaye || 32 ||
śive madhyamayoḥ sandhiryāmayoryā (g, gh: ndhiḥ pādayoḥ) mahāniśā | tasyāṃ parāṃ japedyastu sa bhavecchivasannibhaḥ || 33 ||
niśīthe pūjayedyantramardharātre japenmanum | mahāniśāyāṃ prajapet parāṃ kaulikasattamaḥ || 34 ||
kiṃ kiṃ na sādhayelloke yanmamāpi hi durlabham | rajaḥ śukraṃ surāṃ devi māṃsaṃ mīnaṃ ca maithunam || 35 ||
sarvathā śodhayed devi mūlamantreṇa māntrikaḥ | pibenmadyaṃ bhajedrāmāṃ smared bhairavibhairavam || 36 ||
namedguruṃ japed vidyāmiti kaulamataṃ param | prātaḥkṛtyaṃ śive kṛtvā śrīcakraṃ pūjayet tataḥ || 37 ||
japenmantrī mahāvidyāṃ stotrapāṭhaṃ caret tataḥ | parāṃ japet sadā satyāṃ tato yāti paraṃ padam || 38 ||
mahāpadi mahotpāte mahāśoke mahāmaye | mahāmohe mahā'saukhye mahādāridryasaṅkaṭe || 39 ||
mahāraṇye mahāśūnye (gh: mahāśaile) mahā'jñāne mahāraṇe | durāpadi durāśe ca durbhikṣe durnimittake || 40 ||
samastakleśasaṅghāte smared devi prāmbikām | vaktre sarasvatī tasya lakṣmīstasya gṛhe sadā (kh: tathā) || 41 ||
dhanyā ca jananī tasya yena devī samarcitā | idaṃ sāraṃ hi tantrāṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ tattvamuttamam | mayoditaṃ tava snehānnākhyeyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ || 42 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde paramārthapradīpikāyāṃ yantraśodhanādividhi japa pūjākālanirūpaṇaṃ pañcaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 25 ||
[samāptamidaṃ pūrvārdham] |
atha
[ṣaḍviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairavyuvāca |
bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa (g, ṅ: bhava) kuladharmaprakāśaka | kuleśa śrotumicchāmi tantrasyāsyottarārdhakam || 1 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devi kauleśi kaulikānāṃ hitecchayā | tantrottarārdhaṃ vakṣyāmi rahasyavijayābhidham || 2 ||
durgādevī parādevī parāśaktiḥ parāmbikā | devadevīti yā khyātā (k: vikhyātā) gāyatrīti śrutau smṛtā || 3 ||
tejomayī mahāśyāmā mahātripurasundarī | pañcātmikā pañcamīśī pañcavyomaprakāśini || 4 ||
ugradurgā parā yā śrīstajjyotiḥ paramaṃ padam | parādevīti yā durgā sā śivaḥ sā hariḥ smṛtā || 5 ||
sā sūryaḥ savitā saiva mahāgaṇapatiḥ smṛtā | pañcamī pañcikā devī pañcamācāravartinī || 6 ||
pañcākṣarīti gāyatrī paramātmeti kīrtyate | pañcakṛtyamayī (k, kh, g: vedya) devī sarvadevīmayī śivā || 7 ||
gaṇeśārkaharīśāna durgārūpā sarasvatī | mahāśyāmā mahāvidyā pūjanīyā yathākramam || 8 ||
na kuryād bhedameteṣāṃ kauliko vaiṣṇavo'thavā | gaṇeśārkaharīśāna durgāṇāṃ paramārthavit || 9 ||
pūjayedaikyabhāvena devībhaktyaiva bhaktimān | devīcakre'rcayet sarvāṃśchivaliṅge'thavā śive || 10 ||
sāligrāmaśilāyāṃ vā sūryapīṭhe'thavā priye | śrīgaṇeśvaracakreṇa ma bhedaṃ kārayed budhaḥ || 11 ||
bhedaṃ vai kurute yastu sa śaivaḥ śivahā bhavet | pṛthak pṛthak śive kuryādarcanaṃ kaulikottamaḥ || 12 ||
gaṇeśasya ca sūryasya viṣṇordevi śivasya ca | śrīdevyā ugradurgāyā mantrī devīrahasyavit (k: vat) || 13 ||
adyāhaṃ tava deveśi premṇā vakṣye kulātmakam | rahasyavijayaṃ nāma tantraṃ tantrottarārdhakam || 14 ||
pañcāṅgabhūtameteṣāṃ (k, kh, g: tattvaṃ) sarvamantrārcanāmayam | gaṇeśasya ca pañcāṅgaṃ pañcāṅgaṃ savitustathā || 15 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyāpi pañcāṅgaṃ śrīśivasya ca | durgādevyāśca pañcāṅgaṃ durgādevīrahasyakam || 16 ||
uttarārdhamiti proktaṃ tantrasyāsya maheśvari | sarvasvametad deveśi tantraṃ devīrahasyakam || 17 ||
avaktavyamabhaktebhyo gopayet kulanāyakaḥ | prathamaṃ devi pañcāṅgaṃ mahāgaṇapateḥ śṛṇu || 18 ||
yena śravaṇamātreṇa vighnanāśo bhavet kṣaṇāt | merupṛṣṭhe sukhāsīnaṃ mahādevaṃ trilocanam || 19 ||
surāsuragaṇairyuktaṃ brahmācyutanamaskṛtam | siddhakinnaragandharvairyakṣabhūtapiśācakaiḥ || 20 ||
toṣitaṃ natibhiḥ stotraiḥ pārvatīsahitaṃ śivam | sasmitaṃ bhāṣamāṇaṃ ca brahmaṇā hariṇā saha || 21 ||
pārvatī praṇatā bhūtvā vacanaṃ samabhāṣata |
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan sarvatattvajña sarvadharmaprakāśaka | kāryasya devatānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || 22 ||
vighnaḥ kena bhaved deva saṃśayaṃ chindi śaṅkara |
śrībhairava uvāca |
devi vakṣye rahasyaṃ te praśnottaramidaṃ mahat | avaktavyamabhaktebhyo bhaktebhyo muktisādhanam || 23 ||
vināyako gaṇādhyakṣo gaṇeśa iti yaḥ prabhuḥ | vighnakartā jagattrātā vighnaharteti viśrutaḥ || 24 ||
tasya bhaktasya devasya martyasyāpi maheśvari | vighno na bādhate jātu (k: tasya) yastaṃ saṃpūjayet sadā || 25 ||
yo japed devi tanmantraṃ kavacaṃ tasya dhārayet | paṭhennāmnāṃ sahasraṃ tu stotraṃ mūlaikasādhanam || 26 ||
vighno na bādhate tasya kāryahānirna vā bhavet |
śrīdevyuvāca |
devadeva mahādeva gaṇeśasya jagatprabho | mantraṃ yantraṃ stavaṃ varma nāmnāṃ sahasramuttamam || 27 ||
pūjāṃ śrotumahaṃ tvatto vāñchāmi parameśvara |
śrībhairava uvāca |
yo devadevo varado gaṇeśo vighnanāyakaḥ | gajānano gaṇādhyakṣo vināyaka iti śrutaḥ || 28 ||
pañcāṅgamakhilaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi tava prītaye | tatrādau te pravakṣyāmi mantroddhāraṃ sureśvari || 29 ||
yantroddhāraṃ layāṅgaṃ ca mahāgaṇapateḥ śive |
atha mantroddhāraḥ(-)
tāraṃ mā sakalā smaro maṭhaśivau nāmno vareti dvayaṃ sarpaḥ sarvamato janaṃ ḍulilate jīmūtaśarmākṣaram | bhekī khaṃ lavaṇaṃ samīrasahitaṃ mantrāñcale ṭhadvayaṃ hyaṣṭāviṃśativarṇako nigadito vaināyako'yaṃ manuḥ || 30 ||
iti mantroddhāraḥ | prakāśam(-) oṃśrīṃhrīṃklīṃglauṃgaṃ gaṇapataye varavarada sarvajanaṃ me vaśamānaya svāhā || (28)
tattvalakṣaṃ savedāṅkaṃ puraścaryā prakīrtitā | vaṭe catuṣpathe śūnyagṛhe pretālaye caret || 31 ||
nāsya (tasya sarvatra pāṭhaḥ) vighno na vāśaucaṃ na vā mantraviparyayaḥ | na kleśo naca durbuddhirna moho naca śokatā || 32 ||
sarvathā siddhamantro'yaṃ mahāgaṇapateḥ śive | yantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvāśāparipūrakam || 33 ||
sarvasaṃmohanaṃ cakraṃ gaṇeśasya jagatprabhoḥ |
atha yantroddhāraḥ(-)
trikoṇaṃ khayuktaṃ daśāraṃ maheśi suvṛttaṃ tathā nāgapatraṃ kalāram | suvṛttaṃ caturdvārayuktaṃ prayuktaṃ gajāsyasya śrīcakrametat prasiddham || 34 ||
atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvasiddhipradāyakam | yena smaraṇamātreṇa sarvo vighnaḥ palāyate || 35 ||
udyatkoṭidivākarāṃśusadṛśaṃ tryakṣaṃ kirīṭojjvalaṃ pātraṃ modakapūrṇamīḍyakalaśaṃ padmākṣasūtraṃ bhujaiḥ | bibhrāṇaṃ śucināgasambhavalasatkāyaṃ bhujaṅgojjvalaṃ dhyāyet siṃhayugāsanaṃ gaṇapatiṃ trailokyacintāmaṇim || 36 ||
gāmityādikaranyāsaṃ hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgakam | ṣaḍvargabījabhāgena kalyanyāsaṃ caret tataḥ || 37 ||
layāṅgamadhunā vakṣye (ṅ: layāṅgamadya vakṣyehaṃ) yantrasya parameśvari | pūjanaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitaṃ śarajanmanā || 38 ||
indradharmeśavaruṇāḥ kuberasahitāstathā | pūrvapaścimayoḥ pūjyā dakṣiṇottarayostathā || 39 ||
iti dvārapālāḥ |
nandivīreśasaubhāgya bhṛṅgirīṭivirāṭakāḥ | puṣpadantavikartāntya cittalohitasundarāḥ || 40 ||
nūpurāḍhyavicārograrūpa suptavinartakāḥ | gaṇāḥ ṣoḍaśa saṃpūjyāḥ ṣoḍaśāreṣu sundari || 41 ||
karālaṃ vikarālaṃ ca saṃhāraṃ rurumeva ca | mahākālaṃ ca kālāgniṃ sitāsyamasitātmakam || 42 ||
aṣṭapatreṣu deveśi pūjayedaṣṭa bhairavān | vināyakaṃ vighnarājaṃ gaṇādhyakṣaṃ gajānanam || 43 ||
herambaṃ modakāhāraṃ dvaimāturamarindamam | ekadantaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ daśāreṣu prapūjayet || 44 ||
kumāraṃ ca jayantaṃ ca pradyumnaṃ surasundari | trikoṇe pūjayedbindau mahāgaṇapatiṃ prabhum || 45 ||
gaṇeśaṃ caiva gāṅgeyaṃ siṃhāsanamataḥ param | vighnāntakākhuvāhau ca tripurāntakamīśvari || 46 ||
uparyupari saṃpūjya pūjayedāyudhāṃstataḥ | śatapatraṃ sahasrāraṃ dantamālāṃ maheśvari || 47 ||
modakāṅkitapātraṃ ca kalaśaṃ paraśuṃ tataḥ |
śaṅkhau saṃpūjayedbindau layāṅgamidamucyate || 48 ||
mantrasyāsya gaṇeśasya ṛṣirbrahmā prakīrtitaḥ | gāyatryaṃ chanda ityuktaṃ devo gaṇapatiḥ smṛtaḥ || 49 ||
śivabījaṃ ca bījaṃ syānmāyāśaktirudāhṛtā | kurudvayaṃ kīlakaṃ syāt sarvamantraikasādhanam || 50 ||
trailokyavijaye devi viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | ayutaṃ ca japenmūlaṃ hutvā sarpiryavāṅkuram || 51 ||
mohayet parameśāni mārayed ripumaṇḍalam | ayutaṃ ca japenmūlaṃ vaṭe hutvā citānale || 52 ||
stambhayedakhilāṃllokān vādidasyubalāni ca | nadyāṃ sādhaka evāśu japedayutasaṃkhyayā || 53 ||
juhuyādibhaviṇmāṃsaṃ ripumuccāṭayed dhruvam | vidveṣayecca brahmāṇaṃ girije nātra saṃśayaḥ || 54 ||
vane nimbarasaṃ hutvā japtvā mūlamathāyutam | vaśayedapi rājānamākarṣayati yoṣitaḥ || 55 ||
itīdaṃ paṭalaṃ guptaṃ mahāgaṇapateḥ śive | sarvatantraikasarvasvaṃ gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 56 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye mahāgaṇapati(paṭala)mantroddhāranirūpaṇaṃ ṣaḍviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 26 ||
atha
[saptaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adyāhaṃ paddhatiṃ vakṣye mahāgaṇapateḥ parām | gadyaikasārasarvasvāmānandaikataraṅgiṇīm || 1 ||
sādhako rātriśeṣe samutthāya padmāsanaṃ baddhvā mūlena trirācamya svaśirasi sahasrārapadmakesarojjvalakarṇikāntargataṃ nijaguruṃ śuklālaṅkāraṃ dhyātvā natvā tacchāsanāmādāya bahirāgatya malotsargaśodhanaṃ (g: malāpaśodhanaṃ) vidhāya varṇoktaṃ (k, g: śākhāvarṇo) śaucaṃ kṛtvā nadyādau gatvā vāhlīkabījena dantān viśodhya śivabījena gaṇḍūṣāṇi kṛtvā śrīṃhrīṃklīṃ iti malāpakarṣaṇaṃ snānaṃ vidhāya mūlenāṅkuśamudrayā tatra trikoṇaṃ vilikhya gaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati | narmade sindhukāveri jale'smin sannidhiṃ kuru || iti tatra tīrthamāvāhya devaṃ saśivaṃ (saśaktiṃ) mūlenāvāhya mūlena mukhaṃ triḥ prokṣya trirātmānaṃ payasi pronmajjya hṛīṃhaṃsaḥ śrīsūryāya eṣa te'rgho namaḥ ityarkāyārghyatrayaṃ dattvā jalādavaruhya vaidikīṃ sandhyāṃ nirvartya tāntrikīṃ kuryāt | tato vāmakare jalaṃ dhṛtvā varmaṇāvaguṇṭhya mūlena saptadhābhimantrya tadgalitodakabindubhiḥ svaśiraḥ saptadhā prokṣya tajjalamiḍayāntarnītvā vāmanāsayā viricya suṣumnāmārgeṇa dakṣahaste niḥkṣipya astrāya phaḍiti mantreṇa vāmabhāgasthaśilāyāmāsphālayet ityaghamarṣaṇaṃ vidhāyācamya prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caret | yathā pūrakaḥ (16) kumbhakaḥ (32) recakaḥ (64) evaṃ vidhāya gāyatrīṃ trirjapet | oṃhrīṃ vakratuṇḍāya vidmahe śrīṃklīṃ ekadantāya dhīmahi glauṃgaṃ gaṇapatistannaḥ pracodayāt (3) iti yathāśaktyā japtvā gāyatryā devīdevayorarghyatrayaṃ dattvā mūlaṃ samastabhuvanāntarāyaharaṇaṃ haraputraṃ gaṇagandharvasiddhavanditaṃ prakaṭavikaṭāmnāyaparāpararūpaṃ gaṇādhyakṣaṃ gajānanaṃ mahāgaṇapatiṃ varadagaṇeśaṃ
tarpayāmi namaḥ iti dviḥ santarpya mūlaṃ divyaughasiddhaughamānavaughapaṅktigatān gurūṃstarpayāmi namaḥ | mūlenaikaikāñjalinā parivārān santarpya saṃhāramudrayā manasā devīdevau visṛjya yāgamaṇḍapamāgacchediti sandhyāvidhiḥ || yāgamaṇḍapametya hrīṃśrīṃklīṃ gaṃ gaṅgāyai namaḥ pūrve | (3/) yaṃ yamunāyai namaḥ uttare | (3/) saṃ sarasvatyai namo dakṣiṇe | (3/) yāṃ yoginībhyo namaḥ paścime | (3/) kṣāṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ madhye | iti dvāradevatāḥ saṃpūjya gṛhāntaḥ praviśya (3/) āṃ āsanaśodhanamantrasya merupṛṣṭha ṛṣiḥ sutalaṃ chandaḥ kūrmo devatā āsanamantraṇe viniyogaḥ | aiṃ pṛthivyai namaḥ aṃ anantāya namaḥ vaṃ vasundharāyai namaḥ | mūlaṃ pṛthvi tvayā dhṛtā lokā devi tvaṃ viṣṇunā dhṛtā | tvaṃ ca dhāraya māṃ devi pavitraṃ kuru cāsanam || iti dhyānam | oṃhrīṃśrīṃklīṃ padmāsanāya namaḥ | (4/) siṃhāsanāya namaḥ | (4/) bhadrāsanāya namaḥ | (4/) apasarpantu te bhūtā ye bhūtā bhūmisaṃsthitāḥ | ye bhūtā vighnakartāraste naśyantu śivājñayā || iti tālatrayaṃ dattvā nārācamudrāṃ pradarśya guruṃ dhyāyet | ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā | cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || iti guruṃ dhyātvācamet | glauṃ ātmatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā | (1/) vidyātattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā | (1/) śivatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā | ityācamya pūrvoktaṃ prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ vidhāya bhūtaśuddhiṃ kuryāt | hrīṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ dhyātvā śrīṃ suṣumnāvartmanā vāyuṃ prokṣya klīṃ tatrādhiṣṭhānamānīya svaśarīraṃ bhasmībhūtaṃ vicintya yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃ brahmapathāntarjīvātmānaṃ vicintya tatra haṃkṣaṃ sudhāmānīya toyāt svātmānaṃ saṃplāvya vigatakalmaṣaṃ dehaṃ vibhāvya svasthānaṃ jīvamānīya prāṇān pratiṣṭhāpayediti bhūtaśuddhiḥ || āṃhrīṃkroṃ yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃ śaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃ sohaṃsaḥ haṃsaḥ mama prāṇāḥ iha prāṇāḥ (16/) mama jīva iha sthitaḥ (16/) mama sarvendriyāṇi vāṅmanaścakṣuḥśrotrajihvāghrāṇaprāṇā ihaivāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu svāhā iti prāṇapratiṣṭhākramaḥ | tataḥ punarācamya prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya nyāsapūrvakaṃ saṅkalpaṃ caret |
asya śrīvaradagaṇeśamantrasya śrībrahmā ṛṣiḥ gāyatraṃ chandaḥ śrīmahāgaṇapatirdevatā gaṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ kuru kuru kīlakaṃ śrīmahāgaṇapatiprītyarthe trailokyavijaye jape viniyogaḥ | brahmaṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi
gāyatrīcchandase namo mukhe śrīmahāgaṇapatidevatāyai namo hṛdi gaṃ bījāya namo nābhau hrīṃ śaktaye namo guhye kuru kuru kīlakāya namaḥ pādayoḥ trailokyavijaye viniyogāya namaḥ sarvāṅgeṣu iti ṛṣyādinyāsaḥ | gāṃ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ hṛdayāya namaḥ | gīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ śirase svāhā | gūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | gaiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ kavacāya huṃ | gauṃ kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ netrebhyo vauṣaṭ | gaḥ karatalapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ astrāya phaṭ | iti karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ || oṃātmatattvaṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | oṃvidyātattvaṃ śirase svāhā | oṃśivatattvaṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | oṃgurutattvaṃ kavacāya huṃ | oṃyogatattvaṃ netrebhyo vauṣaṭ | oṃsarvatattvamastrāya phaṭ | iti tattvanyāsaḥ || oṃaṃkaṃkhaṃgaṃghaṃṅaṃāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ iṃcaṃchaṃjaṃjhaṃñaṃīṃ śirase svāhā uṃṭaṃṭhaṃḍaṃḍhaṃṇaṃūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ eṃtaṃthaṃdaṃdhaṃnaṃaiṃ kavacāya huṃ oṃpaṃphaṃbaṃbhaṃmaṃauṃ netrebhyo vauṣaṭ aṃyaṃraṃlaṃvaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃlaṃkṣaṃaḥ astrāya phaṭ | evaṃ karanyāsaḥ | iti kalpanyāsaḥ || oṃgaṃ kāśīpīṭhāya namo hṛdaye oṃgaṃ kāñcīpīṭhāya namaḥ śirasi oṃgaṃ madhupurīpīṭhāya namaḥ śikhāyāṃ | oṃgaṃ uḍḍīyānapīṭhāya namaḥ kavace | oṃgaṃ ayodhyāpīṭhāya namo netrayoḥ | oṃgaṃ jālandharapīṭhāya namaḥ astre iti pīṭhanyāsaḥ || oṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | hrīṃ gaṇapataye śirase svāhā | śrīṃ varavarada śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | klīṃ sarvajanaṃ me kavacāya huṃ | glauṃ vaśamānaya netrebhyo vauṣaṭ | gaṃ svāhā astrāya phaṭ | evaṃ karanyāsaḥ iti mantranyāsaḥ || evaṃ nyāsaṃ vidhāya śrīcakraṃ dhyātvā caturaśraṃ ṣoḍaśadalaṃ vasudalaṃ daśāraṃ trikoṇaṃ binduṃ vicintya bhadrapīṭhopari mūlena saṃsthāpya yogapīṭhapūjāṃ kuryāt | hrīṃ
