namaḥ śrīmahāgaṇapatipātrāsanāya namaḥ iti gandhākṣaterabhyarcya tadupari pātraṃ saṃsthāpya oṃ sūryamaṇḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ śrīmahāgaṇapatyarghyapātrāya namaḥ tato mūlenāpūrya oṃ candramaṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ gaṇapatipātrāya namaḥ iti gandhākṣatairabhyarcya tato'ṅkuśamudrayā gaṅge ca yamune tāpe godāvari sarasvati | narmade sindhukāveri jale'smin sannidhiṃ kuru || iti tīrthamāvāhya mūlenāṣṭadhābhimantrya ṣaḍaṅgaiḥ saṃpūjya matsyamudrayācchādya phaḍiti choṭikābhiḥ saṃrakṣya humityaṃvaguṇṭhya vamityamṛtīkṛtya śaṅkhacakramusalayonimudrāḥ pradarśya tenaiva jalena yāgavastūni prokṣayet | mūlaṃ oṃhrīṃ paramāmṛtarūpeṇa mahāgaṇapaticandramaṇḍalanivāsāya candrāmṛtena pūraya pūraya dravyaṃ pavitrīkuru (2) oṃhrauṃ juṃsaḥ svāhā | anena sarvaṃ prokṣayet | taduttare pādyācamanīyamadhuparkapātrāṇi saṃsthāpya saṃpūjyātmānaṃ tanmayaṃ vibhāvya oṃ namo bhagavate sakalaguṇātmaśaktiyuktāya yogapīṭhātmane'nantāya namaḥ iti saṃpūjya saśaktikaṃ devaṃ mūlenāvāhya mūlena navamudrāḥ pradarśya mūlaṣaḍaṅgaṃ vidhāya prāṇān pratiṣṭhāpya svāgatamityudīrya mūlena pādyārghye dadyāt | evaṃ pādyārghyācamanīyamadhuparkasnānādi vidhāya mātṛkākṣarairabhyarcya tairdhūpadīpanaivedyācamanīyādīn nivedya
puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ dattvā devasyāvaraṇadevatāḥ pūjayet | oṃhrīṃśrīṃ sarvāśāpūrakacakrāya namaḥ iti puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā oṃhrīṃśrīṃ indrāya namaḥ pūrve | (3/) varuṇāya namaḥ paścime | (3/) dharmarājāya namo dakṣiṇe | (3/) kuberāya namaḥ uttare | iti caturaśraṃ gandhākṣatairabhyarcya prathamāvaraṇam || mūlena puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā oṃhrīṃśrīṃ nandine namaḥ | (3/) vīreśāya namaḥ | (3/) saubhāgyāya namaḥ | (3/) bhṛṅgirīṭine namaḥ | (3/) virāṭakāya namaḥ | (3/) puṣpadantāya namaḥ | (3/) vikartāya namaḥ | (3/) antyagaṇāya namaḥ | (3/) cittagaṇāya namaḥ | (3/) lohitāya namaḥ | (3/) sundarāya namaḥ | (3/) nūpurāḍhyāya namaḥ | (3/) vicārāya namaḥ | (3/) ugrarūpāya namaḥ | (3/) suptāya namaḥ | (3/) vinartakāya namaḥ | iti ṣoḍaśāraṃ gandhākṣatairdakṣiṇāvartenābhyarcya dvitīyāvaraṇam || mūlena puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā oṃhrīṃśrīṃ karālāya namaḥ (3/) vikarālāya namaḥ (3/) saṃhārāya(0) | (3/) rurave(0) | (3/) mahākālāya(0) | (3/) kālāgnaye(0) | (3/) sitāsyāya(0) | (3/) asitātmane namaḥ | iti vasudalaṃ gandhākṣatadūrvābhirdakṣiṇāvartenābhyarcayediti tṛtīyāvaraṇam || mūlena puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā oṃhrīṃśrīṃ vināyakāya namaḥ | (3/) vighnarājāya namaḥ | (3/) gaṇādhyakṣāya(0) | (3/) gajānanāya(0) | (3/) herambāya(0) | (3/) modakāhārāya(0) | (3/) dvaimāturāya(0) | (3/) arindamāya(0) | (3/) ekadantāya(0) | (3/) vakratuṇḍāya namaḥ | iti gandhākṣatadūrvābhirdakṣāvartena daśāramabhyarcayediti caturthāvaraṇam || mūlena puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā (3/) kumārāya namaḥ agre | (3/) jayantāya(0) dakṣe | (3/) pradyumnāya(0) vāme | iti gandhākṣatadūrvābhiḥ trikoṇamabhyarcayediti pañcamāvaraṇam || mūlena puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā mūlavidyāmuccārya hrīṃ svaśaktisahitāya mahāgaṇapataye namaḥ iti saptadhā binduṃ saṃpūjayediti (g: jyeti) ṣaṣṭhāvaraṇam || mū(0) hrīṃ gaṇeśāya namaḥ | hrīṃ gāṅgeyāya namaḥ | hrīṃ siṃhāsanāya namaḥ | hrīṃ vighnāntakāya namaḥ | hrīṃ ākhuvāhāya namaḥ | hrīṃ tripurāntakāya namaḥ | ityupari gandhākṣatadūrvābhirabhyarcayediti saptamāvaraṇam || upari mūlaṃ(0) hrīṃ śatapatrāya namaḥ hrīṃ sahasrārāya namaḥ hrīṃ dantamālāyai namaḥ hrīṃ modakapātrāya namaḥ hrīṃ sudhākalaśāya namaḥ hrīṃ paraśave namaḥ hrīṃ
śaṅkhāya namaḥ hrīṃ pāñcajanyāya namaḥ iti darśanenāpi śaṅkhasya kiṃ punaḥ sparśanena ca | vilayaṃ yānti pāpāni himavadbhāskarodaye || iti saptadhā saṃpūjayedityaṣṭamāvaraṇam || mūlamuccārya gandhākṣatadūrvāpuṣpa saṃkalpapūrvaṃ ṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ vidhāya devaṃ dhyātvā mūlena mālāmabhyarcya yathāśaktyā mūlaṃ japet | tato mūlamuccārya devāya japaṃ samarpya kavacasahasranāmastavarājapāṭhaṃ devāgre kṛtvā mūlaṃ prātaḥprabhṛti sāyāntaṃ sāyādiprātarantataḥ | yatkaromi gaṇādhyakṣa tadastu tava pūjanam || iti natvā saṃhāramudrayā saśaktikaṃ devaṃ visarjayet ||
iti śrīnityapūjāyāḥ paddhatiṃ gadyarūpiṇīm | mahāgaṇapaterdivyāṃ sarvathā devi gopayet || 1 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye varadagaṇeśapūjāpaddhatinirūpaṇaṃ saptaviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 27 || atha
[aṣṭāviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
mahādevi gaṇeśasya varadasya mahātmanaḥ | kavacaṃ te pravakṣyāmi vajrapañjarakābhidham || 1 ||
asya śrīmahāgaṇapativajrapañjarakavacasya śrībhairava ṛṣiḥ gāyatryaṃ chandaḥ śrīmahāgaṇapatirdevatā gaṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ kurukuru kīlakaṃ vajravidyādisiddhyarthe mahāgaṇapativajrapañjarakavacapāṭhe viniyogaḥ | gāmityādinā ṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ vidhāya dhyāyet | dhyānam(-)
vighneśaṃ viśvavandyaṃ suvipulayaśasaṃ lokarakṣāpradakṣaṃ sākṣāt sarvāpadāsu praśamanasumatiṃ pārvatīprāṇasūnum | prāyaḥ sarvāsurendraiḥ sasuramunigaṇaiḥ sādhakaiḥ pūjyamānaṃ kāruṇyenāntarāyāmitabhayaśamanaṃ vighnarājaṃ namāmi || 2 ||
oṃśrīṃhrīṃgaṃ śiraḥ pātu mahāgaṇapatiḥ prabhuḥ | vināyako lalāṭaṃ me vighnarājo bhruvau mama || 3 ||
pātu netre gaṇādhyakṣo nāsikāṃ me gajānanaḥ | śrutī me'vatu herambo gaṇḍau me modakāśanaḥ || 4 ||
dvaimāturo mukhaṃ pātu cādharau pātvarindamaḥ | dantān mamaikadanto'vyād vakratuṇḍao'vatād rasām || 5 ||
gāṅgeyo me galaṃ pātu skandhau siṃhāsano'vatu | vighnāntako bhujau pātu hastau mūṣakavāhanaḥ || 6 ||
ūrū mamāvatānnityaṃ devastripuraghātanaḥ | hṛdayaṃ me kumāro'vyājjayantaḥ pārśvayugmakam || 7 ||
pradyumno me'vatāt pṛṣṭhaṃ nābhiṃ śaṅkaranandanaḥ | kaṭiṃ nandigaṇaḥ pātu śiśnaṃ vīreśvaro'vatu || 8 ||
meḍhre me'vatu saubhāgyo bhṛṅgirīṭī ca guhyakam | virāṭako'vatādūrū jānū me puṣpadantakaḥ || 9 ||
jaṅghe mama vikarto'vyād gulphāvantyagaṇo'vatu | pādau cittagaṇaḥ pātu pādādho lohito'vatu || 10 ||
pādapṛṣṭhaṃ sundaro'vyād nūpurāḍhyo vapurmama | vicāro jaṭharaṃ pātu bhūtāni cograrūpakaḥ || 11 ||
śirasaḥ pādaparyantaṃ vapuḥ suptagaṇo'vatu | pādādimūrdhaparyantaṃ vapuḥ pātu vinartakaḥ || 12 ||
vismāritaṃ tu yat sthānaṃ gaṇeśastat sadāvatu |
pūrve māṃ hrīṃ karālo'vyādāgneye vikarālakaḥ || 13 ||
dakṣiṇe pātu saṃhāro nair(-)ṛte rurubhairavaḥ | paścime māṃ māhākālo vāyau kālāgnibhairavaḥ || 14 ||
uttare māṃ sitāsyo'vyādaiśānyāmasitātmakaḥ | prabhāte śatapatro'vyāt sahasrārastu madhyame || 15 ||
dantamālā dinānte'vyānniśi pātraṃ sadāvatu | kalaśo māṃ niśīthe'vyānniśānte paraśustathā || 16 ||
sarvatra sarvadā pātu śaṅkhayugmaṃ ca madvapuḥ | oṃoṃ rājakule hahauṃ raṇabhaye hrīṃhrīṃ kudyūte'vatāt śrīṃśrīṃ śatrugṛhe śaśauṃ jalabhaye klīṃklīṃ vanānte'vatu | glauṃglūṃglaiṃglaṃguṃ sattvabhītiṣu mahāvyādhyārtiṣu glauṃgagauṃ nityaṃ yakṣapiśācabhūtaphaṇiṣu glauṃgaṃ gaṇeśo'vatu || 17 ||
itīdaṃ kavacaṃ guhyaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitam | vajrapañjaranāmānaṃ gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥ || 18 ||
aṅgabhūtaṃ manumayaṃ sarvācāraikasādhanam | vinānena na siddhiḥ syāt pūjanasya japasya ca || 19 ||
tasmāt tu kavacaṃ puṇyaṃ paṭhedvā dhārayet sadā | tasya siddhirmahādevi karasthā pāralaukikī || 20 ||
yaṃyaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃtaṃ prāpnoti pāṭhataḥ | ardharātre paṭhennityaṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalaṃ labhet || 21 ||
iti guhyaṃ sukavacaṃ mahāgaṇapateḥ priyam | sarvasiddhimayaṃ divyaṃ (ṅ: pūjya) gopayet parameśvari || 22 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye mahāgaṇapatikavacanirūpaṇamaṣṭāviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 28 ||
atha
[ekonatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
śṛṇu devi rahasyaṃ me yatpurā sūcitaṃ mayā | tava bhaktyā gaṇeśasya vakṣye nāmasahasrakam || 1 ||
śrīdevī |
bhagavan gaṇanāthasya varadasya mahātmanaḥ | śrotuṃ nāmasahasraṃ me hṛdayaṃ protsukāyate || 2 ||
śrībhairavaḥ |
prāṅ me tripuranāśe tu jātā vighnakulāḥ śive | mohena muhyate cetaste sarve baladarpitāḥ || 3 ||
tadā prabhuṃ gaṇādhyakṣaṃ stutvā nāmasahasrakaiḥ | vighnā dūrāt palāyanta kālarudrādiva prajāḥ || 4 ||
tasyānugrahato devi jāto'haṃ tripurāntakaḥ | tamadyāpi gaṇeśānaṃ staumi nāmasahasrakaiḥ || 5 ||
tamadya tava bhaktyāhaṃ sādhakānāṃ hitāya ca | mahāgaṇapatervakṣye divyaṃ nāmasahasrakam || 6 ||
(pāṭhakānāṃ ca dātṝṇāṃ sukhasaṃpatpradāyakam | duḥkhāpahaṃ ca śrotṝṇāṃ mantranāmasahasrakam) || 7 ||
asya śrīvaradagaṇeśasahasranāmastotramantrasya śrībhairava ṛṣiḥ gāyatryaṃ chandaḥ śrīmahāgaṇapatirdevatā gaṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ kuru (2) kīlakaṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe sahasranāmastavapāṭhe viniyogaḥ | pūrvavad dhyānam(-)
oṃhrīṃśrīṃklīṃ gaṇādhyakṣo glauṃgaṃ gaṇapatirguṇī | guṇādyo nirguṇo goptā gajavaktro vibhāvasuḥ || 8 ||
viśveśvaro vibhādīpto dīpano dhīvaro dhanī | sadāśānto jagattāto (kh: jagattrātā) viśvakseno vibhākaraḥ || 9 ||
visrambhī vijayī vaidyo vārāṃnidhiranuttamaḥ | aṇīyān vibhavī śreṣṭho jyeṣṭho gāthāpriyo guruḥ || 10 ||
sṛṣṭikartā jagaddhartā viśvabhartā jagannidhiḥ | patiḥ pītavibhūṣāṅgo raktākṣo lohitāmbaraḥ || 11 ||
virūpākṣo vimānastho vinayaḥ sanayaḥ sukhī | surūpaḥ sāttvikaḥ satyaḥ śuddhaḥ śaṅkaranandanaḥ || 12 ||
nandīśvaro sadānandī (k, kh: jayānandī) vandistutyo vicakṣaṇaḥ | daityamardī madākṣībo madirāruṇalocanaḥ || 13 ||
sārātmā viśvasāraśca viśvacārī vilepanaḥ | paraṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ sākṣī tryakṣo vikatthanaḥ || 14 ||
vīreśvaro vīrahartā saubhāgyo bhāgyavardhanaḥ | bhṛṅgirīṭī bhṛṅgamālī bhṛṅgakūjitanāditaḥ || 15 ||
vinartako vinetāpi vinatānandano'rcitaḥ | vainateyo vinamrāṅgo viśvanetā vināyakaḥ || 16 ||
virāṭako virāṭaśca vidagdho vidhirātmabhūḥ | puṣpadantaḥ puṣpahārī puṣpamālāvibhūṣaṇaḥ || 17 ||
puṣpeṣurmathanaḥ puṣṭo vikartā kartarīkaraḥ | antyo'ntakaścittagaṇaścittacintāpahārakaḥ || 18 ||
acintyo'cintyarūpaśca candanākulamuṇḍakaḥ | lipito lohito lupto (100) lohitākṣo vilobhakaḥ || 19 ||
lubdhāśayo lobharato lābhado'laṅghyagātrakaḥ | sundaraḥ sundarīputraḥ samastāsuraghātanaḥ || 20 ||
nūpurāḍhyo vibhavado naro nārāyaṇo raviḥ | vicārī vāntado vāgmī vitarkī vijayeśvaraḥ || 21 ||
supto buddhaḥ sadārūpaḥ sukhadaḥ sukhasevitaḥ | vikartano viyaccārī vinaṭo nartako naṭaḥ || 22 ||
nāṭyo nāṭyapriyo nādo'nanto'nantaguṇātmakaḥ | viśvamūrviśvaghātī ca vinatāsyo vinartakaḥ || 23 ||
karālaḥ kāmadaḥ kāntaḥ kamanīyaḥ kalādharaḥ (k, kh, g: nidhiḥ) | kāruṇyarūpaḥ kuṭilaḥ kulācārī kuleśvaraḥ || 24 ||
vikarālo gaṇaśreṣṭhaḥ (ṅ: raṇa) saṃhāro hārabhūṣaṇaḥ | rurū ramyamukho rakto revatīdayito rasaḥ || 25 ||
mahākālo mahādaṃṣṭro mahoragabhayāpahaḥ | unmattarūpaḥ kālāgniragnisūryendulocanaḥ || 26 ||
sitāsyaḥ sitamālyaśca sitadandaḥ sitāṃśumān | asitātmā bhairaveśo bhāgyavān bhagavān bhagaḥ || 27 ||
bhargātmajo bhagāvāso bhagado bhagavardhanaḥ | śubhaṅkaraḥ śuciḥ śāntaḥ śreṣyaḥ śravyaḥ śacīpatiḥ || 28 ||
vedādyo vedakartā ca vedavedyaḥ sanātanaḥ | vidyāprado vedasāro vaidiko vedapāragaḥ || 29 ||
vedadhvanirato vīro varo vedāgamārthavit (idaṃ nāmatrayam) | tattvajñaḥ sarvagaḥ sādhuḥ sadayaḥ (sanmayāyeti nāmacchedaḥ) sad (200) asanmayaḥ || 30 ||
nirāmayo nirākāro nirbhayo nityarūpabhṛt |
nirvairo vairividhvaṃsī mattavāraṇasannibhaḥ || 31 ||
śivaṅkaraḥ śivasutaḥ śivaḥ sukhavivardhanaḥ (k, kh, ṅ: śivānandavivardhanaḥ) | śvaityaḥ śvetaḥ śatamukho mugdho modakabhojanaḥ || 32 ||
devadevo dinakaro dhṛtimān dyutimān dhavaḥ | śuddhātmā śuddhamatimāñchuddhadīptiḥ śucivrataḥ || 33 ||
śaraṇyaḥ śaunakaḥ śūraḥ śaradambhojadhārakaḥ | dārakaḥ śikhivāheṣṭaḥ śītaḥ śaṅkaravallabhaḥ || 34 ||
śaṅkaro nirbhavo (k, kh: nirbhayaḥ) nityo layakṛllāsyatatparaḥ | lūto līlārasollāsī vilāsī vibhramo bhramaḥ || 45 ||
bhramaṇaḥ śaśabhṛt sūryaḥ śanirdharaṇinandanaḥ | buddho vibudhasevyaśca budharājo balandharaḥ || 36 ||
jīvo jīvaprado jaitraḥ stutyo nutyo natipriyaḥ | janako jinamārgajño jainamārganivartakaḥ || 37 ||
gaurīsuto gururavo gaurāṅgo gajapūjitaḥ | paraṃ padaṃ paraṃ dhāma paramātmā kaviḥ kujaḥ || 38 ||
rāhurdaityaśiraśchedī ketuḥ kanakakuṇḍalaḥ | grahendro grāhito grāhyo'graṇīrghurghuranāditaḥ || 39 ||
parjanyaḥ pīvaro potrī pīnavakṣāḥ parārjitaḥ | vanecaro vanapatirvanavāsaḥ smaropamaḥ || 40 ||
puṇyaṃ pūtaḥ pavitraṃ ca parātmā pūrṇavigrahaḥ | pūrṇenduśakalākāro manyuḥ (k, kh: manuḥ) pūrṇamanorathaḥ || 41 ||
yugātmā yugabhṛd (k, g, ṅ: yoga) yajvā (300) yājñiko yañavatsalaḥ | yaśasvī yajamāneṣṭo vajrabhṛd vajrapañjaraḥ || 42 ||
maṇibhadro (k, kh, g: maṇiprabhaḥ) maṇimayo mānyo mīnadhvajāśritaḥ | mīnadhvajo manohārī yogināṃ yogavardhanaḥ || 43 ||
draṣṭā sraṣṭā tapasvī ca vigrahī tāpasapriyaḥ | tapomayastapomūrtistapanaśca tapodhanaḥ || 44 ||
rucako mocako ruṣṭastuṣṭastomaradhārakaḥ | daṇḍī caṇḍāṃśuravyaktaḥ kamaṇḍaludharo'naghaḥ || 45 ||
kāmī karmarataḥ kālaḥ kolaḥ kranditadiktaṭaḥ | bhrāmako jātipūjyaśca jāḍyahā jaḍasūdanaḥ || 46 ||
jālandharo jagadvāsī hāsakṛd havano haviḥ | haviṣmān havyavāhākṣo hāṭako hāṭakāṅgadaḥ || 47 ||
sumerurhimavān hotā haraputro halaṅkaṣaḥ | hālāpriyo hṛdāśāntaḥ kāntāhṛdayapoṣaṇaḥ || 48 ||
śoṣaṇaḥ kleśahā krūraḥ kaṭhoraḥ kaṭhinākṛtiḥ | kūvaro dhīmayo dhyātā dhyeyo dhīmān dayānidhiḥ || 49 ||
daviṣṭho damano dyustho dātā trātā sitaḥ samaḥ | nirgato naigamī gamyo nirjeyo jaṭilo'jaraḥ || 50 ||
janajīvo jitārātirjagadvyāpī jaganmayaḥ | cāmīkaranibho'nādyo (ṅ: nābhyaḥ) nalināyatalocanaḥ || 51 ||
rocano mocano mantrī mantrakoṭisamāśritaḥ | pañcabhūtātmakaḥ pañcasāyakaḥ pañcavaktakaḥ || 52 ||
pañcamaḥ paścimaḥ pūrvaḥ (400) pūrṇaḥ kīrṇālakaḥ kuṇiḥ | kaṭhorahṛdayo grīvālaṅkṛto lalitāśayaḥ || 53 ||
lolacitto bṛhannāso māsapakṣarturūpavān (idaṃ nāmatrayam) | dhruvo drutagatirdharmyo dharmī nākipriyo'nalaḥ || 54 ||
agastyo grastabhuvano bhuvanaikamalāpahaḥ | sāgaraḥ svargatiḥ svakṣaḥ sānandaḥ sādhupūjitaḥ || 55 ||
satīpatiḥ samarasaḥ sanakaḥ saralaḥ suraḥ | surāpriyo vasupatirvāsavo vasupūjitaḥ || 56 ||
vittado vittanāthaśca dhanināṃ dhanadāyakaḥ | rājī rājīvanayanaḥ smṛtidaḥ kṛttikāmbaraḥ || 57 ||
āśvino'śvamukhaḥ śubhro bharaṇo bharaṇīpriyaḥ | kṛttikāsanagaḥ kolo rohī rahaṇapādukaḥ || 58 ||
ṛbhuveṣṭo'rimardī ca rohiṇīmohano'mṛtam | mṛgarājo mṛgaśirā mādhavo madhuradhvaniḥ || 59 ||
ārdrānano mahābuddhirmahoragavibhūṣaṇaḥ | bhrūkṣepadattavibhavo bhrūkarālaḥ punarmayaḥ || 60 ||
punardevaḥ punarjetā punarjīvaḥ punarvasuḥ | tittiristimiketuśca timicārakaghātanaḥ || 61 ||
tiṣyastulādharo jambhyo viśleṣo'śleṣa eṇarāṭ | mānado mādhavo māgho vācālo maghavopamaḥ || 62 ||
medhyo maghāpriyo megho mahāmuṇḍo mahābhujaḥ | pūrvaphālgunikaḥ sphītaḥ phalguruttaraphālgunaḥ || 63 ||
phenilo brahmado brahmā saptatantusamāśrayaḥ | ghoṇāhastaścaturhasto hastivaktro halāyudhaḥ || 64 ||
citrāmbaro (500)'rcitapadaḥ svāditaḥ svātivigrahaḥ | viśākhaḥ śikhisevyaśca śikhidhvajasahodaraḥ || 65 ||
aṇū reṇuḥ kalāsphāro'nūrū reṇusuto naraḥ | anūrādhāpriyo rādhyaḥ śrīmāñchuklaḥ śucismitaḥ || 66 ||
jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhārcitapado mūlaṃ trijagato guruḥ |
śuciḥ pūrvastathāṣāḍhaścottarāṣāḍha īśvaraḥ || 67 ||
śravyo'bhijidanantātmā śravo vepitadānavaḥ | śrāvaṇaḥ śravaṇaḥ śrotā dhanī dhanyo dhaniṣṭhakaḥ || 68 ||
śātātapaḥ śātakumbhaḥ śataṃjyotiḥ śataṃbhiṣak | pūrvābhādrapado bhadraścottarābhādrapāditaḥ || 69 ||
reṇukātanayo rāmo revatīramaṇo ramī | aśviyuk kārtikeyeṣṭo mārgaśīrṣo mṛgottamaḥ || 70 ||
puṣyaśauryaḥ phālgunātmā vasantaścitrako madhuḥ | rājyado'bhijidātmīyastāreśaḥ tārakadyutiḥ || 71 ||
pratītaḥ projjhitaḥ prītaḥ paramaḥ pāramo hitaḥ | parahā pañcabhūḥ pañcavāyuḥ pūjyaḥ paraṃ mahaḥ || 72 ||
purāṇāgamavid (idaṃ nāmadvayam) yogyo mahiṣo rāsabho'gragaḥ | grāho meṣo vṛṣo mando manmatho mithunārcitaḥ || 73 ||
kalkabhṛt kaṭako dīno markaṭaḥ karkaṭo ghṛṇī | kukkuṭo vanajo haṃsaḥ parahaṃsaḥ śṛgālakaḥ || 74 ||
siṃhaḥ siṃhāsano mūṣo mohyo mūṣakavāhanaḥ (600) | putrado narakatrātā kanyāprītaḥ kulodvahaḥ || 75 ||
atulyarūpo baladastulābhṛt tulyasākṣikaḥ | alicāpadharo dhanvī kacchapo makaro maṇiḥ || 76 ||
sthiraḥ prabhurmahākarmī mahābhogī mahāyaśāḥ | vasumūrtidharo vyagro'surahārī yamāntakaḥ || 77 ||
devāgraṇīrgaṇādhyakṣo hyambujālo mahāmatiḥ | aṅgadī kuṇḍalī bhaktipriyo bhaktavivardhanaḥ || 72 ||
gāṇapatyaprado māyī vedavedāntapāragaḥ |
kātyāyanīsuto brahmapūjito vighnanāśanaḥ || 79 ||
saṃsārabhayavidhvaṃsī mahorasko mahīdharaḥ | vighnāntako mahāgrīvo bhṛśaṃ modakamoditaḥ || 80 ||
vārāṇasīpriyo mānī gahana ākhuvāhanaḥ | guhāśrayo viṣṇupadītanayaḥ sthānado dhruvaḥ || 81 ||
pararddhistuṣṭo vimalo maulimān vallabhāpriyaḥ | caturdaśīpriyo mānyo vyavasāyo madānvitaḥ || 82 ||
acintyaḥ siṃhayugalaniviṣṭo bālarūpadhṛt | dhīraḥ śaktimatāṃ śreṣṭho mahābalasamanvitaḥ || 83 ||
sarvātmā hitakṛd vaidyo mahākukṣirmahāmatiḥ | karaṇaṃ mṛtyuhārī ca pāpasaṅghanivartakaḥ || 84 ||
udbhid vajrī mahādaityasūdano dīnarakṣakaḥ | bhūtacārī pretacārī buddhirūpo manomayaḥ || 85 ||
ahaṅkāravapuḥ sāṃkhyapuruṣastriguṇātmakaḥ | tanmātrarūpo bhūtātmā indriyātmā vaśīkaraḥ || 86 ||
malatrayabahirbhūto hyavasthātrayavarjitaḥ | nīrūpo bahurūpaśca kinnaro nāgavikramaḥ || 87 ||
ekadanto mahāvegaḥ senānī stridaśādhipaḥ | viśvakartā viśvabījaṃ (700) śrīḥ saṃpadhrīrdhṛtirmatiḥ || 88 ||
sarvaśoṣakaro vāyuḥ sūkṣmarūpaḥ suniścalaḥ | saṃhartā sṛṣṭikartā ca sthitikartā layāśritaḥ || 89 ||
sāmānyarūpaḥ samāsyo'tharvaśīṣā yajurbhujaḥ | ṛgīkṣaṇaḥ kāvyakartā śikṣākārī niruktavit || 90 ||
śeṣarūpadharo mukhyaḥ śabdabrahmasvarūpabhāk |
vicāravāñśaṅkhadhārī satyavrataparāyaṇaḥ || 91 ||
mahātapā ghoratapāḥ sarvado bhīmavikramaḥ | sarvasaṃpatkaro vyāpī meghagambhīranādabhṛt || 92 ||
samṛddho bhūtido bhogī veśī śaṅkaravatsalaḥ | śambhubhaktirato mokṣadātā bhavadavānalaḥ || 93 ||
satyastapā dhyeyamūrtiḥ karmamūrtirmahāṃstathā | samaṣṭivyaṣṭirūpaśca (idaṃ nāmadvayam) pañcakośaparāṅmukhaḥ || 94 ||
tejonidhirjaganmūrtiścarācaravapurdharaḥ | prāṇado jñānamūrtiśca nādamūrtiyuto'kṣaraḥ || 95 ||
bhūtādyastaijaso bhāvo niṣkalaścaiva nirmalaḥ | kūṭasthaścetano rudraḥ kṣetravit puruṣo budhaḥ || 96 ||
anādhāro'pyanākāro dhātā ca viśvatomukhaḥ | apratarkyavapuḥ skandānujo bhānurmahāprabhaḥ || 97 ||
yajñahartā yajñakartā yajñānāṃ phaladāyakaḥ | yajñagoptā yajñamayo dakṣayajñavināśakṛt || 98 ||
vakratuṇḍo mahākāyaḥ koṭisūryasamaprabhaḥ | ekadaṃṣṭraḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgo vikaṭo dhūmravarṇakaḥ || 99 ||
ṭaṅkadhārī jambukaśca nāyakaḥ śūrpakarṇakaḥ | suvarṇagarbhaḥ sumukhaḥ śrīkaraḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ || 100 ||
suvarṇavarṇo hemāṅgo mahātmā candanacchaviḥ | svaṅgaḥ svakṣaḥ (800) śatānando lokavillokavigrahaḥ || 101 ||
indro viṣṇurdhūmaketurvahniḥ pūjyo davāntakaḥ | pūrṇānandaḥ parānandaḥ purāṇapuruṣottamaḥ || 102 ||
kumbhabhṛt kalaśī kubjo mīnamāṃsasutarpitaḥ | rāśitārāgrahamayastithirūpo (idaṃ nāmatrayam) jagadvibhuḥ || 103 ||
pratāpi pratipatpreyān dvitīyo'dvaitaniścitaḥ | trirūpaśca tṛtīyāgnistrayīrūpastrayītanuḥ || 104 ||
caturthīvallabho devo pāragaḥ pañcamīravaḥ | ṣaḍrasāsvādako'jātaḥ ṣaṣṭhī ṣaṣṭikavatsaraḥ || 105 ||
saptārṇavagatiḥ sāraḥ saptamīśvara īhitaḥ | aṣṭamīnandano'nārto navamībhaktibhāvitaḥ || 106 ||
daśadikpatipūjyaśca daśamī druhiṇo drutaḥ | ekādaśātmā gaṇapo dvādaśīyugacarcitaḥ || 107 ||
trayodaśamanustutyaścaturdaśasurapriyaḥ | caturdaśendrasaṃstutyaḥ pūrṇimānandavigrahaḥ || 108 ||
darśādarśo darśanaśca vānaprastho munīśvaraḥ | maunī madhuravāṅmūlaṃ mūrtimān meghavāhanaḥ || 109 ||
mahāgajo jitakrodho jitaśatrurjayāśrayaḥ | raudro rudrapriyo rukmo rudraputro'ghatāpanaḥ || 110 ||
bhavapriyo bhavānīṣṭo bhārabhṛd bhūtabhāvanaḥ | gāndharvakuśalo'kuṇṭho vaikuṇṭho viṣṇusevitaḥ || 111 ||
vṛtrahā vighnahā sīraḥ samastaduritāpahaḥ | mañjulo mārjano matto durgāputro durālasaḥ || 112 ||
anantacitsudhādhāro vīro vīryaikasādhakaḥ | bhāsvanmukuṭamāṇikyaḥ kūjatkiṅkiṇijālakaḥ || 113 ||
śuṇḍādhārī tuṇḍacalaḥ kuṇḍalī muṇḍamālakaḥ |
padmākṣaḥ padmahastaśca (900) padmanābhasamarcitaḥ || 114 ||
udgītho naradantāḍhyamālābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ | nārado vāraṇo lolaśravaṇaḥ śūrpakaśravāḥ || 115 ||
bṛhadullāsanāsāḍhyavyāptatrailokyamaṇḍalaḥ | ilāmaṇḍalasaṃbhrāntakṛtānugrahajīvakaḥ || 116 ||
bṛhatkarṇāñcalodbhūtavāyuvījitadiktaṭaḥ | bṛhadāsyaravākrāntabhīmabrahmāṇḍabhāṇḍakaḥ || 117 ||
bṛhatpādasamākrāntasaptapātālavepitaḥ | bṛhaddantakṛtātyugraraṇānandarasālasaḥ || 118 ||
bṛhaddhastadhṛtāśeṣāyudhanirjitadānavaḥ | sphuratsindūravadanaḥ sphurattejognilocanaḥ || 119 ||
uddīpitamaṇisphūrjannūpuradhvanināditaḥ | calattoyapravāhāḍhyanadījalakaṇākulaḥ || 120 ||
bhramatkuñjarasaṅghātavanditāṅghrisaroruhaḥ | brahmācyutamahārudrapuraḥsarasurārcitaḥ || 121 ||
aśeṣaśeṣaprabhṛtivyālajālopasevitaḥ | gūrjatpañcānanārāvaprāptākāśadharātalaḥ || 122 ||
hāhāhūhūkṛtātyugrasuravibhrāntamānasaḥ | pañcāśadvarṇabījāḍhyamantramantritavigrahaḥ || 123 ||
vedāntaśāstrapīyūṣadhārāplāvitabhūtalaḥ | śaṅkhadhvanisamākrāntapātālādinabhastalaḥ || 124 ||
cintāmaṇirmahāmallo bhallahasto baliḥ kaliḥ | kṛtatretāyugollāsabhāsamānajagattrayaḥ || 125 ||
dvāparaḥ paralokaikakarmadhvāntasudhākaraḥ | sudhāsiktavapurvyāptabrahmāṇḍādikaṭāhakaḥ || 126 ||
akārādikṣakārāntavarṇapaṅktisamujjvalaḥ | akārākāraprodgītatāranādanināditaḥ || 127 ||
ikārekāramantrāḍhyamālābhramaṇalālasaḥ | ukārokāraprodgārighoranāgopavītakaḥ || 128 ||
ṛvarṇāṅkitaṝkārapadmadvayasamujjvalaḥ | ḷkārayutaḹkāraśaṅkhapūrṇadigantaraḥ || 129 ||
ekāraikāragirijāstanapānavicakṣaṇaḥ | okāraukāraviśvādikṛtasṛṣṭikramālasaḥ || 130 ||
aṃaḥvarṇāvalīvyāptapādādiśīrṣamaṇḍalaḥ | karṇatālakṛtātyuccairvāyuvījitanirjaraḥ || 131 ||
khageśadhvajaratnāṅkakirīṭāruṇapādakaḥ | garvitāśeṣagandharvagītatatparaśrotrakaḥ || 132 ||
ghanavāhanavāgīśapuraḥsarasurārcitaḥ | ṅavarṇāmṛtadhārāḍhyaśobhamānaikadantakaḥ || 133 ||
candrakuṅkumajambālaliptasundaravigrahaḥ | chatracāmararatnāḍhyamukuṭālaṅkṛtānanaḥ || 134 ||
jaṭābaddhamahānarghamaṇipaṅktivirājitaḥ | jhāṃkārimadhupavrātagānanādanināditaḥ || 135 ||
ñavarṇakṛtasaṃhāradaityāsṛkpūrṇamudgaraḥ | ṭaṅkārukaphalāsvādavepitāśeṣamūrdhajaḥ || 136 ||
ṭhakārāḍhyaḍakārāṅkaḍhakārānandatoṣitaḥ | ṇavarṇāmṛtapīyūṣadhārādharasudhādharaḥ || 137 ||
tāmrasindūrapuñjāḍhyalalāṭaphalakacchaviḥ | thakāradhanapaṅktyāḍhyasantoṣitadvijavrajaḥ || 138 ||
dayāmayahṛdambhojadhṛtatrailokyamaṇḍalaḥ |
dhanadādimahāyakṣasaṃsevitapadāmbujaḥ || 139 ||
namitāśeṣadevaughakirīṭamaṇirañjitaḥ | paravargāpavargādimārgacchedanadakṣakaḥ || 140 ||
phaṇicakrasamākrāntagalamaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ | baddhabhrūyugabhīmograsaṃtarjitasurāsuraḥ || 141 ||
bhavānīhṛdayānandavardhanaikaniśākaraḥ | madirākalaśasphītakarālaikakarāmbujaḥ || 142 ||
yajñāntarāyasaṅghātaghātasajjīkṛtāyudhaḥ | ratnākarasutākāntakāntikīrtivivardhanaḥ || 143 ||
lambodaramahābhīmavapurdīnīkṛtāsuraḥ | varuṇādidigīśānaracitārcanacarcitaḥ || 144 ||
śaṅkaraikapriyapremanayanānandavardhanaḥ | ṣoḍaśasvaritālāpagītagānavicakṣaṇaḥ || 145 ||
samastadurgatisarinnāthottāraṇakoḍupaḥ | harādibrahmavaikuṇṭhabrahmagītādipāṭhakaḥ || 146 ||
kṣamāpūritahṛtpadmasaṃrakṣitacarācaraḥ | tārāṅkamantravarṇaikavigrahojjvalavigrahaḥ (kh: tārārṇa) || 147 ||
akārādikṣakārāntavidyābhūṣitavigrahaḥ | oṃśrīṃvināyako oṃhrīṃvighnādhyakṣo gaṇādhipaḥ || 148 ||
herambo modakāhāro vakratuṇḍo vidhismṛtaḥ (kh: vidhiḥ smṛtiḥ) | vedāntagīto vidyārthī śuddhamantraḥ (kh: siddha) ṣaḍakṣaraḥ || 149 ||
gaṇeśo varado devo dvādaśākṣaramantritaḥ | saptakoṭimahāmantramantritāśeṣavigrahaḥ || 150 ||
gāṅgeyo gaṇasevyaśca oṃśrīṃdvaimāturaḥ śivaḥ | oṃhrīṃśrīṃklīṃglauṃgaṃdevo mahāgaṇapatiḥ prabhuḥ (1000) || 151 ||
idaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ te mahāgaṇapateḥ smṛtam | guhyaṃ gopyatamaṃ guptaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitam || 152 ||
sarvamantranidhiṃ divyaṃ sarvavighnavināśanam | grahatārāmayaṃ rāśivarṇapaṅktisamanvitam || 153 ||
sarvavidyāmayaṃ brahmasādhanaṃ sādhakapriyam | gaṇeśasya ca sarvasvaṃ rahasyaṃ tridivaukasām || 154 ||
yatheṣṭaphaladaṃ loke manorathaprapūraṇam | aṣṭasiddhimayaṃ sādhyaṃ sādhakānāṃ jayapradam || 155 ||
vinārcanaṃ vinā homaṃ vinā nyāsaṃ vinā japam | aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīnāṃ sādhanaṃ smṛtimātrataḥ || 156 ||
caturthyāmardharātre tu paṭhenmantrī catuṣpathe | likhedbhūrje ravau devi puṇyaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasrakam || 157 ||
dhārayettu caturdaśyāṃ madhyāhne mūrdhni vā bhuje | yoṣidvāmakare baddhvā puruṣo dakṣiṇe bhuje || 158 ||
stambhayedapi brahmāṇaṃ mohayedapi śaṅkaram | vaśayedapi trailokyaṃ mārayedakhilān ripūn || 159 ||
uccāṭayecca gīrbāṇān śamayecca dhanañjayam | vandhyā putrāṃllabhecchīghraṃ nirdhano dhanamāpnuyāt || 160 ||
trivāraṃ yaḥ paṭhedrātrau gaṇeśastha puraḥ śive | nagnaḥ śaktiyuto devi bhuktvā bhogān yathepsitān || 161 ||
pratyakṣaṃ varadaṃ paśyedgaṇeśaṃ sādhakottamaḥ | ya enaṃ (g: idaṃ) paṭhate nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ bhaktipūrvakam || 162 ||
tasya vittādivibhavo dārāyuḥsaṃpadaḥ sadā | raṇe rājabhaye dyūte paṭennāmnāṃ sahasrakam || 163 ||
sarvatra jayamāpnoti gaṇeśasya prasādataḥ |
itīdaṃ puṇyasarvasvaṃ mantranāmasahasrakam || 164 ||
mahāgaṇapaterguhyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat |
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye mahāgaṇapatisahasranāmanirūpaṇamekonatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 29 || atha
[triṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan parameśāna mahāgaṇapatervibhoḥ | stotramaṅgatamaṃ brūhi mūlamantrasya tattvataḥ || 1 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
mahāgaṇapatervakṣye stotraṃ tattvanirūpaṇam | jīvasyāṅge (ṅ: devasyāgre) kalau śīghraṃ jīvanmuktipradāyakam || 2 ||
asya śrīmahāgaṇapateḥ stotrasya bhairava ṛṣiḥ gāyatryaṃ chandaḥ śrīmahāgaṇapatirdevatā gaṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ kuru kuru kīlakaṃ jīvanmuktikāmanārthe mahāgaṇapatistavarājapāṭhe viniyogaḥ || dhyānam(-)
dvicaturdaśavarṇabhūṣitāṅgaṃ śaśisūryāgnivilocanaṃ sureśam | ahibhūṣitakaṇṭhamakṣasūtraṃ bhramayantaṃ hṛdaye smare gaṇeśam || 3 ||
tāraṃ nāradagītamādyamaniśaṃ yaḥ sādhakendro japedrātrāvahni niśāmukhe śavagṛhe śūnyālaye vā prabho | tasya smeramukhāmbujāḥ pratidinaṃ lāvaṇyadarpojjvalāḥ svarveśyāśca vaśībhavanti tridive bhūmau samastā nṛpāḥ || 4 ||
sakalāṃ sakalāṃ japedyadā gaṇanāthapriyamantrameva yaḥ | sakalakṣmāpatimūrdhasu sphuraccaraṇābjo bhuvi śobhate ca saḥ || 5 ||
kamalāṃ kamalāspṛhī ca yo hṛdaye dhyāyati devamadhyagām | tava mantraprabhāvatastadā (k, kh, g: tataḥ) kamalā sadmani tasya niścalā || 6 ||
kāmarājamaniśaṃ smarāturo yo japeddhṛdi gaṇeśa tāvakam | urvaśīvadanapadmaṣaṭpado dhīyate'dharaparāgakāmṛtam || 7 ||
maṭhaṃ japedyo niśi śūnyagehe vimuktakeśo gaṇanātha bhaktyā | raṇe ripūnindrasamān vijitya prāpnoti rājyaṃ nṛpacakravartī || 8 ||
śivārṇamantaryādi sādhako japedaraṇyabhūmau śivasannidhau vibho | carācare vai vicaredvimāne jagatyaśeṣāmaracakravartī || 9 ||
gaṇapataya iti mūlamanuṃ yo japate bhajate śṛṇute paṭhate | gaṇakinnarasiddhasurāsurairnamito labhate gāṇapatyaṃ saḥ || 10 ||
vara varadeti ca mantramimaṃ yo bhajate niśi vā divase'pyaniśam | vadane vasate sadane vasate hṛdi vāk kamalā tava bhaktirapi || 11 ||
sarva janaṃ me iti mantrarājaṃ japanti ye bhojanakāvasāne | bhajanti te nandanacandanādivṛkṣeṣu līlāṃ surasundarībhiḥ || 12 ||
vaśamānayeti bhagavan yadi japati smarataptahṛdayaśca | vaśameti kinnarasutāpyurvaśī satataṃ suratadakṣā || 13 ||
svāheti mantrākṣarayugmametajjaped dinānte'pyaśanādikāle | rogā aśeṣā vilayaṃ prayānti tamāṃsi sūrye'bhyudite yathāśu || 14 ||
padmahastamamṛtāṃśusannibhaṃ śaṅkhayugmamaparaṃ ca dadhānam | tryakṣamagnisadṛśaṃ smaranti ye te prayānti tridivaṃ vimānagāḥ || 15 ||
bindutryaśradaśāravāsavakalāvedāśramadhye vibho ye dhyāyanti bhavantamīḍyavapuṣaṃ trailokyarakṣāparam | jitvā bhūmimanalpakalpanivahān bhuktvā sahāyairyutāḥ paścādyānti gaṇeśa tāvakapadaṃ devāsurairdurlabham || 16 ||
iti gaṇapateḥ stotraṃ mantrātmakaṃ paramaṃ japet paṭhati śṛṇuyādbhaktyā nityaṃ samastarahasyakam | iha dhanapatirlakṣmīmāyuḥ sutāṃllabhate'cirād vrajati tridivaṃ jīvanmuktaḥ paratra sa sādhakaḥ || 17 ||
iti stavottamaṃ devi mahāgaṇapateḥ param | gopyaṃ guptaṃ sadā (k, kh, g: guhyaṃ gopyaṃ sadā) gopyaṃ pañcāṅgaṃ surasundari || 18 ||
pañcāṅgaṃ ca gaṇeśasya rahasyaṃ mama pārvati | vinā śiṣyāya no dadyāt sādhakāya vinā tathā || 19 ||
vinā dānaṃ na dātavyaṃ vinā dānaṃ na grāhayet | anyathā siddhihāniḥ syāt sarvathā dānamācaret || 20 ||
paṭalaṃ paddhatiṃ varma mantranāmasahasrakam | stotraṃ pañcāṅgamaniśaṃ (ṅ: makhilaṃ) gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 21 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye mahāgaṇapateḥ stotranirūpaṇaṃ triṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 30 ||
[iti gaṇapatipañcāṅgaṃ samāptam] ||
atha
[ekatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
atha sūryapañcāṅgam |
śrībhairava uvāca |
kailāsaśikharāsīnaṃ (ṅ: śrīśaila) bhairavīpatimīśvaram | bhairavaṃ candramukuṭaṃ gaṇagandharvasevitam || 1 ||
pannagābharaṇopetaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam | bhasmāṅgarāgadhavalaṃ sarpagonasakaṅkaṇam || 2 ||
siṃhacarmaparīdhānaṃ gajacarmottarīyakam | kapālakhaṭvāṅgadharaṃ ghaṇṭāḍamarudhāriṇam || 3 ||
triśūlabāṇāsakaraṃ (k, kh, g: bāṇāsikaraṃ) varābhayakaraṃ śivam | muṇḍamālādharaṃ (karaṃ sarvapāṭhaḥ) kāmakālāndhakabhayaṅkaram || 4 ||
brahmopendrendranamitaṃ candrakoṭisuśītalam (k, kh, g: samaprabham) | yakṣeśakinnaropetaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam (k, kh, g: supūjitaṃ) || 5 ||
rakṣomārīmahāpreta bhūtavetālasaṃkulam | sādhyasiddhapiśācaugha bhairavapraṇataṃ prabhum || 6 ||
brahmarṣisevitaṃ devaṃ pārvatīsahitaṃ vibhum | gaṅgādharaṃ prasannāsyaṃ hasitānanapaṅkajam || 7 ||
nandirudrārcitaṃ śambhuṃ dṛṣṭvā provāca bhairavī |
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan devadeveśa bhaktānāmabhayaprada | tvaṃ śivaḥ parameśānastvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ prajāpatiḥ || 8 ||
sattvāśrito rajorūpastāmaso lokanāśanaḥ | nirguṇo bhairavādhyakṣaḥ kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam || 9 ||
vedamūlo vedagamyo jagattrātā jagatpatiḥ | tvaṃ me prāṇādhiko deva krītāsmi tava kiṅkarī || 10 ||
purā pṛṣṭo'si bhagavan mayā tvaṃ bhaktipūrvakam | adya tadvada tattvaṃ me yadyahaṃ tava vallabhā || 11 ||
śrībhairavaḥ |
kiṃ vakṣyāmi śive tattvaṃ yat tavāsti sudurlabham | vismṛtaṃ vada me śīghraṃ vakṣye prāṇādhikāsi me || 12 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
devadeva mahādeva daityanāyakapūjita | sakalāgamasārajña kaulikānāṃ hitecchayā || 13 ||
vada śīghraṃ dayāsindho pañcāṅgaṃ pūrvasūcitam | devadevasya sūryasya sarvatattvottamottamam || 14 ||
śrībhairavaḥ |
etad guhyatamaṃ devi pañcāṅgaṃ dvādaśātmanaḥ | sarvāgamarahasyaṃ te vakṣye snehena pārvati || 15 ||
paṭalaṃ nityapūjāyāḥ paddhatiṃ kavacaṃ param | mantranāmasahasraṃ ca stotraṃ mūlātmakaṃ priye || 16 ||
pañcāṅgamidamīśāni devadevasya bhāsvataḥ | sarvasāramayaṃ (k, kh, g: sarvāgama) divyaṃ rahasyaṃ mama durlabham || 17 ||
adātavyamabhaktebhyo bhaktebhyo bhogadāyakam | athāhaṃ paṭalaṃ vakṣye mūlamantramayaṃ priye || 18 ||
yasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvarogaiḥ pramucyate | yo devadevo bhagavān bhāskarastejasāṃ nidhiḥ || 19 ||
pratyakṣadevo vedānāṃ kartā sākṣī ca karmaṇām | saviteti ca vedeṣu paramātmā jagatpatiḥ || 20 ||
gāyatrīvallabhaḥ sūryaḥ sṛṣṭisthitilayeśvaraḥ | kālātmā ca paraṃ dhāma paraṃ brahmeti gīyate || 21 ||
tasyādidevadevasya sūryasya savituḥ śive | mantroddhāraṃ paraṃ vakṣye sarvasiddhimayaṃ kalau || 22 ||
tāraṃ ḍimbaṃ bhūtiśaktī ca sūryaṃ ṅentaṃ madhye viśvamante bhavāni | mantroddhāraḥ saviturvarṇitaste gurgākṣaro bhogamokṣaikahetuḥ || 23 ||
nāsya vighno na vā doṣo na sādhyāribhayaṃ śive | na śaucaniyamo vāpi viparyayabhayaṃ nahi || 24 ||
aṣṭasiddhiprado mantraḥ sarvarogaharaḥ paraḥ | sarvārthasādhako devi na deyo yasya kasyacit || 25 ||
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ sādhakaḥ sāṅgamīśvari | kiṃ kiṃ na labhate mantrī vāñchitaṃ sūryamudraṇāt || 26 ||
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃśaṃ sādhako hunet | tarpayet taddaśāṃśena mārjayet taddaśāṃśataḥ || 27 ||
bhojayet taddaśāṃśena mantraḥ kalpadrumo bhavet | vaṭe'raṇye śmaśāne ca śūnyāgāre catuṣpathe || 28 ||
ardharātre'tha madhyāhne paraścaraṇamācaret |
sūryoparāgasamaye grāsāvadhi vimuktitaḥ || 29 ||
yajjapet tadbhavet siddhaṃ bhogamokṣaikakāraṇam | mantrasyāsya mahādevi ṛṣirbrahmā samīritaḥ || 30 ||
gāyatryaṃ chanda ityuktaṃ savitā devatā smṛtaḥ | vyoṣaṃ bījaṃ parā śaktistāraṃ kīlakamīśvari || 31 ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe viniyoga iti smṛtaḥ | māyābījena ṣaḍdīrghabhāginā nyāsamācaret || 32 ||
karanyāsaṣaḍaṅgāni yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ | kolatrayaṃ paṭhed devi japādau sādhakottamaḥ || 33 ||
utkīlanaṃ bhaved devi mantrarājasya pārvati | śarattrayaṃ paṭhenmadhye mūlamantrasya sādhakaḥ || 34 ||
sañjīvanamanuḥ prokto mantrasyāsya maheśvari | mātṛkāśodhitaṃ mantraṃ kṛtvā pārvati sādhakaḥ || 35 ||
nistauṭilyo bhavenmantraḥ sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ | vedādiḍimbakāntyacchaṃ śaktirmadhye paṭhecchive || 36 ||
śivaśāpaṃ mocaya dviḥ punarjāyā vibhāvasoḥ | iyaṃ śāpaharī vidyā japyā sādhakasattamaiḥ || 37 ||
daśadhā saviturdevi yena mantrī śivaṃ bhajet | siddhaṃ mantraṃ japed devi yathāśaktyākṣamālayā || 38 ||
sarvarogairvimukto hi bhogamokṣaphalaṃ labhet | jagadante paṭhed devi śaradvāraṃ ca kaulikaḥ || 39 ||
saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ mantro mantrarakṣāmaṇiḥ paraḥ | gurūpadeśato jñeyaḥ sūryāstramanuruttamaḥ || 40 ||
yaṃ japtvā saviturmantro bhavet kalpadrumo'cirāt | tāraṃ vyoṣaṃ ca sūryāya vidmahe tadanantaram || 41 ||
māyāṃ śaktiṃ samuccārya jyotīrūpāya dhīmahi | tannaḥ śivaśca śaktiśca paramātmā pracodayāt || 42 ||
varṇitā sūryagāyatrī sarvatantreṣu gopitā | daśadhā sādhakairjapyā saṃdhyāsvarcāsu tarpaṇe || 43 ||
dhyānamasya pravakṣyāmi sarvadevarahasyakam | sarvarogāpahaṃ devi bhogamokṣaphalapradam || 44 ||
kalpāntānalakoṭibhāsvaramukhaṃ sindūradhūlījapāvarṇaṃ ratnakirīṭinaṃ dvinayanaṃ śvetābjamadhyāsanam | nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaṃ smitamukhaṃ raktāmbaraṃ cinmayaṃ sūryaṃ svarṇasarojaratnakalaśau dorbhyāṃ dadhānaṃ bhaje || 45 ||
yantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvāśāparipūrakam | sarvasaṃmohanaṃ divyaṃ sarvasiddhimayaṃ śive || 46 ||
bindutrikoṇavasukoṇasuvṛttarūpaṃ divyāṣṭapatravilasaddahanāraṇāḍhyam | rekhātrayāñcitadharāsadanaṃ ca devi śrīcakrametaduditaṃ saviturvareṇyam || 47 ||
layāṅgamasya yantrasya vakṣye pārvati sādharam | yasya śravaṇamātreṇa koṭipūjāphalaṃ labhet || 48 ||
śakrāgniyamamāṃsāda varuṇānilavittadāḥ | seśāḥ pūjyā bahirdvāre yantrarājasya sādhakaiḥ || 49 ||
gaṇeśaścaṇḍavetālo lolākṣo vikarālakaḥ | antardvāsthāḥ śive pūjyā vāmāvartena sādhakaiḥ || 50 ||
divyasiddhamanuṣyākhyaṃ gurupaṅktitrayaṃ śive | vṛttatraye'rcayenmantrī gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || 51 ||
candraṃ bhaumaṃ budhaṃ jīvaṃ śukraṃ sauraṃ tamastathā |
ketuṃ vasudale devi vāmāvṛtyārcayet sudhīḥ || 52 ||
dīptāṃ sūkṣmāṃ jayāṃ bhadrāṃ vimalāṃ nirmalāṃ tataḥ | vidyutāṃ sarvatovaktrāṃ grahairvasudale'rcayet || 53 ||
sūryaṃ divākaraṃ bhānuṃ bhāskaraṃ ravimīśvari | tvaṣṭāraṃ tapanaṃ dharmaṃ vasukoṇe samarcayet || 54 ||
haṃsaṃ gṛhapatiṃ devi trikoṇe ca trayītanum | śrībindumaṇḍale devi savitāraṃ samarcayet || 55 ||
kalāḥ samarcayed devi vasukoṇe trikoṇake | tapinīṃ tāpinīṃ caiva bodhinīṃ caiva rodhinīm || 56 ||
kelinīṃ śoṣiṇīṃ caiva vareṇyākarṣiṇīyutām | etāḥ saṃpūjya vasvaśre kaulikaḥ kulasiddhaye || 57 ||
māyāṃ viśvāvatīṃ hemaprabhāṃ tryaśre samarcayet | visphurāṃ savitāraṃ ca bindubimbe samarcayet || 58 ||
kamalaiḥ kevalaṃ devaṃ pūjayedāyudhāni ca | suvarṇapadmaṃ saṃpūjya ratnāḍhyakalaśaṃ śive || 59 ||
mūlena vidhivad devaṃ (kh: devi) namet kaivalyasiddhaye | layāṅgametadākhyātaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitam || 60 ||
mudrāṃ padmābhidhāṃ devi darśayedarcanāvidhau | aṅguṣṭhau vimukhau madhye saṃyojya tarjanīdvayam || 61 ||
kaniṣṭhike ca saṃyojya madhyamānāmikāḥ pṛthak | padmamudreyamākhyātā bimbamudrāṃ śṛṇu priye || 62 ||
aṅguṣṭhau saṃmukhau kṛtvā saṃmukhīraṅgulīścaret | ūrdhvaṃ karayugaṃ kṛtvā bimbamudreyamīritā || 63 ||
adhomerurvāmamadhyā tadūrdhve savyamadhyamā |
tathaiva kaulikaḥ kuryādvāmataḥ savyato'ṅgulīḥ || 64 ||
iyaṃ tu bhāskarīmudrā trailokyavaśakāriṇī | sarvarogāpahā khyātā darśanīyārcanāvidhau || 65 ||
aṅguṣṭhayośca candrārau jñejyāvanāmayostathā | sitāsitau ca tarjanyoḥ rāhuketū pralambayoḥ || 66 ||
madhye tu bhāskaraṃ devaṃ dhyātvā mudrāṃ pradarśayet | āvāhane ca gandhādau naivedye ca visarjane || 67 ||
dhūpadīpādinaivedyaṃ deyaṃ sarvaṃ khaśolkayā | khaśolkākhyā mahāmudrā (sarvarogāpahāriṇī || 68 ||
sarvārthasādhanakarī duḥkhadāridryanāśinī | baddhvā muṣṭiyugaṃ devi parvaṃ parvaṇi yojayet || 69 ||
aṅguṣṭhayoniṃ baddhvordhve sarvayonyuttamottamām | khaśolkākhyā mahāmudrā) śatruvargavimardinī || 70 ||
raviṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamyādau darśanīyā maheśvari | mahāmudrā mahāgopyā mahāmārtaṇḍavallabhā || 71 ||
imāṃ yo bhānavīṃ mudrāṃ darśayet pūjane sudhīḥ | śatavarṣasahasrāṇāṃ pūjāphalamavāpnuyāt || 72 ||
prayogānaṣṭa vakṣye'haṃ śṛṇu pārvati sādaram | yeṣāṃ sādhanamātreṇa mantraḥ siddhiprado bhavet || 73 ||
stambhanaṃ mohanaṃ caiva māraṇākarṣaṇau tataḥ | vaśīkaraṇavidveṣau śāntikī pauṣṭikī kriyā || 74 ||
eteṣāṃ sādhanaṃ vakṣye sādhakānāṃ hitecchayā | aprakāśyamadātavyaṃ kalau rogāpahaṃ śive || 75 ||
ravau prabhāte śayanādutthāyāvaśyakaṃ caret | snātvā japenmahādevi sūryāgre sādhako'yutam || 76 ||
huned daśāṃśato devi padmapadmākṣaśarkarāḥ | sarpiṣā stambhanaṃ sadyo vāditaskarapāthasām (kh: vahni) || 77 ||
ravau madhyāhnavelāyāṃ japedayutasaṃkhyayā | huned daśāṃśamīśāni ghṛtapadmākṣanāgarān || 78 ||
tarpayet payasā sadyo mohanaṃ dyusadāmapi | ravau sāyaṃ japenmūlaṃ nadītīrasthito rahaḥ || 79 ||
ayutaṃ taddaśāṃśena hunet padmākṣaparpaṭān | ghṛtena dadhnā santarpya māraṇaṃ dviṣatāṃ bhavet || 80 ||
ravau niśīthe saṃjapya mūlamantrāyutaṃ śive | huned daśāṃśamambhojaśaṭīghṛtakulatthakaiḥ || 81 ||
ākarṣaṇaṃ bhavet sadyo devi nākastriyāmapi | ravau brāhme muhūrte tu snātvā tatra japejjale || 82 ||
ayutaṃ mūlavidyāyā daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāt sudhīḥ | ghṛtamatsyaṇḍakarpūra padmapadmākṣakesarān || 83 ||
indro'pi vaśatāṃ yāti kiṃ punaḥ kṣudrabhūmipaḥ | sūryodaye japedvidyāṃ sādhako'yutasaṃkhyayā || 84 ||
juhuyāt sarpirambhoja mustāparpaṭaśarkarāḥ | viṣeṇa tarpayed devaṃ bhavedvidveṣaṇaṃ dviṣām || 85 ||
ravāvardhodite devi kūpabhūmau japenmanum | ayutaṃ taddaśāṃśena huned ghṛtayavākaṇāḥ || 86 ||
ambhojakesaraṃ śuṇṭhīṃ (ṅ: kaṇṭīṃ) śāntirbhavati tatkṣaṇāt | ativṛṣṭeranāvṛṣṭeḥ rājabhītermaheśvari || 87 ||
ravāvastaṅgate'pyardhe japedvānīramūlake | mantrāyutaṃ mahādevi juhuyād ghṛtagopayaḥ || 88 ||
padmapadmākṣakiñjalka matsyaṇḍārkadalāni ca | daśāṃśaṃ tarpayed dadhnā kṣīreṇa sitayā sudhīḥ || 89 ||
mahāpuṣṭirbhavelloke devānāmapi durlabhā | ityeṣa paṭalo guhyaḥ savituścātivallabhaḥ || 90 ||
sarvamantramayo divyo gopanīyo mumukṣubhiḥ |
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye sūryapaṭalanirūpaṇamekatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 31 || atha
[dvātriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adyāhaṃ saviturvakṣye nityapūjārahasyakam | paddhatiṃ paramāṃ divyāṃ śṛṇu pārvati sādaram || 1 ||
pañcakṛtyamakṛtvā yo gāyatrīṃ sañjapecchive | sa pātakī bhavedrogī yadidaṃ śivaśāsanam || 2 ||
saviturnityapūjāyāḥ paddhatiṃ gadyarūpiṇīm | sarvatattvarahasyāḍhyāṃ vakṣye'haṃ prāṇavallabhe || 3 ||
brāhme muhūrte utthāya baddhapadmāsanaḥ svaśiraḥsthasahasrārādhomukhakamalakarṇikāmadhyavartinaṃ śrīguruṃ cidānandasvarūpaṃ dhyātvā nutvā taddarśanānandāpluto bhūtvā haṃsaḥ sohaṃ svāhā iti sañjapya japaṃ haṃsāya nivedya sohaṃ haṃsaḥ svāhā iti dhyātvā japtvā gurave nivedya
tadājñāṃ gṛhītvā bahirāgatya malādīn saṃtyajya varṇānurūpaṃ śaucaṃ vidhāya devaṃ dhyātvā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ vidhāya tattvatrayeṇācamya dantadhāvanaṃ kuryāt | tadyathā klīṃ sarvajanamanoharāya kāmadevāya vauṣaṭ iti dantān saṃśodhya hrāmiti gaṇḍūṣatrayaṃ vidhāya praṇavena trirācamya śiromukhahṛtkukṣinābhipṛṣṭhaliṅgajānupādeṣu pratyekaṃ mūlabījākṣarāṇi nyaset | tata upaspṛśya māyābījena tārādyena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuryāt | pūrakaṃ (16) kumbhakaṃ (64) recakaṃ (32) iti prāṇāpānasamānodānavyānādīn niyamya nadyādau gatvā mṛttrayaṃ mūlena tridhābhimantrya malāpakarṣaṇaṃ snānaṃ nirmāya oṃgāṃgīṃgūṃ gaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati narmade sindhukāveri jale'smin sannidhiṃ kuru || ityaṅkuśamudrayā sūryamaṇḍalāttīrthānyāvāhya oṃ bhagavan bhavabhūteśa grahanāyaka bhāskara | cidrūpa vedanetreśa paramārthādvaya prabho || yāvat tvāṃ tarpayiṣyāmi tāvadbhāno ihāvaha | ityāvāhya tṛtīyāṃ mṛdamaṅge vilipya mūlaṃ saptadhā samuccārya kumbhamudrāṃ pradarśya jale trirunmajjet | iti snātvā devaṃ dhyātvā mūlena devāyārghyatrayaṃ dattvā mūlavidyāṃ daśadhā japtvā sūryagāyatryā mahāmārtaṇḍāyārghyatrayaṃ dadyāt | oṃhrīṃ sūryarūpāya vidmahe hrīṃsaḥ jyotīrūpāya dhīmahi tanno haṃsaḥ pracodayāt (3) | oṃhaṃsaḥ mahāmārtaṇḍāya prakāśaśaktisahitāya eṣa te'rgho namaḥ | ityarghyatrayaṃ dattvā mūlena trirmārjanapūrvamācamya vāso'nyat paridhāya saṃdhyāṃ kuryāt | yathā jale tryaśraṃ kṛtvā svadeha upaspṛśya vāmahaste jalaṃ dhṛtvā dakṣahastenācchādya laṃvaṃraṃyaṃhaṃ iti trirabhimantrya dakṣakare dhṛtvā tadgalitāmbubindubhiḥ svamūrdhni dvādaśadhā saṃmārjya iḍayā tajjalamantarnītvā śārīraṃ kaluṣaṃ prakṣālya vāmanāsayā virecya tajjalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pāparūpaṃ svavāmabhāgasthavajraśilāyāmāsphālayediti malāpakarṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā oṃhrīṃ ātmatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā oṃhrīṃ vidyātattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā oṃhrīṃ śivatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā iti trirācamya pūrvavat (16 | 64 | 32) triḥ prāṇānāyamya gāyatrīṃ daśadhā japet | saviturdevi gāyatrīṃ kauliko daśadhā japet | mahāpātakayukto'pi sarvarogaiḥ pramucyate || iti japtvā mūlaṃ yathāśaktyā japtvā japaṃ devāya samarpya mūlamuccārya udvayantamanābhāsaṃ paramaṃ vyoma cinmayam | avyayaṃ saccidākāśamadyanma
jyotiruttamam svāhā ityupasthāya jalāñjaliṃ dattvā punarjale śrīcakraṃ vā yonicakraṃ bindumaṇḍitaṃ vilikhya mūlānte śrīmahāmārtaṇḍadevaḥ sūryaḥ savitā visphurāsahitastṛpyatāmiti dvādaśavāraṃ saṃtarpya pratyekaṃ parivāradevatāḥ saṃtarpya pitrāditarpaṇaṃ vidhāya trirācamya snāneśāya varuṇāya oṃhrūṃśrūṃvāṃ varuṇāya vauṣaṭ iti natvā devaṃ sadevīkaṃ visṛjya hṛtkuśeśayakośāntarlīnaṃ dhyātvā snānaśāṭīṃ nirvartya (kh: niṣpīḍya) yāgamaṇḍapamāgacchediti sandhyāvidhiḥ ||
tatra pādau prakṣālya gehāntaḥ praviśya sāmānyārghyodakenābhyukṣya oṃhrāṃ dehalyai namaḥ oṃgaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ oṃsaṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ oṃduṃ durgāyai namaḥ oṃkṣāṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ madhye vāstudevatābhyo namaḥ iti pūrvadvārādārabhyottaradvāraparyantamabhyarcya dvārordhve gaṅgāyai namaḥ dakṣiṇe yamunāyai namaḥ dvārādhaḥ sarasvatyai namaḥ uttare cakrāyai namaḥ madhye sudhārṇavāya namaḥ iti saṃpūjya mūlena nirīkṣya choṭikābhiḥ saṃtāḍya yathārhamāsana upaviśya śodhanaṃ kuryāt |
oṃāṃ āsanaśodhanamantrasya merupṛṣṭha ṛṣiḥ sutalaṃ chandaḥ kūrmo devatā āsanaśodhane viniyogaḥ | oṃprīṃ pṛthivyai namaḥ oṃmahi tvayā dhṛtā lokā devi tvaṃ viṣṇunā dhṛtā | tvaṃ ca dhāraya māṃ devi pavitraṃ kuru cāsanam || oṃkrāṃhrāṃhrīṃ ādhāraśaktikamalāsanāya namaḥ aṃ anantāya namaḥ padmanālāya namaḥ padmāya namaḥ parāgebhyo namaḥ aṣṭadalapadmāsanāya namaḥ sahasradalapadmāsanāya namaḥ oṃhaṃsaḥ śrīkarṇikāyai namaḥ saptaturagebhyo namaḥ iti saṃpūjya divyadṛṣṭyā divyāṃstālatrayeṇāntarikṣagatān vāmapārṣṇighātatrayeṇa bhaumān vighnānutsārya apasarpantu te bhūtā ye bhūtā bhuvi saṃsthitāḥ | ye bhūtā vighnakartāraste naśyantu śivājñayā || ityakṣataprakṣepeṇa bhūtānniḥsārya oṃhraḥ astrāya phaḍiti digbandhanaṃ kṛtvā oṃhaṃsaḥ māṃ rakṣa (2) hūṃ phaṭ svāhā ityātmarakṣāṃ vidhāya hūṃ phaṭ vāmanāsayā vāyumāpūrya hrīṃ phaṭ kumbhayitvā saḥ phaṭ virecya svātmānaṃ haṃsarūpaṃ dhyātvā oṃhūṃhaṃsaḥ ityākuñcena kulakuṇḍalinīṃ sārdhatrivalayāṃ dīrghākārāmutthāpya pradīpakalikākārāṃ bisatantutanīyasīṃ taḍitkoṭiprabhāṃ candrakoṭiśītalāṃ sūryakoṭidurdarśāṃ vahnikoṭikarālāṃ suṣumnāmārgeṇa ṣaṭcakraṃ bhittvā brahmapathāntarnītvā
paramaśivena saṃyojya sāmarasyodbhavānandāmṛtena santarpya punastenaiva pathā mūlādhāraṃ prāpayitvā vāme pāpapuruṣaṃ śmaśrulaṃ raktākṣaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ khaḍgacarmadharaṃ svāṅguṣṭhākāraṃ vicintya yaṃraṃvaṃlaṃhaṃ iti bhūtabījaiḥ śoṣaṇa dāhana plāvanādīn kuryāt | yathā ādau prāṇāyāmayogena yamiti vāyubījena ṣoḍaśavārajaptena śoṣayet | tato ramiti vahnibījena catuṣṣaṣṭivārajaptena dāhayet | vamiti varuṇabījena dvātriṃśadvārajaptena plāvayet | lamiti bhūbījena daśadhā japtena dehaṃ dṛḍhaṃ vicintya hamityākāśabījena daśadhā japtena śunyātmakaṃ svātmānaṃ dhyātvā hṛdayārabindakarṇikāyāṃ devaṃ sūryaṃ dhyāyet | dedīpyamānamukuṭaṃ maṇikuṇḍalamaṇḍitam | devaṃ sahasrakiraṇaṃ visphurāliṅgitaṃ smaret | iti dhyātvā svātmānaṃ devarūpaṃ smṛtvā oṃāṃhrīṃkroṃhrāṃhrīṃ haṃsaḥ mama prāṇā iha prāṇā (8/) mama jīva iha sthitaḥ (8/) mama sarvendriyāṇi vāṅmanaścakṣustvakśrotrajihvāghrāṇaprāṇāḥ ihaivāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu svāhā iti bhūtaśuddhiṃprāṇapratiṣṭhākramaḥ | tato mūlanyāsaṃ vidhāya mūlānte śirasi triḥ sūryaṃ saṃpūjya mantrasaṅkalpaṃ kuryāt |
oṃ asya śrīsūryapūjāmantrasya śrībrahmā ṛṣiḥ gāyatryaṃ chandaḥ śrīsavitā devatā hrāṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ oṃkīlakam dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe sūryapūjāyāṃ viniyogaḥ | brahmaṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi gāyatryacchandase namo mukhe śrīsavitre devatāyai namo hṛdi hrāṃ bījāya namo nābhau hrīṃ śaktaye namo guhye oṃkīlakāya namaḥ pādayoḥ jape viniyogāya namaḥ sarvāṅgeṣu | hrāṃ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ hrīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ hrūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ hraiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ hrauṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ hraḥ karatalapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | hrāṃ hṛdayāya(0) | hrīṃ śirase(0) | hrūṃ śikhāyai(0) | hraiṃ kavacāya(0) | hrauṃ netrā(0) | hraḥ astrāya(0) | iti karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ | oṃnamaḥ śirasi hrāṃ netrayoḥ hrīṃ mukhe saḥ hṛdi sūṃ kukṣau ryāṃ nābhau yaṃ jānunoḥ naṃ pādayoḥ maḥ śirasaḥ pādaparyantamiti saptadhā vyāpayediti mūlavidyānyāsaḥ ||
oṃhrāṃ ṛgvedātmane sūryāya namaḥ śirasi | oṃhrīṃ yajurvedātmane sūryāya namaḥ kukṣau | oṃsaḥ sāmavedātmane sūryāya namo guhye | oṃ atharvavedātmane sūryāya namaḥ pādayoḥ | iti trirvyāpayediti vedanyāsaḥ ||
oṃhrāṃ ātmarūpāya sūryāya hṛdayāya namaḥ | oṃhrīṃ paramātmane sūryāya śirase svāhā | oṃhrūṃ sarvabhūtātmane sūryāya śikhāyai(0) | oṃhraiṃ jñānātmane sūryāya kavacāya(0) | oṃhrauṃ antarātmane sūryāya netratrayāya(0) | oṃhraḥ haṃsātmane sūryāya astrāya phaṭ | evamaṅgulīnyāsaḥ | ityātmanyāsaḥ ||
oṃhrāṃ somātmane sūryāya aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ(0) | oṃhrīṃ bhaumātmane sūryāya tarjanībhyāṃ(0) | oṃhrūṃ budhātmane sūryāya madhyamābhyāṃ(0) | oṃhraiṃ jīvātmane sūryāya anāmikābhyāṃ(0) | oṃhrauṃ śukrātmane sūryāya kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ(0) | oṃhraḥ saurātmane sūryāya karatalapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | evaṃ hṛdayādinyāsaḥ | iti grahanyāsaḥ ||
oṃaṃāṃiṃīṃuṃūṃṛṃṝṃḷṃḹṃeṃaiṃoṃauṃaṃaḥ sūryāya namaḥ mūlādhāre | hrāṃ kaṃkhaṃgaṃghaṃṅaṃ sūryāya namaḥ maṇipūre | hrīṃ caṃchaṃjaṃjhaṃñaṃ sūryāya namaḥ svādhiṣṭhāne | saḥ ṭaṃṭhaṃḍaṃḍhaṃṇaṃ sūryāya namaḥ anāhate | sūryāya taṃthaṃdaṃdhaṃnaṃ sūryāya namaḥ viśuddhau | naṃ paṃphaṃbaṃbhaṃmaṃ sūryāya namaḥ ājñāyāṃ | maḥ yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃlaṃkṣaṃ sūryāya namaḥ karandhre | iti saptadhā vyāpayediti mūlaśuddhimātṛkānyāsaḥ ||
aṃāṃ gāyatrīchandase sūryāya namo brahmarandhre | iṃīṃ triṣṭhupchandase sūryāya namaḥ ājñāyāṃ | uṃūṃ anuṣṭupchandase sūryāya namo viśuddhau | ṛṃṝṃḷṃḹṃ uṣṇikchandase sūryāya namaḥ anāhate | eṃaiṃ virāṭchandase sūryāya namaḥ svādhiṣṭhāne | oṃauṃ samrāṭchandase sūryāya namo maṇipūre | aṃaḥ bṛhatīchandase sūryāya namo mūlādhāre | iti saptadhā vyāpayediti saptachandonyāsaḥ ||
oṃ gaurāśvāya sūryāya namo brahmarandhre | hrāṃ pāṇḍurāśvāya sūryāya namaḥ ājñāyāṃ | hrīṃ sitāśvāya sūryāya namo viśuddhau | saḥ śvetāśvāya sūryāya namaḥ anāhate | sūryāya himāśvāya sūryāya namaḥ svādhiṣṭhāne | naṃ kṣīrāśvāya sūryāya namo maṇipūre | maḥ kundāśvāya sūryāya namo mūlādhāre | iti trirvyāpayet iti saptaturaganyāsaḥ ||
oṃ ajapādevatāyai sūryāya namaḥ karandhre | hrāṃ gāyatrīdevatāyai sūryāya namaḥ ājñāyāṃ | hrīṃ sāvitrīdevatāyai sūryāya namo viśuddhau | saḥ sarasvatīdevatāyai sūryāya namaḥ anāhate | sūryāya tryakṣarīdevatāyai sūryāya namaḥ svādhiṣṭhāne | naṃ brahmavādinīdevatāyai sūryāya namo maṇipūre | maḥ pañcamukhīdevatāyai
sūryāya namo mūlādhāre | iti trirvyāpayediti gāyatrīnyāsaḥ ||
oṃ śivatattvāya sūryāya namo brahmarandhre | hrāṃ śaktitattvāya sūryāya namaḥ ājñāyāṃ | hrīṃ māyātattvāya sūryāya namo viśuddhau | saḥ vidyātattvāya sūryāya namaḥ anāhate | sūryāya kalātattvāya sūryāya namaḥ svādhiṣṭhāne | naṃ niyatitattvātmane sūryāya namo maṇipūre | maḥ ātmatattvāya sūryāya namo mūlādhāre | iti trirvyāpayediti tattvanyāsaḥ ||
oṃ kāmarūpapīṭheśāya sūryāya namo brahmarandhre | hrāṃ uḍḍīyānapīṭheśāya sūryāya namaḥ ājñāyāṃ | hrīṃ jālandharapīṭheśāya sūryāya namo viśuddhau | saḥ pūrṇagiripīṭheśāya sūryāya namaḥ anāhate | sūryāya madhupurīpīṭheśāya sūryāya namaḥ svādhiṣṭhāne | naṃ avantīpīṭheśāya sūryāya namo maṇipūre | maḥ vārāṇasīpīṭheśāya sūryāya namo mūlādhāre | mūlaṃ kurukṣetrapīṭheśāya sūryāya namaḥ sarvāṅgeṣu | iti trirvyāpayediti pīṭhanyāsaḥ | iti dvādaśanyāsāḥ | yathoktam(-)
munimāyāmūlavidyā vedātmagrahaśuddhayaḥ | chandasturagagāyatrī tattvapīṭhādayaḥ punaḥ ||
ete hi dvādaśa nyāsāḥ sarvatantreṣu gopitāḥ | varṇitāstava deveśi sarvarogāpahārakāḥ ||
etān yaḥ kurute nyāsān savituḥ sarvasiddhaye | tasya lakṣmīdhanārogyavidyākīrtisukhāptayaḥ || nyāsānte bhāskaraṃ dhyāyet pūjākoṭiphalaṃ labhet | iti ||
atha mātṛkānyāsaḥ aṃ kaṃ (5) āṃ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | iṃ caṃ (5) īṃ tarjanībhyāṃ(0) | uṃ ṭaṃ (5) ūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ(0) | eṃ taṃ (5) aiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ | oṃ paṃ (5) auṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ(0) | aṃ yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃlaṃkṣaḥ aḥ karatalapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | iti karanyāsaḥ | evaṃ ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ | iti svarādyantamātṛkānyāsaḥ ||
atha śuddhamātṛkānyāsaḥ aṃ namaḥ śirasi | āṃ namo mukhavṛtte | evaṃ iṃ dakṣanetre | īṃ vāmanetre | uṃ dakṣakarṇe | ūṃ vāmakarṇe | ṛṃ dakṣanāsāpuṭe | ṝṃ vāme | ḷṃ dakṣagaṇḍe | ḹṃ vāme | eṃ ūrdhvoṣṭhe | aiṃ adharoṣṭhe | oṃ ūrdhvadantapaṃktau | auṃ adhodantapaṃktau | aṃ śirasi | aḥ mukhe | kaṃ dakṣabāhumūle | khaṃ kurpare | gaṃ maṇibandhe | ghaṃ aṅgulimūle | ṅaṃ
aṅgulyagre | caṃ vāmabāhumūle | chaṃ kurpare | jaṃ maṇibandhe | jhaṃ aṅgulimūle | ñaṃ aṅgulyagre | ṭaṃ dakṣapādamūle | ṭhaṃ jānuni | ḍaṃ gulphe | ḍhaṃ aṅgulimūle | ṇaṃ aṅgulyagre | taṃ vāmapādamūle | thaṃ jānuni | daṃ gulphe | dhaṃ aṅgulimūle | naṃ aṅgulyagre | paṃ dakṣapārśve | phaṃ vāme | baṃ pṛṣṭhe | bhaṃ nābhau | maṃ jaṭhare | yaṃ hṛdi | raṃ dakṣāṃse | laṃ kakudi | vaṃ vāmāṃse | śaṃ hṛdādidakṣahastāgrāntaṃ | ṣaṃ hṛdādivāmahastāgrāntaṃ | saṃ hṛdādidakṣapādāgrāntaṃ | haṃ hṛdādivāmapādāgrāntaṃ | laṃ pādādiśiraḥparyantaṃ | kṣaḥ namaḥ śirasaḥ pādaparyantamiti trirvyāpayet | iti mātṛkānyāsaḥ || hrīṃ namaḥ śirasi haṃ namo hṛdi saḥ namaḥ pādayoḥ mūlaṃ śirasaḥ pādaparyantaṃ trirvyāpayediti (gh: itthaṃ) nyāsaṃ vidhāya hṛtkamalakarṇikāntargataṃ devaṃ dhyāyet(-)
japādāḍimabimbābhaṃ dvibhujaṃ cāruṇāmbaram | saptāśvarathasaṃyuktaṃ maṇikuṇḍalamaṇḍitam ||
kīyūrahārābharaṇaṃ kalaśāmbhojadhāriṇam | savitāraṃ jagannāthaṃ visphurāliṅgitaṃ bhaje ||
evaṃ dhyātvā mānasopacārairabhyarcya svavāme trikoṇavṛttamaṇḍalaṃ vilikhya raṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya daśakalātmane namaḥ iti saṃpūjya tripadīṃ kṣālitāṃ saṃsthāpya tatra śaṅkhaṃ saṃsthāpya śaṅkhe aṃ arkamaṇḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ iti saṃpūjya tīrthajalenāpūrya sauḥ somamaṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ ityabhyarcya haṃsaḥ sūryāya hrīṃ namaḥ iti trirgandhākṣatapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya oṃgāṃgīṃgūṃ gaṅge ca yamune caiva ityādinā sūryamaṇḍalāt tīrthānyaṅkuśamudrayāvāhya oṃhrāṃhrīṃsaḥ haṃsaḥ śuciṣade sūryāya namaḥ (ṅ: svāhā) iti saṃpūjya dhenuyonimatsyakhaśolkāmudrāḥ pradarśya praṇamet |
darśanenāpi śaṅkhasya kiṃ punaḥ sparśanena ca | vilayaṃ yānti pāpāni himavadbhāskarodaye ||
iti sāmānyārghyaṃ vidhāya sudhārghyaṃ kuryāt | yathā sāmānyārghyasya dakṣe trikoṇavṛttacaturaśraṃ vilikhya sāmānyārghyodakenābhyukṣya oṃhrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ pūrve | oṃhrīṃ śirase svāhā dakṣiṇe | oṃhrūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ paścime
oṃhraiṃ kavacāya huṃ uttare | oṃhrauṃ netrebhyo vauṣaṭ adhaḥ | oṃhraḥ astrāya phaṭ ūrdhve | iti saṃpūjya oṃmitīśāne hamityāgneye saḥ iti agre iti tryaśraṃ saṃpūjya kṣālitādhāraṃ saṃsthāpya raṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya daśakalātmane namaḥ ityabhyarcya tatra
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi raktaṃ vā mṛṇmayaṃ ghaṭam | sthāpayecchobhitaṃ divyamālābhiḥ kuṅkumārñcitam ||
iti saṃsthāpya haṃsaḥ sūryamaṇḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ iti saṃpūjya madhumātreṇāpūrya tatrānāmikāṅguṣṭhābhyāmamṛtadhārāpātena saṃpūrya sauḥ somamaṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ iti somamaṇḍalādamṛtīkaraṇamudrayāmṛtaṃ dhyātvā tatrānīya kumbhe niḥkṣipya aṃāṃ ityādikṣāntamuccārya mūlamuccārya mrāṃmrīṃmrūṃmraiṃmrauṃmraḥ aḥ amṛte amṛtodbhave amṛtākarṣiṇi amṛtavarṣiṇi mahāmārtaṇḍamaṇḍaleśvari sudhādevi paramānandeśvari hrāṃhrīṃsaḥ haṃsaḥ sohaṃ svāhā iti daśadhā japet iti japtvā
sūryamaṇḍalasaṃbhūte varuṇālayasaṃbhave | amābījamaye devi śukraśāpādvimucyatām ||
vedānāṃ (ṅ: devānāṃ) praṇavo bījaṃ brahmānandamayaṃ yadi | tena satyena deveśi (gh, ṅ: te devi) śukraśāpādvimucyatām ||
ekameva paraṃ brahma sthūlasūkṣmamayaṃ dhruvam (ṅ: paraṃ) | kacodbhavāṃ brahmahatyāṃ tena te nāśayāmyaham ||
kṛṣṇaśāpavinirmuktā tvaṃ muktā brahmaśāpataḥ | vimuktā rudraśāpena pavitrā bhava sāṃpratam ||
pavamānaḥ parānandaḥ pavamānaḥ paro rasaḥ | pavamānaṃ paraṃ brahma tena tvāṃ pāvayāmyaham ||
iti triḥ saṃpūjya gaṅgāditīrthānyāvāhya dhenuyonimatsyamudrāḥ pradarśya haṃsaḥ sohaṃ svāhā ityamṛtīkṛtya mūlaṃ daśadhā prajapya gandhākṣatapuṣpaiḥ saṃpūjya mahāmṛtamayaṃ tīrthaṃ dhyāyediti ghaṭasthāpanam ||

iti japaṃ devāya samarpya yonimudrayā praṇamet | tataḥ kavacasahasranāmastavarājapāṭhaṃ kuryāt (vaiśvadevādinityakarma kuryāt) | tadapi bimbamudrayā devāya samarpya daṇḍavat praṇamya oṃhrīṃvīṃ vīravaṭukāya namaḥ | oṃyāṃyūṃyoṃ yoginībhyo namaḥ | oṃkṣāṃ kṣetrapālebhyo namaḥ | oṃtrāṃtroṃ tejaścaṇḍābhyāṃ (ṅ: tejaścaṇḍāya) namaḥ iti baliṃ nivedya oṃhrāṃhrūṃ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ sarvavighnakṛdbhyo balirvauṣaṭ iti baliṃ dattvā (tataḥ sūryasya kṣamāpayet)
śrīsāmayikaiḥ saha vīravandanaṃ vidhāya tadante oṃ sohaṃ haṃsaḥ svāhā ityānandapātraṃ śirasi niḥkṣipya paramānandamayo bhūtvā svātmānaṃ tejomayaṃ sūryarūpaṃ vibhāvya oṃhraḥ astrāya phaṭ sūryāstraṃ dhyātvā praṇamya puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā bhānavīṃ mudrāṃ pradarśya saṃhāramudrayā śrīcakre bindubimbāt sūryatejomayaṃ puṣpamādāya piṅgalayāghrāya tatsauraṃ tejaḥ paramaśivena saṃyojya punarmūlādhāraṃ prāpayya svātmānaṃ tejomayarūpaṃ divyaṃ nāṭayan svaśaktyā saha yathāsukhaṃ viharet ||
