śrībhairava uvāca |
yo devadevo bhagavān bhāskaro mahasāṃ nidhiḥ | gāyatrīnāyako bhāsvān (k: śreṣṭhaḥ) saviteti pragīyate || 1 ||
tasyāhaṃ kavacaṃ divyaṃ vajrapañjarakābhidham | sarvamantramayaṃ guhyaṃ (k: divyaṃ) mūlavidyārahasyakam || 2 ||
sarvapāpāpahaṃ (k, kh: pāpaharaṃ) devi duḥkhadāridryanāśanam |
mahākuṣṭhaharaṃ puṇyaṃ (k: devi) sarvaroganivarhaṇam (k: nivāraṇam) || 3 ||
sarvaśatrusamūhaghnaṃ saṃgrāme vijayapradam | sarvatejomayaṃ sarvadevadānavapūjitam || 4 ||
raṇe rājabhaye ghore sarvopadravanāśanam | mātṛkāveṣṭitaṃ varma bhairavānananirgatam || 5 ||
grahapīḍāharaṃ devi sarvasaṅkaṭanāśanam | dhāraṇādasya deveśi brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 6 ||
viṣṇurnārāyaṇo devi raṇe daityāñjayiṣyati | śaṅkaraḥ sarvalokeśo vāsavo'pi divaspatiḥ || 7 ||
oṣadhīśaḥ śaśī devi śivo'haṃ bhairaveśvaraḥ | mantrātmakaṃ para varma savituḥ sāramuttamam || 8 ||
yo dhārayed bhuje mūrdhni ravivāre maheśvari | sa rājavallabho loke tejasvī vairimardanaḥ || 9 ||
bahunoktena kiṃ devi kavacasyāsya dhāraṇāt | iha lakṣmīdhanārogya vṛddhirbhavati nānyathā || 10 ||
paratra paramā muktirdevānāmapi durlabhā | kavacasyāsya deveśi mūlavidyāmayasya ca || 11 ||
vajrapañjarakākhyasya munirbrahmā samīritaḥ | gāyatryaṃ chanda ityuktaṃ devatā savitā smṛtaḥ || 12 ||
māyā bījaṃ śarat śaktirnamaḥ kīlakamīśvari | sarvārthasādhane devi viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 13 ||
asya śrīvajrapañjarakavacasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ gāyatryaṃ chandaḥ śrīsavitā devatā hrīṃ bījaṃ saḥ śaktiḥ namaḥ kīlakaṃ sarvārthasādhane vajrapañjarakavacapāṭhe viniyogaḥ ||
oṃaṃāṃiṃīṃ śiraḥ pātu oṃ sūryo mantravigrahaḥ | uṃūṃṛṃṝṃ lalāṭaṃ me hrāṃ raviḥ pātu cinmayaḥ || 14 ||
ḷṃḹṃeṃaiṃ pātu netre hrīṃ mamāruṇasārathiḥ | oṃauṃaṃaḥ śrutī pātu saḥ sarvajagadīśvaraḥ || 15 ||
kaṃ.khaṃgaṃghaṃ pātu gaṇḍau sūṃ sūraḥ (k, kh: sūryaḥ) surapūjitaḥ | caṃchaṃjaṃjhaṃ ca nāsāṃ me pāturyāṃ aryamā prabhuḥ || 16 ||
ṭaṃṭhaṃḍaṃḍhaṃ mukhaṃ pāyād yaṃ yogīśvarapūjitaḥ | taṃthaṃdaṃdhaṃ galaṃ pātu naṃ nārāyaṇavallabhaḥ || 17 ||
paṃphaṃbaṃbhaṃ mama skandhau pātu maṃ mahasāṃ nidhiḥ | yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃ bhujau pātu mūlaṃ sakalanāyakaḥ || 18 ||
śaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃ pātu vakṣo mūlamantramayo dhruvaḥ | laṃkṣaḥ kukṣiṃ sadā pātu grahanātho dineśvaraḥ || 19 ||
ṅaṃñaṃṇaṃnaṃmaṃ me pātu pṛṣṭhaṃ divasanāyakaḥ | aṃāṃiṃīṃ uṃūṃṛṃṝṃ nābhiṃ pātu tamopahaḥ || 20 ||
ḷṃḹṃeṃaiṃ oṃauṃaṃaḥ liṅgaṃ me'vyād graheśvaraḥ | kaṃkhaṃgaṃghaṃcaṃ chaṃjaṃjhaṃ kaṭiṃ bhānurmamāvatu || 21 ||
ṭaṃṭhaṃḍaṃḍhaṃ taṃthaṃdaṃdhaṃ jānū bhāsvān mamāvatu | paṃphaṃbaṃbhaṃ yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃ jaṅghe me'vyād vibhākaraḥ (k, kh: divākaraḥ) || 22 ||
śaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃlaṃkṣaḥ pātu mūlaṃ pādau trayītanuḥ | ṅaṃñaṃṇaṃnaṃmaṃ me pātu savitā sakalaṃ vapuḥ || 23 ||
somaḥ pūrve ca māṃ pātu bhaumo'gnau māṃ sadāvatu | budho māṃ dakṣiṇe pātu nair(-)ṛtyām gurureva mām || 24 ||
paścime māṃ sitaḥ pātu vāyavyāṃ māṃ śanaiścaraḥ | uttare māṃ tamaḥ pāyādaiśānyāṃ māṃ śikhī tathā || 25 ||
ūrdhvaṃ māṃ pātu mihiro māmadhastājjagatpatiḥ | prabhāte bhāskaraḥ pātu madhyāhne māṃ dineśvaraḥ || 26 ||
sāyaṃ vedapriyaḥ pātu niśīthe visphurāpatiḥ | sarvatra sarvadā sūryaḥ pātu māṃ cakranāyakaḥ || 27 ||
raṇe rājakule dyūte vivāde śatrusaṅkaṭe (kh: deśa) | saṅgrāme ca jvare roge pātu māṃ savitā prabhuḥ || 28 ||
oṃoṃoṃ uta oṃu(-)ūhasamayaḥ (k, kh, g: sahā) sūryo'vatānmāṃ bhayād hrāṃhrīṃhruṃ (k, kh, g: sa) hahahā hasauḥ hasahasauḥ haṃso'vatāt sarvataḥ | saḥsaḥsaḥ sasasā nṛpādvanacarāccaurādraṇāt saṃkaṭāt pāyānmāṃ kulanāyako'pi savitā oṃhrīṃhasauḥ sarvadā || 29 ||
drāṃdrīṃdrūṃ dahanaṃ tathā ca taraṇirbhāṃbhairbhayād bhāskaro rāṃrīṃrūṃ rururūṃ ravirjvarabhayāt kuṣṭhācca śūlāmayāt | aṃaṃāṃ vivivīṃ mahāmayabhayaṃ māṃ pātu mārtaṇḍako mūlavyāptatanuḥ sadāvatu paraṃ haṃsaḥ sahasrāṃśumān || 30 ||
iti śrīkavacaṃ divyaṃ vajrapañjarakābhidham | sarvadevarahasyaṃ ca mātṛkāmantraveṣṭitam (kh: varṇa) || 31 ||
mahārogabhayaghnaṃ ca pāpaghnaṃ manmukhoditam | guhyaṃ yaśaskaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaśreyaskaraṃ śive || 32 ||
likhitvā ravivāre tu tiṣye vā janmabhe priye | aṣṭagandhena divyena sudhākṣīreṇa pārvati || 33 ||
arkakṣīreṇa puṇyena bhūrjatvaci maheśvari | kanakīkāṣṭhalekhanyā kavacaṃ bhāskarodaye || 34 ||
śvetasūtreṇa raktena śyāmenāveṣṭayed guṭīm | sauvarṇenātha saṃveṣṭya dhārayenmūrdhni vā bhuje || 35 ||
p 183>
raṇe ripūñjayed devi vāde sadasi jeṣyati | rājamānyo bhavennityaṃ sarvatejomayo bhavet || 36 ||
kaṇṭhasthā putradā devi kukṣisthā roganāśinī | śiraḥsthā guṭikā divyā rājalokavaśaṅkarī || 37 ||
bhujasthā dhanadā nityaṃ tejobuddhivivardhinī | vandhyā vā kākavandhyā vā mṛtavatsā ca yāṅganā || 38 ||
kaṇṭhe sā dhārayennityaṃ bahuputrā prajāyate | yasya dehe bhavennityaṃ guṭikaiṣā maheśvari || 139 ||
mahāstrāṇīndramuktāni brahmāstrādīni pārvati | taddehaṃ prāpya vyarthāni bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ || 40 ||
trikālaṃ yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ kavacaṃ vajrapañjaram | tasya sadyo mahādevi savitā varado bhavet || 41 ||
ajñātvā kavacaṃ devi pūjayed yastrayītanum | tasya pūjārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ janmakoṭiṣu niṣphalam || 42 ||
śatāvartaṃ paṭhedvarma saptamyāṃ ravivāsare | mahākuṣṭhārdito devi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 43 ||
nīrogo yaḥ paṭhedvarma daridro vajrapañjaram | lakṣmīvāñjāyate devi sadyaḥ sūryaprasādataḥ || 44 ||
bhaktyā yaḥ prapaṭhed devi kavacaṃ pratyahaṃ priye | iha loke śriyaṃ (k, kh, g: sukhaṃ) bhuktvā dehānte muktimāpnuyāt || 45 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye vajrapañjarākhyasūryakavacanirūpaṇaṃ trayastriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 33 ||
atha
[catustriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
devadevi mahādevi sarvābhayavaraprade | tvaṃ me prāṇapriyā prītā varado'haṃ tava sthitaḥ || 1 ||
kiñcit prārthaya me premṇā vakṣye tatte tadāmyaham |
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan devadeveśa mahārudra maheśvara || 2 ||
yadi deyo varo mahyaṃ varayogyāsmyahaṃ yadi | devadevasya saviturvada nāmasahasrakam || 3 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
etadguhyatamaṃ devi sarvasvaṃ mama pārvati | rahasyaṃ sarvadevānāṃ durlabhaṃ kāmanāvaham || 4 ||
yo devo bhagavān sūryo vedakartā prajāpatiḥ | karmasākṣī jagaccakṣuḥ stotuṃ taṃ kena śakyate || 5 ||
yasyādirmadhyamantaṃ ca surairapi na gamyate | tasyādidevadevasya saviturjagadīśituḥ || 6 ||
mantranāmasahasraṃ te vakṣye sāmrājyasiddhidam | sarvapāpāpahaṃ (k, kh: pāpaharaṃ devi tantramantrā) devi tantravedāgamoddhṛtam || 7 ||
māṅgalyaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caiva rakṣoghnaṃ pāvanaṃ mahat | sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 8 ||
dhanadaṃ puṇyadaṃ puṇyaṃ śreyaskaraṃ yaśaskaram |
vakṣyāmi paramaṃ tattvaṃ mūlavidyātmakaṃ param || 9 ||
brahmaṇo yat paraṃ brahma parāṇāmapi yat param | mantrāṇāmapi yat tattvaṃ mahasāmapi yanmahaḥ || 10 ||
śāntānāmapi yaḥ śānto manūnāmapi yo manuḥ | yogināmapi yo yogī vedānāṃ praṇavaśca yaḥ || 11 ||
grahāṇāmapi yo bhāsvān devānāmapi vāsavaḥ | tārāṇāmapi yo rājā vāyūnāṃ ca prabhañjanaḥ || 12 ||
indriyāṇāmapi mano devīnāmapi yaḥ parā | nagānāmapi yo meruḥ pannagānāṃ ca vāsukiḥ || 13 ||
tejasāmapi yo vahniḥ kāraṇānāṃ ca yaḥ śivaḥ | savitā yastu gāyatryāḥ paramātmeti kīrtyate || 14 ||
vakṣye paramahaṃsasya tasya nāmasahasrakam | sarvadāridryaśamanaṃ sarvaduḥkhavināśanam || 15 ||
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradam | jvararogāpamṛtyughnaṃ sadā sarvābhayapradam || 16 ||
tattvaṃ paramatattvaṃ ca sarvasārottamottamam | rājaprasādavijaya lakṣmīvibhavakāraṇam || 17 ||
āyuṣkaraṃ puṣṭikaraṃ sarvayajñaphalapradam | mohanastambhanākṛṣṭi vaśīkaraṇakāraṇam || 18 ||
adātavyamabhaktāya sarvakāmaprapūrakam | śṛṇuṣvāvahitā bhūtvā sūryanāmasahasrakam || 19 ||
asya śrīsūryanāmasahasrasya śrībrahmā ṛṣiḥ gāyatryaṃ chandaḥ śrībhagavān savitā devatā hrāṃ bījaṃ saḥ śaktiḥ hrīṃ kīlakaṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe sūryasahasranāmapāṭhe viniyogaḥ | dhyānam(-)
kalpāntānalakoṭibhāsvaramukhaṃ sindūradhūlījapāvarṇaṃ ratnakirīṭinaṃ dvinayanaṃ śvetābjamadhyāsanam |
nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaṃ smitamukhaṃ raktāmbaraṃ cinmayaṃ sūryaṃ svarṇasarojaratnakalaśau dorbhyāṃ dadhānaṃ bhaje || 1 ||
pratyakṣadevaṃ viśadaṃ sahasramarīcibhiḥ śobhitabhūmideśam | saptāśvagaṃ saddhvajahastamādyaṃ devaṃ bhaje'haṃ mihiraṃ hṛdabje || 2 ||
oṃhrāṃhrīṃsaḥhaṃsaḥsohaṃ (ṅ: hsauḥ haṃsaḥ) savitā (kh: ādityaḥ) bhāskaro bhagaḥ | bhagavān sarvalokeśo bhūteśo bhūtabhāvanaḥ || 3 ||
bhūtātmā sṛṣṭikṛt sraṣṭā kartā hartā jagatpatiḥ | ādityo varado vīro vīralo viśvadīpanaḥ || 4 ||
viśvakṛd viśvahṛd bhakto bhoktā bhīmo'bhayāpahaḥ | viśvātmā puruṣaḥ sākṣī (ṅ: sākṣāt) paraṃ brahma parāt paraḥ || 5 ||
pratāpavān viśvayonirviśveśo viśvatomukhaḥ | kāmī (k: kāmayogī) yogī mahābuddhirmanasvī (gh: mahasvī) manuravyayaḥ || 6 ||
prajāpatirviśvavandyo vandito bhuvaneśvaraḥ | bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyātmā tattvātmā jñānavān guṇī || 7 ||
sāttviko rājasastāmastamasvī karuṇānidhiḥ | sahasrakiraṇo bhāsvān bhārgavo bhṛgurīśvaraḥ || 8 ||
nirguṇo nirmamo (kh: nirmalaḥ) nityo nityānando (g: nirānandaḥ) nirāśrayaḥ | tapasvī kālakṛt kālaḥ kamanīyatanuḥ kṛśaḥ || 9 ||
durdarśaḥ sudaśo dāśo dīnabandhurdayākaraḥ (g: dayānidhiḥ) | dvibhujo'ṣṭabhujo dhīro daśabāhurdaśātigaḥ || 10 ||
daśāṃśaphalado viṣṇurjigīṣurjayavāñjayī | jaṭilo nirbhayo bhānuḥ padmahastaḥ kuśīrakaḥ || 11 ||
samāhitagatirdhātā vidhātā kṛtamaṅgalaḥ | mārtaṇḍo kokadhṛt trātā rudro bhadrapradaḥ prabhuḥ || 12 ||
arātiśamanaḥ śāntaḥ śaṅkaraḥ kamalāsanaḥ | avicintyavapuḥ (100) śreṣṭho mahācīnakrameśvaraḥ (kh: parākramaḥ) || 13 ||
mahārtidamano dānto mahāmohaharo hariḥ | niyatātmā ca kāleśo dineśo bhaktavatsalaḥ || 14 ||
kalyāṇakārī kamaṭhakarkaśaḥ kāmavallabhaḥ | vyomacārī mahān satyaḥ śambhurambhojavallabhaḥ || 15 ||
sāmagaḥ pañcamo dravyo dhruvo dīnajanapriyaḥ | trijaṭo raktavāhaśca raktavastro ratipriyaḥ || 16 ||
kālayogī mahānādo (kh: mahānandaḥ) niścalo dṛśyarūpadhṛk | gambhīraghoṣo nirghoṣo ghaṭahasto mahomayaḥ (k mayomayaḥ) || 17 ||
raktāmbaradharo rakto raktamālyānulepanaḥ | sahasrahasto vijayo harigāmī harīśvaraḥ || 18 ||
muṇḍaḥ kuṇḍī bhujaṅgeśo rathī surathapūjitaḥ | nyagrodhavāsī nyagrodho vṛkṣakarṇaḥ kulandharaḥ (ṅ: dhurandharaḥ) || 19 ||
śikhī caṇḍī jaṭī (k: ghaṭī) jvālī jvālātejomayo vibhuḥ | haimo hemakaro (g: haimakarī) hārī haridratnāsanasthitaḥ || 20 ||
haridaśvo jagadvāsī jagatāṃ patiriṅgilaḥ (kh: iṅginaḥ; ṅ: iṅgitaḥ) | virocano vilāsī ca virūpākṣo vikartanaḥ || 21 ||
vināyako vibhāsaśca bhāso bhāsāṃ patiḥ patiḥ (k: prabhuḥ) | matimān ratimān svakṣo viśālākṣo viśāṃpatiḥ || 22 ||
bālarūpo giricaro gīrpatirgomatīpatiḥ | gaṅgādharo gaṇādhyakṣo gaṇasevyo gaṇeśvaraḥ || 23 ||
girīśanayanāvāsī sarvavāsī satīpriyaḥ | satyātmakaḥ satyadharaḥ (k, kh: dharmā; kh, gh: satyaparaḥ) satyasandhaḥ sahasraguḥ || 24 ||
apāramahimā mukto muktido mokṣakāmadaḥ | mūrtimān (200) dūrdharo'mūrtistuṭirūpo lavātmakaḥ || 25 ||
prāṇeśo vyānado'pānasamānodānarūpavān | caṣako ghaṭikārūpo muhūrto dinarūpavān || 26 ||
pakṣo māsa ṛturvarṣā dinakāleśvareśvaraḥ | ayanaṃ yugarūpaśca kṛtaṃ tretāyugastripāt || 27 ||
dvāparaśca kaliḥ kālaḥ kālātmā kalināśanaḥ | manvantarātmako devaḥ śakrastribhuvaneśvaraḥ (k: śaktiḥ) || 28 ||
vāsavo'gniryamo rakṣo varuṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ | vāyurvaiśravaṇaḥ śaivyo (k: śravyo girijo jaladāsanaḥ) girijo jalajāsanaḥ || 29 ||
ananto'nantamahimā parameṣṭhī gatajvaraḥ | kalpāntakalanaḥ krūraḥ kālāgniḥ kālasūdanaḥ || 30 ||
mahāpralayakṛt kṛtyaḥ kṛtyāśīryugavartanaḥ (k: vartakaḥ) | kālāvarto (gh: kalā) yugadharo yugādiḥ śahakeśvaraḥ || 31 ||
ākāśanidhirūpaśca sarvakālapravartakaḥ | acintyaḥ subalo bālo balākāvallabho varaḥ || 32 ||
varado vīryado vāgmī vākpatirvāgvilāsadaḥ (k, kh: vāgyoniḥ) | sāṃkhyeśvaro vedagamyo mantreśastantranāyakaḥ || 33 ||
kulācāraparo nutyo nutituṣṭo nutipriyaḥ |
alasastulasīsevyastuṣṭā roganivarhaṇaḥ || 34 ||
praskandano vibhāgaśca nīrāgo (kh, gh: nīrogaḥ) daśadikpatiḥ | vairāgyado vimānastho ratnakumbhadharāyudhaḥ || 35 ||
mahāpādo mahāhasto mahākāyo mahāśayaḥ (k: śaniḥ) | ṛgyajuḥsāmarūpaśca tvaṣṭātharvaṇaśākhilaḥ (kh: śālinaḥ) || 36 ||
sahasraśākhī sadvṛkṣo (kh: sadvyaktaḥ) mahākalpapriyaḥ pumān | kalpavṛkṣaśca mandāro (300) mandārācalaśobhanaḥ || 37 ||
merurhimālayo (g, gh: himācalaḥ) mālī malayo malayadrumaḥ | santānakusumacchannaḥ santānaphalado virāṭ || 38 ||
kṣīrāmbhodhirghṛtāmbhodhirjaladhiḥ kleśanāśanaḥ | ratnākaro mahāmānyo vaiṇyo (kh, gh: veṇyo vīṇādharaḥ) veṇudharo vaṇik || 39 ||
vasanto mārasāmanto grīṣmaḥ kalmaṣanāśanaḥ | varṣākālo varṣapatiḥ śaradambhojavallabhaḥ || 40 ||
hemanto hemakeyūraḥ śiśiraḥ śiśuvīryadaḥ | sumatiḥ sugatiḥ sādhurviṣṇuḥ sāmbo'mbikāsutaḥ || 41 ||
sāragrīvo mahārājaḥ sunando nandisevitaḥ | sumeruśikharāvāsī saptapātālagocaraḥ || 42 ||
ākāśacārī nityātmā vibhutvavijayapradaḥ | kulakāntaḥ kulādrīśo (g, gh: kulādhīśo vihārī) vinayī vijayī viyat || 43 ||
viśvambharo viyaccārī (kh, g: viyad vyāpī) viyadrūpo viyadrathaḥ | surathaḥ sugatastutyo veṇuvādanatatparaḥ || 44 ||
gopālo gomayo goptā pratiṣṭhāyī prajāpatiḥ |
āvedanīyo vedākṣo mahādivyavapuḥ surāṭ || 45 ||
nirjīvo jīvano mantrī mahārṇavaninādabhṛt (kh: nādavān) | vasurāvartano nityaḥ sarvāmnāyaprabhuḥ sudhīḥ || 46 ||
nyāyanirvāpaṇaḥ śūlī kapālī padmamadhyagaḥ | trikoṇanilayaścetyo bindumaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ || 47 ||
bahumālo (kh: mālyaḥ) mahāmālo divyamālādharo japaḥ | japākusumasaṅkāśo japapūjāphalapradaḥ || 48 ||
sahasramūrdhā devendraḥ sahasranayano raviḥ | sarvatattvāśrayo bradhno vīravandyo vibhāvasuḥ || 49 ||
viśvāvasurvasupatirvasunātho visargavān | ādirādityalokeśaḥ sarvagāmī (400) kalāśrayaḥ || 50 ||
bhogeśo devadevendro narendro havyavāhanaḥ | vidyādhareśo vidyeśo yakṣeśo rakṣaṇo guruḥ || 51 ||
rakṣaḥkulaikavarado gandharvakulapūjitaḥ | apsarovandito'jayyo jetā daityanivarhaṇaḥ || 52 ||
guhyakeśaḥ piśāceśaḥ kinnarīpūjitaḥ kujaḥ | siddhasevyaḥ samāmnāyaḥ sādhusevyaḥ saritpatiḥ || 53 ||
lalāṭākṣo viśvadeho niyamī niyatendriyaḥ | arko'rkakāntaratneśo'nantabāhuralopakaḥ || 54 ||
alipātradharo'naṅgo'pyambareśo'mbarāśrayaḥ | akāramātṛkānātho devānāmādirākṛtiḥ || 55 ||
ārogyakārī cānandavigraho nigraho grahaḥ | ālokakṛt tathādityo vīrādityaḥ prajādhipaḥ || 56 ||
ākāśarūpaḥ svākāra indrādisurapūjitaḥ |
indirāpūjitaścendurindralokāśrayastvinaḥ (g, gh: sthitaḥ) || 57 ||
īśāna īśvaraścandra (kh: ścendraḥ) īśa īkāravallabhaḥ | unnatāsyo'pyuruvapurunnatādricaro guruḥ (ṅ: guḍaḥ) || 58 ||
utpalo'pyuccalatketuruccairhayagatiḥ sukhī | ukārākārasukhitastathoṣmā nidhirūṣaṇaḥ || 59 ||
anūrusārathiścoṣṇabhānurūkāravallabhaḥ | ṛṇahartā ṝlihasta ṝṛbhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 60 ||
ḷptāṅga (k: kḷptāṅgaḥ) ḹmanusthāyī ḷḹgaṇḍayugojjvalaḥ | eṇāṅkāmṛtadaścīnapaṭṭabhṛd bahugocaraḥ || 61 ||
ekacakradharaścaiko'nekarcakṣustathaikyadaḥ (kh: vaktradharaḥ) | ekārabījaramaṇa eaioṣṭhāmṛtākaraḥ || 62 ||
oṃkārakāraṇaṃ brahma aukāraucityamaṇḍanaḥ | oaudantālirahito mahito mahatāṃ patiḥ || 63 ||
aṃvidyābhūṣaṇo bhūṣyo lakṣmīśo'mbījarūpavān | aḥsvarūpaḥ (500) svaramayaḥ sarvasvaraparātmakaḥ || 64 ||
aṃaḥsvarūpamantrāṅgaḥ (g: svarūpaḥ sakaliḥ) kalikālanivartakaḥ | karmaikavaradaḥ karmasākṣī kalmaṣanāśanaḥ || 65 ||
kacadhvaṃsī ca kapilaḥ kanakācalacārakaḥ | kāntaḥ kāmaḥ kapiḥ krūraḥ kīraḥ keśanisūdanaḥ (k, gh: keśārisūdanaḥ) || 66 ||
kṛṣṇaḥ kāpālikaḥ kubjaḥ kamalāśrayaṇaḥ kulī | kapālamocakaḥ kāśaḥ kāśmīraghanasārabhṛt || 67 ||
kūjatkinnaragīteṣṭaḥ kururājaḥ (kh, g: kularājaḥ) kulandharaḥ | kuvāsī kulakauleśaḥ kakārākṣaramaṇḍanaḥ || 68 ||
khavāsī (ṅ: kharvāsī) kheṭakeśānaḥ khaḍgamuṇḍadharaḥ khagaḥ | khageśvaraśca khacaraḥ (kh: khecaraśca) khecarīgaṇasevitaḥ || 69 ||
kharāṃśuḥ kheṭakadharaḥ khalahartā khavarṇakaḥ | gantā gītapriyo geyo gayāvāsī gaṇāśrayaḥ || 70 ||
guṇātīto golagatirgucchalo guṇisevitaḥ | gadādharo gadaharo (kh: gadāhāraḥ) gāṅgeyavaradaḥ pragī (kh: sudhīḥ) || 71 ||
giṅgilo gaṭilo (g: gajilaḥ) gānto gakārākṣarabhāskaraḥ | ghṛṇimān ghurghurārāvo ghaṇṭāhasto (kh: gajagaṇṭāhatākaraḥ) ghaṭākaraḥ || 72 ||
ghanacchanno ghanagatirghanavāhanatarpitaḥ | ṅānto ṅeśo ṅakārāṅgaścandrakuṅkumavāsitaḥ || 73 ||
candrāśrayaścandradharo'cyutaścampakasannibhaḥ | cāmīkaraprabhaścaṇḍabhānuścaṇḍeśavallabhaḥ || 74 ||
cañcaccakorakokeṣṭaścapalaścapalāśrayaḥ | calatpatākaścaṇḍādriścīvaraikadharo'caraḥ || 75 ||
citkalāvardhitaścintyaścintādhvaṃsī cavarṇavān | chatrabhṛcchalahṛcchandac (kh, g: hṛt) churikācchinnavigrahaḥ || 76 ||
jāmbūnadāṅgado'jāto jinendro jambuvallabhaḥ | jambārirjaṅgiṭo (kh, g: jaṭilaḥ) jaṅgī janalokatamopahaḥ || 77 ||
jayakārī (600) jagaddhartā jarāmṛtyuvināśanaḥ | jagattrātā jagaddhātā jagaddhyeyo (k, kh: yoniḥ) jagannidhiḥ || 78 ||
jagatsākṣī jagaccakṣurjagannāthapriyo'jitaḥ | jakārākāramukuṭo jhañjāchannākṛtirjhaṭaḥ || 79 ||
jhillīśvaro jhakāreśo jhañjāṅgulikarāmbujaḥ | jhañākṣarāñcitaṣṭaṅkaṣṭiṭṭibhāsanasaṃsthitaḥ || 80 ||
ṭītkāraṣṭaṅkadhārī ca ṭhaḥsvarūpaṣṭhaṭhādhipaḥ | ḍambharo ḍāmarurḍiṇḍī ḍāmarīśo ḍalākṛtiḥ || 81 ||
ḍākinīsevito ḍāḍhī ḍaḍhagulphāṅguliprabhaḥ | ṇeśapriyo ṇavarṇeśo ṇakārapadapaṅkajaḥ || 82 ||
tārādhipeśvarastathyastantrīvādanatatparaḥ | tripureśastrinetreśastrayītanuradhokṣajaḥ || 83 ||
tāmastāmaraseṣṭaśca tamohartā tamoripuḥ | tandrāhartā tamorūpastapasāṃ phaladāyakaḥ || 84 ||
tuṭyādikalanākāntastakārākṣarabhūṣaṇaḥ | sthāṇusthalīsthito nityaṃ sthaviraḥ sthaṇḍilaḥ sthulaḥ (kh, g: sthiraḥ) || 85 ||
thakārajānuradhyātmā devanāyakanāyakaḥ (k, kh: dānava) | durjayo duḥkhahā dātā dāridryacchedano damī (kh, g: cchedanodyanī) || 86 ||
daurbhāgyahartā devendro dvādaśārābjamadhyagaḥ | dvādaśāntaikavasatirdvādaśātmā divaspatiḥ || 87 ||
durgamo daityaśamano dūrago duratikramaḥ | durdhyeyo duṣṭavaṃśaghno dayānātho dayākulaḥ || 88 ||
dāmodaro dīdhitimān dakārākṣaramātṛkaḥ | dharmabandhurdharmanidhirdharmarājo dhanapradaḥ || 89 ||
dhanadeṣṭo dhanādhyakṣo dharādarśo dhurandharaḥ | dhūrjaṭīkṣaṇavāsī ca dharmakṣetro dharādhipaḥ || 90 ||
dhārādharo dhurīṇaśca dharmātmā dharmavatsalaḥ | dharābhṛdvallabho dharmī dhakārākṣarabhūṣaṇaḥ || 91 ||
narmapriyo (g, gh: nandipriyaḥ) nandirudro (700) netā nītipriyo nayī | nalinīvallabho nunno nāṭyakṛnnāṭyavardhanaḥ || 92 ||
naranātho nṛpastutyo nabhogāmī namaḥpriyaḥ | namonto namitārātirnaranārāyaṇāśrayaḥ || 93 ||
nārāyaṇo nīlarucirnamrāṅgo nīlalohitaḥ | nādarūpo (kh: nādapriyaḥ) nādamayo nādabindusvarūpakaḥ || 94 ||
nātho nāgapatirnāgo nagarājāśrito nagaḥ | nākasthito'nekavapurnakārākṣaramātṛkaḥ || 95 ||
padmāśrayaḥ paraṃ jyotiḥ pīvarāṃsaḥ puṭeśvaraḥ | prītipriyaḥ premakaraḥ praṇatārtibhayāpahaḥ || 96 ||
paratrātā paradhvaṃsī purāriḥ purasaṃsthitaḥ | pūrṇānandamayaḥ pūrṇatejāḥ pūrṇeśvarīśvaraḥ || 97 ||
paṭolavarṇaḥ paṭimā pāṭaleśaḥ parātmavān | parameśavapuḥ prāṃśuḥ pramattaḥ praṇateṣṭadaḥ || 98 ||
apārapāradaḥ pīnaḥ pītāmbarapriyaḥ paviḥ | pācanaḥ piculaḥ pluṣṭaḥ pramadājanasaukhyadaḥ || 99 ||
pramodī (g, gh: pramadaḥ) pratipakṣaghnaḥ pakārākṣaramātṛkaḥ | phalaṃ bhogāpavargasya phalinīśaḥ phalātmakaḥ || 101 ||
phulladambhojamadhyasthaḥ phulladambhojadhārakaḥ | sphuṭadyotiḥ (gh: sphuṭada dyotī) sphuṭākāraḥ sphaṭikācalacārakaḥ || 102 ||
sphūrjatkiraṇamālī ca phakārākṣarapārśvakaḥ | bālo balapriyo bānto biladhvāntaharo (g, gh: hṛtaḥ) balī || 103 ||
bālādirbarbaradhvaṃsī babvolāmṛtapānakaḥ | budho bṛhaspatirvṛkṣo bṛhadaśvo bṛhadgatiḥ || 104 ||
bapṛṣṭho bhīmarūpaśca bhāmayo bheśvarapriyaḥ |
bhago bhṛgurbhṛgusthāyī bhārgavaḥ kaviśekharaḥ || 105 ||
bhāgyado bhānudīptāṅgo bhanābhiśca bhamātṛkaḥ | mahākālo (800) mahādhyakṣo mahānādo mahāmatiḥ || 106 ||
mahojjvalo manohārī manogāmī manobhavaḥ | mānado mallahā mallo merumandaramandiraḥ || 107 ||
mandāramālābharaṇo mānanīyo manomayaḥ | modito madirāhāro mārtaṇḍo muṇḍamuṇḍitaḥ || 108 ||
mahāvarāho mīneśo meṣago mithuneṣṭadaḥ | madālaso'marastutyo (g: malastutyaḥ) murārivarado manuḥ || 109 ||
mādhavo medinīśaśca madhukaiṭabhanāśanaḥ | mālyavān medhano māro medhāvī musalāyudhaḥ || 110 ||
mukundo murarīśāno marālaphalado madaḥ | madano (g: modanī) modakāhāro makārākṣaramātṛkaḥ || 111 ||
yajvā yajñeśvaro yānto yogināṃ hṛdayasthitaḥ | yātriko yajñaphalado yāyī yāmalanāyakaḥ || 112 ||
yoganidrāpriyo yogakāraṇaṃ yogivatsalaḥ | yaṣṭidhārī ca yantreśo yonimaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ || 113 ||
yuyutsujayado yoddhā yugadharmānuvartakaḥ (kh: yogi) | yoginīcakramadhyastho yugaleśvarapūjitaḥ || 114 ||
yānto yakṣaikatilako yakārākṣarabhūṣaṇaḥ | rāmo ramaṇaśīlaśca ratnabhānū rurupriyaḥ || 115 ||
ratnamaulī (kh: mālī) ratnatuṅgo ratnapīṭhāntarasthitaḥ | ratnāṃśumālī ratnāḍhyo ratnakaṅkaṇanūpuraḥ || 116 ||
ratnāṅgadalasadbāhū ratnapādukamaṇḍitaḥ (kh: mālaika) | rohiṇīśāśrayo rakṣākaro rātriñcarāntakaḥ || 117 ||
rakārākṣararūpaśca lajjābījāśrito lavaḥ | lakṣmībhānurlatāvāsī lasatkāntiśca lokabhṛt || 118 ||
lokāntakaharo lāmāvallabho lomaśo'ligaḥ | loṅgeśvaro liṅganādo līlākārī lalambusaḥ || 119 ||
lakṣmīvāṁllokavidhvaṃsī lakārākṣarabhūṣaṇaḥ | vāmano vīravīrendro vācālo (900) vākpatipriyaḥ || 120 ||
vācāmagocaro vānto vīṇāveṇudharo vanam | vāgbhavo vāliśadhvaṃsī vidyānāyakanāyakaḥ || 121 ||
vakāramātṛkāmauliḥ śāmbhaveṣṭapradaḥ śukaḥ | śaśī śobhākaraḥ śāntaḥ śāntikṛcchamanapriyaḥ || 122 ||
śubhaṅkaraḥ śuklavastraḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīyutaḥ śrutaḥ | śrutigamyaḥ śaradbījamaṇḍitaḥ śiṣṭasevitaḥ || 123 ||
śiṣṭācāraḥ śubhācāraḥ śeṣaḥ śevālatāḍanaḥ | śipiviṣṭaḥ śiviḥ (kh, g: śivaḥ) śukrasevyaḥ śākṣaramātṛkaḥ || 124 ||
ṣaḍānanaḥ ṣaṭkarakaḥ ṣoḍaśasvarabhūṣitaḥ | ṣaṭpadasvanasantoṣī ṣaḍāmnāyapravartakaḥ || 125 ||
ṣaḍrasāsvādasantuṣṭaḥ ṣakārākṣaramātṛkaḥ | sūryabhānuḥ sūrabhānuḥ sūribhānuḥ sukhākaraḥ || 126 ||
samastadaityavaṃśaghnaḥ samastasurasevitaḥ | samastasādhakeśānaḥ samastakulaśekharaḥ || 127 ||
surasūryaḥ sudhāsūryaḥ svaḥsūryaḥ sākṣareśvaraḥ | haritsūryo haridbhānurhavirbhug havyavāhanaḥ || 128 ||
hālāsūryo homasūryo hutasūryo harīśvaraḥ | hrāṃbījasūryo hrīṃsūryo hakārākṣaramātṛkaḥ || 129 ||
laṃbījamaṇḍitaḥ sūryaḥ kṣoṇīsūryaḥ kṣamāpatiḥ | kṣutsūryaḥ kṣāntasūryaśca laṃkṣaḥsūryaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 130 ||
akārasūryaḥ kṣaḥsūryaḥ sarvasūryaḥ kṛpānidhiḥ | bhūḥsūryaśca bhuvaḥsūryaḥ svaḥsūryaḥ sūryanāyakaḥ || 131 ||
grahasūrya ṛkṣasūryo lagnasūryo maheśvaraḥ | rāśisūryo yogasūryo mantrasūryo manūttamaḥ || 132 ||
tattvasūryaḥ parāsūryo viṣṇusūryaḥ pratāpavān | rudrasūryo brahmasūryo vīrasūryo varottamaḥ || 133 ||
dharmasūryaḥ karmasūryo viśvasūryo vināyakaḥ | (1000) itīdaṃ devadeveśi mantranāmasahasrakam || 134 ||
devadevasya savituḥ sūryasyāmitatejasaḥ | sarvasāramayaṃ divyaṃ brahmatejovivardhanam || 135 ||
brahmajñānamayaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyatīrthaphalapradam | sarvayajñaphalaistulyaṃ sarvasārasvatapradam || 136 ||
sarvaśreyaskaraṃ loke kīrtidaṃ dhanadaṃ param | sarvavrataphalodriktaṃ sarvadharmaphalapradam || 137 ||
sarvarogaharaṃ devi śarīrārogyavardhanam | prabhāvamasya deveśi nāmnāṃ sahasrakasya ca || 138 ||
kalpakoṭiśatairvarṣairnaiva śaknomi varṇitum | yaṃ yaṃ kāmamabhiṃdhyāyed devānāmapi durlabham || 139 ||
taṃ taṃ prāpnoti sahasā paṭhanenāsya pārvati ( kh, g: sundari) | yaḥ paṭhecchrāvayedvāpi ṛṇoti niyatendriyaḥ || 140 ||
sa vīro dharmiṇāṃ rājā lakṣmīvānapi jāyate | dhanavāñjāyate loke putravān rājavallabhaḥ || 141 ||
āyurārogyavān nityaṃ sa bhavet saṃpadāṃ padam | ravau paṭhenmahādevi sūryaṃ saṃpūjya kaulikaḥ || 142 ||
sūryodaye raviṃ dhyātvā labhet kāmān yathepsitān | saṃkrāntau yaḥ paṭhed devi trikālaṃ bhaktipūrvakam || 143 ||
iha loke śriyaṃ bhuktvā sarvarogaiḥ pramucyate | saptamyāṃ śuklapakṣe yaḥ paṭhedastaṃgate ravau || 144 ||
sarvārogyamayaṃ dehaṃ dhārayet kaulikottamaḥ | vyatīpāte paṭhed devi madhyāhne saṃyatendriyaḥ || 145 ||
dhanaṃ putrān yaśo mānaṃ labhet sūryaprasādataḥ | cakrārcane paṭhed devi japan mūlaṃ raviṃ smaran || 146 ||
ravībhūtvā mahācīnakramācāravicakṣaṇaḥ | sarvaśatrūn vijityāśu labhellakṣmīṃ pratāpavān || 147 ||
yaḥ paṭhet paradeśastho vaṭukārcanatatparaḥ | kāntāśrito vītabhayo bhavet sa śivasannibhaḥ || 148 ||
śatāvartaṃ paṭhedyastu sūryodayayugāntare | savitā sarvalokeśo varadaḥ sahasā bhavet || 149 ||
bahunātra kimuktena paṭhanādasya pārvati | iha lakṣmīṃ sadā bhuktvā paratrāpnoti tatpadam || 150 ||
ravau devi likhedbhūrje mantranāmasahasrakam | aṣṭagandhena divyena nīlapuṣpaharidrayā || 151 ||
pañcāmṛtauṣadhībhiśca nṛyukpīyūṣabindubhiḥ | vilikhya vidhivanmantrī yantramadhye'rṇaveṣṭitam || 152 ||
guṭīṃ vidhāya saṃveṣṭya mūlamantramanusmaran |
kanyākartitasūtreṇa veṣṭayedraktalākṣayā || 153 ||
suvarṇena ca saṃveṣṭya pañcagavyena śodhayet (kh, g: mūlamantreṇa mantrayet) | sādhayenmantrarājena dhārayenmūrdhni vā bhuje || 154 ||
kiṃ kiṃ na sādhayed devi yanmamāpi sudurlabham | kuṣṭharogī ca śūlī ca pramehī kukṣirogavān || 155 ||
bhagandharāturo'pyarśī aśmarīvāṃśca kṛcchravān | mucyate sahasā dhṛtvā guṭīmetāṃ sudurlabhām || 156 ||
vandhyā ca kākavandhyā ca mṛtavatsā ca kāminī | dhārayedguṭikāmetāṃ vakṣasi smayatarpitā || 157 ||
vandhyā labhet sutaṃ kāntaṃ kākavandhyāpi pārvati | mṛtavatsā bahūn putrān surūpāṃśa cirāyuṣaḥ || 158 ||
raṇe gatvā guṭīṃ dhṛtvā śatrūñjitvā labhecchriyam | akṣatāṅgo mahārājaḥ sukhī svapuramāviśet || 159 ||
yo dhārayed bhuje nityaṃ rājalokavaśaṅkarīm | guṭikāṃ mohanākarṣastambhanoccāṭanakṣamām || 150 ||
sa bhavet sūryasaṅkāśo mahasā mahasāṃ nidhiḥ | dhanena dhanado devi vibhavena ca śaṃkaraḥ || 161 ||
śriyendro yaśasā rāmaḥ pauruṣeṇa ca bhārgavaḥ | girā bṛhaspatirdevi nayena bhṛgunandanaḥ || 162 ||
balena vāyusaṅkāśo dayayā puruṣottamaḥ | ārogyeṇa ghaṭodbhūtiḥ kāntyā pūrṇendusannibhaḥ || 163 ||
dharmeṇa dharmarājaśca ratnai ratnākaropamaḥ | gāmbhīryeṇa tathāmbhodhirdātṛtvena baliḥ svayam || 164 ||
siddhyā śrībhairavaḥ sākṣādānandena cidīśvaraḥ |
kiṃ pralāpena bahunā paṭhedvā dhārayecchive || 165 ||
śṛṇuyād yaḥ paraṃ divyaṃ sūryanāmasahasrakam | sa bhaved bhāskaraḥ sākṣāt paramānandavigrahaḥ || 166 ||
svatantraḥ sa prayātyante tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam | idaṃ divyaṃ mahat tattvaṃ sūryanāmasahasrakam || 167 ||
aprakāśyamadātavyamavaktavyaṃ durātmane | abhaktāya kucailāya paraśiṣyāya pārvati || 168 ||
karkaśāyākulīnāya durjanāyāghabuddhaye | gurubhaktivihīnāya nindakāya śivāgame || 169 ||
deyaṃ śiṣyāya śāntāya gurubhaktiparāya ca | kulīnāya subhaktāya sūryabhaktiratāya ca || 170 ||
idaṃ tattvaṃ (gh: idaṃ bhadraṃ) hi tattvānāṃ vedāgamarahasyakam | sarvamantramayaṃ gopyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 171 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye sūryasahasranāmanirūpaṇaṃ catustriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 34 || atha
[pañcatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devi vakṣyāmi strotraṃ mantranirūpaṇam | pañcamāṅgamayaṃ tattvaṃ sarvāpattāraṇaṃ dhruvam || 1 ||
aṣṭasiddhimayaṃ sādhyaṃ siddhidaṃ buddhivardhanam | sarvāmayapraśamanaṃ tejobalavivardhanam || 2 ||
mahādāridryaharaṇaṃ putrapautrapradaṃ śive | bhogāpavargadaṃ loke rahasyaṃ mama pārvati || 3 ||
stotrasyāsya mahādevi ṛṣirbrahmā smīritaḥ | gāyatryaṃ chanda ityuktaṃ devatā savitā smṛtaḥ || 4 ||
bījaṃ ca vyoṣamākhyātaṃ māyā śaktiritīritā | praṇavaḥ kīlakaṃ devi viśvaṃ digbandhanaṃ tataḥ || 5 ||
bhogāpavargasiddhyarthaṃ viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
asya śrīsūryastotramantrasya śrībrahmā ṛṣiḥ gāyatryaṃ chandaḥ savitā devatā hrāṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ oṃ kīlakaṃ namo digbandhanaṃ bhogāpavargasiddhyarthe pāṭhe viniyogaḥ || dhyānam(-)
dedīpyamānamukuṭaṃ maṇikuṇḍalamaṇḍitam | visphurāliṅgitaṃ dhyātvā stotrametadudīrayet || 6 ||
kalpāntānalakoṭibhāsvaramukhaṃ sindūradhūlījapāvarṇaṃ ratnakirīṭinaṃ dvinayanaṃ śvetābjamadhyāsanam | nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaṃ smitamukhaṃ raktāmbaraṃ cinmayaṃ sūryaṃ svarṇasarojaratnakalaśau dorbhyāṃ dadhānaṃ bhaje || 7 ||
vedādyaṃ nādabindusphuritaśaśikalālaṅkṛtaṃ mantramūlaṃ yo dhyāyedvedavidyādhyayanavirahito jāḍyapūrṇo daridraḥ | sadyaḥ sa kṣoṇipālojjvalamukuṭalasadratnanīrājitāṅghrirvāgīśaṃ jeṣyate (k, kh, g: jīyate) drāk surasadasi sudhāpūritābhiśca vāgbhiḥ || 8 ||
śivākāraṃ vahniṃ śaśadharakalābindulalitaṃ vibho dhyāyeccitte manumukuṭaratnaṃ japati yaḥ |
sa saṃgrāme jitvā sakalaripusaṅghātamacirād bhavet samrāḍ bhūmau vrajati hi parāsustava padam || 9 ||
vyomānalārūḍhamiti smared yo vāmākṣibindvīndukalābhirāmam | gadyādipadyāmṛtavarṣiṇī vāg vaktre vibho tasya karasthitā śrīḥ || 10 ||
śaktiṃ bhaktiyuto japedyadi manormadhye smaran bhāskaraṃ rogārto nijaśaktikāmarasiko hālārasenālasaḥ | vīro vīryamayo nirāmayavapurbhūtveha bhuktvā śriyaṃ svargastrījanavījitaḥ sa bhagavan dhāmāvyayaṃ yāsyati || 11 ||
sūryāyetyabhidhākṣarāṇi japate yo deva sūryodaye mūkaḥ śokayuto mahāmayamayo (kh: mahābhaya) dāridryapīḍākulaḥ | sadyo gadyasupadyasārasaralā niryāti vāṇī mukhāt tasyārogyatanorbhavanti bhagavan vaśyāḥ sadā saṃpadaḥ || 12 ||
viśvaṃ viśvamanorvibho'ñcalagataṃ yo mānase sañjaped rātrau kāmakalāsamāhitatanuḥ kāmāturaḥ kautukī | kāmaṃ hanta tilottamottamatamā kāmābhirāmā'samā sadyastasya vaśībhaviṣyati majātejasvino māninaḥ || 13 ||
maṇimukuṭamarīcisphītabhāsvallalāṭaṃ kanakakalaśadivyāmbhojahastārabindam | nikhilanigamagamyaṃ visphurāliṅgitāṅgaṃ manasi sarasijeṣṭaṃ sūryamīśaṃ namāmi || 14 ||
bhūgehaśobhitapa(su)rāraṇabhūṣitāṣṭapatrāñcitātmavasukoṇasurāśra bindau |
devaṃ niṣaṇamuditāṃśusahasrabhāsvraddehaṃ bhajāmi bhagavantamanantamādyam || 15 ||
iti stotraṃ mantrātmakamakhilatantroddhṛtamidaṃ paṭhet prātaḥsnāto mihirabhuvaneśasya bhavataḥ | bhaved bhogī bhūmau vibhavasahitaḥ kīrtisahitaḥ paratrānte viṣṇorvrajati paramaṃ dhāma savituḥ || 16 ||
itīdaṃ devi pañcāṅgaṃ devadevasya bhāsvataḥ | tava snehānmayākhyātaṃ nākhyeyaṃ yasya kasyacit || 17 ||
yadgṛhe vartate puṇyaṃ pañcāṅgaṃ paramātmanaḥ | savituḥ sarvasarvasvaṃ (g: tattva) rahasyaṃ guhyamuttamam || 18 ||
tadgṛhe niścalā lakṣmīrdāsīva vasatiṃ caret | nāgnibhītirna dāridryaṃ na rogo nāpyupadravaḥ || 19 ||
na rājabhītirno śokaḥ sadā sarvārthasaṃpadaḥ (k, kh: sarvadā saṃpado gṛhe) | idaṃ tattvaṃ hi tattvānāṃ rahasyaṃ devadurlabham || 20 ||
adātavyamabhaktāya dātavyaṃ ca mahātmane | guhyātiguhyaguhyaṃ ca sūryapañcāṅgamuttamam || 21 ||
sarvadā sarvathā gopyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat |
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye sūryastotranirūpaṇaṃ pañcatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 35 ||
samāptaṃ sūryapañcāṅgam ||
atha
[ṣaṭtriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇapañcāṅgam |
śrībhairava uvāca |
kailāsottuṅgaśikhare ratnarājivirājite | kalpadrumavanākīrṇe svarṇapāṣāṇamaṇḍite || 1 ||
padmarāgaśilāmuktā maṇimāṇikyabhūṣite | vasantakusumāmoda gandhavāhaikavāhini || 2 ||
navaratnaśilābhadra (kh: baddha) pīṭhasthaṃ parameśvaram | devadevaṃ jagannāthaṃ pārvatīsahitaṃ vibhum || 3 ||
vasantaṃ (g: ramantaṃ) ca japantaṃ ca dhyāyantaṃ brahma śāśvatam | pannagābharaṇopetaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam || 4 ||
kapālakhaṭvāṅgakaraṃ varābhayadharaṃ haram | devadānavayakṣendra piśācoragasevitam || 5 ||
gaṇagandharvasiddhaugha nāradārcitamavyayam | prasannavadanaṃ devaṃ devī dṛṣṭvā maheśvaram || 6 ||
praṇamyotthāya sahasā baddhāñjalipuṭaṃ puraḥ | uvāca pārvatī devī (k: dīnā) śivaṃ trailokyanāyakam || 7 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan devadeveśa devāsuranamaskṛta | tvaṃ śivaḥ sarvalokeśaḥ satyaḥ saccitsvarūpakaḥ || 8 ||
anantaḥ paramātmeti trijagatkāraṇaṃ prabhuḥ | udbhūtisthitikṛnnityaṃ layakṛd bhuvaneśvaraḥ || 9 ||
anādinidhano devastriguṇātmāpi nirguṇaḥ | kiṃ tat paraṃ mahattattvaṃ yajjapasyadya santatam || 10 ||
tattattvaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvatto bhaktāsmi kiṅkarī |
śrībhairava uvāca |
lakṣavārasahasrāṇi vāritāsi punaḥ punaḥ | strīsvabhāvānmahādevi punarmāṃ paripṛcchasi || 11 ||
bhaktyānayā prasanno'haṃ tava pārvati tattvataḥ | etadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ vakṣye guhyaṃ divaukasām || 12 ||
avaktavyamidaṃ tattvamadātavyaṃ maheśvari | tava snehena vakṣyāmi nacākhyeyaṃ mahātmabhiḥ || 13 ||
yo devadevo varado lakṣmīnārāyaṇo vibhuḥ (kh: prabhuḥ) | sargasthitikaro loke pralayāntakaro laye || 14 ||
sa eva parameśāno devapannagarakṣasām | daityakinnarayakṣendra manujānalapāthasām || 15 ||
brahmādikīṭaparyanta jagattritayakāraṇam | adhyakṣaḥ sāttvikaḥ sarvabhūtātmā parameśvaraḥ || 16 ||
tasya devasya pañcāṅgaṃ paṭalaṃ paddhatiṃ śive | kavacaṃ tattvabhūtaṃ ca mantranāmasahasrakam || 17 ||
stotraṃ japāmi deveśi smarāmi manasā sadā | paṭhāmyaharniśaṃ śāntaḥ paramānandakāraṇam || 18 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
pañcāṅgaṃ devadevasya lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya vai | śrotumicchāmyahaṃ nātha vaktumarhasi sāṃpratam || 19 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
paramārthapradaṃ devi pañcāṅgaṃ sarvasiddhidam | vakṣyāmi parameśasya lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya te || 20 ||
tatradau paṭalaṃ vakṣye mūlavidyārahasyakam | mantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya te || 21 ||
aṣṭasiddhiṃpradaṃ sadyaḥ sādhakānāṃ sudurlabham | tāraṃ parā ca haritaṃ parā lakṣmīstato'bhidham || 22 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇāyeti viśvamante manuḥ smṛtaḥ | nāsya vighno navā doṣo na bhītirna viparyayaḥ || 23 ||
sākṣānmokṣaprado mantraḥ sarvārthaphaladāyakaḥ | varṇalakṣapuraścaryāṃ vināyaṃ cāsti doṣabhāk || 24 ||
jīvahīno yathā dehaḥ sarvakarmasu na kṣamaḥ | puraścaraṇahīno'pi na mantraḥ phaladāyakaḥ || 25 ||
vaṭe'raṇye śmaśāne ca śūnyāgāre catuṣpathe | ardharātre ca madhyāhne puraścaraṇamācaret (kh: mādiśet) || 26 ||
varṇalakṣaṃ puraścaryāṃ tadardhaṃ vā maheśvari | ekalakṣāvadhiṃ kuryānnāto nyūnaṃ kadācana || 27 ||
prathamaṃ guruhastena sādhakasya kareṇa vā | tataḥ svayaṃ caredbahvīḥ puraścaryā vidhānataḥ || 28 ||
japād daśāṃśato homastaddaśāṃśena tarpaṇam | mārjanaṃ taddaśāṃśena taddaśāṃśena bhojanam || 29 ||
vinā daśāṃśahomena na tatphalamavāpnuyāt | pañcaratneśvarīṃ vidyāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya hi || 30 ||
japet tāṃ pañcabhiḥ sārdhaṃ puraścaryāphalaṃ labhet | atha mantrasya deveśi saṃskāravidhimācaret || 31 ||
vidhinā yena sadyastu sādhakaḥ siddhibhāgbhavet | utkīlayenmanuṃ devi tataḥ sañjīvayet punaḥ || 32 ||
vidyāṃ śāpaharīṃ devi japet sadguruvaktrataḥ | siddhaṃ mantraṃ japedante punaḥ saṃpuṭitaṃ caret || 33 ||
eṣa yogavaro mantro yogināṃ durlabhaḥ kalau | athotkīlanamācakṣe mantrasyāsya maheśvari || 34 ||
parārṇaṃ haritaṃ bhūtiṃ māṃ nāma sakalāṃ paṭhet | viśvānte praṇavo devi sakṛduccārayet sudhīḥ || 35 ||
mantrotkīlanametat syāt sarvatattvamayaṃ śive | mantrasañjīvanaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu pārvati sādaram || 36 ||
parā vibhūtirmā tāraṃ nāmānte viśvamīritam | sañjīvanākhyo gadito mantrarājo maheśvari || 37 ||
śivena varṇitāṃ vidyāṃ śive śāpaharīṃ japet | vakṣyāmi tava bhaktyāhaṃ guhyāṃ sarvārthadāyinīm || 38 ||
tāraṃ parā virdeveśi brahmaśāpaṃ tataḥ paṭhet | mocaya dvayamuddhṛtya parā mā ṭhadvayaṃ japet || 39 ||
vidyeyaṃ durlabhā loke lakṣmīnārāyaṇapriyā | siddhaṃ mantraṃ japenmantrī punaḥ saṃpuṭitaṃ caret || 40 ||
saṃpuṭasya manuṃ vakṣye sarvāgamasamuddhṛtam | viśvamādau manuṃ paścānnāma cānte japet priye || 141 ||
saṃpuṭākhyo manurdevi varṇito'yaṃ phalāptaye |
mantrasyāsya mahādevi varṇito'tra ṛṣiḥ śivaḥ || 42 ||
triṣṭup chando mayākhyātaṃ devatāpi samīritā | lakṣmīnārāyaṇo devi bījaṃ lakṣmīrudāhṛtā || 43 ||
śaktiḥ parā tathā tāraṃ kīlakaṃ samudāhṛtam | bhogāpavargasiddhyarthaṃ viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 44 ||
dhyānamasya pravakṣyāmi lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya te | yenaiva dhyānamātreṇa lakṣmīḥ sannidhimeṣyati || 45 ||
pūrṇenduvadanaṃ pītavasanaṃ kamalāsanam | lakṣmyāśritaṃ caturbāhuṃ lakṣmīnārāyanaṃ bhaje || 46 ||
tāramābhūtibījaistu ṣaḍdīrghāntairmaheśvari | nyāsaṃ kuryāt ṣaḍaṅgādi karaśuddhyādipūrvakam || 47 ||
yantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvāśāsiddhidaṃ param | sarvasaṃmohanaṃ yantraṃ vāñchitaikapradāyakam || 48 ||
bindustrikoṇaṃ vasvaśraṃ vṛttāṣṭadalamaṇḍitam | ṣoḍaśāraṃ ravṛttaṃ ca bhūgṛheṇopaśobhitam || 49 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyaitacchrīcakraṃ paramārthadam | layāṅgaṃ devi vakṣyāmi bhogamokṣaphalapradam || 50 ||
vedāgamarahasyāḍhyaṃ pūjākoṭiphalapradam | vajraśaktidaṇḍakhaḍga pāśayaṣṭidhvajāstataḥ || 51 ||
śūlaṃ pūjyāḥ śive caite bāhyadvāreṣu sarvadā | indrāgniyamamāṃsāda varuṇānilavittadāḥ || 52 ||
seśvarāḥ sādhakaiḥ pūjyā brahmānantādayastataḥ | keśavaṃ mādhavaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ govindaṃ madhusūdanam || 53 ||
gaṅgādharaṃ śaṅkhadharaṃ cakrapāṇiṃ caturbhujam | padmāyudhaṃ kaiṭabhāriṃ ghoradaṃṣṭraṃ janārdanam || 54 ||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ vāmanaṃ caiva pūjayed garuḍadhvajam | ṣoḍaśāreṣu deveśi vāmāvartena sādhakaḥ || 55 ||
tatrārcayenmahādevi mantrī gurucatuṣṭayam | asitāṅgaṃ haṃsaketuṃ vaṃśīpāṇiṃ ca pūjayet || 56 ||
vṛttatrayeṣu deveśi sādhako gandhapuṣpakaiḥ | saṃhāraṃ rurukaṃ caṇḍaṃ bhūteśaṃ kālabhairavam || 57 ||
kapālaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ (kapālibhīṣaṇau iti sādhuḥ pāṭhaḥ) caiva tathā śmaśānabhairavam | pūjayet sādhakaḥ siddhyai vasupatre maheśvari || 58 ||
viṣṇuṃ ca vāsudevaṃ ca devaṃ dāmodaraṃ tathā | nṛsiṃhaṃ ca mahādevi devaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ tathā || 59 ||
trivikramaṃ cāniruddhaṃ viśvaksenaṃ ca sādhakaḥ | lakṣmīśabdāṅkitaṃ devi vasukoṇeṣu pūjayet || 60 ||
gaṅgāṃ ca yamunāṃ caiva tryaśre sarasvatīṃ tathā | pūjayedagravahnīśakramayogena pārvati || 61 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ pūjayed bindumaṇḍale | mahālakṣmīṃ rājyalakṣmīṃ siddhalakṣmīṃ ca pūjayet || 62 ||
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ pūjayed bindumaṇḍale | gandhākṣataprasūnādi gurumālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ || 63 ||
saṃpūjyāmṛtakumbhasthairbindubhirmantrapūjitaiḥ | tarpayet sādhako devaṃ makāraiḥ pañcabhiḥ param || 64 ||
layāṅgametadākhyātaṃ prayogānaṣṭa pārvati | vakṣye yena bhavet siddhirmantrasyāsya viśeṣataḥ || 65 ||
stambhanaṃ mohanaṃ caiva māraṇākarṣaṇau tataḥ | vaśīkāraṃ tathoccāṭaṃ śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ tataḥ || 66 ||
eteṣāṃ sādhanaṃ vakṣye prayogāṇāṃ maheśvari | eṣāṃ sādhanamātreṇa mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate || 67 ||
ravau snātvā mahādevi gatvāśvatthatarostalam | japedayutamīśāni hunet tatra daśāṃśataḥ || 68 ||
ghṛtamatsyaṇḍaguḍajaiḥ puṣpairānandamiśritaiḥ | stambhanaṃ jāyate sadyo vādivātārkapāthasām || 69 ||
candre'rdharātravelāyāṃ gatvā śṛṅgāṭakaṃ sudhīḥ | diśo baddhvāsanaṃ śodhya prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya ca || 70 ||
japenmūlaṃ hariṃ dhyātvā hutvā devi daśāṃśataḥ | ghṛtanāgarapunnāga karañjakusumāni ca || 71 ||
tarpayitvā daśāṃśena mārjayitvā maheśvari | tadbhasmanā cared bhāle tilakaṃ sādhakottamaḥ || 72 ||
trailokyaṃ sahasā dṛṣṭvā mohameṣyati tanmukham | bhaume gatvā śmaśānaṃ ca japedayutasaṃkhyayā || 73 ||
huned daśāṃśato devi sarpirgodhūmapāyasam | dūrvāpatraṃ sāsavaṃ ca mṛtyuśca mriyate kṣaṇāt || 74 ||
budhe gatvāṭavīṃ dūraṃ japej jhaṃjhātaṭe śive | ayutaṃ mūlamantraṃ ca hunet sarpiryavākaṇān || 75 ||
dūrvāpūtāsapadmākṣapatrāṇi kusumāni ca | rambhāpi puratastasya sadyaḥ prādurbhaviṣyati || 76 ||
gurau gatvā nadītīraṃ japet tatra daśāṃśataḥ | hunedājyena madhunā śaṭīcandrakarīrakān || 77 ||
tadbhasmanā sādhitena trailokyaṃ vaśyameṣyati | śukre'śokataruṃ gatvā japedayutasaṃkhyayā || 78 ||
hunet sarpirnāgapaṭaṃ śālicūrṇaṃ tuṣākulam |
tarpayedāsavājyekṣu rasairbhuktvā daśāṃśataḥ || 79 ||
śatroḥ śambhusamānasya bhaveduccāṭanaṃ dhruvam | śanau gatvā nadītīraṃ japedayutasaṃkhyayā || 80 ||
homo daśāṃśataḥ kāryo ghṛtapāyasakuṅkumaiḥ | sāraṇālairjambuphalaiḥ śāntikaṃ jāyate kṣaṇāt || 81 ||
śubharkṣe śubhavāre vā gatvopavanamaṇḍalam | japedayutamīśāni hunedājyena paṅkajaiḥ || 82 ||
sotpalaṃ sakaṇaṃ sāmlaṃ mahāpuṣṭiḥ prajāyate | etadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ tava bhaktyā mayoditam || 83 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyedaṃ sarvasvaṃ paramārthadam | adātavyamabhaktebhyo duṣṭebhyo vīravandite || 84 ||
mahācīnapadasthebhyo bhogadaṃ mokṣadaṃ kalau | gopyaṃ guhyatamaṃ tattvaṃ guhyādguhyatamaṃ śive | ānandakāraṇaṃ gopyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 85 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye lakṣmīnārāyaṇapaṭalanirūpaṇaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 36 || atha
[saptatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devi vakṣye'haṃ gadyapadyaikarūpiṇīm | paddhatiṃ nityapūjāyā lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya te || 1 ||
brāhme muhūrte utthāya baddhapadmāsanaḥ svaśiraḥsthasahasrārādhomukhakamalakarṇikāntargataṃ nijaguruṃ śvetālaṅkārālaṅkṛtaṃ dhyātvā mānasairupacārairabhyarcya tadagre mūlaṃ svaśaktyā japtvā tajjapaṃ gurave samarpya tadājñāmādāya bahirāgatya dūraṃ malādi saṃtyajya varṇoktaṃ śaucamādāya nadyādau gatvā oṃklīṃ sarvajanapriyāya kāmadevāya namaḥ iti dantān viśodhya ātmaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā mṛttrayaṃ mūlena saṃśodhya malāpakarṣaṇaṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā mantrasnānaṃ caret | tatra mṛdā oṃgāṃgūṃ gaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati | narmade sindhukāveri jale'smin saṃnidhiṃ kuru || ityaṅkuśamudrayāvāhya mṛdā mūlaṃ deveśa bhaktisulabha parivārasamanvita | yāvat tvāṃ tarpayiṣyāmi tāvad deva ihāvaha || ityāvāhanādimudrāḥ pradarśya dhenuyonimatsyamudrāḥ pradarśya mṛdamaṅge vilipya jale tryaśraṃ vibhāvya tryaśre mūlaṃ vilikhya tatra mūlamuccaraṃstrirunmajjet | tataḥ sūryāyārghyatrayaṃ dadyāt oṃhrīṃhaṃsaḥ śrīsūryāya eṣa te'rgho namaḥ ityarghyatrayaṃ dattvā jalādāruhya vāsāṃsi (k, kh: vāsasī) paridhāpya dehaśuddhiṃ vidhāya mūlarṣinyāsādi vidhāya mūlaṃ yathāśaktyā japtvā'ghamarṣaṇaṃ kuryāt | vāmahaste jalaṃ dhṛtvā dakṣahastenācchādya yaṃraṃvaṃlaṃhaṃ iti saptadhābhimantrya tadgalitodakabindubhirmūlamuccaraṃścaturdaśadhā śiraḥ prokṣyāvaśiṣṭajalaṃ dakṣahaste dhṛtveḍayāntarnītvā pāpaṃ prakṣālya tajjalaṃ kaluṣaṃ vāmanāsāpuṭena bahī recayitvā vāmamārgasthaśilāyāmāsphālayedityaghamarṣaṇam (kh: bhāgastha) |
tataḥ pūrvavannyāsaṃ vidhāya gāyatrīṃ japet oṃhrīṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇāya vidmahe hsauḥ parabrahmaṇe dhīmahi hrīṃśrīṃ tannaḥ paramātmā pracodayāt (3) | iti yathāśaktyā japtvā anayā śrīgāyatryā sāṅgāya savāhanāya saparicchadāya saśaktikāya śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇāya eṣa te'rgho namaḥ ityarghyatrayaṃ dattvā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā iḍayā piba ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pavanaṃ kuru ṣaṣṭicatuṣṭayamantaragam (gh, ṅ: caturuttaraṣaṣṭi tato adhikam) | tyaja piṅgalayā śanakaiḥ śanakairdaśabhirdaśabhirdaśabhirdvyadhikaiḥ (gh, ṅ: sahitam) || itthaṃ prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ vidhāya oṃhrīṃ ātmatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā oṃhrīṃ vidyātattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā oṃhrīṃ śivatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā ityācamya pūrvavat sūryāyārghyatrayaṃ dattvā jale yantraṃ dhyātvā tatra yathāśaktyā tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt | mūlamuccārya
śrīsāṅgaḥ savāhanaḥ saparivāraḥ sadevīkaḥ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ tṛpyatāmiti triḥ santarpya mūlavidyākṣaramuccārya ekaikāñjalinā parivārān santarpya devarṣipitṝn santarpya pūrvavat sūryāyārghyatrayaṃ dattvā (saṃhāramudrayā devatāṃ praṇamya) yāgamaṇḍapaṃ praviśediti sandhyāvidhiḥ ||
tatra gṛhamāgatya pādau prakṣālya dvāramabhyukṣya dehalyagrataścaturaśravṛttamaṇḍalaṃ vilikhya tatra kṣālitādhāraṃ saṃsthāpya astrāya phaḍiti sādhāraṃ pātraṃ saṃsthāpya oṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ iti hṛnmantreṇāpūrya oṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇasāmānyārghyāya namaḥ ityabhyarcya gaṅge iti tīrthamāvāhya dhenumudrāṃ pradarśya dvāramabhiṣecayediti sāmānyārghyavidhiḥ || pūrve gaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ dakṣiṇe vāṃ vaṭukāya namaḥ paścime kṣāṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ uttare yāṃ yoginībhyo namaḥ dakṣe gāṃ gaṅgāyai namaḥ vāme yaṃ yamunāyai namaḥ ūrdhve saṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ adho dehalyāṃ astrāya phaṭ iti dvāradevīḥ saṃpūjya dvārāntaḥ praviśya vihitāsane upaviśya mūlena nirīkṣya kavacenābhyukṣya astrāya phaḍiti santāḍya pūjāmaṇḍapaṃ sadhūpitaṃ kṛtvā viṣṭaraśuddhiṃ kuryāt | oṃāṃ āsanaśodhanamantrasya merupṛṣṭha ṛṣiḥ sutalaṃ chandaḥ kūrmo devatā āsanaśodhane viniyogaḥ | prīṃ pṛthivyai namaḥ oṃ mahi tvayā dhṛtā lokā devi tvaṃ viṣṇunā dhṛtā | tvaṃ ca dhāraya māṃ loke (kh: devi) pavitraṃ kuru cāsanam || oṃkrāṃ ādhāraśaktikamalāsanāya namaḥ anantāya namaḥ padmāya namaḥ padmanālāya namaḥ tatropaviśya tālatrayaṃ dattvā apasarpantu te bhūtā ye bhūtā bhuvi saṃsthitāḥ | ye bhūtā vighnakartāraste naśyantu śivājñayā || iti vāmapārṣṇighātatrayeṇa vighnānutsārya nārācamudrāṃ pradarśayet iti āsanaṃ saṃśodhya guruṃ praṇamet | akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaram | tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || gurubhyo namaḥ paramagurubhyo namaḥ parāparagurubhyo namaḥ parameṣṭhigurubhyo namaḥ iti śirasi saṃpūjya devaṃ praṇamya oṃhrīṃmityākuñcanena suṣumnāvartmanā pradīpakalikākārāṃ brahmapathāntarnītvā paramaśivena saṃyojya tayoraikyaṃ vibhāvya tadudbhūtāmṛtadhārayā kulagurūn saṃtarpya punastenaiva mārgeṇa ḍākinyādiśaktīḥ prīṇayantīṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ svaṃ padaṃ prāpayya vāmakuṣau pāpapuruṣamaṅguṣṭhamātrākāraṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ dhyātvā yaṃraṃvaṃlaṃ iti śoṣaṇadāhanāplāvanotpādanādi kuryāt |
yaṃ vāyubījena ṣoḍaśadhā japtena śoṣayet | raṃ vahnibījena catuḥṣaṣṭyā japtena dāhayet | vaṃ varuṇabījena dvātriṃśadvārajaptenāplāvayet | lamiti bhūbījena daśadhā japtena śarīraṃ piṇḍībhūtaṃ vidhāya prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kuryāditi bhūtaśuddhiḥ || oṃhrīṃkroṃ yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃ śaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃ sohaṃsaḥ haṃsaḥ mama prāṇā iha prāṇāḥ (16/) mama jīva iha sthitaḥ (16/) sarvendriyāṇi (16/) vāṅmanaścakṣuḥśrotrajihvāghrāṇaprāṇā ihaivāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu svāhā iti prāṇapratiṣṭhākramaḥ || prāṇān samarpya prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā pūrvavadācamya saṅkalpapūrvaṃ nyāsaṃ kuryāt |
asya śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇapūjāmantrasya śrīśiva ṛṣiḥ triṣṭup chandaḥ lakṣmīnārāyaṇo devatā śrīṃbījaṃ hrīṃśaktiḥ oṃkīlakaṃ bhogāpavargasiddhyarthe lakṣmīnārāyaṇapūjāyāṃ viniyogaḥ | śivaṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi triṣṭupchandase namo mukhe lakṣmīnārāyaṇadevatāyai namo hṛdi śrīṃbījāya namo guhye hrīṃ śaktaye namaḥ pādayoḥ oṃ kīlakāya namaḥ sarvāṅgeṣu iti vinyasya ṣaḍaṅgādi kuryāt | oṃhrāṃśrāṃ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃhrīṃśrīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃhrūṃśrūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃhraiṃśraiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃhrauṃśrauṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃhraḥśraḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | evaṃ ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ | atha (punaḥ) karaśuddhiḥ oṃkāmarūpapīṭhāya namaḥ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | hrīṃ jālandharapīṭhāya namaḥ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | hsauḥ pūrṇagiripīṭhāya namaḥ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ | hrīṃ avantīpīṭhāya namaḥ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ | śrīṃ saptapurīpīṭhāya namaḥ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃhrīṃ hsauḥ hrīṃśrīṃ vārāṇasīpīṭhāya namaḥ karatalapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | iti kara śuddhiḥ | evaṃ ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ | aṃāṃiṃīṃ uṃūṃṛṃṝṃ vāmapādādigulphāntam | ḷṃḹṃeṃaiṃ oṃauṃaṃaḥ dakṣapādādigulphāntam | kaṃkhaṃgaṃghaṃṅaṃ gulphādivāmapādamūlāntam | caṃchaṃjaṃjhaṃñaṃ gulphādidakṣapādamūlāntam | ṭaṃṭhaṃḍaṃḍhaṃṇaṃ nābhyādivāmabāhumūlāntam | taṃthaṃdaṃdhaṃnaṃ nābhyādidakṣabāhumūlāntam | paṃphaṃbaṃbhaṃmaṃ kaṭyādikakubantam | yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃ vāmaskandhādivāmakarṇāntam | śaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃ dakṣaskandhādidakṣakarṇāntam | lakṣaḥ śirasaḥ pādaparyantamiti trirvyāpayet ||
aṃkaṃkhaṃgaṃghaṃṅaṃāṃ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ iṃcaṃchaṃjaṃjhaṃñaṃīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ uṃṭaṃṭhaṃḍaṃḍhaṃṇaṃūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ eṃtaṃthaṃdaṃdhaṃnaṃaiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃpaṃphaṃbaṃbhaṃmaṃauṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ aṃyaṃraṃlaṃvaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃlaṃkṣaḥaḥ
karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ iti karanyāsaḥ | evaṃ hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ ||
atha mātṛkānyāsaḥ(-) aṃ namaḥ śirasi āṃ mukhavṛtte iṃ dakṣanetre īṃ vāmanetre uṃ dakṣakarṇe ūṃ vāmakarṇe ṛṃ dakṣanāsāpuṭe ṝṃ vāmanāsāpuṭe ḷṃ dakṣagaṇḍe ḹṃ vāmagaṇḍe eṃ ūrdhvoṣṭhe aiṃ adharoṣṭhe oṃ ūrdhvadantapaṅktau auṃ adhodantapaṅktau aṃ śirasi aḥ mukhe kaṃkhaṃgaṃghaṃṅaṃ dakṣabāhusandhiṣu caṃchaṃjaṃjhaṃñaṃ vāmabāhusandhiṣu ṭaṃṭhaṃḍaṃḍhaṃṇaṃ dakṣapādasandhiṣu taṃthaṃdaṃdhaṃnaṃ vāmapādasandhiṣu paṃ dakṣapārśve phaṃ vāmapārśve baṃ pṛṣṭhe bhaṃ nābhau maṃ jaṭhare yaṃ hṛdi raṃ dakṣāṃse laṃ kakudi vaṃ vāmāṃse śaṃ hṛdādidakṣahastāgrāntaṃ ṣaṃ hṛdādivāmahastāgrāntaṃ saṃ hṛdādidakṣapādāgrāntaṃ haṃ hṛdādivāmapādāgrāntaṃ laṃ pādādiśiraḥparyantaṃ kṣaḥ śirasaḥ pādaparyantamiti trirvyāpayet | tataḥ aṃoṃaṃ iti kṣāntaṃ nyaset | aṃhrīṃamiti kṣāntaṃ mātṛkāṃsthāneṣu nyaset | aṃhsauḥamiti kṣāntaṃ nyaset | aṃhrīṃaṃ iti kṣāntaṃ nyaset | aṃśrīṃaṃ iti kṣāntaṃ nyaset | kevalaṃ mātṛkāsthāneṣu mūlaṃ nyasediti ṣoḍhā nyāsaṃ vidhāya mūlamuccaran dehaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā ghaṭapūjāṃ kuryāt | tatra sāmānyārghyasya vāme binduṣaṭkoṇavṛttacaturaśraṃ vilikhya tatra oṃ pīṭhebhyo namaḥ ityabhyarcya tatra kṣālitādhāraṃ saṃsthāpya raṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya daśakalātmane namaḥ ityakṣataiḥ saṃpūjya tatra śrīghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya brahmaṇā ca yathāpūrvaṃ viṣṇunā ca yathā purā | śambhunā ca yathā devi tathā tvāṃ sthāpayāmyaham || iti saṃsthāpya aṃ arkamaṇḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ iti gandhapuṣpairabhyarcya mūlaṃ vilomamātṛkayā paramāmṛtenāpūrya sauḥ somamaṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ iti saṃpūjya astrāyaphaḍiti kumbhe dravyaṃ saṃtāḍya mūlamuccaran nāsayā trirgandhaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | tatra trikoṇaṃ vilikhya mūlaṃ tririṣṭvā mūlena prapūjya oṃhrāṃhrīṃhrūṃhraiṃhrauṃhraḥ sudhe śukraśāpaṃ mocaya mocaya amṛtaṃ srāvaya srāvaya svāhā iti dravyopari daśadhā saṃjapya oṃ sūryamaṇḍalasaṃbhūte varuṇālayasaṃbhave | amābījamaye devi śukraśāpādvimucyatām || vedānāṃ (k, kh: devānāṃ) praṇavo bījaṃ brahmānandamayaṃ yadi | tena satyena te devi brahmahatyā vyapohatu || pavamānaḥ parānandaḥ pavamānaḥ paro rasaḥ | pavamānaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ tena tvāṃ pāvayāmyaham ||
iti trirjaptvā oṃaṃāṃiṃ amṛte amṛtodbhave amṛtavaṣiṇi amṛtaṃ srāvaya srāvaya aṃhrīṃ amṛteśvaryai namaḥ iti dravyopari daśadhā japtvā ānandabhairavabhairavyau dhyātvā hsakṣamalavaraya(-)ūṃ ānandabhairavāya vaṣaṭ (kh: vauṣaṭ) iti daśadhā japet | (9/) sudhodavyai vauṣaṭ iti dravyopari daśadhā japtvā tatra trikoṇaṃ vilikhya gaṅge ca yamune caiva ityādinā tīrthamāvāhya akārādiṣoḍaśa kakārādiṣoḍaśa thakārādiṣoḍaśa pūrvāditrikoṇe nyaset | madhye haṃlaṃkṣaṃ vilikhya mūlaṃ daśadhā japtvā gandhapuṣpadūrvākṣataiḥ saṃpūjya matsyamudrādīn śodhayediti dravyaśuddhiḥ ||
mīnopari dhenuyonimatsyamudrāḥ pradarśya oṃ tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam | urvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt || iti mūlaṃ trirjaptvā mīnaṃ śodhayediti mīnaśuddhiḥ ||
māṃsopari mudrātrayaṃ pradarśya oṃ pra tadviṣṇuḥ stavate vīryeṇa mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ | yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣvadhikṣiyanti bhuvanāni viśvā || iti mūlaṃ trirjaptvā māṃsaṃ śodhayediti māṃsaśuddhiḥ ||
mudropari mudrātrayaṃ pradarśya oṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ | divīva cakṣurātatam | tadviprāso vipaṇyavo jāgṛvāṃsaḥ samindhate viṣṇoryatparamaṃ padam || iti mūlaṃ trirjaptvā mudrāṃ śodhayediti | tato mudrākhaṇḍamīnakhaṇḍamāṃsakhaṇḍādīn ghaṭe niḥkṣipya caturasraṃ vilikhya svavāme sādhāraṃ pātraṃ guroḥ saṃsthāpya kulāmṛtenāpūrya mūlena pūjayet | tataḥ svabhogapātraṃ śaktipātraṃ yoginīvīrapātramadhuparkapātrāṇi saṃsthāpya kalaśāmṛtenāpūrya ghṛtamadhuśarkarābhirmadhuparkapātraṃ prapūrya yogapīṭhapūjāṃ kuryāt | binduvibhūṣaṇa trikoṇavirājamāna vasukoṇamaṇḍita vṛttāñcita vasudalavirājita ṣoḍaśadalakhacita vṛttatrayasaṃbhūṣita caturaśraṃ śrīyantrarājaṃ vilikhya śrīsvarṇapīṭhādau niveśya hṛdi sadevīkaṃ devaṃ mānasopacārairabhyarcya bāhyapūjāṃ kuryāt | tatra oṃhrīm maṇḍūkāya namaḥ (2/) kālāgnirudrāya namaḥ (2/) mūlaprakṛtyai namaḥ (2/) ādhāraśaktyai namaḥ (2/) kūrmāya namaḥ (2/) anantāya namaḥ (2/) varāhāya namaḥ (2/) pṛthivyai namaḥ
