guhyaṃ gopyamidaṃ tattvaṃ pūjāsāraṃ maheśvari | gopayed vaiṣṇavaḥ satyamityājñā pārameśvarī ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye lakṣmīnārāyaṇapūjāpaddhatinirūpaṇaṃ saptatriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 37 || atha
[aṣṭātriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devi vakṣyāmi lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya te | kavacaṃ mantragarbhaṃ ca vajrapañjarakākhyayā || 1 ||
śrīvajrapañjaraṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam | rahasyaṃ sarvadevānāṃ sādhakānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 2 ||
yaṃ dhṛtvā bhagavān devaḥ prasīdati paraḥ pumān |
yasya dhāraṇamātreṇa brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 3 ||
īśvaro'haṃ śivo bhīmo vāsavo'pi divaspatiḥ | sūryastejonidhirdevi candramāstārakeśvaraḥ || 4 ||
vāyuśca balavāṃlloke varuṇo yādasāṃpatiḥ | kubero'pi dhanādhyakṣo dharmarājo yamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 5 ||
yaṃ dhṛtvā sahasā viṣṇuḥ saṃhariṣyati dānavān | jaghāna rāvaṇādīṃśca kiṃ vakṣye'hamataḥ param || 6 ||
kavacasyāsya subhage kathito'yaṃ muniḥ śivaḥ | triṣṭup chando devatā ca lakṣmīnārāyaṇo mataḥ || 7 ||
ramā bījaṃ parā śaktistāraṃ kīlakamīśvari | bhogāpavargasiddhyarthaṃ viniyoga iti smṛtaḥ || 8 ||
pūrṇenduvadanaṃ pītavasanaṃ kamalāsanam | lakṣmyā śritaṃ caturbāhuṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ bhaje || 9 ||
oṃvāsudevo'vatu me mastakaṃ saśiroruham | hrīṃlalāṭaṃ sadā pātu lakṣmīviṣṇuḥ samantataḥ || 10 ||
hasauḥ netre'vatāllakṣmīgovindo jagatāṃ patiḥ | hrīṃ nāsāṃ sarvadā pātu lakṣmīdāmodaraḥ prabhuḥ || 11 ||
śrīṃ mukhaṃ satataṃ pātu devo lakṣmītrivikramaḥ | lakṣmī kaṇṭhaṃ sadā pātu devī lakṣmījanārdanaḥ || 12 ||
nārāyaṇāya bāhū me pātu lakṣmīgadāgrajaḥ | namaḥ pārśvau sadā pātu lakṣmīnandaikanandanaḥ || 13 ||
aṃāṃiṃīṃ pātu vakṣo oṃ lakṣmītripureśvaraḥ | uṃūṃṛṃṝṃ pātu kukṣiṃ hrīṃ lakṣmīgaruḍadhvajaḥ || 14 ||
ḷṃḹṃeṃaiṃ pātu pṛṣṭhaṃ hasauḥ lakṣmīnṛsiṃhakaḥ | oṃauṃaṃaḥ pātu nābhiṃ hrīṃ lakṣmīviṣṭaraśravaḥ || 15 ||
kaṃkhaṃgaṃghaṃ gudaṃ pātu śrīṃ lakṣmīkaiṭabhāntakaḥ | caṃchaṃjaṃjhaṃ pātu śiśnaṃ lakṣmī lakṣmīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ || 16 ||
ṭaṃṭhaṃḍaṃḍhaṃ kaṭiṃ pātu nārāyaṇāya nāyakaḥ | taṃthaṃdaṃdhaṃ pātu corū namo lakṣmījagatpatiḥ || 17 ||
paṃphaṃbaṃbhaṃ pātu jānū oṃhrīṃ lakṣmīcaturbhujaḥ | yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃ pātu jaṅghe hasauḥ lakṣmīgadādharaḥ || 18 ||
śaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃ pātu gulphau hrīṃśrīṃ lakṣmīrathāṅgabhṛt | laṃkṣaḥ pādau sadā pātu mūlaṃ lakṣmīsahasrapāt || 19 ||
ṅaṃñaṃṇaṃnaṃmaṃ me pātu lakṣmīśaḥ sakalaṃ vapuḥ | indro māṃ pūrvataḥ pātu vahnirvahnau sadāvatu || 20 ||
yamo māṃ dakṣiṇe pātu nair(-)ṛtyāṃ nir(-)ṛtiśca mām | varuṇaḥ paścime'vyānmāṃ vāyavye'vatu māṃ marut || 21 ||
uttare dhanadaḥ pāyādaiśānyāmīśvaro'vatu | vajraśaktidaṇḍakhaḍga pāśayaṣṭidhvajāṅkitāḥ || 22 ||
saśūlāḥ sarvadā pāntu digīśāḥ paramārthadāḥ | anantaḥ pātvadho nityamūrdhve brahmāvatācca mām || 23 ||
daśadikṣu sadā pātu lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | prabhāte pātu māṃ viṣṇurmadhyāhne vāsudevakaḥ || 24 ||
dāmodaro'vatāt sāyaṃ niśādau narasiṃhakaḥ | saṅkarṣaṇo'rdharātre'vyāt prabhāte'vyāt trivikramaḥ || 25 ||
aniruddhaḥ sarvakālaṃ viśvaksenaśca sarvataḥ | raṇe rājakule dyūte vivāde śatrusaṅkaṭe | oṃhrīṃhasauḥ hrīṃśrīṃmūlaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇo'vatu || 26 ||
oṃoṃoṃraṇarājacaurariputaḥ pāyācca māṃ keśavaḥ hīṃhīṃhīṃhahahāhasauḥ hasahasau vahnervatānmādhavaḥ |
hrīṃhrīṃhrīṃjalaparvatāgrabhayataḥ (gh: parvatāgni) pāyādananto vibhuḥ śrīṃśrīṃśrīṃśaśaśālalaṃ pratidinaṃ lakṣmīdhavaḥ pātu mām || 27 ||
itīdaṃ kavacaṃ divyaṃ vajrapañjarakābhidham | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyeṣṭaṃ caturvargaphalapradam || 28 ||
sarvasaubhāgyanilayaṃ sarvasārasvatapradam | lakṣmīsaṃvananaṃ tattvaṃ paramārtharasāyanam || 29 ||
mantragarbhaṃ jagatsāraṃ rahasyaṃ tridivaukasām | daśavāraṃ paṭhedrātrau ratānte vaiṣṇavottamaḥ || 30 ||
svapne varapradaṃ paśyellakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ sudhīḥ | trisaṇdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ kavacaṃ manmukhoditam || 31 ||
sa yāti paramaṃ dhāma vaiṣṇavaṃ vaiṣṇavottamaḥ (ṅ: vaiṣṇaveśvaraḥ) | mahācīnapadastho'pi yaḥ paṭhedātmacintakaḥ || 32 ||
ānandapūritastūrṇaṃ labhed mokṣaṃ sa sādhakaḥ | gandhāṣṭakena vilikhedravau bhūrje japanmanum || 33 ||
pītasūtreṇa saṃveṣṭya sauvarṇenātha veṣṭayet | dhārayedguṭikāṃ mūrdhni lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ smaran || 34 ||
raṇe ripūn vijityāśu kalyāṇī gṛhamāviśet | vandhyā vā kākavandhyā vā mṛtavatsā ca yāṅganā || 35 ||
sā badhnīyāt kaṇṭhadeśe labhet putrāṃścirāyuṣaḥ | gurūpadeśato dhṛtvā guruṃ dhyātvā manuṃ japan || 36 ||
varṇalakṣapuraścaryāphalamāpnoti sādhakaḥ | bahunoktena kiṃ devi kavacasyāsya pārvati || 37 ||
vinānena na siddhiḥ syānmantrasyāsya maheśvari | sarvāgamarahasyāḍhyaṃ tattvāt tattvaṃ parāt param || 38 ||
abhaktāya na dātavyaṃ kucailāya durātmane | dikṣitāya kulīnāya svaśiṣyāya mahātmane || 39 ||
mahācīnapadasthāya dātavyaṃ kavacottamam | guhyaṃ gopyaṃ mahādevi lakṣmīnārāyaṇapriyam | vajrapañjarakaṃ varma gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 40 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye lakṣmīnārāyaṇakavacanirūpaṇamaṣṭātriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 38 || atha
[ekonacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā kathayiṣyāmi vidyāṃ sāhasranāmikīm | bhogadāṃ mokṣadāṃ loke lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya te || 1 ||
śrībhairavī |
bhagavan karuṇāmbhodhe lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya me | bhogāpavargadaṃ divyaṃ vada nāmasahasrakam || 2 ||
sarvamantramayaṃ tattvaṃ sarvapūjāphalapradam |
sarvāgamarahasyāḍhyaṃ sarvadevaikavanditam || 3 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
etadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ mantranāmasahasrakam | lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyeṣṭaṃ sarvasvaṃ tattvato mama || 4 ||
guhyaṃ gopyatamaṃ devi sukhadaṃ dharmavardhanam | lakṣmīsaṃvananaṃ (kh: saṃvardhanaṃ) loke paratra paramārthadam || 5 ||
mahācīnapadasthānāṃ kaulikānāmabhīṣṭadam | upapātakapāpānāṃ śamanaṃ damakārakam || 6 ||
sarvatīrthaphalodriktaṃ sarvayajñaphalapradam | sarvadevastutaṃ sādhyaṃ caturvargaphalapradam || 7 ||
avācyaṃ mārgahīnānāmaśravyaṃ duṣṭacetasām | vaiṣṇavaḥ kaulikaśreṣṭhaḥ paṭhennāmasahasrakam | gurūpadeśato devi sarvasiddhimavāpnuyāt || 8 ||
asya śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasahasranāmapāṭhasya śrīśiva ṛṣiḥ triṣṭup chandaḥ śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇo devatā śrīṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ oṃ kīlakaṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe sahasranāmapāṭhe viniyogaḥ | dhyānam(-)
vedānuddharate jaganti vahate bhūgolamudbibhrate (kh: lokaṃ) daityān dārayate baliṃ chalayate kṣatrakṣayaṃ kurvate | paulastyaṃ jayate halaṃ kalayate kāruṇyamātanvate mlecchān mūrchayate daśākṛtikute kṛṣṇāya tubhyaṃ namaḥ ||
oṃlakṣmīviṣṇurīśāno lakṣmīkānto vināyakaḥ | viśvambharo viśvanātho viśvasūrviśvasūdanaḥ || 1 ||
lakṣmīrājo mahātmā ca paramātmā parāparaḥ | apāravibhavo bhavyo bhavabhūtimayo bhavaḥ || 2 ||
lakṣmīdhavo mahāṃllakṣmīdevo (kh: mahālakṣmī) lakṣmībhavottamaḥ | lakṣmīdharādharo lakṣmīdhārādharasamadyutiḥ || 3 ||
viśruto vikalo vyagro (atra rekhāṅkitamekameva nāma jñeyam) vilāsī gītavallabhaḥ | vidyādharapriyo vidyāvādī vidyāviśāradaḥ || 4 ||
paṭṭabhṛt pāṭaladyotaḥ pītapaṭṭadharo bhagaḥ | bhāgyavān bhogado bārgo bhṛgubhāvavivardhanaḥ || 5 ||
lakṣmīkauleśvaro lakṣmīguhyo lakṣmīvibhāvasuḥ | lakṣmīvīreśvaro lakṣmīdhanyo lakṣmīvibhākaraḥ || 6 ||
acintyo nityasaṃyogī saṃyamī yamabhītihṛt | yāminīśapriyakaro rāhudhvaṃsī viṣāpahaḥ || 7 ||
dhīro bhramaharo bhīmo bhīmāsyo bhīmavallabhaḥ | hārakaṅkaṇabhūṣāḍhyo maulimān nūpurāñcitaḥ || 8 ||
kiṅkiṇīravasantuṣṭo vaṃśīvādanatatparaḥ | sthāṇurūpaścaragatiścāruvaktro jayī nayī || 9 ||
lakṣmīvinayavāṁllakṣmījayavāṁllalitākṛtiḥ | lakṣmīnetravaśī lakṣmīhāsavaśyo vinartakaḥ || 10 ||
nāṭyapriyo naṭo (kh: naṭī nandī) nandī sarvavit sarvasārabhṛt | vāsavo gopyamārgeṣṭo vaiṣṇavācāratatparaḥ || 11 ||
ātmā parātmā jñānātmā lokādhyakṣaḥ sureśvaraḥ | satyaḥ stutyaḥ śucirnityo nityātmā nityadarśanaḥ || 12 ||
pañcanādamayo'nantaḥ pañcamācāravallabhaḥ | pañcamasvarasaṅgītaḥ kīrtido mohanāśanaḥ || 13 ||
lakṣmīparaḥ pumāṁllakṣmīśaktibhṛd bhaktitoṣitaḥ | lakṣmīyogīśvaro (kh: yogeśvaraḥ) lakṣmīyogado bhogināyakaḥ || 14 ||
lakṣmīlokeśvaro lakṣmīvasurlakṣmīmanoharaḥ | acintyamahimā(100>'cintyagarimā ghoranisvanaḥ || 15 ||
sukhī sukhaprado divyarūpo deveśvareśvaraḥ | kāmadevo vaidyavaidyo (ṅ: viśvavaidyo) vedavid vedanāyakaḥ || 16 ||
ṛgrūpaḥ sāmagītajño yajuryajñabhujāṃ patiḥ | yājñiko yamināṃ trātā trilokajanako'jaraḥ || 17 ||
kāmapradaḥ kāmivaraḥ kamanīyākṛtiḥ kuruḥ | lakṣmīpṛthurvasuprīto lakṣmīśrīdaḥ śriyaḥpatiḥ || 118 ||
lakṣmīkāmo lakṣmaṇeśo lakṣmīrāmo'tisundaraḥ | anirvartī ca niḥsaṅgo nirbhayo nirupadravaḥ || 119 ||
nirābhāso nirādhāro nirlepo nirahaṅkṛtiḥ | nirāśrayo nirguṇaśca guṇātīto gaṇeśvaraḥ || 120 ||
brahmasvarūpo brahmajño bṛṃhaṇo brahmavardhanaḥ | mahākraturyajñavapurvarāho yajñanāyakaḥ || 121 ||
mahārudro mahādevo mādhavo madhusūdanaḥ | lakṣmīnirañjano lakṣmīsiddhidaḥ siddhivardhanaḥ || 22 ||
lakṣmīśrīvatsavakṣāśca lakṣmīkaustubhabhūṣitaḥ | sarvalokadharo dānto dantidantāyudho damī || 23 ||
aprameyagatiḥ śāntaḥ śamī kāmī kṛtāgamaḥ | mahākarmā mahācīno makāraśivapūjitaḥ || 24 ||
vāmamārgarasodriktaḥ sarvācāraikamadhyagaḥ (kh: vāmācārai) |
māṃsāhārī nityasaṅgī mīnāsavarasākulaḥ || 25 ||
mudrāpriyo ratānandarato ratipatipriyaḥ | aghoradevo daityārirjitadevo divākaraḥ || 26 ||
niśānātho'mṛtamayo navagrahasamarcitaḥ | satsvarūpo virūpākṣo vibhākaraśataprabhaḥ || 27 ||
nigraho vigrahī vāmo vārāṃnidhinivāsakaḥ | pīnabāhuḥ sthūlapādo dīrghacakṣuralaṃbhujaḥ || 28 ||
pādāmitakramātītaḥ satyasandhaḥ sanātanaḥ | lakṣmīsanātano lakṣmīdharmādhyakṣo dhaneśvaraḥ || 29 ||
lakṣmīdhanaprado (200) lakṣmīdharmabhāgī ca dharmavān | vīrahaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ padmanābho jagatprabhuḥ || 30 ||
padmāsano brahmamayo vismayī vigatasmayaḥ | samānaḥ samadṛṣṭiśca viṣamo viṣamekṣaṇaḥ (ṅ: viṣamokṣaṇaḥ) || 31 ||
caturmūrtistrimūrtiśca cintitaściñciṇīpatiḥ | sahasrabāhuḥ kṣatreśo brāhmaṇo vaṇijāṃ patiḥ || 32 ||
sarvavyāpī sarvamukhaḥ sarvamadhyagataḥ sakhā | cakrārcito nakrapatirvaruṇaḥ śakrasodaraḥ || 33 ||
darpahā sarpaśayanaḥ sarpāśanavarapradaḥ (ṅ: sarpāsanavara) | amānī mānado mānyo mānavendro manūttamaḥ || 34 ||
manuvaśyo'marādhyakṣo lakṣyo lokaikarakṣakaḥ | śokahā durgamo dṛpto balihā kalināśanaḥ || 35 ||
śubhāṅgo madirākṣībaḥ śubhakṛt śobhanākṛtiḥ | atithistithināthaśca nakṣatrapariveṣagaḥ || 36 ||
caturbāhuścatuḥśrotro (ṅ: caturbhāgī) viśravā vilayapradaḥ | pralayāntakaraḥ prājyo jananījanakapriyaḥ || 37 ||
yaśasvī śrīdharaḥ śāntaḥ śaṅkāśatavināśakaḥ | akrūravaradaḥ krūraḥ kīravāg gaṇanāyakaḥ || 38 ||
suvarṇamukuṭo māro mārasūrmaṇibhūṣaṇaḥ | māntriko mañjulo mantrī māntrikeṣṭavarapradaḥ || 39 ||
lakṣmīvitarkavāṁllakṣmīsundaro bandhuro'bhayaḥ | arjitaḥ sukhitastārastārtīyaḥ kārtavīryakaḥ || 40 ||
lakṣmīpadmadharo lakṣmīcandrahāso vikatthanaḥ | lakṣmīgovardhanadharo lakṣmīkambudharo virāṭ || 41 ||
skandāśrayo ripudhvaṃsī devasenādhināyakaḥ | anukūlo'nukūṭaśca sānumān somasundaraḥ || 42 ||
tāmasaḥ sāttvikaḥ sabhyaḥ (300) somarājo marīcimān | arciṣmān vikalaḥ kulyakalpaḥ sajjanapoṣakaḥ (ṅ: pūjakaḥ) || 43 ||
virājo vāmano veṇurvānaro vārivāhanaḥ | vālmīkivarado vandī vandyo bandhūkasannibhaḥ || 44 ||
varṇeśvaro varṇamālī vanamālātisundaraḥ | bhṛgurbhāsvadvapurbhoktā kartā hartā śatakratuḥ || 45 ||
atulyaḥ komalaḥ kopī ramaṇo maṇikuṇḍalaḥ | lakṣmīkeyūravāṁllakṣmīmaṇidāmavirājitaḥ || 46 ||
lakṣmīnūpuravāṁllakṣmīmuktāmālyavibhūṣaṇaḥ | lakṣmīgodhāṅgulitrāṇo lakṣmīsauvarṇakaṅkaṇaḥ || 47 ||
lakṣmīvirājito lakṣmīvividhābharaṇojjvalaḥ |
kakārādikṣakārāntavidyābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 48 ||
akārādyakṣarasphīto niḥśeṣasvaramaṇḍitaḥ | varṇamānyo mahāvidyāmātṛkākṣaratattvavān || 49 ||
lakṣmīkāmeśvaro lakṣmīkāmuko nirjareśvaraḥ | kalāvān kīrtimān kūtaḥ kumbhāṇḍaprāṇahārakaḥ || 50 ||
keśāntakaḥ kālasūśca kārakaḥ kaṣṭahā kaṭhī | krītaḥ kubjaḥ kambudharaḥ kalakaṇṭhaḥ kulālakaḥ || 51 ||
kulādhyakṣaḥ kulācārī kulākulapadārcitaḥ | karañjakaḥ kartarīśaḥ kanakaḥ kartarīkaraḥ || 52 ||
kalaṅkarahitaḥ kokaḥ kokaśokanivarhaṇaḥ | kapilaḥ kalaśī kolaḥ kālikaḥ kulamānasaḥ || 53 ||
lakṣmīkulākulo lakṣmīkulajaḥ karmavardhanaḥ | lakṣmīkāśīśvaro lakṣmīnavanāthavināyakaḥ || 54 ||
lakṣmīkaniṣṭho niṣpiṣṭo lakṣmīyogīndrayogadaḥ | khaparaḥ khecaraḥ kheṭaḥ khagagāmī khalāntakaḥ || 55 ||
kharūpaḥ khagarūpaśca khanitraḥ kheṭanāyakaḥ | khagāyudhaḥ khaṇḍadhārī khañjanekṣaṇabhañjanaḥ || 56 ||
kharadhvaṃsī kharārāvaḥ kharkhurākārabhīṣaṇaḥ | khaṃkhaṭolaḥ khagagatiḥ khecareśvarasevitaḥ (k: pūjitaḥ) || 57 ||
khecarīgaṇasevyaśca khaṇḍamudrāniyantritaḥ | khaḍgahastaḥ khaḍgapālaḥ khetaḥ (k, kh: kheṭaḥ) khavarṇabhūṣaṇaḥ (400) || 58 ||
lakṣmīkheśaḥ khokarūpo lakṣmībhāsvaramūrtimān | lakṣmīkhaṭvāṅgabhṛllakṣmīkhecaraḥ khāśmalepitaḥ (k, kh: khāśmarīpriyaḥ) || 59 ||
lakṣmīcitāgninilayo lakṣmībhasmīkṛtānalaḥ |
lakṣmībhūtiprado lakṣmījyotiṣmān gākṣarāñcitaḥ || 60 ||
lakṣmīgītaḥ svarālāpī gopatirgokuleśvaraḥ | gaṅgādharapriyo goṣṭhī gopālo gandhavardhanaḥ || 61 ||
gandhavāhapriyo gīto gītijño gītalālasaḥ | guñjāhārapriyo gaṇḍī gururgovāhano'gadaḥ (k, kh: gavaḥ; gh, ṅ: 'gamaḥ) || 62 ||
gāmbhīryavān gurutaro guruśabdavivardhanaḥ | gurubhaktipriyo golo gaṇḍaśailanivāsakaḥ || 63 ||
garjannādo gotrapatirgolamārgapriyo'ṅgavān | niraṅgo gajavaktreśo gaṇanāyakanāyakaḥ || 64 ||
gandharvanāthavarado gaganecarapūjitaḥ | garbhahīno garbhavāhī guṇeyo guṇasāgaraḥ || 65 ||
guṇātītavapurguṇyo guptamārgapravartakaḥ | guptamantrapriyo gopyo guhyo guhyakavallabhaḥ || 66 ||
gopīto girināthaśca giridhārī jagannidhiḥ | lakṣmīpriyaḥ priyaḥ prīto lakṣmīgaruḍavāhanaḥ || 67 ||
lakṣmīkapotanilayo lakṣmīkalpadrumo raviḥ | lakṣmīsantānakaḥ sāro lakṣmīsāro latāpatiḥ || 68 ||
lakṣmīgrāhyo'sulakṣmā ca lakṣmīsāgaranandanaḥ | ghṛṇī ghṛṇimayo ghṛṣṭo ghusṛṇārakta īśvaraḥ || 69 ||
ghṛṇāmayo'ghahartā ca ghṛṇinātho ghavarṇabhāk | lakṣmīcintāmaṇiḥ sādhurlakṣmīvīro (g: lakṣmīcintāmaṇisakhaḥ) varottamaḥ || 70 ||
lakṣmīcaturbhujo lakṣmīviśvanātho vināyakaḥ | ṅavarṇo'nantarūpaśca jānujño (k: ṅāntarūpaśca ṅāṇajño) ṅoṇarūpavān || 71 ||
ṅavarṇarūpo viśveśo ṅakārākṣaramaṇḍanaḥ | lakṣmīsevyo nirguṇātmā lakṣmīśānaḥ śivārcitaḥ || 72 ||
cārurūpaścārugatiścārumūrtiścamatkṛtiḥ | cārunetraścārumukhaścārubāhuścaturbhujaḥ || 73 ||
cāruhastaścārunakhaścārukeśaścabhūpatiḥ (500) | citāvāsī caro'celaścīnāmbaradharo'cyutaḥ || 74 ||
cāruhāsaścārudandaścyavanaścandravāsitaḥ | candraścandrakalānāthaścārupādaścaturgatiḥ || 75 ||
caturātmā caturthātmā caturbhūmidharo dharaḥ | catuḥsamudraśayanaḥ catussāgaralaṅghanaḥ || 76 ||
caturdyutiścatuḥśayyācaturvīravaro'varaḥ | caturvedamayo vaidyaścārvaṅgaścārubhāṣaṇaḥ || 77 ||
caturvaktraścaturvaktrapūjitaḥ parameśvaraḥ | calaccandrakaśobhāḍhyaścalannūpurakūjitaḥ || 78 ||
caladambhodasadṛśaścaladambhojalocanaḥ | caladambhodavadanaścaladambhodaśobhitaḥ || 79 ||
calatkanakakeyūraścalatkāñcanakuṇḍalaḥ | calatkanakaśṛṅgābhaścalatkanakaśekharaḥ || 80 ||
cakārarūpaścāreśaścakārārṇavibhūṣitaḥ | lakṣmīśānto mahādakṣo lakṣmīpītāmbaraḥ paviḥ || 81 ||
chatrī cchatradharaśchāntaḥ (k, kh: lakṣmīcchatradharaḥ) chinnamastāpriyaḥ pitā | channacchedī chinnamukhaḥ chakārākṣararūpavān || 82 ||
lakṣmīkāntaḥ kāntiyukto lakṣmīsādhaka īśvaraḥ |
jagannātho jagadbhartā jagatkartā jagatsthitiḥ || 83 ||
jagatkṣayakaro jetā jagatāṃ patiruttamaḥ | jagatsvāmī jagaddhātā jagatsaṃhārakārakaḥ || 84 ||
jīvātmā paramātmā ca jagadbhūtiprado bhavaḥ | jagadguṇī jagatstutyo jagadānandadāyakaḥ || 85 ||
jagatsantoṣabhūtātmā jagatkrodhadayānvitaḥ | jagaddīptikaro vedopāsito jagadīśvaraḥ || 86 ||
javī javānvito jāro jagadāḍambarapradaḥ | jagatsevyo jagatprīto jagadiṣṭo jaganmayaḥ || 87 ||
jṛmbhaṇo jaṭilo jīvo jambhārātivarapradaḥ | jāmātā jaladherjānto (k: trātā) jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitaḥ || 88 ||
jitārirjayado'jeyo jayakṛdvīratāpanaḥ | lakṣmīkucataṭāsīno lakṣmīnayanagocaraḥ || 89 ||
jhalarījhotkṛto jhāḍī jhaṇḍī śaṇṭhapratāpanaḥ | jhāṅkārī jhaṅkṛtirjhillīravo jhāṅkārinūpuraḥ || 90 ||
lakṣmīvaro (600) mahālakṣmīsevito devavanditaḥ | ñakāro ñāralo (k: ñādaro) ñeśo ñavarṇāmṛtarūpavān || 91 ||
lakṣmīsvabhūḥ svargapatirlakṣmīvandyo vidhuntudaḥ | ṭakāro (ṅ: ṭaṃkāro; kh: ṭāṃkāro) ṭaṅkahastaśca ṭāntaṣṭītkārakūjitaḥ || 92 ||
lakṣmīdevo devadevo lakṣmīdāntaḥ kṛpānidhiḥ | ṭhakuro ṭhālako ṭhāsyo ṭhavarṇasuṣamānidhiḥ || 93 ||
lakṣmīvidhurvitarkākhyo vainateyadhvajo dhvajaḥ | ḍamarurḍāmareśāno ḍakārākṣarasaṃyutaḥ (k, kh: saṃjñakaḥ) || 94 ||
lakṣmīpatiḥ pāvarāṅgo lakṣmīnāyakanāyakaḥ | ḍakāravāg ḍhakkabhedyo ḍhakkāsuranisūdanaḥ || 95 ||
lakṣmījetā jayakaro lakṣmīśo lambamūrdhajaḥ | lakṣmījagatsthitirlakṣmīśaurirlakṣmīgadādharaḥ || 96 ||
ṇānto ṇavarṇako ṇeśo ṇavarṇāmṛtasādhitaḥ | lakṣmīdāmodaro lakṣmīprāṇo lakṣmīrathāṅgabhṛt || 97 ||
tulyo'tulyo mahātulyacittastārārṇamaṇḍitaḥ | totulastulasīnāthastantrajño mantranāyakaḥ || 98 ||
tapaḥphalapradastāmrarūpo'tulaparākramaḥ | tuṭirūpastuṭigatistapasvī tāpasapriyaḥ || 99 ||
tuhināṃśustuhinajastuṣārakaraśobhitaḥ | turīsevyastulābhaśca takārākṣaramaṇḍanaḥ || 100 ||
lakṣmīśaṅkhāyudho lakṣmīnandakeśastavarṇabhṛt | sthaviraḥ sthūlagātraśca sthāṇusevyasthaśabdakṛt || 101 ||
sthālīrasapriyo sthūlaḥ sthakāreśvara īśvaraḥ | lakṣmījīveśvaro lakṣmīdharo lakṣmīnṛsiṃhakaḥ || 102 ||
dayāvān dyupatirdakṣo dyūto dambhavivarjitaḥ | dāridryahā duḥkhahartā daurbhāgyakṣayakṛd dayī || 102 ||
dīno dīnaprabhurdambhī dayitodayavāñchakaḥ | dānakṛd dātṛphalado danujendrakṣayaṅkaraḥ || 103 ||
daityahā daityadarpaghno darpavādikṣayaṃkaraḥ | dārapriyo dīrghanakho duṣṭāsuranisūdanaḥ || 104 ||
devadevo yaśovandyo dakārākṣaramaṇḍitaḥ (700) | lakṣmīdayākaro lakṣmīdevo lakṣmīdayānidhiḥ || 105 ||
dhanado dhanakṛddhanyo dhanadeśo dhanapradaḥ | dhṛtimān dharmavān dharmī dharmakarmavicakṣaṇaḥ || 106 ||
dharmādhyakṣo dhanādhyakṣo dhavalo dhairyavān dhanī | dhīro dhairyakaro dharmadakṣo dhanadapūjitaḥ || 107 ||
lakṣmīdhanī mahālakṣmīdhavo lakṣmīmanobhavaḥ | navīno nūtano namro naṭano nāṭyatoṣitaḥ || 108 ||
nago nāganagaśreṣṭho nṛgamyo nāgamaṇḍanaḥ | nṛsiṃho nṛvaro'nanto naranārāyaṇo navaḥ || 109 ||
nāgarājo nāgapatirnāgāntakadhvajo'nalaḥ | nagārūḍho nimnanābhirnandisevyo naṭeśvaraḥ || 110 ||
nalinākṣo nṛvandyo'pi nāyako nāganāyakaḥ | narmadātīrakrīḍākṛnnalinīpatilocanaḥ || 111 ||
nareśo nṛpapūjyaśca nāgaśāyī nagottamaḥ | nārāyaṇo niṣkalaṅko navarṇākṛtirātmavān || 112 ||
lakṣmīnāgo nagadharo lakṣmīnātho narūpavān | puṣpapriyaḥ puṣpaśayyāśayānaḥ puṣpaśekharaḥ || 113 ||
puṣpadhanvā pradyumnaśca puṣpeṣupuṣpapūjitaḥ | pūjyaḥ pavitraṃ paramaṃ parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ || 114 ||
paraṃ padaṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ paramāyuḥ parātparaḥ | pārāvārasutābhartā parameśaḥ paraṃ mahaḥ || 115 ||
puṇyadaḥ puṇyakṛt pūtaḥ purāṇāgamapūjitaḥ | purāṇapuruṣaḥ pīnaḥ pīnavakṣā jitendriyaḥ || 116 ||
pītavāsāḥ pītamālaḥ pītavarṇaḥ parāṅkuśaḥ |
patrago viśrutaḥ pānthaḥ pathikaḥ pānthatoṣadaḥ || 117 ||
pūrvaḥ paurajanastutyaḥ pavarṇākṣaramaṇḍanaḥ | lakṣmīpītāmbaro lakṣmīpīto lakṣmīparaḥ param || 118 ||
phalaṃ phaṇivaraḥ sphītaḥ phalakṛt phaladaḥ phaṇī | phaṇiśayyāśayānaśca phakārāmṛtamaṇḍanaḥ (800) || 119 ||
bālako buddhimān bauddho bandhurbāndhava īśvaraḥ | lakṣmībandhurmahālakṣmībāndhavo lakṣaṇānvitaḥ || 120 ||
bhadrapado bhāsvarāṅgo bhāskaro bhānuravyayaḥ | bhānidhirbhagavān bhīto bhītihā'bhayadāyakaḥ || 121 ||
lakṣmībhayaharo lakṣmībhayado bhayaghātanaḥ | maheśvaro mahāmānyo mahāmātyo manoramaḥ || 122 ||
manohārī mahāśānto mahātejā manojavaḥ | mahotsāhī mādhavaśca māyādhārī manonmanaḥ || 123 ||
mānado muraghātī ca mānaveṣṭaphalapradaḥ | madirāmodamudito māramohavivarjitaḥ || 124 ||
lakṣmīmahodayo lakṣmīmānyo lakṣmīmadālasaḥ | yaśodānandano yānto yaśasvī yodhasainikaḥ || 125 ||
yaśodharo yamo yogī yogināṃ yogadāyakaḥ | yogendro yāgapūjyaśca yādavo yādaveśvaraḥ || 126 ||
yajñaprīto yajñanidhiryājako yājñikapriyaḥ | yajvā yajño yaśojāto yakārākṣararūpavān || 127 ||
lakṣmīyajñakaro lakṣmīyājñiko yajñasevitaḥ | rājā ramāpatirdevo rāmo rājā rajorajaḥ || 128 ||
rājaso rātrikṛdrāmo rāmānandapradāyakaḥ |
revatīramaṇo rākāpatiḥ sarvakalādharaḥ || 129 ||
lakṣmīrāmo mahālakṣmīrājā lakṣmītrivikramaḥ | lākṣāruṇo lītarākṣo lalajjihvo latāpatiḥ || 130 ||
laṅkeśo lāsiko lānto lambodarapriyaḥ paraḥ | lakṣmīlīno'livarṇaśca lakārākāra īśvaraḥ || 131 ||
vāntado vārasenānīrvarāho vigrahī (kh, g: varāhavigraho) virāṭ | viṣṇurvasundharānātho vasudo vasudhādhipaḥ || 132 ||
vāgīśvaro veṇuhasto vetālo viraso viyat | vidvān viśālanayano vikāro'vikṛtiḥ pumān || 133 ||
vitarkī (900) vinayī vidyārājamānyo vicārakaḥ | vāgmī vānīramūlastho vācāṭo vīranāyakaḥ || 134 ||
lakṣmīvarāho vīreśo lakṣmīvīro vanecaraḥ | śaṅkaraḥ śrīdharaḥ śrīlaḥ śramī śītāṃśuśītalaḥ || 135 ||
śaśimauliḥ śarannāgaḥ śambhuḥ śaṅkhanimūdanaḥ | śakraḥ śatrukṣayakaraḥ śatrukālakaraḥ śivaḥ || 136 ||
lakṣmīśivaḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīvaro lakṣmīśivapradaḥ | ṣoḍaśasvararūpaśca ṣoḍaśārṇavibhūṣaṇaḥ || 137 ||
ṣaḍaṅgavidyāvettā ca ṣakārākṣarabhūṣitaḥ | lakṣmīṣaḍaṅgadhārī ca lakṣmīṣoḍaśavarṇabhṛt || 138 ||
sundaraḥ svargavasatiḥ sarveśaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ | saptasaptiḥ sadācāraḥ sādhuḥ sādhujanapriyaḥ || 139 ||
saramaḥ (k, kh: sarasaḥ saralaḥ sāraḥ) saralaḥ sālaḥ sukhī sukhavirdhanaḥ | saptadvīpavatīnāthaḥ saptasāgaranāyakaḥ || 140 ||
saptasvaramayaḥ saptapātālatalavāsakaḥ | sāttvikaḥ sattvasaṃpannaḥ samastaduritāpahaḥ || 141 ||
samastaripuvidhvaṃsī samastāsuraghātanaḥ | samastapātakadhvaṃsī samastasuravanditaḥ || 142 ||
lakṣmīsanātano lakṣmīsanakaḥ sādhupūjitaḥ | harirharo hariharo hāṭakeśo haṭāpahaḥ || 143 ||
haridravarṇo hasito hārī haritalocanaḥ | lakṣmīharirhṛṣīkeśo lakṣmīhāradharo'naghaḥ || 144 ||
kṣamī kṣamāpatiḥ kṣattā kṣameśaśca (k, kh, g: meśaḥ kṣaravarṇa) kṣavarṇabhāk | kṣaṇakṛt kṣaṇadānāthaḥ kṣamāvān kṣubhitāsuraḥ || 145 ||
lakṣmīkṣamāyuto lakṣmīkṣattā lakṣmīkṣavarṇabhṛt | ananto'nantapūjyaścāpyādirādityasaṃnnibhaḥ (kh: nandipūjya) || 146 ||
indirāvallabho deva īśvaraścograrūpavān | ūṣmojjvalo'pi ṛṇahā ṝkārojjvalamātṛkaḥ || 147 ||
ḷvarṇavarṇo ḹkāra enavarṇasamanvitaḥ | aiśvaryasahitaścoṣṭhastathaunmattasvarārcitaḥ || 148 ||
aṃkāraścaivamaḥkārasvarūpaḥ svarabhūṣitaḥ | oṃhrīṃhasauḥ hrīṃśrīṃdevo lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ śivaḥ (1000) || 149 ||
iti mantramayaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ tattvamuttamam | akārādikṣakārānta vidyānilayamīśvari || 150 ||
sarvatīrthamayaṃ sarvadevadānavapūjitam | aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājipeyasya koṭayaḥ || 151 ||
cāndrāyaṇāyutaṃ devi mahādānānyanekaśaḥ |
mantranāmasahasrasya kalāṃ nārghanti ṣoḍaśīm || 152 ||
ardharātre paṭhedvīraḥ śaktivakṣaḥsthitaḥ śanaiḥ | svapne lakṣmīpriyaṃ devaṃ varadaṃ so'pi paśyati || 153 ||
mahācīnārcanaṃ kṛtvā paṭhedvīrārcane sakṛt | śatavarṣasahasrāṇi pūjāyāḥ phalamāpnuyāt || 154 ||
ekavāraṃ paṭhedyastu saṃpūjya gurusaṃnidhau | sa bhavet sādhakaḥ śrīmān paratra tridivaṃ vrajet || 155 ||
puṇyadaṃ varadaṃ nutyaṃ (k: nityaṃ) tīrthasādhanamuttamam | yogināṃ yogadaṃ pūjyaṃ (k: puṇyaṃ) bhogināṃ bhogavardhanam || 156 ||
rogiṇāṃ rogaśamanaṃ sarvaduṣkṛtanāśanam | vaiṣṇavānāṃ priyataraṃ muktānāṃ paramārthadam || 157 ||
adātavyamaśrotavyamanyaśiṣyāya pārvati | vinā dānaṃ na gṛhṇīyānna dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ vinā || 158 ||
dattvā gṛhītvāpyubhayoḥ siddhihānirbhaved dhruvam | idaṃ nāmasahasraṃ tu lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya te | tava bhaktyā mayākhyātaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 159 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye lakṣmīnārāyaṇasahasranāmanirūpaṇamekonacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 39 ||
atha
[catvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adyāhaṃ tattvasarvasvaṃ rahasyaṃ paramārthadam | mantrastotraṃ pravakṣyāmi lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya te || 1 ||
pañcamāṅgaṃ mahādevi paramārthaprakāśakam | caturvedāgamastutyaṃ bhogamokṣaikakāraṇam || 2 ||
guhyaṃ guptataraṃ tattvaṃ mantrarājasya pārvati | kaulikānāṃ sadā saṃvidānandarasakāraṇam || 3 ||
asya śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇamantrastotrarājasya śiva ṛṣiḥ triṣṭup chandaḥ śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇo devatā śrīṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ oṃ kīlakaṃ bhogāpavargasiddhyarthe pāṭhe viniyogaḥ | dhyānam(-)
pūrṇenduvadanaṃ pītavasanaṃ kamalāsanam | lakṣmyā śritaṃ caturbhāhuṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ bhaje || 4 ||
kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalahāramaṇḍitaṃ padmāsanaṃ śyāmamukhaṃ caturbhujam | pītāmbaraṃ śaṃkhagadābjacakrapāṇiṃ (k, kh: gadābjapāṇiṃ purāṇamīśaṃ puruṣaṃ) purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ bhaje vibhum || 5 ||
praṇavaṃ yadi mānavo japeddharipādāmbujasevanākulaḥ | danujāntakadhāma yāti nūnaṃ paramānandamayo gatasmayaḥ || 6 ||
parābījaṃ nutyaṃ yadi japati janturjapabhuvi smarākrāntaḥ smārtāgamakuṭilamārgojjhitabhayaḥ |
bhavet kauleśānaḥ sakalaripudāvāgnijaladaḥ surastrībhiḥ sārdhaṃ suraviṭapivāṭīṣu ramate || 7 ||
vibījaṃ yo mahāmantraṃ japedānandanirbharaḥ | ānandarūpo bhavitā lakṣmīnārāyaṇapriyaḥ || 8 ||
vibhūtibījaṃ manurājatattvaṃ japedratānte yadi kaulikendraḥ | sa yāti devāsurapūjitāṅghriḥ paraṃ padaṃ sarvasurairalabhyam || 9 ||
mābījamantaḥ paramārthatattvaṃ sattvaikarūpaṃ manasā japed yaḥ | sa kāminīkāmaraṇapravīṇo bhavedarīṇāmurudarpahārī || 10 ||
ramābījaṃ nāmākṣarapadamayaṃ mantramukuṭaṃ japedyo yantrāgre haricaraṇapadmārpitamanāḥ | bhaved bhūbhṛnmaulisphuritamaṇimālāṃśunivahaprabhābhāsvatpādaḥ sa dharaṇidharendro vijayavān || 11 ||
nārāyaṇāyeti japenmanuṃ yo rātrau prabhāte paramārthabījam | sa vairidāvānalavārivāho bhavet sa gīrbhirgurugarvahārī || 12 ||
viśvaṃ japedyo hṛdi viśvasāraṃ viśvambharadhyānaparaḥ prabhāte | sāmrājyalakṣmīṃ sa ripūn vijitya labhed bhuvi svargamataḥ parāsuḥ || 13 ||
caturaśraravṛttaṣoḍaśāra vasupatrāñcitakāśrarāśrabindau | kamalāśritamīśvaraṃ niviṣṭaṃ paramānandamayaṃ bhajāmyanantam || 14 ||
iti mantramayaṃ paṭhet stavaṃ yo hṛdi nārāyaṇavallabhaṃ prabhāte | kamalā vimalāśayasya tasya śrutiśīlasya vaśībhavatyavaśyam || 15 ||
itīdaṃ stotramīśāni mūlamantramayaṃ param | tava bhaktyā mayākhyātaṃ nacākhyeyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ || 16 ||
pañcāṅgamidamādyantaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya te | varṇitaṃ gopyamarcāḍhyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 17 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan sarvatattvajña sarvalokahiterata | krītāsmi bhavatānena kathanenāsya śaṅkara || 18 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyādya śrutvā pañcāṅgamuttamam | mayāptaḥ paramānando dāsyahaṃ te bravīmi kim || 19 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
etadrahasyamakhilaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitam | vedānāloḍya tantrāṃśca devi te kathitaṃ mayā || 20 ||
devānāṃ durlabhaṃ tattvaṃ pañcāṅgaṃ vaiṣṇavārcite | rahasyaṃ sarvalokānāṃ sarvasvaṃ mama pārvati || 21 ||
aprakāśyamavaktavyamadātavyaṃ durātmane | deyaṃ śiṣyāya śāntāya gurubhaktiparāya ca || 22 ||
dānaśīlāya bhaktāya kaulamārgaratāya ca | mahācīnapadasthāya vaiṣṇavāya mahātmane || 23 ||
dattvā muktiṃ labhed devi bhaktānāṃ sukhadāyinīm |
itīdaṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ tattvāttattvaṃ parātparam || 24 ||
gopyaṃ guhyaṃ gopanīyaṃ cetyājñā pārameśvarī |
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye lakṣmīnārāyaṇastavākhyānaṃ catvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 40 ||
[samāptaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇapañcāṅgam] | atha
[ekacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
mṛtyuñjayapañcāṅgam |
śrībhairava uvāca |
kailāsaśikhare ramye maṇimālātibhāsvare | nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāpuṣpopaśobhite || 1 ||
vicitraratnakhacita śilāmaṇḍapamaṇḍite | kinnarīmadhurālāpa mukharīkṛtadiṅmukhe || 2 ||
bhagavantamumānāthamupaviṣṭamumāśritam | brahmopendrendracandrārka guruśukrasamanvitam || 3 ||
brahmarṣivasusiddhaugha gaṇagandharvasevitam |
candrārdhamukuṭopetaṃ śūlakhaṭvāṅgadhāriṇam || 4 ||
varābhayakaraṃ śāntaṃ kuntabāṇāsisaṃyutam | khaḍgakheṭakahastaṃ ca pāśatomarakāyudham || 5 ||
bhiṇḍipālakaraṃ prāsaparighāyudhadhāriṇam | gadāḍamaruhastaṃ ca śataghnīcakrasaṃyutam (ṅ: śataghni) || 6 ||
aṣṭādaśabhujaṃ devaṃ bhūtibhūṣitavigraham | digambaraṃ viśālākṣaṃ trinetraṃ pañcavaktrakam || 7 ||
ānandamuditaṃ viśvaṃ viśvanāyakamīśvaram | japantaṃ prahasantaṃ ca gauryāliṅgitavigraham || 8 ||
pannagābharaṇopetaṃ mahādevaṃ maheśvaram | baddhapadmāsanaṃ śaṃbhuṃ śaraṇāgatavatsalam || 9 ||
prasannavadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamyotthāya pārvatī | girā madhurayā devaṃ provāca parameśvaram || 10 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan yaḥ śivo devo mahāmṛtyuñjayaḥ paraḥ | ādinātho jagattrātā (ṅ: tāto) dīkṣānāyaka īśvaraḥ || 11 ||
varṇitaḥ prāṅ mahādevo guṇātītaścidīśvaraḥ | bhavatā tasya devasya parabrahmasvarūpiṇaḥ || 12 ||
pañcāṅgaṃ śrotumicchāmi vaktumarhasi me prabho |
śrībhairava uvāca |
parameśvaradevasya mahāmṛtyuñjayasya te | bhaktyā vakṣyāmi pañcāṅgaṃ nākhyeyaṃ yasya kasyacit || 13 ||
paṭalaṃ paddhatiṃ varma mantranāmasahasrakam | stotraṃ pañcāṅgabhūtaṃ ca gopayedyaḥ sa sādhakaḥ || 14 ||
tatrādau paṭalaṃ vakṣye dīkṣānāyakavallabham | guhyaṃ paramaguhyaṃ ca goptavyaṃ tu (kh: ca) mumukṣubhiḥ || 15 ||
mantroddhāraṃ mahādevi dīkṣāphalavivṛddhaye | divyaṃ sukhakaraṃ sādhyaṃ siddhaṃ vakṣyāmi siddhaye || 16 ||
tāraṃ hṛdbhavatārtikaṃ śivaśaranmaṇḍūkabījaṃ tato vācyaṃ pālaya pālayeti ca punaḥ śaktiḥ śivaḥ śāktikam | hṛjjaṃ tārakabhūṣaṇaṃ nigaditastvadbhaktihetormayā dīkṣānāyakavallabho manurayaṃ trailokyacintāmaniḥ || 17 ||
nāsyāntarāyabāhulyaṃ siddhasādhyāridūṣaṇam | na kāyakleśadaurbalyaṃ nācāraniyamabhramaḥ || 18 ||
na pañcadoṣaśaṅkāpi nottamarṇādhamarṇakau | kevalaṃ paramānandavardhano ripumardanaḥ || 119 ||
mantro'yaṃ mantrarājendro dīkṣāphalasuradrumaḥ | vinā puraskriyāmeṣa mantrarājo na sidhyati || 20 ||
tasmāt puraskriyāhetorguruṃ saṃprārthayecchive | guruhastena yaḥ kuryānmantrasyāsya puraskriyām || 21 ||
tasyāyaṃ mantrarājendro bhavet kalpadrumopamaḥ | varṇalakṣaṃ puraścaryāṃ tadardhaṃ vā maheśvari || 22 ||
ekalakṣāvadhiṃ kuryānnāto nyūnaṃ kadācana | japād daśāṃśato homastaddaśāṃśena tarpaṇam || 23 ||
mārjanaṃ taddaśāṃśena taddaśāṃśena bhojanam | evaṃ vidhāya mantrasya puraścaryāṃ ca sādhakaḥ || 24 ||
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā yathāvibhavamīśvari | tato japo bhaved devi sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ || 25 ||
anyathā na bhavet siddhirdīkṣāyāḥ sumanorapi | yantroddhāravidhiṃ vakṣye devadevasya pārvati || 26 ||
sarvasaṃmohanaṃ divyaṃ sarvāśāparipūrakam | bindutrikoṇaṣaṭkoṇa vṛttāṣṭadalamaṇḍitam || 27 ||
vṛttatrayaṃ dharāsadma śrīcakraṃ śaivamīritam | layāṅgamasya vakṣyāmi yantrarājasya pārvati || 28 ||
yasya śravaṇamātreṇa dīkṣāphalamavāpnuyāt | indrādyā daśa dikpālāḥ sāyudhā bhūgṛhe śive || 29 ||
divyasiddhaughamartyaughā guravo'pyāraṇatraye | asitāṅgo ruruścaṇḍakrodheśonmattabhairavāḥ || 30 ||
kapālīśo bhīṣaṇākhyaḥ saṃhāreśo'ṣṭamaḥ śive | pūjanīyā vasudale sādhakaistu mumukṣubhiḥ || 31 ||
kālāgnirudraṃ netreśaṃ viśvanāthaṃ maheśvaram | sadyojātaṃ vāmadevaṃ pūjayet kāmayoniṣu || 32 ||
kāmeśvaraṃ mahākālaṃ devaṃ svacchandabhairavam | trikoṇe pūjayed devi svāgreśānāgnibhāgataḥ || 33 ||
bindau mṛtyuñjayaṃ devaṃ svaśaktyā sahitaṃ śive | amṛteśvaramīśānamīśvaraṃ bhuvaneśvaram || 34 ||
trikhaṇḍāṃ pāśamīśāni sudhākalaśamuttamam | muktākṣasūtraṃ devāṅge pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ || 35 ||
saṃpūjya vidhivad devi gandhākṣataprasūnakaiḥ | dhūpadīpādinaivedyaistāmbūlaiśchatracāmaraiḥ || 36 ||
layāṅgamidamākhyātaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitam | sarvasiddhipradaṃ devi gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 37 ||
mantrasyāsya mahādevi mahācama padādikaḥ |
sakahola ṛṣiśchando gāyatrī devatā tathā || 38 ||
mahāmṛtyuñjayo rudro mahādevo'dhidevatā | bījaṃ ca praṇavo devi śaktirhṛjjākhyabījakam || 39 ||
kīlakaṃ śaradīśāni digbandho'styastramīśvari | caturvargeṣu vidyāyā viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 40 ||
tārahṛjjaśaradbījaiḥ ṣaḍdīrghaiḥ prāṇa(nyāsa)mācaret | karayorhṛdayādīnāmaṅgānāṃ sādhakottamaḥ || 41 ||
mūlādibījamātreṇa prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caret | tattvatrayeṇācamanamātmavidyāśivādinā || 42 ||
atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi devadeveśvarasya hi | yenaiva dhyānamātreṇa mantrī śaivaṃ padaṃ vrajet || 43 ||
candrārkāgnivilocanaṃ smitamukhaṃ padmadvayāntaḥsthitaṃ mudrāpāśasudhākṣasūtravilasatpāṇiṃ (mudrā trikhaṇḍākhyā ityarthaḥ) himāṃśuprabham | koṭīrendugalatsudhāplutatanuṃ (ṅ: koṭīcandragalatsudhādbhuta) hārādibhūṣojjvalaṃ kāntyā viśvavimohanaṃ paśupatiṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ bhāvayet || 44 ||
candramaṇḍalamadhyasthe rudrabhāle'tivistṛte | tatrasthaṃ cintayet sādhyaṃ mṛtyuṃ prāpto'pi (ṅ: prāpnoti) jīvati || 45 ||
iti sādhyaṃ parābījamantrāvayavabhūṣitam | rudrabhālasthamīśāni gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 46 ||
prayogānaṣṭa vakṣyāmi durlabhān paramārthadān | yān vidhāya śive mantrī bhaved bhairavasannibhaḥ || 47 ||
stambhanaṃ mohanaṃ caiva māraṇākarṣaṇe tataḥ | vaśīkāraṃ tathoccāṭaṃ śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ tathā || 48 ||
eteṣāṃ sādhanaṃ vakṣye sarvasaukhyaikakāraṇam | yena sādhanamātreṇa sarvasiddhirbhavet kalau || 49 ||
ravau snānaṃ śive kṛtvā nityakarma samāpya ca | saṃkalpapūrvaṃ mantraṃ ca japedayutasaṃkhyayā || 50 ||
homo daśāṃśataḥ sarpiryavākanakabījakaiḥ | stambhanaṃ jāyate vādimukhadasyuvivasvatām || 51 ||
candre saṃpūjya deveśaṃ japedayutasaṃkhyayā | homo ghṛtayavālājaśākapatrairdaśāṃśataḥ || 52 ||
tadbhasmatilakenaiva mohanaṃ jagatāṃ bhavet | maṅgale sādhakaḥ snātvā gatvā śmaśānamaṇḍalam || 53 ||
ayutaṃ prajapenmantraṃ homo ghṛtaviśālayā | śrīparṇīmadhukonmiśraiḥ śrīphalaiściñcinīphalaiḥ || 54 ||
mṛtyuṃ yāti ripurdevi daśāhāvadhi matsamaḥ | budhe snātvārcayed devaṃ śrīcakrāgre japenmanum || 55 ||
ayutaṃ daddaśāṃśena hunet sarpiḥ śatāvarīm | trikaṇṭakaṃ bilvakaṃ ca strīṇāmākarṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 56 ||
gurau snātvā japedvidyāṃ parāmayutasaṃkhyayā | homo daśāṃśataḥ kāryo ghṛtapadmākṣacandanaiḥ || 57 ||
āragvadhena kaṇayā varayāmṛtayā śive | ripū rājā dhanī vīro jiṣṇurdāsatvameṣyati || 58 ||
śukre śmaśāne vīreśo japedayutasaṃkhyayā | citāgre mūlavidyāṃ tu taddaśāṃśaṃ huned ghṛtam || 59 ||
samaṇḍūkaṃ śambhūkaṃ ca ripumuccāṭayed dhruvam | śanau snātvā caret pūjāṃ japedvidyāṃ tathāyutam || 60 ||
hunedājyapayomṛtsnā vārtākamṛduśādbalān |
dhattūrapuṣpasahitān sarvaśāntiḥ prajāyate || 61 ||
sarvadā sarvavāreṣu japedayutasaṃkhyayā | homo daśāṃśataḥ kāryo ghṛtapāyasapaṅkajaiḥ || 62 ||
chāgaiṇakūrmavārāhapalayuktaiḥ sabhaktakaiḥ | pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca bhūbhṛtāṃ (k, kh, g: bhūtānāṃ) rogiṇāṃ tathā || 63 ||
daśāṃśaṃ vidhivad dattvā mahāpuṣṭiḥ prajāyate | itīdaṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ mantrasyāsya mayeritam | adātavyamabhaktebhyo gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 64 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye mṛtyuñjayapaṭalanirūpaṇaṃ ekacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 41 || atha
[dvācatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devi vakṣyāmi pūjāpaddhatimuttamām | gadyapadyamayīṃ divyāṃ koṭiyajñaphalapradām || 1 ||
prātaḥkṛtyamakṛtvā tu yaḥ śivaṃ bhaktito'rcayet | tasya pūjā tu viphalā śaucahīnā yathā kriyā || 2 ||
brāhmye muhūrte utthāya baddhapadmāsanaḥ svaśiraḥsthasahasrārādhomukhakamalakarṇikāntargataṃ nijaguruṃ dhyāyet | śrīguruṃ paramānandaṃ vande svānandavigraham | yasya sannidhimātreṇa cidānandāyate vapuḥ (k, kh, g: param) || iti natvā
śrīguruṃ dvibhujaṃ śāntaṃ varābhayakarāmbujam | pūrṇenduvadanāmbhojaṃ hasantaṃ śaktisaṃyutam || śvetavastraparīdhānaṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitam | ānandamuditaṃ devaṃ dhyāyet paṅkajaviṣṭaram ||
iti dhyātvā daṇḍavat praṇamya haṃsaḥ iti ṣaṭśatādhikamekaviṃśatisāhasramajapājapaṃ mūlaṃ ca yathāśaktyā japtvā japaṃ gurave samarpya tadājñāmādāya bahirāgatya malādi santyajya varṇoktaṃ śaucamādāya nadyādau gatvā oṃklīṃkāmadevāya sarvajanamanoharāya namaḥ iti dantān saṃśodhya gaṃglauṃdantaśodhanaśaktyai namaḥ iti gaṇḍūṣatrayaṃ vidhāya mṛdamānīya tribhāgaṃ kṛtvā oṃprīṃ mṛttikāyai namaḥ ityabhiṣicya mūlenābhimantrya malāpakarṣaṇaṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā oṃgāṃgīṃ gaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati | narmade sindhukāveri jale'smin sannidhiṃ kuru || iti sūryamaṇḍalādaṅkuśamudrayā tīrthānyāvāhya mṛdaṃ jale kṣiptvā punaḥ deveśa bhaktisulabha saparicchada bhairava | yāvat tvāṃ tarpayiṣyāmi tāvaddeva ihāvaha || iti jale trikoṇaṃ vibhāvya tatra mṛdā devamāvāhya mudrāḥ pradarśya mūlena prāṇāyāmapūrvaṃ pādādiśiraḥparyantaṃ trirunmajjet | tataḥ sūryāyārghyatrayaṃ dadyāt | oṃhrāṃhrīṃsaḥ śrīsūryāya prakāśāśaktisahitāya eṣa te'rgho namaḥ iti arghyatrayaṃ dattvā tato'nyadvāsaḥ paridhāpya karāṅganyāsapūrvaṃ prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caret | yathā(-)
iḍayā piba ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pavanaṃ caturuttaraṣaṣṭitamābhyadhikam | tyaja piṅgalayā śanakaiḥ śanakairdaśabhirdaśabhirdaśabhirdvyadhikaiḥ ||
pūrakaḥ 16 kumbhakaḥ 64 recakaḥ 32 iti triḥ kṛtvā oṃjuṃsaḥ ātmatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā oṃjuṃsaḥ vidyātattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā oṃjuṃsaḥ śivatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā ityācamya ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vidhāya vāmahaste jalaṃ dhṛtvā tattvamudrayācchādya yaṃraṃvaṃlaṃhaṃ iti
pañcabhūtamantreṇa saptavāramabhimantrya dakṣahaste dhṛtvā vāmānāmikāṅguṣṭhayogena tadbalitodakabindubhiḥ svaśiro mūlamuccaran daśadhā (ṅ: saptadaśadhā) prokṣya punarvāmahaste vidhāya (ṅ: nidhāya) iḍayāntarnītvā dehāntaḥ pāpaṃ prakṣālya piṅgalayā tajjalaṃ sakaluṣaṃ dakṣahaste dhṛtvā svavāmabhāgasthakalpitavajraśilāyāmāsphālayedityaghamarṣaṇaṃ vidhāya pūrvavat ṣaḍaṅgaṃ kṛtvā oṃjuṃsaḥ paramahaṃsāya vidmahe sohaṃsaḥ mṛtyuñjayāya dhīmahi juṃoṃtanno'mṛteśvaraḥ pracodayāt | iti daśadhā prajapya mūlaṃ ca yathāśaktyā japtvā gāyatryā devīdevayorarghyatrayaṃ dadyāt | oṃjuṃsaḥ sāṅgāyāmṛteśvarīsahitāya mṛtyuñjayāya eṣa te argho namaḥ | tathā pūrvavat sūryāyārghyatrayaṃ dattvā jale caturasraṃ satryasraṃ vibhāvya mūlamuccaran saptadhā (ṅ: saptadaśadhā) sadevīkaṃ devaṃ tarpayet | mū(0) sāṅgaḥ savāhanaḥ sāyudhaḥ saparicchadaḥ sadevīko mṛtyuñjayo bhagavāṃstṛpyatāmiti santarpya parivārānekaikāñjalinā santarpya brahmādikīṭaparyantaṃ santarpya pitrāditarpaṇaṃ vidhāya pūrvavad devaṃ saṃhāramudrayā svahṛdi samānīya śivo'hamiti bhāvayan yāgamaṇḍapamāgacchediti saṃdhyāvidhiḥ ||
tato gṛhamāgatya pādau prakṣālya dvāradevatāḥ pūjayet | hūṃphaḍiti dvāraṃ prakṣālya ūrdhve gāṃ gaṇeśāya namaḥ vāmadakṣiṇakrameṇa mahālakṣmyai namaḥ sarasvatyai namaḥ gaṅgāyai namaḥ yamunāyai namaḥ dhātre namaḥ vidhātre namaḥ nandāya namaḥ sunandāya namaḥ pracaṇḍāya namaḥ caṇḍāya namaḥ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ vetālāya namaḥ agnivetālāya namaḥ iti saṃpūjya tatrāsane (ṅ: tata āsanamantreṇa) mantreṇa puṣpaṃ dattvā anantāsanāya namaḥ vimalāsanāya namaḥ padmāsanāya namaḥ | oṃ pṛthvi tvayā dhṛtā lokā devi tvaṃ viṣṇunā dhṛtā | tvaṃ ca dhāraya māṃ loke pavitraṃ kuru cāsanam || trirvāmapārṣṇighātaṃ dattvā apasarpantu te bhūtā ye bhūtā bhūmisaṃsthitāḥ | ye bhūtā vighnakartāraste naśyantu śivājñayā || iti vighnānutsārya hūṃ aghorāya phaṭ iti daśa diśo baddhvā bhūtaśuddhiṃ kuryāt |
adyāhaṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ kariṣye iti saṅkalpya vāme gurubhyo namaḥ dakṣiṇe gaṇeśāya namaḥ agre śivāya namaḥ pṛṣṭhe kṣetrapālāya namaḥ iti namaskṛtya praṇavena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā hūmiti mūlādhārāt
kuṇḍalinīmutthāpya suṣumnāvartmanā hṛdayasthajīvamādāya brahmarandhragatāṃ vibhāvya haṃsa iti brahmaṇi yojayet | tataḥ pādādijānuparyantaṃ pṛthivīṃ jānvādinābhyantaṃ jalaṃ nābhyādihṛdayāntaṃ vahniṃ hṛdayādibhrūmadhyāntaṃ vāyuṃ bhūmadhyādidvādaśāntamākāśaṃ pratyekaṃ pravilāpya ākāśamahaṅkāre'haṅkāraṃ mahattattve tadahaṃprakṛtau tāṃ saccidānandarūpe brahmaṇi vilāpya svātmānaṃ brahmamayaṃ vibhāvya |
ahaṃ devo nacānyo'sti brahmaivāhaṃ na śokabhāk | saccidānandarūpo'haṃ nityamuktasvabhāvavān ||
evaṃ vibhāvya svaśarīradakṣakuṣau pāpapuruṣaṃ dhyāyet |
brahmahatyāśiraskaṃ ca svarṇasteyabhujadvayam | surāpānahṛdā yuktaṃ gurutalpakaṭidvayam ||
tatsaṃsargipadadvandvamaṅgapratyaṅgapātakam | upapātakalomānaṃ raktaśmaśruvilocanam ||
khaḍgacarmadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kukṣau pāpaṃ vicintayet |
iti dhyātvā śarīraṃ sakaluṣaṃ malinaṃ vicintya prāṇāyāmapūrvakaṃ pañcabhūtamantrairniṣpāpaṃ kuryāt | hṛdādibhrūmadhyāt yaṃbījena ṣoḍaśadhā japtena vāyumāpūrya pāpaṃ saṃśoṣya nābhyādihṛtparyantāntargatamagnimagnibījena catuṣṣaṣṭivārajaptena sandīpya pāpaṃ nirdahya jānvādinābhyantaṃ jalaṃ vamiti varuṇabījena dvātriṃśadvārajaptenādāya pāpamambhasāplāvya lamiti bhūbījena ṣoḍaśadhā japtena pādādijānuparyantaṃ pṛthivīṃ vicintya piṇḍībhūtaṃ svātmakaṃ dhyātvā hamityākāśabījena sakṛjjaptena caitanyaṃ saṃbhāvya cidānandamayaṃ svaśarīramutpādya prāṇān dhārayediti bhūtaśuddhiḥ ||
oṃjuṃsaḥ śivāya prāṇātmane namaḥ iti svahṛdi puṣpaṃ dattvā āṃhrīṃkroṃyaṃraṃvaṃlaṃhaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃ haṃsaḥ sohaṃ juṃsaḥ oṃ mama prāṇā iha prāṇāḥ 1(9/) mama jīva iha sthitaḥ 1(9/) mama sarvendriyāṇi 1(9/) mama vāṅmanaścakṣuḥśrotrajihvāghrāṇaprāṇā ihaivāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu svāhā iti prāṇān dhṛtvā mūlaṃ svahṛdi vilikhya saśivaṃ śivaṃ saṃpūjya śivo'hamiti vicintya mantrasaṅkalpaṃ kuryāt | asya śrīmahāmṛtyuñjayapūjāmantrasya
mahācamasakahola ṛṣiḥ devīgāyatrī chandaḥ śrīmṛtyuñjayarudro mahādevo devatā oṃ bījaṃ juṃ śaktiḥ saḥ kīlakam dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe pūjāyāṃ viniyogaḥ | atha nyāsaḥ | mahācamasakaholaṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi devīgāyatrīcchandase (kh: daivīgāyatrī) namo mukhe śrīmṛtyuñjayarudramahādevadevatāyai namo hṛdi oṃ bījāya namo nābhau juṃ śaktaye namo guhye saḥ kīlakāya namaḥ pādayoḥ jape (pūjāyāṃ) viniyogāya namaḥ sarvāṅgeṣu || atha karanyāsaḥ | oṃ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ juṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ saḥ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ juṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ saḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ iti karanyāsaḥ || atha ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ | oṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ juṃ śirase svāhā saḥ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ oṃ kavacāya huṃ juṃ netrebhyo vauṣaṭ saḥ astrāya phaṭ ||
atha mātṛkānyāsaḥ | aṃ namaḥ śirasi | āṃ namo mukhavṛtte | iṃ namo dakṣanetre | īṃ vāmanetre | uṃ dakṣakarṇe | ūṃ vāmakarṇe | ṛṃ dakṣanāsāpuṭe | ṝṃ vāmanāsāpuṭe | ḷṃ dakṣagaṇḍe | ḹṃ vāmagaṇḍe | eṃ ūrdhvoṣṭhe | aiṃ adharoṣṭhe | oṃ ūrdhvadantapaṃktau | auṃ adhodantapaṃktau | aṃ lalāṭe | aḥ jihvāyāṃ (ṅ: aṃ śirasi, aḥ mukhāntaḥ) | kaṃ dakṣabāhumūle | khaṃ kurpare | gaṃ maṇibandhe | ghaṃ aṅgulimūle | ṅaṃ aṅgulyagre | caṃ vāmabāhumūle | chaṃ kurpare | jaṃ maṇibandhe | jhaṃ aṅgulimūle | ñaṃ aṅgulyagre | ṭaṃ dakṣapādamūle | ṭhaṃ jānuni | ḍaṃ gulphe | ḍhaṃ aṅgulimūle | ṇaṃ aṅgulyagre | taṃ vāmapādamūle | thaṃ jānuni | daṃ gulphe | dhaṃ aṅgulimūle | naṃ aṅgulyagre | paṃ dakṣapārśve | phaṃ vāmapārśve | baṃ pṛṣṭhe | bhaṃ nābhau | maṃ jaṭhare | yaṃ hṛdi | raṃ dakṣāṃse | laṃ kakudi | vaṃ vāmāṃse | śaṃ hṛdādidakṣahastāgrāntaṃ | ṣaṃ hṛdādivāmahastāgrāntaṃ | saṃ hṛdādidakṣapādāgrāntaṃ | haṃ hṛdādivāmapādāgrāntaṃ | laṃ pādādiśiraḥparyantaṃ | kṣaṃ namaḥ śirasaḥ pādaparyantam | iti trirvyāpayediti mātṛkānyāsaḥ ||
oṃhsauḥ aṃ śrīkaṇṭhapūrṇodarībhyāṃ namaḥ śirasi | oṃhsauḥ āṃ ananteśavirajābhyāṃ namo mukhavṛtte | oṃhsauḥ iṃ sūkṣmeśaśālmalībhyāṃ namo dakṣanetre | oṃhsauḥ īṃ trimūrtīśalolākṣībhyāṃ namo vāmanetre |
oṃhsauḥ uṃ amareśavartulākṣībhyāṃ namo dakṣakarṇe | oṃhsauḥ ūṃ argheśadīrghaghoṇābhyāṃ namo vāmakarṇe | oṃhsauḥ ṛṃ bhāvabhūtīśadīrghamukhībhyāṃ namo dakṣanāsāpuṭe | oṃhsauḥ ṝṃ tithīśagomukhībhyāṃ namo vamanāsāpuṭe | oṃhsauḥ ḷṃ sthāṇukeśadīrghajihvābhyāṃ namo dakṣagaṇḍe | oṃhsauḥ ḹṃ hareśakuṇḍodarībhyāṃ namo vāmagaṇḍe | oṃhsauḥ eṃ jhiṇṭhīśordhvakeśībhyāṃ namaḥ ūrdhvoṣṭhe | oṃhsauḥ aiṃ bhautikeśavikṛtamukhībhyāṃ namaḥ adharoṣṭhe | oṃhsauḥ oṃ sadyojāteśajvālāmukhībhyāṃ namaḥ ūrdhvadantapaṃktau | oṃhsauḥ auṃ anugraheśolkāmukhībhyāṃ namaḥ adhodantapaṃktau | oṃhsauḥ aṃ akrūreśaśrīmukhībhyāṃ namo lalāṭe (k, kh, g: śirasi) | oṃhsauḥ aḥ mahāseneśavidyāmukhībhyāṃ namo jihvāyāṃ (k, kh: mukhāntare) | oṃhsauḥ kaṃ krodhīśamahākālībhyāṃ namo dakṣabāhumūle | oṃhsauḥ khaṃ caṇḍīśasarasvatībhyāṃ namaḥ kūrpare | oṃhsauḥ gaṃ pañcānaneśasarvasiddhibhyāṃ (ṅ: pañcāntaka) namo maṇibandhe | oṃhsauḥ ghaṃ śivottameśatrilokavidyābhyāṃ namaḥ aṅgulimūle | oṃhsauḥ ṅaṃ ekarudreśamantraśaktibhyāṃ (ṅ: trimūrti) namaḥ aṅgulyagre | oṃhsauḥ caṃ kūrmeśātmaśaktibhyāṃ namo vāmabāhumūle | oṃhsauḥ chaṃ ekanetreśabhūtamātṛbhyāṃ namaḥ kūrpare | oṃhsauḥ jaṃ caturānaneśalambodarībhyāṃ namo maṇibandhe | oṃhsauḥ jhaṃ ajeśadrāviṇībhyāṃ namaḥ aṅgulimūle | (2/) ñaṃ śarveśanāgarībhyāṃ namaḥ aṅgulyagre | (2/) ṭaṃ someśakhecarībhyāṃ namo dakṣapādamūle | (2/) ṭhaṃ lāṅgalīśamañjarībhyāṃ namo jānuni | (2/) ḍaṃ dāhakeśarūpiṇībhyāṃ (ṅ: dārukeśa) namo gulphe | (2/) ḍhaṃ ardhanārīśavīriṇībhyāṃ namaḥ aṅgulimūle | (2/) ṇaṃ umākānteśakākodarībhyāṃ namaḥ aṅgulyagre | (2/) taṃ āṣāḍhīśapūtanābhyāṃ namo vāmapādamūle | (2/) thaṃ daṇḍīśabhadrakālībhyāṃ namo jānuni | (2/) daṃ adrīśayoginībhyāṃ namo gulphe | (2/) dhaṃ mīneśaśaṅkhinībhyāṃ namaḥ aṅgulimūle | (2/) naṃ meṣeśagarjinībhyāṃ namaḥ aṅgulyagre | (2/) paṃ lohiteśakālarātribhyāṃ namo dakṣapārśve | (2/) phaṃ śikhīśakurdinībhyāṃ (ṅ: kubjinī) namo vāmapārśve | (2/) baṃ chagalāṇḍeśakapardinībhyāṃ namaḥ pṛṣṭhe | ((2/) bhaṃ dviraṇḍeśavajriṇībhyāṃ namo
nābhau | (2/) maṃ mahākāleśajayābhyāṃ namo jaṭhare | (2/) yaṃ tvagātmabhyāṃ kapālīśasumukhībhyāṃ namo hṛdaye) | (2/) raṃ asṛgātmabhyāṃ bhujaṅgeśarevatībhyāṃ namo dakṣāṃse | (2/) laṃ māṃsātmabhyāṃ pinākīśamādhavībhyāṃ namaḥ kakudi | (2/) vaṃ meda(-)ātmabhyāṃ khaḍgīśavāruṇībhyāṃ namo vāmāṃse | (2/) śaṃ asthyātmabhyāṃ vakeśavāyavībhyāṃ namo hṛdādidakṣahastāgrāntaṃ | (2/) ṣaṃ majjātmabhyāṃ śveteśarakṣobandhinībhyāṃ namo hṛdādivāmahastāgrāntaṃ | (2/) saṃ śukrātmabhyāṃ bhṛgvīśasahajābhyāṃ namo hṛdādidakṣapādāgrāntaṃ | (2/) haṃ prāṇātmabhyāṃ nakulīśalakṣmībhyāṃ namo hṛdādivāmapādāgrāntaṃ | (2/) laṃ śaktyātmabhyāṃ śiveśavyāpinībhyāṃ namaḥ pādādiśiraḥparyantaṃ | (2/) kṣaḥ krodhātmabhyāṃ saṃvarteśamahāmāyābhyāṃ namaḥ śirasaḥ pādaparyantamiti śrīkaṇṭhādimātṛkānyāsaḥ ||
atha kalānyāsaḥ | oṃaiṃhrīṃhsauḥ sarvajñāya aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | (4/) amṛtajvālāmāline tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | (4/) jvalitaśikhiśikhāya madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ | (4/) vajriṇe vajrahastāya anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ | (4/) aluptaśaktaye kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ | (4/) paśupataye karatalapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | iti karanyāsaḥ ||
oṃaiṃhrīṃhsauḥ sarvajñāya hṛdayāya namaḥ | (4/) amṛtajvālāmāline śirase svāhā | (4/) jvalitaśikhiśikhāya śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | (4/) vajriṇe vajrahastāya kavacāya huṃ | (4/) aluptaśaktaye netrābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ | (4/) paśupataye astrāya phaṭ | iti hṛdayādinyāsaḥ ||
oṃjuṃsaḥ nivṛttyātmane śivāya aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | (3/) pratiṣṭhātmane sadāśivāya tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | (3/) vidyākalātmane īśvarāya madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ | (3/) śāntikalātmane mahārudrāya anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ | (3/) śāntyatītākalātmane viṣṇave kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ | (3/) jyotiṣkalātmane parabrahmaṇe karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | iti karanyāsaḥ ||
oṃjuṃsaḥ nivṛttyātmane śivāya hṛdayāya namaḥ | (3/) pratiṣṭhātmane
sadāśivāya śirase svāhā | (3/) vidyākalātmane īśvarāya śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | (3/) śāntikalātmane mahārudrāya kavacāya huṃ | (3/) śāntyatītākalātmane viṣṇave netrābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ | (3/) jyotiṣkalātmane parabrahmaṇe astrāya phaṭ | iti kalānyāsaḥ ||
oṃjuṃsaḥ netranāthāya aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | haṃsaḥ bhagavannetrāya tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | māṃ pālayapālaya somasūryāgninetrāya madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ | sohaṃsaḥ netranāthāya anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ | juṃoṃ bhagavannetrāya kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃjuṃsaḥ haṃsaḥ māṃ pālayapālaya sohaṃsaḥ juṃoṃ somasūryāgninetrāya karatalapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | evaṃ ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ | iti netranyāsaḥ ||
oṃ namaḥ śirasi | juṃ bhrūmadhye | saḥ mukhe | haṃ kaṇṭhe | saḥ hṛdi | māṃ hastayoḥ | pāṃ stanayoḥ | laṃ kukṣau | yaṃ pārśvayoḥ | pāṃ pṛṣṭhe | laṃ nābhau | yaṃ meḍhre | soṃ jānvoḥ | haṃ jaṅghayoḥ | saḥ pādayoḥ | juṃ pādādiśiraḥparyantaṃ | oṃ śirasaḥ pādaparyantamiti trirvyāpayediti mūlamantranyāsaḥ ||
īśānatatpuruṣayoraghorakalitātmanoḥ | sadyojāteśavāmeśa yutayornyāsamācaret ||
iti śivaśāsanam || oṃ mūlādhāre | juṃ bhrūmadhye | saḥ karandhre | imaṃ nyāsaṃ yathāśaktyā vidhāya divyadehaṃ dhyātvā hṛdaye oṃjuṃsaḥ amṛteśvarapīṭhāya namaḥ | hṛdi gandhākṣatapuṣpaiḥ saṃpūjya oṃjuṃsaḥ haṃsaḥ śrīkālāgnirudramūlaprakṛtikūrmānantavarāhapṛthivīsudhārṇava yogapīṭhāya namaḥ | iti svahṛdaye saṃpūjya amṛtīkaraṇamudrāṃ baddhvā padmamudrāntargataṃ puṣpaṃ sannidhāya mūlādhārāt kuṇḍalinīṃ taḍitkoṭipradyotanīṃ sūryakoṭiprakāśāṃ vahnikoṭidurādharṣāṃ candrakoṭisuśītalāṃ pradīpakalikākārāmutthāpya suṣumnāmārgeṇa brahmapathāntarasthāmṛteśvareṇa saha saṃyojya somamaṇḍalapracyutāmṛtadhārayā saṃtarpya punaḥ svahṛdi samānīya svasthānaṃ prāpayitvāmṛtaśarīrībhūya śivo'hamiti bhāvayan devaṃ bhāvayet |
pīyūṣāṃśuśiromaṇiḥ karatale pīyūṣakumbhaṃ vahan pīyūṣadyutisampuṭāntaragataḥ pīyūṣadhārādharaḥ | māṃ pīyūṣamayūkhasundaravapuḥ pīyūṣalakṣmīsakhaḥ pīyūṣadravavarṣaṇo'pyaharahaḥ prīṇātu mṛtyuñjayaḥ ||
evaṃ devaṃ dhyātvā mānasairupacāraiḥ saṃpūjya kalaśasthāpanaṃ kuryāt | svavāme trikoṇaṣaṭkoṇavṛttacaturaśraṃ vilikhya śaṅkhamudrāṃ pradarśya mūlena saṃpūjya raṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya daśakalātmane namaḥ iti saṃpūjyādhāraṃ saṃsthāpya tatra pātramādhāre nidhāya aṃ arkamaṇḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ iti pātrāntaḥ saṃpūjya tatra jalena saṃpūrya sauḥ somamaṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ iti saṃpūjya tatrāṅkuśamudrayā oṃgāṃgīṃ gaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati | narmade sindhukāveri jale'smin saṃnidhiṃ kuru || ityādinā tīrthamāvāhya mūlenāṣṭābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā dhenuyonikalaśamudrāḥ pradarśya phaḍiti choṭikābhiḥ saṃrakṣya hūmityavaguṇṭhya śaṅkhacakrayonimudrāḥ pradarśya praṇamet | darśanenāpi śaṅkhasya kiṃ punaḥ sparśanena ca | vilayaṃ yānti pāpāni himavadbhāskarodaye || iti sāmānyārghyavidhiḥ ||
sāmānyārghyasya dakṣe bindutrikoṇaṣaṭkoṇavṛttacaturaśraṃ maṇḍalaṃ nirmāya kāmarūpoḍḍīyānajālandharapūrṇagiripīṭhebhyo namaḥ iti caturaśreṣu sampūjya ṣaḍaśreṣu ṣaḍaṅgamantrān saṃpūjya trikoṇe bījatrayaṃ saṃpūjya bindau mūlena saṃpūjya oṃraṃ agnimaṇḍalāya daśakalātmane namaḥ iti prakṣālitamādhāraṃ saṃsthāpya aṃ arkamaṇḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ iti kalaśaṃ kumbhamudrayā saṃsthāpya tatra oṃjvāṃjvīṃjvūṃjvaiṃjvauṃjvaḥsaḥ amṛteśvarabhairavāya mṛtyuñjayāya namaḥ iti mūlena vā mūlavidyayā tattvamudrayā dhārāpātena paramānandadravyādinā kumbhamāpūrya oṃsauḥ somamaṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ iti gandhākṣatapuṣpairabhyarcya haṃsaḥ iti mantreṇa daśa diśo baddhvā choṭikābhiḥ saṃrakṣya hūmityavaguṇṭhya namaḥ ityabhyukṣya mūlaṃ daśadhā japtvāmṛtamudrāṃ pradarśya oṃaṃāṃīṃoṃjuṃsaḥ amṛte amṛtodbhave amṛtavarṣiṇi amṛtaṃ srāvaya (2) oṃjuṃsaḥ amṛteśvaryai namaḥ iti daśadhā japtvā oṃjuṃsaḥ
sūryamaṇḍalasaṃbhūte varuṇālayasaṃbhave | amābījamayi devi śukraśāpādvimucyatām | oṃjuṃsaḥ devānāṃ (g: vedānāṃ) praṇavo bījaṃ brahmānandamayaṃ yadi | tena satyena deveśi brahmahatyā vyapohatu | oṃjuṃsaḥ ekameva paraṃ brahma sthūlasūkṣmamayaṃ dhruvam | kacodbhavāṃ brahmahatyāṃ tena te nāśayāmyaham | oṃjuṃsaḥ brahmaśāpādvinirmuktā tvaṃ muktā viṣṇuśāpataḥ | vimuktā rudraśāpena pavitrā bhava sāṃpratam || (3/) pavamānaḥ parānandaḥ pavamānaḥ paro rasaḥ | pavamānaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ tena tvāṃ pāvayāmyaham || iti trirjaptvā oṃ hasakṣamalavarayūṁ ānandeśvarabhairavāya vauṣaṭ iti daśadhā japtvā sahakṣamalavarayūṁ surādevyai vauṣaṭ iti daśadhā japtvā mūlaṃ trirjaptvā oṃ gaṅge ca yamune caiva ityādinā aṅkuśamudrayā tīrthānyāvāhya kuṇḍalinīṃ jyotīrūpāmutthāpya ṣaṭcakraṃ bhittvā brahmarandhrasthaparamaśivabhaṭṭārakeṇa niyojya (k, kh: saha saṃyojya) haṃsaḥ sohaṃ svāhā iti vicintya tayoḥ sāmarasyodbhavānandāmṛtavahamānanāsāpuṭaniḥsṛtāmṛtadhārayā kalaśamāpūryāmṛtamayaṃ dhyātvā gandhākṣatapuṣpairabhyarcya dhenuyonimatsyamudrāḥ pradarśya praṇamediti dravyaśuddhiḥ ||
tataḥ oṃjuṃsaḥ haṃsaḥ paramāmṛteśaśrīamṛteśvarīśvaramahāmṛtyuñjayapūjādravyebhyo vauṣaṭ iti kalaśādamṛtamādāya oṃ juṃsaḥ haṃsaḥ sohaṃsaḥ juṃoṃ iti daśākṣaramūlena śrīamṛteśvarīśvaramahāmṛtyuñjayacadrāmṛtamayena kalaśāmṛtena yāgadravyāṇi pavitrīkuru (2) sudhādinā pūraya (2) oṃ hauṃ svāhā iti yāgavastūni saṃśodhya sāmānyārghyasyādhastrikoṇaṃ saharaṃ vibhāvya mūlabījatrayeṇa trikoṇaṃ saṃpūjya mūlavidyayā bindumabhyarcya tatrāgnisūryasomamaṇḍalāni saṃpūjya divyaṃ pātraṃ saṃsthāpya kalaśāmṛtenāpūrya mūlavidyayā saṃpūjya pṛthivyādiṣaṭtriṃśattattvāni saṃpūjya mahāmudrāṃ pradarśya agnipadmāmṛtamudrāḥ pradarśya mātṛkāṃ devīṃ saṃpūjya mūlavarṇāṃstatrāntaḥ saṃpūjya gaṅgāditīrthānyāvāhya īśānakalāḥ saṃpūjya tatpuruṣāghorasadyojātavāmadevakalāḥ saṃpūjya śivamayaṃ dhyātvā paramāmṛtabuddhyā vindupānācciddīpaṃ projjvālya śivamayaṃ jagadbhāvayediti paramārghyapātram ||
sāmānyārghyasya vāme guruśaktiyoginīvīravaṭukakṣetrapālapātrāṇi saṃsthāpya tathottare pādyācamanīyamadhuparkācamanīyārghyapātrāṇi sthāpayediti pātrasaṃsthāpanam ||

iti natvā punarnaivedyaṃ oṃratnapātrasthitaṃ divyaṃ nānāvyañjanabruṃhitam | divyaudanaṃ nivedyāśu paramāmṛtasaṃplutam iti mṛgamudrayā nivedya praṇamya mūlānte ācamanīyatāmbūlārātrikācchatracāmarādarśaprabhṛtīni divyāni vastūni sadevīkāya devāya nivedya sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇamet | devāgre mālāmādāya mūlaṃ yathāśakti japtvā guhyātīti japaṃ nivedya devāgre kavacasahasranāmastavarājapāṭhaṃ kṛtvā tadapi devīdevayoḥ samarpya oṃkṣāṃkṣīṃkṣūṃkṣaiṃkṣauṃkṣaḥ kṣetrapālebhyo vauṣaṭ iti baliṃ nivedya oṃyāṃyīṃyūṃyaiṃyauṃyaḥ hsauḥsaḥjuṃoṃ sarvayoginībhyo balirnamaḥ oṃhrīṃ sarvavighnakṛdbhyo bhūtebhyo balirvaṣaṭ svāhā iti baliṃ dattvā praṇāmamudrāṃ pradarśya daṇḍavat praṇamet |tato vīrendraiḥ saha vīrapānaṃ vidhāya pūrṇapātraṃ hutvā svaśaktimānandanirbharāṃ nirmāya ratena saṃtarpya śivo'haṃ bhāvayan devaṃ sadevīkaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ saṃhṛtimudrayā śrīcakrādutthāpya vāmanāsayāntarnītvā tattejaḥ paramacaitanyajyotiṣi brahmaṇi nilīnaṃ dhyātvā ahameva paro haṃsaḥ śivaḥ paramakāraṇam | matprāṇe sa tu paśvātmā līnaḥ sāmarasīgataḥ | iti dhyātvā paramaśivo bhūtvā svaśaktyā saha sukhaṃ viharet | bāhye vaiṣṇavācāraparāyaṇaḥ kālaṃ nayet | tataḥ śrīcakramutthāpya mūlena prakṣālya nirmālyaṃ oṃ juṃsaḥhūṃ oṃsvāhā itīśānadiśi nirmālyaṃ kṣipet |
itīdaṃ devadevasya mahāmṛtyuñjayasya te | nityapūjāsṛtiḥ samyaṅnirṇītā kulasundari ||
guhyātiguhyagoptrī tvaṃ paddhatirnityakarmaṇaḥ | varṇitā netranāthasya nākhyeyā brahmavādibhiḥ ||
sarvatantraikasarvasvaṃ rahasyaṃ pāralaukikam | pūjātattvaṃ mayākhyātaṃ topanīyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye śrīmahāmṛtyuñjayapūjāpaddhatinirūpaṇaṃ dvācatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 42 ||
atha
[trayaścatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
śṛṇuṣva parameśāni kavacaṃ manmukhoditam | mahāmṛtyuñjayasyāsya na deyaṃ paramādbhutam || 1 ||
yaṃ dhṛtvā yaṃ paṭhitvā ca śrutvā ca kavacottamam | trailokyādhipatirbhūtvā sukhito'smi maheśvari || 2 ||
tadeva varṇayiṣyāmi tava prītyā varānane | tathāpi (gh: tvayāpi) paramaṃ tattvaṃ na dātavyaṃ durātmane || 3 ||
asya śrīmahāmṛtyuñjayakavacasya śrībhairava ṛṣiḥ gāyatryaṃ chandaḥ śrīmahāmṛtyuñjayo mahārudro devatā oṃ bījaṃ juṃ śaktiḥ saḥ kīlakaṃ hamiti tattvaṃ caturvargasādhane mṛtyuñjayakavacapāṭhe viniyogaḥ | (dhyānam-)
candramaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ rudraṃ bhāle vicintya tam | tatrasthaṃ cintayet sādhyaṃ mṛtyuṃ prāpto'pi jīvati || 1 ||
oṃjuṃsaḥ hauṃ śiraḥ pātu devo mṛtyuñjayo mama | oṃśrīṃ śivo lalāṭaṃ me oṃhauṃ bhruvau sadāśivaḥ || 2 ||
nīlakaṇṭho'vatānnetre kapardī me'vatācchrutī | trilocano'vatād gaṇḍau nāsāṃ me tripurāntakaḥ || 3 ||
mukhaṃ pīyūṣaghaṭabhṛdoṣṭhau me kṛttikāmbaraḥ | hanuṃ me hāṭakeśāno mukhaṃ vaṭukabhairavaḥ || 4 ||
kandharāṃ kālamathano galaṃ gaṇapriyo'vatu |
skandhau skandapitā pātu hastau me giriśo'vatu || 5 ||
nakhān me girijānāthaḥ pāyādaṅgulisaṃyutān | stanau tārāpatiḥ pātu vakṣaḥ paśupatirmama || 6 ||
kukṣiṃ kuberavaradaḥ pārśvau me māraśāsanaḥ | śarvaḥ pātu tathā (kh: mama) nābhiṃ śūlī pṛṣṭhaṃ mamāvatu || 7 ||
śiśnaṃ me śaṅkaraḥ pātu guhyaṃ guhyakavallabhaḥ | kaṭiṃ kālāntakaḥ pāyādṛrū me'ndhakaghātakaḥ || 8 ||
jāgarūko'vatājjānū jaṅghe me kālabhairavaḥ | gulphau pāyājjaṭādhārī pādau mṛtyuñjayo'vatu || 9 ||
pādādimūrdhaparyantamaghoraḥ pātu me sadā | śirasaḥ pādaparyantaṃ sadyojāto mamāvatu || 10 ||
rakṣāhīnaṃ nāmahīnaṃ vapuḥ pātvamṛteśvaraḥ | pūrve balavikaraṇo dakṣiṇe kālaśāsanaḥ || 11 ||
paścime pārvatīnātho hyuttare māṃ manonmanaḥ | aiśānyāmīśvaraḥ pāyādāgneyyāmagnilocanaḥ || 12 ||
nair(-)ṛtyāṃ śambhuravyānmāṃ vāyavyāṃ vāyuvāhanaḥ | ūrdhve balapramathanaḥ pātāle parameśvaraḥ || 13 ||
daśadikṣu sadā pātu mahāmṛtyuñjayaśca mām | raṇe rājakule dyūte viṣame prāṇasaṃśaye || 14 ||
pāyād oṃ juṃ mahārudro devadevo daśākṣaraḥ | prabhāte pātu māṃ brahmā madhyāhne bhairavo'vatu || 15 ||
sāyaṃ balapramathano niśāyāṃ nityacetanaḥ | ardharātre mahādevo niśānte māṃ mahomayaḥ (ṅ: manonmanaḥ) || 16 ||
sarvadā sarvataḥ pātu oṃjuṃsaḥ hauṃ mṛtyuñjayaḥ |
itīdaṃ kavacaṃ puṇyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham || 17 ||
sarvamantramayaṃ guhyaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitam | puṇyaṃ puṇyapradaṃ divyaṃ devadevādhidaivatam || 18 ||
ya idaṃ ca paṭhenmantrī kavacaṃ vārkṣayet tataḥ | tasya haste mahādevi tryambakasyāṣṭa siddhayaḥ || 19 ||
raṇe dhṛtvā caredyuddhaṃ hatvā śatrūñjayaṃ labhet | jayaṃ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ devi saṃprāpsyati sukhī punaḥ || 20 ||
mahābhaye mahāroge mahāmārībhaye tathā | durbhikṣe śatrusaṃhāre paṭhet kavacamādarāt || 21 ||
sarvaṃ tat praśamaṃ yāti mṛtyuñjayaprasādataḥ | dhanaṃ putrān sukhaṃ lakṣmīmārogyaṃ sarvasaṃpadaḥ || 22 ||
prāpnoti sādhakaḥ sadyo devi satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | itīdaṃ kavacaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāmṛtyuñjayasya tu | gopyaṃ siddhipradaṃ guhyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 23 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye mṛtyuñjayakavacanirūpaṇaṃ trayaścatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 43 ||
atha
[catuścatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā śṛṇu deveśi sahasrākhyastavottamam | mahāmṛtyuñjayasyāsya sārāt sārottamottamam || 1 ||
asya śrīmahāmṛtyuñjayasahasranāmastotramantrasya bhairava ṛṣiḥ uṣṇik chandaḥ śrīmahāmṛtyuñjayo devatā oṃ bījaṃ juṃ śaktiḥ saḥ kīlakaṃ puruṣārthasiddhaye sahasranāmapāṭhe viniyogaḥ | dhyānam(-)
udyaccandrasamānadīptimamṛtānandaikahetuṃ śivaṃ oṃjuṃsaḥbhuvanaikasṛṣṭipralayodbhūtyekarakṣākaram | śrīmattāradaśārṇamaṇḍitatanuṃ tryakṣaṃ dvibāhuṃ paraṃ śrīmṛtyuñjayamīḍyavikramaguṇaiḥ pūrṇaṃ hṛdabje bhaje ||
oṃjuṃsaḥhauṃ mahādevo mantrajño mānadāyakaḥ | mānī manoramāṅgaśca manasvī mānavardhanaḥ || 1 ||
māyākartā mallarūpo mallo mārāntako muniḥ | maheśvaro mahāmānyo mantrī mantrijanapriyaḥ || 2 ||
māruto marutāṃ śreṣṭho māsikaḥ pakṣiko'mṛtaḥ | mātaṅgako mattacitto mattacinmattabhāvanaḥ || 3 ||
mānaveṣṭaprado meṣo menakāpativallabhaḥ | mānakāyo mānasteyī (kh: madhusteyī; kh, ṅ: manusteyī) mārayukto jitendriyaḥ || 4 ||
jayo vijayado jetā jayeśo jayavallabhaḥ |
ḍāmareśo virūpākṣo viśvabhoktā vibhāvasuḥ || 5 ||
viśveśo viśvanāthaśca viśvasūrviśvanāyakaḥ | vinetā vinayī vādī vāntado vāgbhavo (kh: vākprado) vaṭuḥ || 6 ||
sthūlaḥ sūkṣmo'calo lolo lolajihvaḥ karālakaḥ | virādheyo virāgīno vilāsī lāsyalālasaḥ || 7 ||
lolākṣo loladhīrdharmī dhanado dhanadārcitaḥ | dhanī dhyeyo'pyadhyeyaśca dharmyo dharmamayo dayaḥ || 8 ||
dayāvān devajanako devasevyo (g, ṅ: sevo) dayāpatiḥ | ḍulicakṣurdarīvāso dambhī devamayātmakaḥ || 9 ||
kurūpaḥ kīrtidaḥ kāntaḥ klīvo'klīvātmakaḥ kujaḥ | budho vidyāmayaḥ kāmī kāmakālāndhakāntakaḥ (idaṃ nāmnāṃ trayam) || 10 ||
jīvo jīvapradaḥ śukraḥ śuddhaḥ śarmaprado'naghaḥ | śanaiścaro vegagati(100)rvācālo rāhuravyayaḥ || 11 ||
ketuḥ kārāpatiḥ kālaḥ sūryo'mitaparākramaḥ | candro bhadraprado (k: rudrapatiḥ; g: rudrapado) bhāsvān bhāgyado bhargarūpabhṛt || 12 ||
krūro dhūrto viyogī ca saṅgī gaṅgādharo gajaḥ | gajānanapriyo gīto gānī snānārcanapriyaḥ || 13 ||
paramaḥ pīvarāṅgaśca pārvatīvallabho mahān | parātmako virāḍvāso (ṅ: virāḍdhaumyaḥ) vānaro'mitakarmakṛt || 14 ||
cidānandī cārurūpo gāruḍo garuḍapriyaḥ | nandīśvaro nayo nāgo nāgālaṅkāramaṇḍitaḥ || 15 ||
nāgahāro mahānāgo godharo gopatistapaḥ |
trilocanastrilokeśastrimūrtistripurāntakaḥ || 16 ||
tridhāmayo lokamayo lokaikavyasanāpahaḥ | vyasanī toṣitaḥ śambhustridhārūpastrivarṇabhāk || 17 ||
trijyotistripurīnāthastridhāśāntastridhāgatiḥ | tridhāguṇī viśvakartā viśvabhartā''dhipūruṣaḥ || 18 ||
umeśo vāsukirvīro vainateyo vicārakṛt | vivekākṣo viśālākṣo'vidhirvidhiranuttamaḥ || 19 ||
vidyānidhiḥ sarojākṣo niḥsmaraḥ smaranāśanaḥ | smṛtimān smṛtidaḥ smārto brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ || 20 ||
brāhmavratī brahmacārī caturaścaturānanaḥ | calācalo'calagatirvegī vīrādhipo varaḥ || 21 ||
sarvavāsaḥ (k, kh: sarvavāmaḥ) sarvagatiḥ sarvamānyaḥ sanātanaḥ | sarvavyāpī sarvarūpaḥ sāgaraśca sameśvaraḥ (200) || 22 ||
samanetraḥ samadyutiḥ samakāyaḥ sarovaraḥ | sarasvān satyavāk satyaḥ satyarūpaḥ sudhīḥ sukhī || 23 ||
surāṭ satyaḥ satyamatī rudro raudravapurvasuḥ | vasumān vasudhānātho vasurūpo vasupradaḥ || 24 ||
īśānaḥ sarvadevānāmīśānaḥ sarvabodhinām | īśo'vaśeṣo'vayavī śeṣaśāyī śriyaḥ patiḥ || 25 ||
indraścandrāvataṃsī ca carācarajagatsthitiḥ | sthiraḥ sthāṇuraṇuḥ pīnaḥ pīnavakṣāḥ parātparaḥ || 26 ||
pīnarūpo jaṭādhārī jaṭājūṭasamākulaḥ | paśurūpaḥ paśupatiḥ paśujñānī payonidhiḥ || 27 ||
vedyo vaidyo vedamayo vidhijño vidhimān mṛḍaḥ |
śūlī śubhaṅkaraḥ śobhyaḥ śubhakartā śacīpatiḥ || 28 ||
śaśāṅkadhavalaḥ svāmī vajrī śaṅkhī gadādharaḥ | caturbhujaścāṣṭabhujaḥ sahasrabhujamaṇḍitaḥ || 29 ||
sruvahasto dīrghakeśo dīrgho dambhavivarjitaḥ | devo mahodadhirdivyo divyakīrtirdivākaraḥ || 30 ||
ugrarūpa ugrapatirugravakṣāstapomayaḥ | tapasvī jaṭilastāpī tāpahā tāpavarjitaḥ || 31 ||
havirharo hayapatirhayado harimaṇḍitaḥ | harivāhī mahaujasko nityo nityātmako'nalaḥ || 32 ||
saṃmānī saṃsṛtirhārī sargī saṃnidhiranvayaḥ | vidyādharo vimānī ca vaimānikavarapradaḥ || 33 ||
vācaspati(300)rvasāsāro vāmācārī balandharaḥ | vāgbhavo vāsavo vāyurvāsanābījamaṇḍitaḥ || 34 ||
vāsī kolaśrutirdakṣo dakṣayajñavināśanaḥ | dākṣo daurbhāgyahā daityamardano bhogavardhanaḥ || 35 ||
bhogī rogaharo heyo hārī harivibhūṣaṇaḥ | bahurūpo bahumatirbahuvitto vicakṣaṇaḥ || 36 ||
nṛttakṛccittasaṃtoṣo nṛttagītaviśāradaḥ | śaradvarṇavibhūṣāḍhyo galadagdho'ghanāśanaḥ || 37 ||
nāgī nāgamayo'nanto'nantarūpaḥ pinākabhṛt | naṭano hāṭakeśāno varīyāṃśca vivarṇabhṛt || 38 ||
jhāṅkārī ṭaṅkahastaśca pāśī śārṅgī śaśiprabhaḥ | sahasrarūpo samaguḥ sādhūnāmabhayapradaḥ || 39 ||
sādhusevyaḥ sādhugatiḥ sevāphalaprado vibhuḥ | sumahā madyapo matto mattamūrtiḥ sumantakaḥ || 40 ||
kīlī līlākaro lūto (ṅ: lāntaḥ) bhavabandhaikamocanaḥ | rociṣṇurviṣṇuracyutaścūtano nūtano navaḥ || 41 ||
nyagrodharūpo bhayado bhayahā'bhītidhāraṇaḥ | dharaṇīdharasevyaśca dharādharasutāpatiḥ || 42 ||
dharādharo'ndhakaripurvijñānī mohavarjitaḥ | sthāṇukeśo jaṭī grāmyo grāmārāmo ramāpriyaḥ || 43 ||
priyakṛt priyarūpaśca viprayogī pratāpanaḥ | prabhākaraḥ prabhādīpto manyumān mānaveṣṭadaḥ (g, gh: avanīśvaraḥ) || 44 ||
tīkṣṇabāhustīkṣṇakarastīkṣṇāṃśustīkṣṇalocanaḥ | tīkṣṇacittastrayīrūpastrayīmūrtistrayītanuḥ || 45 ||
havirbhug haviṣāṃ jyotirhālāhalo (400) halīpatiḥ | haviṣmallocano hālāmayo haritarūpabhṛt || 46 ||
mradimā''mramayo vṛkṣo hutāśo hutabhug guṇī | guṇajño garuḍo gānatatparo vikramī kramī || 47 ||
krameśvaraḥ kramaparaḥ (k, kh: kramakaraḥ) kramikṛt klāntamānasaḥ | mahātejā mahāmāro mohito mohavallabhaḥ || 48 ||
mahasvī tridaśo bālo bālāpatiraghāpahaḥ | bālyo ripuharo hāhī govirgavimato'guṇaḥ || 49 ||
saguṇo vittarāḍ vīryo virocano vibhāvasuḥ | mālāmayo mādhavaśca vikartano vikatthanaḥ || 50 ||
mānakṛnmuktido'tulyo mukhyaḥ śatrubhayaṅkaraḥ | hiraṇyaretāḥ subhagaḥ satīnāthaḥ sirāpatiḥ || 51 ||
meḍhrī mainākabhaginīpatiruttamarūpabhṛt | ādityo ditijeśāno ditiputrakṣayaṅkaraḥ || 52 ||
vasudevo mahābhāgyo viśvāvasurvasupriyaḥ | samudro'mitatejāśca khagendro viśikhī śikhī || 53 ||
garutmān vajrahastaśca paulomīnātha īśvaraḥ | yajñapeyo vājapeyaḥ śatakratuḥ śatānanaḥ || 54 ||
pratiṣṭhastīvravisrambhī gambhīro bhāvavardhanaḥ | gāyiṣṭho madhurālāpo madhumattaśca mādhavaḥ || 55 ||
māyātmā bhogināṃ trātā nākināmiṣṭadāyakaḥ | nākīndro janako janyaḥ stambhano rambhanāśanaḥ || 56 ||
śaṅkaraḥ īśvara īśaḥ śarvarīpatiśekharaḥ | liṅgādhyakṣaḥ surādhyakṣo vedādhyakṣo vicārakaḥ || 57 ||
bhargo(500)'narghyo nareśāno naravāhanasevitaḥ | caturo bhavitā bhāvī bhāvado bhavabhītihā || 58 ||
bhūteśo mahito (k, kh: īśānīsahitaḥ) rāmo virāmo rātrivallabhaḥ | maṅgalo dharaṇīputro dhanyo buddhivivardhanaḥ || 59 ||
jayī jīveśvaro jāro jāṭharo jahnutāpanaḥ | jahnukanyādharaḥ kalpo vatsaro māsarūpadhṛt || 60 ||
ṛtur(-)ṛbhūsutādhyakṣo vihārī vihagādhipaḥ | śuklāmbaro nīlakaṇṭhaḥ śuklo bhṛgusuto bhagaḥ || 61 ||
śāntaḥ śivaprado'bhedyo'bhedakṛcchāntakṛt patiḥ | nātho dānto bhikṣurūpī dātṛśreṣṭho viśāṃpatiḥ || 62 ||
kumāraḥ krodhanaḥ krodhī virodhī vigrahī rasaḥ | nīrasaḥ sarasaḥ siddho vṛṣaṇī vṛṣaghātanaḥ || 63 ||
pañcāsyaḥ ṣaṇmukhaścaiva vimukhaḥ sumukhīpriyaḥ | durmukho durjayo duḥkhī sukhī sukhavilāsadaḥ || 64 ||
pātrī pautrī pavitraśca bhūtātmā pūtanāntakaḥ | akṣaraṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ balavān balaghātanaḥ || 65 ||
bhallī bhaulirbhavābhāvo bhāvābhāvavimocanaḥ | nārāyaṇo muktakeśo digdevo dharmanāyakaḥ || 66 ||
kārāmokṣaprado'jeyo mahāṅgaḥ sāmagāyanaḥ | tatsaṅgamo nāmakārī cārī smaranisūdanaḥ || 67 ||
kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇāmbaraḥ stutyastārāvarṇastrapākulaḥ | trapāvān durgatitrātā durgamo durgaghātanaḥ (600) || 68 ||
mahāpādo vipādaśca vipadāṃ nāśako naraḥ | mahābāhurmahorasko mahānandapradāyakaḥ || 69 ||
mahānetro mahādātā nānāśāstravicakṣaṇaḥ | mahāmūrdhā mahādanto mahākarṇo mahoragaḥ || 70 ||
mahācakṣurmahānāso mahāgrīvo digālayaḥ | digvāsā ditijeśāno muṇḍī muṇḍākṣasūtrabhṛt || 71 ||
śmaśānanilayo'rāgī mahākaṭiranūtanaḥ | purāṇapuruṣo'pāraḥ paramātmā mahākaraḥ || 72 ||
mahālasyo mahākeśo mahoṣṭho mohano virāṭ | mahāmukho mahājaṅgho maṇḍalī kuṇḍalī naṭaḥ || 73 ||
asapatnaḥ patrakaraḥ pātrahastaśca pāṭavaḥ | lālasaḥ sālasaḥ sālaḥ kalpavṛkṣaśca kampitaḥ || 74 ||
kampahā kalpanāhārī mahāketuḥ kaṭhorakaḥ | analaḥ pavanaḥ pāṭhaḥ pīṭhasthaḥ pīṭharūpakaḥ || 75 ||
pāṭhīnaḥ kuliśī pīno merudhāmā mahāguṇī | mahātūṇīrasaṃyukto devadānavadarpahā || 76 ||
atharvaśīrṣaḥ somyāsyaḥ ṛksahasrāmitekṣaṇaḥ |
yajuḥsāmamukho guhyo yajurvedavicakṣaṇaḥ || 77 ||
yājñiko yajñarūpaśca yajñajño dharaṇīpatiḥ | jaṅgamī bhaṅgado bhāṣādakṣo'bhigamadarśanaḥ || 78 ||
agamyaḥ sugamaḥ kharvaḥ kheṭī kheṭānano (k: khaṭvānanaḥ) nayaḥ | amoghārthaḥ sindhupatiḥ saindhavaḥ sānumadhyagaḥ || 79 ||
pratāpī prajayī prātarmadhyāhnasāyamadhvaraḥ | trikālajñaḥ sugaṇakaḥ puṣkarasthaḥ paropakṛt || 80 ||
upakartāpahartā ca ghṛṇī raṇajayapradaḥ (700) | dharmī carmāmbaraścārurūpaścāruvibhūṣaṇaḥ (ṅ: viśoṣaṇaḥ) || 81 ||
naktañcaraḥ kālavaśī vaśī viśivaro'vaśaḥ | vaśyo vaśyakaro bhasmaśāyī bhasmavilepanaḥ || 82 ||
bhasmāṅgī malināṅgaśca mālāmaṇḍitamūrdhajaḥ | gaṇakāryaḥ kulācāraḥ sarvācāraḥ sakhā samaḥ || 83 ||
sākāro (ṅ: mukuraḥ) gotrabhid goptā bhīmarūpo bhayānakaḥ | aruṇaścaikacintyaśca triśaṅkuḥ śaṅkudhāraṇaḥ || 84 ||
āśramī brāhmaṇo vajrī kṣatriyaḥ kāryahetukaḥ | vaiśyaḥ śūdraḥ kapotasthaḥ tvaṣṭā tuṣṭo ruṣākulaḥ || 85 ||
rogī rogāpahaḥ śūraḥ kapilaḥ kapināyakaḥ | pinākī cāṣṭamūrtiśca kṣitimān dhṛtimāṃstathā || 86 ||
jalamūrtirvāyumūrtirhutāśaḥ somamūrtimān | sūryadevo yajamāna ākāśaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 87 ||
bhavahā bhavamūrtiśca bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ | bhavaḥ śarvastathā rudraḥ paśunāthaśca śaṅkaraḥ || 88 ||
girijo girijānātho girīndraśca maheśvaraḥ | girīśaḥ khaṇḍahastaśca mahānugro gaṇeśvaraḥ || 89 ||
bhīmaḥ kapardī bhītijñaḥ khaṇḍapaścaṇḍavikramaḥ | khaṇḍabhṛt (k: khaḍgabhṛt) khaṇḍaparaśuḥ kṛttivāsā viṣāpahaḥ || 90 ||
kaṅkālaḥ kalanākāraḥ śrīkaṇṭho nīlalohitaḥ | gaṇeśvaro guṇī nandī dharmarājo durantakaḥ || 91 ||
bhṛṅgirīṭī rasāsāro dayālū rūpamaṇḍitaḥ | amṛtaḥ kālarudraśca kālāgniḥ śaśiśekharaḥ (800) || 92 ||
(sadyojātaḥ surṇamuñjamekhalī durnimittahṛt | duḥsvapnahṛt prasahano guṇinādapratiṣṭhitaḥ || 93 ||
śuklastriśuklaḥ saṃpannaḥ śucirbhūtaniṣevitaḥ | yajñarūpo yajñamukho yajamāneṣṭadaḥ śuciḥ || 94 ||
dhṛtimān matimān dakṣo dakṣayajñavighātakaḥ | nāgahārī bhasmadhārī bhūtibhūṣitavigrahaḥ || 95 ||
kapālī kuṇḍalī bhargaḥ bhaktārtibhañjano vibhuḥ | vṛṣadhvajo vṛṣārūḍho dharmavṛṣavivardhakaḥ || 96 ||
mahābalaḥ sarvatīrthaḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ | sahasrabāhuḥ sarvāṅgaḥ śaraṇyaḥ sarvalokakṛt || 97 ||
pavitrastrikakunmantraḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ | brahmadaṇḍavinirmātā śataghnīpāśaśaktimān || 98 ||
padmagarbho mahāgarbho brahmagarbho jalodbhavaḥ | devāsuravinirmātā devāsuraparāyaṇaḥ || 99 ||
devāsuragururdevo devāsuranamaskṛtaḥ |
guhapriyo gaṇasevyaḥ pavitraḥ sarvapāvanaḥ || 100 ||
lalāṭākṣo viśvadevo damanaḥ śvetapiṅgalaḥ | vimuktirmuktitejasko bhaktānāṃ paramā gatiḥ || 101 ||
devātidevo devarṣirdevāsuravarapradaḥ | kailāsagirivāsī ca himavadgirisaṃśrayaḥ || 102 ||
nāthapūjyaḥ siddhanutyo navanāthasamarcitaḥ | kapardī kalpakṛd rudraḥ sumanā dharmavatsalaḥ || 103 ||
vṛṣākapiḥ kalpakartā niyatātmā nirākulaḥ | nīlakaṇṭho dhanādhyakṣo nāthaḥ pramathanāyakaḥ || 104 ||
anādirantarahito bhūtido bhūtivigrahaḥ | senākalpo mahākalpo yogo yugakaro hariḥ || 105 ||
yugarūpo mahārūpo mahāgīto mahāguṇaḥ | visargo liṅgarūpaśca pavitraḥ pāpanāśanaḥ (900) || 106 ||
īḍyo maheśvaraḥ śambhurdevasiṃho nararṣabhaḥ | vibudho'gravaraḥ sūkṣmaḥ sarvadevastapomayaḥ || 107 ||
suyuktaḥ śobhano vajrī devānāṃ prabhavo'vyayaḥ | guhaḥ kānto nijasargaḥ pavitraḥ sarvapāvanaḥ || 108 ||
śṛṅgī śṛṅgapriyo babhrū rājarājo nirāmayaḥ | devāsuragaṇādhyakṣo niyamendriyavardhanaḥ || 109 ||)
tripurāntakaḥ śrīkaṇṭhastrinetraḥ pañcavaktrakaḥ | kālahṛt kevalātmā ca ṛgyajuḥsāmavedavān || 110 ||
īśānaḥ sarvabhūtānāmīśvaraḥ sarvarakṣasām | brahmādhipatirbrahmapatirbrahmaṇo'dhipatistathā || 111 ||
brahmā śivaḥ sadānandī sadānantaḥ sadāśivaḥ | me(-)asturūpaścārvaṅgo gāyatrīrūpadhāraṇaḥ || 112 ||
aghorebhyo'thaghorebhyo ghoraghoratarebhyaśca | sarvataḥ śarvasarvebhyo namaste rudrarūpebhyaḥ || 113 ||
vāmadevastathā jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kālaḥ karālakaḥ | mahākālo bhairaveśo veśī kalavikaraṇaḥ || 114 ||
balavikaraṇo bālo balapramathanastathā | sarvabhūtādidamano devadevo manonmanaḥ || 115 ||
sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi sadyojātāya vai namaḥ | bhave bhave nātibhave bhajasva māṃ bhavodbhavaḥ || 116 ||
bhāvano bhavano bhāvyo balakārī paraṃ padam | paraḥ śivaḥ paro dhyeyaḥ paraṃ jñānaṃ parātparaḥ || 117 ||
pārāvāraḥ palāśī ca māṃsāśī vaiṣṇavottamaḥ | oṃaiṃhrīṃśrīṃhsauḥ devo oṃśrīṃhauṃ bhairavottamaḥ || 118 ||
oṃhrāṃ namaḥ śivāyeti mantro vaṭurvarāyudhaḥ | oṃhrīṃ sadāśivaḥ oṃhrīṃ āpaduddhāraṇo manuḥ || 119 ||
oṃhrīṃ mahākarālāsyaḥ oṃhrīṃ vaṭukabhairavaḥ | bhagavāṃstryambaka oṃhrīṃ oṃhrīṃ candrārdhaśekharaḥ || 120 ||
oṃhrīṃ sañjaṭilo dhūbhro oṃhrīṃ tripuraghātanaḥ | hrāṃhrīṃhruṃ harivāmāṅga oṃhrīṃhūṃhrīṃ trilocanaḥ || 121 ||
oṃ vedarūpo vedajña ṛgyajuḥsāmamūrtimān | rudro ghoraravo'ghoro oṃ kṣmyūṃ aghorabhairavaḥ || 122 ||
oṃjuṃsaḥ pīyūṣasakto'mṛtādhyakṣo'mṛtālasaḥ | oṃ tryambakaṃ jayāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam || 123 ||
urvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt | oṃhauṃjuṃsaḥ oṃbhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ oṃjuṃsaḥ mṛtyuñjayaḥ (1000) || 124 ||
idaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ tu rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam | sarvasvaṃ nākināṃ devi jantūnāṃ bhuvi kā kathā || 125 ||
tava bhaktyā mayākhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham | gopyaṃ sahasranāmedaṃ sākṣādamṛtarūpakam || 126 ||
yaḥ paṭhet pāṭhayedvāpi śrāvayecchṛṇuyāt tathā | mṛtyuñjayasya devasya phalaṃ tasya śive śṛṇu || 127 ||
lakṣmyā kṛṣṇo dhiyā jīvo pratāpena divākaraḥ | tejasā vahnidevastu kavitve caiva bhārgavaḥ || 128 ||
śauryeṇa harisaṅkāśo nītyā druhiṇasannibhaḥ | īśvaratvena deveśi matsamaḥ kimataḥ param || 129 ||
yaḥ paṭhedardharātre ca sādhako dhairyasaṃyutaḥ | paṭhet sahasranāmedaṃ siddhimāpnoti sādhakaḥ || 130 ||
catuṣpathe caikaliṅge marudeśe vane'jane | śmaśāne prāntare durge pāṭhāt siddhirna saṃśayaḥ || 131 ||
naukāyāṃ caurasaṅghe ca saṅkaṭe prāṇasaṃkṣaye | yatra yatra bhaye prāpte viṣavahnibhayādiṣu || 132 ||
paṭhet sahasranāmāśu mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | bhaumāvasyāṃ niśīthe ca gatvā pretālayaṃ sudhīḥ || 133 ||
paṭhitvā sa bhaved devi sākṣādindro'rcitaḥ suraiḥ | śanau darśadine devi niśāyāṃ saritastaṭe || 134 ||
paṭhennāmasahasraṃ vai japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | sudarśano bhavedāśu mṛtyuñjayaprasādataḥ || 135 ||
digambaro muktakeśaḥ sādhako daśadhā paṭhet | iha loke bhavedrājā pare muktirbhaviṣyati || 136 ||
idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ bhaktyā tava mayoditam |
mantragrabhaṃ manumayaṃ na cākhyeyaṃ durātmane || 137 ||
no dadyāt paraśiṣyebhyaḥ putrebhyo'pi viśeṣataḥ | rahasyaṃ mama sarvasvaṃ gopyaṃ guptataraṃ kalau || 138 ||
ṣaṇmukhasyāpi no vācyaṃ gopanīyaṃ tathātmanaḥ | durjanād rakṣaṇīyaṃ ca paṭhanīyamaharniśam || 139 ||
śrotavyaṃ sādhakamukhādrakṣaṇīyaṃ svaputravat |
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye mṛtyuñjayasahasranāmanirūpaṇaṃ catuścatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 44 || atha
[pañcacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
devi vakṣyāmi te stotraṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam | mūlamantraikasarvasvaṃ rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 1 ||
dīkṣākāle ca pūjāyāṃ japānte ca paṭhecchive | visarjane tathāhvāne sa dīkṣāphalamāpnuyāt || 2 ||
asya vai stotrarājasya ṛṣirbhairava īśvari | gāyatryaṃ chanda ityuktaṃ mahāmṛtyuñjayaḥ śive || 3 ||
devatā praṇavo bījaṃ śaktiḥ śaktiḥ smṛtā śive | hṛjjaṃ kīlakamityuktaṃ sūryo digbandhanaṃ tathā | bhogāpavargasiddhyarthe viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 4 ||
candrārkāgnivilocanaṃ smitamukhaṃ padmadvayāntaḥsthitaṃ mudrāpāśasudhākṣasūtravilasatpāṇiṃ himāṃśuprabham | koṭīrendugalatsudhāplutatanuṃ hārādibhūṣojjvalaṃ kāntyā viśvavimohanaṃ paśupatiṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ bhāvaye || 5 ||
pīyūṣāṃśusudhāmaṇiḥ karatale pīyūṣakumbhaṃ vahan pīyūṣadyutisaṃpuṭāntaragataḥ pīyūṣadhārādharaḥ | māṃ pīyūṣamayūkhasundaravapuḥ pīyūṣalakṣmīsakhaḥ pīyūṣadravavarṣaṇo'pyaharahaḥ prīṇātu mṛtyuñjayaḥ || 6 ||
devaṃ dineśāgniśaśāṅkanetraṃ pīyūṣapātraṃ kalaśaṃ dadhānam | daurbhyāṃ sudhāṃśudyutiminducūḍaṃ namāmi mṛtyuñjayamādidevam || 7 ||
candramaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ rudraṃ bālenduśekharam (kh: tivistṛte) | (bhadrāsanaṃ (k, kh, g: bandhacihnasthaṃ pustakeṣu nāsti) smaredrātrau mṛtyuṃ prāpto'pi jīvati || 8 ||
candramaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ rudraṃ bhāle'tivistṛte |) tatrasthaṃ cintayet sādhyaṃ mṛtyuṃ prāpto'pi jīvati || 9 ||
mātrādyaṃ mātṛkāmaulivedakalpataroḥ phalam | yo japet sa bhavedviśvavaibhavāspadamīśvari || 10 ||
hṛjjabījaṃ kulācāravicārakuśalaḥ śivaḥ | yo japet tasya vaktrābje narīnartti hi bhāratī || 11 ||
(savisargaṃ śaktibījaṃ yo japet sādhakaḥ śiva | sa bhavedacirādeva viśvaiśvaryasya bhājanam || 12 || )
deveśākāśabījaṃ te bindubimbendumaṇḍitam | cintayan yo bhaveccitte sa śivādvayatāṃ labhet || 13 ||
savisargaṃ bhṛguṃ bharga sargapralayakāraṇam | nisargato bhajedyo'ntarlīyate sa pare pade || 14 ||
lakṣmīśabdākṣaraṃ bindubhūṣaṇaṃ yo japet tava | kare lakṣmīrmukhe vāṇī tasya śambho raṇe jayaḥ || 15 ||
pālayeti yugaṃ deva yo japedvīrasannidhau | sa sārvabhaumasāmrājyaṃ bhajedante salokatām || 16 ||
śaradaṃ varadāṃ vīrasādhanīṃ savisargakām | japedyaḥ śaradambhodadhavalaṃ tadyaśo bhramet || 17 ||
ākāśabījaṃ sākāśaṃ japedyaḥ kuśasaṃstare | sa kaulikaśiroratna rañjitāṅghriyugo bhavet || 18 ||
śaṅkābījaṃ sarephaṃ te śambho padmāsane japet | kaṅkālamālābharaṇo bhavitā bhairavopamaḥ || 19 ||
hṛjjabījaṃ jagadbījaṃ tejorūpaṃ ca yo japet | tasmai dāsyasi bhoḥ śambho nijaṃ dhāma sanātanam || 20 ||
oṃkāraṃ (k, kh, g: akāraṃ) sākāraṃ giriśa tava mantrāñcalagataṃ japed yo hṛtpadme nirupamaparānandamuditaḥ | sa sāmrājyaṃ bhūmau bhajati rajanīnāyakakalālasanmauliḥ prānte vrajati śivasāyujyapadavīm || 21 ||
bindubhūṣaṇarakoṇarasāra sāraṇasphuradajāraṇavṛtte |
bhūgṛhāḍhya iti cakramaṇḍale tvāṃ niṣaṇamuṣasi smarāmyaham || 22 ||
nānāvidhānārghyavibhūṣaṇāḍhyaṃ niḥśeṣapīyūṣamayūkhabimbe | niṣaṇamīśānamaśeṣaśeṣavāṇītanuṃ mṛtyuharaṃ namāmi || 23 ||
iti stotraṃ divyaṃ sakalamanurājaikanikaṣaṃ paṭhedyaḥ pūjānte śiva śivagṛhe vārcanavidhau | raṇe jitvā varīn bhajati nṛpalakṣmīṃ svamahasā bhavedante vīraḥ sakalasurasevyaḥ śivasamaḥ || 24 ||
itīdaṃ paramaṃ stotraṃ mahāmṛtyuñjayapriyam | paṭhedvā pāṭhayennityaṃ sarvasvaṃ devadurlabham || 25 ||
adeyaṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam | mahāmantramayaṃ divyaṃ sādhanairdhanasādhanam || 26 ||
trailokyasārabhūtaṃ ca trailokyābhayadāyakam | paṭhenniśīthe mantrī tu sadyaḥ siddhirbhavet kalau || 27 ||
catuṣpathe'rdharātre tu brāhmye vāpi muhūrtake | paṭhitvā kauliko devi bhaved bhairavasannibhaḥ || 28 ||
itīdaṃ mama sarvasvaṃ rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam | yasya kasya na vaktavyamityājñā pārameśvarī || 29 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye mṛtyuñjayastotranirūpaṇaṃ pañcacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 45 ||
[samāptaṃ mṛtyuñjayapañcāṅgam] ||
atha
[ṣaṭcatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
atha śrīdurgāpañcāṅgam |
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan sarvatattvajña sādhakānāṃ jayāvaha | yat purā sūcitaṃ deva durgāpañcāṅgamuttamam || 1 ||
sarvasvaṃ sarvadevānāṃ rahasyaṃ sarvamantriṇām | tadadya kṛpayā brūhi yadyasti mayi te dayā || 2 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
etad guhyatamaṃ devi pañcāṅgaṃ tattvalakṣaṇam | durgāyāḥ sārasarvasvaṃ na kasya kathitaṃ mayā || 3 ||
tava snehāt pravakṣyāmi durgāpañcāṅgamīśvari | guhyaṃ gopyatamaṃ divyaṃ na deyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ || 4 ||
yā devī daityadamanī durgetyaṣṭākṣarā śivā | devairārādhitā pūrvaṃ brahmācyutapuraḥsaraiḥ || 5 ||
purandarahitārthāya vadhārthāya suradviṣām | saivaṃ sṛjati bhūtāni rājasī parameśvarī || 6 ||
sāttvikī rakṣati prānte saṃhariṣyati tāmasī | itthaṃ guṇatrayīrūpā sṛṣṭisthitilayātmikā || 7 ||
aṣṭākṣarī mahāvidyā saṃkhyātītā parātmikā |
tasyāḥ pañcāṅgamadhunā rahasyaṃ tridivaukasām || 8 ||
vakṣyāmi paramaprītyā na cākhyeyaṃ durātmane | paṭalaṃ tava vakṣyāmi durgāyāstattvamuttamam || 9 ||
yena śravaṇamātreṇa koṭipūjāphalaṃ labhet | durgāyā devi vakṣyāmi mantroddhāraṃ parāśrayam | sarvatantreṣvavikhyātaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 10 ||
tāraṃ māyā cākrikaṃ cakridūrvā vāyavyārṇaṃ viśvamante bhavāni | durgāyāste varṇito mūlavidyāmantroddhāro gopito'ṣṭākṣaro'yam || 11 ||
nāsyāntarāyabāhulyaṃ nāpyamitrādidūṣaṇam (ṅ: nārimitrāridūṣaṇam) | no vā prayāsasaṃyogo nācārayugaviplavaḥ || 12 ||
sākṣāt siddhiprado mantro durgāyāḥ kalināśanaḥ | aṣṭākṣaro'ṣṭasiddhīśo gopanīyo digambaraiḥ || 13 ||
mahācīnakramasthānāṃ sādhakānāṃ jayāvahaḥ | mantrarājo mahādevi sadyo bhogāpavargadaḥ || 14 ||
varṇalakṣaṃ puraścaryā tadardhaṃ vā maheśvari | ekalakṣāvadhiṃ kuryānnāto nyūnaṃ kadācana || 15 ||
mūlotkīlanasiddhaṃ tu sañjīvanasusaṃskṛtam | puraścaryāṃ caret paścāt saṃpuṭāḍhyaṃ carenmanum || 16 ||
tato mantraṃ japennityaṃ durgāyāstvaṣṭasiddhidam | yaṃ japtvā sādhako bhūmau vicaredbhairavo yathā || 17 ||
ṛṣirasya smṛto devi mantrasyādyo maheśvaraḥ | chando'nuṣṭub devatā ca śrīdurgāṣṭākṣarā smṛtā || 18 ||
cākrikaṃ bījamiśāni māyā śaktiriti smṛtā | tāraṃ kīlakamāśānāṃ viśvaṃ bandhanamīśvari || 19 ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | tāramāyākṣarairdevi nyāsaṃ ṣaḍdīrghabhāgibhiḥ || 20 ||
nihatya ṣaḍripūn devi dhyāyed durgāṃ kuleśvarīm |
dūrvānibhāṃ trinayanāṃ vilasatkirīṭāṃ śaṅkhābjakhaḍgaśarakheṭakaśūlacāpān | saṃtarjanīṃ ca dadhatīṃ mahiṣāsanasthāṃ durgāṃ navārakulapīṭhagatāṃ bhaje'ham || 21 ||
yantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi durgāyāḥ kulamandiram | sarvasiddhipradaṃ cakraṃ sarvāśāparipūrakam || 22 ||
bindutrikoṇaṃ rasakoṇabimbaṃ vṛttāṣṭapatrāñcitavahnivṛttam | dharāgṛhodbhāsitaminducūḍe durgāśrayaṃ (ṅ: śramaṃ) yantramidaṃ pradiṣṭam || 23 ||
layāṅgamasya yantrasya (g: vakṣyāmi) sarvatantreṣu gopitam | yenoccāraṇamātreṇa koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet || 24 ||
gaṇeśaṃ ca kumāraṃ ca puṣpadantaṃ vikarttanam | caturdvāreṣu deveśi pūjayet sādhakeśvaraḥ || 25 ||
brāhmī nārāyaṇī devi cāmuṇḍāpyaparājitā | māheśvarī ca kaumārī vārāhī nārasiṃhikā || 26 ||
pūjyā vasudale devi bhairavāṃścāṣṭa pārvati | asitāṅgo ruruścaṇḍaḥ krodhonmattakapālikāḥ || 27 ||
bhīṣaṇaścaiva saṃhāro vāmāvartena sādhakaiḥ |
pūjyāḥ pṛthak pṛthag devi gandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ śive || 28 ||
dattvā puṣpāñjaliṃ cakre mūlamuccārya sadhakaḥ | pūjayet padmakiñjalkaiḥ ṣaḍaśre ṣaṭ kulāmbikāḥ || 29 ||
śailaputrīṃ svavāmāgrāt pūjayed brahmacāriṇīm | caṇḍaghaṇṭāṃ ca kūṣmāṇḍāṃ skandamātaramīśvari || 30 ||
kātyāyanīṃ ca saṃpūjya dūrvāgandhākṣataiḥ param | punaḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā śrīcakre paramārthade || 31 ||
pūjayed devatāstisraḥ kulasthāstripurāmbikāḥ | kālarātrī mahāgaurī devadūtīti pārvati || 32 ||
trikoṇāgrācchive pūjyāḥ sindūrākṣatapuṣpakaiḥ | dūrvādalāñjaliṃ dattvā yantrarāje'ṣṭasiddhide (ṅ: siddhaye) || 33 ||
pūjayedambikāṃ durgāmaṣṭākṣaravibhūṣaṇām | bindau devīmaṣṭabhujāṃ vidyāmaṣṭākṣarīṃ (k, kh: durgāṃ) śive || 34 ||
nīlakaṇṭhaṃ śivaṃ bindau pūjayejjagadambikām | tatrāyudhāni deveśi pūjayedaṣṭa sādhakaḥ || 35 ||
śaṅkhaṃ padmamasiṃ bāṇān dhanuḥ kheṭakamīśvari | śūlaṃ saṃtarjanīṃ divyāṃ nānāpuṣpaiḥ samarcayet || 36 ||
devadevyau bindupīṭhe pūjayet sarvasiddhaye | atha vakṣye mahādevi prayogānaṣṭa siddhaye || 37 ||
yān vidhāya kalau mantrī bhavet kalpadrumopamaḥ | stambhanaṃ mohanaṃ caiva māraṇākarṣaṇe tataḥ || 38 ||
vaśīkāraṃ tathoccāṭaṃ śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ tathā | eṣāṃ sādhanamācakṣe prayogāṇāṃ maheśvari || 39 ||
mahācīnakramasthānāṃ sādhakānāṃ hitāya ca |
ayutaṃ prajapenmūlaṃ śmaśāne niśi sādhakaḥ || 40 ||
huned daśāṃśataḥ sarpiryavānmāsāsṛgacyutān | stambhanaṃ jāyate kṣipraṃ vādikāmijanāmbhasām || 41 ||
ayutaṃ prajaped devi vaṭe rudrākṣamālayā | homo daśāṃśataḥ kāryo ghṛtapadmākṣapaṅkajaiḥ || 42 ||
āragvadhaiḥ sudhāmūlairmohanaṃ jāyate kṣaṇāt | devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca kā kathālpadhiyāṃ nṛṇām || 43 ||
ayutaṃ prajapenmūlaṃ vane sādhakasattamaḥ | vetasīmūlago vāpi hunet tatra daśāṃśataḥ || 44 ||
ghṛtapāyasaśambūkān ripurmṛtyumukhaṃ vrajet | ayutaṃ prajapedrātrau śūnyāgāre kuleśvari || 45 ||
homo daśāṃśataḥ kāryo ghṛtavyoṣaśaṭīśaraiḥ | kapibījairapi (k, kh: kāpibījaiḥ) prātarbhavedākarṣaṇaṃ striyām || 46 ||
ayutaṃ prajapenmūlaṃ catvare tvaritaṃ hunet | ājyābjakṣurapāṣāṇḍa raktapuṣpāṇi pārvati || 47 ||
śakro'pi vaśatāmeti kiṃ punaḥ kṣudrabhūmipaḥ | ayutaṃ prajapenmūlaṃ sādhako'śvatthamūlagaḥ || 48 ||
hunedājyaṃ daśāṃśena keśaṃ strīṇāṃ tvacaṃ kaṇāḥ | ripumuccāṭayet śīghraṃ yadi śakrasamo bhavet || 49 ||
ayutaṃ prajapenmūlaṃ suradrumatale hunet | ghṛtākṣakukkuṭāṅgāni (k: ghṛtāṇḍa) nānāpuṣpāṇi sādhakaḥ (gh: pracchakaḥ) || 50 ||
rogopadravakālasya sadyaḥ śāntirbhaviṣyati | ayutaṃ prajapenmūlaṃ līlopavanamaṇḍale || 51 ||
homo daśāṃśataḥ kāryo ghṛtamīnājamastakaiḥ |
pādairaṣṭabhirīśāni sadyaḥ puṣṭiḥ prajāyate || 52 ||
ityeṣa paṭalo divyo mantrasarvasvarūpavān | durgārahasyabhūto'pi gopanīyo mumukṣubhiḥ || 53 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye durgāpaṭalanirūpaṇaṃ ṣaṭcatvāriṃṣaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 46 || atha
[saptacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
śṛṇu pārvati vakṣyāmi paddhatiṃ gadyarūpiṇīm | yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet || 1 ||
brāhmye muhūrte cotthāya baddhapadmāsanaḥ svaśiraḥsthasahasrārādhomukhakamalakarṇikāntargataṃ nijaguruṃ śvetavarṇaṃ śvetālaṅkārālaṅkṛtaṃ dvibhujaṃ svaśaktyā śvetāmbarabhūṣitayā vāmāṅge sahitaṃ dhyātvā mānasairupacāraiḥ saṃpūjya daṇḍavat praṇamet |
akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaram | tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ ||
ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā | cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ ||
gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurguruḥ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ | gurureva jagat sarvaṃ tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ ||
