iti natvā tadājñāṃ gṛhītvā bahirāgatya malamūtrādi saṃtyajya varṇoktaṃ śaucaṃ vidhāya nadyādau gatvā sukūrcaṃ dvādaśāṅgulaṃ dantadhāvanaṃ kuryāt | oṃklīṃ kāmadevāya sarvajanapriyāya namaḥ iti dantān viśodhya cākrikabījena gaḍūṣaṣaṭkaṃ vidhāya praṇavena mukhaṃ triḥ prokṣya oṃhrīṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi śikhāparisare rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ phaṭ svāhā iti śikhāṃ baddhvā tattvatrayeṇācamya mūlena prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya malāpakarṣaṇaṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā mantrasnānaṃ caret | tato mūlena mṛdamānīya jalaṃ prokṣayet | mantramṛdā sūryamaṇḍalaṃ vicintya gaṅge ca yamune ceti tīrthānyāvāhya jale yantraṃ vibhāvya sanīlakaṇṭhāṃ durgāmāvāhayet | tatra ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vidhāya devīṃ saśivāṃ dhyātvā mūlaṃ yathāśaktyā japtvā trirnimajjyonmajjet | tatra kumbhamudrāṃ baddhvā svamūrdhni devadevyau jalena snapayitvā oṃhrāṃhrīṃsaḥ mārtaṇḍabhairavāya prakāśāśaktisahitāya eṣa te'rgho namaḥ | iti sūryāyārghyatrayaṃ dattvā vāso'nyat paridhāpya tattvatrayeṇācamya triḥ prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya pūrvasaṃdhyāṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍaṅgaṃ kṛtvā culakena jalamādāya tattvamudrayācchādya yaṃraṃlaṃvaṃhaṃ iti trirabhimantrya mūlamuccaraṃstadgalitodakabindubhiḥ saptadhā svaśirasyabhyukṣya savyahaste śeṣamudakaṃ dhṛtvā iḍayāntarnītvā dehāntaḥ pāpaṃ prakṣālya piṅgalayā virecya puraḥkalpitavajraśilāyāṃ vāmataḥ phaḍiti nikṣipet | ityaghamarṣaṇaṃ vidhāya pūrvavadācamya jale yantraṃ dhyātvā mūlaṃ yathāśaktyā japtvā mūlavidyānte sāṅge savāhane sāyudhe saparicchade śrīnīlakaṇṭhasahite mātardurge tṛpyatāmityaṣṭavāraṃ saṃtarpya nīlakaṇṭhaṃ triḥ saṃtarpya ekaikāñjalinā parivāradevatāḥ saṃtarpya devadevyau hṛdi dhyātvā jale caturaśraṃ vilikhya tatreśānādikrameṇa gurupaṅktiṃ saṃtarpya devīṃ gāyatrīṃ japet | oṃhrīṃduṃ durgāyai vidmahe aṣṭākṣarāyai dhīmahi tannaḥ caṇḍī pracodayāt | iti yathāśaktyā prajapya gāyatryānayā devadevayorarghyatrayaṃ dattvā japaṃ samarpya yāgamaṇḍapamāgacchediti saṃdhyāvidhiḥ ||
tato gṛhamāgatya pādau prakṣālya dvāradevatāḥ pūjayet | oṃgāṃgūṃ gaṇeśāya namaḥ pūrve | oṃkṣāṃhrīṃ vaṭukāya namo dakṣiṇe | oṃkṣāṃkṣeṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ paścime | oṃyāṃyūṃ yoginībhyo namaḥ uttare | gaṃ gaṅgāyai namo dehalyāṃ | yāṃ yamunāyai namaḥ adhaḥ | sauḥ sarasvatyai namo madhye | iti
saṃpūjya gṛhāntaḥ praviśya yathārhamāsanaṃ (k, kh, g: yathopacitam) śodhayet | āṃ āsanaśodhanamantrasya merupṛṣṭha ṛṣiḥ sutalaṃ chandaḥ kūrmo devatā āsanamantraṇe viniyogaḥ | oṃprīṃ pṛthivyai namaḥ | mahi tvayā dhṛtā lokā devi tvaṃ viṣṇunā dhṛtā | tvaṃ ca dhāraya māṃ devi pavitraṃ kuru cāsanam || (oṃdhruvā dyaurdhruvā pṛthivī dhruvāsaḥ parvatā ime | dhruvaṃ viśvamidaṃ jagad dhruvo rājā viśvāmasi ||) oṃāṃ (k, kh: oṃhrīṃoṃ) ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ | maṃ mūlaprakṛtyai namaḥ | aṃ anantāya namaḥ | paṃ padmāya namaḥ | prīṃ padmanālāya namaḥ | tatropaviśya tālatrayaṃ kuryāt | apasarpantu te bhūtā ye bhūtā bhuvi saṃsthitāḥ | ye bhūtā vighnakartāraste naśyantu śivājñayā || iti tālatrayaṃ dattvā vāmapārṣṇighātatrayeṇa vighnānutsārya nārācamudrāṃ pradarśya guruṃ praṇamet | gururbrahmā gururviṣṇuriti ajñānatimirāndhasyeti akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāramiti ca paṭhitvā śrīgurave namaḥ svavāme | guṃ gurubhyo namaḥ | paramagurubhyo namaḥ | parāparagurubhyo namaḥ | parameṣṭhigurubhyo namaḥ | iti gandhākṣatairabhyarcya nyāsapūrvaṃ saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | asya śrīdurgādevī (yogapīṭhapūjā) mantrasya maheśvara ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrīdurgā devatā duṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ oṃ kīlakaṃ namaḥ iti digbandhaḥ dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe durgāpūjāyāṃ viniyogaḥ | atha nyāsaḥ | maheśvaraṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi | anuṣṭupchandase namo mukhe | śrīdurgādevatāyai namo hṛdi | duṃ bījāya namo nābhau | hrīṃ śaktaye namo guhye | oṃ kīlakāya namaḥ pādayoḥ | namo digbandhaḥ iti sarvāṅgeṣu | oṃhrāṃ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃhrīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃhrūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃhraiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃhrauṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃhraḥ karatalapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | iti karanyāsaḥ || evaṃ hṛdādiṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ ||
atha mūlanyāsaḥ | oṃnamaḥ śirasi | hrīṃ mukhe | duṃ vakṣasi | duṃ bhujayoḥ | rgāṃ nābhau | yaiṃ pṛṣṭhe | naṃ jānvoḥ | maḥ pādayoḥ | iti trirvyāpayet | oṃ ātmatattvāya namaḥ śirasi | hrīṃ vidyātattvāya namo mukhe | duṃ śivatattvāya namo hṛdaye | oṃ gurutattvāya namo nābhau | oṃhrīṃ śaktitattvāya namo jaṅghayoḥ | oṃduṃ śivaśaktitattvāya namaḥ pādayoḥ |
oṃ aṃāṃkaṃkhaṃgaṃghaṃṅaṃiṃīṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | hrīṃ uṃūṃcaṃchaṃjaṃjhaṃñaṃṛṃṝṃ śirase svāhā | duṃ ḷṃṭaṃṭhaṃḍaṃḍhaṃṇaṃḹṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | oṃ eṃtaṃthaṃdaṃdhaṃnaṃaiṃ kavacāya huṃ | hrīṃ oṃpaṃphaṃbaṃbhaṃmaṃauṃ netrebhyo vauṣaṭ | duṃ aṃyaṃraṃlaṃvaṃśaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃlaṃkṣaḥaḥ astrāya phaṭ iti hṛdayādinyāsaḥ | evaṃ karanyāsaḥ | iti śuddhamātṛkānyāsaḥ ||
atha mūlamātṛkānyāsaḥ | aṃ namaḥ śirasi | āṃ namo mukhavṛtte | iṃ dakṣanetre | īṃ vāmanetre | uṃ dakṣakarṇe | ūṃ vāmakarṇe | ṛṃ dakṣagaṇḍe | ṝṃ vāmagaṇḍe | ḷṃ dakṣanāsāpuṭe | ḹṃ vāmanāsāpuṭe | eṃ ūrdhvoṣṭhe | aiṃ adharoṣṭhe | oṃ ūrdhvadantapaṃktau | auṃ adhodantapaṃktau | aṃ (k, kh, g: aṃ śirasi aḥ mukhe) lalāṭe | aḥ jihvāyām | kaṃ namo dakṣabāhumūle | khaṃ kurpare | gaṃ maṇibandhe | ghaṃ aṅgulimūle | ṅaṃ aṅgulyagre | caṃ vāmabāhumūle | chaṃ kurpare | jaṃ maṇibandhe | jhaṃ aṅgulimūle | ñaṃ aṅgulyagre | ṭaṃ namo dakṣapādamūle | ṭhaṃ jānuni | ḍaṃ gulphe | ḍhaṃ aṅgulimūle | ṇaṃ aṅgulyagre | taṃ vāmapādamūle | thaṃ jānuni | daṃ gulphe | dhaṃ aṅgulimūle | naṃ aṅgulyagre | paṃ dakṣapārśve | phaṃ vāmapārśve | baṃ pṛṣṭhe | bhaṃ nābhau | maṃ jaṭhare | yaṃ hṛdi | raṃ dakṣāṃse | laṃ kakudi | vaṃ vāmāṃse | śaṃ hṛdādidakṣahastāgrāntaṃ | ṣaṃ hṛdādivāmahastāgrāntaṃ | saṃ hṛdādidakṣapādāgrāntaṃ | haṃ hṛdādivāmapādāgrāntaṃ | laṃ pādādiśiraḥparyantam | kṣaḥ namaḥ śirasaḥ pādaparyantamiti trirvyāpayet | evaṃ nyāsaṃ vidhāya pūrvavat ṣaḍaṅgaṃ kṛtvā praṇavena prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ vidhāya (pūrakaṃ 12 kumbhakaṃ 16 recakaṃ 32) oṃhrīṃ ātmatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā | oṃhrīṃ vidyātattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā oṃhrīṃ śivatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā iti trirācamya prāṇāyāmayogena bhūtaśuddhiṃ kuryāt ||
oṃhūṃ ākuñcena (k, kh, g: aṃkuśena) suṣumnāvartmanā pradīpakalikākāraṃ tejo brahmapathāntarnītvā paramaśive samānīya tatra sudhāvṛṣṭyāṃ kulagurūn dhyātvā tayaiva saṃtarpya punastenaiva mārgeṇa ṣaṭcakrakulaṃ bhittvā tattejaḥ svasthānamānīya yamiti vāyubījena ṣoḍaśadhā japtena vāmakukṣigataṃ pāpapuruṣaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ raktaśmaśrulamaṅguṣṭhamātrākāraṃ dhyātvā śoṣayet | ramiti vahnibījena ṣoḍaśadhā japtena taṃ dāhayet | vamityamṛtabījena ṣoḍaśadhā
japtena galaccandrāmṛtavṛṣṭyāplāvayet |lamitīndrabījena ṣoḍaśavārajaptena (piṇḍībhūtaṃ svātmakaṃ dhyātvā hamityākāśabījena sakṛjjaptena) svātmānaṃ divyadehaṃ vibhāvayediti bhūtaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kuryāt | oṃhrīṃduṃāṃkroṃ sohaṃ haṃsaḥ mama prāṇā iha prāṇāḥ evaṃ (9/) mama jīva iha sthitaḥ (9/) mama sarvendriyāṇi iha sthitāni (9/) mama vāṅmanaścakṣustvakśrotrajihvāghrāṇaprāṇā ihaivāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu svāhā iti prāṇapratiṣṭhākramaḥ | evaṃ prāṇān saṃsthāpya pūrvavat ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vidhāyācamya mūladevīṃ dhyāyet |
bhūgehanāgadalavṛttarasārarārabindusthasanmahiṣapīṭhagatāṃ bhavānīm | dūrvādalāgrasadṛśacchavibhaṣṭabāhuṃ durgāṃ bhaje trinayanāṃ vilasattribījām ||
iti dhyātvā mūlāṅganyāsau vidhāya śrīcakraṃ caturdvāraṃ trivṛttaṃ sāṣṭadalaṃ vṛttaṃ ṣaḍaśraṃ trikoṇabinduṃ vicintya vā aṣṭagandhena vilikhya vā vibhāvya pīṭhapūjāṃ kuryāt | oṃhrīṃ maṇḍūkāya namaḥ | (2/) kālāgnirudrāya namaḥ | (2/) mūlaprakṛtyai namaḥ | (2/) ādhāraśaktyai namaḥ | (2/) kūrmāya namaḥ | (2/) anantāya(0) | (2/) varāhāya(0) | (2/) pṛthivyai(0) | ityuparyupari saṃpūjya (2/) sudhārṇavāya namaḥ madhye | (2/) navaratnavirājitanavakhaṇḍamayadvīpāya namaḥ | (2/) padmarāgakhaṇḍāya namaḥ | (2/) svarṇagiraye(0) | (2/) nandanodyānāya(0) | (2/) kalpavanāya(0) | (2/) padmavanāya(0) | (2/) vicitraratnakhacitabhūmikāyai(0) | (2/) cintāmaṇimaṇḍapāya(0) | (2/) navaratnakhacitaratnamayavedikāyai(0) | (2/) ratnasiṃhāsanāya(0) | tanmadhye (2/) sahasrārapadmāya(0) | (2/) prakṛtimayapatrebhyo(0) | (2/) vikṛtimayakesarebhyo(0) | tanmadhye (2/) aṣṭabījavibhūṣitakarṇikāyai(0) | tatpārśve (2/) dharmāya(0) | (2/) jñānāya(0) | (2/) vairāgyāya(0) | (2/) aiśvaryāya(0) | vāmataḥ (2/) adharmāya(0) | (2/) ajñānāya(0) | (2/) avairāgyāya(0) | (2/) anaiśvaryāya(0) | madhye (2/) saṃ sattvāya(0) | (2/) raṃ rajase(0) |
(2/) taṃ tamase(0) | mūlavidyāmuccārya mahiṣāsanāya namaḥ | mūlamuccārya mātṛkāḥ proccārya śrīyogapīṭhāya namaḥ ityabhyarcya pātrārcanaṃ kuryāt |
tataḥ svadehaṃ gandhādinā saṃpūjya tatra svavāme vṛttatrikoṇacaturaśramaṇḍalaṃ vidhāya mūlenābhyarcya mūlaṃ durgāsāmānyārghyāya namaḥ | raṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya daśakalātmane namaḥ ityādhāre tanmaṇḍalaṃ ṣaḍaṅgenābhyarcya tatrāstrakṣālitaṃ śaṅkhaṃ saṃsthāpya śaṅkhe aṃ arkamaṇḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ iti saṃpūjya vilomamātṛkayā saṃpūrya sauḥ somamaṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ ityabhyarcya mūlāṣṭābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā gaṅge ca yamune caiva ityādinā tīrthamāvāhya śuddhaṃ bhāvayediti sāmānyārghyavidhiḥ ||
sāmānyārghyasya vāme trikoṇaṣaṭkoṇavṛttacaturaśraṃ maṇḍalaṃ vidhāya tanmaṇḍalaṃ ṣaḍaṅgenābhyarcya mūlamuccārya śrīdurgākalaśamaṇḍalāya namaḥ | tataḥ pūrvavat mūlenābhyarcya tatrāstrakṣālitāṃ tripādikāṃ saṃsthāpya raṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya daśakalātmane namaḥ ityabhyarcya tatrāstrakṣālitaṃ kalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya aṃ arkamaṇḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ ityakṣatapuṣpairabhyarcya tatrānāmikāṅguṣṭhābhyāmamṛtadhārāpātena kalaśamāpūrya sauḥ somamaṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ ityabhyarcya oṃhrīṃdāṃdīṃdūṃdaiṃdauṃdaḥ duṃaṃ amṛte amṛtodbhave amṛtavarṣiṇi amṛtaṃ srāvaya (2) śukraśāpaṃ mocaya (2) oṃhrīṃduṃ surādevyai vauṣaṭ (kh: vaṣaṭ) iti saptadhābhimantrya duṃhrīṃoṃ hasakṣamalavaraya ānandabhairavasurādevīpādukābhyo namaḥ iti saṃpūjya dhenuyonimudre pradarśya oṃ sūryamaṇḍalasaṃbhūte varuṇālayasaṃbhave | amābījamaye devi śukraśāpādvimucyatām || ekameva paraṃ brahma sthūlasūkṣmamayaṃ dhruvam | kacodbhavāṃ brahmahatyāṃ tena te nāśayāmyaham || pavamānaḥ parānandaḥ pavamānaḥ paro rasaḥ | pavamānaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ tena tvāṃ pāvayāmyaham || vedānāṃ praṇavo bījaṃ brahmānandamayaṃ yadi | tena satyena te devi brahmahatyā vyapohatu (kh: vihanyatu) || kṛṣṇaśāpavinirmuktā tvaṃ muktā brahmaśāpataḥ | vimuktā muniśāpena (k: rudraśāpena) pavitrā bhava sarvadā (k: sāṃprataṃ) || iti kalaśaṃ saṃpūjya dhenuyonimatsyamudrāḥ pradarśya garuḍamudrayācchādayediti dravyaśuddhiḥ |
oṃhrīṃduṃ kṛtāvatāro hariṇā kalinā pīḍitaṃ jagat | balinā nigṛhītaṃ tu kaulikānāṃ hitāya ca || śrīdurgāparitoṣārthaṃ svayaṃ mīno'bhavat prabhuḥ | iti mudrātrayaṃ pradarśya śuddhiṃ śodhayet | oṃhrīṃduṃ chāgalādigavāntādikṛtarūpāya vai namaḥ | balyarthaṃ devadevyośca pavitrībhava sāmpratam || mūlaṃ tridhā japtvā mudrātrayaṃ darśayediti | oṃhrīṃduṃ śrīdurgārcanakāle tu yāni yānīha sāṃpratam | vastūni saurabheyāni (k, kh: suradeyāni) pavitrāṇīha siddhaye || iti mūlaṃ tridhā japan mudrātrayaṃ sarvasyopari darśayediti kalaśādividhiḥ ||
tato mūlenānandabhairavāṅkopaviṣṭāṃ nīlakaṇṭheśīṃ śrīdevīṃ dhyātvā mūlenāvāhya śrīcakramarcayet | tatra mūlena pādyārghyācamanīyādi parikalpayet | mūlena devadevyormadhuparkācamanīyādi nivedayet (k, kh: parikalpayet) | mūlena naivedyaṃ nivedya ācamanīyaṃ namaḥ iti nivedya gaṇḍūṣatrayaṃ nivedya mūlena tāmbūlādi samarpayet | tato mūlaṣaḍaṅgaṃ vidhāya caturaśraṃ pūjayet | oṃhrīṃduṃ sarvasiddhipradāya cakrāya namaḥ iti puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā oṃhrīṃduṃgaṃ gaṇeśāya namaḥ pūrve | (3/) hauṃ kumārāya namaḥ dakṣiṇe | (3/) prīṃ puṣpadantāya namaḥ paścime | (3/) vaiṃ vikartanāya namaḥ uttare | iti gandhākṣatapuṣpairabhyarcya prathamāvaraṇam || (3/) asitāṅgabhairavayuta brāhmīśrīpādu(0) | (3/) rurubhairavayutanārāyaṇīśrīpā(0) | (3/) caṇḍabhairavayuta cāmuṇḍāśrīpā(0) | (3/) krodheśabhairavayutāparājitāśrīpā(0) | (3/) unmattabhairavayuta māheśvarīśrīpā(0) | (3/) kapālibhairavayuta kaumārīśrīpā(0) | (3/) bhīṣaṇabhairavayuta vārāhīśrīpā(0) | (3/) saṃhārabhairavayuta nārasiṃhīśrīpādu(0) | iti vāmāvartena gandhākṣatapuṣpairabhyarcayet |iti dvitīyāvaraṇam || oṃhrīṃduṃ sarvāśāpūrakacakrāya namaḥ iti puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā ṣaṭkoṇaṃ pūjayet | oṃhrīṃduṃ śailaputrīśrīpā(0) | (3/) brahmacāriṇīśrī(0) | (3/) caṇḍaghaṇṭāśrī(0) | (3/) kūṣmāṇḍāśrī(0) | (3/) skandamātṛśrī(0) | (3/) kātyāyanīśrī(0) | iti vāmāvartena saṃpūjayet | iti tṛtīyāvaraṇam || oṃhrīṃduṃ saubhāgyapradāya cakrāya namaḥ iti puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā trikoṇaṃ pūjayet | (3/) kālarātrīśrīpā(0) | (3/) mahāgaurīśrī(0) |
(3/) devadūtīśrī(0) | iti agreśānāgneyato'bhyarcayet | iti caturthāvaraṇaṃ || oṃhrīṃduṃ aṣṭasiddhipradāya cakrāya namaḥ iti puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā mūlamuccārya śrīnīlakaṇṭhaśrīdurgāśrīpā(0) iti saptavāraṃ bindau abhyarcayet | iti pañcamāvaraṇam || bindūpari mūlaṃ ambikāśrīpā(0) | (3/) aṣṭākṣarāśrīpā(0) | (3/) aṣṭabhujāśrī(0) | (3/) nīlakaṇṭhaśrīpā(0) | (3/) jagadambikāśrī(0) | ityabhyarcayet | iti ṣaṣṭhāvaraṇam || bindūpari mū(0) śaṅkhāya namaḥ | padmāya(0) | khaḍgāya(0) | bāṇebhyo(0) | dhanuṣe(0) | kheṭakāya(0) | śūlāya(0) | tarjanyai namaḥ | mūlavidyāṃ triruccārya śrīnīlakaṇṭhaśrīdurgāśrīpā(0) pū(0) ta(0) iti mūlena gandhākṣatapuṣpadhūpadīpanaivedyācamanīyatāmbūlacchatracāmarā
tatra mūlena baliṃ nivedya sauḥ sarvavighnakṛdbhyo bhūtebhyo namaḥ svāhā | yāṃyīṃyūṃ yoginīgaṇebhyo namaḥ svāhā | vāṃvīṃ devīputravaṭukanātha kapilajaṭābhārabhāsvara trinetra jvālāmukha ehyehi imaṃ baliṃ yathopacitaṃ gṛhṇa 2 svāhā | kṣāṃkṣīṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ | iti baliṃ dattvā saṅkalpapūrvaṃ nyāsādi (kh: dhyānaṃ) vidhāya devyagre mālāmādāya yathāśakti mūlavidyāṃ japtvā guhyātīti japaṃ samarpya devyagre kavaca sahasranāma stavapāṭhaṃ vidhāya tadapi devadevyoḥ samarpya prātaḥ prabhṛti sāyāntaṃ sāyādi prātarantataḥ | yatkaromi jaganmātastadastu tava pūjanam || iti puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā yonimudrayā praṇamya saṃhāramudrayā devadevyau hṛdi visṛjya svayamapi sadāśivo bhūtvā svaśaktyā saha pātrārpaṇaṃ vidhāya sukhaṃ viharediti ||
iti śrīnityapūjāyāḥ paddhatiṃ guhyagopitām | śrīdurgāsārasaṃbhūtāṃ gopayet sādhakeśvari ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye śrīdurgāpaddhatinirūpaṇaṃ saptacatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 47 ||
atha
[aṣṭācatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devi vakṣyāmi (kh: vakṣyehaṃ) kavacaṃ mantragarbhakam | durgāyāḥ sārasarvasvaṃ kavaceśvarasaṃjñakam || 1 ||
paramārthapradaṃ divyaṃ (k: nityaṃ) mahāpātakanāśanam | yogipriyaṃ yogagamyaṃ (kh: yogigamyaṃ) devānāmapi durlabham || 2 ||
vinānena na mantrasya siddhirdevi kalau bhavet | dhāraṇādasya deveśi śivastrailokyanāyakaḥ || 3 ||
bhairavo bhairaveśāno (kh: śāni) viṣṇurnārāyaṇo balī | brahmā pārvati lokeśo vighnadhvaṃsī gajānanaḥ || 4 ||
senānīśca mahāseno jiṣṇurlokarṣabhaḥ priye | sūryastamopahaścaiva candro'mṛtanidhistathā || 5 ||
bahunoktena kiṃ devi durgākavacadhāraṇāt | martyo'pyamaratāṃ yāti sādhako mantrasādhakaḥ || 6 ||
kavacasyāsya deveśi ṛṣiḥ prokto maheśvaraḥ | chando'nuṣṭup priye durgā devatāṣṭākṣarā smṛtā || 7 ||
cakribījaṃ ca bījaṃ syānmāyā śaktiritīritā | tāraṃ kīlakamīśāni digbandho varṇito'śmarī | dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe viniyoga iti smṛtaḥ || 8 ||
asya śrīdurgākavacasya maheśvara ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrīdurgā
devatā duṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ oṃ kīlakaṃ caturvargasiddhaye pāṭhe viniyogaḥ | nama iti digbandhaḥ | dhyānam(-)
dūrvānibhāṃ trinayanāṃ vilasatkirīṭāṃ śaṅkhābjakhaḍgaśarakheṭakaśūlacāpān | saṃtarjanīṃ ca dadhatīṃ mahiṣāsanasthāṃ durgāṃ navārakulapīṭhagatāṃ bhaje'ham ||
oṃ me pātu śiro durgā hrīṃ me pātu lalāṭakam | duṃ netre'ṣṭākṣarā pātu cakrī pātu śrutī mama || 9 ||
maṭhaṃ gaṇḍau ca me pātu deveśī raktakuṇḍalā | vāyurnāsāṃ sadā pātu raktabījanisūdinī || 10 ||
lavaṇaṃ pātu me coṣṭhau cāmuṇḍā caṇḍaghātinī | bhekībījaṃ sadā pātu dantān me raktadantikā || 11 ||
oṃhrīṃśrīṃ pātu me kaṇṭhaṃ nīlakaṇṭhāṅkavāsinī | oṃaiṃklīṃ pātu me skandhau skandamātā maheśvarī || 12 ||
oṃsauḥklīṃ me pātu bāhū deveśī bagalāmukhī | aiṃśrīṃhrīṃ pātu me hastau śivāśataninādinī || 13 ||
sauḥaiṃhrīṃ pātu me vakṣo devatā vindhyavāsinī | oṃhrīṃśrīṃklīṃ pātu kukṣiṃ mama mātaṅginī parā || 14 ||
śrīṃhrīṃaiṃ pātu me pārśvau himācalanivāsinī | oṃstrīṃhūṃaiṃ pātu pṛṣṭhaṃ mama durgatihāriṇī || 15 ||
oṃkrīṃhūṃ pātu me nābhiṃ devī nārāyaṇī sadā | oṃaiṃklīṃsauḥ sadā pātu kaṭiṃ kātyāyani mama || 16 ||
oṃhrīṃśrīṃhrīṃ pātu śiśnaṃ devī śrībhagamālinī | aiṃsauḥklīṃsauḥ pātu guhyaṃ guhyakeśvarapūjitā || 17 ||
oṃaiṃhrīṃśrīṃhsauḥ pāyādūrū mama manonmanā |
oṃjuṃsaḥsauḥ pātu jānū jagadīśvarapūjitā || 18 ||
oṃaiṃklīṃ me pātu jaṅghe meruparvatavāsinī | oṃhrīṃśrīṃgīṃ sadā pātu gulphau mama gaṇeśvarī || 19 ||
oṃhrīṃduṃ pātu me pādau pārvatī ṣoḍaśākṣarī | pūrve māṃ pātu brahmāṇī vahnau māṃ vaiṣṇavī tathā || 20 ||
dakṣiṇe caṇḍikā pātu nair(-)ṛtye nārasiṃhikā | paścime pātu vārāhī vāyavye mā'parājitā || 21 ||
uttare pātu kaumārī caiśānyāṃ śāmbhavī tathā | ūrdhvaṃ durgā sadā pātu pātvadhastācchivā sadā || 22 ||
prabhāte tripurā pātu madhyāhne māṃ maheśvarī | sāyaṃ sarasvatī pātu niśīthe cchinnamastakā || 23 ||
niśānte bhairavī pātu sarvadā bhadrakālikā | agnerambā ca māṃ pātu jalānmāṃ jagadambikā || 24 ||
vāyormāṃ pātu vāgdevī vanād vanajalocanā | siṃhāt siṃhāsanā pātu sarpāt sarpāntakāsanā || 25 ||
rogānmāṃ rājamātaṅgī bhūtād bhūteśavallabhā | yakṣebhyo yakṣiṇī pātu rakṣobhyo rākṣasāntakā || 26 ||
bhūtapretapiśācebhyaḥ sumukhī pātu māṃ sadā | sarvatra sarvadā pātu oṃhrīṃ durgā navākṣarā || 27 ||
itīdaṃ kavacaṃ guhyaṃ durgāsarvasvamuttamam | mantragarbhaṃ maheśāni kavaceśvarasaṃjñakam || 28 ||
vittadaṃ puṇyadaṃ puṇyaṃ varma siddhipradaṃ kalau | aṣṭasiddhipradaṃ gopyaṃ parāpararahasyakam || 29 ||
śreyaskaraṃ manumayaṃ roganāśakaraṃ param | mahāpātakakoṭighnaṃ mānadaṃ ca yaśaskaram || 30 ||
aśvamedhasahasrasya phaladaṃ paramārthadam | atyantagopyaṃ deveśi kavacaṃ mantrasiddhidam || 31 ||
paṭhanāt siddhidaṃ loke dhāraṇānmuktidaṃ śive | ravau bhūrje likhed dhīmān kṛtvā karmāhnikaṃ priye || 32 ||
śrīcakrāgre'ṣṭagandhena sādhako mantrasiddhaye | likhitvā dhārayed bāhau guṭikāṃ puṇyavardhinīm || 33 ||
kiṃ kiṃ na sādhayelloke guṭikā varmaṇo'cirāt | guṭikāṃ dhārayenmūrdhniṃ rājānaṃ vaśamānayet || 34 ||
dhanārthī (kh: dhanārthe) dhārayet kaṇṭhe putrārthī (kh: putrārthe) kukṣimaṇḍale | tāmevaṃ dhārayed devi likhitvā bhūrjapatrake || 35 ||
śvetasūtreṇa saṃveṣṭya lākṣayā pariveṣṭayet | suvarṇenātha saṃveṣṭya dhārayed raktarajjunā || 36 ||
guṭikā kāmadā devi devānāmapi durlabhā | kavacasyāsya (kh: śu) guṭikā dhṛtā muktipradāyinī || 37 ||
kavacasyāsya deveśi varṇituṃ naiva śakyate | mahimā ca mahādevi jihvākoṭiśatairapi || 38 ||
adātavyamidaṃ varma mantragarbhaṃ rahasyakam | avaktavyaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvasārasvatapradam || 39 ||
adīkṣitāya no dadyāt kucailāya durātmane | anyaśiṣyāya duṣṭāya nindakāya kulārthinām || 40 ||
dīkṣitāya kulīnāya gurubhaktiratāya ca | śāntāya kulasaktāya śāktāya kulakāmine || 41 ||
idaṃ varma śive dattvā kulabhāgī bhavennaraḥ | idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ durgākavacamuttamam |
guhyaṃ gopyatamaṃ gopyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 42 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye durgākavacanirūpaṇamaṣṭācatvāriṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 48 || atha
[ekonapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā śṛṇu vakṣyāmi durgāsarvasvamīśvari | rahasyaṃ mama (k: sarvadevānāṃ) devānāṃ durlabhaṃ janmināmapi || 1 ||
śrīdurgātattvamuddiṣṭasāraṃ trailokyakāraṇam | mantranāmasahasraṃ ca durgāyāḥ puṇyadaṃ param || 2 ||
yaṃ paṭhitvā śive dhṛtvā devīnāmasahasrakam | iha bhogī paratrāpi jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ || 3 ||
idaṃ nāmasahasraṃ te mantragarbhaṃ rahasyakam | aśvamedhāyutāt puṇyaṃ loke saubhāgyavardhanam || 4 ||
śreyaskaraṃ viśvavandyaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam | guhyaṃ gopyatamaṃ devi paṭhanāt siddhidāyakam || 5 ||
asya śrīdurgānāmasahasrapāṭhasya śrīmaheśvara ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrīdurgā devatā duṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ oṃ kīlakaṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe
sahasranāmapāṭhe viniyogaḥ | dhyānam(-)
dūrvānibhāṃ trinayanāṃ vilasatkirīṭāṃ śaṅkhābjakhaḍgaśarakheṭakaśūlacāpān | saṃtarjanīṃ ca dadhatīṃ mahiṣāsanasthāṃ durgāṃ navārakulapīṭhagatāṃ bhaje'ham ||
oṃhrīṃduṃ jagadambā bhā bhadrikā bhadrakālikā | pracaṇḍā caṇḍikā caṇḍī caṇḍamuṇḍanisūdinī || 6 ||
anasūyā tuṭistārā kṛttikā kubjikā layā | pralayā sthitiḥ saṃbhūtirvibhūtirbhayanāśinī || 7 ||
mahāmāyā mahāvidyā mūlavidyā cidīśvarī (cide namaḥ pṛthak nāma) | madālasā madottuṅgā madirā madanapriyā || 8 ||
ālirvyālaprasūḥ puṇyā pavitrā parameśvarī | ādidevī kalā kāntā tripurā jagadīśvarī || 9 ||
manonmanā mahālakṣmīḥ siddhalakṣmīḥ sarasvatī | saritkādambarī godhā guhyakālī gaṇeśvarī || 10 ||
gaṇāmbikā jayā tāpī tapanā tāpahāriṇī | tapomayī durālamvā duṣṭagrahanivāriṇī || 11 ||
duḥkhahā sukhadā sādhvī paramāmṛtasūḥ surā | sudhā sudhāṃśunilayā pralayānalasaṃnibhā || 12 ||
samastā saṃpadambhojanilayā karṇikālayā | vidyeśvarī viśvamayī virāṭ chando gatirmatiḥ || 13 ||
dhṛtidā (k: dhṛtiśca) dāmbhikī dolā lopāmudrā paṭīyasī | gariṣṭhāriṣṭahā'duṣṭā kṛpā kāśī kulākulā || 14 ||
akulasthā padanyāsā nyāsarūpā virūpiṇī |
virūpākṣī koṭarākṣī kulakāntāparājitā || 15 ||
ajitā kulikā lampā lampaṭā tripureśvarī | tritayī (100) vedavinyāsā saṃnyāsā sumatirbhayā || 16 ||
abhayā svarmukhā (k: durmukhaḥ) devī mahauṣadhiralambusā | capalā candrikā caṇḍā caṇḍamuṇḍanisūdinī || 17 ||
cāpalākṣī madāviṣṭā madirāruṇalocanā | purī tripurasū rāsnā rasā rāmā manoharā (k: manoramā) || 18 ||
saṃdhyā saṃdhyābhraśīlā ca śālā śyāmapayodharā | śaśāṅkamukuṭā śyāmā surā sundaralocanā || 19 ||
viṣamākṣī viśālākṣī vāśā (k: vaśā) vāgīśvarī śilā | manaḥśilā ca kastūrī mṛganābhirmṛgekṣaṇā || 20 ||
mṛgārivāhanā mādhvī (ṅ: sādhvī) mānadā mattabhāṣiṇī (k: mṛta) | nārasiṃhī vāmadevī vāmā vāmaśrutipriyā || 21 ||
puṇyā puṇyagatiḥ puṇyā putrī puṇyajanapriyā | cāmuṇḍā cogracaṇḍā ca mahācaṇḍā'tamā'tamāḥ || 22 ||
tamasvinī (k: tapasvinī mahā) prabhā jyotsnā mahajjyotiḥsvarūpiṇī | surūpā sadgatiḥ (k: svargatiḥ) sādhvī sadasadrūparājitā || 23 ||
sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiḥ kṣemakarī kṣamā kṣāmonnatastanī | kṣoṇī kṣayakarī kṣīṇā śarvasthā (k, kh: śavasthā) śivavallabhā || 24 ||
danturā dāḍimaprītirdayā dāmbhikasūdinī | rākṣasī ḍākinī yogyā yoginī yogavallabhā (ṅ: yogi) || 25 ||
kabandhā kandharā kṛṣṇā (ṅ: vidyā) kṛttikā kaṇṭhakāntakā |
kalaṅkarahitā kālī kampā kāśmīravallabhā || 26 ||
kāśī kīrtipradā kāñcī kāśmīrī kokilasvanā | prabhāvatī (200) mahāraudrī rudrapatnī rujāpahā || 27 ||
ratiḥ stutistarīsturyā totulā'talavāsinī | tapaḥpriyā śaracchreṣṭhā paṅguputrī yamasvasā || 28 ||
yāmī yamāntakā yāmyā yamunā svarnadī taḍit | nārāyaṇī viśvamātā bhavānī pāpanāśinī || 29 ||
vigatā vigatapraśnā kṛṣṇā kṛṣṭāsidhāriṇī | vārī vārā varadharā varadā vīrasūdinī || 30 ||
vīrasūrvāmanākārā dīrghasūtrā dayāvatī | darī dhanapradā dhātrī dhātrīvallī mahodarī || 31 ||
gaṇeśvarī gayā kāñcī kāñcīkiṅkiṇighaṇṭikā | māyā māyāvatī mattā pramattā pravareśvarī || 32 ||
paurandarī śacī śītā śītātapasvabhāvajā | svābhāvikaguṇā gaṇyā gāmbhīryaguṇabhūṣaṇā || 33 ||
sūtiḥ sūryakalā suptā saptasaptisvarūpiṇī | tejasvinī sadānandā sabhāsantoṣavardhinī || 34 ||
tarpaṇā karṣaṇā hotā saṅkalpā śubhamantrikā | darbhā droṇikalā śrāntā samiddhā (ṅ: samidhā) suravedikā || 35 ||
dhūmrāhutiścaramatiścāmīkararuciścitā | cintānaleśvarī nelākarā (ṅ: nelā kālā) nīlasarasvatī || 36 ||
aparṇā suphalā yajñā sabhayā nirbhayābhayā | bhīmasvanā bhargaśikhā bhāsvatī bhākarā vibhā || 37 ||
vibhāvarī nadī nandyā nandyāvartapravartinī |
pṛthvīdharā viśvadharā (gh, ṅ: viṣadharā) (300) viśvagarbhā pravartikā || 38 ||
viśvamāyā viśvabhālā viśvambharavilāsinī | urageśā padmanāgā padmanābhaprasūḥ prajā || 39 ||
toraṇā tulasī dīkṣā dakṣā dākṣāyaṇī dyutiḥ | saṃpuṭā śayanā śayyā śāsanā śamanāntakā || 40 ||
śyāmākavarṇā śārdūlī śampā śīlāṃśuvallabhā | stutyā praṇītā niyatiḥ kampanā kampahāriṇī || 41 ||
campakābhā carā cīnādīnā dīnajanapriyā | vasundharā vāsaveśī vasunāthā vaṭeśvarī || 42 ||
samudrā saṅgamā pūrṇā'ntarālā (k, kh: taralā) taruvāsinī | pārvatī pāmarī mānyā mānanīyā madhupriyā || 43 ||
mādhavī madhupānasthā mandirā mandurā mṛgī | momuṣā (ṅ: mumūṣā) rūruṣā revā revatī ramaṇī ramā || 44 ||
ṛddhihastā siddhihastā annapūrṇā maheśvarī | annarūpā jagajjyotiḥ samastāsuraghātinī || 45 ||
gāruḍī gaganālambā lambamānakacapriyā | pītāmbarā pītapuṣpā pūtanā gītavallabhā || 46 ||
balākā jagadantā ca jarā jayavarapradā | prītiḥ kaṭhoravadanā karālaradanā rasā || 47 ||
jihvāhastā ca bagalā praṇayā vinayapradā | kirī karālavapuṣī śemuṣī makṣikā maṣī || 48 ||
uttīrṇā tarṇikā tīkṣṇā ślakṣṇā kāmeśvarī śivā | śivapatnī sarojākṣī padmahastā (400) sarasvatī || 49 ||
kamalākṣī kamalajā karavālavihāriṇī |
kavipūjyā kavigatiḥ kavirūpā kavipriyā || 50 ||
kadalī kadalīrūpā kadalīvanavāsinī | kalaprītā kalahadā kalahā kalahāturā || 51 ||
kastūrīmṛgasaṃsthā ca kastūrīmṛgarūpiṇī | kaṭhorā karamālā ca kaṭhorakucadhāriṇī || 52 ||
yajñamātā yajñabhoktrī yajñeśī yajñasaṃbhavā | yajñasiddhiḥ kriyāsiddhiryajñāṅgī yajñarakṣikā || 53 ||
vaiṣṇavī viṣṇurūpā ca viṣṇumātṛsvarūpiṇī | viṣṇumāyā viśālākṣī viśālanayanojjvalā || 54 ||
śivamātā śivākhyā ca śivadā śivarūpiṇī | gāyatrī caiva sāvitrī brahmāṇī brahmarūpiṇī || 55 ||
durgasthā durgarūpā ca durgā durgatināśinī | māheśvarī ca sarvādyā śarvāṇī sarvamaṅgalā || 56 ||
sūryakoṭisahasrābhā caṃdrakoṭinibhānanā | samudrakoṭigambhīrā vāyukoṭimahābalā || 57 ||
somasūryāgnimadhyasthā maṇimaṇḍalavāsinī | dvādaśārasarojasthā sūryamaṇḍalavāsinī || 58 ||
akalaṅkaśaśāṅkābhā ṣoḍaśāranivāsinī | hṛtpadmanilayā'bhīmā mahābhairavanādinī || 59 ||
varṇāḍhyā varṇarahitā pañcāśadvarṇabhedinī | bhavānī bhūtidā bhūtirbhūtidātrī ca bhairavī || 60 ||
bhairavācāraniratā bhūtabhairavasevitā | kāmeśvarī kāmarūpā kāmatāpavimocinī || 61 ||
gaṇeśajananī devī gaṇeśavaradāyinī | gatidā gatihā gītā gautamī gurusevitā || 62 ||
dīnaduḥkhaharā dīnatāpanirmūlakāriṇī | dayāśīlā dayāsārā dayāsāgarasaṃsthitā || 63 ||
nṛtyapriyā nṛtyaratā nartakī nartakapriyā | nārāyaṇī narendrasthā naramuṇḍāsthimālinī || 64 ||
bhairavī bhairavārādhyā bhīmā bhīmavarapradā (500) | bhuvanā bhuvanārādhyā bhavānī bhūtivardhinī || 65 ||
mahiṣāsurahantrī ca raktabījavināśinī | dhanurbāṇadharā nityā dhūmralocananāśinī || 66 ||
kulīnā kulamārgasthā kulamārgaprakāśinī | pañcāśadvarṇabījāḍhyā pañcāśanmuṇḍamālikā || 67 ||
ṣaḍaṅgayuvatīpūjyā ṣaḍaṅgarūpavarjitā | kālamātā kālarātriḥ kālī kamalavāsinī || 68 ||
kamalā kāntirūpā ca kāmarājeśvarī kriyā | māyā matirmahāmāyā bhayadā bhayahārikā || 69 ||
nārī nārāyaṇī gaṇyā nārāyaṇagṛhapriyā | madirāpānasantuṣṭā madirāmodadhāriṇī || 70 ||
tathyā pathyā kṛtī rathyā rathasthā vitatasvarā | mahatī rāgiṇī bhārgī śucihāsā harīśvarī || 71 ||
haridratnāṃśulasitā lakṣmīnāyakasundarī | ambālikāmbā deveśī anaghāgniśikhā śrutiḥ || 72 ||
alasālpagatiścāntyānantānantaguṇāśrayā | ādyā cādityasaṅkāśā ādityakulasundarī || 73 ||
ātmarūpādhiśamanī ādimāyādidevatā | indraprasūrinadyotirināgniśaśilocanā || 74 ||
indrāvarajasaṃstutyā ilā cekṣurasapriyā |
īśvarī īśavanitā īśā keśavavallabhā || 75 ||
umā urvī urubhujā uttuṅgā cokṣavāhanā | uttaṅkā cottamā dhyeyā ullāsā corugarviṇī || 76 ||
ūṣmā ūṇā ca gurvaṅgī ūrdhvākṣī ūrdhvamastakā | ṛddhir(-)ṛcā ṛvarṇeśī ṛṇahartrī ṛvāntakī (ṅ: ṛvātukī) || 77 ||
ṝḍhijā (ṅ: ṛḍhiṛścāru) cāruvastrā ca ṝṇivāsā (600) mahālayā | ḷkārā ḷkkurā līnā ḹkārā varadhāriṇī || 78 ||
eṇāṅkamukuṭā cehā cārucandrakalā kalā | aikāragatiraiśvaryadāyinī caiśvarī gatiḥ || 79 ||
oṃkārā bījarūpā ca autrikī vetradhāriṇī | ambikā lampikā pampā aḥsvarodgārarūpiṇī || 80 ||
kālī ca bhadrakālī ca kālikā kālavallabhā | kadambanilayā kanthā kāñcīmaṇḍanamaṇḍitā || 81 ||
kalaṅkarahitā kūrmā kāñcanābhā karīragā | kanakācalavāsā ca kāruṇyākulamānasā || 82 ||
kulasthā kaulinī kulyā kurukullā kapālinī | kapālakulanirviṇā klīṃkārā kañjalocanā || 83 ||
khañjanākṣī khaḍgadharā kheṭakāyudhabhūṣaṇā | kharparāḍhyā ca khalahā kheṭinī khecarī khagā || 84 ||
khagāyudhā khagagatiḥ khakārākṣarabhūṣaṇā | gaṇādhyakṣā gajagatirgaṇeśajananī gadā || 85 ||
godhā gadādharā (gadādharaprājyā) prājyā gaganeśī mahī malā | ghurghurā ghaṭabhūrghūkā (ṅ: ghṛrā) ghusṛṇābhā gaṇeśvarī || 86 ||
ghanasārapriyā sāmyā ghavarṇakṛtabhūṣaṇā | ṅāntā ṅavarṇamukuṭā kavargakṛtabhūṣaṇā || 87 ||
cāndrī cāndristutā cārvī candrikā caṇḍaniḥsvanā | cañcarīkasvanā devī cañcaccāmīkarāṅgadā || 88 ||
chatrikā churikā chañchā chatracāmarabhūṣaṇā | jraṃkārī jalajihvā ca jṛmbhikā jalayoginī || 89 ||
jaṭājūṭadharā jātirjātīpuṣpasamānanā | jaleśvarī jagaddhyeyā janakī jananī jaṭā || 90 ||
jhañjhā jharī jharatkārī (700) jharatkāñcīrakiṅkiṇī | jhiṇṭhikā jhampakṛd jhampā jhampatrāsanivāriṇī || 91 ||
ñāṇurūpā ñaṅkahastā ñavarṇākṣarasaṃmatā (k, kh: ñakārākṣara) | ṭaṅkāyudhā mahātathyā ṭaṅkārakaruṇā ṭasī || 92 ||
ṭhakurā ṭhatkarā ṭhānī ḍiṇḍīravasanā ḍhalā (ṅ: vasanākulā) | ḍhaṇḍhānilamayī ḍhaṇḍā ḍhaṇatkārakarā ḍhasā || 93 ||
ṇāntā ṇīlāyudhā (kh, g: nīlāyudhā) namrā ṇavarṇākṣarabhūṣaṇā | taruṇī tundilā tondā tāmasī tāmasapriyā || 94 ||
tāmrānanā tāmrakarā tāmrāmbaradharā tulā | tāpatrayaharā tāpī tailāsaktā tilottamā || 95 ||
sthāṇupatnī sthalī sthūlā sthitiḥ sthairyadharā sthulā | dantinī danturā dārvī devakī devanāyikā || 96 ||
daminī śaminī daṇḍyā daṇḍahastā durānatiḥ | durvārā durgatirdrākṣī drākṣā drāviḍavāsinī || 97 ||
dūrasthā dundubhidhvānā daradā daranāśinī | duḥkhaghnī drutagā'duṣṭā dayā dāmbhikyanāśinī || 98 ||
dharmyā dharmaprasūrdhanyā dhanadā dhātṛvallabhā | dhanurdharā dhanurvallī dhānuṣkavaradāyinī || 99 ||
dhūmālī dhūmravadanā dhūmaśrīrdhūmralocanā | nalinī nartakī nāntā naṅgā nalinalocanā || 100 ||
nirmalā nigamācārā nimnagā (g: nimaṅgā) nagajā nimiḥ | nīlagrīvā nirīhā ca nīpopavanavāsinī || 101 ||
nirañjanā janī janyā (800) nidrālurnīravāsinī | naṭinī nāṭyaniratā navanītapriyā'nilā || 102 ||
nārāyaṇī nirākārā nirlepā nityavallabhā | padmāvatī padmakarā putradā putravatsalā || 103 ||
parottarā purī pāṭhā pīnaśrotrā pulomajā | puṣpiṇī pustakakarā paṭuḥ pāṭhīnavāhanā || 104 ||
pāpaghnī śaṃpinī (kh, g: ṣaṣpiṇī) pālī pallī paramasundarī | piśācī ca piśācaghnī pānapātradharā puṭā || 105 ||
pūrṇimā pañcamī pautrī purūravavarapradā | pañcayajñā pañcaśarī pañcāśatimanupriyā || 106 ||
pāñcālī pañcamudrā ca (ṅ: mudrā cā) pūjā pūrṇamanorathā | phalinī phaladātrī ca phalguhastā phaṇipriyā || 107 ||
phiraṅgahā sphītamatiḥ sphītiḥ spītimatī sphurā | balamāyā balastutyā (ṅ: balastanyā) bilvasenā balābalā || 108 ||
bagaleśvarapūjyā ca balinī balavardhinī | buddhamātā bauddhamatirbaddhā bandhanamocinī || 109 ||
bhaginī bhagamālā ca bhagaliṅgāmṛtadravā |
bhīmeśvarī (ṅ: bhāgeśvarī) ca bheruṇḍā bhageśī bhagasarpiṇī || 110 ||
bhagaliṅgasthitā bhagyā bhāgyadā bhagamālinī | mattā manoharā mīnā mainākajananī murī || 111 ||
muralī mānavī hotrī mahasvijanamoditā | mattamātaṅgagā mādrī (kh: mīṭrī) marālagatirañcalā || 112 ||
yakṣeśvareśvarī yajñā yajurvedapriyāśritā (k, kh: dṛtā) | yaśovatī yatisthā ca yatātmā yativallabhā || 113 ||
yavanī yauvanasthā ca yavā yakṣajanāśrayā | yajñasūtrapradā jyeṣṭhā yajñabhū(900)ryūpamūlinī || 114 ||
rañjitā rājapatnī ca rājasūyaphalapradā | rajovatī rajaścitrā rājyadā rājyavardhinī || 115 ||
rājñī rātriñcareśānī rogaghnī gripureśvarī | lulitā latikā lāpyā lopā lalanalālasā || 116 ||
lāṭīradrumavāsā ca pāṭīradrumavartinī | laṅkā lalajjaṭājūṭā laṅghitā lokasundarī || 117 ||
lokeśavaradā leyā (ṅ: līyā) layakartrī mahālayā | vedirvilagnā vāṇī ca vīṇā veṇurvaneśvarī || 118 ||
vandamānā vavarṇāḍhyā vārāhī vīramātṛkā | śaṅkhinī śaṅkhavalayā śaṅkhāyudhadharā śamā || 119 ||
śaśimaṇḍalamadhyasthā śītalāmbunivāsinī | śmaśānasthā mahāghorā śmaśānanilaneśvarī || 120 ||
sindhuḥ sūtradharā satrā samastakulacāriṇī | saptamī sāttvikī sattvā satrasthā'surasūdinī || 121 ||
sureśvarī sampadādyā samastācalacāriṇī | samadā saṃmitiḥ saṃmā savanā savaneśvarī || 122 ||
haṃsī harapriyā hāsyā harinetrā harāmbikā | heṣā haṭeśvarī herā halinī haladāyinī || 123 ||
hehā hāhāravā hālā hālāhalahatāśayā | kṣamā kṣemapradā kṣāmā kṣaumāmbaradharā kṣayā || 123 ||
kṣitiḥ kṣīrapriyā lakṣmīḥ (ṅ: lakṣyā) kṣitibhṛttanayā kṣudhā | kṣatriyī brāhmaṇī kṣetrā kṣapā kṣaḥbījamaṇḍitā || 124 ||
laṃkṣaḥbījasvarūpā ca kṣakārākṣaramātṛkā (ṅ: rākāramātṛkā) | durgandhanāśinī dūrvā durgamā durgavāsinī || 125 ||
durgā durgārtiśamanī oṃhrīṃduṃbījamaṇḍitā (1000) | iti nāmasahasraṃ tu mantragarbhaṃ mahāphalam || 126 ||
durgāyā durgatiharaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam | sarvamantramayaṃ divyaṃ devadānavapūjitam || 127 ||
śreyaskaraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam | yaḥ paṭhet pāṭhayedvāpi śṛṇoti śrāvayedapi || 128 ||
sa mahāpātakairmukto devadānavasevitaḥ (k, kh: pūjitaḥ) | iha loke śriyaṃ bhuktvā paratra tridivaṃ vrajet || 129 ||
durgānāmasahasraṃ tu mūlamantraikasādhanam | ardharātre paṭhedvīro madhurasmayasevitaḥ || 130 ||
trivāraṃ varmapūrvaṃ tu bhavedvāgīśasaṃnibhaḥ | yaḥ paṭhed devi madhyāhne strīyuto muktakuntalaḥ || 131 ||
tasya vairikulaṃ trasyed darśanād daityasūdini (k, kh: mardini) |
dahanādiva deveśi pataṅgakulamadrije || 132 ||
yaḥ paṭhedvetasīmūle sāyaṃ pūjitabhairavaḥ | tasyāsyakuharād vāṇī niḥsaredgadyapadyabhāk (kh: padyajā) || 133 ||
yaḥ paṭhet satataṃ devi śayane strīratākulaḥ | sa bhavedvairividvaṃsī dhanena dhanadopamaḥ || 134 ||
vāgbhirvāgīśasadṛśaḥ kavitvena sitopamaḥ | tejasā sūryasaṅkāśo yaśasā śaśisannibhaḥ || 135 ||
balena vāyutulyo'pi lakṣmyā gīrvāṇanāyakaḥ | devi kiṃ bahunoktena sa bhavedbhairavopamaḥ || 136 ||
stambhanākarṣaṇoccāṭa vaśīkaraṇakakṣamaḥ | ravau bhūrje likhed devi niśīthe vāṣṭagandhakaiḥ || 137 ||
sastanyaretorājaskaiḥ sādhako mantrasādhakaḥ | likhitvā veṣṭayennāmasahasramaṇimīśvari || 138 ||
śvetasūtreṇa saṃveṣṭya lākṣayā pariveṣṭayet | suvarṇarajatādyaiśca veṣṭayet pītasūtrakaiḥ || 139 ||
saṃpūjya guṭikāṃ devi śubhe'hni sādhakottamaḥ | dhārayenmūrdhni vā bāhau guṭikāṃ kāmadāyinīm || 140 ||
raṇe ripūn vijityāśu kalyāṇī gṛhamāviśet | vandhyā vāmabhuje dhṛtvā kṛtvā sādhakapūjanam || 141 ||
putrān labhenmahādevi sākṣādvaiśravaṇopamān | guṭikaiṣā mahādivyā gopyā kāmaphalapradā || 142 ||
sādhakaiḥ satataṃ pūjyā sākṣād durgāsvarūpiṇī | yo'rcayet sādhako durgāṃ guṭikāṃ dhārayet priye || 143 ||
paṭhedvarma śive mantranāmasāhasrikīṃ parām |
aṅgastotraṃ phalaṃ tasya devi vakṣye'dhunā śṛṇu || 144 ||
vane rājakule vāpi durbhikṣe śatrusaṅkaṭe | araṇye prāntare durge śmaśāne sindhusaṅkaṭe || 145 ||
vātye yakṣapiśācādibhūtapretabhaye tathā | vīro vigatabhīrdevi sarvatra vijayī bhavet || 146 ||
stambhayedvātasūryāmbucandrādīn sādhakottamaḥ | mohayet trijagat sadyaḥ kāntāścākarṣayed dhruvam || 147 ||
mārayedakhilāñchatrūnuccāṭayati vairiṇaḥ | vaśayed devatāḥ sadyaḥ kiṃ punarmānavāṃśchive || 148 ||
śamayedakhilān rogān mahotpātānupadravān | kiṃ kiṃ na labhate vīro durgāpañcāṅgapūjanāt || 149 ||
idaṃ rahasyaṃ durgāyā aṣṭākṣaryā maheśvari | sarvasvaṃ sāratattvaṃ ca mūlavidyāmayaṃ param || 150 ||
mahācīnakramasthānāṃ sādhakānāṃ yaśaskaram | paṭhet saṃpūjayed devyā mantranāmasahasrakam || 151 ||
idaṃ sāraṃ hi tantrāṇāṃ tattvānāṃ tattvamuttamam | durgānāmasahasraṃ tu tava bhaktyā prakāśitam || 152 ||
abhaktāya na dātavyaṃ goptavyaṃ paśusaṅkaṭe (kh: paśusaṃnidhau) | abhaktebhyo'pi putrebhyo dattvā narakamāpnuyāt || 153 ||
dīkṣitāya kulīnāya gurubhaktiratāya ca | śāntāya bhaktiyuktāya deyaṃ nāmasahasrakam || 154 ||
vinā dānaṃ na gṛhṇīyānna dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ vinā | dattvā gṛhītvāpyubhayoḥ siddhihānirbhaved dhruvam || 155 ||
idaṃ nāmasahasraṃ te guptaṃ gopyatamaṃ śive |
tattvaṃ (kh: tava) bhaktyā mayākhyātaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 156 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye durgāsahasranāmanirūpaṇamekonapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 49 || atha
[pañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devi vakṣyāmi durgāstotraṃ manoharam | mūlamantramayaṃ divyaṃ sarvasārasvatapradam || 1 ||
duḥkhārtiśamanaṃ puṇyaṃ sādhakānāṃ jayapradam | durgāyā aṅgabhūtaṃ tu stotrarājaṃ parātparam || 2 ||
śrīdurgāstotrarājasya ṛṣirdevo maheśvaraḥ | chando'nuṣṭub devatā ca śrīdurgāṣṭākṣarā śive || 3 ||
duṃ bījaṃ ca parā śaktirviśvaṃ kīlakamadrije | dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 4 ||
asya śrīdurgāstotrarājasya śrīmaheśvara ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrīdurgāṣṭākṣarā devatā duṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ namaḥ kīlakam dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe pāṭhe viniyogaḥ | dhyānam(-)
dūrvānibhāṃ trinayanāṃ bilasatkirīṭāṃ śaṅkhābjakhaḍgaśarakheṭakaśūlacāpān |
santarjanīṃ ca dadhatīṃ mahiṣāsanasthāṃ durgāṃ navārakulapīṭhagatāṃ bhaje'ham || 5 ||
tāraṃ hāraṃ mantramālāsu bījaṃ dhyāyedantaryo'mba lambālakāntaḥ | tasya smāraṃ smāramaṅghridvayīṃ drāg rambhāyāti svargatā kāmavaśyā || 6 ||
māyāṃ japedyastava mantramadhye durge sadā durgatikhedakhinnaḥ | bhavet sa bhūmau nṛpamaulimālāmāṇikyanirghṛṣṭapadāravindaḥ || 7 ||
cākrikaṃ yadi japettavāmbike cakramadhyagata īśvareśvari | sādhako bhavati cakravartināṃ nāyako nayavilāsakovidaḥ || 8 ||
cakribījamaparaṃ smarecchive yo'rivargavihitāhitavyathaḥ | ājimaṇḍalagato jayedripūn vājivāraṇarathāśrito naraḥ || 9 ||
dūrvābījaṃ yo japet pretabhūmau sāyaṃ māyābhasmanā liptakāyaḥ | gīrbāṇānāṃ nāyako devi mantrī bhūtvā rājyaṃ prājyamāḍhyaṃ karoti || 10 ||
vāyavyabījaṃ yadi sādhako japet priyākucadvandvavimardanakṣamaḥ | samastakāntājananetravāgurāvilāsahaṃso bhavitā sa pārvati || 11 ||
viśvaṃ viśveśvari yadi japet kāmakelīkalānte rātrau mātrākṣaravilasitanyāsa īśānivāsaḥ (k: ni vāsaḥ; ṅ: nisāsaḥ) | tasya smerānanasarasijā bhrājamānāṅgalakṣmīrvaśyāvaśyaṃ surapuravadhūmaulimālaurvaśī sā || 12 ||
bhūgehāñcitavahnivṛttavilasannāgāravṛttāñcitadvyagnyārollasitāgnikoṇa dhyāyeccetasi śarvapatni bhavatīṃ mādhvīrasāghūrṇitāṃ yo mantrī sa bhaviṣyati smarasamaḥ strīṇāṃ dharaṇyāṃ divi || 13 ||
durgāstavaṃ manumayaṃ manurājamaulimāṇikyamuttamaśivāṅgarahasyabhūtam |
prātaḥ paṭhedyadi japāvasare'rcanāyāṃ bhūmau bhavet sa nṛpatirdivi devanāthaḥ || 14 ||
iti stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ pañcāṅgaikaśiromaṇim | yaḥ paṭhedardharātre tu tasya vaśyaṃ jagattrayam || 15 ||
idaṃ pañcāṅgamakhilaṃ śrīdurgāyā rahasyakam | sarvasiddhipradaṃ guhyaṃ sarvāśāparipūrakam || 16 ||
guhyaṃ mantrarahasyaṃ tu tava bhaktyā prakāśitam | abhaktāyāpradātavyamityājñā pārameśvarī || 17 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan bhavatānena kathanena maheśvara | śrīpañcāṅgasya durgāyā hyadya krītāsmyahaṃ param || 18 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ durgāsarvasvamuttamam | pañcāṅgaṃ varṇitaṃ gopyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 19 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye durgāstrotranirūpaṇaṃ pañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 50 ||
[samāptaṃ śrīdurgāpañcāṅgam] |
atha
[ekapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
atha durgārahasyam |
śrīśailarājaśikhare nānādrumasamākule | vasantalakṣmīnilaye samāsīnamumāpatim || 1 ||
ekadā devamīśānaṃ śaśiśekharamīśvaram | umāśritārdhavapuṣaṃ devadānavasevitam || 2 ||
dhyānāsaktākṣitritayaṃ jaṭājūṭalatāruṇam | bhasmāṅgarāgadhavalaṃ nārāyaṇanamaskṛtam || 3 ||
brahmādidevapraṇataṃ gāndharvajanavanditam | yakṣarākṣasanāgendra nagendrakulapūjitam || 4 ||
bhairavaṃ bhairavākāraṃ girīśaṃ parameśvaram | utthāya vinatā bhūtvā paryapṛcchata pārvatī || 5 ||
bhagavan sarvalokeśa sarvalokanamaskṛta | guṇātīta guṇādhyakṣa bhūteśvara maheśvara || 6 ||
sṛjatyavati nityānte saṃharatyamitaṃ jagat | carācaraṃ bhavāneva kiṃ punarjapasi prabho || 7 ||
kiṃ dhyāyasi mahādeva satataṃ bhaktavatsala | vada śīghraṃ dayāmbhodhe yadyahaṃ preyasī tava || 8 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
devi kiṃ te pravakṣyāmi rahasyamidamadbhutam | sarvasvaṃ sārabhūtaṃ me sarveṣāṃ tattvamuttamam || 9 ||
lakṣavārasahasrāṇi vāritāsi punaḥ punaḥ | strīsvabhāvānmahādevi punastvaṃ paripṛcchasi || 10 ||
adya bhaktyā tava snehādvakṣyāmi paramādbhutam | devīrahasyatantrākhyaṃ tantrarājaṃ maheśvari || 11 ||
sarvāgamaikamukuṭaṃ sarvasāramayaṃ dhruvam | sarvamantramayaṃ divyaṃ paṭalairdaśabhiryutam || 12 ||
anukramaṇikāṃ divyāṃ śṛṇu tantrasya pārvati | yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa koṭipūjāphalaṃ labhet || 13 ||
śrīvidyānirṇayo devi mantrasādhanako'paraḥ | śivamantraprakāśākhyo dīkṣāvidhiranuttamaḥ || 14 ||
puraścaryāvidhirdevi pañcaratneśvarīkramaḥ | homasādhanakaścaiva cakrapūjāvidhiḥ paraḥ || 15 ||
ācāranirṇayo devi daśamo daśamīvidhiḥ | tatrādau devi vakṣye'haṃ durgābhuvanamadbhutam || 16 ||
jayaṃ nāma mahādivyaṃ bahuvistāravistṛtam | nānāratnasamākīrṇaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham || 17 ||
indragopakavarṇaṃ ca candrakoṭimanoharam | aprameyamasaṃkhyeyamagamyaṃ sarvavādinām || 18 ||
idaṃ divyaṃ jayaṃ nāma bhuvanaṃ parameśvari | tatraiva vasate durgā navarūpātmikā parā || 19 ||
yā devadevī varadā sarvalokaikasundarī | yā durgeti smṛtā loke brahmāṇḍodaravartinī || 20 ||
viṣṇunā tapasā pūrvamārādhya parameśvarīm |
mahiṣasyāsurendrasya vadhārthāyāvatāritā || 21 ||
yogamāyā mahāmāyā sarvadā parameśvarī | tāmevāharniśaṃ dhyāye śrīvidyāṃ paramāṃ jape || 22 ||
tāmadyāhaṃ pravakṣyāmi vidyācaraṇadāyinīm | yāṃ śrutvā sa śivo jātaḥ pañcanādātmakaḥ śivaḥ || 23 ||
yadābhūddharihīnā sā durgā niṣkalarūpiṇī | sākṣādbhuvanarūpāpi mahājyotiḥsvarūpiṇī || 24 ||
tadā śahakakāle (k: śaphaka) tu jyotīrūpo maheśvari | śivaḥ prabhāmaṇḍalato nirgato'cetano vibhuḥ || 25 ||
aśṛṇonnādamādhāraṃ jagatāṃ bījamuttamam | api (k, g, gh: ava) saṃsmara māyāṃ tvaṃ sṛṣṭo'gramanunāyakaḥ (kh: sṛṣṭvogramanunāyaka) || 26 ||
iti śrutvā parānādaṃ tāramityabhidhīyate | śivo jajāpa sahasā bījaṃ trijagatāṃ śive || 27 ||
tena māyetiśabdaṃ sa śuśrāva gaganāttataḥ | dumaṃ (k, kh, g: dāmaṃ bhaja) bhaja meheśāna sadānandālayaṃ param || 28 ||
bindunādamayo devaḥ śivo'bhūt parameśvaraḥ | tato nādaṃ sa śuśrāva duṣṭavarṇavivarjitam || 29 ||
durgāṃ (kh: dūrvā jape) bhajeti sa śivaḥ pañcanādātmako'bhavat | tato japtvā parāṃ vidyāmasṛjajjagadambike || 30 ||
ādau vāyuṃ śivaḥ sṛṣṭvā tataḥ sṛṣṭiryathecchayā | icchāmātraṃ śive viśvaṃ viśveśvari carācaram || 31 ||
sasarja lavamātraṃ sa śitikaṇṭhaḥ śivaḥ śive |
itīmāṃ guptavidyāṃ tu labdhvā gurupadārcanāt || 32 ||
kiṃkiṃ na sādhayelloke sādhako mantrasādhakaḥ | vastraṃ vahniṃ ca kāmaṃ ca dhanaṃ vṛttaṃ ca sādhakaḥ || 33 ||
vaśīkuryādyathābuddhyā yena turyākulaṃ bhavet | śrīcakramidamādhāraṃ devyā vibhavakāraṇam || 34 ||
guhyaṃ sarvasvamambhāyāḥ pūjyaṃ sādhakasattamaiḥ | cakraṃ likhenmahādevi pūjyamabjārkayordalaiḥ || 35 ||
yena devī mahāmāyā śrīdurgāśu prasīdati | cakre saṃpūjayedyastu nīlābhāṃ dāhanīṃ dyutim || 36 ||
vahnīndusūryāmbarajaṃ maṇḍalākāramarcayet | lasanmukuṭarociṣṇuḥ (kh: rociṣkaḥ) sa bhavet sādhakottamaḥ || 37 ||
tasya śaṅkhanibhā kīrtirbhramate bhuvanatraye | sasurāsuragandharvaṃ (kh: mahāsiddhiḥ satāṃ haste) vaśaṃ yāti maheśvari || 38 ||
śarāsavarasānandamayo (kh: mārāsava) bhūtvā japenmanum | kheṭakāstasya tuṣyanti sādhakasyāṅgapūjanāt || 39 ||
rasya rogā vinaśyanti sarve śūlādayo'cirāt | tarjanīṃ tasya vīkṣyāpi (k, g, gh: tava vakṣyāmi) ripavo yānti vidrutāḥ || 40 ||
tasya gehe dhanaṃ gāvo mahiṣyā viṣṭaraṃ gajāḥ | durgā ratnavatī bhūmistasya pīṭhaṃ manoharam || 41 ||
sādhakasya bhavedevaṃ saṃpattirbahudhārcanāt | evaṃ dhyāyenmahādevīṃ durgāṃ durgatināśinīm || 42 ||
dhyānena yena devendro bhaviṣyati hi sādhakaḥ | itīdaṃ devi tattvaṃ te kathitaṃ paramādbhutam | avaktavyamadātavyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 43 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye mantravidyānirūpaṇamekapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 51 || atha
[dvipañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
mantrasādhanakaṃ vakṣye rahasyaṃ sarvamantriṇām | yena sādhanamātreṇa mantraḥ siddhimupaiṣyati || 1 ||
vinotkīlanamantreṇa na mantraḥ (kh: manuḥ) siddhidāyakaḥ | vinā sañjīvanenāpi saṃpuṭena vinā śive || 2 ||
viśvamādau manordadyāt tāraṃ dadyāt tathāñcale | manurutkīlanākhyo'yaṃ sarvasiddhipradaḥ (kh: mayaḥ) śive || 3 ||
cākrikaṃ nāma bījaṃ tu dadyādādau manoḥ śive | tadagre nāma vinyasya tāramāye tadagrataḥ || 4 ||
manorante'śmarīṃ dadyānmanuḥ sañjīvanābhidhaḥ | tataḥ siddhamanuṃ devi japenmāntrikasattamaḥ || 5 ||
yathāśaktyā tato dadyāt saṃpuṭaṃ sādhakottamaḥ (kh: sādhakeśvaraḥ) | tāraṃ parāṃ cakribījaṃ viśvamante'bhidhaṃ nyaset || 6 ||
saṃpuṭākhyo'styayaṃ mantraḥ sarvāśāpūrakaḥ smṛtaḥ | evaṃ saṃskṛtamīśāni manuṃ devyā japet sadā || 7 ||
sarvasiddhimavāpnoti sādhako mantrasādhakaḥ | itīdaṃ mantratattvaṃ te sādhanākhyaṃ maheśvari | guhyātiguhyaguptaṃ ca goptavyaṃ sādhakottamaiḥ || 8 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye mantrasādhananirūpaṇaṃ dvipañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 52 || atha
[tripañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā śivavidyāṃ te vakṣyāmi paramārthadām | sarvavidyāmayīṃ (kh: sarvasiddhi) sādhyāṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitām || 1 ||
kevalaṃ yo japecchāktaṃ manuṃ śaivaṃ tu no japet | janmakoṭiṣu japto'pi naṃ manuḥ siddhibhāgbhavet (kh: siddhido) || 2 ||
yasyā devyāstu yo devaḥ śivastasyāḥ śivo (k, kh, g: śivaṃ) bhavet | tena vidyā mahādevi kalau siddhyati satvaram || 3 ||
kālikāyā mahākālaḥ sumukhyā amṛteśvaraḥ | kāmeśvarastrikūṭāyāḥ śiva ityevamīśvari || 4 ||
chinnāyāḥ kālarudrastu śāradāyāḥ śivaḥ śivaḥ |
śrībhairavaḥ kālarātryāḥ śiva ityevamīśvari || 5 ||
jvālāmukhyā mahādevo vāgdevyā vijayeśvaraḥ | īśvaro bhuvaneśvaryyāḥ śiva ityevamīśvari || 6 ||
viśvanāthastu pārvatyā rājñyā bhūteśvaraḥ śivaḥ | bhīḍāyāstu virūpākṣaḥ śiva ityevamīśvari || 7 ||
nīlakaṇṭhastu durgāyāḥ śiva ityevamīśvari | śilāyā vāmadevastu śivaḥ proktaḥ sureśvari || 8 ||
sadyojātastu tārāyāḥ śiva ityevamīśvari | adya durgāśivasyādau vakṣye mūlamanuṃ param || 9 ||
yaṃ japtvā parameśāni vidyā siddhyati satvaram | śrīnīlakaṇṭhamantrasya dakṣiṇāmūrtirīśvaraḥ || 10 ||
ṛṣiśchando mayānuṣṭub varṇito vīravandite | durgeśvaro nīlakaṇṭho devatā kathito mayā || 11 ||
haritaṃ bījamīśāni tāraṃ śaktiḥ smṛtā śive | kīlakaṃ viśvamākhyātaṃ niyogo manusiddhaye || 12 ||
tāracandrakaḍimbādyaiḥ (kh, gh, ṅ: ḍimbhādyaiḥ) ṣaḍdīrghairnyāsamācaret | dhyānamasya śivasyādya śrutvā guptatamaṃ kuru || 13 ||
bandhūkakāñcananibhaṃ rucirākṣamālāṃ pāśāṅkuśau varamabhītimamuṃ dadhānam | hastaiḥ śaśāṅkaśakalābharaṇaṃ trinetraṃ śrīnīlakaṇṭhamumayā śritamāśrayāmi || 14 ||
mantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvasiddhimayaṃ param | durgārahasyabhūtaṃ ca śṛṇu pārvati satvaram || 15 ||
praṇavaṃ haritaṃ vyoṣaṃ nīlakaṇṭhāya cāśmarī |
durgeśanīlakaṇṭhasya mantroddhāro daśākṣaraḥ || 16 ||
anena mantrarājena japtamātreṇa pārvati | durgāyāḥ paramā vidyā kalau siddhyati satvaram || 17 ||
itīdaṃ guhyaguptātiguhyaṃ (kh: guhyaguhyāti) sarvasvamīśvari | rahasyaṃ nīlakaṇṭhasya gopanīyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ || 18 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye śivavidyānirūpaṇaṃ tripañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 53 || atha
[catuṣpañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
dīkṣāvidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi sādhakānāṃ hitecchayā | vidhāya vidhivad dīkṣāṃ paśutvāt sa vimucyate || 1 ||
dīyate paramā siddhiḥ kṣīyate karmavāsanā | āpyate paramaṃ dhāma tena dīkṣā smṛtā śive || 2 ||
brahmādikīṭaparyantaṃ jagat sarvaṃ maheśvari | paśutvānmohitaṃ devyā tasmād dīkṣāṃ caret kalau || 3 ||
śrīdevyāḥ sevayā devi cakrārcanapuraḥsaram | sādhakaḥ paśubhāvena mukto jñānaṃ bhajet tataḥ || 4 ||
dīkṣito yāti caraṇaṃ dīkṣāhīno bhavet paśuḥ | dīkṣitastu bhavejjñānī paśubhāvojjhito vibhuḥ || 5 ||
sarvapātakamukto hi labhet sa paramāṃ gatim | yasya dīkṣā śive nāsti jīvanāntaṃ ca janminaḥ || 6 ||
sa jātu nottared devi nirayāmbunidheḥ kvacit | dīkṣāhīnasya deveśi paśoḥ kutsitajanmanaḥ || 7 ||
pāpaugho'ntikamāyāti puṇyaṃ dūraṃ palāyate | tasmādyatnena dīkṣaiṣā grāhyā kṛtibhiruttamaiḥ (kh: ttamā) || 8 ||
bālye vā yauvane vāpi vārdhakye'pi sureśvari | anyayā nirayī pāpī pitṝn svānnirayaṃ nayet || 9 ||
ante paśumanuṣyaḥ (kh: paśurmanuṣyaḥ sa) san paśuyoniṃ vrajecchive | pūrvapuṇyārjitāṃ prāpya vāsanāṃ paramārthadām || 10 ||
guruṃ kulīnaṃ tantrajñaṃ sarvāṅgaiḥ sumanoharam | labdhvā bhaktyā praṇamyādau toṣayitvā viśeṣataḥ || 11 ||
praṇāmairvandanairdevi dakṣiṇāmbarapūrvakam | siddhasādhyārinirṇītāṃ dīkṣāṃ devyā yathāvidhi || 12 ||
gṛhṇīyāt parayā bhaktyā sādhako yena jāyate | guruśca śiṣyaṃ ramyāṅgaṃ sarvāṅgaiḥ sumanoharam || 13 ||
gurubhaktirataṃ bālaṃ kulīnaṃ garbhadīkṣitam | devībhaktirataṃ bhaktaṃ (kh: bhaktyā) pāpabhītaṃ kṛtātmakam || 14 ||
dṛṣṭvā dīkṣāṃ parāṃ dadyāt kṛtabhāgī bhavet tataḥ |
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan karuṇāmbhodhe sādhakānāṃ hitecchayā | kadā dīkṣā parā grāhyā sādhakaistadvadasva me || 15 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
sudine śubhanakṣatre saṅkrāntāvayanadvaye | navarātridine pitroḥ śrāddhe svajanivāsare || 16 ||
navavarṣadine devi candrasūryoparāgake | śivarātryāṃ svajanmarkṣe dīkṣāṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ (kh: dadyāt) || 17 ||
tatrādau śubhanakṣatre snātvā saṃpūjya bhairavam | gatvā nadītaṭaṃ devi tathā devālayaṃ kvacit || 18 ||
devatāgre guruṃ natvā natvā santoṣahetave | dvīpaṃ vopavanaṃ (ṅ: vā paramaṃ) puṇyaṃ devānāmapi durlabham || 19 ||
devatāyatanaṃ vāpi prāpyāśu praṇamet tataḥ | tatrādāvāsanaṃ devi saṃśodhya gurumarcayet || 20 ||
bhūtānniḥsārya deveśi svāṅganyāsaṃ caret tataḥ | prāṅmukho gururāsīnaścottarābhimukhaṃ śiśum || 21 ||
saṃsthāpya vidhivad devi devīṃ smṛtvā parāmayaḥ | devatāgre parāprītyai dīkṣāṃ dadyādyathāvidhi || 22 ||
karṇamūle mahāvidyāṃ śrīvidyāṃ sādhakeśvaraḥ (ṅ: sādhakottamaḥ) | ānandasaktahṛdayaḥ śanaistristriḥ samarpayet || 23 ||
gaṇeśasya ca gāyatryāstato mṛtyuñjayasya ca | iṣṭadevyāḥ śivasyāpi tato vidyāṃ samarpayet || 24 ||
śiṣyo dīkṣāṃ tu saṃprāpya gurumabhyarcya śaktitaḥ | toṣayitvā praṇāmaiśca dakṣiṇābhiḥ śubhāmbaraiḥ || 25 ||
tadājñāṃ sahasādāya pūjāyai (ṅ: japāya) parameśvari | yantraṃ mantraṃ ca mālāṃ ca pañcāṅgaṃ parameśvari || 26 ||
punarjātu śive śiṣyo gurave'pi na rśayet | iti dīkṣāvidheḥ sārabhūtaṃ guhyaṃ rahasyakam | guhyātiguhyaguptaṃ tu na prakāśyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ || 27 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye dīkṣānirūpaṇaṃ catuṣpañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 54 || atha
[pañcapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā mantrarājasya puraścaraṇamuttamam | vakṣye siddhiprado yena mantraḥ kalpadrumo bhavet || 1 ||
ekadā sudine devi sunakṣatre suparvaṇi | puraścaraṇakarmādau ārabhet sādhakottamaḥ || 2 ||
varṇalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ tadardhaṃ vā maheśvari (ṅ: sureśvari) | ekalakṣāvadhiṃ kuryānnāto nyūnaṃ kadācana || 3 ||
lakṣasaṃkhyā prakartakhyā sādhakaiścenna śakyate | ekalakṣaṃ prajaptavyaṃ nāto nyūnaṃ kadācana || 4 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
lakṣajapto manurdeva yadi kalpadrumo bhavet |
tadā kiṃ sādhako loke lakṣatattvaṃ vadasva me || 5 ||
kasya hastena mantrasya puraścaraṇakakriyām | kārayet sādhakaścaitat saṃśayaṃ chindhi dhūrjaṭe || 6 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā devi śṛṇu vakṣyāmi pārvati | na kadācit svayaṃ kuryādādau mantrapuraskriyām || 7 ||
guruhastena deveśi sādhakasya kareṇa vā | kuryānmantravarasyāsya puraścaraṇakakriyām || 8 ||
jīvahīno yathā deho sarvakarmasu na kṣamaḥ | puraścaraṇahīno'pi (ṅ: no hi) na mantraḥ phaladāyakaḥ || 9 ||
japād daśāṃśato homastaddaśāṃśena tarpaṇam | mārjanaṃ taddaśāṃśena taddaśāṃśena bhojanam || 10 ||
mantrasyādau pramādāccet svayaṃ kuryāt puraskriyām | tadā jāpyaṃ bhaved vyarthaṃ kṣetreṣviva ghṛtaṃ yathā || 11 ||
tasmācca guruhastena sādhakasya kareṇa vā | puraścaryāṃ svamantrasya kārayet sādhakottamaḥ || 12 ||
puraścaraṇasaṅkalpaṃ dattvādau gurave śive | japaṃ yathāvidhi kuryād guruḥ kulamanoḥ priye || 13 ||
guroḥ pādaprasādena puraścaryāphalaṃ śive | gṛhṇīyāt sādhako devi guruṃ santoṣayet tataḥ || 14 ||
yena mantraḥ kalau śīghramiṣṭasiddhiprado (kh, g: maṣṭa) bhavet | dakṣiṇābhiḥ śubhairvastrairyathāvibhavamātmanaḥ || 15 ||
tataḥ svayaṃ puraścaryā bahvīḥ kuryāt tu sādhakaḥ | parvatāgre nadītīre devatāyatane tathā || 16 ||
ekānte ca śucau deśe japenniyatamānasaḥ | brahmacaryadharo vīro mitāhāro jitendriyaḥ || 17 ||
anṛtaṃ matsaraṃ dambhaṃ tyajet pratigrahaṃ tathā | puraścaraṇakāle tu taddhomāvasare tathā || 18 ||
mūlaṃ japtvaikalakṣaṃ tu kṛtvā homaṃ daśāṃśataḥ | sādhakaiḥ kṣatriyeṇāpi daśāṃśaṃ homamācaret || 19 ||
tarpayet suhito devīṃ bhojayet sādhakāṃstataḥ | puraścaryāvidhiścaiṣa varṇitaḥ kulasundari || 20 ||
athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate | aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi || 21 ||
sūryodayāt samārabhya yāvat sūryodayo bhavet | tāvajjaptvā nirātaṅko mantraḥ kalpadrumo bhavet || 22 ||
candrasūryagrahe vāpi grāsāvadhi vimuktitaḥ | yāvatsaṃkhyāmanurjaptastāvaddhomādikaṃ caret || 23 ||
sarvasiddhīśvaro mantro bhavet sādhakavandite | śaratkāle ravau devi japenmantraṃ yathāvidhi || 24 ||
niśīthe racayeddhomaṃ kṣatranyastāhutiṃ (k, kh: hastanyastā) śive | tatkṣaṇāt sādhako devi kṣatriyo'pi śubhaṃ labhet || 25 ||
athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate | gurumānīya saṃsthāpya devatāpūjanaṃ caret || 26 ||
vastrālaṅkārahemādyaiḥ santoṣya gurumeva ca | tatsutaṃ tatsutāṃ caiva tasya patnīṃ tathaiva ca || 27 ||
pūjayitvā manuṃ japtvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet | athavānyaprakāreṇa puraścaraṇamiṣyate || 28 ||
sahasrāre guroḥ pādapadmaṃ dhyātvā prapūjya ca | kevalaṃ devabhāvena (ṅ: devi) sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 29 ||
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād yathāvibhavamātmanaḥ | guroranujñāmātreṇa duṣṭamantro'pi siddhyati || 30 ||
ityeṣa paṭalo guhyo mantrasāramayo dhruvaḥ | aprakāśyo na dātavyo nākhyeyo brahmavādibhiḥ || 31 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye puraścaryāvidhinirūpaṇaṃ pañcapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 55 || atha
[ṣaṭpañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devi vakṣye'haṃ pañcaratneśvarīvidhim | yena śravaṇamātreṇa vidyā siddhyati satvaram || 1 ||
vinā pañcaratneśvarīmantrajāpyaṃ na siddhirbhavet sādhakasyottamasya | tataḥ pūjayed dīkṣitaḥ śrīguruṃ svaṃ samastāṣṭasiddhīśvaraṃ devadevi || 2 ||
durgāyāḥ paramaṃ tattvaṃ pañcaratneśvarīmayam | śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā yena muktirbhavet (kh: bhaktiḥ) kalau || 3 ||
śrīdurgā śāradā śārī sumukhī bhagalāmukhī |
pañcaratneśvarī vidyā durgāyāḥ kathitā mayā || 4 ||
sudine devi durgāyāḥ pañcaratneśvarīṃ japet | varṇalakṣapuraścaryāphalamāpnoti sādhakaḥ || 5 ||
sādhakeṣu caturṣvevaṃ śrīdurgāsādhakaḥ śive | śrīguruṃ vandanaiḥ stutyā toṣayitvā dhanairapi || 6 ||
dīkṣāmanyeṣu śiṣyeṣu dāpayet sādhakottamaḥ | yena mantro hi durgāyāḥ sadyaḥ sphurati bhāratī || 7 ||
pañcasvapi mahādevi sādhakeṣu kalau yuge | pañcaratneśvarīṃ dattvā puraścaryāphalaṃ labhet || 8 ||
śrīdurgopāsakaścaikaḥ śāradopāsakaḥ paraḥ | śārikopāsakastvanyo mātaṅgyāstvaparaḥ śive || 9 ||
pañcamo bagalāmukhyāścaikatra militāśca te | pūjayeyurguruṃ devi pañcaratneśvarīṃ japet || 10 ||
anyonyaṃ sādhakāḥ pañca śrīguroḥ purataḥ śive | puraścaryāphalaṃ siddhaṃ (kh: siddhiṃ) prārthayeyurgurostataḥ || 11 ||
evaṃ siddhamanurloke sarvasiddhiṃ prayacchati |
tāraṃ māyā cākrikaṃ cakridūrvāvāyavyāḍhyaṃ (kh: vāyavyārṇaṃ) viśvamante bhavāni | durgāyāste varṇito mūlavidyāmantroddhāro gopito'ṣṭākṣaro'yam || 12 ||
tāraṃ māyā kāmarājaśca śaktiḥ stambhaṃ tasmādbhagavatyai ca nāma | bhūtistasmādañcale ṭhadvayaṃ syāt proktaṃ muktyai śāradā mantra eṣa || 13 ||
tāraṃ parā mātaṭasindhurārṇāḥ khaṃ śarma (kh: śarmato madhya) tanmadhyagataṃ ca nāma | ante'śmarī pārvati śārikāyāstrayodaśārṇo manurasti gopyaḥ || 14 ||
vāk kāmamucchiṣṭapadaṃ (kh: kāma ucchiṣṭa) vibhāvya caṇḍālinī (k: caṇḍālini vai sumukhi ca devi mahāpiśāci) vai sumukhī ca devi | mahāpiśācī sakalātrayābjaṃ vanaṃ manuḥ syāt sumukhīpriyo'yam || 15 ||
tāraṃ maṭhaṃ bagalāmukhi sarvaduṣṭānāṃ vācaṃ mukhaṃ stambhaya dviḥ | padaṃ jihvāṃ kīlaya dvirmaṭhaṃ vā tāraṃ nīraṃ brahmaṇo'styastravidyā (kh: syā) || 16 ||
ityeṣā guptavidyeyaṃ prabhāvasahitā kalau | pañcaratneśvarī grāhyā puraścaraṇasiddhaye || 17 ||
itīdaṃ tattvamīśāni puraścaryārahasyakam | anantaphaladaṃ guhyaṃ gopanīyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ || 18 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye pañcaratneśvarīvidyānirūpaṇaṃ ṣaṭpañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 56 ||
atha
[saptapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
atha homavidhiṃ vakṣye sarvatantreṣu gopitam | durgārahasyakaṃ sāraṃ mantrarājasya pārvati || 1 ||
dhyātvā devīṃ parāṃ durgāṃ guruṃ dhyātvā saśaktikam | japecchrīcakrapurato niśīthe mantramīśvari || 2 ||
ayutaṃ lakṣamekaṃ vā daśāṃśaṃ homamācaret | koṭilakṣaprajaptasya mantrasya surasundari || 3 ||
vinā daśāṃśahomena na tatphalamavāpnuyāt | vinā śmaśānagamanaṃ nityahomajapādayaḥ || 4 ||
na siddhyanti varārohe kalau bhairavaśāpataḥ | ghṛtapāyasamṛdvīkā guḍapuṣpasitāśaraiḥ || 5 ||
homo daśāṃśataḥ kāryo japasya suravandite | pañcāmṛtena deveśi taddaśāṃśena tarpayet || 6 ||
tarpayitvā daśāṃśena pañcāmṛtamukhaṃ sudhīḥ | taddaśāṃśena deveśi hyaṣṭagandhena mārjayet || 7 ||
bhojayitvā daśāṃśena dīkṣitāṃśca dvijottamān | tato devi puraścaryāphalamāpnoti sādhakaḥ || 8 ||
anyathā siddhihāniḥ syājjaptasyāpi manoḥ sadā |
śrīdevyuvāca |
yasya no (kh: naitāvatī śaktiḥ) bhavati śaktirhomaṃ kartuṃ daśāṃśataḥ | sa kathaṃ kriyate homaṃ tadvadasva maheśvara || 9 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
yasya homaṃ śive kartuṃ śaktirnāsti daśāṃśataḥ | tasya yuktiṃ bravīmyadya kaulikānāṃ hitāya ca || 10 ||
śubhe'hni sāyaṃ deveśi gatvopavanamaṇḍalam | śmaśānaṃ saṃmukhaṃ dhṛtvā pṛṣṭhe vā parameśvari || 11 ||
śmaśānaṃ praṇamedbhaktyā sādhakaḥ sādhakaiḥ samam | jvālākarālavadane kalpāntadahanapriye || 11 ||
prāṇiprāṇālayodbhūte cite me'nugrahaṃ kuru | iti natvā mahādevi jñātvā digbhūtabhairavān || 13 ||
nivaset tatra rātrau tu kuryāddhomaṃ kuleśvari | aiśānyāṃ diśi deveśi śrīcakraṃ tu vibhāvayet || 14 ||
saṃpūjya vidhivanmantrairdikpālāṃstatra pārvati | gaṇeśaṃ pūjayettatra pūjayet kulayoginīḥ || 15 ||
tatpūrvataḥ khanet kuṇḍaṃ hunedājyaṃ ca vidyayā | trikoṇaṃ kuṇḍamīśāni hastādhogādhamadrije || 16 ||
hastaikavistṛtaṃ viśvak tasmiṃścakraṃ vibhāvayet | binduṃ trikoṇaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vasupatraṃ trivartulam || 17 ||
bhūgṛhāṅkaṃ mayākhyātaṃ vahnicakraṃ kulārcite | gaṇeśadharmavaruṇāḥ kuberasahitāstataḥ || 18 ||
pūjanīyā viśeṣeṇa gandhākṣataprasūnakaiḥ | brāhmyādimātaraḥ pūjyā asitādyāśca bhairavāḥ || 19 ||
vasupatreṣu saṃpūjyā vahnicakre maheśvari | māyā ca mohinī caiva tṛtīyā ca manonmanā || 20 ||
muktakeśī ca mātaṅgī madirākṣī ṣaḍaśrake | trikoṇe yamunā gaṅgā saṃpūjyā ca sarasvatī || 21 ||
bindau durgā ca saṃpūjyā gandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ śive | bindāvaraṇimāmantrya (k: bindāvāvaraṇaścaiva) mūlamantreṇa māntrikaḥ || 22 ||
vahnimāvāhya mūlena tadāvāhanamudrayā | oṃrūṃrāmagnaye svāhā mantreṇeti sureśvari || 23 ||
vahniṃ mūlena saṃskṛtya kṛtvājyaṃ ghṛtamīśvari | daśāṃśahomasaṅkalpaṃ kuryānmantrasya (kh: mūlasya) sādhakaḥ || 24 ||
mālayā dahane dadyādāhutīnāṃ śatatrayam | āhutīḥ kṣatriyanyastāstatra vahnau hunet priye || 25 ||
puṣpaiḥ phalairājyamiśraistato dadyād baliṃ priye | makāraiḥ pañcabhirdevi punarjaptvā ca (kh, ṅ: tu) pūrvavat || 26 ||
āhutīnāṃ śataṃ dadyādaṣṭottaramadhomukhaḥ | tataḥ sādhakacakrasya kṣatriyasya ca pārvati || 27 ||
pūjāṃ vidhāya cakre'smiṃstoṣayennutibhirgurum | āśīrbhirvardhayet kṣatraṃ yenāśu kṣoṇipo bhavet || 28 ||
kṣatriyo'pi vadet tatra puraścaryāphalaṃ manoḥ | labhasva sādhakaśreṣṭha tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ hunet || 29 ||
tato varma paṭhed devi yena devīmayo bhavet | tato devīṃ ca saśivāṃ mantrī saṃhāramudrayā || 30 ||
sādhakāṃstarpayitvādau bhakṣyapānādibhiḥ priye | visṛjya sādhakān devīṃ saśivāṃ saparicchadām || 31 ||
puraścaryāphalaṃ prāpya sādhako muktibhāg bhavet | ityeṣa paṭalo divyo mantrapūjāmayo dhruvaḥ |
sarvatattvaikanilayo gopanīyo mumukṣubhiḥ || 32 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye homavidhinirūpaṇaṃ saptapañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 57 || atha
[aṣṭāpañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā cakrapūjāṃ te vakṣyāmi naganandini | yena durgā kalau śīghraṃ varadā bhavati priye || 1 ||
ekādaśāvadhi (kh, ṅ: dhikāḥ) devi sādhakāḥ paramārthadāḥ | ekādaśāpi cakre tu varṇitāḥ sādhakāḥ śubhāḥ || 2 ||
uttamā nava deveśi madhyamāḥ pañca sādhakāḥ | adhamāstu trayo devi na pūjyāścakramadhyagāḥ || 3 ||
vinā cakrārcanaṃ naiva nityapūjājapādayaḥ | phaladā yoginīśāpāt tasmāccakraṃ prapūjayet || 4 ||
kuhūpūrṇendusaṃkrānti caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca | navamyāṃ maṅgale mande cakrapūjā śubhapradā || 5 ||
sādhakāśca sutīrthyāśca militāḥ śivamandire | devatāyatane vāpi śūnye śṛṅgāṭake'tha vā || 6 ||
digbhūtabhairavān devi vicārya purasādhakaḥ (kh: parisādhakaḥ) | upaviśyāsane devi saṃśodhya vīramaṇḍale || 7 ||
sādhakānupaviśyātra kuryāt saṃkalpamādarāt | nyāsaṃ vidhāya sarvāṅge bhūtaśuddhyādikaṃ caret || 8 ||
tatra prāṇān pratiṣṭhāpya śrīcakraṃ pūjayecchive | ātmaśrīcakrayormadhye kumbhasthāpanamācaret || 9 ||
gauḍī mādhvī tathā pauṣṭī cāsavaṃ pūjayecchive | eteṣāṃ rasamādāya tattvato bhairavārcane || 10 ||
ānandarasapūjāyāṃ tuṣyate parameśvarī | viprāśca kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāḥ pūjyāśca (ṅ: pūjāsu pāvanāḥ) pārvati || 11 ||
gauḍī vipreṣu śubhadā mādhvī kṣatreṣu cottamā | vaiśyeṣu śubhadā paiṣṭī śūdreṣu śubhamāsavam (ṅ: śivaṃ) || 12 ||
brahmakṣatriyavaiśyānāmānandastu śubhāvahaḥ | āsavaṃ dūratastyājyaṃ sādhakaistu mumukṣubhiḥ || 13 ||
abhāve tu surānandarasānāṃ (ṅ: rasānanda) parameśvari | madhunā pūjayed devi devamānandabhairavam || 14 ||
dravyaṃ saṃśodhya deveśi makārān pañca śodhayet | śrīcakrāgre'rcayet tatra sādhakān bhairavāgame || 15 ||
tatra saṃpūjya yantreśaṃ devamāvāhya bhairavam | yoginīḥ pūjayet tatra vaṭukaṃ pūjayet tataḥ || 16 ||
gaṇeśaṃ kṣetrapālāṃśca pūjayeccakranāyikām (kh, g: nāyakān) | santarpya devān pitṝṃśca munīn vedān maheśvari || 17 ||
śrīcakrāgre japenmūlaṃ paṭhet kavacamīśvari |
mantranāmasahasraṃ ca stotraṃ puṇyaṃ paṭhettataḥ || 18 ||
tato devyai baliṃ dattvā sādhakāṃstarpayecchive | bhairavāṃstarpayeccāṣṭau dīkṣitāṃstarpayet tataḥ || 19 ||
uttamaṃ nava pātrāṇi pañca pātrāṇi madhyamam | adhamaṃ trīṇi pātrāṇi caikapātraṃ na pūjayet || 20 ||
pravṛtte bhairave tantre sarve varṇā dvijātayaḥ | nivṛtte bhairave tantre sarve varṇāḥ pṛthak pṛthak || 21 ||
nava kanyāḥ samabhyarcya vīreśo bhairavārcane | retasā tarpayed devīṃ kulakoṭiṃ samuddharet || 22 ||
śaktyucchiṣṭaṃ pibed dravyaṃ vīrocchiṣṭaṃ tu carvaṇam | makārapañcasaṃyuktaṃ kuryācchrīcakramaṇḍalam || 23 ||
svaguruṃ pūjayet tatra tarpayecchaktitaḥ param | toṣayitvā guruṃ devi dakṣiṇābhiśca vandanaiḥ || 24 ||
tadājñāṃ śirasādāya kuryādānandamātmanaḥ |
vāme rāmā ramaṇakuśalā dakṣiṇe cālipātramagre mudrā caṇakavaṭukau sūkarasyoṣṇaśuddhiḥ | tantrī vīṇā sarasamadhurā sadguroḥ satkathāyāṃ vāmācāraḥ paramagahano yogināmapyagamyaḥ || 25 ||
itīdaṃ cakrasarvasvaṃ guhyaṃ tattvātmakaṃ param | tava bhaktyā mayākhyātaṃ gopanīyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ || 26 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye cakrapūjānirūpaṇamaṣṭāpañcāśattamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 58 ||
atha
[ekonaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā devi vakṣyāmi durgāyāstattvamuttamam | ācārāṇāṃ vidhiṃ yena kalau durgā prasīdati (g, gh: prasiddhyati) || 1 ||
dvau mārgau cāgame syātāṃ vāmācārastu dakṣiṇaḥ | tayostatvaṃ kulācāraḥ śṛṇu teṣāṃ vidhiṃ śive || 2 ||
sādhako dīkṣito bhūtvā kena siddhimavāpnuyāt | dadvadāmi tava snehānnacākhyeyaṃ durātmane || 3 ||
trīṇi bījāni durgāyāstadācārāstrayaḥ smṛtāḥ | prathamo dakṣiṇācāro vāmācāro dvitīyakaḥ || 4 ||
tṛtīyastu kulācāro vidhiṃ teṣāṃ śṛṇu priye | prabhāte snānasandhyādi madhyāhne japamīśvari || 5 ||
aurṇamāsanamākhyātaṃ bhakṣyaṃ pāyasaśarkarāḥ | mālā rudrākṣasaṃbhūtā pātraṃ pāṣāṇasaṃbhavam || 6 ||
bhogaḥ svakīyakāntābhirdakṣiṇācāra ityayam | dravyeṇa madhunā devi siddhihānikaro mataḥ || 7 ||
vāmācāraṃ pravakṣyāmi śrīdurgāsādhanaṃ param | yaṃ vidhāya kalau śīghraṃ māntrikaḥ siddhibhāgbhavet || 8 ||
mālā nṛdantasaṃbhūtā pātraṃ pāṣāṇamuṇḍakam | āsanaṃ siṃhacarmādi kaṅkaṇaṃ strīkacodbhavam || 9 ||
dravyamāsavatattvāḍhyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ māṃsādikaṃ śive | carvaṇaṃ bālamatsyādi mudrā vīṇāravaḥ kathā || 10 ||
maithunaṃ varakāntābhiḥ sarvavarṇasamānataḥ | vāmācāra iti proktaḥ sarvasiddhipradaḥ śive || 11 ||
anyathā siddhihāniḥ syānmantrasyāsya maheśvari | tasmādvāmaṃ bhajennityaṃ vāma eva parā gatiḥ || 12 ||
dakṣiṇaṃ ca kulaṃ caiva vīraiḥ sādhakasattamaiḥ | tyājyaṃ dūrāt kalau devi vāmameva bhajet kalau || 13 ||
kulācāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sevyaṃ yogibhiruttamaiḥ | kulastriyaṃ kulaguruṃ kuladevīṃ maheśvari || 14 ||
nityaṃ yat pūjayeditthaṃ sa kulācāra ucyate | kulastriyaṃ śive jñātvā nutvā nutvā maheśvari || 15 ||
haṭhādānīya saṃpūjya tathā bhogaṃ vidhāya ca | retasā tarpayed devīṃ śrīdurgāṃ cakranāyikām || 16 ||
nīlakaṇṭhaṃ ca vidhinā japaṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥ | tatpūrvakaṃ careddhomaṃ kulakāntāṃ vibhūṣayet || 17 ||
pānaiḥ peyaistathā bhakṣyaiḥ santarpya kulayoṣitam | pratyahaṃ vai caredevaṃ kulācāra iti smṛtaḥ || 18 ||
ityācāraparaḥ śrīmān kulastrīgurupūjakaḥ | vāmācāraparo mantrī muktibhāg bhavitā dhruvam || 19 ||
ityeṣa paṭalo guhyo devyāścācāravallabhaḥ | adātavyo'pyabhaktebhyo na prakāśyo mumukṣubhiḥ || 20 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīrahasye ācāranirūpaṇamekonaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 59 ||
atha
[ṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā kathayiṣyāmi śrīdurgāyā rahasyakam | tattvaṃ mantrasya deveśi daśamīpūjanaṃ param || 1 ||
dīkṣāguruḥ śive yastu daśamī sa prakīrtitaḥ | pūjanaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi sarvatantreṣu gopitam || 2 ||
dīkṣāṃ gṛhītvā vidhivad guroḥ kulavicakṣaṇāt | tadājñāṃ śirasādāya sādhayet svamanuṃ tataḥ || 3 ||
ekadā puṇyadivase muhūrte śubhade tathā | gurumānīya deveśi śunyagehe catuṣpathe || 4 ||
śmaśāne vā vane vāpi svagṛhe vāpi pārvati | tatra bhūmau likhedyantraṃ yathāvad varṇyate mayā || 5 ||
bindutrikoṇaṃ vasukoṇabimbaṃ vṛttāṣṭapatraṃ śikhivṛttayuktam | dharāgṛhaṃ vahnituṭībhirīḍhyaṃ yantraṃ gurordevi mayā pradiṣṭam || 6 ||
sindūreṇa vilikhyātaḥ (ṅ: vilikhyāśu) pūjayeccakramīśvari | gaṇeśadharmavaruṇāḥ kuberasahitāḥ śive || 7 ||
pūjyā dvāḥsthāḥ supuṣpaiśca (ṅ: ṣpaiḥ tu) gandhākṣatapuraḥsaraiḥ | asitāṅgo ruruścaṇḍo krodheśonmattabhairavau || 8 ||
kapālī bhīṣaṇo devi saṃhāro'rcyo'ṣṭapatrake | paramānandanāthaṃ ca prakāśānandanāthakam || 9 ||
śrībhogānandanāthaṃ ca samayānandanāthakam | bhuvanānandanāthaṃ ca sumanānandanāthakam (ṅ: śrīsvātmānanda) || 10 ||
gaganānandanāthaṃ ca śrīviśvānandanāthakam | aṣṭau kulagurūn devi pūjayed vasupatrake || 11 ||
madanānandanāthaṃ ca śrīlīlānandanāthakam | maheśvarānandanāthaṃ pūjayedvai trikoṇake || 12 ||
bindau guruṃ ca saṃpūjya gandhākṣataprasūnakaiḥ | tatra bindau guruṃ devi sthāpayed bhaktipūrvakam || 13 ||
saṃpūjayet svamūlena dakṣiṇāṃ kālikāṃ yajet (ṅ: bhajet) | mahākālaṃ yajet tatra kāmaṃ kāmeśvarīṃ tathā || 14 ||
guruṃ ca paramaṃ devi parāparaguruṃ tathā | parameṣṭhiguruṃ caiva svagurormūrdhni pūjayet || 15 ||
saṃpūjya vividhaiḥ puṣpairmālyairābharaṇottamaiḥ | dakṣiṇābhirmaheśāni bhakṣyairbhojyaiśca lehyakaiḥ || 16 ||
coṣyaiḥ peyaiśca khādyaiśca baliṃ dattvā ca tarpayet | ānandarasasaṃpūrṇaṃ guruṃ dṛṣṭvā (k, kh: buddhayā) maheśvari || 17 ||
tato (ṅ: tatra) devi guruṃ natvā prārthayet svamanoratham | ya evaṃ pūjayed devi svaguruṃ puṇyavāsare || 18 ||
sa eva bhairavaḥ sākṣādvicared bhuvanatraye | gurureva paro mantro gurureva paro japaḥ || 19 ||
gurureva parā vidyā nāsti kiñcidguruṃ vinā |
yasya tuṣṭo gururdevi tasya tuṣṭā maheśvarī || 20 ||
yena saṃtoṣito devi guruḥ sa hi sadāśivaḥ | yanna (ṅ: yatra na gurustantraṃ) dṛṣṭyāpi vai brūyādgurustanna samācaret || 21 ||
puṇyaṃ vāpuṇyamīśāni tyājyaṃ grāhyaṃ kulārcite | gururvadati yat sadyastat kuryāt sādhakottamaḥ || 22 ||
vinā gurūpadeśena na siddhyati kalau manuḥ | tasmād guruṃ bhajed bhaktyā toṣayet satataṃ gurum || 23 ||
guroryatra parīvādo nindā yatra pravartate | karṇau tatra pidhātavyau no vā dūraṃ palāyanam || 24 ||
gururdevi paro dharmo gurureva parā gatiḥ | gurumabhyarcayennityaṃ yena (ṅ: durgā yena) devī prasīdati || 25 ||
itīdaṃ gaśamītattvaṃ sarvāgamarahasyakam | sārātsārataraṃ devi gopanīyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ || 26 ||
itīdaṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ tattvaṃ sarvasvamuttamam | durgārahasyasārāḍhyaṃ guhyaṃ gopyaṃ ca sādhakaiḥ || 27 ||
iti devīrahasyākhyastantro'yaṃ tantrasāgaraḥ | sarvasvaṃ me rahasyaṃ me sarvāgamanidhiḥ paraḥ (k, kh: rahasyakaḥ) || 28 ||
śrīdurgāyāstattvabhūto mantrarājamayo dhruvaḥ | siddhiprado mahādevi pūjanīyo'sti sādhakaiḥ || 29 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavan bhavatā bhaktyā prasādo'yaṃ mayi kṛtaḥ | yattvayā varṇitastantraḥ śrīdurgāyāḥ kuleśvara || 30 ||
krītāsmi tava dāsyasmi bhaktāsmi tripurāntaka | sarvathā rakṣaṇīyāsmi kimanyat kathayāmi te || 31 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
idaṃ devīrahasyākhyaṃ tantrarājaṃ maheśvari | adātavyamabhaktebhyo durātmabhyo maheśvari || 32 ||
svaputrebhyo'nyaśiṣyebhyo na deyaṃ tu mumukṣubhiḥ | idaṃ hi sāraṃ tantrāṇāṃ tattvaṃ sarvasvamuttamam || 33 ||
rahasyaṃ devi durgāyā gopanīyaṃ svayonivat |
[iti śrīrudrayāmalatantrāntargata śrīdevīrahasye daśamīvidhinirūpaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 60 || [samāptaṃ cedaṃ devīrahasyatantram] |
pañcāṅkanandaśaśi (1995) saṃmitavaikrame'bde devīrahasyakamaśeṣasutantrasāram | śrīrudrayāmalamahābdhimahārgharatnaṃ saṃskṛtya śuddhipadapāṭhasumelanādyaiḥ || 1 ||
prācīnahastalikhitānapi jīrṇabhūyogranthān prayatnavaśato'nuvidhṛtya labdhān | audāryavīryasubhagatvaguṇasphuracchrī rājādhirāja harisiṃhanṛpānuśiṣṭyā || 2 ||
uccaiḥpadādhikṛtibhājana kākajāti śrīrāmacandravibudhādhikṛtiprabandhe | saṃpādya sūri śivanāthasahāyabhājā prākāśi śāstriharabhaṭṭa vipaścitedam || 3 ||
atha
[pariśiṣṭam] |
[jvālāmukhīpañcāṅgam] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi bhairavi (kh: bhairavaprāṇa) prāṇavallabhe | jvālāmukhyāstu sarvasvaṃ paṭalaṃ devadurlabham || 1 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavaṃstvaṃ hi sarvasya jñātā śāstrasya dhūrjaṭe | śrutāni tvanmukhāmbhojād granthāni (kh: tantrāṇi) vividhāni ca || 2 ||
jvālāmukhyā mahāmantraṃ yantraṃ pūjā vidhānataḥ | layāṅgaṃ vada me nātha (śīghraṃ pāṭhaḥ) yadyahaṃ preyasī tava || 3 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
śṛṇu devi manuṃ yantraṃ layāṅgaṃ bhairaveśvari | prayogasādhanaṃ vakṣye gopyād gopyataraṃ mama || 4 ||
idaṃ viśvamaho krūraṃ bhaktihīnaṃ maheśvari | ekadā haṃsarūpeṇa manunāhaṃ jagatparam || 5 ||
deveśi sraṣṭumaniśaṃ jvālāmukhyāḥ prasādataḥ | jvālāmukhyā tayā mantro varṇito nāmamātrataḥ (kh: nāda) || 6 ||
tadā prabhṛti tanmantrājjagatsthāvarajaṅgamam | sṛjāmi saṃhariṣyāmi rakṣāmi ca divāniśam || 7 ||
yasyā mantraprabhāveṇa prāptamaiśvaryamuttamam | jvālāmukhī jaganmātā saiva syāt triguṇātmikā || 8 ||
sattvena sṛjyate viśvaṃ rajasā caiva pālyate | tamasā jīryate (kh: līyate) yasyā guṇatrayaprabhāvataḥ || 9 ||
trilokajananī mātā saiva me'pīṣṭadevatā | tasyā yantraṃ ca mantraṃ ca dhyānaṃ layāṅgasaṃyutam || 10 ||
prayogān parameśāni śṛṇu tvaṃ sāvadhānataḥ | tatrādau tu manūddhāraṃ sarvāgamaviniścitam || 11 ||
pravakṣyāmi mahādevi na prakāśyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ | ādau praṇavamuddhṛtya māyāṃ ca kamalāṃ tathā || 12 ||
jvālāmukhi mametyatra sarvaśatrūn samuccaret | bhakṣaya dvayamuddhṛtya kūrcaṃ turagasaṃyutam || 13 ||
ṭhadvayena samāyukto jvālāmukhyā hyayaṃ manuḥ | mantro'yaṃ parameśāni kalāvīpsitadāyakaḥ || 14 ||
brahmahatyā gurorhatyā śtrīhatyābhakṣyabhakṣaṇam | agamyagamanaṃ pāpaṃ mātṛ svasṛgamodbhavam (kh: hatyāsamudbhavam) || 15 ||
tat kṣālayati mantro'yaṃ devi satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | adhunā śṛṇu deveśi yantroddhāraṃ parātparam || 16 ||
bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ gopyaṃ gītavāditratoṣitam | ānandasundaraṃ stutyaṃ yantroddhāraṃ bravīmyaham || 17 ||
matsarvasvaṃ na deṣṭavyaṃ sārātsārottamottamam | ādau ṣaṭkoṇamuddhṛtya cordhvarekhāṃ nikarṣayet || 18 ||
adhorekhāṃ samākṛṣya pārśvābhyāṃ ca nikarṣayet | adhorekhāṃ kṣipedūrdhvamūrdhvarekhāṃ kṣipedadhaḥ || 19 ||
madhye kuryāt trikoṇaikaṃ nyasedbinduṃ śivālayam | madhye yat tu trikoṇaṃ syāt sundarībhavanaṃ smṛtam || 20 ||
ūrdhvatrikoṇamanyat syād dakṣiṇākālikālayam | madhye trikoṇabindau śrījvālāmukhyā mahālayam || 21 ||
tato vṛttaikamālikhya likhedaṣṭāramuttamam | ṣoḍaśāraṃ samuddhṛtya vṛttaikopari pārvati || 22 ||
vṛttatrayaṃ punarnyasya likhed bhūpurakaṃ punaḥ | jvālāmukhyā idaṃ yantraṃ trailokyoddharaṇakṣamam || 23 ||
na deṣṭavyo'nyaśiṣyebhyo diṣṭvā tu brahmahā bhavet | layāṅgaṃ śṛṇu deveśi brahmaviṣṇusamarcitam || 24 ||
yantrarājasya deveśi samāsena yathārthataḥ | gaṇeśo dharmarājaśca vāsukirnarasiṃhakaḥ || 25 ||
caturdvāreṣu saṃpūjyāścatvāro dvārapālakāḥ | pūrve ca gaṇanāthastu dakṣiṇe dharmarājakaḥ || 26 ||
paścime vāsukiḥ pūjya uttare narasiṃhakaḥ | tato'ṣṭadvayapatreṣu pūjyā jvālāśca ṣoḍaśa || 27 ||
vāmāvartakramād devi nānāpūjāphalaṃ labhet (kh: nanu pūjāphalaṃ haret) | vāruṇī caiva vātyālī vārāhī kulasundarī || 28 ||
kūvarī (kh: kūrvarī) kulikā kuṇṭhī kutsitā kuṭilā kuhūḥ | kuntī kumbheśvarī kuntā kūcarī kāruṇī kṛtiḥ || 29 ||
iti ṣoḍaśa jvālāḥ syustasyāstu sakalāṅgagāḥ | tato'ṣṭadalapatreṣu pūjyā hyaṣṭau tu kanyakāḥ || 30 ||
māyā ca mohinī caiva bālā ca bhagarūpiṇī | bhagāvāsā ca bhīruṇḍā mṛḍānī baindaveśvarī || 31 ||
aṣṭau kanyāḥ samākhyātāḥ saṃpūjyāścāṣṭapatrake | tatastu jvālāmukhyāstu sukhadā (kh: mukhagā) daśa pārvati || 32 ||
vāmāvartakrameṇaiva pūjāsiddhirbhaved dhruvam | brāhmī ca śāmbhavī durgā vārāhī kulakāminī || 33 ||
nārasiṃhī ca kaumārī mātaṅgī bhadrakālikā | ugratārā samākhyātā jvālādaśakalā imāḥ || 34 ||
saṃpūjyā daśapatreṣu sādhakaiśca susiddhaye | tata ūrdhve samabhyarcya devīṃ tripurasundarīm || 35 ||
tanmadhye'dhaḥsthitā pūjyā devī dakṣiṇakālikā | tanmadhye pūjanīyā ca devī jvālāmukhī tathā || 36 ||
jvalinī jaṭinī caiva jātī jālandharī tathā | bindau trikoṇamadhyasthe yantrasya parameśvarī || 37 ||
devyāścāyudhapūjāṃ ca kuryācca caturaśrake | yantramadhyasthite devi caturaśre vidiggate || 38 ||
abhayaṃ varadaṃ padmaṃ pāśaṃ (śaraṃ) saṃpūjayet sudhīḥ | īśānānukrameṇaiva pūjayedāyudhāṃstathā || 39 ||
layāṅgamiti te proktaṃ dhyānaṃ śṛṇu maheśvari | dhyātvā devīṃ mahādevi mantrī syād bhairavopamaḥ || 40 ||
jvālāparvatasaṃsthitāṃ trinayanāṃ pīṭhatrayādhiṣṭhitāṃ jvālāḍambarabhūṣitāṃ suvadanāṃ nityāmadṛśyāṃ (kh: nityāsadaśyāṃ) janaiḥ | ṣaṭcakrāmbujamadhyagāṃ varaśarāmbhojābhayān bibhratīṃ cidrūpāṃ sakalārthadīpanakarīṃ jvālāmukhīṃ naumyaham || 41 ||
udyacchītakarāṃśusaṃnibhamukhīmāpīnatuṅgastanīṃ sadyaḥ phullasarojapāśamamalaṃ vāme kare vibhratīm |
dakṣe'bhītivarau trivarṇavilasadgātrāṅgayaṣṭiṃ parāṃ rudrābjasthatrikoṇamadhyavigatāṃ jvālāmukhīmāśraye || 42 ||
śītāṃśudyutisannibhāṃ śaśikalācūḍāṃ trinetrāṃ śivāṃ dviḥṣaṭkārasarojapīṭhavigatāṃ mādhvīrasāghūrṇitām | tryarṇodbhāsitasarvagātralatikāṃ jvālādikanyākulāṃ (kh: kālīkulāṃ) rajyatpādayugāṃ trilokajananīṃ jvālāmukhīṃ naumyaham || 43 ||
iti dhyānatrayaṃ proktaṃ tantramantraviniścitam | prayogān śṛṇu deveśi śrutvā gopyatamān kuru || 44 ||
stambhanaṃ mohanaṃ caiva māraṇākarṣaṇe tathā | vidveṣaṇaṃ vaśīkāramuccāṭanamataḥ param || 45 ||
mauktikaṃ śāntikaṃ caiva pauṣṭikaṃ paramādbhutam | śṛṇuṣvāvahitā bhūtvā yena jvālā prasīdati || 46 ||
ravāvutthāya muhūrte brāhme vā cārdharātrake | gatvā nadītaṭaṃ kuryādyathā naimittikīṃ kriyām || 47 ||
snānasandhyāvidhiṃ kuryājjapamaṣṭottaraṃ caret | jvālādevyā manuṃ japtvā vrajet pretālayaṃ tataḥ || 48 ||
tata ānīya deveśi bhasmamuṣṭiṃ ca sādhakaḥ | nikhanet kuṇḍamekaṃ tu trikoṇaṃ sādhakottamaḥ || 49 ||
bhasmamuṣṭiṃ ca tatkuṇḍe kṣiptvā homaṃ samācaret | ghṛtena tilatailena pāyasena sureśvari || 50 ||
mūlena cācareddhomaṃ yāvanmādhyāhnikaṃ bhavet | tasyopari pated daṇḍamaiṣikaṃ parameśvari || 51 ||
homaṃ saṃpādya (kh: saṃpādayed devi) deveśi kuryāt karma paraṃ sudhīḥ | ardharātre samutthāya bhasmānīya ca lepayet || 52 ||
aṅgeṣu sādhako dhīmāṃllalāṭe tilakaṃ caret | prabhāte tu vrajenmantrī sabhāmadhye sureśvari || 53 ||
tasya darśanamātreṇa indro jīvaḥ pitāmahaḥ | stambhavāgbhagavān viṣṇurbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 54 ||
maṅgale'hni samutthāya madhyāhne vārdharātrake | ānīya nūtanaṃ kumbhaṃ pūrayet payasā priye || 55 ||
tasminmadhye caret pūjāṃ jvālāmukhyā maheśvari | mantrī dināṣṭakaṃ tāvad gandhārghyakusumaistathā || 56 ||
prāpte'nyamaṅgaladine dadyānmantrī baliṃ śubham | kukkuṭaṃ ca maheśāni tadraktaṃ ca ghaṭe kṣipet || 57 ||
tato mūlena naivedyaṃ dattvā snānaṃ samācaret | tena kumbhasya nīreṇa sādhako mantrasādhakaḥ || 58 ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā mohayed bhuvanatrayam | sarvajñasya mamāpyeṣa kariṣyatyanyathā dhruvam (kh: drutam) || 59 ||
anyadā śanivāre tu gatvā pretālayaṃ śive | saśivāṃ devatāṃ dhyātvā kuryāt snānamanuttamam || 60 ||
tato'ṣṭottaravāraikaśatamāvartya mālayā | yoṣinmūrtiṃ vidhāyaiva tyajedretaḥ prayatnataḥ || 61 ||
retasaścopari kṣaudraṃ kṣiptvā madyaṃ kṣipet sudhīḥ | stanyaṃ saṃkṣipya viśveśi gomūtramupari kṣipet || 62 ||
naramūtraṃ ca saṃkṣipya kharamūtraṃ ca niḥkṣipet | gajamūtraṃ tathā madhye mīnamāṃsaṃ maheśvari || 63 ||
tilatailaṃ ca lavaṇamāraṇālasamanvitam | ghaṭaṃ saṃpūrya vidhivat sādhakaḥ pretamandire || 64 ||
bhūmau kṣiptvā cirennityaṃ japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam | māsamekaṃ samullaṅghya dattvā māhiṣikaṃ balim || 65 ||
tato viracayeddhomaṃ pāyasena ca sarpiṣā | tathā virīphalaṃ hutvā juhuyācca harītakīm || 66 ||
tato māse gate devi sādhako mantrasādhakaḥ | ghaṭaṃ niṣkarṣayedbhūmau praṇamya śirasā punaḥ || 67 ||
japedekasahasraṃ tu mūlamantraṃ yathārthataḥ | ardharātre ripornāma gṛhītvā tu catuṣpathe || 68 ||
kumbhaṃ ca sādhako bhindyāt sadyaḥ śatrurmariṣyati | athākarṣaṇakaṃ vakṣye prabhāte guruvāsare || 69 ||
gatvā rahaḥsthalaṃ devi kuryānnaimittikīṃ kriyām | tataḥ kṣīraṃ samānīya māhiṣyastanyameva ca || 70 ||
ekīkṛtya careddhomaṃ sarpiṣā pāyasena ca | kṛtvā caiva priyābhogaṃ retaḥ kṣīre viniḥkṣipet || 71 ||
homayet puṣpasaṅghātaṃ pītaṃ raktaṃ ca pāṇḍuram | anyedyuratha deveśi śītalaṃ bhasma coddharet || 72 ||
yojayedretasā sākaṃ kṣipenmantrī catuṣpathe | urvaśī svargasaṃsthāpi prātaḥ prādurbhaviṣyati || 73 ||
candravāre samutthāya gatvā pretālayaṃ sudhīḥ | madhyāhne nūtane kumbhe kṣiped bhasmāsthisañcayam || 74 ||
ghaṭamācchādya vastreṇa kṣiped bhūmau ca māntrikaḥ | japed dināṣṭakaṃ yāvad mūlamantramanusmaran || 75 ||
aṣṭame divase prāpte kumbhamākṛṣya (kh: ākṣipya) māntrikaḥ | ardharātre ripordvāri ghaṭaṃ tat sphoṭayecchanaiḥ || 76 ||
pādaprahāradaśabhiḥ śatrorvidveṣaṇaṃ bhavet | budhavāre sunakṣatre pañcagavyaṃ samānayet || 77 ||
liptvā bhūmiṃ trikoṇaṃ tu kuṇḍaṃ likhya mahāmanum | tanmadhye pūrayedyantraṃ homayenmūlajākṣaraiḥ || 78 ||
baliṃ dattvā biḍālaṃ ca sādhako mūlamantrataḥ | japet saptasahasraṃ tu sāṅgaṃ ca vidhivannaraḥ || 79 ||
yasya nāma ca saṅgṛhya striyo vā puruṣasya ca | saptavāraṃ surendro'pi vaśībhavati nānyathā || 80 ||
brahmādyā nirjarāḥ sarve rambhādyā hyapsarogaṇāḥ | vaśamāyānti deveśi mantrasyāsya prasādataḥ || 81 ||
śanivāre kharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vanaṃ gatvā niśīthake | yantraṃ saṃpūjya tasyāgre baliṃ dadyāt svamūlataḥ || 82 ||
japaṃ ca daśasāhasraṃ kṛtvā kuṇḍaṃ khanet pathi | tadraktaṃ homayet sarpiḥ śatrornāma samuccaret || 83 ||
tenaiva sarvaripavaḥ saṃkṣayaṃ yāntyasaṃśayaḥ | śubhe'hni śubhanakṣatre gatvā sindhutaṭe śubhe || 84 ||
mūlenaivācareddhomaṃ śamīpatraistu sādhakaḥ | stanyādikṣīrakhaṇḍādyaiḥ sarpiṣā daddaśāṃśataḥ || 85 ||
homaṃ saṃpādya deveśi dadyāt pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ | tasmācca jāyate puṣṭirdevānāmapi durlabhā || 86 ||
idaṃ paṭalamākhyātaṃ jvālāyā hyuttamaṃ mayā | rahasyaṃ paramaṃ devi sarvasvaṃ sāramuttamam || 87 ||
durlabhaṃ tridive devi na dātavyaṃ hi kasyacit | nindakāya ca duṣṭāya dveṣiṇe bhaktivarjite | gopyaṃ guptatamaṃ bhūmau kalāviṣṭaphalapradam || 88 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre daśavidyārahasye śrījvālāmukhīpaṭalaṃ] || [atha pūjāpaddhatiḥ] |
adhunā devi vakṣyāmi jvālāpaddhatimuttamām | gadyapadyamayīṃ guhyāṃ koṭiyajñaphalapradām || 1 ||
prātaḥ kṛtyamakṛtvā tu śrījvālāṃ pūjayet tu yaḥ | tasya pūjā ca viphalā śaucahīnā yathā kriyā || 2 ||

iti dhyātvā praṇāmamantrān paṭhet |
namāmi sadguruṃ śāntaṃ pratyakṣaṃ śivarūpiṇam | śirasā yogapīṭhasthaṃ muktikāmārthasiddhaye || 2 ||
śrīguruṃ paramānandaṃ vandāmyānandavigraham | yasya sānnidhyamātreṇa cidānandāyate param || 3 ||
ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā | cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 4 ||
akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāpte yena carācaram | tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 5 ||
gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurguruḥ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ | gurureva jagatsarvaṃ tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 6 ||
namaste nātha bhagavañchivāya gururūpiṇe | vidyāvatārasaṃsiddhyai svīkṛtānekavigraha || 7 ||
navāya navarūpāya paramārthaikarūpiṇe | sarvājñānatamobhedabhānave ciddhanāya te || 8 ||
svatantrāya dayākḷptavigrahāya parātmane | paratantrāya bhaktānāṃ bhavyānāṃ bhavyarūpiṇe || 9 ||
prakāśināṃ prakāśāya vivekāya vivekinām | jñānināṃ jñānarūpāya vimarśāya vimarśinām || 10 ||
purastāt pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhe namaskuryāmuparyadhaḥ | sadā saccittarūpeṇa vidhehi bhavadāsanam || 11 ||
iti śrīguruṃ praṇamya suprasannaṃ vibhāvya manasā tadājñāṃ gṛhītvā
mūlādhāre svarṇavarṇacaturdalakamalakarṇikāntargatatrikoṇacakrāntargata parāṃ) parāṃ śaktiṃ kuṇḍalinīmudyaddinakarasahasrabhāsvarāṃ vidyutkoṭisannibhāṃ sakalamantramātaraṃ
