prakāśamānāṃ prathame prayāṇe pratiprayāṇe'pyamṛtāyamānām | antaḥpadavyāmanusañcarantīmānandarūpāmabalāṃ prapadye ||
iti stutvā
nāhamasmi na cānyo'sti dhyeyaṃ cātra na vidyate | ānandapadasaṃlīnaṃ manaḥ samarasīgatam |
ahaṃ devī na cānyo'sti brahmaivāhaṃ na śokabhāk | saccidānandarūpo'haṃ svātmānamiti cintayet ||
iti saṃsmṛtya gurūpadeśapūrvaṃ sūkṣmadhyānenaivānena sveṣṭadevatāsthūladhyānaṃ kuryāt | tattejasā vyāptaṃ svadehaṃ vicintya tattejasaiva pariṇatāṃ svahṛdayakamale svābhedena śrīparadevatāṃ dhyātvā prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuryāt | tadvidhiryathā tatra vihitapadmādyāsano mūlādhārārpitacittavṛttirmūlaṃ praṇavaṃ vā ṣoḍaśavāramuccaran dakṣāṅguṣṭhena dakṣanāsāpuṭaṃ nirudhya vāmena puṭena pavanaṃ pūrayet | tatastameva catuṣṣaṣṭivāramuccaran dakṣānāmākaniṣṭhābhyāṃ vāmaṃ puṭaṃ ca dṛḍhaṃ nirudhya dvābhyāṃ pavanaṃ kumbhayet | tatastameva dvātriṃśadvāramuccaran vāmaṃ puṭaṃ tathaiva nirudhya dakṣiṇena puṭena pavanaṃ śanaiḥ śanai recayedityekaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ | eṣa eva viparyayeṇa kriyamāṇo dvitīyaḥ | prathamavat tṛtīyaḥ | itthaṃ prāṇāyāmatrayeṇa nirastasakalakaluṣaṃ svadehaṃ devatārādhanayogyaṃ vibhāvya svamūlavidyāyā ṛṣyādismaraṇaṃ vidadhīta | yathā(-) asya śrījvālāmukhīmantrarājasya śrīvaiśvānara ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrījvālāmukhī devatā hrīṃ bījaṃ śrīṃ śaktiḥ hūṃ kīlakaṃ caturvargasādhanārthe jape viniyogaḥ iti smṛtvā nyaset | śrīvaiśvānaraṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi anuṣṭupchandase namo mukhe śrījvālāmukhīdevatāyai namo hṛdi hrīṃ bījāya namo guhye śrīṃ śaktaye namaḥ pādayoḥ hūṃ kīlakāya namo nābhau jape viniyogāya namaḥ sarvāṅgeṣu | iti ṛṣyādinyāsaḥ | oṃhrāṃśrāṃ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃhrīṃśrīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā oṃhrūṃśrūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ oṃhraiṃśraiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ huṃ oṃhrauṃśrauṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ oṃhraḥśraḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ phaṭ | evaṃ hṛdayādinyāsaḥ | iti karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ vidhāya svahṛdayakamale svābhedena śrībhairavabhairavyau dhyāyet | yathā(-)
trinetramindvardhakirīṭaratnaṃ kalpāntasūryaprabhaminduhāsam | vṛṣāsanaṃ śūlakapālahastaṃ vande mahādevamahaṃ cidīśam || 1 ||
jvālāparvatasaṃsthitāṃ trinayanāṃ pīṭhatrayādhiṣṭhitāṃ jvālāḍambarabhūṣitāṃ suvadanāṃ nityamadṛśyāṃ janaiḥ | ṣaṭcakrāmbujamadhyagāṃ varaśarāmbhojābhayān bibhratīṃ cidrūpāṃ sakalārthadīpanakarīṃ jvālāmukhīṃ naumyaham || 2 ||
iti dhyātvā mānasopacārairārādhya omiti setuṃ hṛdi daśadhā vinyasya strīmiti mahāsetuṃ viśuddhau sahasrāre ca daśadhā vinyasya oṃaṃmūlaṃ aiṃaṃāmityādi kṣaḥ ityantam | omiti maṇipūrake nirvāṇaṃ daśadhā japet | tato mantrasaṃskāraṃ kuryāt | yathā śrīṃoṃ jvālāmukhi mama sarvaśatrūn bhakṣaya (2) hūṃ phaṭ svāhā hrīṃ iti trirjapet ityutkīlanam | hūṃoṃhrīṃśrīṃ jvālāmukhi mama sarvaśatrūn bhakṣaya (2) svāhā iti triḥsañjīvanam | caṃchaṃjaṃ mūlaṃ jhaṃñaṃ iti trirjapet iti tauṭilyam | oṃhrīṃśrīṃ jvālāmukhi bhairavaśāpaṃ mocaya (2) hūṃ phaṭ svāhā iti śāpaharīṃ daśadhā japet | oṃhrīṃśrīṃ kurukullāyai svāhā iti kurukullāṃ daśadhā japet | oṃhrīṃśrīṃ namo jvālāmukhyastrāya dahadaha duritaṃ hūṃ phaṭ hana (2) kīlān svāhā jvālāmukhīṃ hrīṃ svāhā ityastramantraṃ trirjapet | oṃ mūlaṃ oṃ ityaśaucadvayanivāraṇārthaṃ saptadhā japet | oṃjvālāmukhyai vidmahe hrīṃ jagadbhakṣiṇyai dhīmahi śrīṃ tanno jvāle pracodayāt iti mūlagāyatrīṃ daśadhā japtvā mālāmādāya oṃ māṃ māle mahāmāle sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇi | caturvargastvayi nyastastasmānme siddhidā bhava || oṃhrīṃ siddhyai namaḥ iti manasā gandhādinā tāṃ saṃpūjya oṃgaṃ avighnaṃ kuru māle tvaṃ sarvabhāveṣu sarvadā | iti manasā pūjitāṃ dakṣakareṇa mālāmādāya śirasi śrīguruṃ śuklavarṇaṃ kaṇṭhe svarṇavarṇāṃ mūlavidyāṃ hṛdi śrīparadevīṃ yathoktarūpāṃ dhyāyan yathāśakti japaṃ kṛtvā japānte
tvaṃ māle sarvadevānāṃ prītidā śubhadā bhava | śubhaṃ kuruṣva me bhadre yaśo vīryaṃ ca sarvadā ||
iti paṭhitvā mālāṃ śirasi saṃsthāpya oṃhrāṃhrauṃ mahādevāya namaḥ iti bhairavamantraṃ yathoktavidhinā saṃjapya mūlaṃ sasaṃpuṭaṃ trirjaptvā punarapi
prāṇāyāmādinyāsān vidhāya
guhyātiguhyagoptrī tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japam | siddhirbhavatu me devi tvatprasādānmaheśvari ||
ityanena tejomayaṃ japaṃ śrīdevīvāmahaste samarpya yonimudrayā praṇamet |
prātaḥ prabhṛti sāyāntaṃ sāyādi prātarantataḥ | yatkaromi jagadyone tadastu tava pūjanam ||
iti nijakṛtyaṃ samarpya svakāryānuṣṭhānāya
trailokyacaitanyamayi sureśi śrījvālike tvaccaraṇājñayaiva | prātaḥ samutthāya tava priyārthaṃ saṃsārayātrāmanuvartayiṣye ||
saṃsārayātrāmanuvartamānaṃ jvālāmukhi tvaccaraṇājñayālam | spardhātiraskārakalipramādabhayāni māṃ mābhibhavantu mātaḥ ||
jānāmyadharmaṃ naca me nivṛttirjānāmi dharmaṃ naca me pravṛttiḥ | tvayā hṛṣīkeśi hṛdisthayāhaṃ yathā niyukto'smi tathā karomi ||
iti śrīdevyājñāṃ prārthya mūlādhārādidvādaśāntacakraparyantasthitābhyo mahāgaṇapatiprabhṛtidevatābhyaḥ śrīgurūpadeśajñātaṃ sahajasiddhamajapājapaṃ saṅkalpya samarpayet | yathā adya pūrvedyurahorātrācaritamucchvāsaniḥśvāsātmakaṃ ṣaṭśatādhikamekaviṃśatisahasrasaṃkhyākamajapājapaṃ mūlādhāra svādhiṣṭhānamaṇipūrānāhata viśuddhājñā brahmarandhreṣu caturdala ṣaḍdala daśadala dvādaśadalaṣoḍaśadala dvidala sahasradaleṣu svarṇavidrumanīlapiṅgaladhūmravidyutkarburavarṇeṣu sthitābhyo gaṇapatibrahmaviṣṇurudra jīvātmaparamātmaśrīgurupādukābhyo yathā bhāgaśaḥ samarpayāmi iti smṛtvā kṛtāñjalirnyaset | yathā oṃaiṃhrīṃśrīṃ mūlādhāracakrasthāya śrīgaṇapataye ajapājapānāṃ ṣaṭśatāni samarpayāmi namaḥ | (4/) svādhiṣṭhānacakrasthāya brahmaṇe'japājapānāṃ ṣaṭsahasrāṇi samarpa(0) | (4/) maṇipūracakrasthāya viṣṇave'japājapānāṃ ṣaṭsahasrāṇi samarpayā(0) | (4/) anāhatacakrasthāya rudrāyājapājapānāṃ ṣaṭsahasrāṇi samarpayā(0) | (4/) viśuddhacakrasthāya jīvātmane'japājapānāṃ sahasraṃ samarpayā(0) | (4/) ājñācakrasthāya paramātmane'japājapānāṃ sahasraṃ samarpa(0) | (4/) sahasradalakamalakarṇikāmadhyavartinyai
śrīgurupādukāyai ajapājapānāṃ sahasraṃ samarpayāmi namaḥ | ityajapājapaṃ samarpya ajapāmantreṇa prāṇāyāmaṃ kṛtvā saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | yathā(-)
oṃasya śrīajapāgāyatrīmantrasya haṃsa ṛṣiḥ avyaktagāyatrīchandaḥ śrīparamātmā paramahaṃso devatā haṃ bījaṃ saḥ śaktiḥ so'haṃ kīlakaṃ oṃkārastattvaṃ udāttaḥ svaraḥ nabhaḥ sthānaṃ haimo varṇaḥ mama muktisādhanārthe ajapājape viniyogaḥ | (4/) haṃsaṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi | (4/) avyaktagāyatrīcchandase namo mukhe | (4/) śrīparamahaṃsadevatāyai namo hṛdi | (4/) haṃ bījāya namo guhye | (4/) saḥ śaktaye namaḥ pādayoḥ | (4/) so'haṃ kolakāya namo nābhau | (4/) oṃkāratattvāya namo hṛdaye | (4/) udāttasvarāya namaḥ kaṇṭhe | (4/) nabhase sthānāya namo murdhni | (4/) haimāya varṇāya namaḥ sarvāṅgeṣu iti vinyasya mama mokṣārthe'japājape viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjaliḥ paṭhet | iti ṛṣyādinyāsaḥ | (4/) hsāṃ sūryātmane svāhā aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | (4/) hsīṃ somātmane svāhā tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā | (4/) hsūṃ nirañjanātmane svāhā madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ | (4/) hsaiṃ nirābhāsātmane svāhā anāmikābhyāṃ huṃ | (4/) hsauṃ anantatanuḥ sūkṣmādevī pracodayāt svāhā kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ | (4/) hsaḥ avyaktabodhātmane svāhā karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ phaṭ | evaṃ hṛdayādinyāsaḥ | tato dhyānam(-)
dyāṃ mūrdhānaṃ yasya viprā vadanti khaṃ vai nābhiṃ candrasūryau ca netre | digbhiḥ śrotre yasya pādau kṣitiśca dhyātavyo'sau sarvabhūtāntarātmā ||
iti virāṭsvarūpaṃ svātmānaṃ dhyātvā tadanusandhāyinaṃ prāṇavāyornigamapraveśātmakamajapāmantraṃ pañcaviṃśativāraṃ japtvā samarpya śrīgurūpadiṣṭamārgeṇa nādānusandhānapūrvakaṃ nirastasamastopādhinā kenāpi cidvilāsena pravartamāno'smīti vibhāvya svakāryānuṣṭhānāya
samudramekhale devi parvatastanamaṇḍale | viṣṇupatni namastubhyaṃ pādasparśaṃ kṣamasva me ||

iti hutvā punarhṛdayakamale śrīdevīṃ dhyātvā uttarāpośānādisarvopacārairārādhya mūlaṃ yathāśakti japitvā prāṇāyāmādinā japaṃ samarpya śrīguruṃ praṇamya svadehaṃ gandhādinā saṃbhūṣya manasā yathāśakti japahomādikaṃ ca kṛtvā svaśarīraṃ kāmakalārūpaṃ dhyāyan svadehaṃ pūjāyogyaṃ kṛtvā sāmānyārghyaṃ kuryāt | tatra svadakṣe trikoṇavṛttabimbaṃ cakraṃ vidhāya tatra ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ iti saṃpūjya tadupari tripādikāṃ saṃsthāpya raṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya daśakalātmane namaḥ iti saṃpūjya tatra astrāya phaḍiti kṣālitapātraṃ śaṅkhādikaṃ vā saṃsthāpya (aṃ sūryamaṇḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ iti saṃpūjya śuddhajalena tatpātramāpūrya soṃ somamaṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ iti saṃpūjya) tatra gaṅge ca yamune caiva ityādinā tīrthānyāvāhya gandhākṣatapuṣpāṇi niḥkṣipet | evaṃ sūryasomakalāḥ saṃpūjya dhenumudrāṃ pradarśayediti sāmānyārghyavidhiḥ ||

bhūmau skhalitapādānāṃ bhūmirevāvalambanam | tvayi jātāparādhānāṃ tvameva śaraṇaṃ śive ||
aparādho bhavatyeva sevakasya pade pade |
ko'paraḥ sahate loke kevalaṃ svāminaṃ vinā ||
aparādhasahasrāṇi kriyante'harniśaṃ mayā | samakṣaṃ savidhaṃ sarvamiti mātaḥ kṣamasva me ||
iti praṇāmapūrvaṃ kṣamāpya arghyodakaṃ culukena gṛhītvā oṃ itaḥ pūrvaṃ prāṇabuddhidehadharmādhikārato jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyavasthāsu manasā vācā karmaṇā padbhyāmudareṇa śiśnā yat smṛtaṃ yaduktaṃ yat kṛtaṃ tat sarvaṃ śrīdevyarpaṇamastu svāhā ityanena devyāścaraṇārabindayorgṛhītodakadānenātmānaṃ samarpya kṛtāñjalirbhūtvā
yad dattaṃ bhaktimātreṇa puṣpaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ jalam | niveditaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tad gṛhāṇānukampayā ||
āvāhanaṃ na jānāmi na jānāmi visarjanam | pūjābhāgaṃ na jānāmi tvaṃ gatiḥ parameśvari ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā nāsti vānyā gatirmama | antaścāreṇa bhūtānāṃ rakṣa tvaṃ parameśvari ||
mātaryonisahasreṣu yeṣu yeṣu vrajāmyam | teṣu teṣvacyutā bhaktiracyute'stu sadā tvayi ||
devī dātrī ca bhoktrī ca devī sarvamidaṃ jagat | devī jayati sarvatra yā devī so'hameva hi ||
yadakṣarapadabhraṣṭaṃ mātrāhīnaṃ ca yadgatam | kṣantumarhasi deveśi kasya na skhalitaṃ manaḥ ||
kṣamasva devadeveśi jvālāmukhi maheśvari | tava pādāmbuje nityaṃ niścalā bhaktirastu me ||
iti puṣpaiḥ kṣamāpayitvā yonimudrayā praṇamya śaṅkhamuddhṛtya devyupari bhrāmayitvā
sādhu vāsādhu vā karma yadyadācaritaṃ mayā | tat sarvaṃ kṛpayā devi gṛhāṇārādhanaṃ mama ||
iti devīdakṣahaste śaṅkhajalaṃ kiñcid dattvā śaṅkhaṃ svasthāne saṃsthāpya tajjalaṃ kiñcidvāmahaste nidhāya mūlena saptadhābhimantrya svātmānamanyānapi
sāmayikān tena prokṣya puṣpāñjalimādāya
gaccha gaccha paraṃ sthānaṃ svasthānaṃ parameśvari | yatra brahmādayo devā na viduḥ paramaṃ padam ||
iti visṛjya saṃhāramudrayā śrīcakrāt puṣpamādāya tattejaḥ samuddhṛtyāghrāya pūrakayogena hṛdayakamalaṃ prāpayya tatra yathoktarūpāṃ dhyāyan
tiṣṭha tiṣṭha pare sthāne svasthāne parameśvari | yatra brahmādayaḥ sarve surāstiṣṭhanti me hṛdi ||
iti hṛdayakamale saṃsthāpya caṇḍeśvarāya namaḥ iti nirmālyaṃ saṃpūjya aiśānyāṃ jalena trikoṇaṃ vidhāya tatra nirmālyavāsinyai namaḥ iti naivedyaśatāṃśaṃ sahasrāṃśaṃ vā nirmālyapuṣpasahitaṃ kṣipet tālatrayapūrvaṃ nirmālyavāsinīṃ visarjayet | tataḥ
deva nātha guro svāmin deśika svātmanāyaka | trāhi trāhi kṛpāsindho pūjāṃ pūrṇatarāṃ kuru ||
iti śrīguruṃ praṇamya prārthya śrīpātraṃ samuddhṛtyāmastakāntaṃ śiraḥsthāya śrīgurave samarpya tatpātraṃ dakṣakare nidhāya vāmakareṇa tattvamudrayā śrīpādukāmantreṇa śrīpādukāṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ iti triḥ santarpya tatpātraṃ svasthāne saṃsthāpya tajjalaṃ kiñcit pātrāntare nidhāya oṃ ātmatattvāya namaḥ hrīṃ vidyātattvāya namaḥ śrīṃ śivatattvāya namaḥ mūlaṃ sarvatattvāya namaḥ iti catustattvāni jale vinyasya tajjalaṃ culakenādāya oṃaiṃhrīṃśrīṃ prakṛtibuddhyahaṅkāramanaḥśrotratvak ḷṃ ḹṃ eṃ aiṃ oṃ auṃ aṃ aṃḥ aiṃ mūlaṃ ātmatattvātmakāśuddhacaturviṃśatitattvasahitaṃ sthūladehaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā oṃaiṃhrīṃśrīṃ māyākalāvidyārāgakālaniyatipuruṣātmaka jhaṃ ñaṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ klīṃ mūlaṃ vidyātattvātmakaṃ sūkṣmadehaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā oṃaiṃhrīṃśrīṃ śivaśaktisadāśiveśvaraśuddhavidyādipañcatattvasahitaṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ laṃ kṣaḥ sauḥ mūlaṃ śivatattvātmakaṃ paradehaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā oṃaiṃhrīṃśrīṃ śivādiṣaṭtriṃśattattvasahitaṃ aṃ āṃ ityādi kṣaḥ ityantaṃ aiṃklīṃsauḥ mūlaṃ sarvatattvasthūlasūkṣmaparākhyadeharūpābhimāninaṃ
jīvātmānaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā iti culakacatuṣṭayaṃ svīkṛtya tatpātraṃ karābhyāmādāya mūlaṃ gurupādukāmuccārya
oṃ prakāśākāśahastābhyāmavalambyonmanīsrucam | dharmādharmakalāsnehapūrṇāṃ vahnau juhomyahaṃ svāhā ||
iti tajjalamaśnīyāt | tataḥ karābhyāṃ mūrdhādipādāntaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattattvātmakatāṃ bhāvayan svadehaṃ spṛśet | tataḥ svasāmayikaiḥ saha yathāśāstraṃ gurūpadiṣṭavidhinā pātravandanaṃ kuryāt | tatrādau mūlādhārāt kuṇḍalinīmiṣṭadevatārūpāmutthāpya svajihvāgrāntamānīya pātraṃ vāmahastakṛtatrikhaṇḍopari dakṣahastenācchādya ślokaṃ paṭhet |
adhunā devi vakṣye'haṃ pātravandanamīśvari | tatkālaṃ yadvarānandapātraṃ devaiśca vanditam || 1 ||
pūjāyāṃ pātramānandabharitaṃ parameśvari | guruṇā dattamabhyarcya praṇamecchirasā tadā || 2 ||
śrīmadbhairavaśekharapravilasaccandrāmṛtaplāvitaṃ kṣetrādhīśvarayoginīgaṇamahāsiddhaiḥ samārādhitam | ānandāgamakaṃ mahātmakamidaṃ sākṣāt trikhaṇḍāmṛtaṃ vande śrīprathamaṃ karāmbujagataṃ pātraṃ viśuddhipradam || 3 ||
oṃ ātmatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā |
haimaṃ caiṇarasāvahaṃ (kh: sindhu) dayitayā dattaṃ ca peyādibhiḥ kiñciccañcalaraktapaṅkajadṛśā sānandamālokitam (kh: udvīkṣitam) | vāme svāduviśuddhaśuddhiśakalaṃ pāṇau nidhāya svake vande pātramahaṃ dvitīyamadhunānandaikasaṃvardhanam || 4 ||
oṃ vidyātattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā |
oṃ sarvāmnāyakalākalāpakalitaṃ kautūhaloddyotanaṃ (kh: uddyotitaṃ) candropendramahendraśaṃbhuvaruṇabrahmādibhiḥ sevitam |
dhyātaṃ devagaṇaiḥ paraṃ munigaṇairmokṣārthibhiḥ (kh: varaiḥ) sarvadā vande pātramahaṃ tṛtīyamadhunā svātmāvabodhakṣamam || 5 ||
oṃ śivatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā |
madyaṃ mīnarasāvahaṃ hariharabrahmādibhiḥ sevitaṃ mudrāmaithunadharmakarmanirataṃ kṣārāmlatiktāśritam (kh: śrayam) | ācāryārcitamaṣṭabhairavakalānyāsena (g: ācāryāṣṭakasiddhabhairava) cācchāditaṃ pāyāt pañcamakāratattvanilayaṃ pātraṃ caturthaṃ numaḥ || 6 ||
prakṛtitattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā |
ādhāre bhujagādhirājavalaye pātraṃ mahīmaṇḍalaṃ dravyaṃ (g: madyaṃ) saptasamudravāri piśitaṃ cāṣṭau ca digdantinaḥ | sohaṃ bhairavamarcayan pratidinaṃ tārāgaṇairakṣatairādityapramukhaiḥ surāsuragaṇairājñākaraiḥ kiṅkaraiḥ || 7 ||
puruṣatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā |
sacchatrāmalabhadrapīṭhaparamānandodayādāyakaṃ (g: chatraṃ cāmarabhadra; | kh: dayaṃ dāyakaṃ vājīdantimanoharaṃ) ramyaṃ rājyakaraṃ sadā sukhakaraṃ sāyujyasāmrājyadam | nānāvyādhibhavāndhakāraharaṇaṃ janmāntaradhvaṃsanaṃ śrīmadbhairavabhairavīpriyataraṃ pātraṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ numahḥ || 8 ||
manastattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā |
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptibodhapavanaṃ (g: turyaparataḥ) caitanyasākṣyapradaṃ vidyudbhāskaravahnicandradhanuṣāṃ jyotiṣkalāvyāpitam | vāmāpiṅgalamadhyagā trivalayā tasyāḥ (kh: sat kuṇḍalī cordhvagaṃ) prabodhoddhataṃ pātraṃ saptamamūṣaṇena taruṇānandapradaṃ pātu mām || 9 ||
buddhitattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā |
khaḍgaṃ śrīgurupādukāṃ ca tilakaṃ kaṇṭhe'pi sārasvataṃ śatrorvāgbalaśauryakāryaharaṇaṃ (g: buddhi) dehasthiteḥ kāraṇam | vāñchāsiddhikaraṃ manaḥsthitikaraṃ cāvarjanaṃ (kh: vaśyaṃ jagadyoṣitāṃ) yoṣitāṃ pātraṃ cāṣṭamamaṣṭasiddhikaraṇaṃ prauḍhaprasannaṃ bhaje || 10 ||
ahaṅkāratattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā |
sarvānandakaraṃ sadā śivapadaṃ sarvārthasaṃpatpradaṃ sāmrājyārthakaraṃ samastasukhadaṃ cājñānavidhvaṃsanam | āyuṣkāntiyaśovivardhanakaraṃ saṃsāramohacchidaṃ pātraṃ lakṣaguṇātmakaṃ (kh: lakṣama) ca navamaṃ prauḍhapratāpaṃ bhaje || 11 ||
śaktitattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā |
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ devānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | durlabhaṃ pāvanaṃ pātraṃ daśamaṃ praṇamāmyaham || 12 ||
bhairavatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā |
pāpaghnaṃ śāntiśubhadaṃ divyaṃ svādu sukhāvaham | pātramekādaśaṃ vande gurusevāsukhāgatam || 13 ||
sarvatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā | iti pātravandanaṃ kṛtvā pātrapraśaṃsā kuryāt |
pātraṃ kṛtvā kare mantrī sarvakarma labhetsukhī | iha loke śriyaṃ bhuktvā dehānte bhairavo bhavet || 14 ||
kare pātraṃ mukhe stotramānando hṛdayāmbuje | bhaktirgurupadāmbhoje smaraṇaṃ kimataḥ param || 15 ||
ekena śuṣkacaṇakena ghaṭaṃ pibāmi vāpīṃ pibāmi sahasā lavaṇārdrakeṇa | āsvādya māṃsamalirohitamuṇḍakhaṇḍaṃ gaṅgāṃ pibāmi yamunāṃ saha sāgareṇa || 16 ||
kare mālā mukhe hālā vāme rāmā sukomalā |
tripurā hṛdaye bālā yāgaśālā gṛhe gṛhe || 17 ||
pātraṃ bhairavapātraṃ gotraṃ śrīnāthapādukāgotram | śāstraṃ saṃvicchāstraṃ jñānaṃ tattvāvabodhakaṃ jñānam || 18 ||
alipiśitapurandhrībhogapūjāparo'haṃ bahuvidhakulamārgārambhasaṃbhāvito'ham | paśujanavimukho'haṃ bhairavīmāśrito'haṃ gurucaraṇarato'haṃ bhairavo'haṃ śivo'ham || 19 ||
vāme candramukhī mukhe ca madirā pātraṃ karāmbhoruhe mūrdhni śrīgurucintanaṃ bhagavatīdhyānāspadaṃ mānasam | jihvāyāṃ japasādhanaṃ pariṇatiḥ kaulakramābhyāsane ye santo niyataṃ pibanti sarasaṃ te bhuktimuktī gatāḥ || 20 ||
vāme rāmā ramaṇakuśalā dakṣiṇe cālipātramagre mudrāścaṇakavaṭakāḥ sūkarasyoṣṇaśuddhiḥ | skandhe vīṇā sarasakavitā sadguroḥ satkathāyāṃ kaulo mārgaḥ paramagahano yogināmapyagamyaḥ || 21 ||
pītvā pītvā punaḥ pītvā yāvat patati bhūtale | utthāya ca punaḥ pītvā punarjanma na vidyate || 22 ||
dharmādharmahavirdīpte svātmāgnau manasā srucā | suṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛttīrjuhomyaham || 23 ||
prakāśākāśahastābhyāmavalambyonmanīsrucā | dharmādharmakalāsnehapūrṇāṃ vahnau juhomyaham || 24 ||
yāvanna calate dṛṣṭiryāvanna calate manaḥ | tāvat pānaṃ prakartavyaṃ paśupānamataḥ param || 25 ||
itthaṃ pātrapraśaṃsāṃ kṛtvā tataḥ svasāmayikān yathāśāstraṃ gurūpadiṣṭavidhinā saṃpūjya saṃtarpya pūrvasthāpitabalipātrasthamannādikamekasmin
pātre kṛtvā tadgṛhādutthāya sodakapātrahasto bahirgatvā jalena śucau deśe caturaśravṛttatrikoṇātmakaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tatra gadātriśūlaḍamarupātrahastaṃ trilocanam | kṛṣṇābhaṃ bhairavaṃ devaṃ sarvavighnavināśanam || ityucchiṣṭabhairavaṃ dhyātvā gandhādinā saṃpūjya (4/) ucchiṣṭabhairava ehyehi baliṃ gṛhṇa (2) hūṃ phaṭ svāhā iti pātrasthaṃ balidravyaṃ tatra maṇḍale visṛjya tatpātre hastau pādau ca prakṣālyācamya tatpātraṃ jalenāpūrya pūjāgṛhadvāraṃ gatvā praviśya svāsane samupaviśya tatpātrasthajale śrīpātrajalabinduṃ dattvā tena jalena svātmānamabhiṣiñcan śāntistotraṃ paṭhet | taduktaṃ śrīdevīrahasye (21 pa0) | yathā(-)
devi vakṣyāmi pūjānte śāntistotramanuttamam | vīrā yena parānandapadaṃ prāpsyantyanāmayam (kh: niḥspṛhāḥ) || 1 ||
yoginīcakramadhyasthaṃ mātṛmaṇḍalaveṣṭitam | namāmi śirasā nāthaṃ bhairavaṃ bhairavīpriyam || 2 ||
anādighorasaṃsāravyādhidhvaṃsaikahetave | namaḥ śrīnāthavaidyāya kulauṣadhipradāyine || 3 ||
āpado duritaṃ rogāḥ samayācāralaṅghanāt | te sarve'tra vyapohantu divyacakrasya melanāt || 4 ||
āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ kīrtirlābhaḥ sukhaṃ jayaḥ | kāntirmanorathaścāstu pāntu sarvāśca devatāḥ || 5 ||
saṃpūjakānāṃ paripālakānāṃ yatīndrayogīndratapodhanānām | deśasya rāṣṭrasya kulasya rājñāṃ karotu śāntiṃ bhagavān kuleśaḥ || 6 ||
nandantu sādhakakulānvayadarśakā ye sṛṣṭyādyanākhyacaturuktamahānvayā ye | nandatu sarvakulakaularatāḥ pare ye'pyanye viśeṣapadabhedakaśāmbhavā ye || 7 ||
nandantu siddhaguravaḥ svagurukramaughā jyeṣṭhānugāḥ samayino vaṭukāḥ kumāryaḥ | saḍyoginīpravaravīrakulaprasūtā nandantu bhūmipatigodvijasādhulokāḥ || 8 ||
nandantu nītinipuṇā niravadyaniṣṭhā nirmatsarā nirupamā nirupadravāśca | nityā nirañjanaratā guravo nirīhāḥ śāktāśca śāntamanaso hṛtaśokaśaṅkāḥ || 9 ||
nandantu yoganiratāḥ kulayogayuktā ācāryasāmayikasādhakaputrakāśca | gāvo dvijā yuvatayo yatayaḥ kumāryo dharme bhavantu niratā gurubhaktiyuktāḥ || 10 ||
nandantu sādhakakulā aṇimādiniṣṭhāḥ śāpāḥ patantu samayadviṣi yoginīnām | sā śāmbhavī sphuratu kāpi mamādhyavasthā yasyāṃ guroścaraṇapaṅkajameva labhyam || 11 ||
yāścakrakramabhūmikāvasatayo nāḍīṣu yā saṃsthitā yāḥ kāyadrumaromakūpanilayā yāḥ saṃsthitā dhātuṣu ucchvāsormimaruttaraṅganilayā niḥśvāsavāsāśca yāstā devyo ripupakṣabhakṣaṇaparāstṛpyantu kaulārcitāḥ || 12 ||
yā divyakramapālikāḥ kṣitigatā yā devatāstoyagā yā nityaṃ prathitaprabhāḥ śikhigatā yā mātariśvāśrayāḥ | yā vyomāmṛtamaṇḍalāmṛtamayā yāḥ sarvagāḥ sarvadāstāḥ sarvāḥ kulamārgapālanaparāḥ śāntiṃ prayacchantu me || 13 ||
ūrdhvaṃ brahmāṇḍato vā divi gaganatale bhūtale nistale vā pātāle vā tale vā saṃlilapavanayoryatra kutra sthitā vā | kṣetre pīṭhopapīṭhādiṣu ca kṛtapadā dhūpadīpādikena prītā devyaḥ sadā naḥ śubhabalividhinā pāntu vīrendravandyāḥ || 14 ||
brahmāśeṣeśadurgāguhavaṭukagaṇā (kh: śrīśeṣa) bhairavāḥ kṣetrapālā vetālādityarudragrahavasumanusiddhāpsaroguhyakādyāḥ | bhūtā gandharvavidyādharaṛṣipitṛyakṣāsurāhiprabhūtā yogīśāścāraṇāḥ kiṃpuruṣamunivarāścakragāḥ pāntu sarve || 15 ||
dehasthākhiladevatā gajamukhāḥ kṣetrādhipā bhairavā yoginyo vaṭukāśca yakṣapitaro bhūtāḥ piśācā grahāḥ | anye bhūcaradikcarāśca khacarā vetālakāśceṭakāstṛptāḥ syuḥ kulaputrakasya pibataḥ pānaṃ sadīpaṃ carum || 16 ||
satyaṃ cedguruvākyameva pitaro devāśca cedyoginīprītiścet paradevatā ca yadi cedvedāḥ pramāṇaṃ ca cet | śākteyaṃ yadi darśanaṃ bhavati cedājñeyameṣāsti cet santyatrāpi ca kaulikāśca yadi cet syānme jayaḥ sarvadā || 17 ||
tṛpyantu mātaraḥ sarvāḥ samudrāḥ sagaṇādhipāḥ | yoginyaḥ kṣetrapālāśca mama dehe vyavasthitāḥ || 18 ||
śivādyavaniparyantaṃ brahmādistambasaṃyutam | kālāgnyādiśivāntaṃ ca jagadyajñena tṛpyatu || 19 ||
paṭhitvedaṃ namedvīrān vīravandanamācaret | stuvedvīrānnamedvīrān mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyate || 20 ||
itthaṃ śāntistotraṃ paṭhitvā vīravandanastotraṃ paṭhet |
jagattrayābhyarcitaśāsanebhyaḥ parārthasaṃpādanakovidebhyaḥ |
samuddhṛtakleśamahoragebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ || 1 ||
prahīṇasarvāśrayavāsanebhyaḥ sarvārthatattvoditasādhanebhyaḥ | sarvaprajābhyuddharaṇodyatebhyo namo namaḥ sādhakanāyakebhyaḥ || 2 ||
vidhūtakeśālikapālikebhyaḥ surāsavāraktavilocanebhyaḥ | navīnakāntā ratatatparebhyo namo namaḥ śāmbhaviśāṃbhavebhyaḥ || 3 ||
vibhūtiliptāṅgadigambarebhyaścitāgnidhūmālibhayānakebhyaḥ | kapālapātrāmṛtapānakebhyaḥ namo namo bhairavibhairavebhyaḥ || 4 ||
siddhyaṣṭakādhānamahāmunibhyaḥ śrībhairavācārakṛtādarebhyaḥ | svādhīnatānyakkṛtanirjarebhyo namo namo bhairavibhairavebhyaḥ || 5 ||
anena vīrastavakīrtanena samuddhṛtakleśasuvāsano'ham | saṃsārakāntāramahārṇave'sminnimajjamānaṃ jagaduddhareyam || 6 ||
iti śāntistotraṃ vīravandanaṃ ca paṭhitvā sarvān sāmayikānabhiṣicya viśeṣārghyapātramuddhṛtya śiraḥsthāya śrīgurave samarpya tathaiva tatpādukāṃ triḥ saṃpūjya mūlavidyayā gurupādukāvidyānte ca svāheti svamūlādhārakuṇḍalinyātmakaparadevatāmukhe
havanabuddhyā tajjalaṃ pātrāntare kṛtvāśnīyāt | śeṣaṃ priyaśiṣyāya prasādabuddhyā kiñcid dadyāt | so'pi svapātre kṛtvā tajjalaṃ prāśnīyāditthamarghyapratipattiḥ | tataḥ svagurūpadiṣṭavidhinā śeṣakṛtyaṃ samāpayet | tatastāmrādipātre gandhapuṣpākṣatānvitaṃ jalamāpūrya oṃ namo vivasvate brahman bhāsvate viṣṇutejase | jagatpavitre śucaye savitre karmadāyine || oṃhrāṃhrīṃsaḥ sūrya eṣa te'rghaḥ svāhā ityarghyaṃ sūryāya dattvā kṛtāñjaliḥ oṃ yajñaśchidraṃ tapaḥcchidraṃ yacchidraṃ pūjane mama | acchidramastu tatsarvaṃ bhāskarasya prasādataḥ || ityacchidramavadhārayet | tato mūlena prāṇāyāmarṣyādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsān vidhāya ṣaḍāsana vāgdevatāṣṭakanyāsān vidhāya prāguktagurustotraṃ paṭhitvā śrīguruṃ praṇamya mūlavidyayā dvitīyakūṭena nirmālyaṃ śirasi dhṛtvā mūlavidyayaiva caraṇodakaṃ svīkṛtya śrīparadevatābhaktebhyo naivedyādikaṃ vibhajya suhṛdvāndhavajanaiḥ sākaṃ bhuktvā svātmānaṃ kāmakalārūpaṃ bhāvayan sukhaṃ viharediti ||
ityeṣā nityapūjāyāḥ paddhatirgadyarūpiṇī | jvālāsarvasvarūpāpi na deyā tattvavādibhiḥ ||
śrījvālāpaddhatirguhyā nityārcanakramāṅkitā | guhyātiguhyaguhyāḍhyā gopanīyā mumukṣubhiḥ ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre daśavidyārahasye śrījvālāmukhīpaddhatiḥ] || 2 ||
atha
śrījvālāmukhīkavacam
śrībhairava uvāca |
śṛṇu devi jaganmātarjvālāmukhyā bravīmyaham | kavacaṃ mantragarbhaṃ ca trailokyavijayābhidham ||
aprakāśyaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ na kasya kathitaṃ mayā | vināmunā na siddhiḥ syāt kavacena maheśvari || 2 ||
avaktavyamadātavyaṃ duṣṭāyāsādhakāya ca | nindakāyānyaśiṣyāya na vaktavyaṃ kadācana || 3 ||
śrīdevyuvāca
trailokyanātha vada me bahudhā kathitaṃ mayā | svayaṃ tvayā prasādo'yaṃ kṛtaḥ snehena me prabho || 4 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
prabhāte caiva madhyāhne sāyaṃkāle'rdharātrake | kavacaṃ mantragarbhaṃ ca paṭhanīyaṃ parātparam || 5 ||
madhunā matsyamāṃsādimodakena samarcayet | devatāṃ parayā bhaktyā paṭhet kavacamuttamam || 6 ||
oṃ hrīm me pātu mūrdhānaṃ jvālā dvyakṣaramātṛkā | oṃ hrīṃśrīṃ me'vatādbhālaṃ tryakṣarī viśvamātṛkā || 7 ||
oṃ aiṃklīṃsauṃḥ mamāvyāt sā devī māyā bhruvau mama | oṃ aṃāṃiṃīṃhsauṃḥ pāyānnetre me viśvasundarī || 8 ||
oṃ hrīṃaiṃsauḥ pātu nāsāṃ uṃūṃ karṇau ca mohinī | ṛṃṝṃḷṃḹṃhsauṃḥ me bālā pāyād gaṇḍau ca cakṣuṣī || 9 ||
eṃaiṃoṃauṃ sadāvyānme mukhaṃ śrībhagarūpiṇī | aṃaḥ oṃhrīṃklīṃsauṃḥ pāyād galaṃ me bhagadhāriṇī || 10 ||
kaṃkhaṃgaṃghaṃhsauṃḥ pāyāt skandhau me tripureśvarī | ṅaṃcaṃchaṃjaṃhsauṃḥ vakṣaḥ pāyācca baindaveśvarī || 11 ||
jhaṃñaṃṭaṃṭhaṃḥsauṃḥ aiṃklīṃhūṃ mamāvyāt sā bhujāntaram | ḍaṃḍhaṃṇaṃtaṃ stanau pāyād bhīruṇḍā mama sarvadā || 12 ||
thaṃdaṃdhaṃnaṃ kukṣiṃ pāyānmama hrīṃśrīṃ parā jayā | paṃphaṃbaṃśrīṃhrīṃsauṃḥ pārśvaṃ mṛḍānī pātu me sadā || 13 ||
bhaṃmaṃyaṃraṃśrīṃhsauṃḥlaṃvaṃ nābhiṃ me pāntu kanyakāḥ | śaṃṣaṃsaṃhaṃ sadā pātu guhyaṃ me guhyakeśvarī || 14 ||
laṃkṣaḥ pātu sadā liṅgaṃ hrīṃśrīṃ liṅganivāsinī | aiṃklīṃsauṃḥ pātu me meḍhraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ me pātu vāruṇī || 15 ||
oṃ śrīṃhrīṃklīṃhūṃhūṃ pātu ūrū me pātvamā (kh: pātu māṃ) sadā | oṃ aiṃklīṃsauṃḥyāṃ vātyālī (kh: vārāhī) jaṅghe pāyāt sadā mama || 16 ||
oṃ śrīṃsauṃklīṃ sadā pāyājjānunī kulasundarī | oṃ śrīṃhrīṃhūṃ kūvarī (kh: kulikā) ca gulphau aiṃśrīṃ mamāvatu || 17 ||
oṃ śrīṃhrīṃklīṃiṃsauṃḥ pāyāt kuṇṭhī krīṃhrīṃhsauṃḥ me talam | oṃ prīṃśrīṃ pādau hsauṃḥ pāyād hrīṃśrīṃkrīṃ kutsitā mama || 18 ||
oṃ hrīṃśrīṃ kuṭilā hrīṃkrīṃ pādapṛṣṭhaṃ ca me'vatu | oṃ śrīṃhrīṃśrīṃ ca me pātu pādasthā aṅgulīḥ sadā || 19 ||
oṃ hrīṃhsauṃḥaiṃ kuhūḥ majjāṃ oṃ śrīṃ kuntī (kh: kuntā) mamāvatu | raktaṃ kumbheśvarī aiṃklīṃ śukraṃ pāyācca kūcarī || 20 ||
pātu me'ṅgāni sarvāṇi oṃ hrīṃśrīṃklīṃaiṃhsauṃḥ sadā | pādādimūrdhaparyantaṃ hrīṃkrīṃśrīṃ kāruṇī (kh: klīṃśrīṃ me vāruṇī) sadā || 21 ||
mūrdhādipādaparyantaṃ pātu klīṃśrīṃ kṛtirmama | ūrdhvaṃ me pātu brāṃ brāhmī adhaḥ śrīṃ śāmbhavī mama || 22 ||
duṃ durgā pātu me pūrve vāṃ vārāhī śivālaye | hrīṃkrīṃhūṃśrīṃ ca māṃ pātu uttare kulakāminī || 23 ||
nārasiṃhī hsauṃḥ aiṃklīṃ vāyavye pātu māṃ sadā | oṃ śrīṃkrīṃaiṃ ca kaumārī paścime pātu māṃ sadā || 24 ||
oṃ hrīṃśrīṃ nir(-)ṛtau pātu mātaṅgī māṃ śubhaṅkarī | oṃ śrīṃhrīṃklīṃ sadā pātu dakṣiṇe bhadrakālikā || 25 ||
oṃ śrīṃaiṃklīṃ sadāgneyyāmugratārā sadāvatu | oṃ vāṃ daśadiśo rakṣenmāṃ hrīṃ dakṣiṇakālikā || 26 ||
sarvakālaṃ sadā pātu aiṃsauḥ tripurasundarī | mārībhaye ca durbhikṣe pīḍāyāṃ yoginībhaye || 27 ||
oṃ hrīṃśrīṃ tryakṣarī pātu devī jvālāmukhī mama | itīdaṃ kavacaṃ puṇyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham || 28 ||
trailokyavijayaṃ nāma mantragarbhaṃ maheśvari | asya prasādādīśo'haṃ bhairavāṇāṃ jagattraye || 29 ||
sṛṣṭikartāpahartā ca paṭhanādasya pārvati | kuṅkumena likhedbhūrje āsavena svaretasā || 30 ||
stambhayedakhilān devān mohayedakhilāḥ prajāḥ | mārayedakhilān śatrūn vaśayedapi devatāḥ || 31 ||
bāhau dhṛtvā caredyuddhaṃ śatrūñjitvā gṛhaṃ vrajet | pote raṇe vivāde ca kārāyāṃ rogapīḍane || 32 ||
grahapīḍādikāleṣu paṭhet sarvaṃ śamaṃ vrajet | itīdaṃ kavacaṃ devi mantragarbhaṃ surārcitam || 33 ||
yasya kasya na dātavyaṃ vinā śiṣyāya pārvati | māsaikena bhavet siddhirdevānāṃ yā ca durlabhā | paṭhenmāsatrayaṃ martyo devīdarśanamāpnuyāt || 34 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre daśavidyārahasye śrījvālāmukhīkavacam] || 3 || atha
[śrījvālāmukhīsahasranāmakam] |
śrībhairavyuvāca |
bhagavan sarvadharmajña (kh: śāstrajña) devānāmabhayaṅkara | purā me yat tvayā proktaṃ varaṃ kailāsasānutaḥ || 1 ||
kṛpayā parayā nātha taṃ me dātuṃ kṣamo bhava |
śrībhairava uvāca |
satyametat tvayā proktaṃ varaṃ varaya pārvati || 2 ||
taṃ prayacchāmi saṃsiddhyai manasā yadabhīpsitam |
śrībhairavyuvāca |
jvālāmukhyāstvayā deva sahasrāṇi ca tattvataḥ || 3 ||
proktāni brūhi me bhaktyā yadi me tvatkṛpā bhavet |
śrībhairava uvāca |
pravakṣyāmi mahādevi jvālānāmāni tattvataḥ || 4 ||
sahasrāṇi kalau nṝṇāṃ varadāni yathepsitam | abhaktāya na dātavyaṃ duṣṭāyāsādhakāya ca || 5 ||
yā sā jvālāmukhī devī trailokyajananī smṛtā | tasyā nāmāni vakṣyāmi durlabhāni jagattraye || 6 ||
vinā nityabaliṃ stotraṃ na rakṣyaṃ sādhakottamaiḥ | durbhikṣe śatrubhītau ca māraṇe stambhane paṭhet || 7 ||
sahasrākhyaṃ stavaṃ devyāḥ sadyaḥ siddhirbhaviṣyati | vinā gandhākṣataiḥ puṣpairdhūpairdīpairvinā balim || 8 ||
na rakṣyaṃ sādhakenaiva devīnāmasahasrakam | dattvā baliṃ paṭhed devyā mantrī nāmasahasrakam | devi satyaṃ mayā proktaṃ siddhihānistato'nyathā || 9 ||
asya śrījvālāmukhīsahasranāmastavasya bhairava ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrījvālāmukhī devatā hrīṃ bījaṃ śrīṃ śaktiḥ oṃ kīlakaṃ pāṭhe viniyogaḥ | bhairavaṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi | anuṣṭupchandase namo mukhe | śrījvālāmukhīdevatāyai namo hṛdi | hrīṃ bījāya namo nābhau | śrīṃ śaktaye namo guhye | oṃ kīlakāya namaḥ pādayoḥ | viniyogāya namaḥ sarvāṅgeṣu | oṃhrāmiti ṣaḍdīrghayuktamāyayā karaṣaḍaṅgāni vidhāya dhyāyet(-)
udyaccandramarīcisaṃnibhamukhīmekādaśārābjagāṃ pāśāmbhojavarābhayān karatalaiḥ saṃbibhratīṃ sādarāt (kh: tīmādarāt) | agnīndvarkavilocanāṃ śaśikalācūḍāṃ trivargojjvalāṃ pretasthāṃ jvaladagnimaṇḍalaśikhāṃ jvālāmukhīṃ naumyaham ||
oṃhrīṃjvālāmukhī jaitrī śrīṃjyotsnā jayadā jayā | audumbarā mahānīlā śukraluptā śacī śrutiḥ (kh: stutiḥ) || 1 ||
smayadā smayahartrī ca smaraśatrupriyaṅkarī | mānadā mohinī mattā māyā bālā balandharā || 2 ||
bhagarūpā (kh: mātā) bhagāvāsā bhīruṇḍā bhayaghātinī | bhītirbhayānakāsyā ca bhrūḥ subhrūḥ sukhinī satī || 3 ||
śūlinī śūlahastā ca śūlivāmāṅgavāsinī | śaśāṅkajananī śītā śītalā śārikā śivā (g: śilā) || 4 ||
srucikā madhumanmānyā trivargaphaladāyinī | tretā (g: trilocanā) trilocanā durgā durgamā durgatirgatiḥ || 5 ||
pūtā plutirvimarśā (kh, g: visargā) ca sṛṣṭikartrī sukhāvahā | sukhadā sarvamadhyasthā lokamātā maheśvarī || 6 ||
lokeṣṭā varadā stutyā stutirdrutagatirnutiḥ (kh: drutirgatiḥ) | nayadā nayanetrā ca navagrahaniṣevitā || 7 ||
ambā varūthinī vīrajananī vīrasundarī | vīrasūrvāruṇī vārtā varā'bhayakarā vadhūḥ || 8 ||
vānīratalagā vāmyā vāmācāraphalapradā | vīrā śauryakarī śāntā śārdūlatvak ca śarvarī || 9 ||
śalabhī śāstramaryādā śivadā śambarāntakā | śambarāripriyā śambhukāntā śaśinibhānanā || 10 ||
śastrāyudhadharā śāntirjyotirdīptirjagatpriyā (kh: vīrā; g: dhīrā) | jagatī jitvarā jārī mārjārī paśupālinī (100) || 11 ||
merumadhyagatā maitrī musalāyudhadhāriṇī | mānyā mantreṣṭadā mādhvī mādhvīrasavighūrṇitā || 12 ||
modakāhāramattā ca mattamātaṅgagāminī | maheśvarapriyonnattā dārvī daityavimardinī || 13 ||
deveṣṭā sādhakeṣṭā ca sādhvī sarvatragā'samā | santānakataruśchāyāsantuṣṭā'dhvaśramāpahā || 14 ||
śāradā śaradabjākṣī varadābjanibhānanā (g: ccandrani) | namrāṅgī karkaśāṅgī ca vajrāṅgī vajradhāriṇī || 15 ||
vajreṣṭā vajrakaṅkālā vānarī vāyuveginī | varākī kulakā kāmyā kuleṣṭā kulakāminī || 16 ||
kuntā kāmeśvarī krūrā kulyā kāmāntakāriṇī | kuntī kuntadharā kubjā kaṣṭahā bagalāmukhī || 17 ||
mṛḍānī madhurā mūkā pramattā baindaveśvarī | kumārī kulajā'kāmā kūvarī naḍakūvarī || 18 ||
nageśvarī nagāvāsā nagaputrī nagārihā | nāgakanyā kuhūḥ kuṇṭhī (g: kaṇṭhā) karuṇā kṛpayānvitā || 19 ||
kakāravarṇarūpāḍhyā hrīrlajjā śrīḥ śubhāśubhā | khecarī khagapatnī ca khaganetrā khageśvarī || 20 ||
kātā khanitrī khasthā ca japyā jāpyā'jarā dhrutiḥ (g: śrutiḥ) | jagatī janmadā jambhī jambuvṛkṣatalasthitā || 21 ||
jāmbūnadapriyā satyā sāttvikī sattvavarjitā (kh: saṃsthitā) | sarvamātā samālokā lokākhyātirlayātmikā || 22 ||
lūtā latāratirlajjā vājigā (200) vāruṇī vaśā | kuṭilā kutsitā brāhmī brahmāṇī brahmadāyinī || 23 ||
vrateṣṭā vājinī vastirvāmanetrā vaśaṅkarī | śaṅkarī śaṅkareṣṭā ca śaśāṅkakṛtaśekharā || 24 ||
kumbheśvarī kurughnī ca pāṇḍaveṣṭā parātparā | mahiṣāsurasaṃhartrī mānanīyā manupriyā || 25 ||
dakṣiṇā dakṣajā dakṣā drākṣā dūtī dyutirdharā | dharmadā dharmarājeṣṭā dharmasthā dharmapālinī || 26 ||
dhanadā dhanikā dharmyā patākā pārvatī prajā | prajāvatī purī prajñā pūḥ putrī patrivāhinī || 27 ||
patrihastā ca mātaṅgī patrikā ca pativratā | puṣṭiḥ plakṣā śmaśānasthā devī dhanadasevitā || 28 ||
dayāvatī dayā dūrā dūtā nikaṭavāsinī | narmadā'narmadā nandā nākinī nākasevitā || 29 ||
nāsā saṅkrāntirīḍyā ca bhairavī cchinnamastakā | śyāmā śyāmāmbarā pītā pītavastrā kalāvatī || 30 ||
kautukī kautukācārā kuladharmaprakāśinī | śāmbhavī gāruḍīvidyā garuḍāsanasaṃsthitā || 31 ||
vinatā vainateyeṣṭā vaiṣṇavī viṣṇupūjitā | vārtādā (g: vāntadā) vālukā vetrī vetrahastā varāṅganā || 32 ||
vivekalocanā vijñā viśālā vimalā hyajā | vivekā pracurā luptā naurnārāyaṇapūjitā ( g: sevitā) || 33 ||
nārāyaṇī (300) ca sumukhī durjayā duḥkhahāriṇī | daurbhāgyahā durācārā duṣṭahantrī ca dveṣiṇī || 34 ||
vāṅmayī bhāratī bhāṣā maṣī lekhakapūjitā | lekhapatrī ca lolākṣī lāsyā hāsyā priyaṅkarī || 35 ||
premadā praṇayajñā ca pramāṇā pratyayāṅkitā | vārāhī kubjikā kārā kārābandhanamokṣadā || 36 ||
ugrā cogratarogreṣṭā nṛmānyā narasiṃhikā | naranārāyaṇastutyā naravāhanapūjitā || 37 ||
nṛmuṇḍā nūpurāḍhyā ca nṛmātā tripureśvarī | divyāyudhogratārā ca tryakṣā tripuramālinī || 38 ||
trinetrā koṭarākṣī ca ṣaṭcakrasthā krimīśvarī | krimihā (g: kramikā) krimiyoniśca kalā candrakalā camūḥ || 39 ||
carmāmbarā ca cārvaṅgī cañcalākṣī ca bhadradā | bhadrakālī subhadrā ca bhadrāṅgī pretavāhinī || 40 ||
suṣamā strīpriyā kāntā kāminī kuṭilālakā | kuśabdā kugatirmedhā madhyamāṅkā ca kāśyapī || 41 ||
dakṣiṇākālikā kālī kālabhairavapūjitā | klīṃkārī (kh: krīṃ) kumatirvāṇī bāṇāsuranisūdinī || 42 ||
nirmamā nirmameṣṭā ca nirayonirnirāśrayā | nirvikārā nirīhā ca nilayā nṛpaputriṇī || 43 ||
nṛpasevyā viriñcīṣṭā viśiṣṭā viśvamātṛkā | mātṛkā'rṇaviliptāṅgī madhusnātā madhudravā || 44 ||
śukreṣṭā śukrasantuṣṭā śukrasnātā kṛśodarī | vṛṣā vṛṣṭiranāvṛṣṭirlabhyā lobhavivarjitā || 45 ||
abdhiśca (400) lalanā lakṣyā lakṣmī rāmā ramā ratiḥ | revā rambhorvaśī vaśyā vāsukipriyakāriṇī || 46 ||
śeṣā śeṣaratā śreṣṭhā śeṣaśāyinamaskṛtā | śayyā śarvapriyā śastā praśastā śambhusevitā || 47 ||
āśuśukṣaṇinetrā ca kṣaṇadā kṣaṇasevitā | kṣurikā karṇikā satyā sacarācararūpiṇī || 48 ||
caritrī ca dharitrī ca ditirdaityendrapūjitā | guṇinī guṇarūpā ca triguṇā nirguṇā ghṛṇā || 49 ||
ghoṣā gajānaneṣṭā ca gajākārā guṇipriyā (g: gajapriyā) | gītā gītapriyā tathyā pathyā tripurasundarī || 50 ||
pīnastanī ca ramaṇī ramaṇīṣṭā ca maithunī | padmā padmadharā vatsā dhenurmerudharā maghā || 51 ||
mālatī madhurālāpā mātṛjā mālinī tathā | vaiśvānarapriyā vaidyā cikitsā vaidyapūjitā || 52 ||
vedikā vāraputrī ca vayasyā vāgbhavī prasūḥ | krītā padmāsanā siddhā siddhalakṣmīḥ sarasvatī || 53 ||
sattvaśreṣṭhā sattvasaṃsthā sāmānyā sāmavāyikā | sādhakeṣṭā ca satpatnī satputrī satkulāśrayā || 54 ||
samadā pramadā śrāntā (kh: prāntā) paralokagatiḥ śivā | ghorarūpā ghorarāvā muktakeśī ca muktidā || 55 ||
mokṣadā baladā puṣṭirmuktirbalipriyā'bhayā | tilaprasūnanāsā ca prasūnā kulaśīrṣiṇī || 56 ||
paradrohakarī (g: pura) (500) pānthā pārāvārasutā bhagā | bhagapriyā bhargaśikhā helā haimavatīśvarī || 57 ||
herukeṣṭā vaṭusthā ca vaṭumātā vaṭeśvarī | naṭinī troṭinī trātā svasā sāravatī sabhā || 58 ||
saubhāgyā bhāgyadā bhāgyā bhogadā bhūḥ prabhāvatī | candrikā kālahartrī ca jyotsnolkā'śanirāhnikā || 59 ||
aihikī cauṣmikī coṣmā grīṣmāṃśudyutirūpiṇī | grīvā grīṣmānanā gavyā (g: nāgakanyā) kailāsācalavāsinī || 60 ||
mallī mārtaṇḍarūpā ca mānahartrī manoramā | māninī mānakartrī ca mānasī tāpasī tuṭiḥ || 61 ||
payaḥsthā tu parabrahmastutā stotrapriyā tanuḥ | tanvī tanutarā sūkṣmā sthūlā śūrapriyā'dhamā || 62 ||
uttamā maṇibhūṣāḍhyā maṇimaṇḍapasaṃsthitā | māṣā tīkṣṇā trapā cintā maṇḍikā carcikā calā || 63 ||
caṇḍī cullī camatkārakartrī hartrī harīśvarī | harisevyā kapiśreṣṭhā carcitā cārurūpiṇī || 64 ||
caṇḍīśvarī caṇḍarūpā muṇḍahastā manogatiḥ | potā pūtā pavitrā ca majjā medhyā sugandhinī || 65 ||
sugandhā puṣpiṇī puṣpā preritā pavaneśvarī | prītā krodhākulā nyastā nyakkārā suravāhinī || 66 ||
srtotasvatī madhumatī devamātā sudhāmbarā (600) | matsyā matsyendrapīṭhasthā vīrapānā madāturā || 67 ||
pṛthivī taijasī tṛptirmūlādhārā prabhā pṛthuḥ | nāgapāśadharānantā pāśahastā prabodhinī || 68 ||
prasādanā kaliṅgākhyā madanāśā madhudravā | madhuvīrā madāndhā ca pāvanī vedanā smṛtiḥ || 69 ||
bodhikā bodhinī pūṣā kāśī vārāṇasī gayā | kauśī cojjayinī dhārā kāśmīrī kuṅkumākulā || 70 ||
bhūmiḥ sindhuḥ prabhāsā ca gaṅgā gaurī śubhāśrayā | nānāvidyāmayī vetravatī godāvarī gadā || 71 ||
gadahartrī gajārūḍhā indrāṇī kulakaulinī | kulācārā kurūpā ca surūpā rūpavarjitā || 72 ||
candrabhāgā ca yamunā yāmī yamakṣayaṅkarī | kāmbhojī sarayūścitrā vitastairāvatī jhaṣā || 73 ||
caṣikā pathikā tantrī vīṇā veṇuḥ priyaṃvadā | kuṇḍalinī nirvikalpā (g: nirvikārā) gāyatrī narakāntakā || 74 ||
kṛṣṇā (kh: tṛṣṇā) sarasvatī tāpī (kh: dhārā) payorṇā śatarudrikā | kāverī śatapatrābhā śatabāhuḥ śatahradā || 75 ||
revatī rohiṇī kṣipyā kṣīṇā kṣoṇī kṣamā kṣayā | kṣāntirbhrāntirgururguvī gariṣṭhā gokulā nadī || 76 ||
nādinī kṛṣiṇī kṛṣyā satkuṭī bhūmikā (700) bhramā | bibhrājamānā tīrthyā ca tīrthā tīrthaphalapradā || 77 ||
taruṇī tāmasī (kh: tāpasī) pāśā vipāśā pāśadhāriṇī | paśūpahārasantuṣṭā kukkuṭī haṃsavāhanā || 78 ||
madhurā vipulā'kāṅkṣā vedakāṇḍī vicitriṇī | svapnāvatī sarit sītādhāriṇī matsarī ca mut || 79 ||
śatadrūrbhāratī kadrūranantānantaśākhinī | vedanā vāsavī veśyā pūtanā puṣpahāsinī || 80 ||
triśaktiḥ śaktirūpā cākṣaramātā kṣurī kṣudhā | mandā mandākinī mudrā bhūtā bhūtapatipriyā || 81 ||
bhūteṣṭā pañcabhūtaghnī svakṣā komalahāsinī | vāsinī kuhikā lambhā lambakeśī sukeśinī || 82 ||
ūrdhvakeśī viśālākṣī ghorā puṇyapatipriyā (g: pativratā) |
pāṃsulā pātrahastā ca kharparī kharparāyudhā || 83 ||
kekarī kākinī kumbhī suphalā kekarākṛtiḥ | viphalā vijayā śrīdā śrīdasevyā śubhaṅkarī || 84 ||
śaityā śītālayā śīdhupātrahastā kṛpāvatī | kāruṇyā viśvasārā ca karuṇā kṛpaṇā kṛpā || 85 ||
prajñā jñānā ca ṣaḍvargā ṣaḍāsyā ṣaṇmukhapriyā | krauñcī krauñcādrinilayā (kh: dalanī) dāntā dāridryanāśinī (g: hāriṇī) || 86 ||
śālā cābhāsurā sādhyā sādhanīyā ca sāmagā | saptasvarā saptadharā saptasaptivilocanā || 87 ||
sthitiḥ kṣemaṅkarī svāhā vācālī (800) vividhāmbarā | kalakaṇṭhī ghoṣadharā sugrīvā kandharā ruciḥ || 88 ||
śucismitā samudreṣṭā śaśinī vaśinī sudṛk | sarvajñā sarvadā śārī sunāsā surakanyakā (g: muni) || 89 ||
senā senāsutā śṛṅgī śṛṅgiṇī hāṭakeśvarī | hoṭikā hāriṇī liṅgā bhagaliṅgasvarūpiṇī || 90 ||
bhagamātā ca liṅgākhyā liṅgaprītiḥ (g: prītā) kaliṅgajā | kumārī yuvatī prauḍhā navoḍhā prauḍharūpiṇī || 91 ||
ramyā rajovatī rajjū rajolī rājasī ghaṭī | kaivartī rākṣasī rātrī rātriñcarakṣayaṅkarī || 92 ||
mahogrā muditā bhillī bhallahastā bhayaṅkarī | tilābhā dārikā dvāḥsthā dvārikā madhyadeśagā || 93 ||
citralekhā casumatī sundarāṅgī vasundharā | devatā parvatasthā ca parabhūḥ paramākṛtiḥ || 94 ||
paramūtirmuṇḍamālā nāgayajñopavītinī | śmaśānakālikā śmaśruḥ pralayātmā pralopinī || 95 ||
prasthasthā prasthinī prasthā dhūmrārcirdhūmrarūpiṇī | dhūmrāṅgī dhūmrakeśā ca kapilā kālanāśinī (kh: kali) || 96 ||
kaṅkālī kālarūpā ca kālamātā malimlucī | śarvāṇī rudrapatnī ca raudrī rudrasvarūpiṇī || 97 ||
sandhyā trisandhyā saṃpūjyā sarvaiśvaryapradāyinī | kulajā satyalokeśā satyavāk satyavādinī || 98 ||
satyasvarā (g: sapta) satyamayī haridvārā harinmayī | haridratnamayī rāśi (sāmacatuṣṭam) (900) grahatārātithitanuḥ || 99 ||
tumburustruṭikā troṭī bhuvaneśī bhayāpahā | rājñī rājyapradā yogyā yoginī bhuvaneśvarī || 100 ||
turī tārā mahālakṣmīrbhīḍā bhārgī bhayānakā | kālarātrirmahārātrirmahāvidyā śivālayā || 101 ||
śivāsaṅgā śivasthā ca samādhiragnivāhanā | agnīśvarī mahāvyāptirbalākā (g: sadāvāpti) bālarūpiṇī || 102 ||
vaṭukeśī vilāsā ca sadasatpurabhairavī | vighnahā khalahā gāthā kathā kanthā śubhāmbarā || 103 ||
kratuhā kratujā krāntā mādhavī cāmarāvatī | aruṇākṣī viśālākṣī puṇyaśīlā vilāsinī || 104 ||
sumātā skandamātā ca kṛttikā bharaṇī baliḥ | jineśvarī sukuśalā gopī gopatipūjitā || 105 ||
guptā gopyatarā khyātā prakaṭā gopitātmikā | kulāmnāyavatī kīlā pūrṇā svarṇāṅgadotsukā || 106 ||
utkaṇṭhā kalakaṇṭhī ca raktapā pānapā'malā | saṃpūrṇacandravadanā yaśodā ca yaśasvinī || 107 ||
ānandā sundarī sarvānandā nandātmajā layā | vidyut khadyotarūpā ca sādarā javikā javiḥ || 108 ||
jananī janahartrī ca kharparā khañjanekṣaṇā | jīrṇā jīmūtalakṣyā ca jaṭinī jayavardhinī || 109 ||
jalasthā ca jayantī ca jambhārivaradā tathā | sahasranāmasaṃpūrṇā devī jvālāmukhī smṛtā (1000) || 110 ||
iti nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ tu jvālāmukhyāḥ śivoditam | caturvargapradaṃ nityaṃ bījatrayaprakāśitam || 111 ||
mokṣaikahetumatulaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām | stutyaṃ ca sādhanīyaṃ ca sarvasvaṃ sāramuttamam || 112 ||
mahāmantramayaṃ vidyāmayaṃ vidyāpradaṃ param (g: nṛṇām) | parabrahmasvarūpaṃ ca sākṣādamṛtarūpaṇam || 113 ||
advaitarūpaṇaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ bhairavoditam | yaḥ paṭhet pāṭhayedvāpi śṛṇoti śrāvayedapi || 114 ||
bhaktyā yuto mahādevi sa bhavedbhairavopamaḥ | śivarātryāṃ ca saṃkrāntau grahaṇe janmavāsare || 115 ||
bhairavasya (kh: kukkuṭasya) baliṃ dattvā mūlamantreṇa māntrikaḥ | paṭhennāmasahasraṃ ca jvālāmukhyāḥ sudurlabham || 116 ||
anantaphaladaṃ gopyaṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhet sudhīḥ | aṇimādivibhūtīnāmīśvaro dhārmiko bhavet || 117 ||
ardharātre samutthāya śunyagehe paṭhedidam | nāmnāṃ sahasrakaṃ divyaṃ trivāraṃ sādhakottamaḥ || 118 ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā jvālāmukhyāḥ suto bhavet | madhyāhne pratyahaṃ gatvā pretabhūmiṃ vidhānavit || 119 ||
naramāṃsabaliṃ dattvā phaṭhet sahasranāmakam | divyadehadharo bhūtvā vicaredbhuvanatrayam || 120 ||
śanivāre kuje'ṣṭamyāṃ paṭhennāmasahasrakam | dattvā kṣīrabaliṃ tasyai karasthāḥ sarvasiddhayaḥ || 121 ||
vinā naivedyamātreṇa na rakṣyaṃ sādhakottamaiḥ | kujavāre sadā devi dattvāsavabaliṃ naraḥ || 122 ||
paṭhet sādhaka evāśu labhed darśanamuttamam | śanivāre sadā vidyāṃ japtvā dattvā baliṃ priye || 123 ||
kapotasya maheśāni paṭhennāmasahasrakam | tadgṛhe vardhate lakṣmīrgokarṇamiva nityaśaḥ || 124 ||
śatāvartaṃ caredrātrau sādhako darśanaṃ labhet | vandhyā vā kākavandhyā vā kuṅkumena likhedidam || 125 ||
svastanyena ca śukreṇa bhūrje nāmasahasrakam | gale vā vāmabāhau vā dhārayet pratyahaṃ priye || 126 ||
vandhyāpi labhate putrāñśūrān vidyādharopamān | idaṃ dhṛtvā savyabāhau gatvā raṇadharāṃ prati || 127 ||
nirjitya śatrusaṅghātān sukhī (kh: pratyāyāti sukhī gṛham) yāti svakaṃ gṛham | vāratrayaṃ paṭhennityaṃ śatrunāśāya pārvati || 128 ||
vāradvayaṃ paṭhellakṣmyai muktyai tu śatadhā paṭhet | vaśyārthe daśadhā nityaṃ māraṇārthe ca viṃśatim (kh: rviśadha) || 129 ||
stambhanārthe paṭhennityaṃ saptadhā māntrikottamaḥ | bhūmyarthe triṃśatiṃ devi paṭhennāmasahasrakam || 130 ||
pratyahamekavāraṃ tu mṛto mokṣamavāpnuyāt | aprakāśyamadātavyamavaktavyamabhaktiṣu || 131 ||
aśāktāyākulīnāya kuputrāya durātmane | gurubhaktivihīnāya dīkṣāhīnāya pārvati || 132 ||
dattvā kuṣṭhī bhavelloke paratra narakaṃ vrajet | śraddhāyuktāya bhaktāya sādhakāya mahātmane | sācārāya suśīlāya dattvā mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 113 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre daśavidyārahasye śrījvālāmukhīsahasranāmastotram] || 4 || atha
[śrījvālāmukhīstotram] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
tāraṃ yo bhajate mātarbījaṃ tava sudhākaram | pārāvārasutā nityaṃ niścalā tadgṛhe vaset || 1 ||
śūnyaṃ yo dahanādhirūḍhamamalaṃ vāmākṣisaṃsevitaṃ senduṃ binduyutaṃ bhavāni varade svānte smaret sādhakaḥ | mūkasyāpi surendrasindhujalavadvāgdevatā bhāratī sadyaḥ padyapayīṃ nirargalatarā mātarmukhe tiṣṭhati || 2 ||
śubhaṃ vahnyārūḍhaṃ matiyutamanalpeṣṭaphaladaṃ sabindvīnduṃ mando yadi japati bījaṃ tava priyam (kh: priye) | tadā mātaḥ svaḥstrījanaviharaṇakleśasahitaḥ sukhamindrodyāne svapiti sa bhavatpūjanarataḥ || 3 ||
jvālāmukhīti japate tava nāmavarṇān yaḥ sādhako giriśapatni subhaktipūrvam | tasyāṅghipadmayugalaṃ suranāthaveśyāḥ sīmantaratnakiraṇairanurañjayanti || 4 ||
pāśāmbujābhayadhare mama sarvaśatrūn śabdaṃ tviti smarati yastava mantramadhye | tasyādriputri caraṇau bahupāṃsuyuktau prakṣālayantyarivadhūnayanāśrupātāḥ || 5 ||
bhakṣayadvayamidaṃ yadi bhaktyā sādhako japati cetasi mātaḥ | sa smarāririva tvatprasādatastvatpadaṃ ca labhate divāniśam || 6 ||
kūrcabījamanaghaṃ yadi dhyāyet sādhakastava maheśvari yo'ntaḥ | aṣṭa hastakamaleṣu suvaśyāstasya tryambakasamastasiddhayaḥ || 7 ||
ṭhadvayaṃ tava manūttarasthitaṃ yo japettu paramaprabhāvadam | tasya devi hariśaṅkarādayaḥ pūjayanti caraṇau divaukasaḥ || 8 ||
oṃhrīṃśrīṃ tryakṣare devi surāsuranisūdini | trailokyābhayade mātarjvālāmukhi namo'stu te || 9 ||
uditārkadyute (kh: dine) lakṣmi lakṣmīnāthasamarcite | varāmbujābhayadhare jvālāmukhi namo'stu te || 10 ||
sarvasāramayi śarve (kh: sarve) sarvāmaranamaskṛte | satye sati sadācāre jvālāmukhi namo'stu te || 11 ||
yasyā mūrdhni śaśī vilocanagatā (kh: trilocana) yasyā ravīndvagnayaḥ pāśāmbhojavarābhayāḥ karatalāmbhojeṣu saddhetayaḥ | gātre kuṅkumasannibhā dyutirahiryasyāgale santataṃ devīṃ koṭisahasraraśmisadṛśīṃ jvālāmukhīṃ naumyaham || 12 ||
nidrāṃ no bhajate vidhirbhagavati śaṅkā śivaṃ no tyajed viṣṇurvyākulatāmalaṃ kamalinīkānto'pi dhatte bhayam | dṛṣṭvā devi tvadīyakopadahanajvālāṃ jvalantīṃ tadā devaḥ kuṅkumapītagaṇḍayugalaḥ saṃkrandanaḥ krandati || 13 ||
yāmārādhya divāniśaṃ surasarittīre stavairātmabhūrudyadbhāsvaragharmabhānusadṛśīṃ prāpto'marajyeṣṭhatām | dāridryoragadaṣṭalokatritayīsaṃjīvanīṃ mātaraṃ devīṃ tāṃ hṛdaye śaśāṅkaśakalācūḍāvataṃsāṃ bhaje || 14 ||
āpīnastanaśroṇibhāranamitāṃ kandarpadarpojjvalāṃ lāvaṇyāṅkitaramyagaṇḍayugalāṃ yastvāṃ smaret sādhakaḥ | vaśyāstasya dharābhṛdīśvarasute gīrvāṇavāmabhruvaḥ pādāmbhojatalaṃ bhajanti tridaśā gandharvasiddhādayaḥ || 15 ||
hṛtvā devi śiro vidheryadakarot pātraṃ karāmbhoruhe śūlaprotamamuṃ hariṃ vyagamayat sadbhūṣaṇaṃ skandhayoḥ | kālānte tritayaṃ mukhendukuhare śambhoḥ śiraḥ parvati (k, kh: pārvati) tanmātarbhuvane vicitramakhilaṃ jāne bhavatyāḥ śive || 16 ||
gāyatrī prakṛtirgale'pi vidhṛtā sā tvaṃ śive vedhasā śrīrūpā hariṇāpi vakṣasi dhṛtāpyardhāṅgabhāge tathā | śarveṇāpi bhavāni devi sakalāḥ khyātuṃ na śaktā vayaṃ tvadrūpaṃ hṛdi mādṛśāṃ jaḍadhiyāṃ dhyātuṃ kathaivāsti kā || 17 ||
jvālāmukhīstavamimaṃ paṭhate yadantaḥ śrīmantrarājasahitaṃ vibhavaikahetum | iṣṭapradānasamaye bhuvi kalpavṛkṣaṃ svargaṃ vrajet suravadhūjanasevitaḥ saḥ || 18 ||
iti śrīparamājvālātattvaṃ pañcāṅgamīritam | parārahasyakaṃ śyāmāsarvasvaṃ kulasundari || 19 ||
gopyaṃ guhyatamaṃ sāraṃ śivadaṃ puṇyavardhanam | koṭiyajñaphalaprājyaṃ kulācāraikakāraṇam || 20 ||
stutyaṃ rogāpahaṃ divyaṃ sarvaiśvaryapradāyakam | sarvasvabhūtaṃ deveśi rahasyaṃ mama pārvati || 21 ||
paraśiṣyāya no deyaṃ dattvā hānirbhavenmanoḥ | gurupūjāṃ vidhāyādau guruṃ santoṣya yatnataḥ || 22 ||
gṛhṇīyāt parameśāni jvālāmukhyā yathāvidhi | pañcāṅgamakhilaṃ divyaṃ rahasyaṃ pāradaivatam || 23 ||
sarvasiddhirbhavedāśu devānāmapi durlabhā |
śrīdevyuvāca |
krītāsmi bhavatānena stotreṇāpi maheśvara | sarvathā tava dāsyasmi pañcāṅgaśravaṇena hi || 24 ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ tava bhaktyā mayoditam | pañcāṅgamakhilaṃ devyā gopanīyaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ || 25 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre daśavidyārahasye śrījvālāmukhīstotram] || 5 ||
[samāptaṃ śrījvālāmukhīpañcāṅgam] |
atha
[śrīśārikāpañcāṅgam] ||
śrībhairava uvāca |
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi paṭalaṃ devadurlabham | sarvasiddhikaraṃ divyaṃ sarvaiśvaryapradāyakam || 1 ||
yā devadevī varadā śārikā tripureśvarī | trailokyajananī durgā vidyā saptākṣarī parā || 2 ||
saptavidyeśvarī saiva saptalokāntarāśrayā | saptadvīpamayī pṛthvī śūnyarūpā kuleśvarī || 3 ||
yā devī cetanā loke śilārūpāsti śārikā | sarvepsitapradā nityaṃ pradyumnapīṭhamāśritā || 4 ||
vakṣyāmi paṭalaṃ tasyā mantroddhāraprakāśakam | yantroddhāraṃ layāṅgāḍhyaṃ yathāvadvarṇayāmi te || 5 ||
mantroddhāraṃ mahadgopyaṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ kalau | mantraṃ hitārthaṃ lokānāṃ tatrādau śṛṇu pārvati || 6 ||
tāraṃ parāmātaṭasindhurārṇāḥ khaṃ śarma tanmadhyagataṃ ca nāma | ante'śmarī pārvati śārikāyāstrayodaśārṇo manurasti gopyaḥ || 7 ||
mantrasyāsya mahādevi na vighno nāpi dūṣaṇam | na viparyayabhīrloke siddhasādhyārisaṃśayaḥ || 8 ||
puraścaryāphalaṃ nāpi na kāyakleśasaṃgrahaḥ | sākṣāt siddhiprado mantraḥ sarvavighnāpahārakaḥ || 9 ||
brahmahatyā surāpāna mahāpātakajaṃ malam | prakṣālayati mantro'yamabhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ drutam || 10 ||
mantramutkīlayedādau mantraṃ ( g: mṛtaṃ) sañjīvayettataḥ | siddhaṃ mantraṃ japenmadhye dadyādante ca saṃpuṭam || 11 ||
tataḥ siddhamanuḥ siddho nāsādhyo bhavati dhruvam | asya mantrasya deveśi prasādādbhairavo'smyaham || 12 ||
viṣṇurnārāyaṇo devi brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | na deyaḥ paraśiṣyāya bhaktihīnāya pārvati || 13 ||
anyathā siddhihāniḥ syādubhayoḥ śivaśāpataḥ | mantrasyāsya ṛṣiḥ prokto mahādevo maheśvari || 14 ||
triṣṭup chandaḥ samākhyātaṃ śārikā devatā smṛtā | śarma bījaṃ ramā śaktiḥ sindhuraṃ kīlakaṃ smṛtam || 15 ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe viniyoga itīritaḥ | tāraparāramābījaiḥ ṣaḍdīrghoccārarūpakaiḥ || 16 ||
nyāsaṃ kuryāt ṣaḍaṅgādi yena devīmayo bhavet | dhyānamasyāḥ pravakṣyāmi jagaccaitanyakāraṇam | yena dhyātena deveśi parānandaḥ prajāyate || 17 ||
bālārkakoṭidyutiminducūḍāṃ varāsicakrābhayabāhumādyām | siṃhādhirūḍhāṃ śivavāmadehalīnāṃ bhaje cetasi śārikeśīm || 18 ||
yantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sādhakānāṃ śubhāvaham | sarvārthasādhakaṃ divyaṃ sarvāśāparipūrakam || 19 ||
khatrikoṇa vasukoṇasuvṛttoddyotanāgadalavṛtta(sattri)maṇḍalam | bhūgṛhaṃ śikhiravīndubhāñcitaṃ yantrametaduditaṃ śivā''layam (g: śilā) || 20 ||
śārikāyā mahāyantraṃ trailokyoddhārakārakam | na deyaṃ paraśiṣyebhyo dattvā tu brahmahā bhavet || 21 ||
layāṅgamasya vakṣyāmi brahmaviṣṇusamarcitam | yantrarājasya deveśi caturvargapradāyakam || 22 ||
gaṇeśadharmavaruṇāḥ kuberasahitāḥ śive | pūjyā dūrvākṣataiḥ puṣpaiścaturdvāreṣu sādhakaiḥ || 23 ||
indrādyāścaiva dikpālāstatheśānakrameṇa ca | brāhmī ca vaiṣṇavī devī caṇḍikāpyaparājitā || 24 ||
kaumārī śāmbhavī caiva vārāhī nārasiṃhikā | pūjyā vāmakrameṇaitā mātṛcakrasthamātaraḥ || 25 ||
tatraiva guravo'bhyarcyāstriṣu vṛtteṣu sādhakaiḥ | guruṃ ca paramaṃ devi parāparaguruṃ tathā || 26 ||
parameṣṭhiguruṃ devi nutvā pūjyāśca bhairavāḥ | saṃhāro bhīṣaṇo devi kapālyunmattabhairavau || 27 ||
krodhaścaṇḍo ruruścaivamasitāṅgo maheśvari | ityetān bhairavān devi vasupatreṣu pūjayet || 28 ||
brāhmyādyā mātaro yatra tatra saṃpūjayet sadā | bhairavān dakṣiṇāvṛttyā mātṛcakraṃ tu vāmataḥ || 29 ||
amā kāmā ca cārvaṅgī devī ca ṭaṅkadhāriṇī | tārā ca pārvatī devi saṃpūjyā yakṣiṇī śivā || 30 ||
vāmāvartakrameṇaiva vasukoṇagatāḥ śive | kālikā tripurā durgā pūjyā madhyatrikoṇagāḥ || 31 ||
īśānakramayogena yathābhīṣṭaphalapradāḥ | madhye śrīśārikādevīṃ vāmadevāṅkamadhyagām || 32 ||
makāraiḥ pañcabhiḥ kaulaḥ kaulācāraparāyaṇaḥ | saṃpūjayenmahādevi sādhako mantrasādhakaḥ || 33 ||
varaṃ cakraṃ ca khaḍgaṃ ca pūjayedabhayaṃ tathā | bindau puṣpākṣataiścaiva dhūpadīpāditarpaṇaiḥ || 34 ||
naivedyācamanīyādyaistāmbūlaiśca suvāsitaiḥ | layāṅgamidamākhyātaṃ prayogāñchṛṇu pārvati || 35 ||
stambhanaṃ mohanaṃ caiva māraṇākarṣaṇe tathā | vaśīkāraṃ tathoccāṭaṃ śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ tathā || 36 ||
eteṣāṃ sādhanaṃ vakṣye rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam | yena sādhanamātreṇa sādhako bhairavo bhavet || 37 ||
ravau snātvā śive kūpe kṛtvā karmāhnikaṃ tathā | ardharātre nirāhāro japenmūlaṃ catuṣpathe || 38 ||
ayutaṃ niyamenaiva daśāṃśaṃ homamācaret | ghṛtarāsnāśaṭīkṣaudra kṛkalāsādibhiḥ śive || 39 ||
brahmā hariḥ śivo jiṣṇuḥ stambhavān bhavati dhruvam | candre madhyāhnasamaye vetasīmūlamaṇḍale || 40 ||
trikoṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā śrīcakraṃ pūjayettamaḥ | ayutaṃ prajapenmūlaṃ niyamena sureśvari || 41 ||
hunedājyapeyomatsya karpūrāsavatajjaṭāḥ | śītoddhṛtena deveśi bhasmanā tilakaṃ caret || 42 ||
tasya darśanamātreṇa trailokyaṃ mohameṣyati |
bhaume niśāmukhe gatvā śmaśānamayutaṃ japet || 43 ||
citāyāṃ tatra dīptāgnau hunedājyaṃ sagomayam | śamīmūle narāsthīni śatrunāmnā nikhātayet || 44 ||
api devasamo vāpi śatrurmṛtyumukhaṃ vrajet | budhe gatvā vanaṃ devi vaṭāśvatthatale japet || 45 ||
ayutaṃ mūlamekākī hunet puṣpacayaṃ sitam | sājyaṃ sāsavaraktaṃ ca puṣpāṇi ca maheśvari || 46 ||
menakā pīnavakṣojā prātaḥ prādurbhaviṣyati | gurau gatvā śavāsīno japenmūlaṃ catuṣpathe || 47 ||
ayutaṃ vāyutārdhaṃ vā hunet pāyasamāsavam | svayaṃ cāsavalolākṣaḥ sājyaṃ tāmbūlamiśritam || 48 ||
indrāgniyamamāṃsāda varuṇānilavittadāḥ | seśvarāḥ sahasā tasya vaśameṣyantyasaṃśayam || 49 ||
śukre'rdharātre viṣṭyāṃ vā gatvā pretālayaṃ param | ekākī prajapettatra kṛtvā pānāñjanaṃ śive || 50 ||
ayutaṃ tu citāvahnau hunedājyaṃ sakāñcikam | citāṅgāracaye devi riporuccāṭanaṃ bhavet || 51 ||
śanau madhyāhnasamaye snātvā kṛtvāhnikīṃ kriyām | gatvā devālayaṃ devi devīṃ dhyātvā yathāvidhi || 52 ||
tadagre pūjayedyantraṃ japenmūlamathāyutam | tatra trikoṇakuṇḍe tu hunedājyaṃ samairavam || 53 ||
rurumāsaṃ kuleśāni kukkuṭasya śirastathā | sadyaḥ sarvabhayānāṃ ca śāntirbhavati pārvati || 54 ||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ gatvā pretālayaṃ śive | japedayutamardhaṃ vā hunet pāyasaśarkarām || 55 ||
mṛdvīkāṃ trīṃśca madyādīnmahāpuṣṭiḥ prajāyate | ityeṣa vidhirākhyātaḥ sarvatantreṣu gopitaḥ || 56 ||
nākhyeyo naca deṣṭavyo yoginīcakrapūjakaiḥ | ityeṣa paṭalo guhyaḥ sakalāgamasāravān | rahasyabhūto'yaṃ devi gopanīyo mumukṣubhiḥ || 57 ||
[iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre daśavidyārahasye śrīśārikādevīpaṭalaḥ] || 1 || atha
[śrīśārikāpūjāpaddhatiḥ] |
śrībhairava uvāca |
adhunā paddhatiṃ vakṣye śārikārcanasaṃyutām | gadyapadyamayīṃ gopyāṃ sakalāgamaniścitām || 1 ||
prātaḥ kṛtyamakṛtvā tu yo devīṃ ca samarcayet | tasya pūjā tu viphalā śaucahīnā yathā kriyā || 2 ||
tatrādau brāhmye muhūrte prātaḥkṛtyaṃ vidhāya nadyāṃ snānasandhyādi karma kṛtvā gṛhamāgatya pūjāmaṇḍapadvāradevatāḥ pūjayet | yathā(-) oṃhrīṃ dvāraśriyai namaḥ ūrdhve gaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ dakṣe kṣāṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ vāme vāṃ vāstupuruṣāya namaḥ dehalyāṃ ityabhyarcya vāmapādapuraḥsaramantaḥ praviśya
svāsane upaviśya asya śrī āsanaśodhanamantrasya merupṛṣṭha ṛṣiḥ sutalaṃ chandaḥ kūrmo devatā āsanaśodhane viniyogaḥ | pṛthvi tvayā dhṛtā lokā devi tvaṃ viṣṇunā dhṛtā | tvaṃ ca dhāraya māṃ devi pavitraṃ kuru cāsanam || oṃ hrīṃ ādhāraśaktikamalāsanāya namaḥ ityāsanaṃ saṃpūjya apasarpantu te bhūtā ye bhūtā bhuvi saṃsthitāḥ | ye bhūtā vighnakartāraste naśyantu śivājñayā || pāṣāṇḍakāriṇo bhūtā bhūtā bhūmyantarikṣagāḥ | apasarpantu te sarve te naśyantu śivājñayā || būtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca rākṣasāśca sarīsṛpāḥ | apasarpantu te sarve devyā astreṇa tāḍitāḥ || iti tālatrayeṇa tarjanīmadhyamābhyāmūrdhvordhvaṃ tālatrayadānena vāmapārṣṇighātatrayeṇa ca divyadṛṣṭyā ca trividhavighnānutsārya daśabhiśchoṭikāmirdaśadigbandhanaṃ kṛtvā caturdikṣu vahniprākāraṃ sañcintya prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuryāt | (16) pūrakam (64) kumbhakam (32) recakam ityekaḥ viparyayeṇa dvitīyaḥ prathamavat tṛtīyaḥ | iti prāṇāyāmatrayeṇa nirastasakalakilviṣaṃ svadehaṃ devatārādhanayogyaṃ vibhāvya nyāsaṃ kuryāt | asya śrīśārikābhagavatīmantrasya mahādeva ṛṣiḥ triṣṭup chandaḥ śrīśārikādevī devatā śāṃ bījaṃ śrīṃ śaktiḥ phrāṃ kīlakaṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe pūjane viniyogaḥ iti kṛtāñjalirvadet | mahādevaṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi triṣṭupchandase namo mukhe śrīśārikādevatāyai namo hṛdi śāṃ bījāya namo guhye śrīṃ śaktaye namaḥ pādayo phrāṃ kīlakāya namo nābhau pūjane viniyogāya namaḥ sarvāṅgeṣu | iti ṛṣyādinyāsaḥ | oṃhrāṃśrāṃ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ hrīṃśrīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ oṃhrūṃśrūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ hraiṃśraiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃhrauṃśrauṃ kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃhraḥśraḥ karatalapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | iti karanyāsaḥ | vaṃ ṣaḍaṅgeṣvapi nyaset | iti nyāsairdehaṃ sannahya
mūlādhāre mūlavidyāṃ vidyutkoṭisamaprabhām | sūryakoṭipratīkāśāṃ candrakoṭiprabhāṃ priye | bisatantusvarūpāṃ tāṃ bindutrivalayāṃ priye | ūrdhvaśaktinipātena sahajena varānane || mūlaśaktidṛḍhatvena madhyaśaktiprabodhataḥ | paramānandasandohasānandāṃ cintayet parām | ityantaryajanaṃ kṛtvā mūlādhāre ātmāntarātmaparamātmajñānātmetyātmacatuṣṭayaṃ sacaturaśraṃ kuṇḍalyagnisamujjvalaṃ kuṇḍaṃ dhyātvā tanmukhe mūlānte ahantāṃ
juhomi svāhā ityahantāṃ samarpya asatyaṃ paiśunyaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ lobhaṃ madaṃ mātsaryaṃ juhomi suṣumnāsaktamanaḥsruveṇa pratyekaṃ hutvā athavā dharmādharmahavirdīpte svātmāgnau manasā srucā | suṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛttīrjuhomyaham || iti hutvā punaḥ hṛtkamale yathoktarūpāṃ devīṃ dhyātvā mānasopacārairārādhya yathāśakti japahomādikaṃ ca manasaiva kṛtvā kāmakalārūpaṃ svātmānaṃ vicintya svadehaṃ gandhādinā saṃpūjya kalaśasthāpanaṃ kuryāt |
tatra svadakṣe trikoṇaṃ vṛttamaṇḍalaṃ vidhāya ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ ityabhyarcya tatrādhāraṃ nidhāya tadupari astrāya phaḍiti śodhitaṃ namaḥ iti pūritaṃ pātraṃ śaṅkhaṃ vā saṃsthāpya tatra gaṅge ca yamune caivetyādinā tīrthānyāvāhya oṃmiti gandhādi niḥkṣipya vahnisūryasomakalābhyo namaḥ iti saṃpūjya dhenumudrāṃ pradarśya svamantreṇa saṃpūjayediti sāmānyārghyaṃ vidhāya | tataḥ svavāme ṣaṭkoṇāntargatatrikoṇabindubāhyavṛttacaturaśraṃ vidhāya sāmānyārghyodakena taṃ maṇḍalamabhyukṣya tatra ādhāraśaktibhyo namaḥ iti saṃpūjya ādhāraṃ saṃsthāpya raṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya daśakalātmane namaḥ iti prapūjya phaḍiti kalaśaṃ prakṣālya kāraṇena prapūrya raktavastramālyādinā saṃbhūṣya devībuddhyā saṃsthāpya aṃ arkamaṇḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ iti kalaśaṃ saṃpūjya sauṃ somamaṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ iti dravyaṃ saṃpūjya phaḍiti saṃrakṣya hūmityavaguṇṭhya mūlena saṃvīkṣya nama ityabhyukṣya mūlena gandhamāghrāya kumbhe puṣpaṃ dattvā śāpamocanaṃ kuryāt |
ekameva paraṃ brahma sthūlasūkṣmamayaṃ dhruvam | kacodbhavāṃ brahmahatyāṃ tena te nāśayāmyaham | sūryamaṇḍalasaṃbhūte varuṇālayasaṃbhave | amābījamayi devi śukraśāpādvimucyatām || vedānāṃ praṇavo bījaṃ brahmānandamayo yadi | tena satyena deveśi brahmahatyāṃ vyapohatu || iti triḥ paṭhitvā tato vāṃ vīṃ vūṃ vaiṃ vauṃ vaḥ brahmaśāpamocitāyai surādevyai namaḥ ityapi triruccārya haṃsaḥ śuciṣadityādi adrijā ṛtamityantaṃ triḥ paṭhitvā ānandabhairavamaṣṭādaśabhujaṃ trinayanaṃ pañcamukhaṃ surādevīsahitaṃ dhyātvā (9/) ānandabhairavāya vauṣaṭ sahakṣamalavaraya(-)ūṃ surādevyai vauṣaṭ iti triḥ saṃpūjya dravyamadhye dakṣiṇāvartena tripaṃktyā aṃ (16) kaṃ (16) thaṃ (16)
iti vilikhya tanmadhye haṃsaḥ iti tatsamāveśād dravyamadhye'mṛtaṃ vicintya dhenumudrayāmṛtīkṛtya vamiti sudhābījaṃ mūlamapi cāṣṭadhā paṭhet | tayormadhye trikoṇaṣaṭkoṇavṛttacaturaśraṃ vilikhya caturaśre pūrṇagiripīṭhāya namaḥ uḍḍīyānapīṭhāya namaḥ kāmarūpapīṭhāya namaḥ jālandharapīṭhāya namaḥ iti saṃpūjya ṣaṭkoṇe ṣaḍaṅgaṃ saṃpūjya trikhaṇḍena trikoṇāgradakṣottaraṃ saṃpūjya madhye ādhāraśaktyai namaḥ iti saṃpūjya trikoṇagarbhe yantrikāṃ saṃsthāpya nama iti sāmānyārghyajalenābhyukṣya madhye raṃ vahnimaṇḍalāya daśakalātmane namaḥ iti saṃpūjya phaḍiti pātraṃ prakṣālya yantrikopari saṃsthāpya tatra aṃ arkamaṇḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ iti saṃpūjya trikoṇavṛttaṣaṭkoṇaṃ pātre vilikhya samastavyastamantreṇa saṃpūjya vaṃ mūlaṃ vilomamātṛkāṃ ca paṭhannamṛtena trikoṇaṃ prapūrya tatra gandhādi niḥkṣipya sauṃ somamaṇḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ iti saṃpūjya pūrvavadyantraṃ dravye vilikhya trikoṇatrirekhāyāṃ aṃ (16) kaṃ (16) thaṃ (16) iti vilikhya mūlena trikoṇaṃ triḥ saṃpūjya ṣaḍaṅgena ṣaṭkoṇaṃ saṃpūjya gaṅge ca yamune caiveti tīrthamāvāhya ānandabhairavabhairavyau svasvamantreṇa saṃpūjya pūrvāditaḥ glūṃ gaganaratnebhyo namaḥ pūrve | slūṃ svargaratnebhyo namaḥ dakṣiṇe | mlūṃ martyaratnebhyo namaḥ paścime | plūṃ pātālaratnebhyo namaḥ uttare | nlūṃ nāgaratnebhyo namaḥ madhye | iti saṃpūjya māṃsādi saṃśodhayet | māṃsapātramānīya phaḍastrāya phaḍiti sāmānyārghyedakenābhyukṣya humityavaguṇṭhya vamityamṛtamudrayāmṛtīkṛtya mūlaṃ saptadhoccārya pra tadviṣṇuḥ stavate ityṛcā saṃśodhayet | tryambakaṃ yajāmahe ityṛcā mīnaṃ śodhayet | oṃ viṣṇuryoniṃ kalpayatu tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi piṃśatu | āsiñcatu prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te | garbhaṃ dhehi sinīvāli garbhaṃ dhehi sarasvati | garbhaṃ te aśvinau devā ādhattāṃ puṣkarasrajam || oṃ hsaḥ bhrauṃ juṃsaḥ amṛte amṛtodbhave amṛtavarṣiṇi amṛtaṃ srāvaya (2) svāhā iti kuṇḍagolādikaṃ saṃśodhyāvaguṇṭhyāmṛtīkṛtya tadupari saptadhā mūlaṃ sañjapya tatra devīmāvāhya tālatrayeṇa digbandhanaṃ vidhāya yonimudrāṃ pradarśya hsauṃ namaḥ iti saṃpūjya śaṃkhamudrāṃ pradarśya ṣaḍaṅgena sakalīkṛtya matsyamudrayā pātramācchādya mūlamuccaran pātraṃ devīrūpaṃ vibhāvayet | tato ghaṃṭasamīpe guruśaktibhogasvapātrayoginīvīrabalipādyārghyācamanīyamadhuparkapātrāṇi krameṇa saṃsthāpayet |
tataścarvaṇayutakāraṇena tattvamudrayā śrīpātrād bindūnsamuddhṛtya ānandabhairavaṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ iti triḥ santarpya tataḥ śrīmacchrī amukānandanāthaśrīgurupādukāṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ iti triḥ evaṃ paramaguruparamācāryādīn santarpya śrīpātrāmṛtena mūlena śrīdevīṃ sāyudhāṃ savāhanāṃ saparivārāṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ iti santarpayediti kalaśasthāpanam ||
tataḥ pīṭhapūjāṃ kuryāt | oṃ maṇḍūkāya namaḥ kālāgnirudrāya(0) mūlaprakṛtyai ādhāraśaktyai kamaṭhāya anantāya pṛthivyai sudhārṇavāya ratnadvīpāya kalpavanāya nandanodyānāya maṇimaṇḍapāya maṇivedikāyai ratnasiṃhāsanāya sūryasomavahnimaṇḍalebhyo hsauḥ sadāśivamahāpretāsanāya namaḥ iti pīṭhaṃ saṃpūjya vāyubījena vāmanāsāpuṭena svahṛdayād devīṃ kusumāñjalau saṃyojya deveśi bhaktisulabhe parivārasamanvite | yāvat tvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi tāvad devi ihāvaha || iti paṭhitvā mūlaṃ śrīvāmadevasahite śrīśārikābhagavati ihāgaccha (2) iha saṃtiṣṭha (2) iha saṃnidhehi (2) saṃniruddhā bhava (2) mama sarvopacārasahitāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa (2) ityāvāhanādimudrāḥ pradarśya prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ lelihānamudrayā vidhāya daśadigbandhanaṃ kṛtvā avaguṇṭhya ca dhenuyonī pradarśya varāsicakrābhayamudrāśca pradarśya śrīpātrāmṛtena sāyudhāṃ savāhanāṃ saparivārāṃ sāvaraṇāṃ śrīśārikābhagavatīśrīpādukāṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ iti triḥ santarpya mūlaṃ śrīvāmadevasahitaśārikābhagavatyai pādyaṃ namaḥ evamarghyaṃ svāhā ācamanīyaṃ sudhā madhuparkaṃ sudhā mukhe snānīyaṃ namaḥ pāduke paridhāyātha śārike ratnanirmite | snānamaṇḍapamāyāhi snānārthaṃ śakradiggatam | mūlena snātvā punaḥ śārike paridhāyātha pāduke ratnanirmite | āgaccha nirmitaṃ ramyamalaṅkārasya maṇḍapam || iti susnāpya śuddhadukūlenāṅgaṃ proñchya vicitrapaṭavastrakuṅkumakastūrīcandanasindūramukuṭakuṇḍalahārādi nānālaṅkārān dattvā mūlena madhyamānāmāṅguṣṭhāgrairgandho namaḥ evamaṅguṣṭhatarjanībhyāṃ puṣpāṇi vauṣaṭ oṃ jagaddhvanimantramātaḥ svāhā iti ghaṇṭāṃ saṃpūjya vāmena pāṇinā tāṃ vādayan mūlena dhūpaṃ dadyāt | evaṃ dīpacāmaracchatradhvajādarśanaivedyādīn nivedayet | tatastattvamudrayā devīṃ triḥ santarpya kṛtāñjaliḥ śrīśārikābhagavati āvaraṇaṃ te pūjayāmi namaḥ ityājñāṃ gṛhītvāvaraṇapūjāmārabhet |
tatrādau caturdvārapūjā | oṃhrīṃśrīṃgaṃ gaṇapatiśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namastarpayāmi namaḥ | (3/) dhaṃ dharmaśrī(0) | (3/) vaṃ varuṇaśrī(0) | (3/) kuṃ kuberaśrī(0) | puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā yonimudrayā praṇamediti caturdvāraprathamarekhāyāṃ pūrvādikrameṇa pūjanam |
