mantro manurharaścaiva hanurbālaṃ vidurbudhāḥ | bījānyetāni mantrasya kṛtrimānyaparāṇi tu || 1 ||
harabījau dvau mantraḥ phaṭ ca | prakāśaṃ oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ bhuvaneśvaryai namaḥ iti || tato mātaṅgīmantroddhāraḥ | uktaṃ hi kulasiddhāsantāne(-)
tomā kālī tathā lakṣmīrvāgurādvayameva ca | cārukaṃ rasabījāni hyādau proktāni śambhunā || 1 ||
ante jihvā tathā padmaṃ lajjā nīrajameva ca | vāsanā paṅkajaṃ caiva vanaṃ proktaṃ ca śūlinā || 2 ||
iti | tatra jihvābījanāmāni kālībījoddhārāṇi ca kulacūḍāmaṇau(-)
kālī kuntī rasajñāpi jihvāpi rasanā tathā | krīṃ bījāni ca hyetāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 2 ||
krīṃ iti jihvābījam | atha vāgurābījanāmāni(-)
vāgurā vāyupūjyāpi vātudāsya (kh: vānta; g: vārtu) tribījakam | prīṃ bījāni tu proktāni hyasatyānyaparāṇi tu || 1 ||
prīṃ iti vāgurābījam | atha cārukabījanāmāni muṇḍamālātantre(-)
cārukaṃ caiva cārvaṅgī cārutocchūnabījakam | catuṣṭayaṃ ca cchrīṃ bīje asatyānyaparāṇi ca || 1 ||
cārvaṅgībījau dvau cchrīṃ aiṃ ca || tataḥ padmabījanāmāni uktaṃ ca vāmakeśvare(-)
padmaṃ paṅkajapayoje nīrajamambujaṃ tathā | pañca ṭhakārabījāni hyasatyānyaparāṇi ca || 1 ||
ṭhaḥ iti padmabījam | prakāśam oṃkrīṃśrīṃprīṃprīṃcchrīṃ ucchiṣṭhacaṇḍālini devi mahāpiśācini mātaṅgīdevi krīṃṭhaḥ hrīṃṭhaḥ aiṃṭhaḥ svāhā | iti mātaṅgīmūlam || atha śārikāmantroddhāraḥ uktaṃ svakṛtau tripurāśiromaṇau(-)
tāraṃ māyāṃ śriyaṃ kūrcaṃ sindhuraṃ śūnyameva ca | kalyāṇaṃ śārikādevyā bījaṃ saptākṣaraṃ smṛtam || 1 ||
ante stambhaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ śārikāmantramuttamam |
tatra sindhurabījanāmāni uktaṃ ca vāmakeśvare(-)
sindhuraṃ ca gaṇaṃ (kh: taṭajaṃ) ghoṇāhastinaṃ (kh: hastaṃ) dviradaṃ tathā | phrāṃbījāni ca (kh: hi) catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 1 ||
phrāṃ iti sindhurabījam || tataḥ śūnyabījanāmāni uktaṃ ca bhairavatantre(-)
śūnyaṃ khamambaraṃ vyoma āṃbīje ca catuṣṭayam |
hakāraṃ cāpi vijñeyamuktaṃ tadrudrayāmale (kh: ca) || 1 ||
asatyamaparaṃ jñeyaṃ tārābhaktisamanvite |
āmiti (haṃ ca) śūnyabījam || tataḥ kalyāṇabījanāmāni tatriva(-)
kalyāṇaṃ caiva śarmāpi śaṃ śubhaṃ ca catuṣṭayam | aparamanṛtaṃ jñeyaṃ parvateśvaranandini || 1 ||
śarmabīje dve sauḥ śa ca | prakāśaṃ(-) oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hūṃ phrāṃ āṃ śāṃ śārikāyai namaḥ | iti || tato rājñīmantroddhāraḥ śyāmātantre(-)
tāraṃ lajjā śriyamagniḥ (g: śriyaṃ cāgniḥ) kāmaḥ śaktiḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ | bījaṃ ca ṣaṭśiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavamuddharet || 1 ||
bhagavatyai tathā rājñyai hyante māyā ca ṭhadvayam | ebhiḥ saha manuḥ prokto rājñyāḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥ || 2 ||
iti | tatra agnibījanāmāni śyāmātantre(-)
agnī rephaśca vahniśca hutabhug havyavāhanaḥ | raṃ bījoddhārametaddhi kṛtrimamaparaṃ smṛtam || 1 ||
raṃ ityagnibījam | prakāśam oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ rāṃ klīṃ sauḥ bhagavatyai rājñyai hrīṃ svāhā | iti || atha bhīḍāmantroddhāraḥ kulacūḍāmaṇau(-)
praṇavaṃ ca vibhūtiśca harikāntā tathaiva ca | viyacchaktyagnibījāni saṃyojya vāgbhavaṃ tathā || 1 ||
madanaṃ ca tathā śaṅkābījaṃ saptākṣaraṃ vadet | ṭhadvayena samāyuktaḥ prokto viṃśākṣaro manuḥ || 2 ||
(tāraṃ parā ramā vedī candramanmathaśaktayaḥ | bhīḍābhagavatītyevaṃ haṃsarūpiṇi ṭhadvayam || 3 ||)
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hsrāṃ aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ bhīḍābhagavati haṃsarūpiṇi svāhā | iti || atha jvālāmukhīmantroddhāraḥ śāradātilakaṭīkāyāṃ(-)
tāraṃ lajjāṃ śriyaṃ caivamante kūrcaṃ haraṃ (kh: puraṃ) payaḥ |
bījaṃ ca tryakṣaraṃ (kh: ṣaḍakṣaraṃ devyā jvālāmukhyāḥ sureśvari || 1 ||
(tāraṃ lajjā śriyaṃ caiva jvālāmukhi mameti ca | sarvaśatrūn bhakṣaya dvirante kūrcaṃ haraṃ payaḥ || 2 ||)
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ jvālāmukhi mama sarvaśatrūn bhakṣaya 2 hūṃ phaṭ svāhā | iti ||
daśavidyā mayākhyātā yathāgamaviniścitāḥ | sādhakeṣṭapradā devyo nānāratnavibhūṣitāḥ || 1 ||
etāsāṃ daśavidyānāṃ guṇān vakṣyāmi tvaṃ śṛṇu |
dakṣiṇāmūrtiḥ |
muktiṃ dadāti tripurā lakṣmīṃ lakṣmīrdadāti ca | vidyāṃ dadāti vāgdevī pratyekaṃ janmaniścalām || 2 ||
tārā jñānaṃ tathā mokṣaṃ (kh, g: tārayate sindhuṃ) hyaiśvaryaṃ bhuvaneśvarī | mātaṅgī rākṣasīśatrubhītiṃ harati nityaśaḥ || 3 ||
śārikā śaṃ dadātyeva rājñī rājyaṃ prayacchati | bhīḍādevī dadātyeva santatiṃ viśvavyāpinīm || 4 ||
dhanaṃ jvālāmukhī devī bhaktebhyaḥ saṃprayacchati | daśavidyā yathā etā bhaktebhyaḥ phalamiṣṭadam | prayacchanti mahādevyaḥ pūjāhomajapādibhiḥ || 5 ||
[iti śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtimuniviracite uddhārakośe sarvāgamasāre daśavidyāmantroddhārakośākhyānaṃ prathamaḥ kalpaḥ] || 1 ||
atha
[dvitīyaḥ kalpaḥ] |
śrī(-)īśvaraḥ |
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi tripurāṃ parivāritām | ṣaṭsakhībhirahaṃ tāsāṃ mantroddhāraṃ bravīmi te || 1 ||
akṣobhya uvāca |
guro vidhātṛsaṃbhūta nānāśāstraviśārada | śrotumicchāmyahaṃ mantrān sarvān saṃmuktihetave || 2 ||
dakṣiṇāmūrtiḥ |
śṛṇvakṣobhya mahābhāga sarvaṃ vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ | daśavidyā bhadrakālī turī ca cchinnamastakā || 3 ||
dakṣiṇākālikā śyāmā kālarātrīti sundara | ṣaṭsakhīnāmahaṃ tāsāṃ mantroddhāraṃ bravīmi te || 4 ||
tatrādau bhadrakālīmantroddhāraḥ | śyāmātantre(-)
kālītrayaṃ kūrcayugaṃ lajjāyugmaṃ ca bhadrikā | bhadrakālipadaṃ brūyād bījāni pratilomataḥ || 1 ||
ṭhadvayena samāyukto bhadrakālyā (kh: kālīmahā) mahāmanuḥ |
tatra bhadrikābījanāmāni muṇḍamālātantre(-)
bhadrikā bhāsvatī bhīmā bhaiṃbīje tritayaṃ smṛtam | anṛtamaparaṃ jñeyaṃ brahmānvayasamudbhava || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) krīṃ (3) hūṃ (2) hrīṃ (2) bhaiṃ bhadrakāli bhaiṃ hrīṃ (2) hūṃ (2) krīṃ (3) svāhā | iti ||
atha turīmantroddhāraḥ | svatantre(-)
praṇavaṃ tārakā jyotistārā hyante nama iti | turyā mūlamidaṃ (kh: turīmūlaṃ) proktaṃ svatantre śambhunā svayam || 1 ||
atha tārakājyotistārābījoddhārāṇi kāmeśvare tantre(-)
ṛṃkṣaṃ bhaṃ tārakā jyotistārā bījāni pañca ca |
oṃ (g: truṃtrāṃtroṃ) truṃ trauṃ troṃ mahāturyai namaḥ | iti prakāśam || atha cchinnamastāmantroddhāraḥ | chinnāśiromaṇau(-)
tryambakaḥ (kh: tryambikā) sakalā padmā cārukaṃ ca sureśvari | ante ucchūnabījaṃ phaṭ ṭhadvayena samāyutam || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ cchrīṃ chinnamastake cchrīṃ phaṭ svāhā | iti || dvitīyo bhedaḥ āgamalaharyām(-)
lakṣmīṃ lajjāṃ tathā māyāṃ mātrāṃ dvādaśikāmatha | vajravairocanīye dve māye phaṭsvāhayā yute || 1 ||
prakāśam śrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ vajravairocanīye hrīṃ hrīṃ phaṭ svāhā | iti || atha dakṣiṇākālīmantroddhāraḥ śyāmārahasye(-)
kuntītrayaṃ tīrayugmaṃ kṣāmāyugmaṃ tato'bhidhām | dakṣiṇe kāliketyevamante kālītrayaṃ punaḥ || 1 ||
kūrcayugmaṃ parāyugmaṃ payaścaiva sureśvari | dakṣiṇāyāḥ kālikāyā manurdvāviṃśadakṣaraḥ || 2 ||
prakāśam(-) krīṃ (3) hūṃ (2) hrīṃ (2) dakṣiṇe kālike krīṃ (kh: tryambikā) (3) hūṃ (2) hrīṃ (2) svāhā | iti || atha śyāmāmantroddhāraḥ | tatra śyāmātantre(-)
hariṇākṣī tathā lajjā kālī jihvācatuṣṭayam | tataḥ sudhārase śyāme kṛṣṇaśāpaṃ vimocaya || 1 ||
amṛtaṃ srāvaya svāhā śyāmāmantramudāhṛtam |
prakāśam(-) śrīṃ hrīṃ krīṃ krīṃ krīṃ krīṃ krīṃ sudhārase śyāme kṛṣṇaśāpaṃ vimocaya amṛtaṃ srāvaya svāhā | iti || atha kālarātrīmantroddhāraḥ | uktaṃ ca
kālarātrīkalpe(-)
praṇavaṃ vāsanā māyā manmathaḥ kamalodbhavam (kh: kamalā tathā) | bījaṃ pañcaśiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavamuddharet || 1 ||
tato madhye'bhidhāṃ tyaktvā hyante sarvaṃ vaśaṃ kuru | nīro (kh: vīryaṃ) dehi yugaṃ madhye tyaktvābhidhāṃ ca kāmini || 2 ||
gaṇeśvaryai tathā cānte viśvaṃ ca samudāhṛtam |
prakāśam(-) oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ śrīṃ kāhneśvari sarvajanamanohari sarvamukhastambhini sarvarājavaśaṅkari sarvaduṣṭanirdalini sarvastrīpuruṣakarṣiṇi bandīśṛṅkhalāṃstroṭaya (2) sarvaśatrūn bhañjaya (2) dveṣyān nirdalaya (2) sarvāṃstambhaya (2) mohanāstreṇa dveṣiṇamuccāṭaya (2) sarvaṃ vaśaṃ kuru svāhā dehi (2) sarvakālarātri kāmini gaṇeśvaryai namaḥ | atha bhedāḥ(-)
deveśi tripurābālaṃ vijñeyaṃ dvādaśātmakam || 3 ||
uktaṃ ca muṇḍamālātantre(-)
dvādaśātmakaṃ vijñeyaṃ devi tattripurāhanum | kevalaṃ muktaye devi yatproktaṃ tacchubhaṃ smṛtam || 1 ||
uḍḍāmare(-)
aṣṭātmikā ca vijñeyā vidyā śrīṣoḍaśākṣarī | paraṃ yat sūcitaṃ devi sadyo muktipradaṃ smṛtam || 1 ||
tathā svakṛtau tripurāśiromaṇau(-)
aṣṭātmakamidaṃ bījaṃ tripurāyāḥ smṛtaṃ tathā | aṣṭabhirvatsarairvāpi māsairaṣṭabhireva ca || 1 ||
aṣṭabhirdivasairvāpi jānīyānmuktilakṣaṇam | lakṣmībhedadvayaṃ jñeyaṃ bhāṣitaṃ kṛttivāsasā || 2 ||
lakṣmī ca rukmiṇī caiva tribhirvarṣaiḥ phalaṃ labhet |
atha sarasvatībhedāḥ kāminīkalpe(-)
vāgdevī ca tathā vāṇī sarasvatyanalapriyā | bhedāstvete tu (g: ca) vikhyātāḥ phalaṃ varṣacatuṣṭaye || 1 ||
tatastārābhedāḥ bhairavatantre(-)
tārāpi tāriṇī caivamekajaṭā tathaiva ca | nīlasarasvatī caivamugratārā prakīrtitā || 1 ||
tārābhedāstu pañcaivamakṣobhyeṇa prakāśitāḥ |
atha bhuvaneśvarībhedāḥ bhairavatantre(-)
bhairavī bhīmarūpā ca bhīmāpi bhuvaneśvarī | bhaktyā phalapradā devī nityaṃ varṣacatuṣṭaye || 1 ||
atha mātaṅgībhedāḥ rudrayāmale(-)
mātaṅgīsumukhyoraikyaṃ mataṅgamuninā smṛtam | mātaṅgī (g: taṅga) cakriṇī devī kubjikā śāmbarī tathā || 1 ||
devyā bhedāni catvāri phalaṃ varṣacatuṣṭaye |
atha śārikābhedadvayam(-)
śārikāpi tathā'parṇā phaladāpi dvivarṣike |
atha rājñībhedāḥ(-)
rājñībhedadvayaṃ proktaṃ rājñī ca khagagāminī | dvivarṣamadhye bhaktyā ca rājñī rājyaṃ prayacchati || 1 ||
kulikārṇave(-)
bhīḍā bhedavihīnā ca prajābhāgyavivardhinī |
atha jvālāmukhyāḥ jvālāśiromaṇau(-)
tato (k: tārā) jvālāmukhī caivamambikā bhagarūpiṇī | yatheṣṭaphaladaṃ proktaṃ jvālābhedatrayamidam || 1 ||
etāsāṃ daśavidyānāṃ nānābhedamudāhṛtam |
tatrādau tripurābhedāḥ tripurātilake muṇḍamālātantre ca(-)
tripurā bhairavīvidyā hiṅgulā caṇḍikā tathā | cāmuṇḍā nārasiṃhī ca hyaindrī haimavatīśvarī || 1 ||
mṛḍānī vāruṇī durgā mahātripurasundarī | devyā dvādaśabhedāstu proktā hyete triśūlinā || 2 ||
śrīṃ hrīṃ sauḥ tripure'pi candravasane (kh: vasasane) kāmaḥ śaradbhairavi oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hiṅgule tathaiva kamalā kṣāmaḥ tryakṣaṃ caṇḍike | cāmuṇḍe hasakalahrīṃ ca sakalahrīṃ śrīnārasiṃhi tathā hyaindri cāraṇameva hrīṃ ca madanaḥ kāmaṃ parā rukmiṇī || 3 ||
devī haimavatīśvaryapi kamalā lajjā tathā manmathaścandro vāruṇi vā kaeīlaparā durge smṛtā śambhunā | śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ cāraṇaṃ śaradapi tathā tryakṣaṃ parā rukmiṇī vidyāśrīrviparītabhāvasahitā syāt ṣoḍaśātmāvidhiḥ || 4 ||
iti ṣoḍaśākṣarībhedāḥ || prakāśam śrīṃ hrīṃ sauḥ tripure || aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ bhairavi || oṃ hrīṃ sauḥ hiṅgule || śrīṃ hrīṃ oṃ caṇḍike || hasakalahrīṃ cāmuṇḍe || sakalahrīṃ śrī nārasiṃhi || oṃ hrīṃ klīṃ aindri || klīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ devi haimavatīśvari || śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ mṛḍāni || aiṃ vāruṇi || kaeīlahrīṃ durge || śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ aiṃ sauḥ oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kaeīlahrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ sakalahrīṃ sauḥ aiṃ klīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ mahātripurasundari | iti ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
maheśvara trikālajña śaraṇāgatavatsala | bhedairyutānāṃ devīnāṃ mantraṃ (g: manuṃ) tvaṃ vaktumarhasi || 1 ||
īśvara uvāca |
dayayā tava deveśi tadvakṣyāmi samāsataḥ |
atha śriyā mantroddhāraḥ yaduktaṃ bhairavatantre(-)
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hariṇākṣībījadvayaṃ phalapradaṃ sadyaḥ |
tryakṣaṃ hrīṃ śaktinīramante proktamathāpi dhūrjaṭinā || 1 ||
atha rukmiṇyā mantroddhāraḥ(-)
oṃ hrīṃ caivaṃ tu rukmiṇyāstāraṃ lakṣmīrapastathā | ante proktaṃ maheśāni lakṣmībhedaṃ dvayaṃ tvidam || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ lakṣmi oṃ hrīṃ saḥ svāhā | oṃ hrīṃ rukmiṇi oṃ śrīṃ svāhā || atha sarasvatībhedāḥ(-)
tomā parā vāgbhavameva kṣāmā tāraṃ ca proktaṃ parameśvareṇa | vāgdevatāyāḥ phaladaṃ hi bālaṃ nṛṇāṃ paro muktiparāyaṇānām (g: namo bhakti) || 4 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃhrīṃaiṃhrīṃoṃ vāgdevatāyai namaḥ || atha vāṇībhagavatyā mantraḥ(-)
tāraṃ lajjordhvabījaṃ ca hyante stambhamudāhṛtam |
prakāśam(-) oṃhrīṃaiṃ vāṇībhagavatyai namaḥ || atha sarasvatīmantraḥ(-)
cārvaṅgyapi vibhūtiśca tryakṣaṃ sarasvatyai tataḥ | namo'nte parameśāni mayā proktaṃ nagātmaje || 5 ||
prakāśam(-) aiṃ hrīṃ oṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ || athānalapriyāmantraḥ(-)
tāraṃ lajjā vāgbhavaṃ ca madhye'nalapriye tataḥ | tryakṣaṃ viśvaṃ tathānte ca parvateśvaranandini || 6 ||
devyāścatvāri bhedāni sarasvatyā varānane |
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ aiṃ analapriye oṃ namaḥ ||
atha tārābhedāḥ prakāśam(-) oṃ aiṃ hūṃ hrīṃ aiṃ hūṃ tāre phaṭ svāhā | oṃ hrīṃ aiṃ hūṃ ugratāre (g: tāriṇi) phaṭ svāhā | oṃstrīṃaiṃhūṃ ekajaṭe phaṭ svāhā | oṃhrīṃaiṃhūṃ nīlasarasvati phaṭ svāhā | oṃhrāṃstrīṃhrīṃaiṃhūṃ ugratāre phaṭ svāhā | iti tārābhedāḥ ||
atha bhuvaneśvaryā bhedāḥ oṃ bhairavyai namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ bhīmarūpāyai namaḥ | oṃhrīṃśrīṃ bhīmāyai namaḥ | oṃhrīṃśrīṃklīṃ bhuvaneśvaryai namaḥ | iti ||
atha mātaṅgībhedāḥ prakāśam(-) oṃkrīṃśrīṃprīṃprīṃcchrīṃ ucchiṣṭacaṇḍālini devi mahāpiśācini mātaṅgi devi krīṃṭhaḥ hrīṃṭhaḥ aiṃṭhaḥ svāhā || dvāviṃśākṣaro mantraḥ sumukhyāḥ svāhānto vā | oṃ ucchiṣṭacaṇḍālini sumukhi
devi mahāpiśācini hrīṃṭhaḥṭhaḥ (22) || atha cakriṇyāḥ(-) oṃkrīṃcchrīṃ mahācakriṇi aiṃṭhaḥ svāhā || atha kubjikāyāḥ(-) oṃśrīṃprīṃ kubjike devi hrīṃṭhaḥ svāhā || atha śāmbaryāḥ(-) oṃprīṃ devi śāmbari krīṃṭhaḥ svāhā ||
atha śārikābhedadvayam(-) tatrā'parṇāmūlam oṃhūṃcchrīṃ āṃśāṃ devyai aparṇāyai namaḥ || (atha haimavatīśvarīmūlam oṃhrīṃśrīṃhaimavatīśvari hrīṃ svāhā) || bhīḍā bhedavihīnā ityalam ||
jvālāmukhībhedāḥ tatrāmbikāmūlam(-) oṃhrīṃ mātarambike hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || atha bhagarūpiṇyāḥ(-) oṃśrīṃ devi bhagarūpiṇi hūṃ phaṭ svāhā ||
etāni bhedamantrāṇi (g: rūpāṇi) mayā proktāni pārvati | etāsāṃ daśavidyānāmanyāsāṃ śṛṇu vacmyaham || 7 ||
bhadrakālī yathā devī dakṣiṇā kālikā tathā | turī bhedavihīnāsti yatheṣṭaphaladāyinī || 8 ||
prakāśam(-) krīṃ (3) hūṃ (2) hrīṃ (2) bhaiṃ bhadrakāli bhaiṃ hrīṃ (2) hūṃ (2) krīṃ (3) svāhā ||
krīṃ (3) hūṃ (2) hrīṃ (2) dakṣiṇe kālike krīṃ (3) hūṃ (2) hrīṃ (2) svāhā (22) ||
atha cchinnamastā dvividhā oṃhrīṃśrīṃchrīṃchrīṃ chinnamastake chrīṃ phaṭ svāhā |
dvitīyā(-) oṃhrīṃśrīṃaiṃ vajravairocani hrīṃhrīṃ phaṭ svāhā ||
dakṣiṇā kālikā śyāmā kālarātrī sureśvari | etā bhedavihīnāśca yathākāmaphalapradāḥ || 9 ||
[iti śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtimuniviracite uddhārakośe sarvāgamasāre ṣaḍdevīmantroddhārakośabhedasūcako dvitīyaḥ kalpaḥ] || 2 ||
atha
[tṛtīyaḥ kalpaḥ] |
īśvara uvāca |
atho devi pravakṣyāmi devīnāṃ mantramuttamam | śṛṇuṣvaikāgramanasā bravīmi tvatkutūhalāt || 1 ||
dakṣiṇāmūrtinā tasmin kāle'ntevāsine tathā | bhāṣitā ṣoḍaśīvidyā nanandākṣobhyako muniḥ || 2 ||
tasmin kāle munestasya cāśramaṃ munisevitam | āyayurmunayaḥ sarve sotsukā mantrakāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 3 ||
lohitoddālakau śaṅkhamātaṅgau puṇḍarīkajau | śāṇḍilyagālavau caivamete tasyāśramaṃ yayuḥ || 4 ||
sarve militvā munipuṅgavaṃ te śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtimidaṃ tamūcuḥ | parasparaṃ vai svakuleṣṭadevīmantrāṃśca vandyān śubhadān papracchuḥ || 5 ||
śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtiruvāca |
śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve vakṣyāmyāścaryamuttamam | carācare'smiñjagati devī tripurasundarī || 6 ||
naiva tādṛk kvacidasti devīsīmantaśekharā | tasyāśca vadanāmbhojāt sapta devyaḥ śrutā mayā || 7 ||
yatheṣṭaphaladāyinyaḥ sarvarogabhayāpahāḥ |
acireṇaiva kālena phaladāstanmukhācśrutāḥ || 8 ||
ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ |
kā devyaḥ kāni nāmāni kīdṛśāni manūni hi | prasādaṃ kuru viprarṣe cedasmāsu dayā tava || 9 ||
muniruvāca |
devīnāṃ parayā prītyā mantrān śṛṇudhvamagrataḥ | yena śravaṇamātreṇa hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 10 ||
īśvara uvāca |
munīśvarān punardevo (kh: manūn) dakṣiṇāmūrtirabravīt (g: 'bhyadhāt) | sapta vidyāḥ purā proktā vajrayoginyādidevatāḥ || 11 ||
tāsāṃ vakṣyāmi nāmāni parvateśvaranandini | dakṣiṇāmūrtinā teṣāṃ prakāśitāni tattvataḥ || 12 ||
śrīvajrayoginī devī vārāhī śāradā tathā | kāmeśvarī tathā gaurī hyannapūrṇā tathaiva ca || 13 ||
kulavāgīśvarī hyetāḥ sapta devyaḥ śrutā mayā | dakṣiṇāmūrtinā teṣāṃ sapta vidyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 14 ||
etāsāṃ balamāśritya devī tripurasundarī | sasṛje jagadetacca pālyate ca sureśvari || 15 ||
haste'pi tathā (g: punaḥ) viśvaṃ carācarasamanvitam |
ṛṣiruvāca |
etadvākyāmṛtaṃ tasyā mukhāmbhojācchrutaṃ mayā | tāsāṃ vakṣyāmi mantrāṇi śṛṇudhvaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ || 16 ||
atha mantroddhārāḥ tatrādau vajrayoginīmantroddhāraḥ uktaṃ ca svatantre(-)
praṇavaṃ sakalā caiva bījau dvau phaladāyakau |
madhye'pi vajrayoginyai hyante nīramudāhṛtam || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ vajrayoginyai svāhā ||
asyā mantraṃ samuccārya yaḥ saṃgrāmaṃ praviśati | sa nirjitya ripūn sarvān kalyāṇī gṛhamāviśet || 17 ||
asyā bījadvayaṃ devi japate yadi mānavaḥ | dvādaśadivasaṃ tāvatsiddhirbhavati vāñchitā || 18 ||
asyā bījāvupādiśya hyekānte prajapennaraḥ | ṛtusnātāyā bhāryāyā maithunaṃ kurute naraḥ || 19 ||
śukreṇa saha deveśi saptabhirauṣadhairlikhet | likhitvā sa bhavedrājā asyā yantraṃ samantrakam || 20 ||
likhitvā dhārayenmūrdhni trailokyavijayī bhavet | asyāḥ saṃbhogakāle tu mantraṃ japet sureśvari || 21 ||
kāntāyā maithunaṃ kuryād bahuputrayuto bhavet | asyā yantraṃ samantraṃ ca bāhau yo dhārayennaraḥ || 22 ||
yāvajjanma bhavettasya tāvacchatrurna jīvati | asyā yantraṃ samantraṃ ca hṛdi yo dhārayennaraḥ || 23 ||
yāvajjanma bhavettasya tāvallakṣmīrbhaviṣyati | asyā yantraṃ samantraṃ ca kukṣau yo dhārayennaraḥ || 24 ||
anuvāde sa śatrūṇāṃ vākyajñaḥ sahasā bhavet | tasyāstripurasundaryā mukhāmbhojānmayā śrutam || 25 ||
phalametanmahāścaryakārakaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ |
iti vajrayoginī || atha vārāhīmantroddhāraḥ uktaṃ ca svakṛtau tripurātilake(-)
vāsanā caiva vālhīkaṃ tamobījasamanvitam | vāgbhavaṃ sauśmakaṃ caiva tataḥ pallavamuddharet || 1 ||
bhagavati ca vārtāli tathā vārāhi devate |
varāhamukhi caivaṃ tu vāsanā ca maṭhaṃ tathā || 2 ||
tataḥ paṅkajapayojau haraṃ nīraṃ maheśvari | bhagavatyāstu vārāhyā ekatriṃśākṣaro manuḥ || 3 ||
tatra vālhīkabījanāmāni muṇḍamālātantre(-)
vālhīkaṃ maṭhasaṃñjaṃ ca (kh: rāmaṭhaṃ caiva) hiṅgubījaṃ munīśvarāḥ | glauṃ bījoddhāramedaddhi cānyadanṛtamāvadet || 1 ||
atha tamobījanāmāni svatantre(-)
tamobījaṃ tathā dvāntaṃ mohaṃ timirameva ca | laṃ bījoddhārāṇyetāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi tu || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) aiṃglauṃlaṃaiṃ namo bhagavati vārtāli vārāhi devate varāhamukhi aiṃglauṃṭhaḥṭhaḥ phaṭ svāhā iti vārāhī || atha śāradāmantroddhāraḥ uktaṃ ca śāradāpaṭale(-)
tāraṃ māyā ca madanaṃ śaradvijñeyamauśmakam | mantraṃ ca ṣ't śiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavamuddharet || 1 ||
bhagavatyai śāradāyai cānte lajjā ca ṭhadvayam |
prakāśam(-) oṃhrīṃklīṃsauḥ namo bhagavatyai śāradāyai hrīṃ svāhā || atha kāmeśvarīmantroddharaḥ bhairavapaṭale(-)
māyā ca hariṇākṣī ca candraḥ śītāṃśureva ca | madanamūrmidhvāntau dvau saṃyojya stanabījakam || 1 ||
manuḥ saptaśiro jñeyastataḥ pallavamuddharet | jṛmbhaṇākhye (g: jambaḥ) tato devi kāmeśvari tathaiva ca || 2 ||
tato bāṇadevate'pi hyante nīramudāhṛtam | kāmeśvaryā mahādevyā dvāviṃśadakṣaro manuḥ || 3 ||
tatra candrabījanāmāni kālīsarvasve(-)
candraḥ śītāṃśurinduśca śarvarīpatireva ca |
tārādhipaḥ sudhāraśmiḥ kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 1 ||
candrabījau dvau aiṃ drāṃ ca | athormibījanāmāni tatraiva(-)
ūrmirvīcistathā caiva taraṅgastritayaṃ smṛtam | blūṃ bījoddhāranāmāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 2 ||
atha stanabījanāmāni uktaṃ cāgamālaṅkāre(-)
stanabījaṃ kucaṃ caivamurojo hṛjjameva ca | jaṃ bījanāmānyetāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) hrīṃśrīṃdrāṃdrīṃklīṃblūṃjaṃ jṛmbhaṇākhye (g: jamba) kāmeśvari bāṇadevate svāhā | iti bhairavapaṭaloktam | atha gaurīmantroddhāraḥ tripurāśiromaṇau(-)
praṇavaṃ kamalā caiva māyā vālhīkameva ca | śivabījaṃ tathā devi gauri śarvaśca ṭhadvayam || 1 ||
bhagavatyā mahāgauryā bālastu dvādaśākṣaraḥ |
iti | tatra śivabījanāmāni uktaṃ ca kulacūḍāmaṇau(-)
śivabījaṃ ca śambhuśca śarvaḥ śaṅkara eva ca | gaṃ bījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃśrīṃhrīṃglauṃgaṃ devi gauri gīṃ svāhā (12) || athānnapūrṇāmantroddhāraḥ kāmeśvarītantre(-)
tāraṃ parāpi kamalā mīnaketana eva ca | viśvaṃ tato bhagavati māheśvari tataḥ punaḥ || 1 ||
annapūrṇe ṭhayugalaṃ manurviṃśākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ |
mīnaketana iti doṣaḥ | uktaṃ ca svakṛtau tripurasundarīsarvasve(-)
tryakṣaṃ māyāpi padmā ca kāmaṃ viśvamudāhṛtam | bījaṃ tu ṣaṭśiro jñeyaṃ viśvena saha bhāmini || 1 ||
ityuddhāraḥ | prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ namo bhagavati māheśvari annapūrṇe svāhā || atha kulavāgīśvarīmantroddhāraḥ uktaṃ ca muṇḍamālātantre(-)
praṇavaṃ madanaṃ caiva skandaṃ nārāyaṇapriyām |
taṭaṃ tathecchābījaṃ ca tataḥ pallavamuddharet || 1 ||
jhaṣahaste tataḥ paścāt kulavāgīśvari tathā | ante ca vāsanābījaṃ padmaṃ kāṅkṣāpi nīrajam || 2 ||
nartakībījamambhojaṃ payaścaiva sureśvari | kulavāgīśvarīdevyāsturyaviṃśākṣaro manuḥ || 3 ||
tatrecchābījanāmāni vāmakeśvare(-)
icchābījaṃ spṛhā kāṅkṣā lipsā bījacatuṣṭayam | jhaṃ bījasyaiva nāmāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 1 ||
atha nartakībījanāmāni cchinnārahasye(-)
nartakībījamatyugraṃ veśyāpi gaṇikā tathā | paṇyastrī pañca nāmāni phrīṃ bījasyānṛtaṃ param || 1 ||
ambujāmbhojayoraikyamiti doṣaḥ | prakāśam(-) oṃ klīṃ hrāṃ śrīṃ hūṃ jhaṃ jhaṣahaste kulavāgīśvari aiṃṭhaḥ jhaṃṭhaḥ phrīṃṭhaḥ svāhā (24) ||
etā mayā maheśāni sapta vidyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | adyāhaṃ tava bhaktyā te hṛdi yadrocate priyam || 26 ||
vada me satvaraṃ devi tadvakṣyāmi suvistaram |
śrīdevyuvāca |
pañcānāṃ bālakākhyānāṃ kīdṛśāste manūttamāḥ | kṛpayāpi purā mahyaṃ sūcitā na prakāśitāḥ || 27 ||
munaya ūcuḥ |
brahmarṣe sarvaśāstrajña tvanmukhātsakalaṃ śrutam | manūn pañcakumārāṇāmasmākaṃ vaktumarhasi || 28 ||
dakṣiṇāmūrtirmunīn prati īśvaraḥ pārvatīṃ prati bravīti |
śrī(-)īśvara uvāca |
śṛṇu pārvati deveśi maharṣīṇāṃ purā śive | dakṣiṇāmūrtinoktaṃ yat tatte vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ || 29 ||
herambaśarajanmānau kārtavīryārjunastathā | hanumadbhairavāvete bhāṣitāḥ pañca bālakāḥ || 30 ||
iti | bhairavītantre vāmakeśvare ca(-)
herambaśarajanmānau mahāmṛtyuñjayastathā | kārtavīryājunaścaiva hanumadbhairavau tathā || 1 ||
svayaṃ mayā ca tantroktā bhāṣitāḥ ṣaṭ kumārakāḥ |
rudrayāmale'pi(-)
gaṇeśo vaṭukaścaiva skando mṛtyuñjayastathā | kārtavīryārjuno'pyevaṃ sugrīvo hanumāṃstathā || 1 ||
yāmale rudraśabdādau bhāṣitāḥ sapta bālakāḥ |
tatrādau gaṇeśamantroddhāraḥ rudrayāmale(-)
praṇavaṃ kamalāṃ lajjāṃ kandarpaṃ maṭhabījakam | śaṅkaraṃ ṣaṭśiromantraṃ tataḥ pallavamuddharet || 1 ||
gaṇapataye namaḥ paścād vara varada eva ca | sarvajanaṃ tataḥ paścānme vaśamānayeti ca || 2 ||
ante'pi ṭhadvayaṃ jñeyamaṣṭāviṃśākṣaro manuḥ |
prakāśam(-) oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ glauṃ gaṃ gaṇapataye varavarada sarvajanaṃ me vaśamānaya svāhā | iti || atha kumārasya mantroddhāraḥ kulacūḍāmaṇau(-)
praṇavaṃ chavibījaṃ ca mantraṃ tu dviśiraḥ smṛtam | madhye kumārāya namo hyante nīramudāhṛtam || 1 ||
tatra cchavibījanāmāni siddhasārasvate(-)
chavibījaṃ kāntibījaṃ śobhā'pi suṣamā tathā | hrāṃ bījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrāṃ kumārāya namaḥ svāhā iti || atha kārtavīryārjunamantroddhāraḥ uktaṃ coḍḍāmaratantre(-)
praṇavaṃ vāyupūjyāpi cārukaṃ manmathastathā |
śukrabījaṃ tathā śūnyaṃ kamalā rasanā tathā || 1 ||
candraṃ ḍimbaṃ ca kūrcaṃ ca turagaṃ ca sureśvari | madhye tannāma vijñeyaṃ kārtavīryārjunāya ca || 2 ||
ante payo manuḥ prokta ekaviṃśākṣaraḥ śive |
tatra śukrabījanāmāni cchinnāśiromaṇau(-)
śukrabījaṃ tathā kāvyo bhārgavaḥ kavibījakam | daityamānyo (kh: daityāmātyo) maheśāni surāsuranamaskṛte || 1 ||
brauṃ bījāni ca pañcaiva kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca |
śukrabījau dvau brauṃ ḹṃ ca | prakāśam(-) oṃ prīṃ cchrīṃ klīṃ brauṃ āṃ śrīṃ krīṃ aiṃ hrauṃ hūṃ phaṭ kārtavīryārjunāya svāhā || atha hanumato mantroddhāraḥ kulacūḍāmaṇau(-)
praṇavamūrdhvabījaṃ ca vibhūtistadanantaram | hanumate tataḥ paścādrāmadūtāya vai punaḥ || 1 ||
laṅkāvidhvaṃsanāyaivamañjanīgarbhasaṃ tataḥ | bhūtāya śākinī caiva ḍākinī tadanantaram || 2 ||
vidhvaṃsanāya kili dvau bubukāreṇa vai punaḥ | vibhīṣaṇāya hanumaddevāya tadanantaram || 3 ||
tryakṣaṃ māyā hariṇākṣī vyoṣaṃ skandaṃ tathaiva ca | haramāpastathānte'pi saptaṣaṣṭyakṣaro manuḥ || 4 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ hanumate rāmadūtāya laṅkāvidhvaṃsanāya añjanīgarbhasaṃbūtāya śākinīḍākinīvidhvaṃsanāya kili (2) bubukāreṇa vibhīṣaṇāya hanumaddevāya oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hrauṃ hrāṃ phaṭ svāhā iti || atha vaṭukabhairavasya mantroddhāraḥ rudrayāmale(-)
praṇavaṃ manmathaṃ caivamabhrabījasamanvitam | abdhibījaṃ kalpabījaṃ śataghnībījasaṃyutam || 1 ||
mayā madhye'pi vaṭuka bhairavāyāśmarī tathā |
ante'po bhairavasyāyaṃ manuraṣṭādaśākṣaraḥ || 2 ||
tatrābhrabījanāmāni vāmakeśvare(-)
abhrabījaṃ ca jīmūtamambudaṃ jaladaṃ ghanam | vīṃ bījāni ca pañcaivamanṛtāni parāṇi ca || 1 ||
athābdhibījanāmāni tripurātilake(-)
abdhibījaṃ tathā sindhuḥ sāṃbaraṃ sāgarastathā | ruṃ bījāni ca catvāri (kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca) || 1 ||
raṃkāra(-) ruṃkārayorbhedena (g: rukāra rakārayorbhede) ramagnibījaṃ rumityabdhibījam | agnyabdhyorantarādantaramiti nirdoṣaḥ | atha kalpabījanāmāni āgamālaṅkāre(-)
kalpabījaṃ ca saṃvartaṃ pralayaṃ kṣayabījakam | kṣāmikaṃ kṣurakaṃ kṣaudraṃ tathā kalpāntabījakam || 1 ||
dhruṃ(-) bījānyevamaṣṭau ca kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca |
atha śataghnībījanāmāni āgamalaharyām(-)
śataghnī śyālikā (g: śālikā) śyāmā śādvalā śuṣkalā tathā | ghnīṃ bījāni tu pañcaivamasatyānyaparāṇi ca || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ klīṃ vīṃ ruṃ dhruṃ ghnīṃ hrīṃ vaṭukabhairavāya namaḥ svāhā || atha mahāmṛtyuñjayasya mantroddhāraḥ ānamalaharyām(-)
tryakṣaṃ hṛjjaṃ śaktiśobhe'pi śaṅkā māṃ tasmādvai pālaya dvau tathaiva | tasmācchaktiḥ khaṃ śarad hṛjjatārau mantroddhāro devi mṛtyuñjayasya || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ juṃsaḥ haṃsaḥ māṃ pālaya (2) sohaṃsaḥ juṃ oṃ || atha sugrīvasya mantroddhāraḥ āgamaśiromaṇau(-)
tāraṃ māyā vāgbhavaṃ manmathaṃ ca śaktirmadhye nāma tyaktvā tathānte |
kālīpadmau kūrcapadmau samastāpadmau nīrameṣa sugrīvamantraḥ || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ saḥ sugrīvāya krīṃṭhaḥ hūṃṭhaḥ hrīṃṭhaḥ svāhā ||
mayākhyātā maheśāni hyete vai sapta bālakāḥ |
dakṣiṇāmūrtiruvāca |
śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ kiñcidyuṣmākamasti yaddhṛdi | bravīmi bhavatāṃ prītyā ājñāpayitumarhatha || 31 ||
[iti śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtimuniviracite uddhārakośe sarvāgamasāre saptadevī saptakumārakośākhyānaṃ tṛtīyaḥ kalpaḥ] || 3 || atha
[caturthaḥ kalpaḥ] |
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
brahmarṣe sarvatattvajña śāstrāmbhonidhipāraga | navagrahāṇāmasmākaṃ mantrāṃstvaṃ (kh: manūṃstvaṃ) vaktumarhasi || 1 ||
īśvara uvāca |
tasmin kāle maharṣīṇāṃ yaduktaṃ dhātṛsūnunā | navagrahāṇāṃ mantrāṃśca tān vakṣyāmi samāsataḥ || 2 ||
ādityendujaśukrāśca gurvindū parameśvari |
ete pañca maheśāni pañceṣorbāṇadevatāḥ || 3 ||
bhaumārkirāhavaścaiva traya ete munīśvarāḥ | devasya khaṇḍaparaśorlocanatrayadevatāḥ || 4 ||
ketuśca parameśāni bhūmerdevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | ete nava grahāḥ proktāḥ śambhunā rudrayāmale || 5 ||
athādau pañcagrahamantroddhāraḥ | tatrādāvādityasya mantroddhāraḥ viśvanāthasāroddhāre(-)
praṇavaṃ cāmbaraṃ lakṣmīrvyoṣabījaṃ (kh, g: vyoma) tathaiva ca | bījaṃ turyaśiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavamuddharet || 1 ||
grahādhirājāya tata ādityāya tathaiva ca | ante payastu vijñeyaṃ manurdvyaṣṭākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 2 ||
tatrāmbarabījanāmāni bhairavatantre(-)
ambaraṃ vastrabījaṃ ca śūnyaṃ śaktiriti dvayam | haritaṃ hariṇībījaṃ haridrābījameva ca || 1 ||
hsauḥ(-) bījāni saptaiva kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca |
ambarabījau dvau hsauḥ āṃ ca | prakāśam(-) oṃ hsauḥ śrīṃ āṃ grahādhirājāya ādityāya svāhā | atha budhasya mantroddhāraḥ svatantre(-)
praṇavaṃ ca tathā skandaṃ rasajñā ca ṣaḍānanaḥ | madhye'pi grahanāthāya budhāyānte ca ṭhadvayam || 1 ||
budhasya grahanāthasya manuścaturdaśākṣaraḥ |
tatra ṣaḍānanabījanāmāni kubjikāsarvasve(-)
ṣaḍānanaḥ śarajanmā skandaḥ kumārabījakam | śāmbhavaḥ śālinībījaṃ tathā ṣaṇmukhabījakam || 1 ||
ṭaṃ(-) bījāni ca saptaivamanṛtānyaparāṇi ca |
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrāṃ krīṃ ṭaṃ grahanāthāya budhāya svāhā || atha śukrasya
mantroddhāraḥ āgamaśiromaṇau(-)
praṇavamūrdhvabījaṃ ca stanabījasamanvitam | śivabījaṃ tato madhye graheśvarāya vai punaḥ || 1 ||
śukrāyānte'śmarī caiva bālaścaturdaśākṣaraḥ |
prakāśam(-) oṃ aiṃ jaṃ gaṃ graheśvarāya śukrāya namaḥ || atha bṛhaspatermantroddhāraḥ tripurātilake(-)
tryakṣaṃ māyāpi saubhāgyā surāsuranamaskṛte | taraṅgaveśye saṃyojya cārvaṅgī hiṅgubījakam || 1 ||
ūrdhvaṃ ca ṣaṭśirobījaṃ tataḥ pallavamuddharet | tato grahādhipataye bṛhaspataya eva ca || 2 ||
punarvārivahaṃ caiva padmaṃ lakṣmīstu nīrajam | vāsanā paṅkajaṃ caivamante proktaṃ vanaṃ śive || 3 ||
ityuddhāraḥ | saubhāgyeti doṣaḥ | dakṣiṇāmūrtistu(-) tasya dhigastu munayaḥ svayaṃ yasya na dhīrbhavet | kva rukmiṇī kva saubhāgyaṃ dyobhuvorantaraṃ mahat || iti doṣaḥ | uktaṃ ca svakṛtau sundarīsarvasve(-) praṇavaṃ sakalā caiva deveśi rukmiṇī tathā | tato vārivahamiti doṣaḥ | vāmakeśvare(-)
praṇavaṃ ca parā lakṣmīrvīciveśye'pi yojayet | candro maṭhaṃ tataḥ paścād grahādhipataye namaḥ || 1 ||
tato bṛhaspataye'pi tato jīmūtabījakam | padmaṃ lakṣmīrnīrajaṃ ca vāsanā paṅkajaṃ tathā | ante nīraṃ samākhyātaṃ pañcaviṃśākṣaro manuḥ |
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ khrīṃ aiṃ glauṃ grahādhipataye bṛhaspataye brīṃṭhaḥ aiṃṭhaḥ śrīṃṭhaḥ svāhā || atha candrasya mantroddhāraḥ kālīpaṭale(-)
tryakṣaṃ ca hariṇākṣī ca kuntībījasamanvitam | haretiśabdaṃ saṃyojya śūnyānusvārasaṃyutam || 1 ||
nāṭyabījaṃ tato madhye candrāyānte'śmarī smṛtā |
tatra nāṭyabījanāmāni bhairavatantre
nāṭyabījaṃ ca naṭanaṃ tāṇḍavaṃ nṛttabījakam | caṃ bījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ śrīṃ krīṃ hrāṃ caṃ candrāya namaḥ ||
ete vai pañcabāṇānāṃ grahāḥ pañca prakīrtitāḥ |
atha trigrahamantroddhāraḥ | tatrādau bhaumasya mantroddhāraḥ śāradāṭīkāyām
cāraṇaṃ hariṇībījaṃ rukmiṇī śarvarīpatiḥ | vedhobījaṃ tato madhye grahādhipataye tataḥ || 1 ||
bhaumāyānte payaḥ (k, kh: mayā) prokto manuḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥ |
tatra vedhobījanāmāni cchinnārahasye(-)
vedhobījaṃ vidhirbrahmā svayambhūbījameva ca | kaṃ(-) bījānyapi catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) aiṃ hsauḥ śrīṃ drāṃ kaṃ grahādhipataye bhaumāya svāhā || atha śanaiścarasya mantroddhāraḥ āgamalaharyām(-)
tāraṃ lajjāṃ śriyaṃ caiva bījaṃ triśira (k, kh: triśūla) ūrdhvagaḥ | grahacakravartine'pi śanaiścarāya vai tataḥ || 1 ||
madanaṃ vāsanā śaktirante nīramudāhṛtam | śanaiścarasya devasya manurviṃśākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 2 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ grahacakravartine śanaiścarāya klīṃ aiṃsaḥ svāhā || atha rāhormantroddhāraḥ tatraiva(-)
praṇavaṃ rasanāyugmaṃ taṭayugmaṃ ca garjitam | tataṣṭaṅkadhāriṇe ca rāhave havyavāhanaḥ || 1 ||
lajjā lakṣmīstathā bhīmā hyante vanamudāhṛtam | rāhorviṃśākṣaro bālo yathābhīṣṭaphalapradaḥ || 2 ||
tatra garjitabījanāmāni svatantre(-)
garjitaṃ svanabījaṃ ca stanitaṃ rasitaṃ tathā | ṭaṃ(-) bījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ krīṃ krīṃ hūṃ hūṃ ṭaṃ ṭaṅkadhāriṇe rāhave raṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ bhaiṃ svāhā | iti
śambhornetratrayāṇāṃ ca devatā bhāṣitā mayā | sudine sādhako mantrān grahāṇāṃ sādhayecchive || 1 ||
atha ketumantroddhāraḥ mantramuktāvalyām(-)
praṇavaṃ sakalā vṛṣṭistato'pi krūrarūpiṇe | ketave'pi tataḥ paścāccandraḥ śaṅkā payastathā || 1 ||
ketorayaṃ manuḥ prokto (k: mahāmantro) devi pañcadaśākṣaraḥ |
tatra vṛṣṭibījanāmāni muṇḍamālātantre(-)
vṛṣṭibījaṃ ca karakaṃ varṣopalastu vārṣikaḥ (k, g: kārṣikaḥ) | krūṃ(-) bījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi tu || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ krūṃ krūrarūpiṇe ketave aiṃ sauḥ svāhā || iti
eteṣāṃ navagrahāṇāṃ manavo bhāṣitā mayā | athāhaṃ tava deveśi varṇānāṃ vacmi vai manūn || 1 ||
kośaṃ lokopakārārthaṃ gopyādgopyatamaṃ kuru | yena vijñānamātreṇa māntrikaḥ sādhako bhavet || 2 ||
[iti śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtimuniviracite uddhārakośe sarvāgamasāre navagrahamantroddhārakośākhyānaṃ caturthaḥ kalpaḥ] || 4 ||
atha
[pañcamaḥ kalpaḥ] |
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
brahmarṣe brahmaputrastvamāgamāṇarvapāraga | prasanno'si mahābhāginnasmāsu kṛpayā prabho || 1 ||
nānāśāstrāṇi hyasmābhiḥ śrutāni tvanmukhāmbujāt | varṇānāṃ śrotumicchāmo mantrakośāni ca vayam || 2 ||
śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtiḥ |
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi matto yūyaṃ yathāvidhi (k, g: mantrakopaṃ suvistaram) | varṇānāṃ mantrakośaṃ ca niḥsṛtaṃ tripurāmukhāt || 3 ||
śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve mantrakośaṃ suvistaram | munīnāṃ sūcitaṃ yacca dakṣiṇāmūrtinā purā || 4 ||
tripurātilake(-)
ātmabījamakāraṃ ca svāntaṃ hṛdbījameva ca | mānasaṃ ca manobījaṃ paitāmahamiti smṛtam || 5 ||
aparamanṛtaṃ jñeyamakārasya sureśvari | śūnyaṃ khamambaraṃ vyoma vaiṣṇavaṃ ceti bhāṣitam || 6 ||
ākārasyānṛtamanyaduktaṃ bhairavatantrake | indrabījaṃ tathā jiṣṇurmarutvān maghamā hariḥ || 7 ||
śaivamikāravarṇasya kṛtrimamaparaṃ vadet | mayā proktaṃ sureśāni granthe bhairavatantrake || 8 ||
buddhibījaṃ tathā medhā dhībījaṃ ca matistathā | aindraṃ tathaiva vijñeyamīkārasyānṛtaṃ param || 9 ||
mayā proktaṃ sureśāni tripurātilake śive |
indrabījau dvau iṃ īṃ ca |
rutibījaṃ tathā nandā vāmanaṃ vītubījakam (g: vātu) || 10 ||
sauryamukārabījāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca | mayākhyātāni sarvasve kubjikāyāḥ sureśvari || 11 ||
kacabījaṃ tathā keśaṃ śiroruhaṃ ca mūrdhajam | aindavamanṛtamanyadūkārasya sureśvari || 12 ||
śiromaṇau mayā proktāḥ sundaryāḥ parameśvari | pāpmabījaṃ (g: padyā padyā) tathā pāpaṃ kilviṣaṃ kalmaṣaṃ tathā || 13 ||
kiṅkarībījamevaṃ ca maṅgalamanṛtaṃ param | ṛkārasya rahasye'smin kālyāḥ proktaṃ mayā śive || 14 ||
kṛpābījaṃ dayābījaṃ karuṇā kārṣikaṃ tathā | ṝkārasyānṛtamanyad bhāṣitaṃ viṣṇuyāmale || 15 ||
viśvabījadvayaṃ jñeyaṃ ḷkāraṃ ca nama iti | vyaktabījaṃ jagadbījaṃ gaurvaṃ proktaṃ mayā śive || 16 ||
ḹkārasyānṛtamanyaduktaṃ ca rudrayāmale | gaṅgābījaṃ surnadī ca nākavāpī ca svardhunī || 17 ||
śākramanyadanṛtaṃ ca ḹkārasya mayā smṛtam | granthe ca svakṛtau devi mantrasāgaratantrake || 18 ||
ekādaśī mātrikā ca latābījaṃ tathaiva ca |
vallībījaṃ ca vārākī cānyadanṛtamāvadet || 19 ||
aparaṃ ca mayākhyātamekārasya sureśvari | kulacūḍāmaṇau granthe racite māntrikottamaiḥ || 20 ||
vāgbhavamūrdhvabījaṃ ca cāraṇaṃ caṇḍikeśvaraḥ | caṇḍo'pi (kh: candro'pi) carma vasanaṃ vāsanā ca tathaiva ca || 21 ||
cārvaṅgyapi ca carmāṇaṃ mātrāṃ dvādaśikāmatha | rāhu khyātaṃ mayā devi aikārasyānṛtaṃ param || 22 ||
tripurāsārasarvasve dakṣiṇāmūrtinā kṛte | praṇavaṃ ca tatastāraṃ (g: dhanustā) tryakṣaṃ tomāpi tryambakaḥ || 23 ||
trāsastārakaṃ (g: tāraṃ ca) deveśi kaitavaṃ ca mayā smṛtam | chinnāśiromaṇau granthe racite vai mayā svayam || 24 ||
mokṣabījaṃ tathā muktirjñānaṃ nirvāṇabījakam | āgastyaṃ ca mayā khyātaṃ granthe bhairavatantrake || 25 ||
aṃbījaṃ vṛkṣabījaṃ ca pādapaṃ dharaṇīruham | bhūruhaṃ ca mayākhyātamanṛtamaparaṃ vadet || 26 ||
siddhasārasvate granthe brahmaṇaiva prakāśitam | nāgabījaṃ bhūdharaṃ ca bhhargyabījaṃ ca bhānavam || 27 ||
dhrauvaṃ khyātaṃ mayā devi aḥśabdasyānṛtaṃ (kh: varṇa) param | granthe tripurasundaryāḥ sarvasve viśvadurlabhe (g: vallabhe) || 28 ||
kakāraṃ ca śirobījaṃ mūrdhabījaṃ ca cāruṇam (g: vāruṇaṃ; kh: cāraṇaṃ) | vedhobījaṃ vidhirbrahmā svayambhūbījameva ca || 29 ||
kakārasya mayā khyātamanṛtamaparaṃ vadet | granthe chinnārahasye'smin parvateśvaranandini || 30 ||
nabhābījaṃ puṣkaraṃ ca dyaubījaṃ cakravālakam | vaiṣṭaraśravabījaṃ ca proktaṃ tripurayā svayam || 31 ||
āgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ durlabhāyāṃ mayāpi ca | śivabījaṃ ca śambhuśca śarvaḥ śaṅkara eva ca || 32 ||
gakārasyānṛtamanyad bhāṣitaṃ ca mayā śive | kulacūḍāmaṇau granthe durlabhe tridive priye || 33 ||
jinabījaṃ ṣaḍabhijñaṃ mārajidbījameva ca | māyātmajo'rkabandhuśca gautamamanṛtaṃ param || 34 ||
vakārasya mayākhyātaṃ granthe vai rudrayāmale | ṣaḍānanaḥ śarajanmā skandaḥ kumārabījakam || 35 ||
śāmbhavaḥ śālinībījamanṛtamaparaṃ smṛtam | kubjikāsarvasve khyātaṃ mayā trailokyapūjite || 36 ||
nāṭyabījaṃ ca naṭanaṃ tāṇḍavaṃ nṛttabījakam | cakārasya mayā khyātaṃ granthe bhairavatantrake || 37 ||
śanibījamarkajaṃ ca paṅgubījaṃ tathaiva ca | kālaṃ ca saurabījaṃ ca sūtiḥ sundarabījakam || 38 ||
chakārasya mayā proktaṃ granthe kāmeśvare śive |
śanibījau dvau chaṃ ñaṃ ca |
stanabījaṃ kucaṃ caivamurojo hṛjjameva ca || 39 ||
jakārasya mayākhyātamanyadanṛtamāvadet | āgamālaṅkāraje ca granthe bhairavanirmite || 40 ||
icchābījaṃ spṛhā kāṅkṣā lipsābījaṃ catuṣṭayam | jhakārasya mayā khyātamasatyamaparaṃ smṛtam || 41 ||
trailokyaprathite granthe devi vai vāmakeśvare | yamabījaṃ kālabījaṃ kṛtāntasamavartinau || 42 ||
kīnāśaṃ mṛtyubījaṃ ca ñakārasya mayā smṛtam | tripurāsarvasve granthe trijagaddurlabhe priye || 43 ||
kālabījau dvau ñaṃ chaṃ ca |
garjitaṃ svanabījaṃ ca stanitaṃ rasitaṃ tathā | ṭakārasya mayā khyātaṃ svatantre devavandite || 44 ||
padmaṃ paṅkajapayojau nīrajamambujaṃ tathā | pañca ṭhakārabījāni kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca || 45 ||
mayā khyātāni deveśi tantre vai vāmakeśvare | siṃhikā sarasībījaṃ reṇukābījameva ca || 46 ||
añjanībījakaṃ khyātamanṛtamaparaṃ smṛtam | ḍakārasya mayā devi granthe vai rudrayāmale || 47 ||
vāyubījaṃ cānilaṃ ca samīraṇaṃ maruttathā | samīraṃ cāśugaṃ jñeyaṃ vātaṃ śvasanabījakam || 48 ||
ḍhakārasya mayā khyātamanyadanṛtamāvadet |
vāyubījau dvau ḍhaṃ yaṃ ca |
bāṇabījaṃ mārgaṇaṃ ca patriṇamāśugaṃ tathā || 49 ||
ṇakārasyānṛtamanyad granthe bhairavatantrake |
āśugabījau dvau ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ ca |
rātribījaṃ tamībījaṃ tāmasībījameva (g: tāmasī ca niśā mamā) ca || 50 ||
kṣapā ca kṣaṇadābījamanyadanṛtamāvadet | kubjikāsarvasve granthe taṃbījaṃ ca mayā smṛtam || 51 ||
bilabījaṃ ca vivaraṃ suṣiraṃ ca nāgalokakam | thakārasya mayā khyātaṃ tantre vai kulikārṇave (g: kubjikā) || 52 ||
cakribījaṃ vyālabījaṃ sarpaḥ kākodaroragau | bhogibījaṃ bhujaṅgaṃ ca bhujaṅgamamiti smṛtam || 53 ||
dakārasya mayā khyātamanṛtamaparaṃ smṛtam | svatantre devadeveśi dakṣiṇāmūrtinā kṛte || 54 ||
puṣpabījaṃ prasūnaṃ ca prasūtiḥ suprajāstathā | dhakārasyānṛtamanyat tripurātilake smṛtam || 55 ||
kṣārabījaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ saindhavaṃ sūkaraṃ vṛkam | vārāhamanṛtamanyanmayā khyātaṃ sureśvari || 56 ||
trailokyaprathite granthe tripurāyāḥ śiromaṇau | kūrmamīnapadavyāptau bījārṇaṃ sadṛśaṃ priye || 57 ||
phakārasya pakārasya bhedo nāsti parasparam | bhāṣaṇoddhāraviṣaye likhane prakṛtiḥ pṛthak || 58 ||
matsyaṃ ca mīnabījaṃ ca śapharībījameva ca | jhaṣabījaṃ mayākhyātaṃ granthe chinnāśiromaṇau || 59 ||
kūrmabījaṃ ca kamaṭhaṃ karkaṭo'pi kulīrakam | kacchapamanṛtamanyanmayākhyātaṃ ca bhāmini || 60 ||
śāradāpaṭale granthe trailokyaprathite śive | ūrmirvīcistathā caivaṃ taraṅgastritayaṃ smṛtam || 61 ||
asatyamaparaṃ jñeyaṃ mayākhyātaṃ sureśvari | kālikākulasarvasve brahmaṇaiva prakāśite || 62 ||
bhadrikā bhāsvatī bhīmā bhakārasyānṛtaṃ param | tantre vai muṇḍamālāyāṃ mayākhyātaṃ sureśvari || 63 ||
ḍulibījaṃ śilībījaṃ maṇḍūkaṃ durduraṃ tathā | bhekībījaṃ mayākhyātamasatyamaparaṃ smṛtam || 64 ||
āgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ parvateśvaranandini | vāyubījaṃ tathā vāgmi vācālaṃ vaśyabījakam || 65 ||
vīrāśārṇaṃ (g: vīrabījaṃ) tathā vāpī mayākhyātaṃ svatantrake |
agnī rephaśca vahniśca hutabhug havyavāhanaḥ || 66 ||
rakārasya mayākhyātaṃ śyāmātantre sureśvari | tamobījaṃ tathā dhvāntaṃ mohaṃ timirameva ca || 67 ||
lakārasya mayākhyātaṃ svatantre munivandite | bhūbījaṃ dharaṇībījaṃ lakāraṃ bhāṣitaṃ mayā || 68 ||
abhraṃ meghaṃ ca jīmūtamambubhṛdambudaṃ ghanam | vakārasya mayākhyātaṃ tantre vai vāmakeśvare || 69 ||
kalyāṇaṃ caiva śarmāpi śaṃ śubhaṃ ca catuṣṭayam | śakārasya mayākhyātaṃ granthe bhairavatantrake || 70 ||
śampābījaṃ taḍidbījaṃ vidyucchatahradā tathā | hrādinībījakaṃ caivamasatyamaparaṃ smṛtam || 71 ||
mayākhyātaṃ sureśāni granthe vai rudrayāmale | śaktiḥ śarmāpi vijñeye śaracchaṅke tathaiva ca || 72 ||
sakārasya mayākhyātaṃ granthe chinnāśiromaṇau | chavibījaṃ kāntibījaṃ śobhā bhā suṣamā tathā || 73 ||
ākāśaṃ ca hakārasyānṛtamanyanmayoditam | siddhasārasvate granthe nityaṃ māntrikapūjite || 74 ||
devabījaṃ nirjaraṃ ca tridaśaṃ tridiveśakam | surabījaṃ ca gīrbāṇaṃ lekhamamarabījakam || 75 ||
kṣakārasya mayā proktaṃ kulacūḍāmaṇau priye | varṇānāṃ devadeveśi kośaṃ proktaṃ mayā śive | nānāmantrayutaṃ devi sarvāgamaviniścitam || 76 ||
[iti śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtimuniviracite uddhārakośe sarvāgamasāre sarvavarṇakośākhyānaṃ pañcamaḥ kalpaḥ] || 5 ||
atha
[ṣaṣṭhaḥ kalpaḥ] |
śrī(-)īśvaraḥ |
dvyakṣarāṇāṃ pṛthaṅnāma krīṃprīṃśrīṃhrīṃhsrauḥ tathā | pṛthaṅnāma sureśāni sakalāgamaniścitam || 1 ||
adya vakṣyāmi te devi tisro bhuvanadevatāḥ | dakṣiṇāmūrtinā pūrvamṛṣīṇāṃ bhāṣitāḥ svayam || 2 ||
bhavānī devadeveśi dvitīyā bagalāmukhī | indrākṣī sā tṛtīyā ca tisro bhuvanadevatāḥ || 3 ||
āsāmahaṃ te mantrāṇi vakṣyāmi śṛṇu pārvati | yasya kasya na vaktavyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ varānane || 4 ||
tatrādau bhavānīmantroddhāraḥ muṇḍamālātantre(-)
praṇavaṃ caiva dve padme tryakṣayugmaṃ parā punaḥ | hariṇākṣī dvayaṃ kūrcaṃ haraṃ ṭhadvayasaṃyutam || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ śrīṃ śrīṃ oṃ oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śrīṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā iti ||
atha bagalāmukhyā mantroddhāraḥ āgamalaharyām(-)
tārakaṃ caiva mṛdbījaṃ dvyakṣaraṃ samudāhṛtam | mantraṃ ca dvi śiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavamuddharet || 1 ||
bhagavati bagalā ca mukhi devi tataḥ punaḥ | tato'pi sarvaduṣṭānāṃ vācaṃ mukhaṃ padaṃ tathā || 2 ||
stambhaya dvistathā jihvāṃ kīlaya dvirbuddhiṃ tathā | vināśaya dvivāraṃ ca mṛttikābījakaṃ tathā || 3 ||
tryakṣamante payo jñeyaṃ dvipañcāśākṣaro manuḥ |
tatra mṛdbījanāmāni bhairavatantre(-)
mṛdbījaṃ mṛttikābījaṃ mṛtsnābījaṃ praśastikā | mṛtsā'nṛtaṃ paraṃ jñeyaṃ parvateśvaranandini || 1 ||
hrīṃ iti mṛdbījam | prakāśam(-) oṃ hrīṃ bhagavati bagalāmukhi devi sarvaduṣṭānāṃ vācaṃ mukhaṃ padaṃ stambhaya (2) jihvāṃ kīlaya (2) buddhiṃ vināśaya (2) hrīṃ oṃ svāhā (52) iti || athendrākṣyā mantroddhāraḥ rudrayāmale(-)
tryakṣaṃ kuntīdvayaṃ devi kūrcayugmaṃ tathaiva ca | prasthabījaṃ parāṃ padmāṃ carmāṇaṃ ca tato'bhidhām || 1 ||
indrākṣi vajrahaste'nte lakṣmīṃ lajjāṃ ca puṣkaram | tīrayugmaṃ rasane dve trāsaścandro haraṃ vanam || 2 ||
indrākṣyā devadevyāśca hyaṣṭāviṃśākṣaro manuḥ |
tatra prasthabījanāmāni śāradāpaṭale(-)
prasthabījaṃ sānubījaṃ śikharaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā | mlauṃ bījoddhārametaddhi cānyadanṛtamāvadet || 1 ||
prakāśam(-) oṃ krīṃ krīṃ hūṃ hūṃ mlauṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ aiṃ indrākṣi vajrahaste śrīṃ hrīṃ mlauṃ hūṃ hūṃ krīṃ krīṃ oṃ aiṃ phaṭ svāhā (28) iti ||
śrī(-)īśvaraḥ |
tisra etā mayā khyātā devi bhuvanadevatāḥ | dakṣiṇāmūrtinā bhaktyā saṃsāre'smin prakāśitāḥ || 1 ||
athāhaṃ devadeveśi khecaryā vacmi vai manum | yāmāśritya labhedyogī khecarīṃ siddhidāṃ kalām || 2 ||
viśvayāmale khecarīmantroddhāraḥ(-)
gīrbāṇadaśamaṃ varṇaṃ coddharet pratilomataḥ | tamobījaṃ tato dadyānmāyābījaṃ tataḥ param || 1 ||
tato dadyāccharadbījaṃ kūṭo'yaṃ parikīrtitaḥ |
mantraṃ (bījaṃ) turyaśiro jñeyaṃ yogī dadyāttato'bhidhām || 2 ||
khecaryai ca tato dadyādante hyauśmakameva ca |
prakāśam(-) mūlhrīṃsauḥ phecaryai namaḥ iti ||
[iti śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtimuniviracite uddhārakośe sarvāgamasāre tridevīnāṃ khecaryāśca kośākhyānaṃ ṣaṣṭhaḥ kalpaḥ] || 6 || atha
[saptamaḥ kalpaḥ] |
śrī(-)īśvaraḥ |
atha vakṣyāmi te devi dhyānānāgamaniścitān | etāsāṃ devatānāṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu pārvati tattvataḥ || 1 ||
tatrādau daśavidyānāṃ dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi tvaṃ śṛṇu | vāmakeśvara tantroktaṃ tripurāyāḥ sureśvari || 2 ||
divyāmbarāṅkitatanuṃ mihirāgnicandranetrāṃ sudhāṃśumukuṭāṃ himasannibhābhām | siṃhāsanāṃ paraśukhaḍgadharāṃ bhujābhyāṃ brahmendraviṣṇunamitāṃ tripurāṃ bhaje'ham || 3 ||
atha vakṣye śriyo dhyānaṃ bhāṣitaṃ rudrayāmale | munisādhakagīrvāṇa vighnavargaiḥ (kh: vipravargaiḥ) supūjitam || 4 ||
lakṣmīṃ padmāsanagatakaṭiṃ sūryaśītāṃśunetrāmudyadbhāsvatkanakarucibhiḥ padmaśaṅkhāsipāṇim |
nānāmuktāmaṇisukalaśāṃ bhūṣitāṅgīṃ dvibāhuṃ nityaṃ lokatritayaphaladāṃ naumyahaṃ bhaktipūrvam || 5 ||
atha vakṣyāmi vāgdevyā dhyānaṃ vidyāpradaṃ śive | tantramuktāvalau granthe durlabhe tridive'pi ca || 6 ||
vāṇīṃ pūrṇaniśākarojjvalamukhīṃ karpūrakundaprabhāṃ candrārdhāṅkitamastakāṃ nijakaraiḥ saṃbibhratīmādarāt | vīṇāmakṣaguṇaṃ sudhāḍhyakalaśaṃ vidyāṃ ca tuṅgastanīṃ divyairābharaṇairvibhūṣitatanuṃ siṃhādhirūḍhāṃ bhaje || 7 ||
adha vakṣyāmi tārāyā dhyānaṃ bhairavatantrake | devyā bhedavihīnāyā munisādhakapūjite || 8 ||
devīṃ pannagabhūṣitāṃ himaruciṃ śītāṃśuśaṅkhaprabhāṃ muktāratnaparītakaṇṭhavalayāṃ raktāmbaraṃ bibhratīm | śūlābjāsigadādharāṃ suragaṇairvaikuṇṭhamukhyaiḥ stutāṃ nityaṃ lokatrayaikarakṣaṇaparāṃ tārāṃ trinetrāṃ bhaje || 9 ||
athāhaṃ bhuvaneśvaryā dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu | sādhakeṣṭaprade granthe niḥsṛtaṃ rudrayāmale || 10 ||
udyadbhānusahasrasannibhamukhīṃ pīnastanīṃ padmagāṃ dorbhiraṅkuśapāśapustakajapān (kh: jayān) saṃbibhratīṃ sādaram | brahmopendramaheśvarendramunibhirnityaṃ stutāṃ vandanaiḥ stotrādyairbhuvaneśvarīṃ trinayanāṃ hṛtpaṅkaje'haṃ bhaje || 11 ||
atha vakṣyāmi mātaṅgyā dhyānaṃ parvatanandini | kubjikāsarvasve granthe mamāpyatyantadurlabhe || 12 ||
candrārdhāṅkitaśekharāṃ trinayanāṃ koṭīndusūryaprabhāṃ nānāratnasahasrabaddharaśanāṃ pretāsane saṃsthitām |
śaṅkhaṃ tomarapaṭṭisābjayugalān dorbhirvahantīṃ mudā dhyāye'haṃ hṛdaye sadā bhagavatīṃ mātaṅginīṃ hāriṇīm || 13 ||
atha vakṣye maheśāni śārikādhyānamuttamam | āgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ niḥsṛtaṃ durlabhaṃ janaiḥ || 14 ||
śrīśaṅkhacakramusalāmbujayugmahastāṃ (g: salābjayugāṅka) nāgendrahāravalayāṅkitakaṇṭhamālām | sindūrakuṅkumasahasramarīcidīptiṃ śrīśārikāṃ trinayanāṃ hṛdaye smarāmi || 15 ||
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi rājñīdhyānamanuttamam | vāmakeśvaratantroktaṃ parvateśvaranandini || 16 ||
śītāṃśubālārkakṛśānunetrāṃ caturbhujāmeṇatvagāsanasthām | śaṅkhābjaśūlāsidharāṃ maheśīṃ rājñīṃ bhaje'haṃ tuhinādrirūpām || 17 ||
atha vakṣyāmi bhīḍāyā dhyānamicchāphalapradam | niḥsṛtamāgamoddyote mayā viracite svayam || 18 ||
udyacchītāṃśuraśmidyuticayasadṛśīṃ phullapadmopaviṣṭāṃ vīṇānāgendraśaṅkhāyudhaparaśudharāṃ dorbhirīḍyaiścaturbhiḥ | muktāhārāṃśunānāmaṇiyutahṛdayāṃ śīdhupātraṃ vahantīṃ vande bhīḍāṃ bhavānīṃ prahasitavadanāṃ sādhakeṣṭapradātrīm || 19 ||
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi jvālāmukhyā anuttamam | dhyānaṃ mayā viracite granthe jvālāśiromaṇau || 20 ||
jvālāparītāsyaśiroruhāṃ tāṃ sarojaśaṅkhāsigadādharāṃ ca |
siṃhāsanasthāpitapādayugmāṃ jvālāmukhīṃ saddhṛdaye smarāmi || 21 ||
athāhaṃ bhadrakālyāśca dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi niḥsṛtam | svayaṃ mayā viracite tantre vai vāmakeśvare || 22 ||
muṇḍaṃ viśvasya kartuḥ karakamalatale dhārayantīṃ hasantīṃ nāhaṃ tṛptā vadantīṃ sakalajanamidaṃ bhakṣayantīṃ sadaiva | śyāmāṃ viṣṇuṃ girīśaṃ bhujanivahabalācchūlaprotaṃ vahantīṃ dhyāye'haṃ bhadrakālīṃ navajaladanibhāṃ pretamadhyāsanasthām || 23 ||
turīdhyānamahaṃ vakṣye niḥsṛtamāgamāmṛte | asmiṃścarācare khyāte brahmaṇaiva prakāśite || 24 ||
nānāratnanibaddhacandraśakalāṃ maulau jaṭābhirvṛte pāśāmbhojadharāṃ himāṃśudhavalāṃ dorbhyāṃ dvibāhuṃ śivām | sūryendvagnivilocanāṃ smitamukhīṃ pretāsane saṃsthitāṃ brahmopendramaheśvaraiśca namitāṃ devīṃ bhaje'haṃ turīm || 25 ||
athāhaṃ (g: athādau) chinnamastāyā dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi niḥsṛtam | svakṛte tripurāyāśca granthe devi śiromaṇau || 26 ||
eṇāṅkāṃśuparītabhālaphalakāṃ bālārkakoṭiprabhāṃ jvālābaddhamahārgharatnanicayāṃ kandarpadarpojjvalām | śūlāsyaṅkuśapāśaveṇumusalāmbhojābhayān bibhratīṃ bhakteṣṭāṃ (g: bhaktaiḥ pūjitapādapadmayugalāṃ śrīcchinnamastāṃ bhaje) chinnamastakāṃ bhagavatīṃ dhyāye hṛdabje sadā || 27 ||
dakṣiṇākālikāyāśca dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi niḥsṛtam | granthe kālīrahasye'smin parvateśvaranandini || 28 ||
brahmopendraśivāsthimuṇḍaraśanāṃ tāmbūlaraktādharāṃ varṣāmeghanibhāṃ triśūlamusale padmāsipāśāṅkuśān |
śaṅkhaṃ sāhiyugaṃ varaṃ daśabhujaiḥ saṃvibhratīṃ pretagāṃ devīṃ dakṣiṇakālikāṃ bhagavatīṃ raktāmbarāṃ tāṃ smare || 29 ||
atha vakṣyāmi śyāmāyā dhyānaṃ parvatanandini | śyāmātantre mayākhyātaṃ sakalāgamasāgare || 30 ||
trailokyapūjitapadāmburuhadvayāṃ tāṃ kṛṣṇāmbubhṛtsadṛśarūpadharāṃ trinetrām | śūlāsiśaṅkhamahatīśca bhujairvahantīṃ śyāmāṃ bhaje śavaśarīrakṛtāsanasthām || 31 ||
athāhaṃ kālarātryāste dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi niḥsṛtam | mayā viracite devi tantre vai vāmakeśvare || 32 ||
śūlābjapāśāṅkuśapadmahastāṃ caturbhujāṃ dhūmranibhāṃ trinetrām | siṃhāsanasthāṃ dhṛtapītavastrāṃ dhyāye maheśīṃ hṛdi kālarātrīm || 33 ||
nānābharaṇasaṃyukte devi vakṣyāmi tvaṃ śṛṇu | śrīvajrayoginīdhyānaṃ niḥsṛtaṃ kulikārṇave || 34 ||
indvagnisūryanayanāṃ pāśāṅkuśadharāṃ śivām (k: parāṃ; g: śubhāṃ) | dvibhujāṃ siṃhamadhyasthāṃ bhaje'haṃ vajrayoginīm (k, g, gh: abhayaṅkarīm) || 35 ||
atha vakṣyāmi vārāhyā dhyānaṃ tantraviniścitam | yathābhīṣṭapradaṃ devi kulacūḍāmaṇau priye || 36 ||
candrārdhacūḍāṃ dvibhujāṃ bhujābhyāṃ śūlāṅkuśau śyāmamukhīṃ vahantīm | sūryāgnicandrīkṛtanetrapadmāṃ (k: dṛṣṭipātāṃ) dhyāye hṛdabje vimalāṃ varāhīm || 37 ||
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi śāradādhyānamuttamam | śāradāpaṭale granthe racite'pi mayā svayam || 38 ||
ṣaḍbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ smitānanāṃ śāṇḍilyarṣinutapādapaṅkajām | parvatasthitavatīṃ dhṛtaśūlāṃ śāradāṃ bhagavatīṃ hṛdi dhyāye || 39 ||
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi tvaṃ śṛṇu dhyānamuttamam | kāmeśvaryāstripurāyāḥ sarvasve tantrakottame || 40 ||
trilocanāṃ sūryasahasraśobhāṃ siṃhāsanasthāṃ dvibhujāṃ dhṛtāsim | pītāmbarāṃ viṣṇumaheśasevyāṃ kāmeśvarīṃ tāṃ hṛdaye smarāmi || 41 ||
atha vakṣyāmi gauryāste dhyānaṃ bhairavatantrake | granthe mayā viracite parvateśvaranandini || 42 ||
gaurāṅgīṃ dhṛtapaṅkajāṃ trinayanāṃ śvetāmbarāṃ siṃhagāṃ candrodbhāsitaśekharāṃ smitamukhīṃ dorbhyāṃ vahantīṃ gadām | viṣṇvindrāmbujayoniśambhutridaśaiḥ saṃpūjitāṅghridvayāṃ gaurīṃ mānasapaṅkaje bhagavatīṃ bhakteṣṭadāṃ tāṃ bhaje || 43 ||
athāhamannapūrṇāyā dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi tvaṃ śṛṇu | niḥsṛtaṃ bhairavītantre mayā devi prakāśite || 44 ||
candrārdhamauliṃ dvibhujāṃ trinetrāṃ śūlākṣamāle dvibhuje vahantīm | eṇāsanasthāṃ bhujagopavītāṃ tāmannapūrṇāṃ hṛdaye smarāmi || 45 ||
kulavāgīśvarīdhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi tvaṃ śṛṇu priye |
āgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ durlabhāyāṃ mamāpi ca || 46 ||
triśūlāsidharāṃ dorbhyāṃ raktāsyāṃ vahnisannibhām | tryakṣāṃ siṃhāsanagatāṃ kulavāgīśvarīṃ bhaje || 47 ||
atha vakṣye gaṇeśasya dhyānaṃ gīrbāṇapūjite | āgamāmṛtapīyūṣe ( g: rṇava) durlabhe bhuvane'mbike || 48 ||
dvicaturdaśavarṇabhūṣitāṅgaṃ musalāmbhojadharoragopavītam | dvimṛgādhipagāminaṃ trinetraṃ śivaputraṃ dviradānanaṃ bhaje'ham || 49 ||
atha dhyānaṃ kumārasya vakṣyāmi śṛṇu pārvati | niḥsṛtamāgamoddyote mayā viracite svayam || 50 ||
himādrigauraṃ (g: śvetaṃ) dvibhujaṃ bhujaṅgaiḥ parītagātraṃ śikhiviṣṭarastham | nagendrakanyāpriyaputramādyaṃ hṛdi smare'bhīṣṭapradaṃ kumāram || 51 ||
haihayasya bravīmyevaṃ dhyānaṃ tava kutūhalāt | yathābhīṣṭapradaṃ nṝṇāmuḍḍāmaraviniścitam || 52 ||
sahasrabhujamaṇḍalījitatamīcareśādhipaṃ himāṃśusadṛśānanaṃ dhṛtasahasratūṇīrakam | sitāmbaradharaṃ sadā turagarājamadhyasthitaṃ smarāmi bhuvanādhipaṃ hṛdi tu kārtavīryārjunam || 23 ||
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi dhyānaṃ tasya viniḥsṛtam | mṛtyuñjayasya devasya granthe kubjāśiromaṇau || 54 ||
candrodbhāsitamūrdhajaṃ surapatiṃ pīyūṣapātraṃ bṛhad hastābjena sudhāṃśukoṭivimalaṃ hastasthapaṅkeruham (g: candrāmṛtāplāvitaṃ) | sūryāgnīnduvilocanaṃ karatalaiḥ pāśākṣasūtrāṅkuśāmbhojānvibhratamakṣayaṃ paśupatiṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ taṃ smare || 55 ||
sugrīvasyātha vakṣye'haṃ dhyānaṃ parvatanandini | kulacūḍāmaṇau granthe nirmite mantrasāgare || 56 ||
bālaṃ ṣoḍaśahāyanaṃ kapipatiṃ vahniprabhābhāsvaraṃ dorbhirvṛkṣagadādhanuḥśaracayān saṃbibhrataṃ cādarāt (g: sādarāt) sītāmārgaṇasaktavānarabalairārādhyamānaṃ bhaje kākutsthaṃ bhajamānamarkatanayaṃ sugrīvadevaṃ hṛdi || 57 ||
athāhaṃ te hanumato dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi niḥsṛtam | kulacūḍāmaṇau granthe parvateśvaranandini || 58 ||
rāmeṣṭamitraṃ jagadekavīraṃ plavaṅgarājendrakṛtapraṇāmam | sumeruśṛṅgābhamacintyamādyaṃ hṛdi smare'haṃ hanumantamīḍyam || 59 ||
atha te bhairavasyāhaṃ dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi pārvati | niḥsṛtaṃ bhairave tantre yathābhīṣṭaphalapradam || 60 ||
kapālahastaṃ bhujagopavītaṃ kṛṣṇacchaviṃ daṇḍadharaṃ trinetram | acintyamādyaṃ madhupānasaktaṃ hṛdi smare bhairavamiṣṭadaṃ tam || 61 ||
atha vakṣyāmi sūryasya dhyānaṃ tantraviniścitam |
tripurāsarvasve granthe dakṣiṇāmūrtinā kṛte || 62 ||
pratyakṣadevaṃ viśadaṃ sahasramarīcibhiḥ śobhitabhūmideśam | saptāśvagaṃ saddhvajahastamādyaṃ devaṃ bhaje'haṃ mihiraṃ hṛdabje || 63 ||
atha vakṣyāmi saumyasya dhyānaṃ bhairavatantrake | yathābhīṣṭapradaṃ satyaṃ surāsuranamaskṛte || 64 ||
somātmajaṃ haṃsagataṃ dvibāhuṃ śaṅkhendurūpaṃ hyasipāśahastam | dayānidhiṃ bhūṣaṇabhūṣitāṅgaṃ budhaṃ smare mānasapaṅkaje'ham || 65 ||
atha vakṣyāmi śukrasya dhyānaṃ tantraviniścitam | kubjikāsarvasve granthe brahmaṇaiva prakāśite || 66 ||
santaptakāñcananibhaṃ dvibhujaṃ dayāluṃ pītāmbaraṃ dhṛtasaroruhadvandvaśūlam | krauñcāsanaṃ hyasurasevitapādapadmaṃ śukraṃ smare dvinayanaṃ hṛdi paṅkaje'ham || 67 ||
atha vakṣyāmi jīvasya śṛṇu pārvati tattvataḥ | dhyānaṃ bhairavatantroktaṃ sakalārthapradaṃ nṛṇām || 68 ||
tejomayaṃ śaktitriśūlahastaṃ surendrajyeṣṭhaiḥ stutapādapadmam | medhānidhiṃ hastigataṃ (g: matsya) dvibāhuṃ guruṃ smare mānasapaṅkaje'ham || 69 ||
atha vakṣyāmi candrasya dhyānaṃ devi śṛṇu priye | niḥsṛtamāgamoddyote nānādhyānasaritpatau || 70 ||
śaṅkhaprabhameṇapriyaṃ śaśāṅkamīśānamaulisthitamīḍyavṛttam (g: rūpam) | tamīpatiṃ nīrajayugmahastaṃ (k: mambuja) dhyāye hṛdabje śaśinaṃ graheśam || 71 ||
atha vakṣyāmi bhaumasya dhyānaṃ tantraviniścitam | āgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priye || 72 ||
prataptagāṅgeyanibhaṃ graheśaṃ siṃhāsanasthaṃ kamalāsihastam | surāsuraiḥ pūjitapādapadmaṃ bhaumaṃ dayāluṃ hṛdaye smarāmi || 73 ||
atha vakṣye śanerdhyānaṃ yathābhīṣṭaphalapradam | niḥsṛtaṃ ca maheśāni śubhadamāgamāmṛte || 74 ||
nīlāñjanābhaṃ mihireṣṭaputraṃ graheśvaraṃ pāśabhujaṅgapāṇim | surāsurāṇāṃ bhayadaṃ dvibāhuṃ śaniṃ smare mānasapaṅkaje'ham || 75 ||
athāhaṃ saiṃhikeyasya dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi tvaṃ śṛṇu | niḥsṛtaṃ phaladaṃ nṝṇāṃ tantre vai vāmakeśvare || 76 ||
śītāṃśumitrāntakamīḍyarūpaṃ ghoraṃ ca vaiḍūryanibhaṃ vibāhum | trailokyarakṣāparamiṣṭadaṃ (g: pradaṃ) ca rāhuṃ grahendraṃ hṛdaye smarāmi || 77 ||
atha vakṣyāmi ketośca dhyānamāgamaniścitam | niḥsṛtamāgamoddyote granthe vai tantrasāgare (kh: mantra) || 78 ||
lāṅgulayuktaṃ bhayadaṃ janānāṃ kṛṣṇāmbubhṛtsannibhamekavīram | kṛṣṇāmbaraṃ śaktitriśūlahastaṃ ketuṃ bhaje mānasapaṅkaje'ham || 79 ||
atha vakṣyāmi deveśi bhavānīdhyānamuttamam | kulacūḍāmaṇau granthe niḥsṛtaṃ bhuvaneśvari || 80 ||
ariśaṅkhakṛpāṇakheṭabāṇān sudhanuḥśūlakatarjanīrdadhānām (k: rdadhānā | bhavatāṃ mahiṣottamāṅgasaṃsthā navadūrvāsadṛśī śriye'stu durgā) | bhayadāṃ mahiṣottamāṅgasaṃsthāṃ navadūrvāsadṛśīṃ bhaje bhavānīm || 81 ||
athāhaṃ bagalāmukhyā dhyānaṃ vakṣyāmi niḥsṛtam | āgamāmṛtamañjaryāṃ surāsuranamaskṛte || 82 ||
nānāratnanibaddharamyamukuṭāṃ pītāmbarāṃ bhāgyadāṃ gharmāṃśvagniśaśāṅkaraśminayanāṃ siṃhāsanasthāṃ śivām | saccaṇḍīśaratāṃ (k: saccaṇḍāṃśunibhāṃ; g: sadragāṅgeyanibhāṃ) mahārghamaṇibhirudbhāsitāṅgīṃ sadā devīṃ śrībagalāmukhīṃ hṛdi bhaje bhakteṣṭadāṃ muktidām || 83 ||
atha vakṣye śṛṇoṣi tvamindrākṣīdhyānamuttamam | niḥsṛtaṃ jagadīśāni granthe vai rudrayāmale || 84 ||
mālāsyaṅkuśapadmayugmakadharāṃ cakṣuḥsahasrāṅkitāṃ (g: sāhasranetrāṃ śivāṃ) mattairāvaṇapṛṣṭhagāṃ śaśimukhīṃ trailokyarakṣāparām | dorbhirgānaratāṃ sphuṭāmbujanibhāṃ brahmādidevaiḥ stutāmindrākṣīṃ janamātaraṃ hṛdi bhaje kāruṇyarūpāṃ parām || 85||
atha vakṣye maheśāni khecarīdhyānamuttamam |
yāṃ dhyātvā khecarīṃ yogī jīvanmukto bhavet kalau | granthe bhairavatantrākhye niḥsṛtaṃ tridaśārcite || 86 ||
vinindrakamalotpalairmunibhirarcitāṅghridvayāṃ sitāṃ sitakarāmbujāṃ sitakarojjvalacchekharām | ravīnduśikhilocanāmabhayapustakau bibhratīṃ smarāmi hṛdi khecarīṃ bhuvanamātaraṃ siddhidām || 87 ||
etāsāṃ devadeveśi mantradhyānacayaṃ smṛtam | yasya kasya na dātavyaṃ granthamuddhārakośakam || 88 ||
ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ |
dhanyaḥ sa yasya putrastvaṃ sakalāgamapāragaḥ | jaya tvaṃ svagṛhaṃ gantumājñāpayitumarhasi || 89 ||
dakṣiṇāmūrtiḥ |
gacchadhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve kṣamadhvaṃ kṛpayā mama | ityuktvā munayo jagmuḥ svagṛhaṃ mantralālasāḥ || 90 ||
śrī(-)īśvara uvāca |
dakṣiṇāmūrtinā tena dṛṣṭvā tantrānmanoramān | kṛtamuddhārakośākhyaṃ granthaṃ gopyatamaṃ kuru || 91 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
krītāsmi bhavatānena granthenāhaṃ sureśvara | ityuktvā sumahākuñjaṃ kailāsādreśca jagmatuḥ | ubhau tāvambikā devī devaśca candraśekharaḥ || 92 ||
[iti śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtimuniviracite uddhārakośe sarvāgamasāre ṣoḍaśadevī saptadevī saptakumāra navagraha tridevī khecarīdhyānakośanirūpaṇaṃ saptamaḥ kalpaḥ] || 7 ||
[samāptaścāyamuddhārakośa iti śivam] |
